(82)ben:re15 :rdo stuno nye kyikrung da ga pa ba 'jug gnas bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /

rgyud 'bum/ tshomi (82)0473 dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa/ 3rab tu byed pa dang po/ 3rab tu byed pa gnyis pa/ 10rab tu byed pa gsum pa/ 15rab tu byed pa bzhi pa/ 20rab tu byed pa lnga pa/ 24rab tu byed pa drug pa/ 27rab tu byed pa bdun pa/ 31rab tu byed pa brgyad pa/ 32rab tu byed pa dgu pa/ 33rab tu byed pa bcu pa/ 34rab tu byed pa bcu gcig pa/ 36rab tu byed pa bcu gnyis pa/ 381

rab tu byed pa bcu gsum pa/ 40rab tu byed pa bcu bzhi pa/ 42rab tu byed pa bco lnga pa/ 42rab tu byed pa bcu drug pa/ 45rab tu byed pa bcu bdun pa/ 46rab tu byed pa bco brgyad pa/ 46rab tu byed pa bcu dgu pa/ 47rab tu byed pa nyi shu pa/ 48rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ 50rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ 51rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ 53rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ 54rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ 55rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ /7rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ 58rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ 61rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ 62rab tu byed pa sum cu pa/ 63rab tu byed pa sum cu so gcig pa/ 64rab tu byed pa sum cu so gnyis pa/ 65rab tu byed pa sum cu so gsum pa/ 67rab tu byed pa sum cu so bzhi pa/ 70rab tu byed pa sum cu so lnga pa/ 72rab tu byed pa sum cu so drug pa/ 732

rab tu byed pa sum cu so bdun pa/ 77rab tu byed pa sum cu so brgyad pa/ 78rab tu byed pa sum cu so dgu pa/ 80rab tu byed pa bzhi bcu pa/ 81rab tu byed pa bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa/ 82slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pa las rim par brgyud pa/ dpal nā ro pa'i slob ma kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta a kā ra sirnyi dang / lo tsa sdu ṭā/ slong tshul khrims kyis zhus shing gtan bsdur mchan/(84) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(88)0474 dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud ces bya ba/ 89dang po/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro byin gyis rlob pa'i le'u/ 89gnyis pa/ sngags kyi le'u/ 94gsum pa/ ri mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ 96bzhi pa/ phan yon dang bcas par dbang bskur ba'i le'u/ 98lnga pa/ lha'i le'u/ 101drug pa/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i ye shes bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 107bdun pa/ sbyin sreg gi le'u/ 112brgyad pa/ byang chub kyi snying po'i rgyan gtsug tor 'byung ba'i le'u/ 116dgu pa/ ye shes gsum gyi mtshan 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 118bcu pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro khro bo'i sbyor bas dgra bsad pa'i le'u/ 120bcu gcig pa/ rgyud thams cad dbye ba'i le'u/ 121bcu gnyis pa/ dam tshig dang sdom pa dbye ba'i le'u/ 123bcu gsum pa/ ro langs chen mo'i le'u/ 1263

bcu bzhi pa/ bla ma bkur ba'i le'u/ 128bco lnga pa/ dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i shes rab kyi mtshan nyid brtag pa'i le'u/ 130bcu drug pa/ shes byed kun du spyod pa'i le'u/ 132bcu bdun pa/ 134rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la gusta dang /bod kyi lots+tsha ba chen po mnga' bdag lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(139) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(15)0475 'phags pa gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po/ 150dang po/ rnam par 'god pa'i le'u/ 15༷gnyis pa/ ye shes rigs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u/ 161gsum pa/ rigs bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u/ 165bzhi pa/ chos kyi dkyil 'khor gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u/ 171lnga pa/ 'dod pa'i rigs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u/ 174drug pa/ dngos grub thams cad kyi dam tshig gi ye shes mchog gi le'u/ 177bdun pa/ dang po'i ye shes kun las btus pa'i le'u/ 179brgyad pa/ dam tshig thams cad kyi sgrub thabs chen po gsang ba'i mchod pa'i le'u/ 182dgu pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes khong du chud par byed pa zhes bya ba'i mchog tu gsang chen gyi le'u/ 187bcu pa/ dam tshig gi le'u/ 190

bcu gcig pa/ bsam gtan chen po'i le'u/ 193bcu gnyis pa/ sems dpa' chen po skyed par byed pa'i le'u/ 201bcu gsum pa/ rig ma'i tshul la sogs pa'i las can gyi le'u/ 202bcu bzhi pa/ rig ma'i las kyi le'u/ 207bco lnga pa/ sngags thams cad kyi rdo rje 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 208bcu drug pa/ sngags thams cad kun las btus pa'i le'u/ 226bcu bdun pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad skyod pa'i le'u/ 227bco brgyad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba rdo rje sems dpa' mnyes par byed pa'i le'u/ 228bcu dgu pa/ gsang ba chen po'i le'u/ 230nyi shu pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngags yid bzhin nor bu'i le'u/ 232nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ sngags thams cad kun las btus pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u/ 240nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs yongs su dag pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi rdo rje zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 244mkhan chen thar pa lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe'i gseb nas shog yar lnga byung ba sngar bsgyur ba las/phyis nyang stod smon 'gro'i gtsug lag khang nas rgya dpe lhag ma rnams rnyed nas bu ston gyis bsgyur/dus phyis jing gir rigs kyi skad rigs smra ba'i lo tsā ba mgon po skyabs kyis/ rgya'i bka' 'gyur nang gi rgya gar paṇa chen dā na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur ba'i rgyud dpe tshang ma las blangs te ji nus bzhin bod skad du bsgyur/bsdur mchad/(27) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(265)

0476 dpal de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba rnal 'byor chen po rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba mnyam pa nyid gnyis su med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rdo rje dpal mchog chen po brtag pa dang po'o// 266rdo rje mi 'gyur ba zhes bya ba'i brtag pa'i rgyal po dang po/ 266dang po/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid la gnas pa'i le'u/ 266gnyis pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi snying po gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rdo rje gsum bstan pa'i le'u/ 269gsum pa/ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bla na med par bstan pa'i le'u/ 273bzhi pa/ phyag rgya chen po sgrub pa'i don bstan pa'i le'u/ 275lnga pa/ phyag rgya chen po nges par 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 278drug pa/ ting nge 'dzin bla na med pa mchog tu bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/281bdun pa/ dngos grub mchog tu bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 283brgyad pa/ dkyil 'khor chen po gsang bar ston pa'i le'u/ 286dgu pa/ mchod pa dang gsang sngags mngon par 'byung ba rdo rje sgyu 'phrul ston pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 290bcu pa/ gsang ba chen po'i byang chub kyi sems rab tu 'byung ba ston pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 295bcu gcig pa/ gsang ba chen po rab tu rgyas pa'i mchod cing bstod pa'i le'u/ 302brtag pa gnyis pa rnam par nges pa gsal ba zhes bya ba/ 305bcu gnyis pa/ 'dus pa chen po gsang ba'i mchod pa thog mar bstan pa'i le'u/ 3056

bcu gsum pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i kun tu spyod pa'i snang ba ston pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 313bcu bzhi pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba bstan pa mi phyed pa'i le'u/ 318bco lnga pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par rol pa ston pa'i le'u/ 323bcu drug pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba rab tu bstan pa'i le'u/ 328bcu bdun pa/ rab tu mi gnas pa'i ye shes bstan pa'i le'u/ 334bco brgyad pa/ 'byung 'jug gnas par dag pa kun du ye shes ston pa'i le'u/ 339bcu dgu pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa nye bar bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 343le'u nyi shu pa/ 348nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ dman pa'i spyod pa las ring zhing lam bde ba chen pos ye shes la rol pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 353nyer gnyis pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen gyi gnas nges par bstan pa mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes gtan la phab pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 362brtag pa gsum pa rdo rje gsang ba ye zhes 'byung ba'i rgyal po zhes bya ba/ 373nyer gsum pa/ shin tu bde ba chen po'i gnas mngon par ston pa'i le'u/373nyer bzhi pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bstan pa'i le'u/ 379nyer lnga pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes mngon par rol pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 3847

nyer drug pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mdzad pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 390nyer bdun pa/ gsang ba chen po'i ye shes kyi don gtan la phab pa'i le'u/ 396nyer brgyad pa/ dag pa'i skyes bu bstan pa'i le'u/ 401nyer dgu pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bde ba mi 'gyur ba'i don bstan pa'i le'u/ 406sum cu pa/ 'gro ba 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 411sum cu gcig pa/ rnal 'byor chen po'i 'dul ba don yod pa'i mchog bstan pa'i le'u/ 416so gcig pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin bstan pa'i le'u/ 421so gnyis pa/ mnyam pa nyid 'byung bar bstan par gyur pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 427gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud kyi brtag pa bzhipa/ 441so bzhi pa/ chos kyi tshul bsdu ba mngon par byang chub pa'i le'u/ 441so lnga pa/ yongs su dag pa'i gnas rdo rje'i le'u/ 447so drug pa/ gsang ba bla na med pa'i don yongs su skyong ba'i le'u/ 452so bdun pa/ theg pa'i lam rnam par dag pa'i gnas bstan pa'i le'u/ 457so brgyad pa/ gsang ba dag pa mchog gi le'u/ 462so dgu pa/ dag pa de bzhin nyid kyi cho ga ston pa'i le'u/ 467bzhi bcu pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid kyi don 'byung ba rdo rje'i le'u/ 471zhe gcig pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'dus pa chen po'i le'u/ 480

bzhi bcu gnyis pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rab tu mi gnas pa'i don bstan pa'i le'u/ 485bzhi bcu gsum pa/ gsang ba yongs su mi zad pa'i 'byung gnas su bstan pa'i le'u/ goXbazhi bcu bzhi pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas gsang ba chen po thun mong ma yin pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ go5brtag pa lnga pa dri med pa'i ye shes byin gyis brlab pa zhes bya ba/ 511bzhi bcu lnga pa/ gsang ba'i lha mo'i mchod pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 511bzhi bcu drug pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes dri ma med pa gnas pa'i le'u/ 517bzhi bcu bdun pa/ lhag pa'i ye shes 'byung bar bstan pa'i le'u/ 522bzhi bcu brgyad pa/ srung ba yongs su dag pa dang bar chad med pa'i don bstan pa'i le'u/ 527bzhi bcu dgu pa/ gdon la yongs su dag cing kun du mchod pa'i le'u/ 532lnga bcu pa/ gsang chen thun mong ma yin pa'i rab tu byed pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 538lnga bcu gcig pa/ rab tu mi gnas pa'i don bstan pa'i le'u/ 544lnga bcu gnyis pa/ sde snod kyi tshul yongs su dag par spyod pa'i le'u/ 548lnga bcu gsum pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsum gyi zhing khams bstan pa'i spyod yul bla na med pa'i le'u/ 553lnga bcu bzhi pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyud kyi don bstan pa'i le'u/ 559lnga bcu lnga pa/ gsang ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor rab tu ston pa rdo rje'i le'u/ 5659

brtag pa drug pa gsang ba ye zhes rdo rje byin gyis rlob pa'i rgyal po/ 592lnga bcu drug pa/ dbyings dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don gyi le'u/ 592lnga bcu bdun pa/ rigs kyi dkyil 'khor 'byung gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 598lnga bcu brgyad pa/ gsang ba bla na med pa'i lam yongs su rdzogs par ston pa'i le'u/ 603lnga bcu dgu pa/ ye shes nges par byed pa gnas gtan la dbab pa'i don gyi le'u/ 609drug cu pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nor bu'i tog gi rgyal po'i ngo bo'i le'u/ 614drug cu gcig pa/ de bzhin nyid yid la byed pa med par ston pa rdo rje'i le'u/ 618drug cu gnyis pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpal mchog chen po de kho na nyid 'byung ba bstan pa'i le'u/ 623drug cu gsum pa/ gsang ba dag pa chen po'i tshul bstan pa'i le'u/ 627drug cu bzhi pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid gcig par ston pa rdo rje'i le'u/ 632drug cu lnga pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rmad du gyur pa ston pa'i le'u/ 637drug cu drug pa/ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po rol pa mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 648rtog pa'i rgyal po bdun pa/ 662drug cu bdun pa/ gsang sngags dang mchod pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 66210

drug cu brgyad pa/ dbang bskur ba chen po tshad med pa rdo rje'i le'u/ 672drug cu dgu pa/ las phran tshegs bstan pa dang spyod pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 688bdun cu pa/ snying po mchog tu bskul ba dang yongs su dag par ston pa'i le'u/ 698don gcig pa/ mchog tu gsang ba dang / spyod pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 715bdun cu gnyis pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis sems can gyi khams bskyed pa dang bsdu ba'i don bstan pa'i le'u/ 722bdun cu gsum pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la gnas par bstan pa'i le'u/ 728bdun cu bzhi pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin rnam par dag cing don dam pa'i gnas kyi dag pa chen po de kho na nyid bstan pa'i le'u/ 740bdun cu rtsa lnga pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dngos po thams cad phyin ci ma log pa dag pa bsam pa sna tshogs pa'i don rab tu bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 752bdun cu rtsa drug pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor rab tu gsang ba bdud rtsi dag par ston pa rgyal po'i le'u/ 761bdun cu rtsa bdun pa/ chos thams cad la bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don bstan pa'i le'u/ 272rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal ye shes snying po dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba mar pa lho brag pa chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(789) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(833)11

༷4lo ge/rmyu1)stso cho/〉〉ci 49 5 ༷ mig rdzu 'i r+shan 0 dzhadzā/14 zla 4rdzu dri'ur murngo te / sgo ho la la la khaji ga no /sdu ༵/skyo / (the tsho723 sta ra ri rami/ba 〉snyi snga shi47 99sgo 1665 zi te༈ choX rgyu (64 tsho ku rdzo/ ༄ /lhapa'i 3bye ( 914 7)ga(2rke rirdo rdzo shākaX ( rngo sa pha ba tsho rje17 5tsho(74༷sa/54 sgo tsho pa)bye/81༷ po sgo༄ ༄snyen/ zhe༄stong4) 4༄rdo|11 9 ge / snal ne ( ( rke 4 / kye ) lo 17 ༄ ༄ ༄ la he rmiX4cha ra rdo jo ga byu mo/sa 978 ༷tsha( / byu nga/siXng te (54migs nga 'aXrings paXshāri4 775 4 tshang7 4rwa// lko ༄ rine snyeX sisgro1la sko ba sku pa 〉 ripā che lko ga sa sdeX ge 4 74 4 r+shaX/wa rwa tho —— — 374 shā 'o 〉gal zlar pa sa4 44 sa shāX 4 3 4 3 29 tshoskye ྅ nā rirwa gats+tshan+tu/shā ༵༵ rdo she tshakhri ra tārnya lto 4 5 snye la5

༄gi /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa/①༄dzi /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tshwa na badz+ra sa muts+tsha ya/ bod skad du/dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus ②pa/ dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa yis/ /dus gcig tshe na bcom ldan 'das / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba'i dbyings su bdag nyid kyis/ /ye shes ngo bor bzhugs gyur pas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /ro mnyam dam tshig rdo rje nyid/ /mi phyed ting 'dzin snyoms zhugs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /sems dpa' chen po byams pa sogs/ /rnams kyis lizhus shing gsol btab ni/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la zhus/ /ma rig pa dang sems byung dang / /sems zhes bgyi ba ji ltar lags/ /de skad ces ni gsol pa dang / /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs kun gyi/ /sku gsung thugs nyid rdo rje yi/ /bdag nyid can gyis (pebaka' stsal pa/ /rigs kyi bu 82—3

rnams legs nyon cig /ye shes gsum ni rdo rje las/ /byang sems rdo rje de bzhin nyid/ /yang dag 'byung ba de yi phyir/ /ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin ni/ /de yi don ni 'di lta ste/ /ye shes gsum ni dag pa'i sems snang ba gsum gyi 'byung gnas rdo rje las mi phyed pa rlung rig tha mi dad du gnas pa nyid de/ byang chub sems ni kun rdzob don dam dbyer med pa ste/ rdo rje de bzhin nyid ni gdod 1ma nas lhun gyis grub pa'i chos nyid las yang dag par 'byung ba ni/chos thams cad kyi ngo bo bde chen/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las na'abyung zhing 'jug la gnas pa de'i phyir na/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ye shes rdo rje rlung sems dbyer med thogs pa med pas khyab cing dbang byed pa nyid do / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi dgongs pa ni/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa nyid/ /mngon par byang chub nyid las rab 'byung ba/ /rlung rig dbyer med pa las dus kun tu/ /snang ba gsum du shar ba 'gag pa med/ /de nyid lhan cig skyes par rab rtogs bya/ /yang dag don ni zab pa ste/ /rdo rje'i ngo bor yang dag bshad kyi don la ni/ /gsang ba yang dag 4byang chub snyesems / /rlung sems dbyer med chos nyid las/ /zab pa mi 'gyur rang rig ni / /spros 5med 'gag pa med cing zhi/ /skye med mnyam nyid ngang las ni/ /rtogs pa med kyang rgyu rkyen las/ /shes pa ma rig de nyid ni/ /'byung gnas thog ma mtha' ma med/ /de las lhan skyes ma rig pa/ /nye bar thob pa dngos med pa/ /bdag med thams cad snying po las/ /snang med pa las ma 'gags nepas / /rim pa ma yin 'char ba yang / /zab pa stong chen por 'byung ba'i/ /ma rig pa las rkyen snang ba/ /snang ba thob pa mi rtog pa/ /de las rang bzhin 82—4

sems las byung / /de las snang ba mched pa ste/ /shin tu gsal zhing stong pa che / /sems las 'byung ba'i rgyan dag ni/ /rgyu dang mig yul dbang po dang 1/ /mtshungs pa'i de ma thag pa las/ /sems zhes bya ba 'byung ba ste/ /de ni snang ba'i don dang ni/ /stong pa nyid du gsungs pa yin/ /sems ni don la gnas pa ste/ /sems byung bye brag rnam par ston/ /ma rig de nyid chos nyid den/ /chos nyid bdag nyid mi gnas pas/ /snang dang stong pa de dag ni/ /gsum gsum spros dpa med 'byung ba/ /'od gsal ngang las 'byung ba ste/ /gsal bde stong pa dbyer med pas/ /rdo rje byang sems ngo bor bstan/ /ces pas bstan te/ de nas byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' de dag de'i dus la shin tu ngo mtshar can du ngo mtshar skyes te cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ sku dang gsung dang lathugs rdo rje'i bdag nyid can gyi5/ byang chub sems dpa' de rnams cang mi smra bar gyur pa gzigs nas bka' stsal pa ci'i phyir cang mi smra bar 'dug /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal te/ mgo bos gtugs 6 te gzhan yang zhus pa/ e ma ho ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /rtogs par dka' ba'i rnam shes ni/ /gsum gyi dbye ba mchog zab pa/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad du gsol/ /bde bar gshegs pas gsung du gsol/ /de skad ces ni zhus pa dang / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gang dag 'od gsal las byung de nyid ni/ /sems dang yid dang rnam par shes pa zhes/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa bar gyur pa ste/ /kun nyon mongs dang rnam par byang ba yi/ /bdag nyid de las rtogs pa gnyis rig 782—5

byed / /rnam shes de yi bzhon pa rlung yin te/ /rlung las me dang me las chu 'byung zhing / /chu las sa yang rab tu 'byung bar bshad/ /de rnams 'dus las phung po lnga nyid dang / /skye mched drug dang yul lngar snang ba gang / /de dag rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba ste/ /rlung dang rnam shes nye bar 'dres pa'o/ /de nas rnam par shes pa gsum gyis ni/ /rang bzhin gyi ni snang bar rab gsal bar / /spyod pa rjes su myong bar byed pa'o/ /snang ba'i rgyu 'bras kyis ni rang bzhin rnams/ /yang dag par yang rab tu 'byung ba dang / /mi lam sgyu ma ltar ni snang ba'o/ /de yang 'od gsal gnas pa med pa dang / /'gag pa dang ni skye ba med pa ste/ /don dam bden pa yang dag pa yi mtha'/ /de las 'byung ba mun pa'i snang ba ni/ /'gog pa ma rig pa zhes bya bar bstan(1)/ /de yi rang bzhin snang ba dang / /'khrul dang rnam par g.yeng ba dang / /dran pa med dang le lo dang / /mi smra ba dang mi gsal ba'o/ /ma rig pa yang sems las byung ba ste / /ngo bo chos nyid rnam par mi rtog pa/ /mar me ltar 'bar snang ba nyer thob las/ /rlung gi khams nyid phra bar 'jug pas ni/ /ma ning ltar ni shes dang mi gsal ba'o/ /nyi ma'i snang ba lta bur bstan pa dang / /shin tu gsal ba'i smig rgyu lta bu ste/ /de yi rang bzhin chags dang dga' ba dang / /mchog tu dga' dang drag po la sogs pa'o/ /kun rdzob tu ni mngon sum gyis bstan dang ske/ /skyes pa'i gzugs dang yab lha'i tshogs dag dang / /mtshan ma rdo rje zhes ni rang brtags pa'o/ /sems las sems zhes bshad pa yin/ /zla ba'i snang dang shin tu gsal ba ste/ / chu yi 2zla ba lta bur bstan pa'o/ /rang bzhin ni 'dod chags dang bral ba la sogs pa'o/ /kun rdzob tu gsal ba las/82wa 6

bud med dang / bha ga dang / pad+ma dang lha mo'i tshogs kyi brda'o/ /'dir chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ gang dag 'od gsal las byung de nyid ni chos nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa 'od gsal dbyings las/ rig pa rtog med kyi shes pa phra ba'i rlung dang lhan cig tu 'byung bas na/ sems ni kun gzhi'o/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni spro ba dang sdud ①par byed pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa ni tshogs brgyad dang ldan pa'o/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa bar gyur pa ni/ byang chub kyi sems mi 'gyur ba rdo rje nam mkha' mnyam pa nyid do/ /sa bon ma dag pa las 'gro ba 'khrul pa kun nas nyon mongs par snang la/ bag chags dag las 'khrul pa las log (shepa/ rnam par byang ba nyid du yang dag par snang ba'o/ /phyi rol pas brtags (shepa'i tha snyad sna tshogs pa bdag tu brtags 2)pa de las/ rtog pa gnyis su gyur pa ste/ gzung 'dzin du 'byung ba'o/ /bdag dang gzhan ni bdag dang bdag gi bar 'dzin pa gnyis su brtags (zhesapas/ dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa/ sems su rig par byed pa nyid do/ /de las rnam par shes pa nyid du snang / de nyid du chos nyid kyi rlung las/ 'od snang rang byung gi snang bar shar ba'o/ /der las rlung las kun du g.yo bas/ chags pa las me byung / bsrub pa las zhe sdang gi chu snang ske/ drod gsher las gti mug gi 56)sa'i khams bskyed cing / der 'byung ba lnga lhan cig tu tshogs shing 'dus pa las/ rtsa kun gzhi'i rig pa snying ga tsam du brten te/ de las gzung 'dzin du 'khrul pa las/ de rnams 'dus pa las phung po lnga dang ni skye mched drug dang yul lngar snang ba ste/ de nyid rlung dang rnam shes tha dad med par nye bar 'dres pas/ 'gag pa med pa kun du snang ba rten 782—7

cing 'brel par 'byung ba nyid du'o/ /chos nyid rtog med kyi ngang las/ rlung dang lhan cig tu 'byung bas/ srid pa bar dor yul la (3)spyod tshul ni/ de nas rnam par shes pa gsum gyi ni/ rkyen las 'char ba'i snang ba dang / snang ba mched pa dang / snang ba thob pa ste/ rgyu'i rkyen dang / dmigs pa dang /dbang po bdag po dang / mtshungs pa de ma thag pa las/ mngon par 'byung ba / rtog pa dang ldan pa'i rang bzhin gyi snang ba/ rang bzhin sum cu ( rtsa gsum dang / mtshan nyid bzhi bcu dang ma rig pa'i skad (kyecig ma bdun du rab tu gsal bar nyin dang mtshan du spyod pas/ rjes su nyams su myong bar byed pa ma dag pa'i dus so/ /yang rlung dal zhing rig pa cung zad gnas pa'i tshe/snang ba gsum gyi rgyu 'bras thams cad sgyu ma lta bur gyur pas/ rang bzhin rnam pa thams cad ye shes kyi ngang du rang dag rang zhi rang sar grol bas/ yang dag par rab tu 'byung ba/ de bzhin nyid du bde ba/ gsal ba/ stong zhing bdag med pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'char bas/ bag chags rnam par dag pa'i bar dor mi lam gyi bar dor lus ngag sgyu ma ltar kun du snang ba'o/ /sgyu lus kyi snang ba de nyid kun rdzob kyi spyod pa dag par byed pa'i phyir/ de yang 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug pas ril por 'dzin pa dang / rjes su gzhig pa'i bsam gtan gyis lhan cig skyes pa'i dri ma rnam par dag pa'i tshe/ gang la yang gnas pa med pa dang / chos rnams kun la 'gag pa med pa dang /gnas pa med cing / skye ba med pa ste/ spros med don dam pa'i bden pa rab tu mi gnas pa'i don/ yang dag pa'i mtha' snang ba med pa zhes bya'o/ /de nyid las ni lugs las bzlog gyur pa'i/ /mun pa lta bu'i snang ba phra rlung las/ /82—8

'gog pa ma rig pa zhes bya bar bstan/ / de yi 1rang bzhin snang ba 'byung ba dang ske/ /'khrul dang rnam g.yeng the tshom dang / /brjed ngas pa dang le lo dang ske/ /mi smra gyur dang skyo gyur pa'o/ /ma rig pa yang sems las byung ba ste/ /snang ba nyer thob mar me ltar 'bar las/ /ngo bo chos nyid rnam par mi rtog pa/ /rlung gi khams nyid phra bar 'jug pas ni/ /ma ning ltar ni shes pa ma g.yos pa'o / /pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte bar ldan pa la/ /stong pa bzhi bcas ma ning yi ge gnas / /hrīḥni thig le ldan pa dbus su dmigs/ /snang ba thob pa nyid kyi don 'di'o / /snang ba mched pa nyi ma lta bur bstan/ /shin tu gsal ba smig rgyu 2 lta bu ste/ /de yi rang bzhin 'dod chags dga' ba dang / /mchog tu dga' ba drag po la sogs pa'o/ /kun rdzob tu ni mngon sum gyis bstan dang / /skyes pa'i gzugs dang lha yi 2tshogs dag dang 4/ /mtshan ma rdo rje zhes ni rang brtags pa'o/ /pad+ma de nyid lte bar nyi ma'i dal/ /dbus su rdo rje thig le ldan pa la/ /kā li gsal byed yi ge sum cu bdun/ /snang ba mched pa de nyid gsal ba'o/ /sems las byung ba la ni sems zhes 5bshad/ /zla 6ba'i snang ba rab tu gsal ba ste/ / chu yi 7zla ba lta bur bstan pa'o/ /rang bzhin chags pa dang bral la sogs pa'o/ /kun rdzob gsal ba las ni bud med dang / /bha ga pad+ma lha mo'i tshogs kyi brda'o/ /snga ma ltar las zla dbus pad+mar bcas/ /dbyangs yig phyogs su brkyang ba 'od 'bar ba/ /mtshams su zung bcas bcu gnyis rim par dgod/ /gsang sngags 'khor lo rim pa kun rdzogs byed/ /dmigs bcas bzlas pa sems gsum sgyu mar 'char/ /'od gsal ye shes ngang las zung 'jug pa'o/ /snang ba mched pa bde ba ste/ /gzung du med pas 82—9

chags zhen bral/ /nyi ma ltar gsal ngang gis bde/ /'gro 'ong gnas nyid skad cig ma/ /mtshan ma bral ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ /go 'byed mun pa 'joms pa'ol/ /snang ba thob pa'i ye shes sems/ /rnam par mi rtog bdag nyid can/ /ma rig de nyid rnam dag pa/ /mun pa med cing snang ba bral/ /sgron me ltar 'char lhun grub pa/ /g.yo med mi g.yo rnam dag pa'o/ /gnas med chos nyid ngang du dag /stong dang stong pa chen po dang / /shin tu stong pa dngos med pa/ /thams cad stong pa zag pa med/ /nye bar thob pa snang med pa/ /mkha' ltar dag pa 'od gsal ba/ /mnyam med gnyis med phyag rgya che/ /lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi dbyings/ /lhag mthong dmigs pa kun las 'das/ /kun khyab zhi ba spros med pa/ /stong nyid ngang las rtog pa dang / /mi rtog mtha' las 'das pa ste / /chos nyid zab dang rgya che ba'i/ /rgya mtsho chen po rang dngos la/ /rtswa shing g.yo bcas sna tshogs pa/ /steng du lhung zhing 'gro 'ong nyid/ /du mas khebs shing bskyod gyur kyang / /rtog med rang bzhin gnas med pas/ /ro gcig 1'gyur med mkha' ltar ro/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa dang po'o// //rnal 'byor lus nyid sgyu ma rmi lam ltar/ /gnas lus nges par 'gyur ba de nyid las/ /rdo rje pad+ma yang dag par sbyor ba shes rab kyi ye shes rab tu 'byung ba las rang gi rdo rje sbyor ba las me'o/ /me las chu/ chu las nur nur po rnams dang / de nas mer mer po rnams dang / nar nar po dang / gor gor po dag go/ /de nas 'dod chags dang bral ba'i snang ba las te/ khrag gi 82—10

gong bu las mkhrang nyu)'gyur rnams so/ /khyab 'jug rus nasbal gyi rnam pa can de dag pha ma'i khu khrag gudag gis bskyed pa'o/ /de nas dbang po gnyis mnyam par sbyor ba'i chags pa las/ 'dod chags dang bral ba dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba bar ma'i cha las shes par bya ste/ de las rtsa 4/rnams lus la mngon par 'byung ba/ stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa/ kun 'dar ma dang ske/ ro ma dang / brkyang rim dang / lte ba dang / snying ga dang /mgrin pa dang / spyi bo dang / gsang ba dang / mdzod spu'i 'khor lo dag dang ske/ yang na sum cu gnyis dang / rtsa kha gsum pa dang / rtsa lu gu rgyud dang ske/ rtsa ba'i mig lta bu dang / rtsa bar ta ka rin po che'i pho brang dang / rtsa rig pa'i gnas dang / gzhu chen gyi dbyibs dang / bde skyong nor bu'i 'khor lo ste/ dbyibs tha dad du ma las yi ge'i rnam pa sogs 6)srog tu gyur pa snying por gnas pa las/ khams gsum pa'i 'gro ba'i rgyud dpag tu med pa las skyon dang yon tan mtha' dag gi rten can te/ de'i phyir lus dang lus las 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor du 'char ba la sogs pa'i phyag rgya dang / gsung gi bzlas pa'i phyir phyag rgya dang / bsgom pa'i phyag rgya gsum du gyur pa dang / ā li kā li las yang dag par 'byung ba'i sngags dang sems kyi thabs su gyur pa shes rab dang ske/ mi phyed pas bde ba chen po ltar dmigs pa'o/ /yab yum bsrubs pa'i bde ba de nyid las/ /gnas skabs dag las rigs kyi cha thob pa/ /mngon par byang chub ye shes lngar 'byung las/ /lus rdzogs 'byung bas bya ba byed 'gyur ba'o/ /chos rnams kun ni bdag tu bsgrub pa dang / /bdag ni lhar bsgrub lha nyid ye shes so/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i yul dbang po gnyis 82—11

thabs su gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dang pad+ma yang dag par sbyor ba ni/ sems dang sems las 'byung ba dag gi thabs su gyur pa'o/ /sems las byung ba mnyam par sbyor ba'i bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis thabs shes rab ro mnyam par gyur pa'o/ /de sgyu ma lta bu'i dpe nye bar mtshon te/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gaṅgā'i bye ma snyed kyi zhing khams rnams/ sgyu ma lta bu dang / chu zla dang /mig yor dang / smig rgyu 1dang / rmi lam dang / sgra brnyan dang / dri za'i grong khyer dang / mig 'phrul dang / dbang po'i gzhu dang / glog 2dang /chu bur dang / me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis/ bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin nye bar mtshon pa'i tshul lo/ /rdo rje lus kyi rtsa dang rlung / /yi ge thig le gnas pa dag /dbyangs dang gsal byed tshogs rnams las/ /thabs dang shes rab ro mnyam 'char/ /gsal dang bde ba brten pa nyid/ /mi rtog chos nyid dang las ni/ /rlung dang shes pa mnyam du yang / /'byung 'jug gnas pa nyid yin no/ /chos nyid snang ba kun gzhi ste/ /rnam shes ma bcos rang gsal ba/ /sgrib med rang byung kun tu ni/ /g.yo bcas 'gyur med kun tu ni/ /de nyid gnas pa rten gyur pa'o/ /rnam pa sems byung 'char ba yang / /du ma nyid ni go rims 5dang / /go rims 6med pa'i rang bzhin rnams/ /rtog pa'i 'du 'phro rkyen gyis bsgyur/ /chags bral gsum du 'byung ba nyid/ /yid la byed pa 'gro 'ong dang / /rig pa rgod par byed dang yid 'byung ba'o/ /mya ngam gsum ni ma dad pa/ /zhe sdang med pas zhi bar gnas/ /kun tu rtog pa khong khro ba/ /'jigs pa tsam mo 'tshig pa ste / /reg pa khre bo'i spyod pa dang / /'khon du 'dzin nyid 'jigs chen po/ /82—12

srid (1)pa che 'bring gsum 'byung ba/ /nyer len bzhi ste 'chab pa can/ /mi dge bkres (2skom gdung ba po/ /rig 'dzin yid la byed pa bzhi(kyi/ /rig pa po ste gnas pa las/ /tshom 4)par byed pa tshor ba ni/ /rnam pa gsum ste sems pa'ol/ /gnyid dang 'gyod pa rtog dpyod pa/ /ngo tsha shes dang bag yod pa/ /rnam par mi 'tshe snying rje dang / /brtse ba byams pa gsum gsum dang / /dogs dang bsags pa ser sna dang / /phrag dog rtog pa rang bzhin te/ /snang ba'i ngang du spro zhing sdud5kyi/ /chags pa zhen dang dga' ba dang / /dga' zhing shin tu dga' ba ste/ /'dod chags rtogs par 'byung ba'o/ /bde bas yi rme/rangs gti mug med/ /rab tu mgu ba shes rab dang / /ngo mtshar dgod 7 par byed dang tshim/ / 'khyud pa smyo kha sprod 'jib pa dang / /rten pa de nyid ting 'dzin te / /brtson 'grus byed dang rgyal ba dang / /bya dang 'phrog pa las gyur yin/ /stobs ngom rgyags pa dregs byed do/ /mos pas spro bar gyur pa ste/ /lhan cig skyes bdag btang snyoms so/ /tha dad med pa shin tu'o/ /drug po rnam sgeg zhe 99'gras byed/ /bag yod pa yi dge ba ste/ /tshig gsal bden smra dad pa dang / /g.yo med dran pa ldan pa can/ /mi bden pa dang de bzhin nges/ /shes bzhin ma yin ma nges pa/ /nye bar mi len ma chags sems/ /sbyin byed bskul ba mdun pa nyid/ /de bzhin des dang ngo tsha med/ /dpa' bas rnam par 'tshe byed pa/ /bag med pa dang khrel med pa/ /shes bzhin bral ba ma yin pa/ /g.yo sgyu ston pas mi bsrun dang / /gya gyur byed pa rgod bag can/ /'di dag rtog pa 'byung ba ste/ /snang ba mched pa'i shes pa las/ /kun tu rgyu zhing 'jug par byed/ /mtshan nyid 'di dag bstan pa'o/ /chags pa bar ma'i skad 7cig 82—13

ma / /ma rig pa nyid min 1ri pa ltar/ /'thibs shing snang ba med pa'o/ /brjed ngas 2pa dang rmugs pa'o/ /'khrul chen log par lta ba can/ /brjod med 'gog pas 'jug pa zad/ /skyo zhing le lo snyom rin/las byed/ /the tshom gyur pa yid dpyod 4pa/ /ma ning 'byung ba phra ba dang / /rags pa skye 'gag gnas pa las / /bag chags dri ma'i rtog pa kun/ /snang ba thob pa'i de nyid du/ /stong nyid spros pa bral gyur pas/ /rnam par dag pa 'od gsal ba'o/ /nang gi rnam par shes pa de nyid ni/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i chos nyid rtog med pa/ /'od gsal ngo bo stong zhing bdag med pa/ /rlung gis bskyod pas ri5)mtshan ma'i rnam par byung / /de yi skad cig rang bzhin 'byung 'jug pa/ /mtshan ma snang ba gsum du mngon par 'byung / /de bas na 'di dag nges par rtogs pas ji ltar 'o ma dang / til dag gis yang dag pa'i mngon par 'du bya ba med pa dang /til mar gyi 'byung ba de bzhin du sngags dang phyag rgya mngon par 'du bya ba'i rdo rje dang pad+ma mnyam par sbyor ba med par rnam par shes pa gsum nye bar brtag par mi nus so/ /gang du rlung med na kun gzhi rten pa med pa'o/ /gang du kun gzhi'i rten pa med na rnam par shes par mi 'gyur ro/ /rnam par shes pa 6nyid med na gang bha 7ga dang liṅga yang dag par sbyor bar /nus pa med de/des ni bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin mi rnyed do/ /ji ltar 'o ma bsrubs pa las mar dang / ji ltar til mar te/ de bzhin du rdo rje thabs kyi ye shes nye bar brtag pa'i phyir dang / pad+ma shes rab kyi ye shes nye bar brtag pa'i phyir ro//yul 'jug pa med cing / de la sems pa med pas/ rnam par shes pa'i bzhon pa rlung med do/ /de med pas phyi rol 'byung ba chen po bzhi dang / nang 82—14

khams dang skye mched med par 'gyur te/ snang ba gsum du dmigs pa yang mi 'byung bas/ yang dag pa'i mtha' la rab tu 'jug pa med pa na/ zung du 'jug par mi 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems kyi ngo bo nyid/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la/ /mos gus mthar phyin gyur pas ni/ /lam gyi rim pa kun rdzogs pa/ /sgrib dag yon tan thob pa ste/ /dbang gi rgyal ba 1)rnyed pa bzhin/ /las dang dngos grub ma lus pa/ /ye shes mi zad gnas thob bo/ /gang rnal 'byor lam gyi rim pa thams cad cig car 2du rdzogs pa bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis lhag par mos pa tsam gyis/ las dang po pa ril gnas par 'gyur te phyir mi ldog pa la yang gnas par 'gyur ro/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// //spyi don mdo ltar ston pa bdag med pa/ /e ni chos te baṃ ni gang zag gis//stong pa zhi ba dngos po med pa nyid/ /phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad kun / /rang bzhin med pa'i chos rnams thams cad bral/ /blang dor med pa'i ye shes mnyam pa nyid/ /e ni stong nyid spros dang bral ba las/ /baṃ ni thabs mchog snying rje chen por bstan/ /gnyis med mnyam pa byang sems ro gcig pa'ol/ /rnam thar sgo gsum pha rol phyin pa drug /tshad med bzhi dang bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi/ /byang chub phyogs 4chos sum cu rtsa bdun te/ /so so 5yang dag rig dang ma 'dres chos/ /stobs 6bcu mi 'jigs bzhi dang bsrung ba med / /mkhyen pa rgyas pa de nyid kun khyab mdzad/ /e baṃ brtan g.yo snang dang stong pa las/ /phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad ni/ /lha yi bdag nyid 82—15

dkyil 'khor dag tu'o/ /yig don sgra dang tha snyad du ma rnams/ /brtags pa med de 1sna tshogs rkyen gyur las/ /rgyu 'bras rab byed sgyu mar snang ba kun/ /'jig rten rigs byed mtshon byed sgra ldan pa'o/ /'dod chags chos kyi sbas pa zhes bya ba/ /rnal 'byor thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor las/ /sna tshogs dga' ba dang po rjes chags dang / /rnam par smin pa mchog tu bde ba nyid/ /mtshan nyid bral ba skad cig lhan cig skyes/ /bde ba mi 'gyur ye shes phyag rgya che / /rnam par nyid pa dga' bral rjes la'o/ /de nyid snying po bla med byang chub sems/ /bde stong dbyer med byang chub chen po'o/ /kun da 92byang sems ye shes mes sbyangs pas/ /zag med bde bas lus sems rnam dag pa'o/ /'jig rten kun du brtan pa sna tshogs pa/ /de rten 'byung ba 'dus pa'i ri rab dang ske/ /gzhal med khang sogs dngos po 'khrul las snang / /brten pa 'gro brgyud khams gsum sems can kun/ /sgyu ma lta bur skye zhing 'gag par 'gyur / /'khor ba yul dang dbang po rtog par byung / /de bzhin gshegs pa byin gyis brlabs pa las/ /zlog 0byed yang dag kun rdzob lam bstan 95)pas/ /dngos po mtshan mar 6'dzin pa las log nas/ /rang bzhin bden don rtogs tsho7pas byang chub thob/ /'od gsal ba yi de nyid ni/ /shes pa spyi yi khyad par las / /de las sems ni ma bcos pa/ /gnas lugs tsho phyogs su ma lhung bas/ /de yang rtog med chos nyid kyi/ /snang ba gsum du mngon par 'byung / /yul dang yul can gnas skabs las/ /rgya mtsho rab tu dngas 9pa las/ /de las rlung gis bskyod gyur pas/ /rba rlabs 'byung ba ji bzhin du/ /rang bzhin sems byung rtog tshogs byung / /gnas rgyu dus dang rkyen dbang gis/ /gnas 82—16

na 'od gsal stong nyid las/ /rgyu ni rlung sems dbyer med pas/ /dus gsum dus med skad cig mar/ /ngo bo stong pa rlung gis bskyod/ /rkyen las mtshan ma'i chos su snang / /gnas sgrub 91)bye brag tha dad pas/ /rnam shes de nyid 'bul ba dang / /ma 'khrul pa las khyad par du/ /dge dang mi dge sna tshogs las/ /bde sdug nyams su myong gyur pas/ /las dang nyon mongs bag chags las/ /lus ngag yid kyis naspyod par snang / /ma dag dag byed bla ma yi//gdams pas kun las grol bar 'gyur/ /bsod nams bsod nams ma yin las / /rgyu 'bras sna tshogs snang ba yang / /nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang las ni/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i cho 'phrul byung / /de nyid skye med rang bzhin las/ /'gag pa med par gnas pa'o/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba ste/ /de nyid bdag med chos nyid las/ /spros med dngos dang dngos med kyi/ /ma 'dres yongs rdzogs gnas med pa'o/ /rgyar ni go rims rin)bzhin du gnas pa la/ /sdud ( ribyed go rims 'chol 5ba 'khor lo brtan6)/ /dam tshig kun ldan phyag rgya snying po nyid/ /kun dor 'byung lnga lha mo rdo rje dbyings/ /bde chen rdo rje gsang ba phun sum tshogs/ /de nyid mi 'gyur 'byung gnas thim gyur gang / /skad cig rgyan rdzogs bum pa gang ba ltar/ /bdud rtsi gtsug 57)tor ye shes rgyal bar gyur/ /rjod 8)byed 'bru gsum brjod bya badz+ra sgrikari9ci /bya ba rdzogs pa'i rnam par skye ba ste / /snang ba thob pa lhan cig tu gnas pas 7yul ldan pa snang ba mched pa/rtog cing ba'i bye brag la rig pa 'jug pas brad 11pa snang ba'o/ /byams pas gsol pa/ sbas pa'i don gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/kun rdzob bden pas sbas pa ni gang du snod bcud ma lus pa snang ba sgyu ma lta bur 82—17

bdag byin gyis brlab pa rang bzhin gyis bden pa rnam par dag pa'o/ /sems snang ba gsum gyis sbas pa ni gang chos nyid las yang dag par 'byung ba/ thob pa dang / mched pa dang / snang ba ni sems ye shes kun tu rnam par rtog pa med pa bzhin du rang bzhin dang bcas par 'byung ba'o/ /chos kyis sbas pa ni bde ba'i don gang rdo rje dang pad+ma mnyam par sbyar ba'i bde bas/ rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i snang ba gsum nye bar mtshon par byed pa de ni/ bde ba chen po'i go 'phang 1rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni sbas pa'i bshad pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das spyi'i don ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nyan thos la sogs pa 'dod chags dang bral ba'i chos la spyod pa/ rnam par rtog pa'i bag chags las ma grol ba/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud mtha' dag tu/ rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la bzhugs zhes 2bya ba la sogs pa'i 'dod chags kyi chos gsal bar byed pa ngo mtshar gyi rdo rje'i tshig thos nas smod par byed pa de rnams las mi 'gal ba'i sgo nas bshad pa de ni spyi'i don du gsungs pa'o/ /byams pas gsol pa/ yi ge'i don gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / gang yang ā li kā li dasgra'i don la brten nas rjod 94par byed pa/ brjod pa'i mtha'i byed pa/ mtha' dang brjod pa rkyen rnams las rnam par 'byung ba/rab tu byed pa dang bcas pa tha snyad sna tshogs pa la brten nas cha shas tsam du bstan pa'o/ /byams pas gsol pa/ thun mong ma yin pa bla na med pa 'di ltar mthar thug par bshad pa ji ltar bshad pa lags/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams 82—18

la legs so zhes bya ba byin nas/ legs so legs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' snying rje mchog dang ldan pa nyon cig /mtha' ni mu ste/ 'od gsal ba yang dag pa'i tshul zhes bya ba mthar thug pa'o/ /mtha' ldan mtha' bcas grol ba yang dag mtha'akyori/ /mtha' nyid bzlog bral grub mtha' las 'das pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen pos gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das thabs gang gis mthar thug thob pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phung po dang khams dang skye mched la sogs pa'i mtha' snang ba gsum las stong pa gsum mo / /dmigs pa med pa sgyu ma lta bu las stong pa gsum gyi mtha' bde stong 'od gsal ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen pos gsol pa/ stong pa gsum 'od gsal ba'i mthar ji ltar 'gyur ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / ji ltar mes shing bsregs pa ste 'bar bar byed pa de bzhin du 'od gsal bar shes rab kyi snang ba ye shes yun ring pos rnam par sbyong bar byed do/ /ji ltar ta la'i lo ma yang 'bar bar byed pa de bzhin du ste geri'od gsal bar byed pa de bzhin du thabs kyis ye shes la mched pa rnam par sbyong bar byed do/ /ji ltar ras bal gyi 'dab ma bsregs pa de bzhin du snang ba rathob pa'i ye shes mchog tu gyur pas rnam par sbyong bar byed do/ /de'i phyir shing ta la'i lo ma dang ras bal gyi 'dab ma bsregs pas 'bar zhing thal bar gyur pa de bzhin du stong pa dang /stong pa chen po dang / shin tu stong pa dang / thams cad stong pa rnams snang ba canye bar thob pa 'od gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /'od gsal don dam bden pa nyid/ /mnyam nyid ye shes rtogs 5)pas ni/ /dbyings kyi ngang du rtog pa'i tshogs/ /ma dag gnyen po'i byed pa dang / /rgyu rkyen yul spyod dngos po kun/ /rtog med 82—19

rang 'byung me 'bar bas/ /shing gi bye brag sna tshogs dang / /ras bal phung po du ma yang / /tshig cing dngos med byed pa ltar/ /de bzhin gzugs 'dzin ma lus pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi gnas nyid du/ /bsregs shing thim gyur mi gnas pa'o/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /kun rtog ma lus bcom gyur pa'i / /rnam par dag pa'i ye shes kyi/ /mkhyen pa byang chub sems kyi rgyun/ /mi 'gag phrin 1las rgyun mi 'chad/ /mi 'gyur stong nyid bde chen po/ /zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas pa/ /thob tu med las kun du 'byung / /lhun grub de bzhin nyid gnas pa'o/ /de kho na nyid las rtog pa dang mi rtog pa rnam par dag par gyur pas/ rang bzhin slob pa 2)dang mi slob pa'i bye brag gis rab tu mi gnas pa'i ngo bor 'gyur ro/ /'di ni mthar thug pa'i bshad pa gsungs pa'o/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// //byams pas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rimatha' drug gis bshad pa ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa dgongs pas bshad pa dang dgongs pa ma yin pas bshad pa dang / drang ba'i don dang / nges pa'i don dang / sgra ji bzhin pa dang / sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa rnams so/ /byams pas gsol pa/thugs brtse ba nye bar gzhag cing / bcom ldan 'das tshig re re'i dbye ba bstan du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mthar thug pas bshad pa de nyid dgongs pas 'jig rten gyi spyod pa dang 'gal ba rmad du byung ba 82wa 20

bshad pa ni 'di lta ste/ 'dod chags ma yin pa dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba yang ma yin pa dang / bar ma dbu ma nye bar mi dmigs pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa rdo rje'i tshig rnams ni dgongs pas bshad pa'o/ /bde ba zag bcas ma yin te/ /zag pa med pa'i bde ba nyid/ /bde ba spangs shing 'bras med pas / /sgyu ma lta bur byung ba ste/ /de nyid bde ba'i ye shes ni/ /dbu ma tsam du'ang mi dmigs so/ /gang zag dbang po dman pa rnams/ /skrag byed 'gal ba ltar snang ngo / /dbang po mchog rnams chos la ni/ /sngon chad ma byung chos thos pas/ /ngo mtshar nges shes skyes pa yis/ /rmad du gyur pa'i ting 'dzin thob / /rnam par grol 17thob mtshan nyid do/ /phyi rol gsang bar smra la sogs/ /ma dag dag par 'dod pa dang / /ma grol grol 'dod dgag pa dang / /rang gar 'jug pa dgag pa'i phyir/ /cung zad 'jig rten brtags pa las /bzlog phyir ye shes zab mo'i don/ /gnas lugs 'khrul pa rnam dag ste/ /de nyid snying po dgongs te bshad/ /lus dang ngag dang yid med pa dang /bdag med pa dang / thams cad stong pa dang / dag pa dang / 'od gsal ba zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i rdo rje'i tshig ni dgongs pa ma yin pas bshad pa'o/ /chos thams cad la dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa dang / bdag tu 'dzin pa la dgongs pa ma yin pa'i phyir dgongs pa 2min te/ chos thams cad bdag med par ston cing spros med de bzhin nyid las stong pa nyid du sten dpa dang /chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa dang / lus med pa ste phung po dang khams dang skye mched mi dmigs pa dang / brjod pa las 'das pas ngag med pa dang / ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir yid med pa ni dgongs min du 82wa 21

bshad pa'o/ /ga pur dang / khrag chen po dang / tsan+dan dmar po dang rdo rje dang ske/ pad+ma dang / yi ge dang / phyag rgya zhes bya ba la sogs pa rdo rje'i tshig rnams ni drang ba'i don te/ ga pur 1ni khu ba dang / khrag chen po ni zla mtshan gyi khrag dang / tsan+dan dmar po'i khu ba dang bsres pa ni tsan+dan dmar po'i khu ba'o / /rdo rje dang mtshan ma dang / thabs dang / pad+ma bha ga dang / shes rab dang / yi ge dang / phyag rgya dang / btsun mo rnams dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa rdo rje'i tshig rnams nges pa'i don no/ /ga pur ni dkyil 'khor yig 'bru dang / khrag chen po nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor yig 'bru dang / tsan+dan dmar po ni pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad yig 'bru gsum dang bcas pa dang / rdo rje'i rgyud mtshan ma yab dang / pad+ma mtshan ma ste yum dang / yi ge ni sngags te sa bon dang / phyag rgya ni phyag mtshan te sku yongs su grub pa phyag rgya bzhi ldan no/ /lha'i sku yongs su rdzogs pa yongs su brtags pa'i lha rnams 'khrul pa bzlog pa tha mal pa las nus pa cung zad ldan pa ste thun mong pa'o/ /yang rang bzhin tha mi dad pa'i don las ga pur 2ni khu ba ka pur shu ki ste rnam pa kun 'dar las rgyu 4ba dang / khrag chen po ni rang 'byung gi khrag ste sih+la rak+ta rtsa ro ma nas rgyu 5ba dang / tsan+dan dmar po'i khu ba ni chos 'byung nang du 'dres pa las yum gyi pad+ma'i khongs su yongs su 'dres la dbyer med pa las 'gro ba'i lus mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul du yongs su rdzogs pa nyid do/ /pad+ma bha ga ste shes rab kyi cha dang ske/ rdo rje liṅga ste thabs kyi cha dang / zla nyi nub pa'i ldog pa cha mnyam par gyur pa las yi ge ste sa bon yon tan grub byed/ phyag rgya bzhi ldan gyi yab yum rdo rje btsun mo rnams chos 'byung las mngon par bde ba'i don ye shes yang dag 82—22

par bstan pa thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /byams pas gsol pa/ de dag gi drang ba'i don gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang yang ā li dang kā li'i yi ge sna tshogs sgra'i don gyi sgo nas rjod 17par byed pa'i mtha' dang ske/ brjod par bya ba'i thun mong gi chos dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams la bla na med pa gsang ba chen po'i gzungs sngags dang rig sngags 'di sgra'i de kho na nyid la brten nas rab tu rtogs par bya ba dang / yang gang zag rtog ge par gyur pa rnams la bstan gyi rjod 5byed thun mong du gyur pa mi phyed rdo rje'i yi ge srog tu gyur pa chos kyi phung po du ma yang de nyid las byung zhing de nyid du thim dpa ni drang ba'i don du bstan pa'o / /de dag la yang phung po lnga dang / rigs lnga dang / 'byung ba lnga dang ye shes lnga rnam par dag pa/ tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang rnam par grol ba dang rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po dag go/ /thug pa phyogs bcas 'gyur ba nyid/ /nyi zla lus kyi gnas las skyes/ /dbang gi dkyil 'khor g.yo ldan pa/ /gnas bzhi pa las phyogs gyur pa/ /chu bos brgyad cu rtsa bzhi ste/ /stong dang brgyad cu dh+ri 'od can/ /de dag chos kyi sgor gyur pa/ /phung po bla na med par 'gyur/ /gnyis ka dang bya ba'i rgyud la sogs pa rnams su don gsal bar gsungs pa ni sgra ji bzhin pa ste/ 'di lta ste dkyil 'khor dang mchod sbyin dang / gtor ma dang / sman dang / zhi ba la sogs pa'i las kyi tshogs rnams dang / de bzhin du 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub chen po brgyad gsungs pa rnams ni sgra ji bzhin pa ste yi ge'i don gyis bshad pa'o / /dkyil 'khor rtog pa'i cho ga sogs/ /spyod pa bsnyen bsgrub 4'bras 82—23

ldan pa/ /yan lag don rgyas rnam bshad pa/ /ji bzhin sgra zhes bstan pa yin//ko ṭa k+ṣa/ ko ṭa bha ṇa/ ko ṭa we/ ko ṭa bha shwa 19pa/ ka tir na ka /ko la khyad / ko la ba/ ko la bhasbyo4/ ko la sta thā/ ko la bha bhi/ 'dis dbang po dang yul gsungs te/ de lta bu la sogs pa rdo rje'i tshig ni sgra ji bzhin ma (5)yin pa'i sgo nas sbas pa'i bshad pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i brda'i gsang ba gang —/ /ko ṭa k+ṣa sogs mkha' 'gros bstan pa dang / /brda spyod gsang ba 'jig rten ma grags pas6/ /ji bzhin ma yin sgrar bstan pa'o/ /byang chub sems nyid spros med las/ /mtha' bral rnam par mi rtog pas/ /dmigs med phyag rgya chen po ste/ /mi gnas zung 'jug bla na med/ /rdo rje rang 'byung ting nge 'dzin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /rgyal bas nges pa'i don du gsungs / /mtha' drug rnam par dbye ba gtan la phab pa'o/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa bzhi pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa' chen pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje theg pa snyechen po'i rgyud sde gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyud sde ni 'di lta ste/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang / gnyis ku'i rgyud dang /spyod pa'i rgyud dang / bya ba'i rgyud dang / rtog 7pa'i rgyud do/ /byams pas gsol pa/ rgyud de rnams kyi tshad ji ltar lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i /rgyud ni stong phrag bcu gnyis te 9rgyas par phye na grangs med do/ /rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la stong phrag drug go/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la stong phrag brgyad do/ /bya ba'i rgyud la stong phrag bzhi'o/ /rtog pa 82—24

dang phra mo'i rgyud la stong phrag bzhi'o/ /de dag stong phrag sum cu rtsa bzhi ste rgyud dang rtog pa'i ming gi mtha' ma'i yi ge ji snyed pa ni/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa bye chaṇa/ ta tha 5mid dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥng ) a ā i khri u u/ ṛ rī '-i lī (ge.e e o au i aḥ'adi dag ni ming gi yi ge'i tshogs rnams so/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen pos gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de rnams kyi byed pa'i cho ga dang sgrub pa de gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ don dam pa'i bden pa las rang byin gyis brlab pa'i rim gyis langs te 'dod chags las byung ba'i byang chub kyi gnas rab tu bstan pa'i phyir btsun mo'i 'khor gyi dbus su 'khor los sgyur tshorar ba'i gzugs kyis bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la yang dag par bzhugs te/ 'jig rten gyi spyod pa dang 'gal ba rmad du byung ba rdo rje'i tshig gi mtha' drug dang tshul bzhi'i sgo nas rab tu spyod de bsgrub par bya'o / /zhes rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud du gnas so/ /rig ma dang lha mo dang lhan cig tu dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor la ri dgod par bya'o/ /de nas las byed pa'i sgrub pa la sogs pa de kho na nyid rnam pa bcu rab tu spyod de sgrub 7༄par byed pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la bzhugs so/ /las kyi bya ba sna tshogs rgya chen po bya ba'i rgyud phyag rgya dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid rab tu spyad pa sgrub rin/par byed pa ni spyod pa'i rgyud la bzhugs so/ /'khor ba la shin tu 'jigs par dmigs shing shin tu gtsang sbra byed pa dang / ye shes sems dpa'i bde ba med pa dang / bdag nyid lha'i bsnyems 9pa med pa dang / rmad du byung ba'i spyod yul rang rkyen gyis rgyu'i bar spyod pa sgrub par byed pa ni bya ba'i rgyud la bzhugs so/ /sngags dang 82—25

sman dang / sbyin sreg dang mig sman dang rkang mgyogs la sogs pa dngos grub chen po brgyad rab tu spyad pa sgrub par byed pa phra mo dang rtog pa'i rgyud la bzhugs so/ /gsang chen rgyud kyi ngo bo dang / /nges tshig sgra 'jug rgyu mtshan dang ske/ /khyad par dbye thabs dang ldan pa/ /gzhung tshad dang ni ldang tshad dang —/ /brjod bya rjod 1byed ston tshul lo/ /sems bskyed sngon 'gro mtshungs ldan pas/ /khyad par smin lam byin rlabs lam/ /rjes snang 'brel pa thun mong min/ /bde ba lam myur mthong chos 'gyur/ /de nyid thabs zab bla na med / /dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang chen gyin/ /sku gsung thugs las mi phyed pa/ /bde chen mchog gi snying po nyid/ /ngo bo ye shes dri med pa'o/ /tan+ta 0zhes pa rgyud yin te/ / ten+ta shes 5pa dngos la rgyun/ /tra ya dus gsum thog med pas / /'dren pa rtog tshogs 'joms byed pa'o/ /rgyun chags 'brel pa ma tshang med / /rgyas byed sems can khams las ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnal 'byor pa/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa mtha' yas pa/ /bar mi bcad cing ye shes rgyun / /phrin las mi zad 'khor lo ste/ /rgyud ces sgrar btags de nyid do/ /gleng gzhi gleng yislong gsang chen la/ /rgyas bsdus ngo bo mi 'gyur ba/ /'jug gnas mthar phyin bla na med/ /rdo rje theg pa'i ldang tshad do/ /sngon rgyu gdung ba shas che la/ /spong bar mi nus 'jug phyir na/ /dbang phyug chen po lta bu'o/ /lam la gnas pa rim gnyis chos/ /ngo bo mi 'gyur mchog gsang ba/ /sa lam bgrod pa mthar phyin pas/ /bla ma'i lam ni gtsor gyur pa/ /bla na med pa tshe 'dis thob/ /rgyu dang thabs lam 'bras bu ste/ /grub 7byed gsang ba rtsa ba'i rgyud / /snying po mchog las rab 'byam spyod/ /gsal byed phyi ma bde blag 82—26

'gyur / /dka' ba spyod dang kha skong byed/ /the tshom sel nges ster ba dang / /dus rtags blo la sbyar ba ste/ /snod rig skal ba'i khyad par bstan/ /gsang ba chen po spyi dang bye brag thams cad du/ /tha dad pa dang gcig tu gnas pa ting 'dzin dang / /mthar thug rim pa dam tshig sku gsung thugs dang ni/ /sdom 1pa'i de nyid kun tu khyab pa byang chub sems/ /yang dag bde ba chen po phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa/ /ye shes tshad med rgya chad phyogs su lhung ba med/ /mnyam nyid spros pa med pa dag pa chen po ste/ /sgra dang sgra min las 'das rgyud ni bla 2med pa'o/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa lnga pa'o// //byams pas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sbyor ba dang po'i mdzad pa gang lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dpal bde ba chen po mi 'gyur tsho ba 'og min chos kyi dbyings dkyil 'khor chen po yongs su dag pa tshad med pa'i pho brang du/ de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi sems rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyis yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su bzhugs te/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dpag tu med pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'dus pa'i gsang ba bla na med par dbang bskur ba/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i snying po gsang ba chen po yongs su dag cing ye shes 4yongs su dag pa thob pa ni/ dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i yon tan phrin 5las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa/ spro ba dang bsdu bar mdzad pa/ spros pa med cing snang ba rnam par dag pa de nyid la gnas pa ni sbyor ba dang po zhes bya'o/ /82—27

byams pas gsol pa/ dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog ji ltar du ston par 'gyur ba lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /'di nyid tshad med dkyil 'khor du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /rdo rje bla na med pa'i mchog /rten dang brten par bcas pa yi/ /bde gshegs pho brang snying po ni/ /'dod pa khams kyi 'gro ba rnams/ /ri rab chen po'i steng du ni/ /khang bu brtsegs pa ga la bar/ /dbang po brgya byin 'khor bcas pa/ /nye dbang sum cu rtsa gnyis sogs/ /rin chen rang byung mchod sprin ldan/ /dbang bskur rim pa ston par mdzad/ /dbang phyug u mar bcas pa dang / /tshangs pa khyab 'jug gdong drug sogs/ /'dul phyir yul dang dbang po ni/ /gnyis med mnyam par sbyor ba las/ /longs spyod bde ba'i spyod pa yis/ /rnam par dag pa bya ba'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor du ni 'jug par mdzad/ /de nas dag khams de nyid du/ /de bzhin nyid kyi ngang las 'das pa yi/ /byang chub sems mchog rdo rje bla med pa/ /zil gnon rdo rje ting nge 'dzin la zhugs/ /dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med mnyam nyid dang / /rnal 'byor bde chen mngon par byang chub pa/ /nyi zla pad+ma ā li kā li bcas/ /thugs gsung sku yi rdo rje de nyid las / /'od spros 'jig rten khams su khyab gyur pas/ /brtan g.yor bcas pa yongs su dag par gyur/ /byin gyis brlabs kyi snang ba'i rgyud sbyangs pas/ /'gro ba rdo rje sems dpa'isho 'phang bkod/ /bde ba dang ni yid bde thob gyur te / /rjes su rnal 'byor ye shes rgya mtsho las/ /mi phyed dbang phyug byang chub sems kyi sku/ /ye shes 'byung ba rdo rje'i ting 'dzin las/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pa dang / /sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid mchog /82—28

dbang bskur ba yi cho 'phrul bla na med/ /gsang (1ba lhun grub snying po'i ngang la ste / /oṃ āḥrgyu dang swā hā 'od 'phro ba/ /'od zer gyis ni phyogs bcur khyab par mdzad/ / māṃ māṃ tshon)dzā ṭ+wāṃ slo las 'byung (8)ba bzhi/ /mo sgyu ( )o oṃ oṃ hūṃ oṃ saṃ las / /rnam shes brgyad kyi rang bzhin sems dpa' che/ /rū sha ga ra spa ste 'dod yon nyid/ /dzaḥ(5)rgyu baṃ hoḥrgyu drug 'od 'bar las/ /mthar (6)byed khro bo'i rgyal po yum bcas bcu/ /yan lag tshogs gnas phyogs kyi gdon 'joms pa'o / /shin tu rnal 'byor rdzu 'phrul cho 'phrul ston/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub sems kyi rdo rje 'chang de nyid/ zhal gsum phyag drug rgyan 7bcas gzigs par gyur/ /mtshan dpe rdzogs pa phyag rgya ldan par snang / /de nyid chos dbyings rdo rje yum bcas bzhi/ /chos 'byung nas byon thugs ku'i dbus ma nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa du ma spros pa las/ /ched du brjod pa gsang ba de nyid gsungs/ /kun rdzob cho 'phrul mi zad 'khor lo bstan/ /de rjes 'dod pa khams pa gdul don du/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs kyis 98 dang ba'i tshul/ /rnam snang mdzad pa rdo rje 'dzin sku las/ /sku yi cha zhu lha mo'i tshul bstan pa/ /spro dang bsdu ba ye shes mngon rol pa'i/ /spyod pa bde chen dgyes par bstan pa'o/ /dpal ldan mi bskyod rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor mchog /rdul med pa nyid gru bzhir byin brlabs pa/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs dpag med/ /phyogs dus kun nas khyab cing yongs su bskor / /byang chub sems nyid rdo rje dbus bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan rnam snang mdzad pa rin chen 'byung / /'od dpag med pa gdon mi za ba nyid/ /bder gshegs dpag med rnams dang lhan cig tu/ /rang 9snang ye shes yum dang 82—29

gnyis med pa/ /shin tu rnal 'byor rim pa yang dag pa'o/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rjes byin rlabs pa/ /dam tshig pa dang ye shes sems dpa' che/ /nus pa brtan dang dbang bskur rgyas gdab pa'o1ri/ /ting 'dzin sems dpa' thugs mar nges gnas pa/ /rnal 'byor chen po yi ni mgon po mchog /rig pa chen po'i skyes bu de bzhin gshegs/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med bzhugs pa'o//de bzhin gshegs pa dpag med 'dus pa'i dus/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dpag med brjod mi lang / /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma sprin phreng ba'i/ /mchod pa'i tshogs kyis bar snang gang bas mchod/ /rdo rje 'chang chen de bzhin gshegs pa la / /de bzhin gshegs dang 2sems dpa' thams cad kyis/ /thun mong du ni gsol ba btab gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi / /'dus pa gsang ba las byung ba/ /rdo rje snying pos bsdus pa yi/ /bcom ldan snying po bshad du gsol/ /zhes zhus shing gsol ba btab par gyur la/ de tshe rdo rje 'chang gis bka' stsal pa/ /'dir ni legs ces (5gsang ba nges pa la spro bas zhus pa gsang chen bla med la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mchog gyur thams cad kyang / /the tshom skye bar gyur pa yin pas na/ /sems dpa' khyed tshornams kun gyis ji ltar rtogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun gyis gsol ba ni/ /rdo rje dam tshig 'byung ba'i tshig gis ni/ /shin tu rtogs par dka' bar gyur pa la//de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyi 7mthu stobs kyis/ /skal bar ldan pa rjes su 'dzin par ni/ /nus pa mchog ldan phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /shin tu rab tu rtogs par byin rlabs shing / /dbang bskur mdzad pas mngon par rtogs mdzad gsol/ /rmad du byung ba'i ye shes cho 'phrul kun/ /da lta nyid du gsal 882—30

bar bstan mdzad gsol/ /sbyor ba dang po'i rim ri1༄pa'o/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /mngon rdzogs byang chub rdo rje yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs nas ni/ /dang po'i mgon po nyid kyis ni/ /rig pa chen po'i skyes bu ste/ /chos dbyings rdo rje ma gnyis med/ /dkyil 'khor spro dang sdud (gepar mdzad/ /dpal ldan mi bskyod rdo rjes ni/ /ye shes sgron ma rdo rje yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs pas/ /badz+ra jika las phyung 3)gyur ni/ /zhal gsum phyag ni drug pa ste/ /in+d+ra nī la kun+da ltar/ /rā ga 'bar ba'i zhal mnga' ba/ /g.yas g.yon rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /pad+ma 47'khor lo nor bu dang / /pad+ma ral gri g.yon du ste/ /rdo rje skyil krung gergyan spras pa/ /de nyid sku las 'od zer tshogs//spros nas kun tu bder gshegs kyis/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams khyab mdzad nas / /'gro sbyangs dag par gyur nas ni/ /smin bar nas zhugs thugs kur thim / /de ni de ma thag tu yang / /bcom ldan zhe sdang rdo rjer gyur/ /rin chen sna tshogs seng ge'i khri/ /zla ba nyi ma'i steng du bzhugs/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus gnas pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo mngon par 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa drug pa'o// //dpal ldan rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ /mngon par rtogs pa rdo rje yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /zhal gsum phyag drug kun+da'i mdog /'khor lo dril bu yum dang rol/ /rdo rje nor bu g.yas pa la/ /g.yon pa pad+ma ral gri 'dzin/ /sngo dang dmar dang g.yas dang g.yon/ /glang chen khri steng 82wa 31

pad zla'i steng / /rgyan bcas skyil krung bzhugs pa'o/ /bde gshegs rin chen 'byung gnas kyis/ /bdag med rdo rje la bzhugs te/ /rasna 9174ka phyung gser gyi mdog /yid bzhin nor bu dril bu dang / /'khor lo pad+ma ral gri can / /dung dang ut+pal mtshungs pa ni/ /rin chen rgyan spras rta mchog ste/ /yum bcas skyil krung bzhugs pa'o/ /dpal ldan tshe dpag med pa ni/ /'od zer 'bar ba rdo rjer bzhugs/ /a ro lika ces rā ga'i 'od/ /sngo dkar pad+ma dril bu dang / /rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri bcas/ /yum bcas rma bya'i khri la bzhugs / /rin chen rgyan ldan 'od 'phro bas na/ /mnyam pa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /bcom ldan gdon mi za ba'i sku/ /zil gnon rdo rje la bzhugs te/ /pradz+nyā tsho sgrika las markata 74mdog /dkar dmar ral gri dril bus 'khyud/ /rdo rje 'khor lo nor bu dang / /pad+ma rin chen rgyan ldan nyid/ /yum bcas shang shang khrir bzhugs pa/ /rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi 'khor lo mngon par 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa bdun pa'o// //de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje btsun mo spyan ma yis/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kun/ /mnyam byed dam tshig la bzhugs te/ /mo 5tā ra ti las byung ba/ /dung mdog sngo dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /sku yi rdo rje dang mtshungs pa/ /pad+ma zla nyi shar lhor bzhugs/ /rdo rje btsun mo mā ma khris6/ /sangs rgyas rjes su mnyes byed pa'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas/ /82—32

de ṣa ra ti las byon pa/ /thugs kyi rdo rje mtshungs pa nyid/ /bai ḍūr 1dung dang rā ga'i zhal(2/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan spras 'gying / /pad zlar lho nub grwar bzhugs so/ /rdo rje btsun mo gos dkar gyis/ /rjes su chags pa rdo rje yi / /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /rā ga ra ti las byon pa/ /gsung gi rdo rje mtshungs pa nyid/ / bca ri ga na sngo dang dkar/ /sgeg cing rin chen rgyan spras pa/ /pad zlar nub byang grwar bzhugs pa'o/ /rdo rje btsun mo sgrol ma yi/ /glu ma rdo rje zhes bya ba'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /badz+ra ra 9 ti las byung sgeg /markata dung dang bhanu kun /phrin las rdo rje dang mtshungs pa/ /rin chen rgyan gyis legs spras pa/ /pad zlar byang shar grwar bzhugs pa'o/ /lus kyi gnas su lte ba dang / /snying ga mgrin pa gsang ba dang / /lī māṃ 96)spru ṭ+wāṃ sa bon nyid/ /'byung ba la 7ni lhan cig /spyod pa yi/ /lha mo ye shes bde bar rol / /de nyid mnyam pa phyag rgya che/ /ye shes mnyam par sbyor ba lha mo'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa brgyad pa'o// //lha mo gzugs kyi rdo rje mas/ /dam tshig mchog gi mchod pa yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs 95te/ /badz+ra rū pe zhes sngags las/ /sku mchog dkar mo me long 'dzin/ /rdo rje spyan ma dang mtshungs pa/ /rin chen rgyan rnams kyis mdzes spras/ /me yi phyogs kyi grwar bzhugs pa'o/ /lha mo sgra yi rdo rje lasang/ /nam mkha'i 'od kyi sprin rdo rje/ /tshim byed ting 'dzin la bzhugs te/ /badz+ra shasdo 11las byon pa/ /rdo rje mā ma tī dang mtshungs/ /a gi rgyud mangs steng 82wa 33

mdzad glu/ /dbyangs kyis kun tu mchod byed pa/ /bden bral phyogs kyi grwar bzhugs so/ /lha mo dri byug rdo rje mas/ /mngon par byang chub bdun ston pa/ /de nyid rdo rje'i ting 'dzin bzhugs/ /badz+ra gadhe las phyung 1ba/ /gos dkar yum dang mtshungs pa ste/ /dung chos lha rdzas mchog 'dzin pa/ /rin chen rgyan spras 'gying bag ldan/ /rig 5'dzin phyogs kyi grwar nabazhugs pa'o/ /rdo rje ro mchog lha mo ni/ /dam tshig chen po'i camachod pa ni/ /kun mchod ting 'dzin la bzhugs te/ /badz+ra rā su 5las byung tshob/ /rin chen pad snod bdud rtsi ni/ /ro mchog bcud ldan 'dzin mdzad pa/ /sgrol ma dang ni mtshungs pa ste/ /dbang ldan phyogs kyi grwar bzhugs so/ /rig ma mchod lha rnams kyis ni/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod gyur pa'o/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa dgu pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying ni/ /zhi ba'i dam tshig mchog gnas las/ /k+ṣi ti gar+bha'i sngags las byung / /mdog dkar 'khor lo rtsibs bcu 'dzin/ /thor tshugs cod pan rgyan gyis spras/ /shar khyams skyil krung dag gis bzhugs/ /sems dpa' rdo rje 'dzin pa ni/ /dngos dang dngos med dam tshig ste/ /ro mnyam ting 'dzin la bzhugs pa/ /badz+ra pā ṇi e zhes las/ /gser mdog rdo rje 'bar ba 'dzin/ /lho phyogs khyams la skyil krung bzhugs/ /byang chub nam mkha'i snying po ni/ /dam tshig mchog la gzigs pa yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /ā kā sha 7gar+bha'i sngags las byung / /gser mdog marka ta 'dzin pa/ /'gying bcas lho phyogs khyams la bzhugs/ /sems dpa' 'jig 82—34

rten dbang phyug gis/ /gsung mchog rdo rje ye shes kyi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /lo ke shwa 1kyir badz+ra las/ /byon pa pad+ma rā ga'i 'od/ /g.yon pa'i pad+ma g.yas pa yis/ /'byed mdzad nub kyi lha khyams bzhugs/ /byang sems mgon po 'jam dbyangs kyis/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje tshul gcig pa'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs 5)te/ /sto ṣa nā tha las phyung rdo /ba'i/ /dmar ser rin chen rgyan spras pa'i/ /ut+pal dmar po 'dzin mdzad pa/ /g.yas pas 'byed par mdzad pa ni/ /skyil krung nub kyi khyams la bzhugs/ /byang sems sgrib ( pa kun sel gyis/ /chos rnams kun la 'jug pa'i sgo/ /rdo rje zhes pa'i ting 'dzin bzhugs/ /ni wa 55cir ni las byung ba'i/ /markata 'od 'phro ral gri can / /rgyan ldan byang gi khyams la bzhugs/ /dpal ldan byams pa'i mgon pos ni/ /rdo rje spros pa'i sngags bkod kyi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te//mi tri nā tha las byung ba/ /dung mdog klu shing spyi blugs can/ /rin chen rgyan gyis spras pa ste/ /shar gyi khyams la bzhugs mdzad pa'o/ /sems dpa' kun tu bzang po ni/ /zhing khams kun khyab mchod sprin gyi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /sa man+ta bha dra las phyung 6ba/ /ljang mdog sna tshogs rdo rje can / /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan spras pa/ /byang phyogs khyams la skyil krung bzhugs / /pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la ni/ /'gying bcas thor tshugs rgyan spras pa/ /kun kyang zhal gsum phyag drug ste/ /gtso la bsnol ma'i tshul gyis gzigs/ /mo z-i 57)i oṃ oṃ dang ni/ /hūm̐ oṃ si nyid rnam shes brgyad/ /rnam par dag pa sems dpa'o/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa bcu pa'o// //82—35

khyad par rnam par nges 'gyur ro/ /de nas dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi dang / /phyogs rnams kun tu khro bo bcu/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can bgegs 'joms mdzad / /zhal gsum phyag drug ldan pa'o/ /khro bo chen po gshin rje'i gshed/ /rdo rje 'khor lo 'bar ba yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /ya mān+ta kṛta las phyung 2ba/ /mthing nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhing / /rdo rje tho ba 'khor lo dang / /ral gri nor bu sdigs mdzub can/ /shar sgor dri za'i steng bzhugs pa'o/ /khro rgyal shes rab mthar byed kyis/ /mngon par byang chub rdo rje yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /pradz+nyān+ta kṛta sngags las phyung sna/ /dung mdog sngo dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /be con dgra sta 'khor lo dang / /ral gri nor bu pad+ma 'dzin/ /lho sgor grul bum gnon mdzad pa'o/ /khro bo'i 4rgyal po rta mchog gis/ /rdo rje chags med pad+ma ni/ /ye shes 'byung ba'i ting 'dzin las / /pad+ma lhaka las phyung ba ni/ /bhad+dha ri ku'i mdog 'dra ba/ /g.yas mthing g.yon dkar 'jigs par byed/ /pad+ma rdo rje tho ba dang / /ral gri 'khor lo dgra sta can/ /nub sgor klu dbang steng bzhugs pa'o/ /khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yis/ /rdo rje byin rlabs snying po'i tshul/ /rdo rje ting 'dzin la zhugs te/ / bisgyun+ta kṛta 5las byung 6ba/ /markata 7dkar dang dmar ba'i zhal / /rgya gram 'khor lo ral gri dang / /gtun shing dgra sta sdigs mdzub 8can / /byang sgor gnod sbyin steng 9bzhugs so/ /khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon po yis / /chos dbyings mi zad rdo rje yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /82—36

ār+ya a tsa las phyung nyid/ /be+e ḍūr dkar dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /ral gri 'khor lo dgra sta dang / /pad+ma nor bu sdigs 1mdzub bo/ /me phyogs drang srong gnon mdzad pa'o/ /khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po yis/ /bsam gtan thogs med rdo rje yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /ṭak+ki rā dza'i sngags las phyung / /in+d+ra nī la kun+da dmar/ /phyag rgya bsnol ba'i sdigs 2mdzub can/ /lcags kyu ral gri ut+pa la/ /sdigs namadzub zhags pa 'dzin pa ste/ /bden bral steng du bzhugs pa'o/ /khro bo rdo rje be con 4can/ /'jigs mdzad snying rje'i ting nge 'dzin / /nī la daṇ+ḍa 5las byung 6ba/ /char sprin mdog 'dra dkar dmar zhal/ /dbyug pa ral gri nor bu dang / /'khor lo pad+ma sdigs 7mdzub mdzad/ /gtum po mi bzad me dpung klong / /rlung lha'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /rdo rje khro bo stobs po che/ /sku gsum mi phyed rdo rje yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /ma hā ba la'i sngags las phyung / /ut+pal sprin dkar byi 8ru'i zhal/ /rtse gsum rnga yab ral gri dang / /'khor lo nor bu sdigs 9mdzub can/ /'byung po'i gdan steng bzhugs mdzad pa'o/ /khro rgyal rdo rje gtsug tor can/ /rig pa'i stobs samachog rdo rje yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /usnri ṣa bi dza'i sngags las phyung / /nam mkha'i mdog can gtsug tor gyi/ /phyag rgya spyi bor bcings pa ste/ /rdo rje ral gri pad+ma dang / /sdigs 1 mdzub zhags pa 'khor lo 'dzin / /rnam 'tshe 'joms mdzad sa bdag gnon/ /lha rgyal tshangs pa gnon mdzad pa'o/ /rdo rje gnod mdzes khros pa'i sku/ /rab tu 'byung gnas ye shes kyil/ /rdo rje'i ting 'dzin la zhugs nas/ /brtan g.yo gdug pa dug can gyi/ /drag po 'joms mdzad mthing nag nyid/ /sum bha rā dza'i sngags las byung / /82—37

rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri dang / /nor bu pad+ma sdigs 1mdzub mdzad/ /rnam 'tshe zhi mdzad sa bdag gnon/ /lus kyi gnas su khro bo rnams/ /sa bon phyag mtshan rtsa gnas la/ /g.yas mthing 2thod dbyug /g.yon par ni/ /be con mgrin par pad+ma can/ /gsang bar sna tshogs rdo rje 'khyil/ /dzaḥ rgyu baṃ hoḥ95sdo bzhi bsrung / /drug ldan hūṃ gis brgyan pa ni/ /lcags kyu dpung g.yas rtse gsum g.yon/ /lha ngar dbyug pa tri shu la/ /long 56bur rdo rje spyi gtsug tu/ /'khor lo gye'u 'phags gyur pa'o/ /khro rgyal thams cad yum dang ldan/ /rin chen klu dbang rgyan gyis spras/ /dbu skra gyen brjes me dpung dbus/ /yan lag rags shing brjid pa'i sku/ /ha ha hūṃ hūṃ sgra sgrogs pa sa/ /srid gsum g.yo bar mdzad pa po/ /dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i gdon/ /log lta can rnams 'dul mdzad pa/ /yab yum gnyis med sbyor ba dgyes/ /gsang ba bde ba chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor ye shes snying po bstan/ /lha tshogs mngon par 'byung ba'i 'khor lo'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa bcu gcig pa'o// //zab pa'i rgyan la rnam par dbye ba gang / /mtha' ldan dang ni bshad tshul dbye ba yis/ /nus pa khyad par gyur pa rgyan dang ldan/ /sa yi dbang phyug gsang ba'i rgyan bstan pa'o/ /rgya che'i rgyan la spyi dang bye brag can/ /rgya che la ni mtshon don ston pa dang / /rigs can lngas ni nges par 'jug gyur pa/ /gang zag dang ni dngos grub sgrub pa'i gnas/ /lnga tshad gzugs khams tshad med ldan / /tshul ldan ston pa'i mtshan nyid dang / /rgyud dang gleng gzhi nges pa'i 82—38

tshig /rgyu yis mthar 'byin spyod pa'o/ /chos kyi tha dad pa yi rgyan/ /tshogs slob gnyis dang bden gnyis so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po byams pas gsol pa/ don dam pa'i bden pa la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po las kyi rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin la brten nas sems can gyi don ji ltar rab tu spyad par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ji srid du zhi ba la sogs pa'i las kyi sems can gyi don mi byed pa de srid du yang dag pa'i mtha' la rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gang du sems can thams cad kyi don bya bar mthong ba de'i tshe yang dag pa'i mtha' las langs te sems can gyi don byas nas yang dag pa'i mtha' nyid du 'jug cing mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa mngon du byed do/ /gang du 'gro ba'i don 'byung ba/ /dus la bab pa de yi 1tshe / /rdo rje'i spyan gyis gzigs pa'i tshe/ /thogs pa med par phrin las kun/ /gdul bya'i bsam pa ji lta bar/ /nges pa nyid du 'byung 'gyur ba'o/ /sa rlung brtan po thob pa dang / /rlung gis rnam par 'degs byed pa/ /thabs dang shes rab srog rtsol la/ /brten pas rdo rje rkang mgyogs 2'grub/ /tha mal lus ngag yid dag la/ /lha sngags rlung sems rtse gcig las / /bsam gtan ya rlung ma /rlung gis/ /kun tu bsgyur bas gser 'gyur thob/ /lha byed sgyu ma'i rnam shes las/ /ting 'dzin chu rlung gsal snang gis/ /lkog tu gyur pa'i rdzas mthong ba/ /de nyid mig sman ril bu 'grub/ /rlung gi cadamigs pa rnon po yi/ /rnal 'byor pa yi mtshon cha mchog /gar bsgyur gcod par byed pa yi/ /thogs med ral gri'i dngos grub bo/ /rtog med tha mal dbugs bral la/ /zhing skyong cho 5'phrul yum gzhan bzhugs/ /pho nya sngags kyi nus pa las/ /grub 82—39

—— — — —— —— —— — —— —————— — ——wa ————— ——————— — —— —— ———————————— — —wa —— — ——— ———ster ro langs grub pa 'byung / /bdud rtsi rang lus gnas pa las/ /stobs gyur 'byung ba ro snyoms pas/ /sman mchog zil ldan rnyed pa ltar/ /bcud len yon tan khyad par 'grub/ /nam mkha'i rlung las rtsa gnas der/ /rlung sgrom dag byed sbed shes pas/ /grib ma mi 'byung bde thob pa/ /mi snang bar snang byed pa nyid/ /gsang sgo rtsa yi bu ga las/ /'dus pa sgron mes khams dgu yi / / dngas snyigs byed 1pas lha min gyi/ /bug 2rnyed la ni sa 'og 'grub/ /dbang dang dgug dang bskrad pa dang / /mnan dang rengs byed mngon spyod dang ske/ /zhi dang rgyas pa klus las byed/ /brjod bya dang ni rjod byed dang / /dpe dang mngon gyur stobs dang ni/ /chos don khyad par gyur pa'i phyir/ /nus ldan gsang ba'i rgyan yin no/ /gnas pa dang ni gsal rdzu 'phrul/ /yon tan phrin las rgyan rim cabazhin/ /de ni rjod byed rtag par brgyan/ /don gyur dgos pa bla na med/ /don gnas byed dang ye shes kyi/ /gsang chen don mthong snying po ste/ /rgyan pas dbye bsdu bstan pa'o/ /dug zhi ba dang bsrung ba dang —/ /rgol ba'i nus 'joms phrin las te / /rab 'byam las tshogs du ma /sna/ske/pa'o///dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa bcu snyebyang chub sems dpa' chen po byams pas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rgyan rnam pa bdun ji ltar lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gleng bslang ba rnam pa lnga dang / rigs pa rnam pa bzhi dang / mtha' drug gis bshad pa dang / bshad tshul rnam pa bzhi dang / dbye ba rnam pa gnyis dang /(22wa 40

gang zag rnam pa lnga'i sgo nas slob ma brtag pa dang / bden pa gnyis kyi dgongs pa'o/ / gleng bslang 1ba rnam pa lnga ni 'di lta ste/ mtshan dang /gang zag dang / byed pa po dang / tshad dang / dgos pa rnams so/ /dang po gleng rigazhi gleng 3slong bstan pa las/ /phun sum tshogs pa lnga dang ldan bsdus pal/ /gser gyi 'khor lo rin chen chos mthun pa/ /spyi bo'i gnas su e bo rdo rje bzhugs/ /ston pa chags can 'khor dang de bzhin chos/ /ye shes dus ldan tshad las dgos pa bsgrub/ /byang sems rdo rje cho ga dbang bskur ba/ /rnam grangs le'u gnas tshul lnga ldan pa/ /rim gnyis rgyud gsum don gyis phye ba nyid / /byang chub phyogs las dum bu dbye bar gyur/ /rnal 'byor bsnyen bsgrub yan lag mchog dang ni/ /rdo rje rnam bzhi yan lag rim pas bsdus/ /dgos pa'i khyad par las dang dngos grub las/ /grub pa brgyad dang mchog ldan yang dag pa'o/ /bde chen 'khor lor thig le gtsor gyur pa'i/ /dgu brgya phrag gcig ye shes rlung gyur pa/ /bcu gcig bzhi cha phrag lnga'i rtsa gnas so/ /lnga bcu phrag gnyis ā li kā li ste/ /rtsibs stong ldan pa sbas pa'i 'khor lo'o/ /spyod pa rim ldan rjes su gsang ba ste/ /rmad byung dkyil 'khor snying po bskul ba dang ske/ /sngags dang ye shes sku bskyed phrin las dag /rab 'byam 5rigs 'dzin yan lag 'bras bu bstan/ /sngags dang nad la mchog gzhol rnal 'byor grub / /las tshegs sgyu tshar gcod rjes 'dzin rmi lam chos/ /rnam dag dkyil 'khor las kyi phrin las tshogs/ /dam tshig sdom pa rab rdzogs gzhung bsdus bstan / /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa bcu gsum pa'o// //82wa 41

gang ske/ /rgyal chen shākya'i rigs rgyud dus ldan mchog /don gyi pho brang du 'khrungs dbugs 'byin pa/ /byang chub gleng gzhi a khaṃ bīr hūṃ las/ /'jug pa chu sgo yang dag thar pa'i rten/ /gzigs las rlung yul las 'das kun 'dar mthong / /gshegs pa ye shes sa bon drug tu ni/ /nges 'byung rang 'byung gnyis su med pa'i rten/ /sdom zhing 'gog pas nges pa snying por bskul/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon byed shes spyod pa/ /'khor lo bskor bstan snying po mchog thob pas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa bla na med par gyur/ /de ni rgyud ces mngon par byang chub lnga/ /phung po dag pa khams gsang rigs gcig nyid/ /gleng 91gzhi nges pa dbang sogs lam rdo rje/ /rgyu ni spyod pa zhi drag khro tshogs 'dren/ /gleng 2gzhi dbye ba tshul gnyis rtogs par bya/ /yid bzhin nor bu ngo bo nyid ldan sku/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa bcu bzhi pa'o// //mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lor gsung rdo rje/ /mtha' ldan drug ni glang chen stobs ldan pa/ /brjod bya ming tshig rab byed sgra tshogs las/ /zung gyur ro drug longs spyod don ldan brjod/ /'gro drug gnas don nges pa rgyan du gyur/ /'jig rten gnas dang 'jig rten 'das las grol/ /yangs thob rnal 'byor rgyu 'bras rmi lam dang / /mtshungs pa sgyu mar ston pa drang ba'i don/ /grub mtha' rim ldan gzungs las yon tan tshogs/ /ngo bo nyid kyis grol ba stong pa nyid/ /82—42

rnam par mi rtog skye med dngos rnam dag /spros bral de bzhin nyid las kun du ston / /ye shes yongs su dag pa nges pa'i don/ /dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i blo bzlog byed/ /yang dag gnyis med ye shes lam ston cing / /dman pa zil gnon mchog don rmad gyur pa1/ /dgongs bshad gsang chen 'byung gnas don kun bsgrub/ /chos rnams 'byung ba rgya mtsho chen po las/ /thugs rje'i zhags pas 'dren pa blo gros mchog /tshig don spro naribasdus byang chub gnas thob byed/ /yon tan dgongs pa min pa zhes brjod do/ /rtsa rlung byang sems yi ge gnas dag pa/ /ro rkyang srog rtsol drang nges khyad par gsang / /snying gar 'bru lnga rtsa ba 'bru lnga lhung ba dag /dgongs bshad drug lnga shes byed lam sbyang ba'o / /dgongs min ā li gsung dbyangs yan lag gnas/ /de nyid chos rnams bdag med sgra sgrogs pa/ /ā li kā li drug ldan mtshan dpe ni/ /ji bzhin sgra las rgyan spras bla na med/ /ji bzhin min sgra bcu gnas rdo rje'i dbyings / /gsang ba snying po bsdus pa brdas bshad nyid/ /thog ma bar dang mtha' mar dge ba'i chos/ /bla med mi zad rnam pa thams cad du/ /rab 'byam don bsgrub rtog pa phrin las tshogs/ /grub steng gnas las ji bzhin sgrar 'byung ston/ /phyir mi bzlog pa bral dang mtha' las 'das/ /khyad par brda las zab pa snying po'i don/ /rgyal ba'i spyod yul tha snyad las grol ba/ /ji bzhin ma yin sgra zhes rnam par bsgrags/ /dus gzhan la dgongs pa ni drang ba'i don to/ /gang zag gzhan la dgongs pa ni drang ba'i don to/ /mnyam pa nyid la dgongs pa ni nges pa'i don to/ /don gzhan la dgongs pa ni nges pa'i don to/ /gang zag gi bsam pa la dgongs pa ni dgongs bshad do/ /82—43

— — —— ———————— ——— ————wa wa — —wa — — — ————wa ———————— —— ——wa ——— —wa wa——bsgyur ba la ldem por dgongs pa ni dgongs bshad do/ /gnyen po la ldem por dgongs pa ni dgongs bshad do/ /gzhung la ldem por dgongs pa ni sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa'o/ /mtshan nyid la ldem por dgongs pa ni sgra ji bzhin ma sbya dī /pa'o/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa bcwa 2lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor gnas pa ni/ /rnam par bshad pa tshul bzhin ldan pa ni/ /ma nor phyin ci ma log ston pa ste/ /'di ni rdo rje btsun mo'i chos tshul mtshungs/ /lte ba'i 'khor lo sgra ldan yig 'bru brgyad/ /mdo las e baṃ ma yā gsang ba nyid/ /rgyud spyi brda dbyibs sgra dang rgyas 'debs te/ /kun rdzob rang gzhan bdag byin brlabs pa las/ /rmi lam sgyu lus mtshon pa bar do sbyang ske/ /sems gsum lastong nyid ye shes sbas pa nyid/ /snang ba gsum las drang bzhin dag 'od gsal/ /bde ba las ni gtum mo 'bar 'dzag las/ /phyi rol gnyis med gsang ba'i snyoms 'jug pa/ /sgyu ma'i rol pa btsun mo lta bur bstan/ /dang po yi ge'i don te spyi ming tsam/ /smos pas ā li kā lis rkyen sbyar nas/ /rnam pa du ma'i byed pa sgrar bcas pa/ /las rnams lus dang yan lag 'brel pas mtshon/ /spyi don gnyis las mod don nyan rang dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i lam mchog la dbang ste/ /'jug pa rnam thar la sogs drug ldan pa/ /chos rnams yongs rdzogs mkhyen bcas 'dir ston byed/ /rdo rje theg pa spyi don rgyud kun gyi/ /dgongs pa blta tshoba'i rnal 'byor gsang ston pa//rig sngags gzungs rgyabacas gsang sngags de nyid kyi/ /'dus par 'jug pa'i 82—44

rim pa lam gyur pa'o/ /sbas pa'i don las snying po gsang ba mchog /bla na med pa'i 'byung gnas btsun mo dang / /phyogs mtshungs phyi ltar rin chen rgyan spras bzhin/ /spyi don gnyis kyis na bza' gos rim na1/ /sbas don gsang ba btsun mo'i lus ngag yid/ /lus ni sgyu ma kun rdzob rmi lam ltar/ /ngag ni rlung sngags gnyis med sbyor ba las/ /rnam shes sems nyid snang ba gsum sbas pa/ /bde ba'i lam gyis sbas pa dga' ba bzhi/ /ye shes chen po rol pa'i gsang ba mchog /snying po bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'o/ /ye shes 'byung gnas nyid ni skad cig bzhi/ /mthar thug de kho na nyid 'od gsal ba/ /de la brten pas lam myur bgrod pa ste/ /rang 'byung zhi gnas lhag mthong ro mnyam pa/ /zung 'jug mi 'gyur byang chub sems rdo rje/ /lam mthar phyin pa lhun grub ngo bo nyid//brjod 'das rgya chen po yang de nyid do/ /e baṃ 2las ni phun tshogs lnga ldan pa/ /dpe don gyur pa sgra dang rtags las shes/ /yi ge bzhi bcu gsang ba gleng gzhi las / /e baṃ gsang ba gleng bslang mdo rgyas pa/ /'dzam gling gnas su dkyil 'khor snang ba bstan/ /gsang sngags dbyibs dang brda 3sngags don sbyar ba/ /thun mong gyur pa the tshom sel ba'o/ /dpal ye 4shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa bcu drug pa'o// //smin mtshams mdzod spu'i 'khor lo mu khyud las/ /rtsa yi byed pa ro rkyang thabs shes las/ /srog rtsol 'byung 'jug byang sems spro bsdu dang / /sgro 'dogs gcod pa phyi dang gsang ba'i tshul/ /rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas lugs khyad par las/ /dmag dpon ral gri thogs pa lta bu ste/ /tshogs slob gnyis la spyi 82—45
