dang rang mtshan nyid/ /spros dang spyod pa de nyid snang ba lam/ /rnam shes ye shes dbang po sgo 'byed pa/ /chos la rab tu dbye ba'i sgo nas bstan/ /gang zag rigs pa dbye ba gnyis su shes/ /dbang gis phye ba khyad par chos la yang / /phyi las gzhol dang gsang ba nang gnas byed/ /de nyid khyad par dbye ba de ni mtshon par bya/ /'jig rten pa rnams khams gsum bsam gtan phyir ldog lam//'jig rten las 'das phyir mi ldog pa yang dag ston 1/ /ye shes las ni bla ma'i lam rten 'don rdzogs thob/ /byin rlabs chu rgyun gyis ni bde chen bla med don//rab grub bde ba dpe med ma rtogs log rtog the tshom sel/ /sgro 'dogs skur 'debs bral ba dri med gsang ba grub pa can/ /mthar thug snying po rdzogs sangs 'bras bu lam gyur spyod pa'o/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa bcu bdun pa'o// //gsang ba'i 'khor lo la brten rigs las ni/ /'gro ba blo rigs lnga ldan dbang po ni/ /rab dang yang rab dman pa 'bring rnams te/ /yan lag rlung sgo dbang po lnga spyod yul/ /bdud rtsi lnga ldan de nyid blon po ste/ /byang sems thig le bde ba'i 'byung gnas so/ /gsang ba bde skyong 'khor lo de nyid ni/ /skal can blo ldan 'gro ba'i rgyud kyis bsdus/ /gang zag blo rigs dpe dang sbyar ba ste/ /snod kyi bye brag chos mthun mtshungs pa ste/ /rgyud la 'jug pa'i dbang po'i rim pa ni/ /tha dad chos can blon por chos mthun pa/ /tsan+dan lta bu dbang po 2dman pa'o/ /ut+pal lta bu tha mar gyur pa dang / /pad dkar skal ldan 'bring gyur cung zad dag /pad dmar dbang po rab 'gyur brtson pa che//82wa 46

yang rab rin chen lta bu bla na med/ /rtsa dang byang sems yi ge rlung dag pa/ /nges pa can dang ma nges par 'byung la/ /sbyangs pa can dang thog ma 91)med nas kyi / /rang bzhin yon tan gus pa thob gyur pa'o/ /tsan+dan lta bu ni nyan thos kyi rigs can/ ut+pal lta bu ni rang rgyal ba'o/ /pad+ma dkar po ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams so/ /pad dmar lta bu ni gsang sngags la 'jug pa'o/ /rin chen nalta bu yon tan dang ldan pa ni/ dpal rdo rje 'chang gi rigs sol/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa bcwa 8brgyad pa'o// //kun rdzob kyi bden pa ni chu zla la sogs pa'o/ /don dam pa'i bden pa ni stong pa nyid bcwa 4brgyad do/ /de'i don ni rgya myo/tshor gza' skar shar ba ltar skad cig la 'char ba'o/ /gtsug tor gnas las yon tan kun mthar phyin/ /rdo rje gsum gyi snying po sku gsum rdzogs/ /kun 'dar 5byang chub sems kyis snyobartan gyur pa/ /sgro 'dogs gcod byed dmag dpon ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /don dam kun rdzob dbyer med rta mchog ste/ /dbu ma zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas pa/ /sku bzhi lhun grub ye shes rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ldan par rim pa nyid/ /rdo rje lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad ni/ /dbu ma la brten cha shas phra rags gang / /mtshungs gyur rdo rje gsang chen gyur pa gang / /lam gyur bden pa gnyis kyi 7de nyid ni/ /thams cad sdud byed rim pa rab rdzogs la/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin byang chub pas/ /thog ma bar dang mtha' ma kun du yang / /dus dang rnam pa thams cad rten byed pa/ /khyab cing gnas 82wa 47

med gnas ni bsam mi khyab/ /rgyu 'bras 'gag med rten cing 'brel 'byung girka/ /sku sogs dbang phyug yon tan tshad med pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pa yang dag zhing khams nyid/ /zung 'jug gang du thim pa gnas gar 'jug /rang gi ngo bo byang sems 'gyur med pa/ /gnyis med ro mnyam gyur pa lam dang ni/ /lta 1la spyod pa kun du zung 'jug pa/ /thogs pa med par 'byung ba'i dpal dang ldan/ /ye shes bla med dbang phyug bcu gsum sa/ /mthar phyin skad cig byang chub dbyings ye shes/ /dbyer med byang chub chen po mgon po nyid/ /bde chen mnyam nyid rang 'byung chen po'o/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa bcu dgu pa'o// // nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni ting nge 'dzin gyis bsdus so/ /chen po stong pa nyid dang ske/ don dam pa dang / 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas ni brtson 'grus kyis so/ /mtha' las 'das pa dang / thog ma dang tha 2ma med pa dang /dor ba med pa ni dga' ba yang dag pas so/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang /chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni shin tu sbyangs pas so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid dang rka/ mi dmigs pa ni/ chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag gis so/ /dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid 3stong pa nyid ni dran pa yang dag pas so/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni/btang snyoms yang dag pa byang chub kyi yan lag dang ldan pas so/ /skad cig ma ste chos nyid bden pa'i don to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i 82—48

snying pos gsol pa/ mgon po byams pa la cung zad cig bzhengs la bzod par gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bdag zab don cung zad cig zhu bas / skabs dbye bar gsol zhes zhus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de'i dus la bab par shes na ci rigs par zhus shigaci1 /ngas legs par bstan par bya'o zhes gsungs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying pos gsol pa/ gsang ba chen po'i rgyud 'di yi/ /dgongs pa zab cing rgya che bas/ /gting dpag dka' bar gyur pas na/ /zab don snying po gsung du gsol/ /zhes zhus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / /nam mkha'i snying po shin tu legs/ /gsang chen de nyid gong 'og tu/ /snga phyi'i rim pa'i khyad par kun/ /bshad kyis gus pas legs par zung / /gsang ba'i de nyid bla na med/ /rgyu 'bras zab cing rgya che ba/ /thabs dang shes rab 'dus pa'i rgyud/ /zung 'jug bde chen bstan par bya/ /thog ma bar dang mtha' dge ba/ /byang chub sems mchog bstan pa nyid/ /gzhi dang dngos po'i khyad par dang / /lam byed nus pa phrin la sogs/ /'byung gnas ye shes bstan pa la/ /smon pa dang ni 'jug sems bskyed/ /don dam bstan pa'i byang chub sems/ /yang dag don gyi sems bskyed pa/ /kun tu bzang po'i ting 'dzin las/ /spyi bor pad+ma zla nyi la/ /'khor lo oṃ dkar 'od 'phro ba/ /mgrin par pad dmar āḥ'od 'bar/ /thugs kur zla ba rdo rje ni/ /dkar po rtse lnga 'od 'phro ba/ /dngul chu'i mdog 'dra'i hūṃ ye shes/ /kun rdzob don dam byang chub sems/ /de nyid ting 'dzin gnas par bya/ /dpral bar rin chen sa yig gser / /lte bar ral gri ha ljang ba/ /'od 'phro ye shes lnga bdag nyid//(92wa 49

—— ———— — — —— —————————————— ———— — — ———————wa ————————————wa —wa wa 'od 'gyed 'gro ba sbyangs pa las/ /slar 'dus rigs kyi bdag po ni/ /rdo rje bai ḍūr+ya yi 1'od/ /thugs kur rdo rje la thim pas/ /khro bo'i rdo rje kha gyes pas/ /'dus pa rdo rje 'chang ngo bo/ /byang chub sems kyi rdo rje nyid/ /gnyis med bde ba chen por gnas/ /rtogs pa brjod pas bstan par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor ting 'dzin gnas pa ni/ /'jig rten lam la gnas pa ste/ /phyi la mchog tu gzhol bas ni/ /'jig rten chos brgyad rtog pa 'dab/ /ma spangs lha yi dmigs pa las/ /phra mo rlung la bslab pa dang / /rags pa thig le bsgom pas ni / /las chen thun mong dngos grub la/ /dmigs phyir gnas skabs 'bras bu thob / /rim gnyis ldan pa'i ting 'dzin las/ /spro bsdu rigs kyi rnal 'byor lam / /sa bon thig le'i de nyid las/ /ngo bo ye shes bde chen 'grub/ /mchog gyur nang don mngon du bya/ /rnam par bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / /byang chub sems dang lus gnas pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor bde chen 'byung gnas nyid / /sems kyi dkyil 'khor mchog gyur pa/ /bum pa gsang ba shes rab dang / /de nyid snying po'i dkyil 'khor te/ /ye shes mchog tu dbang bskur ba'o / /gsang ba'i de kho na nyid ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen por bde ba chen po lhun gyis grub pa lhan cig skyes pa/ skal ba dang ldan pa rnams las/ tshad med pa'i don dam pa'i ye shes kyi dbang rdo rjes thogs pa med par kun tu dbang /rdokā ba'o/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa nyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa yi/ /chos don de nyid bla na med/ /spyod 82wa 50

pa'i gsang ba mngon du byung / /khyad par snod ldan rtogs gyur pa'o/ /dag pa'i gnas dang 'khor 'dus la/ /ci phyir tshig ni 'di lta bu/ /rigs pa ma yin ces pa'i don/ /the tshom gnas su gyur pa las/ /phyi rol gyur dang thun mong dang / /ji bzhin sgra dang ma yin dang / /bstan la rang dgar 'jug pa can / /yin nam snyam du rtog pa la/ /bzlog pa de bzhin gshegs rnams kyis/ /phyin ci log tu gyur las bzlog /lan gsungs sgro 'dogs bcad pa'o/ /sems la dmigs pa bdag med pa/ /rnam par dben don bstan pa las/ /gsang ba byang chub rim gyis 1dang / /cig car rim pa nyer bstan pa/ /de nyid lam du mngon par 'byung / /spyod dang grol ba bla med pa/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis gdul 2don du/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i spyod pa spyod/ /rnal 'byor brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin pa'i/ /kun 'gro kun la dbang bskur ba/ /mi 'jigs dgra las rgyal ba ste/ /rig pa brtul zhugs spyod bya ba/ /kun bzang mgon po kun spyod do/ /spros pa'i spyod pas mnyam gzhag dang / /rjes thob gnyis med lam du blang / /phyogs las rnam rgyal spyod thob nas/ /ye shes chen po'i spyad 8bya ba/ /zung 'jug bde chen ro mnyam las/ /mthar thug spang blang med par grol / /a ba dhū cakhri'i spyod pa las/ /spros bcas spros med dag dang ni/ /shin tu spros med spyod pa spyod/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //sangs rgyas kun gyi bla med pa/ /gsang ba byang chub sems dbang bskur/ /dbang po rab dang yang rab dang / /'bring gyur mos pa'i dbang byas pas/ /82—51

thams cad mos spyod lam mtshan 1pa/ /gsang chen mchog gi don las ni/ /ye shes lam bstan de nyid do/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i 2tshad gyur pa/ /ye shes tshad med ri rab ste/ /spyod yul bla med 'dir bstan pa/ /mchod pa'i rol pa lha mo ste/ /pad+ma sna tshogs bde bas mchod/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba kun / /gsang chen theg pa la brten nas/ /rdo rje ye shes ting 'dzin brnyes/ /rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bor ni/ /bde chen mnyam pa nyid gyur pas/ /mi phyed ye shes mngon sangs rgyas/ /rigs ldan mchod pa bla na med pa ste/ /dran pa gcig pa nas ni lus dben par/ /rags pa'i ting 'dzin slob 3dus mnyam rjes las/ /yul lnga gzugs kyi rdo rje ma la sogs/ /sa yi snying po la sogs dbang po lnga/ /yab yum lhar brten slob pa spyod pa ste/ /gzung 'dzin ma spangs spros pa ldan pa'i phyir/ /spros bcas spyod pa zhes cani grags pa'o/ /mchod yul rigs lnga rnam snang la sogs pa/ /mchod rdzas yul lnga lha dang lha mor snang ske/ /mchod byed spros bcas spyod pa la gnas pa/ /mchod thabs so sor rigs kyis mchod pa'o/ /rten slob spros med ngag dben sems dben ldan/ /bdag byin brlabs 5pas ting 'dzin phra ba sa/ /slob ma mnyam rjes thabs dang shes rab dag /gnyis med rten pa'i lus sems brten slob pa/ /mchod bya rigs kyi bdag po lnga sogs so/ /mchod dngos rnam gsum khyad par dag tu'o / /mchod byed rnal 'byor gyis ni thabs bcas mchod/ /rten slob shin tu spros med 'od gsal nas/ /sgyu lus dag pa'i bar du ting 'dzin ni/ /shin tu phra ba slob pa mnyam rjes la/ /bsams pas thabs dang shes rab dbang po dang //yul lnga gnyis med rang bzhin med par bslab/ /spros pa rnam par byed pa de yi 82—52

phyir la/ /shin tu spros med de la bye brag tu/ /mchod bya'i yul ni ye shes sku 'byung ba/ /mchod byed gang zag sgyu mar gnas pas so/ /don ni snang gsum sgyu mar ldan pa las/ /mchod dngos sgyu ma'i 'dod yon nyid yin no/ /mchod pa'i thabs ni bsam gtan gnyis kyis ni/ /'od gsal ngang du thim pa de nyid dol/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa nyi shu 1rtsa gnyis pa'o// //rjes su 2mdor bstan drug gis ni/ /dben pa gsum dang sgyu lus dang / /'od gsal sngon 'gro rgyu dag las/ /ting 'dzin las spyod des spyod pa'i/ /snyoms 'jug rim pa gnyis ldan las/ /dag pa'i sgyu lus rdzogs rim gyi/ /rigs lnga'i gsang ba'i spyod pa las/ /slob bzhin zung 'jug ye shes 'thob/ /bskyed rim pas ni mkha' gsang dag /byin brlabs snyoms zhugs spyod pa'o/ /rjes su dran pa bcu drug gis/ /lam dang spyod pa bstan pa las/ /dag pa'i sgyu ma la gnas nas/ /mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /rigs lnga'i dang po'i sbyor ba bstan/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran la sogs lngas/ /sgyu dag 'od gsal lugs bzlog las/ 4 /rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan pa'o/ /snang gsum ngang las longs sku ni/ /rdo rje 'chang du gnas pa las/ /yab yum bde ba'i ngang las ni / /rnam snang mdzad kyi spro bsdu yis/ /sprul sku'i spros nas bsdu bar bya/ /rjes dran drug pas lce chung gi/ /bdud rtsi 'bab byed bcud len bstan/ /bdun pas bdag nyid yab yum ldan/ /mtshan ma med la gnas pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal po camachog gnas pa/ /brgyad pa dgu pa bcu pa las/ /sku 82— 53

gsung thugs rnams byin brlab pa/ /lha yi rnal 'byor bstan pa'o/ /bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pas/ /rgyu dag lha yi sku gsung thugs/ /byin rlabs bzhi yi bsdus pa la/ /thams cad ye shes dbyings 'jug pa/ /phyi mar mchog thob bstan pa'o/ /bcu gsum pa ni bar ma dor/ /sangs rgyas lam ni ston tsho1pa'o / /bcu bzhi pa dang bco 2lnga pas/ /phyag rgya chen po grub pa ste/ /tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya'i lam ston byed/ /de ltar rjes dran bco 3lnga pas/ /ting nge 'dzin ni bstan pa'o/ /spyod pa rjes dran bcu drug pas/ /dkyil 'khor ting 'dzin bsdus nas ni/ /spyod pa lha mo dgu 'am lnga/ /spyod pa mthar phyin byed pa'o / /rjes dran bcu drug gis ni 'dir/ /myur bar skyob pa'i khyad par yang //zab dang rgya che bstan pa'o/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa nyi shu 4rtsa gsum pa'o// //'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /bder gshegs byang chub sems dpar bcas/ /the tshom gcod mdzad rdo rje'i tshig /yang dag don ni ston par mdzad / /gsang ba ye shes smin grol gyis/ /ting 'dzin ye shes chos bstan to/ /dgongs te gsungs pa gang la gang / /sngon byung rjes 'jug ldem dgongs nyid/ /gsal ba gzhan las khyad par gyur/ /dkyil 'khor dbus 5dbyung rigs bsdus pa'i/ /de nyid rgyal ba 6bslang bar mdzad/ /gcod byed rdo rje bzlas pa ste / /ma byin len pa sems dmigs kyis/ /mi tshangs spyod pa'i 'od gsal ba/ /sgyu mas brdzun du smra ba nyid/ /zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas pas/ /tshig rtsub dngos 'dzin zlog par byed pa'o/ /las rlung cung zad dul bar gyur pa yis/ /82wa 54

ye shes rlung gi nus pa rnyed gyur nas/ /ting 'dzin gsal zhing phra rab 'jug pa nyid / /kun 'dar du 1ni srog rtsol rab sim gyur/ /2dbu mar gnas pas 'byung 'jug g.yo mi 'gyur/ /de las ye shes 'od zer glog lta bu/ /kun nas 'byung ba de nyid thig le'i dbus/ /dkar dmar gong bu 'dres pa'i byang chub sems / /'byung ba'i sgo dang 'jug pa'i sgo nyid ni/ /mi 'pho ri bong 'dzin pa zla rgyas pas/ /sna yi bu ga g.yas g.yon rnal 'byor pa'i/ /gcig nas 'byung zhing gcig tu 'jug pa ni/ /tshim byed bde gnas snying ga lte bar ni/ /gnas pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i snying po ni/ /bskul bar gyur pa'i bde gshegs thams cad la / /phyogs bcur mchod nas dgyes par gyur pa las/ /bdud rtsi spyan gyi mdzod spu nas phyung ste/ /'jug pa rnal 'byor spyi gtsug 'khor lor zhugs/ /mgrin par longs spyod thugs kur thim gyur pas/ /byang chub chen po a ba dhū latīr gnas/ /de nyid spros med bdud rtsi rab rgyas pas/ /gnas bcur khyab pa kun 'dar mi ldog gyur/ /bde ba chen po'i snying po bskul ba ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ro mnyam pas/ /byang sems rdo rje nyid du mchog mngon 'gyur/ /rgyal sras thams cad rab tu dgyes gyur pas/ /ye shes snying po nus pa brtan byed 'gyur/ /'di ni ye shes pho nya mchog gis ni/ /skad cig nyid la byang chub mngon du byed/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //ye shes mngon par 'byung ba las/ /sngags kyis lha yi sku bskyed pa/ /mngon par byang chub rnam lnga las/ /rdo rje 'chang nyid grub byed pa'i/ /bden 82wa 55

gnyis rnam dag rgyu 'bras te/ /yongs su dag pa'i skur rdzogs byed/ /rigs kyi lha yi rnal 'byor pa/ /rim pa ji bzhin rdzogs byed pa/ /sngags kyis bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /ye shes kyis ni sku bskyed pa/ /rdo rje 'chang nyid rnal 'byor pa/ /sgyu ma stong nyid 'jug pa ste/ /dngos pos mthong bar mi 'gyur ro//khams gsum brtan g.yo bdag nyid bcas/ /ril 'dzin rjes gzhig ting 'dzin gyis/ /thams cad 'od gsal gnas 'jug pa/ /ye shes zung 'jug thob 'gyur ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /mngon shes sgrub byed sa bon bcas/ /de las yang dag rab grub 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las stobs/ /mtshungs med yon tan rgya mtsho ste/ /mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo mchog /ā li bcu gnyis dbyangs ldan pa/ /'byung ba lnga yi rlung gis ni/ /lha mo lnga ru gyur pa la/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag drug cur brjod/ /kā li gsal byed yi ge 1ni/ /ḍa nye da dha ya la ta/ /sum cu rtsa bzhi de snyed las/ /drug bcas bzhi bcu nyis 'gyur las/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cur 'gyur/ /rang bzhin dag pas gnas 'gyur ba'o/ /yang na dbyangs yig nyis 'gyur bcas/ /mtshan mchog sum cu rtsa gnyis pon/ /'grub 'gyur rgyu rkyen nyer len las/ /rgyu 'bras mngon du gsal bar 'byung / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kun yon tan ni/ /'khor los sgyur las khyad 'phags pa/ /mdzod spu smin mtshams 'od 'bar ba/ /gsang ba sbubs su nub pa dang / /gtsug tor lta bas mi mngon pa/ /'od zer dkyil 'khor khyab byed pa/ /dbang gi nus pa brtan gyur pas/ /gzugs sku'i yon tan rgyu 'bras kyi/ /byed las stobs ldan 'byung 'gyur nyid/ /gsang sngags zab dang rgya che ba/ /82wa 56

myur ba nyid du byin brlabs shing / /bde ba lam byed tshe 'di dang / /bar dor 1ye shes mngon du byed/ /bla ma las ni grol spyod 'thob/ /mngon sum rten 'brel khyad par ro/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa nyi shu 2rtsa lnga pa'o// //de nas rang bzhin rtog pa ni/ /dper na rgya mtsho chen po la/ /bya yi tshogs rnams rgyu ba kun/ /'gro 'ong du ma byed gyur kyang / /rgya mtsho g.yo ba med pa bzhin/ /snang ba gsum gyi ye shes la/ /gos pa med cing rtog pa med/ /rtsa rnams rnam par dag pas ni/ /gtum mo ye shes me 'bar ba'o/ /rlung ni srog rtsol dag pa na/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu 3chu zlar 'char/ /thig le dag par gyur pa nal/ /'od gsal bde ba chen por 'char/ /bag chags rtog pa dag pa las/ /rmi lam sangs rgyas zhing khams mthong / /yi ge dag cing khams dngas 4pas/ /mkhyen pa brkyang bas rnam grol 'thob/ /sems gsum zhi gnas cha dang ni/ /sems gsum lhag mthong gang yin pa/ /rnal 'byor pa la nges par 'char/ /rtog pa'i rba rlabs ngang gis zhi/ /snang ba skye ba med pa ste/ /snang ba thob pa 'gag pa med/ /snang ba mched pa mi gnas shing / /gnas pa med pas mi rtag pa / /nyer thob stong nyid don gnas pa'o/ /'od gsal chos nyid de bzhin nyid / /mkha' ltar dag pa bde ba che/ /ma 'gags dri ma med zhi ba/ /don dam phyag rgya chen po nyid/ /sa lam nus pa kun rdzogs pa/ /slob pa'i zung 'jug snying po nyid/ /rdo rje sgo gsum rnam dag pas/ /mi slob zung 'jug mngon du gyur/ /de nyid mthar phyin bla med pa'o/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun (92—57

las bsdus pa 1las rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o// //de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /bsam gtan gnyis kyis ye shes 'jug /de yi khyad par bcas pa bstan/ /rig pa 'dzin pa lnga grub pa/ /rnal 'byor dngos grub thob 'gyur bshad/ /'bru gsum bdud rtsi ril bu yi/ /yon tan nus pa myur grub byed/ /rdo rje dgug pa'i phrin las dbang / /dam tshig sha lnga'i yon tan tshul/ /de las dngos grub dbang phyug 'thob/ /mngon gyur 'bras bu phrin las 'grub/ /da rini bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi/ /rdo rje rnam bzhi lha yi sku/ /lus dben rdo rje bzlas pa dang / /snang gsum sgyu lus 'od gsal ba/ /so sor bsdus pa bsam gtan lam/ /srog rtsol 'dzin pa de bzhin nyid/ /rjes dran yan lag ting 'dzin stobs/ /zung 'jug rim pa bstan pa las/ /rigs kyi cha las de nyid gnas / /rgyu rkyen lam dang nus 'bral gang / /mngon 'gyur lta stangs spyod yul kun/ / rim gyis 'char dang cig car ba/ /de nyid thod rgal rim rtogs bya/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas lam dang ni/ /bar dor dngos grub 'byung lam dang / /sgo gsum byin brlabs rdo rje yi/ /smon lam phyi dus 'grub par gyur / /bsam gtan gnas pa dbang po thabs/ /yul nyid shes rab ting nge 'dzin / /dbyer med sbyo ra ba gsang gnas te/ /dus gsum las 'das rtog pa'o / /rnam shes de nyid gsal ba las/ /ma 'gags yul rjes mi 'brang zhing //mi g.yo nyon mongs las dag pa/ /rnam par spyod pa bye brag gsal/ /rnam par mi rtog dmigs med pa/ /mi 'khrul lus sems tha mi dad/ /tshor ba las 82—58

'das dga' ba nyid/ /'phro ba med pas sems gnas pa'o/ /zug rngu'i rdul mang 1rnam 'tshe dag /sgo gsum ngang du dul zhing zhi/ /bde ba zag med chos nyid gnas/ / 'du 'bral 2med par gyur pas so/ /rab tu dul ba rnam shes tshogs / /dag gyur shes bya chos kyi khams/ /zad cing gzung 'dzin rnam dag pas / /stong nyid ye shes rtse gcig pa/ /rnam pa kun du mi ldog pas/ /mtshan ma med pa byang chub pa'o/ /snang ba thob pa stong pa nyid/ /mchod pa stong chen gyur pa ste/ /snang tsam thams cad stong pa dang / /nyer thob thams cad stong pa nyid / /dag pa rab gsal mchog gyur pas/ /ro gcig gyur pa lugs 'byung dang ske/ /lugs bzlog rtog natshogs zhi ba ste/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos 'jig rten lam/ /de nyid mchog tu bstan pa yin/ /de bzhin gshegs kun bdag nyid las/ /rkyen las 'byung ba lam gyur pa/ /rnal 'byor gsal dang mi rtog pa / /bde ba'i byed pa lta stangs las/ /ka ra ṇa bcings nus pas ni/ /srid pa gsum po g.yo mi 'gyur/ /bin+dha 4kun dor gnang sdom las/ /mi 'gyur brtan byed yon tan thob/ /lus gnas rtsa yi pho brang las/ /g.yas pa'i nyi ma rtsol ba ste/ /g.yon pa zla ba srog bcing ba/ /'byung 'jug gnas pa lam bstan pa'o/ /dbu mar byang sems rten byed pa/ /kun 'dar nges gnas 'pho med bzung / /mtshan mar mi 'gyur mchog gi rtsa/ /las kyi rlung sgom bye brag pal/ /'gog pas mun pa sgra gcan 'dzin/ /gsang ba'i sna rtse'i steng 'og tu/ /'byung ba rkyen rlung snang ba grogs/ /sgo lnga bzlog las gnas par bya/ /ye shes sgron me snang ba skye/ /rnal 'byor gang zhig mngon gyur pas/ /rlung sems rnam dag rtags 'char ba/ /yang na 'pho tshe lam 'thob 'gyur/ /de las rang 82—59

bzhin dag pa'i tshe/ /'od gsal ngang las spro bsdu nyid/ /dbu ma'i lam nas 'jug par 'gyur/ /bde ba'i thig le thabs dang ni/ /ye shes me ni shes rab che / /gnyis med dhū tī'i nang zhugs pas/ /bdud rtsi mi 'pho gsang lam gnas / /de nyid du ni srog brten cing / /'dzin pa ye shes lam gyur pa'o/ /de las gtum mo 'bar gyur zhing / /las rlung gyen log lte bar phyin/ /ho las bdud rtsi 'bar 'dzag gyur/ /mgrin par dga' ba snying gar ni/ /mchog dga' lte bar khyad par can/ /gsang bar mi ldog lhan cig skyes/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur 'thob pa'o/ /de nyid ye shes rjes dran gces/ /lus ngag yid dang ye shes zhi/ /phyag rgya'i de nyid mngon gyur pa'o/ /shes pa dag ni rnam dag pa/ /lte bar 'dod chags rtog pa dag /snying gar gnyid kyi rtog pa zhi/ /mgrin par rmi lam shes pa dag /dpral bar sad pa'i shes pa spangs/ /las rlung rtsa yi 1'khor lo yi/ /thig ler gnas pa rten dang ni/ /brten pa byang sems mi 'gyur thob/ /las kyi phung po log gyur cing / /mnyam pa'i bden pa la 'jug pa / /gtsug tor sgo ni phye gyur pas/ /'bigs byed brtan pa'i don thob pas/ /yon tan dpag med mngon du gyur/ /thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang du gyur/ /de nyid yon tan phrin las tshogs/ /rtog med ngang las kun du 'byung / /skad cig mngon rdzogs zung 'jug pa/ /ting nge 'dzin zhes brjod pa ste/ /gsang chen gnas 'thob mngon sangs rgyas / /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'o// //82—60

de nas ye shes kun mkhyen pa'i/ /gsang ba rab 'byam 1grub pa ste/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /yang dag sbyor ba'i don gyis ni/ /thogs med nus pa ldan gyur pa/ /bden pa gnyis bsres don bstan pa'o/ /phrin las bzhi yi byed pa las/ /grub tshul de nyid bstan pa'o/ /bzlas thabs bcu yis grub pa'i don/ /sngags rnams kun gyi de nyid kyis/ /lam rdzogs sa rnams mngon gyur pas/ /bdag byin brlab par gyur pa'o/ /tshe 'di nyid dang bar dor ni/ /ye shes dngos grub thob par bshad/ /gong du 'pho ba'i don grub byed/ /bcu bdun lha yi 'khor lo las/ /grub pa rab gsal bde thob pa'one/ /mtshon bya'i 'bras bu mngon grub na/ /mtshon byed nus pa thogs med 'byung ske/ /gsal bya gsal byed rgyu 'bras dang / /bskyed bya skyed byed rgyu 'bras so / /ngo bo nyid kyi rgyu 'bras las/ /rgyus ni 'bras bu skyed byed pas/ /'bras bu rgyu las 'byung bas na/ /phan tshun ltos rnapa'i rgyu 'bras so/ /ngo bo gcig par grub 'gyur te/ /rgyu 'bras rnam pa tha dad kyang / /rigs mthun gnas nyid mtshungs 'bral bas/ /grub sde gcig par grub pa'o/ /rgyu 'bras ma lus rten 'brel te/ /de nyid nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /stong nyid dngos po sna tshogs par / /gnas kyang ro mnyam 'gag pa med/ /chos rnams snang ba ma lus la/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin ngang las 'byung / /sgrib phyogs dang ni snang phyogs dag /skye 'gag de nyid dngos med pas/ /bden gnyis tha dad gyur pa na/ /ye shes lam ni don med 'gyur/ /gsal stong gnyis ni tha dad na/ /rtag chad mthar ni ltung bar 'gyur/ /dngos po'i gnas lugs la brten nas/ /dngos med ye shes 'od gsal ba/ /zab dang rgya che gnyis med pa/ /rgyu rkyen ma lus dag byed 82—61

pas / /bsam gtan ting 'dzin mthar thug ni/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ngo bo nyid/ /dngos po thams cad zlog byed pa/ /shing gi tshogs la me 'bar bas/ /bsregs te dngos med 'gyur ba ltar/ /mthar ni thams cad stong nyid du/ /ye shes mes ni rnam par sbyangs/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i dbyings las ni/ /ye shes phrin las 'gag med 'byung / /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /dpal ldan lus kyi rnam shes dang / /ye shes sgyu 'phrul la sogs bstan/ /lha mo bzhi dang khro bo bcu/ /sna tshogs phrin las du ma mchog /'gro ba 'dul ba'i don du'o/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las / /phyi nang dbye ba rim pa yis/ /ma grub spogs pa'i cho ga ni/ /phur gdab de nyid bstan pa'o/ /'dod pa'i khams na 'gro ba kun/ /rnam rtog rlung gi ra bar tshud/ /bdag 'dzin mdud pas bsdams pa la/ /smin grol ye shes lam rtogs pa/ /bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad bkod pa la/ /so bdun yi ge la dmigs pa/ /bcu drug cha dang ldan pa'o/ /drod ni snang ba rtog bral sems/ /spangs thob yon tan 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /rtse mo mchod pa nus pa rnyed/ /'jigs pa las grol brtan par 'gyur/ /bzod pa snang ba thob pa nyid/ /rtog pa kun las rnam par grol/ /chos mchog snang ba nyer thob nyid/ /ye shes de ma thag pa che/ /zil gnon rten 'brel phyogs cha 'char / /rigs pa mngon gyur rtog pa 'dag /de nyid 'khor 'das yon tan thob / /gzung 'dzin cha 'das lam du gyur/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rtogs par 82—62

——wa wa ———————————wa —————— —————————————————————— — ——— — — —————— ——————————————————————————sdo// pa'o/da//pal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa spros pa med pa'i spyod pa ye shes kyi grub pa'i don bstan pa'i phyir/ dben gnas dben pa yon tan kun dang ldan pa/ lus gnas sems kyi dur khrod rab tu sgrub pa nyid du bya ba ste/ dngos 'dzin rnam par dag pa nyid kyis so/ /sme sha can ni rtog med ma'i sha la rol pa nyid de1/ khyad par du ye shes yang dag pa bsgrub pa ste/ dus rtag tu ye shes kyi ngang las mi 'da' bar bsgrub pa'o/ /rig ma shes rab ye shes las skyes ma/ rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa ste bcu phrag gnyis ma nyid do/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni/ ye shes kyi sku bskyed pa/'od gsal las byung ba'i lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i pho brang dang ldan pa'o/ /de nyid phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnam par dag pa/ dpal rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dkyil 'khor du dmigs pa'ol/ /bshang gci'i dam tshig ni yul dang dbang po gnyis med du sbyar ba'o/ /la sogs ni bde ba stong pa nyams su myong ba'i zas kyis khyad par yul la spyod pa'o / /de ru cho ga bzhin du zhes pa rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum rol pa bde chen mi 'gyur ba yongs su grub pa'o/ /de'i dkyil 'khor rten gzhal yas khang chos 'byung dang / 'byung ba rim brtsegs dang bcas pa rten dang brten pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ye shes las skyes pa/ ye shes las byung ba'i mtshan nyid bde stong ro mnyam du 'byung ba'i ngo bo nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /rab tu bzang bas na 'od gsal ba'i ye shes las skyes pa/ bzhin rab tu mdzes pa ye shes kyi 82wa 63

dbang po dang stobs las byung ba nyid do/ /rgyan rnams ni bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i cha las 'phags pa'i nor las yan lag bdun ldan ye shes kyi che 1bas yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid dang / reg bya rdo rje ma chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje mar gyur pa rnam par bsgom zhes pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor lnga'i 'khor lo ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i dkyil 'khor/ dpral ba mgrin pa thugs ka lte ba gsang ba dang bcas par sangs rgyas kyi sku'i mtshan dpe dang / sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan dang ldan pa/ye shes las 'byung ba skad cig gis so/ /der rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gsang sngags kyi rnam par bsam pa'i 'khor lo can gyi gsang ba ye shes kyi bsgrub pa ste/bde stong gnyis su med pa'i phyag rgya chen por ngo bo nyid mi 'gyur ba'i mchod pa'i gnas / tshad med pas yang dag par mchod pa/ dmigs pa rnam par gyur pa'i nyams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis so/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa sum cu pa'o// //de nyid las gsang ba bla na med pa'i bsgrub pa bstan pa'i phyir/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can zhes pa ste/ sku rdo rje mi 'gyur ba gsung rdo rje 'gag pa med pa / thugs rdo rje rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes la2/ de nyid dbyer mi phyed pa'i dkyil 'khor/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la kun tu rnam par snang bar mdzad pa/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/sku'i 'od kyi snang ba las spro ba dang bsdu bar mdzad pa'i phyir 'od zer chen po dang rab tu chen po/ spro ba dang bsdu ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes kyi rol (92wa 64

pa ston pa'o/ /yang de nyid du rig ma'i rigs dag pas1/ ye shes bsgrub pa phun sum tshogs pa bstan pa'i phyir/ bram ze ma nal sogs pa ste/ rdo rje rigs kyi sme 3sha can lta bu'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la ni/ btso blag mkhan te dngos po thams cad ye shes su sgyur labar byed pa'o/ /yang na bram ze zhes pa stespyo/ sdig pa'i dri mas ma gos pa'o/ /rgyal rigs ni rin po che'i rigs la ste /ye shes 'bar ba'i che ba dang ldan pa'o/ /rje'u rigs ni pad+ma can la ste 7chags pa med pa'o/ /rdo rje chos kyi rigs chags pa med pa pad+ma'i 'dam las thon pa lta bur bsgrub pa nyid do/ /yang na gar mkhan gyi rigs kyis kun tu sgyur bar byed pas/ 'di ni ye shes bde chen gsang ba ye shes myur du thob par byed pa nyid do/ /yang na pad+ma'i rigs kyi rig ma lta bu'am/ gtum pa ma rnam rtog rtsad nas gcod pa dag gam/ khyad par du rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ba yis/zhe sdang rdo rje'i 'khor lo dang ldan pas/ snying ga'i gnas su stong pa dang snying rje tha mi dad pa/ byang chub rdo rje'i sbyor ba dang ldan pas/ rig ma ut+pa la mthing ga'i mdog 'dra ba/ sems dpa' ut+pa la la chu'i dri mas ma gos pa dang mtshungs pa/ btso blag mkhan thams cad ye shes su sgyur bar byed pa nyid de/sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang mtshungs pa dag ni/ brten bsgrub pa mnyam rjes gnyis su med pas rab tu grub pa'i dbang phyug 'thob pa'o/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa sum cu so gcig pa'o// //yang shin tu spros pa med pa'i rnal 'byor bstan pa las ni/ dam pa gnyis kyi sbyor ba ni/ thabs rlung gi sbyor ba dang / shes rab rig pa /stong nyid spros 82—65

med lhan cig skyes pa rang 'byung ro mnyam bde ba chen po'i sbyor bas ye shes la rol pa gar gyi nyams kyi spyod pa thams cad 'od gsal ba'i ngang las/ zung 'jug bde ba chen por phrin las thams cad brtsam par bya ba'o/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub sems 'da' bar mi bya bas 'da' bar dka' ba ste da 1phan yon ni sku gsung thugs gsang ba gsum gyi ye shes dang ldan pa de ni skad cig de ma thag tu yang / dpal rdo rje 'chang byang chub sems rdo rje dang phrin las tha mi dad pa 'thob par 'gyur ba'i mtshan nyid kyi tha tshig go/ /rdo rje nyi ma nub pa rdo rje ni/ sgyu lus dag pa thabs mi phyed pa/ nyi ma ni snang ba dang snang ba mched pa'i cha las nub pa snang ba thob pa las/ khyad par du rang bzhin gyi rtog pa thams cad rtsa ro rkyang naganyis rlung dang shes pa dbyer med du bsdus nas/ rtsa dbu ma ye shes kyi ngang du/ spang blang med par nub pa chen po nyid de/ de nyid du nam mkha' rnam par dag pa lta bu'i bde stong dbyer med 'od gsal chen po rab tu mi gnas pa'i ngang du gnas par 'gyur ba'o/ /de las slob pa'i zung 'jug tu ldang bas/ skya rengs shar ba lta bu ste/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes dus gsum phyogs bcur khyab pa'i skad cig ma'i khyad par la/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gyur pa'o/ /khyad par sgyu lus rnam par dag pa ye shes kyi rab tu byed pa bstan pa'i phyir/ rgyal po sems dpa' ste/ chos rnams kun dang mtshungs par ldan pa rgyal po 'khor los sgyur lab ni/ rin po che bdun dang ldan pa ste/ gnas skabs su 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyi rgyan gyis spras pa na / rgyud gsang chen la rgyan bdun gyis spras par gyur pas/ sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan du grub pa 'dod dang thar pa rab tu grub pa ste/82wa 66

—————wa wa wa ————————wa — —————————— — ——— ——————————————— ——dbang phyug brgyad ldan zung 'jug bla na med pa rab tu grub pa nyid do/ /dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa thams cad rnam par 'dzin pa/ rnam par dag par sgyu ma rab tu mi gnas par bstan pa'i don du/ de ni rdo rje chos kyi bdag ces tshad med pa'i byang chub sems las byung ba'i chos kyi dbang phyug chen po/ phyir mi ldog pa'i gnas thob pa/ dag pa'i sa la gnas par 'gyur ba ni/ sa bcu la ni gnas par 'gyur ba ste/ snang ba gsum po rang bzhin dang bcas pa/thams cad dag pas bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa thob pas/ lus kyi gnas dang nye ba'i gnas la sogs par bgrod pas/ rten dang brten pa rang byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rgyal po dpung gi dam tshig 'dzin na 1thogs pa med pa'i ye shes kyis phrin las yon tan mi zad pa stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa'i dbang phyug dam pa brgyad la sogs pa ma 'dres pa'i chos spobs dzon la dbang sgyur ba/ kun gyi mchog tshad med mngon du gyur pa'o/ /mngon par byang chub rnam gnyis las/ /phyi nang gnyis su dgos pas bshad/ /nang gi dus te cho 'phrul bstan/ /bdud las rnam par rgyal ba ste/ /rdo rje sgo gsum so sor dag /slob pa'i phyi yi mngon byang chub/ /tho rangs mi slob zung 'jug ste/ /sku bzhi gcig 4tu 'dus pa ste/ /skad cig ye shes rnam grol r+shar+shadī/ pa'o///dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa sum cu so de las mngon par byang chub pa bde ba chen po'i dbang phyug bstan pa'i phyir/rdo rje rnal 'byor pas ci rdo rje lus kyi khyad par la bstan 6nas/ rig ma mngon 82—67

par 'du bya ba las/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs dang ldan pas/ thabs dang thabs las 'byung ba'i rdo rje chos 'byung pad+mar nub pas/ shes rab ze 'bru rgyas par zla ba dang nyi ma ngo 1mnyam par gyur pas/ snang ba dang snang ba mched pa dang snang ba thob pa dang / nye bar thob pa nub pa can gyi ye shes kyi bsgrub pa kun tu brtsam pa'o/ /'od gsal ba'i ye shes thog ma dang mthar 'byung ba nyid kyis rang bzhin rnams kun 'dar du 2nub cing rnam par dag pa'o/ /skya rengs 'char ba'i cha ni mkha' snang dag pa'i ngang du ye shes 'jug pa dang bzlog par gyur pas/ stong pa bzhi las 'das pa'i ting nge 'dzin mchog ste/ rgyu kun tu byang chub sems 'phel ba las/ rkyen rig ma'i stobs kyis/ rtsa gnas thams cad du thig le 'phel zhing rgyas pa las/ dga' ba'i dus su rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i skad cig ma dang / mchog dga'i dus su rnam par smin pa'i khyad par gyi dga' ba'i dus su rnam par nyed pa nyid do/ /skad cig ma gsum las 'das pa'i dus de ma thag pa las/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba las mtshan nyid bral ba'i skad cig ma mngon du gyur pa/ bde stong ro mnyam gyi ye shes phyag rgya chen po rab tu mi gnas pa'i don zung 'jug chen po thob par gyur pa'o/ /de snyenyid yongs su dag pa bla na med pa'i che ba bstan pa la/ rgyan rnams don gyi rgyan ye shes kyi che ba bsam gyis dmi khyab tu 'char la/ rnam grangs yon tan gyi che ba tshad med par 'chor ba'o/ /rnam pa thams cad du rim 4dang cig car du kun du snang ba'o/ /me tog ni gzugs rdo rje spos ni dri rdo rje ma la tshosogs kyis sgra rdo rje / ro rdo rje dang / reg bya rdo rje ma'i rnam par snang ba'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ byang chub sems rdo rje'i phrin las/ phung po khams dang skye mched 82wa 68

thams cad rten dang brten par gyur pa/ spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar du bde ba tshad med pa skyes pas/ snang srid thams cad bde ba tshad med par gyur pa / sa gsum kun tu sgyu ma'i rol pas mi zad pa'i cho 'phrul dpag tu med pa skad cig gcig la 'char bar 'gyur ba'o/ /de'i tshe bstan pa sku gsum mchog ni / bde ba longs sku/ gsal ba sprul sku/ mi rtog pa chos kyi sku ste/ dbyer med ngo bo nyid lhun grub de la/ phrin las thogs pa med par 'char bas rab tu bsgom pa'o/ /dpag tshad brgya'i ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhing khams tshad med pa'i snang ba chen pos kun tu byas pa spro bsdu'i mdzad pa ston pa'o/ /de las dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba ni/ thabs snying rje chen po bla na med pa ni shes rab rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med du gyur pa'o/ /sangs rgyas ni slob pa las 'das pa mi slob pa'i zung 'jug ste/ byang chub ni yang dag pa'i ye shes thugs su chud pa'o//gnas zhi ba ste mtha' thams cad dang bral ba gnyis med zung 'jug chen po mngon du gyur pas sa bcu gsum pa'i dbang phyug dam pa'o/ /nye bar bsdu ba la gdams pa ste/ rdo rje can ni dag pa'i sgyu lus la gnas pa ste/ mi slob pa'i zung 'jug lam thams cad mthar phyin pas srod dus su bdud bcom ste/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po'i nus pa thob pa/ thob pas ye shes chen po gsang ba'i gnas grub pa'o/ /tho rangs shin tu rnam par dag pa'i grub pa/ye shes rab tu mi gnas pa/ gtsug tor chen po rab tu rdzogs 1pa bde ba chen po mi shigs 2pa bla na med pa thob pa'o/ /bshang gci'i dam tshig bza' ba ni/dbyings kyi ngang du ye shes ro mnyam du thim pas dngos grub ma zad pa ye shes rgya 82—69

mtsho rnam par dag pa/ rdo rje sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba byang chub chen po rab tu rtogs pa'i skad cig gcig rdo rje 'chang de bzhin gshegs pa mngon du gyur pa'o / /yang dag par gsungs pa phyi'i mngon par byang chub pa ste/ dgongs pas 1bshad pa'o/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa sum cu so gsum pa'o// //de la 'dir chos thams cad ni sgyu ma dang mtshungs pa/ sgyu ma lta bur spyod cing 'jug pa nyid/ /sgyu ma de dag byin gyis rlabs pa'i rim pa las/ /ma dag pa las rnam dag lha yi 2sku/ /lus ngag yid gsum sgyu mar lam du 'chang da/ /phung po khams dang skye mched 'byung sogs rnams/ /shes pa gnyis la de nyid yongs 4bsdus nas/ /gang zhig stong chen gnyid log gyur pa ste/ /rlung gi byed pas rmi lam mthong bar 'gyur/ /rmi lam yul las bye brag 'khrug par snang / /kun du rtog pa'i rgyu 'bras rmi lam rtog /gang gis mtshan dang nyin du gnyid 'jug pas/ /gnyid log sad pa tha dad gyur pa min/ /sa mthug 5bsgribs pas rab tu ring gnyid log /sngar byas 'bras bu ma smin las rnams kun/ /de nas rlung gis las rnams 'byung 'jug 'gyur/ /sngon las smin par gyur na rlung sems dag /'jig rten 'pho ba gnas gzhan dag tu 'gro/ /ji ltar phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba rnams/ /de yi sku la rkang rus sha khrag med / /sems can don du khams la 'jug par mdzad/ /sprul pa sgyu mas 'gro don mdzad pa bzhin/ /de bzhin gnyid log sad gyur rim pas sems/ /rnam rtog dra bas bcings pas tha dad can/ /chos rnams las ni yongs su ma 'das phyir//82wa 70

bden dang brdzun pa gcig dang du mar min/ /phyi rol don du gyur pa ci yang med / /de phyir rang sems stong nyid cho 'phrul yin/ /sgyu mar snang ba 'khrul pa las bzlog bya/ /cir snang med bdag rtogs par bya/ /rmi lam de nyid rtog med rang gsal ba/ /'byung ba'i gnas la khams 'dus snang ba gang / /sas brtan chus sdud 1mes rno ngar chags pa/ /rlung gis yang zhing g.yo byed mi brtan pa'o/ /nam mkha' la 'dus lus bde nyams bzang ba/ /bdud rtsi dag las nus pa 'byung ba ste/ /gla rtsis zhe sdang 2bzhi mnyam gti mug nyid/ /ga bur chags byed si glas nga rgyal bskyed/ /sna tshogs las kyis phrag ridog 'du 'phro byed/ /lam gyur dmigs pas yon tan pa rnam 'char/ /sngar phyung ba las phyis 'byung rtags su 'char/ /yul dus mtshan ma nges pa dran pa'i blo/ /nyams snang blo las ma bcos sgyu mar snang / /de nyid ros snye zin ye shes grogs yin no/ /rang srog snying por gyur pa sems nyid las/ /chos nyid sems lus khams gsum snang ba la/ /gzhan pa med cing rlung las khams gsum sprul/ /sgyu lus rmi lam rmis pa bzhin du mthong / /khams gsum rlung rig bdag nyid de bzhin nyid/ /rjes su rtogs pa 'bring gis chos rnams kun/ /sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur 'char ba dang / /rab kyi nam mkha' lta bur rtogs pa ni/ /'od gsal ba la bsam gtan ting 'dzin ldan/ /rjes su rtogs pa shin tu rab gyur pas/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur rtogs pa nyid/ /zung 'jug mngon du gyur pa'i don nyid de/ /ngo bo nyid las 'bad med gzhan don du/ /rtog med mi g.yo lhun grub gyur pa'o/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las/ rab tu byed pa sum cu so bzhi pa'o// //

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad bsdus pa yi / /'khor lo 'byung ba bla med pa/ /gsang chen dkyil 'khor bstan pa'o/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /yab yum rol pa gsang ba yi/ /'og min gnas nas 'dir gshegs pa/ /byin rlabs ye shes dbab par byed/ /'di ni rdo rje chen po yi/ /dbang bskur ye shes gsang ba ste/ /rnal 'byor lus kyi gnas rnams su/ /spyi bo lte ba dpral ba dang / /mgrin pa snying ga gsang bar ni / /bder gshegs rdo rje chen po yi/ /yab yum phyi nang gsang ba la /gnyis med rol pas dbang bskur ba/ /bde chen ye shes mi 'gyur ba'i/ /gsang chen dbang ni dri med pa'o/ /gsang ba rdo rje theg pa yi/ /sdom pa gsang ba rgyas gdab pa/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i snying po ni/ /yang dag sdom pa bstan pa'ol/ /rlung sems 'gyur ldog dus gnad 'gyur ba nyid/ /rlung sems gcig tu gnas sam tha dad 'gyur/ /gal te rlung sems gcig tu mtshungs ldan na/ /thog mar sngon du 'gro ba gang yin pa/ /'gro 'ong rim pa bzhin du byed 'gyur na / /sngon du 'gro ba gang yin de rjes su/ /'brangs las gang gang byed pa gang de snyed/ /so sor byed dam gcig tu mnyam par byed/ /so sor byed na gcig pa'i khyad par nyams/ /gcig tu byed na snga 1phyi med par 'gyur/ /rlung 'gags rnan ni rtog pa 'gag mi 'gag /gal te rtog pa bzlog par gyur pa na/ /rlung gis las ni ji ltar byed par gyur/ /'byung ba rlung dang rang bzhin rtog pa dag /mnyam du 'byung 'jug byed dam mi byed brtag /srog ste rlung dang rnam shes gang yin pa/ /phyi rol 'byung ba'i rlung ni 'gags dpa na/ /lus can 82—72

rnams kyi srog kyang 'gag par 'gyur/ /phyi yi rlung dang nang gi rlung dag las/ /gcig 'gags 1pas na phyi ma 'gag 'gyur ram/ /gcig ni log na thams cad log 'gyur grang / /gcig ni log kyang gsum po mi ldog 'gyur/ / 'di yi 2dbye ba khyad par rtogs par bya/ /rlung sems 'gro ldog gi gnas lugs bstan pa'o / /rtag tu ma byin len pa ni/ /yon tan ye shes phrin las kun/ /dus med par ni nus pas blang / /rnam rtog ltung byed ma lus pa/ /rang bzhin shes pas rtsa ba bcad/ /chos rnams sgyu ma rmi lam ltar/ /gsang ba bde chen grub pa late/ /rmad byung bde chen 'dod chags nyid/ /shes pas rang bzhin med par smra / /rdo rje 'dzin par gnas par spyad/ /bzlog pa sman nyid ye shes che/ /log par ltung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sdom pa thabs dang shes rab dag /gnyis med phyag rgya chen 3por na / /dus kun du ni de nyid sdom/ /sdom pa thams cad kyi gsang ba zil gnon rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin spyod pa'i brtul zhugs so/ /rdo rje'i bdag nyid gsum 'dus nas/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor pa thim 'gyur / /de gnyis sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /rtog pa'i dba' 5rlabs rab zhi brka/ /nyer dpyad ye shes sgyu ma dag pa las/ /yongs dag rnal 'byor spros bcas dang / /spros med las 'das stong pa nyid/ /'od gsal shin tu spros med las/ /phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug thob/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las/ rab tu byed pa sum cu so lnga pa'o// //'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /de nyid gsang chen tshul mchog ste/ /rdo rje gsum las 'khor lo 'byung / /byang chub sangs rgyas gnas 'jug pa'o/ /82—73

de kho na nyid las mngon rtogs/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rgyan gyur pa'o/ /brjod bya dang ni rjod byed dang / /dpa' dang mngon gyur 1stobs dang ni/ /chos don khyab par gyur pa'i phyir/ /stobs ldan khyad par rgyan yin no/ /gnas pa dang ni gsal rdzu 'phrul/ /yon tan phrin las rgyan rim bzhin/ /de ni rjod 2byed rtag tu rgyan/ /don gyur dgos pa bla na med/ /don gnas byed pa ye shes kyil/ /gsang chen bde mthong khyad par te/ /rgyan las dbye bsdu bstan pa'o/ /de nas bder gshegs rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dus pa'i tshogs la rjes brtse bas/ /rdo rje gsang ba gsung dag pa/ /ye shes rdo rjes 'dir gsungs pa/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas ma lus pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings ni ye shes che/ /'od gsal rang bzhin yongs su dag /dri med nam mkha'i dbyings bzhin no/ /ye shes ngo bo nyid 'byung ba/ /khams gsum dag na byang chub spyod/ /'gro ba kun la bde 'byung ba'i/ /dge ba yongs su dag gyur byos/ /dag pa'i lus ni rnam thar gyi//sgo gsum grub 3pa sku rdo rje/ /ngag ni dag pa chos kyi tshul/ /so sor yang dag rig pa che/ /gsung gi dbyangs ni mi phyed 'gyur/ /rnam shes dus gsum dus med du/ /ye shes byang chub chen por 'byung / /dbyer med bde chen mi gnas pa'o / /de nas sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams ngo mtshar du gyur rmad du gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po 'di ci'i slad du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi 'khor gyi nang du/ 'di lta bu'i tshig ngan pa gsung zhes gsol to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu rnams thong de 82—74

skad ces ma zer cig ces pa nas/ 'jigs skrag dngangs nas brgyal bar gyur to zhes pa dang / de dag la slar gsol zhes pa'i bar gyi dpal rdo rje 'chang gi bar gyis gsungs pa ni/ bzhugs 1pa la ldem por dgongs pa'i the tshom sel ba bstan pa'o/ /srog chags gsod la dga' ba zhes pa nas/ 'di ni sangs rgyas 'grub par 'gyur gyi bar gyis gsungs pa ni/ 'od kyis reg pa tsam gyis/ de dag rang rang gi stan la gnas par gyur to zhes pas bstan no/ /'di lta bu yang dag pa ma yin pa'i tshig gi lam/ rdo rje'i tshig ci'i slad du gsung zhes dris pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu rnams 'du shes ngan pa dang / dman pa'i 'du shes de lta bu ma skyed cig ci'i phyir zhe na / rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ sngags kyi spyod pa'i mchog go/ /'di lta ste sngags kyi spyod pa nani de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod pa'o zhes pa nas/ dam tshig de dag rjes su rig par bya'o zhes pas/ bsgyur ba la ldem por dgongs pa'i the tshom sel ba'o/ /sku mi 'gyur ba mi gnas pa ma skyes pa zhes pa la sogs pa nas/yang de nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal la sogs pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la zhus pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyed rnams lta ci smos te/ nged sgo gsum rdo rje'i gsang ba mi 'gyur ba rnyed pa yang sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i byang chub mi shis so zhes pa dang / de ci'i phyir zhe na / skye ba med pa'i rdo rje mngon par byang chub pa'i ngo bo nyid med pa mi 'gyur ba las byung ba'o/ /zhes ngo bo nyid chos kyi mtshan nyid la ldem por dgongs pa'i the tshom sel ba'o/ /dgongs pa sgyid lug pa spang ba'i phyir/ rigs kyi bu sems can chen po'i zhes pa nas/ rdo rje'i ye shes thob pa'o zhes pas bstan 82—75

pa'o / /bcom ldan 'das mar me mdzad ces pa nas skal ba med pa'i phyir gyi bar gyis gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa 'byung ba dkon pa la gdams pa'o/ /yang lam ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs shing tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgyas pa bstan pa ni 'on kyang zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas zhes 1bya ba'i grangs su 'gro'o zhes gsungs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis gsung rdo rje'i yi ge'i tshig 'di thos nas rab tu ngus so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /byang chub sems dpa' khyed rnams ma ngu cig /sdug bsngal gsum bsgom par ma byed cig /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i yi ge'i ming tsam thos pa'i skal ba yang ma mchis na ji ltar mi ngu bar bgyi / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bka' stsal pa/ de skad ces ma zer cig /gnyen po la ldem por dgongs pas na skyid lug 2 pa spang ba'i phyir yi ge 3ni thun mong ste/ rigs kyi bu khyed rnams kyis ji ltar mi shes pa dang ma thos pa de bzhin du nged de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis kyang / rigs kyi bu gsang ba'i yi ge 'di dag ma mthong ma thob cing mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma rgyas so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/gsang ba gsum gyi yi ge rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro zhes the tshom bsal ba'o /sngags kyi sems dpa' mi bya ste/ byas na byang chub rnyed par dka' zhes pa la zhen pa dang ma bral na 'ching bar 'gyur zhes pa gang zag gzhan la dgongs pa'o//mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu bsgrags zhes pa la sogs pa don gzhan la dgongs pa'o/ /chos thams cad la mnyam pa nyid mthong ngam 82wa 76

zhes pa mnyam pa nyid la dgongs pa'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la skal ba yod pa'i phyir ro zhes gsungs pas ni dus gzhan la dgongs pa'o/ /dgongs pa nyid ni phyir mi ldog pa'i don la dgongs pa ni ldem por dgongs pa dag go/ /dgongs pa spyi ni nga nga dag par dgongs pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa'i khyad par bstan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa sum cu so drug pa'o// //byang chub sems kyi ngo bo nyid/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la/ /mos gus mthar phyin gyur pas ni/ /lam gyi rim pa kun rdzogs pas/ /sgrib dag yon tan thob pa ste/ /dbang gi rgyal po rnyed pa bzhin/ /las dang dngos grub ma lus pa/ /ye shes mi zad gnas 'thob pa'o/ /dam tshig dag gi 'khor lor ni//dga' ba chen pos rol pa ni/ /lus kyi gnas su rtsa gnas pa/ /'khor lo drug gi rnam pa la/ /thig le yi ge rlung dag pa/ /bde gsang stong nyid ye shes las/ /dbang phyug mdzod spu gtsug tor du/ /gnyis med mnyam pa bde chen du/ /rab tu thim pas rnam grol nyid/ /rten 'brel thams cad mkhyen pa ra 'gyur/ /las rgyal mchog gi phrin las ni/ /don dam stong nyid ngang las ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur las/ /rnam par snang mdzad skur bsgyur ba/ /zla ba'i gdan la gnas pa yi/ /spyan dang gnyis med sbyor ba las/ /zhi bar 'dod rnams thams cad kyi/ /der gnas gnod pa zhi bar byed/ /rgyas la rin chen 'byung gnas dpal/ /mā ma tī dang gnyis med pas/ /spro bsdus rin chen char dbab bya/ /dbang la 'od dpag med pa nyid/ /gos dkar yum dang 82—77

gnyis med pas/ /spros pas dbang du bsdu bar bya/ /mngon spyod gdon mi za ba nyid/ /pad+ma nyi ma la gnas pas/ /sgrol ma dang ni gnyis su med/ /spro bsdus khro bos las la sbyar/ /de dag las tshogs thams cad kun/ /sgyu ma mi lam ltar gsal bas/ /bdag byin brlab pa nyid du lta/ /sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin nye bar mtshon par 'gyur ba yin te/de ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa kun 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ji srid gnas pa'i bar du chos thams cad la dbang sgyur 1thob/ zab pa dang rgya che ba bla na med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bzhugs nas/ 'dod pa'i yon tan du ma rnams kyis rol par mdzad cing rab tu dga' bar mdzad pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pas/ bdag ji ltar bzhed pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dpag tu med par mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los phrin las thogs pa med par rab tu mngon par 'byung ba'o/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las/ rab tu byed pa sum cu so bdun pa'o// //e ma'o rdo rje ni snang ba/ e ma'o rdo rje ni mched pa/ e ma'o rdo rje yin par bshad pa ni snang ba thob pa'i ye shes so/ /sgyu rlung sems sgyu ma tsam las 'byung ba'i gang du zhes 'od gsal ba'i ngang du'o/ /der ni sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu'i lus med snang tsam/ ngag med grag tsam sems med rtog med stong pa nyid do/ /der stong nyid 'od gsal ba'i ngang las/ lus ni rnam par bsgom pa sgyu lus 82—78

rnam par dag pa'i skad cig gis 'byung ba'i zung 'jug gi sku thob par gyur pa'o//zung 'jug slob bzhin pa la gnas pas ni/ lhun gyis grub pa'i dbyings kyi don nam mkha' 'od gsal las byung ba'i ye shes kyi lha mo rig ma dang / yang de nyid du thabs snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i thabs shes rab gnyis med du sbyor bas mnyes par gyur pa'i ngo bo nyid do/ /bdud 'dul bar mdzad pas rig ma ni rnam pa sgyu ma lta bu las skyes bu rnal 'byor pa dga' ba chen po'i rol pa ye shes mi 'gyur ba'i rdo rje ste/ shes rab pad+ma chos kyi 'byung gnas dang mnyam par sbyor bas ni gang zhig 'di dag sgom pa zhes sku rdo rje dag pa dga' ba'i skad cig /gsung rdo rje mchog dga'i skad cig /thugs rdo rje dag pa dga' bral gyi skad cig dang gsum las rdo rje sku gsum gyis mtshan pa ni skad cig bzhi la lhan cig skyes pa ro mnyam bde ba chen po ngo bo nyid kyi sku mngon du byed pa ste/ khyu mchog byang chub sems rdo rje de ni mnyes par gyur pa/ zung 'jug slob bzhin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' grags chen sa bcu pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa dang mnyam par 'gyur te/ dus dag pa ye shes skad cig bdun pa la gzi brjid che ba ni/ye shes dbang phyug nus pa rdzogs pa thob par yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i sku gsum mngon du gyur pas longs spyod rdzogs sku ye shes kha sbyor du gyur pa bde ba chen po dang / snying rje chen pos 'gro don mngon par 'byung ba/ 'gog pa med pa'i ye shes rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phyag rgya chen po rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med 'thob pa'o/ /sabha zhes bdun pa'i sgra ste des yan lag dang ldan par brjod pa'o/ /de nyid kun du 'ong zhes dang / /ye shes mtshon pa'i sa thob pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la gnas pas mngon par byang 82wa 79

chub chen po nyid/ bdag gi lus ngag sems rdo rje/ /mnyam rjes gnyis su med par ni/ /'gyur ba med don rab rtags dang 1/ /phyag rgya chen po mngon grub pa'i/ /gsang ba dbang phyug cho ga ni/ /byang chub ye shes rdo rje yi/ /skur gyur sgom pa sgrib bral ba'i/ /zung 'jug bla na med pa ni/ /mkhyen pa rgyas pas rab mi gnas/ /rtog med snang ba med pa yi/ /skad cig nyid la yon tan rdzogs / /de bzhin gshegs par gyur pa yis/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas / /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las/ rab tu byed pa sum cu so brgyad pa'o// //de nas nam mkha'i dbyings 'di thams cad ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /dam tshig chen po rdo rje ye shes kyi/ /byang chub sems kyi bde ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus kun du snang bar mdzad/ /sa gsum kun du khyab cing yongs gang ba/ /bum pa rdo rje mi 'gyur chus gang ltar / /yongs su dag nga/sa byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /de nas rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings 'di thams cad kyi/ /gang du 'gro ba sku gsum las byung ba/ /de dag rnams la rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi/ /dpal gyis reg nas dbang bskur gegyur thob pas / /'gro kun bde bar gshegs pa dgra bcom pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes ro mnyam thob/ /dbyer med zung 'jug bla na med par gyur/ /yang dag par ni mngon par sangs rgyas pa'o/ /chos kun snying po lam dalas 'das pas na/ /mthar phyin gyur pas 'bad rtsol las las grol/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rnam dag pa/ /zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas gyur pa'o/ /dngos dang dngos 82—80

med spangs thob bral ba'i phyir/ /mtshan ma'i chos las rgyu rkyen bral ba'o/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes bdag med mnyam pa nyid/ /dmigs med ngang 'byung 'od gsal de nyid las/ /rang dag dbyings dang dbyer med rang grol ba/ /phrin las yongs su dag pa bla na med/ /yul dang yul can byang chub thob med pa/ /rnam par mi rtog mtha' bral brjod du med/ /de bzhin nyid dag bde chen lhun grub pa'o/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las/ rab tu byed pa sum cu so dgu pa'o// //de bzhin gshegs pa dus gsum dang / /phyogs bcu kun du zhing khams rab 'byam dang 1/ /kun du gzigs shing kun mkhyen pa/ /ma lus yongs dag ting nge 'dzin/ /thams cad mkhyen pas skad cig las/ /nam mkha' ltar ni rtog med pas/ /gdul bya dus la bab pa la/ /'bad med par ni sku gsung thugs / /rgyun mi 'chad cing thogs med don/ /snang med ngang las 'byung 'gyur ba'o/ /rgyud kyis bsdus dang ma bsdus las/ /rdo rje ngo bo nyid ston 'gyur / /de las mngon par byang chub pa bla na med pa ye shes kyi sku de bzhin gshegs pa 'jug pa dang / gnas pa dang / 'byung bar 'gyur ba mnyam pa ni chos nyid de bzhin nyid las byang chub pa ste/ rang bzhin gyis spros pa med pa lhun grub stong pa nyid do/ /khyab tsang gsal ba'i ngo bo mngon par byang chub pa ni/dngos po med pa'i gsal bar gyur pa'i khyab bdag rdo rje'o/ /mi zad pa snang ba'i ye shes mngon par byang chub pa ni/ mi mtshungs pa med pa'i snang ba 'od gsal ba'i mtshan nyid rtag tu mi 'gyur ba'i de bzhin nyid do/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba 82—81

mngon par byang chub pa ni/ kun tu 'byung ba thogs pa med pa'i dus dang /rnam pa thams cad du 'gag pa med pa'o/ /yongs su dag pa chos kyi dbyings mngon par byang chub pa ni/ tha dad par dmigs pa med pa'i ye shes kyi skul/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems dus gsum thog mtha' kun du dkyil 'khor chen po/ gsang ba'i bde ba chen po sku gsung thugs rdo rje dam tshig gi 'khor los zhi ba dang / khro bo'i sku sna tshogs su snang ba'o/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa mtshan dpe ldan/ /yab yum bde chen ngo bo nyid/ /snying rje chen po tshad med pas/ /rgyun mi 'chad par bsam pa dang / /mthun par 'jug pas zhi mi 'gyur/ /rang bzhin med pas mi 'gyur ba'o/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las/ rab tu byed pa bzhi bcu pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs/ /dpag med 'dus pa thams cad kyi / /rtag tu dga' ba'i gzugs can mchog /bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang chen gyi / /gsung dbyangs rdo rje sgra sgrogs pa/ /nye ba nyid du thos pa yis/ /bde ba dang ni yid bde thob/ /de nyid du ni skad cig la/ /yang dag ting 'dzin sgo thob cing / /rmad byung ye shes dbyangs kyis bstod/ /chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /thugs rje tshad med 'gro skyob mdzad1/ /byang chub ye shes gtso chen po/ /bde chen dpe bral phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje gsang ba mi 'gyur ba/ /mchog tu gyur pa bde chen po/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /gar gyi bdag po 2phyag 'tshal lo/ /drag po ma rungs thams cad kun/ /gsung gi nga ros zil gnon cing / /'jigs byed bdud 'dul chen po nyid/ /rgyal ba 82—82

rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal/ /chos rnams mi zad mdzod thob pas/ /'gro ba kun la gter sbyin mdzad/ /dbang phyug bla med phyag rgya che/ /cod pan gtsug tor phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten dbang sgyur 1sa gsum pa/ /dri med nor bu chen po ste/ /mtshungs med sgyu 'phrul rgyal po che/ /byang chub snying po phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ dpal rdo rje 'chang chen po la yang dag par bstod pa'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la sogs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la sogs pa dpag tu med pa dga' mgu yi narangs te/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pas ci yang mi smra bar gyur to/ /dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab tu byed pa bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa'o// //slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pa las rim par brgyud pa/ dpal nā ro pa'i slob ma kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta ā ka ra sidhi dang / lo tsā 4ba dge slong tshul khrims kyis 5zhus shing gtan la phab pa6 782—83
