༄tshon /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra skṛ 51 da ya a lo rikā ra tan+t+ra nā rim/bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud ces bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi snying po bud med bcu'i dkyil na cha shas rdo lnga pa'i tshul du bzhugs so/ /brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i 'khor rdo rje dang pad+mar 6sbyor ba la bzhugs pa 'di lta ste/ dam tshig yongs su spyod pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / ye shes kyi lus yongs su 'grub pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang ske/ sgra brnyan lta bu'i rdo rje'i gsung 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang ske/ gzhan gyis shes par byed pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / rtse gcig tu 7kyi'adris pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / gzhan las 'phags 82—89

pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / rten par byed pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / rlan par byed pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / smin par byed pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / skyod 1par byed pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / go 'byed par byed pa nazhes bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang ske/ hā ra nu pū ra la sogs pas mdzes pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang ske/ gī 4ta mgrin la sogs pa'i glu mkhan ma zhes bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang ske/ sbrul gyi snying po la sogs pa'i dri ldan ma zhes bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang ske/ tshod ma sna tshogs za ba'i ro 6ldan ma zhes bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang /rtsen pa sna tshogs kyis 'khyud namakhan ma zhes bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang /gsum rig par byed pa dngos med 9ma zhes bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma 1 la sogs pa ri rab kyi rdul dang mnyam pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro thams cad dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro chen mo nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam pa 'di lta ste/ gzugs kyi mtshan nyid zhu ba zhes bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro chen po dang / tshor ba'i mtshan nyid sim pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro chen po dang / 'du shes kyi mtshan nyid nub pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro chen po dang / 'du byed kyi mtshan nyid la rtog 11pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro chen po dang / rnam par 12shes pa'i mtshan nyid bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro chen po la sogs pa nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam pa rnams kyis 1nasangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di til gyi gang bu lta bur gang bar snang ngo / /de nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro de dag thams cad gcig tu 'dus nas mkha' 'gro chen po rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la mchod pa'i sprin spros pa du ma yid las byung ba lha dang mi'i mchod pa las khyad par du 'phags pas mchod 82wa 90

nas phyag 'tshal te/ 'di skad ces gsol to/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum bsdus pa'i spyod pa'i mchog /rdo rje snying po'i rgyan gyi rgyud/ /'dren pa mchog gis bshad du gsol/ /de nas rdo rje chen pos gsol ba btab pa'i tshig gsan nas mkha' 'gro thams cad la rnam par bltas 1te cang mi gsung bar bzhugs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro de dag thams cad kyis kyang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang phyug gi 2yon tan khyad par du 'phags pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro chen po la sogs pa'i 'khor du 'chad du mi bzhed pa de bdag cag la mi dgyes dasu ma mdzad cig /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la rnam par bltas te tshigs su bcad pa gsungs pa/ sems dpa' chen pos zhus pa legs/ /sa 'og ma yi sangs rgyas kyang / /'di yi gzhung gis 4/sems rmongs na/ /sems dpa' 95/gzhan ni smos ci dgos/ /sangs rgyas chos nyid dag pa 'di/ /byis pa rnams kyis mi rtogs phyir/ /byin gyis brlabs nas 'chad pa ni/ /ston ( pa rnams kyi 97 chos nyid do/ /de nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro de dag thams cad rab tu dga' nas yang mchod pa'i tshogs kyis mchod de phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so legs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang phyug gis 8bdag cag byin gyis brlab par 9mdzad du gsol / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa bstan cing 7rnam pa thams cad kyi dbang phyug gis bdag cag byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 1 dbang phyug gis 82—91

rdo rje mkha' 'gro de dag gis gsol ba btab pa mkhyen nas sems dpa' thams cad byin gyis rlob pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i snying po 'di 1rang gi thugs tshonanalas phyung pyo /ngo / /oṃ āḥ/ sa ma ya badz+ra / de nas phyung ma thag tu de'i 'od zer gyis rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i 'khor de dag thams cad bsdus nas rang gi snying gar parabatsud nas bud med kyi dkyil na thams cad brgyal ba ltar gnas so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang phyug gis 5de bslang ba'i phyir mkha' 'gro thams cad 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu de dag dran pa slar thob cing ji lta ba bzhin du gnas so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang phyug gis 76)'khor lo rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu rdo rje mkha' 'gro de dag thams cad rang rang gi gnas ji lta ba bzhin du 'khod par gyur to/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs (7kyis nam mkha'i dbyings na gnas pa ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyang bde ba dang yid bde ba /myong bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang phyug gis rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ sems can gyi khams thams cad mnyam pa nyid du dmigs te/ dbugs rngub par mi mdzad/ dbyung 9bar mi mdzad/ lus 'gyur bar yang mi mdzad/ lus gnas par yang mi mdzad/dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mi gzigs mi dgongs nye bar 82—92

mi 'jig go/ /thabs dang shes rab stong par yang mi mdzad/ shin tu 'gal ba can yang dag par 'dzud par mi mdzad/ mtho ris la yang mi 'jog /ma dad pa rnams dad par yang mi mdzad/ ma dul ba rnams dul bar yang mi mdzad / nye bar 'tshe ba zhi bar yang mi mdzad/ ma 'gags pa rnams 'gag 1par yang mi mdzad/ ma bskul ba rnams bskul bar yang mi mdzad/ ma rgyas pa rnams rgyas par yang mi mdzad/ rnam par rmongs pa rnams rmongs pa sel bar yang mi mdzad/ dga' bar gyur pa rnams mi dga' bar yang mi mdzad/ mi dga' ba 2rnams dga' bar yang mi mdzad/ ma khros pa rnams khros par yang mi mdzad / mi sdug pa rnams sdug par yang mi mdzad/ drag po ma rungs pa chen po dang / gtum po chen po dang / lha dang lha ma yin dang log 'dren dang gdug pa chen po dang yi dgas ridang sha za dang gnod sbyin dang srin po dang shin tu gdug pa'i dug chen po dang tsha ba'i gdon dang nad dang sbrul dang sems can thams cad la 'tshe bar byed pa rnams nye bar zhi bar yang mi mdzad do/ /rnam par dul bar yang mi mdzad do / /de nas bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te brjid pa dang bcas par gar mdzad 5 cing zhal 'dzum 6pa dang 'dor 97)ba dang bskum pa dang / 'gyed pa dang spyan mdzes pas smin rings bskyod cing bsgyur ba dang / pad+ma'i /phyag gi sor mo g.yas g.yon gar gyi 7phreng ba'i tshul gyis sa'i ngos la zhabs 'phen zhing sgyur 1 ba dang / 'dor zhing bskul ba dang 'jog cing 'degs 11pa'i rnam par gnon pas nam mkha'i dbyings 'di thams cad kun du khyab par mdzad de/ rlung gi khams chen por kun tu khyab par mdzad/ de la khyab nas me'i khams chen por kun du khyab par mdzad de/82wa 93

de nas chu'i khams chen por kun du khyab par mdzad/ de nas sa'i khams chen por kun du khyab par mdzad do/ /de 1yang kun du khyab nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi na sems la kun du khyab par mdzad do/ /ri dang sems can thams cad dang / /sna tshogs phra ba sbom po dang / /bud med gzhon nu rgan po dang ske/ /skyes pa dang ni ma ning dang / /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / /gdon dang skar ma gshin rje dang / /chu bdag brgya ( kyibyin la sogs dang / /'byung dang 'byung 'gyur thams cad la/ /bcom ldan 'das ni bde chen po/ /kun du bzang po rdo rje 'dzin/ /kun du khyab par (4 byas te gnas/ /dpal rdo rje snying po 5rgyan gyi rgyud las rdo rje mkha' 'gro byin gyis rlob tsho6pa'i le'u ste dang po'ol// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /las kyi mchog rnams 'grub byed pa'i/ /gsang sngags rnams ni bshad par bya/ /rtse gcig sems kyis mnyan par bya'o/ /oṃ a kā 7ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā 8)shā ābyu nut+pan+da tāta9/ gtor ma'i sngags so/ /a ā/ i khri7/ u u11/ e e/ o au/ e aḥ/ bud med do/ / ṛ 212—/ bla 11 / ma ning ngo 1 / /ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa nye 15kho/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ skyes pa'i 'o/ /ya ra la wa nya 'byung ba'i 'o/ /sha ṣa 1 sa ha 'jigs pa la sogs pa'o/ /k+ṣaḥ1/chos kyi dbyings kyi 19sa bon no/ /badz+ra lhaka hūṃ/ dzi 21na dzika 22rgyu snye/ rat+na sgrika i/ ā ro lika rdzu lha/ pradz+nyā lhaka 26kho/ mkha' 'gro chen po lnga'i'on rme/ /de ṣa nar ti māṃ/mo ha ra ti 2 lī/ rā ga ra ti r+pā/ badz+ra ra ti 16 / rdo rje mkha' 'gro rten na82wa 94

rnyed dka' ba'i/ /sngags kyi tshogs rnams ji snyed pa/ /de kun sngon du rgyas pa ru / /gsang ba dang ni 'jigs byed dang / /bde mchog sogs la nga 517yis ni/ /las dang bcas par rab bshad pa/ /rnal 'byor rtogs pas shes bya'o/ /dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las sngags kyi le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas mkha' 'gro 2grong khyer mchog /dkyil 'khor 'jigs pa bri bar bya / /las kyi cho ga shes pa yis/ /ci rigs par ni las rnams bya/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i srad bu ni/ /sems med las byung byas nas su/ /byin rlabs 4mi bskyod rtag pa ru/ /byas te 5 thig ni gdab pa'o/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /twa yir ṇa 7bzhis brgyan pa ste/ /dar dang me tog phreng bas bklubasan/ /srad bu bzhi dang rab ldan pa/ /zur gyi cha ni thams cad du/ /zla ba rin chen rdo rje dgod/ /las kyi 9bye brag shes pa yis/ /blo dang ldan pas phyag rgya dgod/ /in+d+ra nī 1 la lta bu yi/ /'jigs byed rdo rje dbus su bri/ /shar du rtsibs 11brgyad 'khor lo dkar / /lho ru rin chen zur dgu ljang / /nub tu 'dab 12brgyad pad+ma dmar/ /byang du ral gri sngon po bri/ /me yi mtshams 1 su 'khor lo sngon1 / /bden bral ut+pal dmar po dang / /rlung gi mtshams 15su pad+ma dmar/ /dbang ldan ut+pal ser po ste/ /rdo rje tho ba shar gyi sgo/ /lho yi sgo ru rdo rje dbyug /pad+ma'i sdong bu nub kyi sgo/ /byang sgo rdo rje kha bye ba/ /sbyor ba ldan pas dgod par bya/ /rnam pa nyi shu rtsa lngar ni/ /tshon rtsi dag kyang bsgom bya ste/ /rdul tshon lnga la sogs pa rnams / /rim pa bzhin du gdab par bya/ /de nas bum pa gzung 17bya ba/ /rtsa ba nag nog med pa yi/ /zhabs brtan mgrin ring mchu 'phyang ba/ /lha yi 82—96

grangs tsam sta gon gnas/ /mgul par ras kyis lho)yang dag dkris/ /ldum bu yis ni kha mdzes pa/ /rin chen sman 'bru sna lnga dang / /spos chu yis ni rab tshonabakang nas/ /bum pa mngon par bsngags par bya/ /rnam rgyal bum pa dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bdag po lha mo rnams kyi bzhi/ /lha rnams kyi ni bum pa bzhi/ /sgo yi py-i niphyogs kyi bum pa ni/ /las kun byed pas bzlas byas te/ /ku sha'i chun pos sems can che/ /'jug pa kun la gtor bar bya/ /yon dang gtor ma mchod phul nas/ /de dag phyi grwar rab bkod 4de/ /g.yas su rgyal ba spyan drang ngo / /de nas lha rnams rab gnas pa'i/ /bsam pa'i sbyor bas bsam bya ste / /phyag rgya bral ba'i sbyor ba ni/ /lus can byin gyis mi rlob 55pas /bu mo gzugs bzang lang tshos brgyan/ /dbang thob lus rgyas thob pa mo/ /g.yon ma rgyan gyis rab brgyan te/ /de yis (phyira'akhor lo sprul par bya/ /de la mar me brgya sogs pa'i/ /mchod pa phul nas bstod bya ste/ /bshang gci 7cikhu ba khrag rnams ni/ /dung chen po ru bzhag byas terdon/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nas mkha' 'gro grong mchog tu/ /slob ma rnams ni gzhug 9bya ste/ /rdo rje ye shes rab thob pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /pho brang dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bya/ /de nas slob ma de yis kyang / /me tog sngags 'dis gtor ba'o/ / oṃ pra tīts+tsha bebadz+ra hoḥ11 de nas tshig 'dis gdong g.yogs dgrol/ /de ring dad pa'i shugs kyis ni/ /dkyil 'khor deng kyi 'dir blta bar bya/ /sangs rgyas rigs su khyod skyes so/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas khyod byin brlab/ /dngos grub thams cad phun sum tshogs / /dam tshig mchog tu 'grub par byed/ / rdo rje pad+mo 12rol pa'i mchog /82—97

sngags kyi bdag nyid shes par bya/ / pā sh+ya 91badz+ra/ gang dag me tog gsang (2rib ste/ /de de de yi lha yang dag /de yi sbyor ba rab sbyin te/ /de yi nan tan du sgrub dbo/ /dung chen bdud rtsi lnga blud de/ /dmyal ba'i chu 'dis khyod la ni//dam tshig 'das na 4sreg 5par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub pa'i/ /'thung shig rdo rje bdud rtsi'i 6chu/ /badz+ra ut+pa 'chi / de nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi / /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa rnams/ /bla mas slob ma sdig bral la/ /ci lta ba bzhin bsgrag 9par bya/ /dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las ri mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /dbang bskur ba yi khucho ga'i mchog /gang gis legs par byed 'gyur na/ /de ni sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid thams cad ldan/ /yang dag shes shing rgyud shes pa/ /de nyid bcu la sogs pa yi/ /gsang rig cho ga shes pa pos/ /bsgrims te slob ma yang dag gzung / /bla ma la gus dad pa'o11/ /dge bsgom nyu2lha rnams mchod byed pa/ /gtong phod yon tan ldan pa'o/ /de nas slob ma de yis kyang / /langs te zhabs la mgos gtugs ti nas/ /rgyal po dbang phyug bde dam pa/ /gos dang rgyan gyis 1 legs par bgos/ /steng du bla re bre nyagebar bya/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang / /lham dang tshangs pa'i skud pa dang / /gdu labu dag dang ska 1 rags dang / /bkra shis tshigs bcad sna tshogs kyis/ /slob ma sdig dang bral ba la/ /slob dpon gyis 18ni dbang bskur ro/ /dang po rnam rgyal bum pa dang / /de nas lha mo bzhi rnams dang / /lha rnams kun gyi bzhi po 82—98

yis6)ske/ /bkra shis tshigs bcad glu sgra dang / /rdo rje dril bu gsil (gyib yis /skyob pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du/ /til gyi gang bu bzhin gang ba'i/ /rgyal bas bum pa bzung nas ni/ /de nyid la ni dbang bskur bar/ /dkyil 'khor de nyid rig par bsam/ /de lta bu ni bsams kyenas kyang / /chos kyi mtshan nyid bstan par bya/ /de nas yid 'ong bu mo ni/ /legs par goms ribapa dbang thob pa/ /rgyan gyis rab brgyan rab mdzes pa/ /btsal te bla ma la phul nas/ /de nas rgyal dbang slob ma de/ /nang gi sbas pa btus pa yi/ /gsang ba mnyam par 'jug pa yi/ /sbyor dang ldan pas dbang bskur bya/ /rdo rje pad+mo las drang ba/ /sbom po mtha' ltag rtse sbyar nas/ /rkan (bdu rdo rje gzhag par bya/ /kye ma'o bde ba bde ba che/ /kye ma'o dam tshig bde brjod cing / /kye ma'o bde ba blang bar bya'o/ /'di ni gsang ba zhes bya ba'i/ /de dbang bskur ba'i thabs mchog go/ /yang na shin tu dad ldan pa/ /gzugs bzang sgrub la dga' ba dang / /sbyor goms bla ma la ni dbul/ /bla mas byin brlabs lha mo dang / /sgrub 96)pa de la sbyin par bya/ /de yis blangs (7nanas brtson pa'i tshogs / /ci (3)skad gsungs bzhin rab byas nas/ /rang gi lha dang sangs rgyas dang ske/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /mnyes byed cho gas sems brtags yo)te/ /mngon sum bde ba tsherang 'byung ba/ /gzhan gyis gang du bsgrag mi nus/ /go ba'i yul de bde ba che/ /bla ma de la dbul bar khya bla ma gzhan la de bzhin du/ /ci dga' bar ni yon yang 1stedabul/ /slob dpon cung zad ci 'dod pa/ /yid la bsams 1 pa dbul bar bya/ /dam tshig 'da' bas 'jigs pa'i phyir/ /bsgrims te de bzhin dbul bar bya/ /slob 82wa 99

dpon gyi ni yul gyi mchog /rigs kyi khyad par gyis ni lnga/ /bum pa'i dbang sogs dbye ba yis/ /yang na gsum du 'gyur ba yin/ /rang gi ma dang seng ge gdan / /yon gyi mchog ste sangs rgyas rigs/ /gser dang glang po rin chen dang ske/ /sring mo bla ma la dbul ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs yin te/ /yon de 1yon gyi mchog yin no/ /shing 2rta rta ni shin tu brgyan/ /rang gi chung ma dbul bya ste/ /rin chen sna tshogs rnam dag pa/ /yon de 3rin po che yi rigs//mu tig phreng ba shin tu mdzes/ /bu mo rin chen 'dra cab yis/ /brgyan te bla ma la dbul ba/ /yon de pad+ma'i 5rigs yin no/ /rgyal po dang ni dbang phyug dang ske/ /chung ma 'phrul gyi bzhon pa sogs/ /glang po rta ni shin tu brgyan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi rje/ /nan tan bla ma dbul bya ba/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i rigs yin no/ /de rnams bzhi dang 'gyur ba dang / /mi 'gyur ba yi bye brag gis / /gsum du shes bya bla ma la/ /blo ldan rdo rje slob ma yis/ /ci ste bde ba kun 'dod na/ /dad mos sems kyis 6dbul bar bya/ /yid 97la gang bsams nam phul lam/ /khas blangs de ni ma phul na/ /yi dgas 9dmyal ba rnam 1 gnyis su/ /nges par skyes te brlag 1 par 'gyur/ /de bas de rnams 12rab phul nas/ /gsol ba dag ni rab tu gdab/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor chen po yi / /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so/ /sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi1da / /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so/ /sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi / /dkyil 'khor bdag gis di 1 ring mthong / /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur/ /de nas bla ma de yis kyang ske/ /de la dbang bskur sbyin bya ste/ /dri dang me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /82wa 100

bsgrims te yang dag brtag dzo1par bya/ /dang po la ni bum pa'i dbang / /gnyis pa la ni gsang ba'i dbang / /gsum pa shes rab ye shes te/ /bzhi pa de yi 95)ye shes te/ /bla ma las ni thob pa'o/ /dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las phan 8)yon dang bcas par dbang bskur ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //gang gi thabs kyis rigs lnga'i don/ /rang gi don gyur kun du bzang / /'di dag gzhan la rab bde'i 4phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /yid 'ong dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ /ci bder gnas la nam mkha' kun/ /sems kyis khyab par byas nas su/ /rnam brtags 5e ma'o 'jig rten kun/ /sdug bsngal chos kyis kun nas gtses/ /byang chub sems nyams sems can rnams / /kun las 'byung zhes dam bcas pa'i/ /sngags pas 6spyi bor bzhag pa ni/ /āḥsems kyi rdul phran cha drug rnams/ /phyogs bcu dag tu phye nas su/ /chos kyi don rnams des bsal 7)nas/ /shin tu dri med sems dag pa/ /'das tshonadang ma 'ongs pa yi sems/ /da ltar yang ni dmigs su med/ /gnyis med de la gnyis med med/ /nam mkha' 95zhes pa'ang gnas pa med/ /de ltar kun du brtags nas su/ /'gro ba thams cad shin tu stong / /dri med rnal 'byor nyid kyi yin/ /dngos po med par rang sems bsam/ /'gro ba 'di ni de lta bu'i/ /dngos po gang dag yod min na/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs gang dag lags / /sems nyams sems can 'byung bar bsgom1 / /'on kyang sngon gyi smon lam shugs/ /dbyangs yig spel ba'i glu ldan bya/ /rin chen sems ni rmugs 11pa la/ /bde gshegs rnams kyis 512bskul bar snang 1 / /shu n+ya 7tā ti 82—101

yo ga pā rdo swā hā/ pra bha bī 1 ā kā sha ta mā pa ga ta 9rinas ma ya/ u pa ta pa (sne)yarnyi su ga ta su ga te 4rig ti shrī badz+ra swā hā/ pū (5phu s+t+waṃ rta16)/ rnam rtog kun spangs dri med pa'i/ /rnam par mi rtog sgom pa'i sems/ /sngags kyi de nyid bskyod byas la/ /rtsu zhes pa yi gzugs su brtag /ting nge 'dzin gyis (7)dbang 'gyur nan/ /gang phyir de ni bsgoms 9 pas thob/ /dam pa nam mkha'i dbyings la gnas/ /byang chub sems tshogs der bcas la/ /rnal 'byor yid kyis kun bsams nas/ /rgyas par rnam par brtag par bya/ /yi ge sne gyis lha yi gnas/ /rdo rje rin chen gyis ni brgyan/ /sgo khyud rta babs ka ba dag /dar gyi phreng bas rnam par bklubs / /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /dril bu'i dra ba dag gis brgyan/ /rtag par do shal me long dang / /me tog phreng bas rgyan 3glernams bres/ /de yi dbus su seng ge'i gdan/ /seng ge brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan / /smon lam dbang gis de dag kun/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthu bo che / /shar phyogs ba glang 12shin tu rgyas/ /lho phyogs rta yi gdan bzang ste32/ /nub phyogs su ni rma bya bshad/ /de bzhin byang phyogs nam mkha' lding / /mi bskyod 1 khro bo bsam 15pa ni/ /mthing ga 7dkar po dmar po'i zhal/ /rdo rje phyag rgya thugs ka 1 na/ /mthing ga 18kha dog gsal la bzang / /g.yas na rin chen 'khor lo ste/ /ral gri pad+ma g.yon pa na/ /'jig rten khams ni kun 'khrug pa'o/ /brtul zhugs can gyis zhal gsum bsam/ /dang po yi ni stong pa nyid/ /gnyis pa de bzhin mtshan ma med/ /gsum pa smon pa med pa yi/ /zhal du mkhas pas 19rig par bya/ /phyag drug rtag tu 'bar bar bsgom )/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs rnams dang ldan/ /pad+ma la ni mnyam gzhag 21nas/ /ye shes 82—102

phyag rgya snying ga 3)nang / /dbus kyi gnas su bsam pa ni/ /rdo rje skyil na mo krung snedu gnas/ /shar gyi gnas su bsam pa ni/ /sngags pa rnam snang thub pa ste/ /dkar dang mthing ga (5dmar ba'i zhal/ /'khor lo phyag rgya snying ga 6rin/ /rdo rje 'bar sogs 'od gsal ba/ /rin chen rdo rje g.yas pa na/ /ral gri pad+ma g.yon pa na/ /rnal 'byor can gyis rtag par bsam/ /thor tshugs dbu rgyan dag gis brgyan/ /rin chen mgon po lho phyogs na/ /ser dang mthing ga 7dkar ba'i zhal/ /rin chen phyag rgya snying ga nas / /margad lta bur 9snang ba'o / /g.yas na 'khor lo ral gri ste/ /rdo rje pad+ma g.yon na'o/ /rtag par rnal 'byor pas bsam pa/ /rin chen char du 'bebs pa'o/ /nub phyogs gnas su dgod bya ba/ /snang ba mtha' yas bsam pa ni/ /dmar dang mthing ga (7dkar ba'i zhal/ /pad+ma rā ga'i mdog lta bu/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgya snying ga 11na/ /rdo rje rin chen g.yas pa na/ /'khor lo ral gri g.yon pa na/ /pad+ma la ni mnyam gzhag zhu bsam/ /byang phyogs gnas su don grub ni/ /ljang gu mthing ga 15dkar ba'i zhal/ /ral gri phyag rgya snying ga san/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas mnyam pa'i'o0she / /pad+ma rdo rje g.yas pa na/ /'khor lo rin chen g.yon pa na/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa/ /byang gi gnas su bsam par bya/ /sngags pas phyag drug bsam pa ni/ /spyan de zhal gsum dkar mo yi/ /rnam par snang mdzad phyag rgya 17bzhin/ /de yi don du rnam par bsgom1 / /mā ma tī yang bsam pa ni/ /ut+pal 18dang ni mthing 'dra ba19/ /zhal gsum phyag drug chags pa ste/ /mi bskyod phyag rgya mchog 'dzin pa'o/ /chags pas chags pa rigs kyi sngags/ /zhal gsum phyag drug dge ba ste/ /sbyor ba'i sa ni dkar mo bsam/ /pad+ma rā 82—103

ga'i phyag rgya'o/ /sgrol ma kha dog ser mo ste/ /'khril bag rgyan gyis rab tu brgyan / /zhal gsum phyag drug rab tu bsam/ /thogs 1)med rgyal po'i phyag rgya'o / /sgo bzhi sgo srungs nadagod bya ba/ /sgo rnams su ni khro bo bsam/ /khro bo chen po gshin rje'i dgashed/ /gzhan gyis mi thub de bzhin te/ /thub par cidaka' ba rta mgrin dang / /khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bsam/ /de dag kun kyang zhal gsum pa/ /drag cing drag por gnon pa'o/ /mthing ga 4ser po de bzhin dmar / /ljang gu 5dag ni kha dog tu'o/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa ste/ /thod pa'i phreng thogs de bzhin no/ /gdon rnams thams cad skrag byed pa/ /gnod sbyin srin po phra 6men ma/ /ma he seng ge stag rnams dang / /ba lang zhon pa rnams 7bzhi'o/ /rnam par 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer 8can/ /khro bo spyan ni kun nas bsdus/ /sngags 'di rnams kyis (9)bsam pa ni/ /gshin rje'i yogashed la sogs pa'o/ /sngags kyi de nyid rjes mthun 11par/ /sngags pa'i 12dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas su/ /sa yi snying po la sogs pa/ /sems dpa' rnams ni der gnas bsam/ /lus dang ngag dang sems de nyid/ /hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i yi ge mchog /sems ni de ru zhugs par bsam/ /mi bskyod pa ni bdag nyid che/ /dbang po'i lam du byung 1 nas su/ /dang ba'i sadakyil 'khor gyis ni brgyan/ /bdag nyid gcig cing gcig 'gyur babo/ /skad cig gis ni brtag par bya/ /khyod ni rdo rje sems zhes bya/ /de la sogs pas stod (17par byed/ /de nas rnam snang mdzad la 1 sogs/ /rang gi snying gar 18rab tu gzudami / /gzugs rnams kyi ni rang bzhin du/ /rnam par snang mdzad thub pa bzhugs/ /tshor ba rin chen mgon po yin/ /mtha' yas 'od ni 'du shes su'o/ /'du byed kun 82wa 104

du gdon mi za/ /mi bskyod pa ni phung po lngar1/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga rnams ni/ /sngags 'di rnams kyis 2 bzhugs par bsam/ /sa yi khams kyi rang bzhin du/ /de nas spyan ni gzhug 8)bya ste/ /rnal 'byor yid kyis bsam pa ni/ /de yang spro bar gnas par bsam/ /mā ma tī yang chu yi khams/ /brlan zhing khrag ni rgyu ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor pas ni yid kyis bsam/ /de yi lus ni rgyas par 'gyur/ /me yi khams kyi rang bzhin du/ /gos dkar mo yang gzhug capar bya/ /kun du khyab par bzhugs pa yi/ /'od rnams su ni der 'gyur ro/ /sgrol ma rlung gi rang bzhin du/ /bzhugs po par de ni bsam par bya / /rlung ni rnam pa lnga ru 'gyur/ /de bzhin yid mgyogs tsho7 rdzu 'phrul 'grub/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin dag tu 'jug /de lus khong stong nyid la ni/ /rang sems yon tan bsgom 8pa'i sems/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas sgyu ma'i sbyor bas su/ /dag pa'i bdag nyid ci 'dod par/ /de nas ri rab phul nas 'gro/ /sa yi snying po bdag nyid che/ /sangs rgyas spyan ni bdag nyid de/ /mig gi phyogs su zhugs nas ni/ /'phrul gyi mig tu rtag tu 'gyur/ /phyag na rdo rje bdas/ nyid che/ /rna ba'i rnam shes sbyor bas na/ /sgra rnams thams cad shes pa de/ /rna ba'i rnam shes de bzhin 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i snying po bdag nyid che/ /sna yi rnam shes sbyor bas na/ /sangs rgyas shangs ni bdag nyid shes/ /de yang de yi ngo bor 'gyur / /'jig rten dbang por rab 9chags pa/ /rdo rje lce yi sbyor bas su/ /ro yi dngos po myong ba des/ /skad cig gcig la de ru 'gyur/ /blo ldan sgrib pa thams cad ni/ /rnam par sel ba'i ming dang ldan/ /nyon mongs thams 82—105

cad rnam par sel/ /nye ba'i nyon mongs pa yang 'jigatso /me long gi (mini rnam pa ltar/ /rten pa'i tshul gyis 'byung ba ni/ /gzugs brnyan gyi ni sbyor bas su//skad cig gis ni de ru 'gyur/ /bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la( / /rnam pa bcu dang drug tu yang / /sbyor ba de ni byin brlabs nas can/ /sngags pas de ni sems la gzhug5 /khro bo lcags kyu dpung pa yis/ /zhags pa lta bu gnyis pa'ol/ /lu gu rgyud kyi kha sprad gsum/ /rgyal mtshan gzhug par khyab par bzhag /de ltar don rnams rab tu zhugs ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bor bdag /rdo rje phyag rgya dang ldan pa/ /g.yon pa dril bsnams sta zur brten/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de 7gnas 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor chen po dkar ba'i gzugs/ /dkar dang mthing ga 8dmar po'i dbu/ /stong nyid la sogs bdag sbyor ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes su smra/ /rdo rje phyag rgya rjes su chags pa la/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta 9a nu rā ga ṇa 1 badz+ra swa bhā ba 1ཿād+ma ko3rtag12/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa la/ oṃ sarba 15ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma mi1ko3rtanyug/ rang gi dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin/ /mdun du bsams 17nas nam mkha' la/ /khyab pa'i sbyor bas gcig byas te1 / /dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin bsams bzlas/ /bcom ldan mi mnyam gzhug bcing 18bzhugs/ /rdo rje phyag rgya thugs kur 16bsnams/ /g.yas par 'khor lo rin po che/ /pad+ma ral gri g.yon pa'o/ /de nyid gsum gyi tshul gyis ni/ /ci tsam nus par bzlas par bya/ / skyo na 2 skuyid kyis drangs nas 1ni / /de dag thams cad snying gar gzhug rta /mnyam pa nyid kyi gnas 'dug na / /lus kyis ji na tsam bskyod pa dang / /tshig tu rab tu 'phro na )ba'i rnams/ /de dag sngags dang phyag rgyar 'gyur/ /rtag tu bsgom 25pa'i sbyor bas ni/ /de 82wa 106

la sems dpa'i gzhan ma yin/ /rnal 'byor ngo bo gzugs can la/ /lha mo rnams kyang de la 'dzin/ /dbang po lam du gang gyur pa/ /de dang de yi ngo bo dag /shin tu mnyam gzhag (1)sbyor bas su/ /bdag nyid lhag pa'i lhar bya'o/ /dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las lha'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i (5de bzhin gshegs pa la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis tshig mthun na par sgra dbyangs gcig gis gsol ba btab pa/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs kun gyi/ /ye shes gces pa dri med pa/ /byang chub sems ni rin po che/ /bla na med pa bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la canade bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol ba btab par thugs su chud nas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sems ni lus kyi rnam pa yin la/ lus kyang sems kyi rnam pa yin zhing sems kyang tshig gis rab tu brjod pa yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 5sku dang gsung dang thugs sbyor ba thob nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /kye ma kun du bzang po 'di/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /chos rnams skye ba med pa ste/ /g.yo ba med cing gnas pa med kyi/ /rtog pa'i dri ma spangs pa yin/ /bskyed par bya zhes 57)rab tu gsungs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs 8pa de bzhin gshegs pa 9gsung spros pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs 7nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so11/ /dngos po 'di dag ma 82—107

skyes te/ /chos can med cing chos nyid med/ /nam mkha' bzhin du dmigs med pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni brtan 1pa yin/ /(9bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje mi 'khrugs pas sgyu cicigasungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung gnas kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dmigs su med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs 4 nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so(5kyi/ /dngos po 'di dag dngos med de/ /chos kyi mtshan nyid spangs pa yin/ /bdag med chos las legs byung ba'i/ /byang chub sems ni brtan 6pa yin/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rin chen tog gis gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyis rdo rje me lce 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dngos po skye ba med pa ste/ /dngos po ngo bo yod min pas/ /nam mkha'i go 'phang 'thob 7bo zhes/ /dngos rnams rab tu brjod pa yin/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyis gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa don yod grub kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bla ma'i yang bla ma'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /gzod 8nas dag cing rtog pa med/ /sems can med cing srog kyang med/ /sangs rgyas nyid dang byang chub med/ /mi lam sgyu ma ltar snang ba'i/ /byang chub sems ni brtan 9pa yin/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das don yod grub kyis gsungs so/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung 82—108

dang thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i byang chub kyi sems rnam par dag pa thob nas ngo mtshar skyes par gyur te ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /kye ma'o sangs rgyas kye ma'o dag 17 /kye ma'o chos ni bstan pa rnams/ /bdag med chos las legs byung ba/ /byang chub sems khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems kyi bsgom 95)pa yi/ /mi g.yo yi ge las byung zhing / /mi lam la sogs ma skyes pa/ /byang chub sems khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnas dang stan ni rnam bsams te/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung na bcas nas/ /dang por rang bzhin dag go zhes/ /dag pa'i chos kyi tshul la gnas/ /yid kyis hūm̐ byas rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems mas byin gyis brlab(4)/ /rin chen lus su nga rgyal bya/ /lag pa bstod (5)de bskor ba na(6)/ /lcags kyu yis ni spyan yang drang / /byon nas drang por phyogs bcing ste(7kyi/ /dam tshig mchog kyang dbul bar bya/ /gdan rnams so sor phul nas su/ /mchod yon 'bul ba'i sbyor ba bya/ /dbang bskur mtshon cha go cha sogasal/ /sil snyan mchod sogs ngo bo bya/ /rnam pa kun gyis mnyes bya ba/ /rnal 'byor bdag nyid can gyi rin bdag /rnal 'byor rnam gsum shes bya ste/ /byin gyis brlabs dang yongs brtags dang / /gzugs nyid yongs su rdzogs pa dag /rnal 'byor yin zhes sangs rgyas gsungs/ /sngags kyi byin rlabs 9nga rgyal bskyed/ /rnal 'byor byin rlabs kyi )yin par gsungs/ /byang chub sems ni dag pa dang / /gsang sngags sa bon skye ba che/ /phyag rgya tshogs su brtag 11pa yi / /rim gyis gzugs kyis 12rdzogs bya ba/ /de ni brtags pas 12brjod pa ste / /rnal 'byor cho ga yin par gsungs/ /bsdu dang spro bar bya ba las/ /rnam pa'i mchog kun ldan pa dang / /skad cig ye shes kyis 7rdzogs pa/ /82wa 109

rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes brjod do/ /dang por dam tshig byin brlabs par/ /rnal 'byor rig pa dag gis brtag1 /rab tu rdzogs par bya ba dag /'di ni rnal 'byor cho gar bshad/ /nyon mongs dri mar bcas pa'i sems/ /byang chub sems kyis dag bya ste/ /de ni rang bzhin dag pa'o zhes/ /brjod cing thal mo gsum gyis sbyar/ /dag gyur de nas blo yis ni/ /sems la so sor brtag dunadapar bya/ /sems la so sor brtags nas kyang / /phyi rol rang bzhin stong bar bya / /sems tsam la ni gnas nas su/ /byang chub tshogs kyi (gubag chags des/ /bsgom par bya ba'i ngo bo dag /zla ba'i gzugs su rnam par brtag /dag pa'i pad+ma la gnas pa/ /o gyi myu gus bskrun pa yi/ /yan lag kun gyi mtshan nyid gzugasal/ /rdo rje sku ni bsgom par bya/ /āḥzhes bya ba'i spros med gsung 4)/ /sems ni hūm̐ zhes bya bar sprul/ /yi ge gsum gyis byin brlabs lus/ /snying la gnas pa zla ba'i gzugs/ /de la rang gi yi ge ni/ /mdog gzugs 'od ni byed bsams te/ /nga rgyal bskyed nas de la ni/ /rdo rje'i (snyebadag nyid bdag nyid brjod/ /rgyan kun yongs su rdzogs pa dang / /'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis rinebargyan pa/ /cha shas kyi ni dra ba can/ /ye shes sems dpa' rdzogs par brtag /de 'og lag pa'i phyag rgya yis(7/ /go cha mtshon cha la sogs bya/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas lnga dbang bskur te/ /cod pan phreng ba rnams kyis bklubs(8ri//de nas de 'og sangs rgyas kyi/ /sprul pa mdzad pa'i sgyu ma 'phro/ /yan lag bzhi pa dpung ldan pa'i/ /phyogs bcur khro bo bcu dag dang / /bsnyems ma dang ni tog ldan ma/ /mtshon cha ma dang rtsed mo can/ /sgyu ma'i cha byad rnam pa'o/ /rnam par 'phrul pa byin gyis brlab 9/ /kun la khyab par byed pa yi/ /sna 82wa 110

tshogs dbus su bzhag tsamanas ni/ /de nyid chen po bdag nyid lngas/ /phyogs bzhi 'khor la (5)khyab bya ste/ /dga' bas dga' byed bzhi yang spro/ /ting 'dzin kun gyi dga' ba la/ /'os par byed pa'i sngags pa yi no/ /'khor lo dang ni rdo rje'i gzugs/ /pad+ma'i gzugs la de dag ni/ /'khor lo kun la pad+ma yi/ /ngo bo yis ni rol pa dang / /e zhes bya ba 'phro ba las/ /mdog ldan bdag nyid gzugs su bya/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan la rnams kun ldan pa'i/ /nyid kyi gdan la bzhugs par blta55/ /sgeg dang glu dang gar rnams dang / /rgyal mtshan la sogs tshon dgye ( ridang / /sil snyan mchod pa'i rnam pa ni/ /sna tshogs rnams kyis mchod pa bya/ /rnam pa kun dang ldan par ni/ /bdag nyid kyi ni lus bsgoms nas/ /myur ches bya ba bul 7)ba dang / /mi gsal gug skyed 98)nyams pa dang / /rtog pa ngan pa rnam par spangs/ /de nas gsang sngags bzlas brjod bya/ /bzlas pas skyo na lag g.yas kyis/ /bsgrims ri9nas rdo rje gsor nas su/ /g.yon pas dril bu la gsil 7zhing / /rdo rje glu tshul sna tshogs dang ske/ /ba dan tshul du byas pas mchod/ /bzlas pa yis ni 'jug brtul nas//gshegs su gsol dang rang nyid 'grub/ /lus dang ngag dang sems bsgoms te//brtan por ci bder 'gro bar bya/ /bar chad du ni gyur na 11yang / /yi ge brgya pas byin gyis brlab/ /de ltar bsgoms pas sgom nyu2byed pa/ /rdo rje theg pas rab rdzogs pa'i/ /byang chub de ni myur thob nas/ /zla nyi dkyil 'khor lta bur snang ske/ /sna tshogs las kyi thog 'dren cing / /rin chen rgyal mtshan rab dga' byedal/ /rgyal byed pad+ma'i gdung brgyud 12can/ /gnas chen 'jig rten dbang phyug 'gyur/ /dpal ldan rig sngags kun gyi gtso/ /dga' chen 'dod dgur 82—111

lcags kyur 'gyur/ /sgyu ma bzhin du 1kun shes shing / /dregs pa 'joms 2byed khro bar 'gyur/ /dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las byang chub kyi sems bsgom capa'i ye shes bsgrub 5pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //sbyin sreg de nyid la gnas pa'i/ /me ni lha yi zhal yin pas/ /sna tshogs las rnams grub byed pa'i/ /sbyin sreg las ni rab tu bshad/ /sbyin sreg gis 6ni lha rnams tshim/ /tshim par gyur nas 7)dngos grub ster/ /gsang sngags lhag chad gang yin pa/ /thams cad sbyin sreg dag gis bskongs/ /de phyir sku gsum chos mchog gis/ /sbyin sreg rab tu bsngags par mdzad/ /gtsub 8shing las ni byung 9ba'i me/ /dge ba yi ni las rnams byed/ /gdol pa'am dur khrod byung ba yi/ /me ni las rnams rab tu bsgrub1 no/ /thab khung zlum po gru bzhi dang / /zla gam dang ni zur gsum dang / /dkyil 'khor gyi ni kha khyer la/ /rdo rje mtshan ma 11dag gis brgyan/ /sbyin sreg de nyid tshul rig 12pas / /thab khung rnams kyi dbus su ni/ /pad+ma'i steng gnas gtsug tor dang / /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma bzhag /ji ltar dmigs pas bdugs 1 nas su/ /lag gnyis pus mo'i bar bzhag ste/ /dgang gzar 97mar gyis bkang nas ni/ /blugs 15gzar bkang ste de bzhin bsreg /sbyin sreg la dgos g.yas su bzhag /g.yon du chu yi snod dgod dol/ /las kun byed pas bzlas nas su/ /bsang k+ṇi gtor dang ni 'thor 'thung bya/ /ku sha rtse mo rnon po yis/ /thab khung khor yug bskor bar bya/ /me ni 'bar bar shes pa dang / /g.yas pa mi 'jigs thob spyod cing / /gsang sngags 'dis ni cho ga bzhin/ /me yi lha ni 82—112

spyan drang ngo / /tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che/ /lha yi drang srong bram ze mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs 17su gsol / /oṃ asna (5)yi ā di tsho /bya ā bī 94)she (5 ā bī 6she 7ma hā shri ye hā 8kyi bya kā bya 9bā ha nā 7ya ཿkāswā hā/ phyag g.yon rdo rje bsang 15gtor te/ /mchod yon mchod pa rnam lnga dbul51lha/ /me yi phyogs nas bod pa ni1 / /gsus po che la mig gsum pa/ /gdong bzhi pa la lag bzhir ldan/ /mdog dmar ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ /me yi dkyil 'khor la gnas shing / /las kyi 'od zer rnams kyis brgyan/ /lag pa dang po mchog sbyin la/ /gnyis pa na ni sngags nor phreng 7/ /g.yon pa ril ba spyi blugs te/ /gnyis pa na ni be con nyid/ /mdog dmar rgyan ni med pa la/ /drang srong rnams kyis yongs bskor ba/ /'di lta'i gzugs ni bsams nas kyang / /thab kyi dbus su bzhugs su gsol/ /de la sbyin sreg la dgos pa/ /kun la lan gsum sreg blugs dbul/ /de nas 'thor 7'thung byas nas su/ /'bar ba'i rnam par bsgyur bar bya/ /rim pa 'di yi 1 tshul gyis ni/ /mkhas pas lha rnams tshim par bya/ /legs par tshim byas bzod gsol te/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub gsol ba gdab/ /bum pa rgyal mtshan rdo rje gdugs/ /pad+ma'i lcags kyu'i rnam pa dang / /me lce mdog dkar snang ba dang / /'khyil pa'i mtshan mas mkhas pas 1 brtag /des ri16ni myur du ci'abyung 'gyur ba/ /bsgom dang bzlas la 'bad par bya/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang la ni/ /oṃ zhes pa dang swā hā mthar/ /dbyangs kyi rgyud ni bsring 1ba ni/ /bar chad med pa'i dbyangs kyis sbyar/ /zhi ba'i sems ni zhi ba la/ /'byor pas rgyas pa mngon par spel/ /dregs bde stabs tshul bcas pa dang na / /82—113

dbang du gyur pas dbang du bya'o/ /drag shul spyod tshul la gnas pa/ /hūm̐ zhes pa dang phaṭa dang bcas/ /lus ni me lce 'bar ba dang / /'jig rten gsum po bzar bsams nas/ /bskul ba'i tshig dang spel ba yi/ /gsang sngags yi ge nges par sbyor/ /sngags grub cho ga shes pa yis/ /sbyin sreg cho ga thams cad la / /sna tshogs las dang ldan pa yi/ /yang dag yin pa mchod par bya/ /sbyin sreg de nyid la bskul zhing / /dang por nyadagang blugs bsreg 2)cing dbul/ /phyis ni rim bzhin rnam par spel/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang rnams la/ /dge ba'i rdzas rnams sbyin sreg bya/ /bshang gci khrag rkang rus pa dang / /sha chen dag kyang sbyin sreg bya/ /ci ste ye shes sems dpa'i zhal/ /mi gtsang ba yis bkang na ko/ /ji 4ltar sdig pa skye mi 'gyur/ /gal te sdig 'gyur 'bras bu gang ske/ /sems can mi shes pas rmongs pa/ /thabs dang shes rab rnam spangs shing ske/ /phyi rol dngos la mngon zhen pa/ /rnam rtog (5nadra bas blugs byas gang //de dag gis ni dge sdig gi/ /phung po gnyis su rnam par brtags/ /chos 'di rang bzhin gyis dag ste/ /skye ba med cing gnas med kyang / /sems can shes pa spel ba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis thabs su bstan(7/ /dam pa'i don du dge spangs nas/ /bsod nams min pa ci zhig smos/ /dper na mi gang chu klung gi/ /pha rol 'gro ba'i sems can dag /rtswa na/dang shing la 99nasogs bsdus nas/ /chu la rgal ba'i gzings 7byas te/ / de la 'jug ste 37legs brgal 12nas/ /bor te bde bar 'gro ba ltar/ /de bzhin 'khor ba'i pha rol gyi / /chos kyi 1 lam ni bskyed 1 byas kyang / /chos dang chos min rnam 15spangs nas / /byang chub bde ba thob pa ni/ /de phyir rnam rtog (7rnam spangs la/ /82wa 114

zab mo yi ni chos spel te/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs rnams la/ /sngags rig rnam rtog ma byed cig /rnam rtog rmongs pa chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung byed pas/ /nam mkha' lta bur dri med pa'i/ /rnam par mi rtog ting 'dzin gnas/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyar te/ /lus dang ngag dang sems bsdus nas/ /nga'o snyam pas gzi bskyed lus/ /rnam pa kun gyis 91rnam brgyan na/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas tshe 'di la/ /ye shes rdzogs pa nyid du 'gyur / /las las byung bar bstan pa yi/ /skyes pa bud med gzugs mang la /mnyes pa nyid du mi bya 'di/ /rdo rje lus can dam tshig yin/ /ngan rtog bzang rtog dra ba yi/ /sems kyis sems can rnams la ni/ /sna tshogs gdung bas sun mi 'byung / /rdo rje dang ldan dam tshig yin/ /sred pas bskyed rtsub phra ma na yi / /tshig dag rnam par mi smra zhing / /mnyan na bde ba byed pa 'di/ /rdo rje ngag can dam tshig yin/ /rnam par snang mdzad chen 'khrug mchog /sha yi khams la gnas pa yin/ /rkang la mi 'khrugs khurgyas pa ste/ /khrag la rin chen 'byung ba gtso/ /sems can rnams kyi rus phung gi(4/ /rus gong la ni 'od dpag med/ /rtsa yi tshogs rnams rnam 'brel 5)la/ /thub pa skyes mchog don yod la/ /dam tshig shes pa rnams la ni/ /gsang chen pa yis bstan pa 'di/ /blo ldan rdo rje rnams kyis ni/ /rtag tu brten 565cing bsgom par bya97)/ /'dod chags de bzhin gti mug rmongs/ /srid dang 'du byed rnam sel ba'i chos ni rnam pa lnga po 'di/ /thub pa 98tshoskyes mchog rnams kyis gsungs/ /bshang gci khu chu mchil ma khrag /'dzag pa 'byung ba bzhis bsdus pa/ /bsgom 9༄pa'i blo gos rtogs pa yis/ /dam tshig brtan par bya ba ste/ /rtag tu bza' zhing 82—115

sbyin par bya/ /dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las sbyin sreg gi 1)le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /'gro ba mi shes mun bsal phyir/ /ye shes nyi ma shar ba las/ /keg rdon pu mun pa bsal tshul gsungs/ /gshin rje'i gshed la 5sogs pa yi/ /mdog dang phyag mtshan la smyo sogs pa/ /de kun sngon du rgyas pa ru/ /bye brag gis ni rgyas par bstan/ /de ni las kyi 5khyad par gyi/ /dbang du byas pa khro bo'i 95)tshogs/ /gzhan du ma gsungs gang yin pa / /de dag 'di ru bshad par bya/ / rbu gyi 7ye shes las byung ba/ /gtsug tor nagazi brjid phung po ste/ /zhal gsum ser po mdangs dang ldan/ /phyag drug nyi ma la 9sogs pa/ /'dzin cing skyil mo krung yobacas pa ral 17pa'i gtsug tor gyis brgyan 1 cing / /'jig rten khams kun 'khrug byed pa'i/ /gzugs kyi 'phros 1 pas nam mkha' thugang / /rig mas sku la rab 'khyud pas/ /chags phyir spro ba'i rtsol ba can/ /'di 'dra sgom par byed pa la/ /bgegs kyis 15gnod pa yong mi gos417/ /skyon med rdo rje 1 zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// yang ni phroṃ gyi 18ye shes las/ /byung ba sngags kyi 'khor lo can/ /zhal gsum gser 'dra mdangs po che/ /phyag drug 'khor lo la 3)sogs pa/ /ral tshopa'i gtsug tor gyis brgyan pa/ /'dzin cing stag gi 3lhamad g.yogs te/ /thod pa'i phreng bas sku la brgyan/ /rig ma dang ldan chags pa po 2/ /'jol sgeg nyams kyi sbyor ba 2namadzad/ /'di sgom 2 spro bar byed pa la/ /nyin dang mtshan du rdo rje sems / /'khor bcas gnas su byon nas su/ /rtag tu srung 25ba nyid du byed/ /82—116

bka' bzhin byed pas (1rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de bzhin phroṃ nagyi ye shes las/ /byung ba'i khro bo gtsug tor rgyal/ /zhal gsum ser po mdangs dang ldan ri/ /phyag drug lcags kyu la sogs pa/ /'dzin cing sprul gyis yang dag brgyan / /'og tu bgegs kyi gtso mnan nas/ /gad mo'i sgras ni 'debs par byed / /ral pa'i gtsug tor 4 gyis brgyan pa/ /khro bo 'di 'dra sgom byed pa'i/ /rnal 'byor gang la 95sangs rgyas kyi/ /sprul pa'i bgegs kyang rlag byed na/ /gzhan ma rnams ni smos ci dgos/ /snying 'gugs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /sum̐ las yang ni byung ba yi/ /gtsug tor dam tshig spyod 6pan can/ /zhal gsum gser zhun mdangs ldan pa/ /phyag drug ka pā la 7sogs pa/ /'dzin cing sna tshogs rab tu 'bar/ /ral pa'i gtsug tor gyis brgyan pa/ /zhabs rnams bsgyur 8)zhing rnam par 'phen/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i blo gros can/ /'di 'dra gang zhig bsgom pa la/ /bi nā 9ya ka 1 ril sogs pa'i/ /bgegs kyis skabs ni mi rnyed phyir/ /ji bzhin rab tu bsgom par bya/ /gzhan gyis mi thub pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin tog11/ /rbu gyi 12yi ge las kyang byung / /ming gi gtsug tor rnam par 'thor1 / /zhal gsum gser ni btso sam 'dra/ /phyag drug tri shu la 1stesogs pa/ /'dzin cing srog song steng na gnas/ /rol pa'i stobs kyis bgegs mchu 17bcings/ /ral pa'i gtsug tor gyis brgyan pa/ /sangs rgyas sprin ni spro ba'o/ /gang zhig de 'dra sgom byed pa'i/ /rna la 'byor de yis go cha bgos/ /sra 1 ba'i ngang tshul can yin pas/ /bgegs lus gang gis mi g.yo'o/ /bgegs las rgyal ba 18rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /phroṃ gyi ye shes mthu las byung / /gtsug tor rnam par 'joms pa'i mchog /zhal 82—117

gsum gser 'dra'i nyi 'od mtshungs/ /phyag drug rdo rje la sogs pa/ /'dzin cing tshems 1kyis sgros mnan te/ /chags ldan rig nams 'khyud pa'o/ /ral pa'i gtsug tor gyis brgyan pa/ /khrag can ljags kyang 'dril ba ste/ /bla med byang chub thob 'dod pa/ /'di 'dra sgom par byed pa la/ /bskal pa brgyad cu'i bar du yang / /bgegs kyi 4gnod pa yong mi 'ong / /bgegs kyi (5rastong pa ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /yang ni r+bha (6gyi ye shes las/ /yang dag byung ba'i skabs dkar po/ /zhal gsum gser zhun lta bur gnas/ /phyag drug gdugs la sogs 'dzin cing / /skyabs med phongs pa'i skyabs mdzad cing ske/ /ma ning rnams dang za ma la/ /bu ni sbyin par byed pa po/ /ral pa'i gtsug tor gyis 7brgyan pa/ /rig ma dang ldan sku chen 'di/ /rnal 'byor gang gis sgom byed cing / /bzlas pa rtse gcig tu byed na/ /bgegs kyi gnod pas de mi brdzin/ /rin chen gyi skyabs 9chirdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /rnal 'byor khyad par can gyis ni/ /'di rnams byang chub bsrung ba'i phyir/ /'khor lo gtso bor rab bsgoms na/ /nang 1 rigi bgegs kyis yong 11mi tshugs/ /byang chub snying po don gnyer bas/ /'di 'dra'i 'khor lo can bsgoms na/ /bsgrims nas rnal 'byor bsgoms pa yis/ /ring por 1nyami thogs 'dod pa 'thob1 la/ /dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan 'gyi rgyud las byang chub kyi snying po'i rgyan 3gegatsug tor 'byung ba'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma thams cad 'dus nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces 82wa 118

gsol to/ /'di yi dpal ni gang zhig lags/ /rdo rje dang ni snying po dang / /de bzhin rgyan gyi don ni ci/ /kye ho mchog de bstan du gsol/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin pas de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'di ni thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /gsang ba'i rgyud du rab sbas pa/ /ji 1bzhin gnas pa'i de kho na/ /yang dag bstan gyis rtse gcig nyon / /lus ngag yid gsum bde dam pas/ /lha mo las ni bskyod bya ste/ /byang chub chen po bde ba yis/ /tshul bzhin du ni sngags pas bya/ /bskul ba'i snying pos 'di 2smra ste/ /dz+dza sa zhes skad cig skad cig tu/ /rang gi gnas na gnas pa yin/ /de nyid lha nyid bskyed par bya/ /bcu drug cha dang yang dag ldan / / zla ba cagasang ba'i thig le la/ /me tog dang ni 'dra ba nyid/ /rlung gis phul bas bskyod par bya/ /de bzhin bskyod pas bsgrub (zhe par bya/ /de bzhin du yang bskul bya ba/ /rgyud kyi phreng ni 'od gsal bzhin/ /steng dang mdun du rtsa gnyis las/ /bcu drug gnas su yang dag gnas/ /de las snying dbus rab zhugs te/ /rlung gi sbyor bas phul byas pas/ /steng dang mdog 6rab mdzes rdzogs sku/ /bdag gi dpal du shes par bya/ /de las byung ba'i dngos grub che/ /nor bu la gnas rtog 7 bral ba/ /thig le yig med bsdus pa'i sku/ /lhan cig skyes par shes par bya/ /de la de yi gzugs kyi sku/ /nam mkha'i khams kun gang ba yi/ /bral ba'i shes pas don byed pa/ /gzhan gyi dpal du shes par bya/ /de rnams rgyu 8las byung ba yi/ /ye shes shes rab shin tu gsang / /gsang ba rnam par 'grub pa yi/ /rdo rje snying po'i rgyan zhes 9bya/ /lha mo las byung bde dang ldan/ /'ja' tshon ltar gsal rgyud dag pa/ /snang 82—119

ba'i sku de mi shigs pa/ /rdo rje nga yis yang dag bsgrags/ /snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun/ /bsdus phyir brtsegs 1pa'i sku dam pa/ /rtog bral 2rgyud du sim gnas pa/ /'byung phyir snying po zhes su bsgrags/ /dag dang ma dag thams cad la/ /'khor ba ji srid bar snang ba/ /gnyis ka mdzes par byed pas na/ /rgyan du yang dag bsgrags pa yi/ /dpal dang rdo rje snying po dang / /rgyan zhes bya ba bzhi po ni/ /'brel cing grub par byed pa'i phyir/ /rgyud ces bya bar bshad pa'o/ /chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang / /bzhi stong gi ni grangs snyed kyi/ /mtshan gyi don ni 'di don du/ /yang dag 'dus par ngas bshad do / /gzhan du don ni ma bsgrags pa/ /bla ma la ni gus pa yi/ /slob ma la ni ma rtogs pa'i/ /rgyud gzhan dag tu sbas pa'o/ /don 'di yang dag ma shes nan / /ji snyed don ni bsam yas pa/ /shes kyang de yi 'bras bu med/ /de 'dod mnyes byas yang dag blang / /dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las ye shes gsum gyi mtshan 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //rtag par mi phyogs smra ba dang / /bla ma smod byed brtson pa la/ /dam tshig phyir ni yongs bsgral bya/ /de yi sha khrag klad tsho6)pa rna mas/ /drangs te chos 7kyi ston mo bya/ /de ltar ma byas sdug bsngal tshogs/ /gti mug can des thob par 'gyur / /nad thams cad dang khros chen dang / /'jigs dang nye bar 'tshe ba yi / /bskal pa grangs med bye ba ru/ /sdug bsngal chen por rab snyed /cing / /'o dod 'bod pas sbrul gyis 9brgyan/ /bstir med chen por rta ga par 'gro/ /de bas las 'des rgyas gdab po/ /bad ga nyid rdo rje ma/ba' 'gro yi/ /khro bo 82wa 120

gzugs can nyid gyur nas/ /ut+pal 1mthing ga kyi'adra ba yi/ /zhal gsum pa la phyag drug pa/ /rdo rje tri shul tsho phur bu dang / /thod pa gri gug 'khor lo 'dzin / /mi sdug khros pa lce lnga pa/ /bsams nas cade 'og nam mkha' la/ /bsgrub bya rgyas par dmigs nas su/ /rdo rje phur pa la 5sogs pa/ /sems can dkyil 'khor gnas pa la/ /sgrub pos de yi nyes pa bsgo6kyi/ /de nas phyag mtshan tri shul (7dang / /phur bu drag po mchog dag gis/ /mgo dang snying ga 8lte ba dang / /9/rkang pa gnyis dang lag pa yi/ /gnas lnga rab tu phug bya ste/ /lce 1 tsholnga'i 'od zer lnga po yis/ /srin bu 11'dza' lu ka bzhin du/ /khrag kun sngags kyis drangs nas su/ /thod par phab nas btung bar bya/ /de bzhin sha rnams yang bsdus nas/ /bza' ba ru ni rab tu brtag12 /rus pa rnams kyang 'tshos 1 byas nas/ /shes pa rdo rje pad+mar sbyar/ 'di ni don sgrub rab 1 byed pas / /zla ba phyed ni tshun chad kyis15/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po nga nga 'chi bar 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /rdo rje gsang ba 'di lta bu/ /bsgrub bya legs par bsgrubs 17byas nas/ /las ngan dag gis de mi 'khol/ /sangs rgyas su ni skye bar 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor de yang de yi 1 mthus/ /khro bo mkha' 1 'gro zhes 'gyur te/ /khams gsum bsad 19dang gso ba dang / /sems kyi 2 rdo rje brtan 21byas nas/ /skad cig tsam du byed par 'gyur/ /gsal bar nus pa gdon mi zal/ /dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan nagyi rgyud las rdo rje mkha' 'gro khro bo'i /sbyor bas dgra bsad rna pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /'dod chags thabs chen po yi rgyud/ /82—121

gang gis legs par shes na ni/ /tshe 'dis dngos grub sbyin par bshad/ /gsang ba 'dus pa stong phrag gcig /rdo rje phreng 91ba 'bum phrag gsum/ /dgongs pa lung ston stong phrag bzhi/ /lha mo bzhis zhus brgya bdun cu )/ /ut+tar /tan+t+ra 4)nyis brgya brgyad/ /de yi nye bar bshad pa'i rgyud/ /dam tshig chen po lnga bcu lnga/ /rdo rje lnga 'dus /5ristong phrag gcig /kun las btus (6)pa 'bum phrag gcig /mnyam nyid rnam rgyal nyis brgya bcu/ /zla gsang thig le stong phrag bdun ri/ /rdo rje sa 'og brgya nyi shu/ /cod pan rdo rje bdun brgya 78lnga//khro zla thig le 'bum phrag lnga/ /rdo rje rnam rgyal brgya dgu brgya(9kyi/ /mnyam nyid gsang ba stong phrag lnga/ / rdo rje gsang rgyan stong phrag lnga/ /7rdo rje gsang mdzes (11stong phrag bdun/ /nor bu gsang thig 'bum phrag bcu'o/ /snang mdzad rdzu / 'phrul stong dang brgyas/ /rdo rje gsang rgyan 12stong phrag gcig /rdo rje thod pa nyis brgya brgyal/ /de nyid brgya stong brgya 3 stong bdun/ /dam tshig mngon rgyan 51 stong phrag gsum19/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo 'bum phrag gcig /gsang chen 'dus 2 pa brgya lnga bcu/ /rin chen sdong 1po dgu brgya bdun/ /dus kyi thig le brgya brgyad cudage/ /lha mo bstan chos lnga brgya bdun/ /'di rnams dgongs dgepa'i bye brag gis/ / nga yis tsho yang dag bstan par bya/ /'di ni gnyis gnyis 'khyud 25pa yis/ /rgyud kyi dbye ba bstan pa'o/ /de bzhin du ni yan dzo calag bcangs / /rgod 2 dang bltas pas shes par bya/ /de bzhin zhe sdang gti mug gis ske/ /rgyud rnams kun kyang shes par bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 3)rgyud kun yang ske/ / 'di yi rim pas 1shes par bya/ /phyi nang dbye bar ra shes pa yis 2/ /rgyud kyi dbye ba shes par bya/ /nang du bstan pa'i bla ma ra )las/ /yang dag 82—122

blangs te bsgrub 0)par bya/ /ci bzhin gnas pa la dgongs te/ /bde bar gshegs pas rgyud kun bstan/ /rdo rje snying po'i rgyan rdon gyi rgyud/ / 'di yi rgyud ni rten)mkha' 'gro pha/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi (4)phyi mo ste/ /gzhan du ma bsgrags don gang zhig /'di ru yang dag bstan pa ste(5)/ /rnal 'byor gang zhig len pa'am / /sgom par sbyo6)byed dam 'chad pa'am/ / klog par (7byed pa rnal 'byor che / /de yang nga rin dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan 9gyi rgyud las rgyud thams cad 57dbye ba'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /sna tshogs mdo dang rgyud rnams kyis11/ / sdom pa yang dag shes 'gyur na/ /mkha' 'gro chen por 'gyur bar bshad/ /gang gis nyan thos rab 'byin pa/ /spong ba ltung ba'i bye brag bshad/ /bslab pa dang ni rdzas grags kyis/ /12'di ru des 12kyang yongs rdzogs byed/ /tshul khrims kyis nya )ni bslab pa gsum/ /dge ba'i chos ni sdud 15pa dang / /sdom pa nyi shu la 8sogs dang / /sems can don byed pa'i tshul khrims/ /byang chub sems dpa' rab sbyin nyu pa/ /lus ngag yid gsum rab byung 1 ba'i/ /sdom pa des 17kyang mkha' 'gro yi/ /rgyud rnams yang dag sbyor bar byed/ /zla ba smyung tsho dang gtsang sbra bsdam/ /grong dang gnag lhas thang la'am/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyis ni 1)/ /gnod pa dag ri ni yong mi byed/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sdom pa mchog /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /'gro ba'i don byed byang chub sems / / byang chub sems ni na rab tu bzung na / /rdo rje mi bskyod ri gerigs chen po / /rdo rje che dang 27dril bu dang / /slob dpon yang da ni bzung byas la dz+wa/ /82wa 123

de yi 1yon tan thob par byed/ /rin chen tog gi 2rigs mthon )po/ /nyin dang 4mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang zing mi 'jigs 55chos dang byamasari kyi/ /byin pas de yi 7yon tan thoban/ /pad+mo snang ba'i rigs dag la/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba yi/ /dam tshig rab tu bzung 9ba yis/ /bla med byang chub thob par byed/ /rnga sgra las kyi 1 rigs ma/nga po/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom par 511ldan / /bsnyen 1 bkur mchod pa sems can don/ /byas pas de yi 1 yon tan thobaske/ /srog mi gcod cing g.yem 1 mi bya/ /ma byin mi len rdzun 15mi smu/ / phra dang kyal tshig rtsub po dang 1 ‘/ /smra ba 1 mi bya brnab 18sems dang / /gnod sems tsha/ga par lta ba rnams/ /nam yang bya ba ma yin no/ /dkon mchog gsum ni yong mi spang / /lha dang bla ma de bzhin no/ /nyes pa kun gyi rtsa ba'i phyir / /chang yang rnam par spang bar bya/ /phyag rgya 1rngubazhon pa mtshon cha sogs/ /mtshan ma 'am ni lha yi grib / /'gom dang bza' bar mi bya ba/ /de la 21sogs pa mtha' yas pa'i/ /sdom pa gang de gsungs pa rnams/ /'di ru dang po'i las can la/ /de yis yang dag 'jug par byed/ /thun mong ma yin phas pham pa/ /bcu bzhir grags pa gang 'di ni/ /sngags pas don kun 'grub byed pas/ /spang zhing dor bar mi bya'o/ /slob dpon snying nas smod pa dang / /bde gshegs bka' las 'da' byed dang / /zhe 2 sdang gis ni mched sun 'byin / /byams sems med par sems can spangs/ /byang chub sems chen 'dor ba dang / /bdag gzhan grub pa'i mtha' smod byed/ /snod mi rung la gsang ba bstan/ /rgyal ba'i bdag nyid phung po smod/ /dag pa'i chos la som nyi na byed/ /gsum ldan khro la byams ldan te/ /stong pa thal na byung la rtog pa/ /82—124

dad ldan sem/sa ni sun 'byin byed/ /dam tshig dang ldan rtse 1mi byed/ /shes ldan bud med smod par byed/ /sngags pas de dag yo/ngas naspangs nas / /nges par dngos grub thob par byed/ /de la sngags pa yong 'das nas ri/ /nges par bdud dang phrad par 'gyur/ /nad dang sdug bsngal 'phel 'gyur te/ /bstir med spyi'u tshugs dmyal bar 'gro/ /sbom po ltung byed nyes dmigs kyang / /de dang 'dra bar shes nga/ra bya/ /dam tshig mi ldan rig mar bsten5)/ /tshogs kyi 'khor 'o ra rtsod (6/nga/ra byed/ /gas/nga ba'i chos ni ston pa dang / /dad ldan rnams la gzhan du ston/ /nyan thos nang du yun ring 7/gnas/ /snod mi rung la gas/nga ba bstan/ /kha na ma tho sbom 'gyur te/ /sngags pa de yi dam sdom zad / /zad pas 'grub par yong mi 'gyur/ /de bas nyin re lan gsum du/ /kha ton nagyis kyang bklag 9par bya/ /dkyil 'khor mthong dang zhugs pa dang / /dbang bskur ba la 1 sogs tshul gyi/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro thob pa gzhan11/ /byang chub sems dang nyan thos dang / /bya dang gnyis ka 15rnal 'byor rgyud/ /dgongs gsungs rnams kyis de lta min/ /de lta bas na sdom pa'i mchog /nga yis yang dag bstan par bya/ /dri chen dri chu rak+ta 1 dang / /shes dang byang chub sems rnams ni/ /bza' ba'i sbyor bas yang dag bza'/ /lto yi ye shes mis k+ṇi sbyangs phyir/ /phyi rol zas las khyad par 'gyur/ /de bzhin glang chen rta sha dang —/ /ba lang 12khyi sha sha chen rnams/ /ye shes lnga yi ngo bo'i phyir/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis 7bza' bar bya/ /de bzhin sems can gsad 1 par bya/ /ma byin par yang blang bar 18bya'o/ /bud med thams cad 'dod pa 19spyod/ /brdzun tshig dag kyang smra bar bya/ /de ltar byas pas sangs rgyas dang / /byang 82wa 125

chub sems dpa' mnyes par 'gyur/ /sems can rnams kyang tshim zhing dga'//de bzhin rnal 'byor snying po yis/ /sangs rgyas dang ni byang chub sems/ /rang 'dren nyan thos sku gzugs sogs/ /rang nyid dag pa gsum sbyor bas/ /phyag byas na ni mi rung 'gyur/ /kun du rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /lus ngag yid kyi dkyil 'khor las/ /rang nyid bsam gtan gsum sbyor bas3)/ /dbyer med blo yis mi bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor dag kyang mi bri'o/ /glegs bam dag kyang mi bklag 5go/ /mchod rten las kyang yong mi bya/ /lag pa'i phyag rgya rnams kyang spang / /nyin re zhing ni dus bzhi rtsa95)/ /bu mo legs par goms pa las/ /ga bur tsan+dan khas blangs te/ /cho ga bzhin du lus 'khor mchod/ /rol mo'i thabs ni sna tshogs pa/ /nga 94)yi rgyud las rab bstan pas/ /bcu drug thig le ngal so las/ /sngags kyi snying po brtag 95par bya/ /bla ma dam pa thugs rje ches//yang dag bstan pa la dmigs pas(6)/ /phyin ci log khur yongs 'dor te/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nga 97'drar 'gyur/ /dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las dam tshig dang sdom pa dbye ba'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas ro langs chen mo yi/ /sgrub pa yang dag bshad par bya/ /sgrub pos legs par shes gyur na/ /dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba'o/ /nag po yi ni tshes brgyad dang / /yang na bcu bzhi gang yang rung / /shing gcig na dur khrod ma mo 'am/ /yang na mi med gong bar du/ /sngon du sgrub pa'i bdag nyid can / /las kun 'grub par byed par sgrubashe/ /mda' mkhan ma dang sme sha can / ci /gdol pa mo dang gar mkhan sogs/ /mdun 7gyi so la lhag yod pa/ /82—126

byad dang mdangs ri19ldan rma med ma/ /lo ni sum cu 2rtsa gnyis bsngags/ /yang na nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /yang na chu dang dang por skyes/ /sbyangs nas shi ba ma sbags pa / /yang dag blangs te pha bong steng / /gzhan yang bu mo skra bzung ste/ /lha bzhad /sde dang ni dbang po lag /dkar po dang ni ri sgra dang / /gru gnon chu yis bkru bar bya/ /de nas tsan+dan dkar ri rapo yis/ /bu mo lus byugs rgyan dang gos/ /yang dag brgyan te mdun bzhag nas/ /dkyil 'khor 'jigs pa bri bya ste/ /rtsa sogs gsang sngags rab tu bzla/ /'byung po'i gtor ma yang byin te/ /sha na nag po mdangs dang ldan/ /myos byed bsregs pa ro yi khar//mtshan gcig thog thag sbyin sreg bya/ /de nas tho ras 6 dus su yang / /khrag chen phyogs bzhir gtor byas nas ri/ /mar khu chen po ro la bsku / /de nas ro de langs gyur 9)te/ /khro dang ldan pa'i ag tsar 1 )gyis/ /sa gsum mo yi sgras 'gengs 1 byed/ /de tshe sgrub po skrag mi bya/ /mā ma tī mi yi sbyor ba sogs/ /srung 32ba'i 'khor los bsrung bobar bya/ /skrag na de ma thag tu gsod/ /de tshe bsrung bas bsrungs 32byas nas/ /bdag nyid langs te de yi mgor17/ /yungs mar cho1 gyis ni brdeg par bya/ /de nas de ni babs gyur te / /sgrub pa po yi mdun gnas nas/ /bka' nod 'di skad smra bar byed/ /sems can chen po khyod ci 'dod/ /bdag la yang dag bka' stsol cig /ral gri mig sman sa 'og gam/ /rkang mgyogs 12de bzhin bcud kyis 19len/ /mi snang 'gugs pa las gang dag /bdag gis gcig cig sbyar bar bya/ /de nas sgrub po de yis kyang ske/ /gang 'dod smras nas cang te'u brdung / /de nas ro langs kha de nas/ /du cib 'thul sa1zhing me 'bar ba/ /de nas sbrul nag lta bu ru/ /ro yi kha nas 82—127

'byung bar byed/ /de de sgrub pos 11kha yis blang (2/ /byung ste gser gyi ral grir 'gyur / /de thogs tshangs pa'i 'jig rten khams/ /steng du nges nga/ra 'gro bar byed/ /de bzhin kun du 'gro bar byed/ /de bzhin rdzas kun gang la bstan / /thams cad gser 'gyur rtsi lta bu/ /de bzhin thabs sgrub de bya na kyi/ /ro ni snga mkho bzhin 'gyur te/ /de yis sbyin sreg rab byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor 5/nga dag tshim nga/ra bya/ /de bas 'di ni sgrub pa'i mchog /don kun yang dag 'grub byed pa/ /las thams cad kyi gtso bo ste/ /bcom ldan rdo rje sem/sa dpas gsungs/ /dang/la rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las ro langs chen mo'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// // da ni rang yis sgrub ngo/ yi/ /dngos grub slob dpon las byung phyir/ /rgyud rnams kun las gsungs pa yi/ /slob dpon bkur ba'i cho ga bshad/ /slob dpon med nga/ra gyur na ni/ /dngos grub thob par mi 'gyur bas/ /slob dpon grangs dang mtshan nyid ni/ /yid gcig bsdus la ma/nyan 7 par gyis/ /dam sdom gyi ni snod gtsang la/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs nga/ra/ /byed cing dang po las 'jug nga/ra/ /byed pa rgyu yi slob dpon no/ /ri bong 8'dzin pa skul 9byed cing / /de yi 0sgrub po zhing dag cing / /ye shes sgyu ma'i snod rung byed/ /rkyen gyi slob dpon chen po'o/ /lhan cig nyan 11par gang gyur pa / /de las dga' ba nga/nga dag thobanyis/ /thob (1 pas yang dag rab ma/thar phyin//lhan cig byed pa'i slob dpon ning/ /mi 'gyur byams ldan shes rab can/ /sngags rgyud sbyor shes dkyil 'khor mkhas/ /de nyid bcu shes theg chen dga'/ /82—128

gsang ba zungs thub slob dpon yin/ /mig bzang 51ya so bcu drug pa/ /khu 'phrig tshon rtog pa yang dag spangs/ /bla ma dga' ba dad mos can/ /shin tu rgyan gyis rab brgyan pa/ /dad ldan sbyor ba la goms pa/ /gzugs bzang 'dod chags kyis myos byed/ /shin tu dul ba khyad par can/ /bkur dba'i gnas su yang dag blangs/ /dge dang bsgom 4pa la dga' ba/ /rtag tu bla ma la gus pa'i/ /slob mas bla ma 'di ltar blta/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam / /de nyid rtag tu rdo rje 'chang / /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung la/ /de ni ye shes rgya mtsho che/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen sbyin/ /de yi yon tan thams ca da gzung 5ci/ /skyon ku na sems kyis kyang mi bsamachi / /yon tan bzung nas 7)dngos grub 'thob / /skyon gyis dngos grub nyams par byed / /mchod rten bshig 9dang sdig 'dra'i phyir/ /de yi grib ma'ang mi 'gom ste/ /stan dang lham dang bzhon pa dang / /'gom par bya ba smos ci dgos / /rgyu ba dang ni mi rgyu ba'i/ /mchog ku na de yis spangs par 'gyur/ /slob dpon smod par byed pa de1 / /mi la ma du yang mthong mi bya/ /de ni bgegs dang log 'dren 'dzin/ /rims dang snag dang gshi na rjes 'dzin/ /'chi bar 11rab tu 'gyur ba ste/ /ngan pa gtum po blun 1 chen te/ /phyogs bzhi dab/ tu song gyur yang / /blo lda na rnams kyis mi bsrung 1 bar/ /mdung la sogs pa'i mtshan cha yis/ /kha na ma tho byed pa bsad/ /mdo sogs bstan pa'i dmyal ba ru/ /slob dpon smod par byed pa de / /gnas par 'gyur bar 15nga yis bsta na/ /de bas bla ma'i zhabs drung du/ /bag ma bzhin du ngo tsha bsru nga ske/ /glang da nga da god dang 510lud pa sogs/ /kha la 1 lag pas bkab 82wa 129

nas su/ /shin tu 'jam par smra bar bya/ /mgo thod bcing dang mtshon byug byipa / /bla ma'i drung du mi bya'o/ /bro brdung ba rinodang brkam tshig dag /thos pa'i yul nas mi bya'o/ /mdun 'gro ba dang rkang pa brkyang / /yang dag nyid du mi bya'o/ /las ni gang dag byed pa 'am/ /mnyan pa la 5sogs 'dod pa la/ /gzung 4phyir thal mo ma bshig par/ /gnas nas langs te mthong yul du/ /rgyab kyis phyogs par mi bya ste/ /mtshan mo dang ni chu brgal tshonanodang / /gcong 6rong dag tu gnas gyur 7na/ /bka' lung gnyer du dgum pa'i naphyir/ /mdun du 'gro ba nyes mi 'gyur/ /de bas thabs ni thams cad kyis(9/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bla ma mchog /rjes su mthun 7pas mnyes par bya/ /de mnyes sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes/ /gang gis slob dpon yang dag smad/ /de yis rgyud kun bsgrub 11pa'i mchog /gnyid dang 'du 'dzi rnam tshespangs te/ /bskal pa stong du legs bsgrubs kyang / /dmyal sogs sgrub par byed pa'o/ /de phyir kun gyis rab bsgrims te/ /bsam 1 pa 'bras bu smin byed pa'i/ /sangs rgyas 'bras bu 'dod pa yis/ /sems can dad dang ldan pas mchod/ /dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las bla ma bkur ba'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //rdo rje pad+mo sbyor ba las/ /yang dag ye shes skye 'gyur bas/ /sgyu ma'i mchog ni bud med de/ /de yi ming dang mtshan nyid bstan/ /ha ste ni 51 dang sha'i ni15/ /ka ma la 17dang tsi tra na(1 / /thams cad rigs ni bzhir 'gyur te// ha sti rak+ta ro tsha 18ba/ /sbom mo 'dod chags yang dag che/ /pad 16yangs kha nas sha rul bro/ /dkar 'chang tshomatha' phra go sbom tsho 7byed/ / sha'i rak+ta ro skyur zhug82—130

ba / /rked phra sna legs cung zad khro/ /kha nas dud bro 'gros dal 17legs/ /dkar 'chang dpal gyi 'bras bu 'dra/ /ka ma'i rak+ta'i ro mngar zhing 5/ / shadi rak+ta ro skyur ( /ba/ /phra sbom ran pa dmar mo ste/ /'dod chags mig ni mi 'dzums lta54)/ /dkar 'chang a ri sha 'dra ba/ /tsi tra rak+ta ro mngar 5zhing //thun rung (6)khro bag dang bcas pa/ /chags min 7)lta byed ngo gnag pa/ /dkar 'chang g.yas g.yon dgye na/ba ste/ /'di rnams yang dag phrad gyur na/ /sgrub pa po la tshe 'di ru/ /dngos grub yang dag ster (9ba ste/ /de ri bas 'di rnams 'bad pas btsal/ /yang dag rnyed nas gang rung du/ /ba lang bza' ni mda' yi nang / /btung bas shel khams 1lharnam par 'phel/ /de ni thabs kyis 12ster ba yis/ /yang dag tu ni rang bzhin brtaganyuge /rang bzhin nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /dngos po thams cad zad pa ste/ /rnam par rtog pa thams cad dang / /bral ba'i dga' ba yang dag zab/ /bsam med zad med phra mo ste/ /dam pa zhi ba rnam dag pa/ /'chi med rdo rje bdud rtsi brjod/ /gang gi dbus su 'dab brgyad pa/ /snying po lnga yis yang dag brgyan/ /de dbus de gnas sacha nas lnga/ /cha gnyis pa ni brgyad mthar dbyung / /sum cu 8bcu pa lnga yi 7ni/ /cha gnyis lnga pa drug pa yi/ /thig le ru ni gzhug pa ste/ /skyes bu gang gis de la ni/ /mig gi 'od zer nyu thogyis blta 12ba/ /de la ci bzhin gnas pa yi/ /ye shes skye bar the tshom 16med/ /nam zhig 'gog pa'i sems gyur na/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 2 mchog 'dzin pa/ /dpal ldan mkha' 'gro 'dra bar 'gyur/ /de 21ring phan chad bu khyod ni/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag 'dri 22ba dang / /sgrub po rgyud la sbyor ba yin / /slob dpon chen po nyid du 'gyur/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun gyis 82—131

kyang ske/ /dbang bskur bar ni rab bsngags nyunote/ /thams cad sngags ni sgrub 'gyur te/ /las mchog khyad par can yang 'grub/ /bu mo 'di ni khyod dang mthun95 / /sems can khyod kyis 'dod pa gyis/ /yid du 'ong ba'i rig ma 'di / /bde gshegs kun gyis khyod spyod gnas/ /stong pa la ni sems sbyor na/ /khyod ni yang dag dam par 'gyur/ /'di ni bde gshegs bde mdzad pa/ /khyod ni 3'di las rab 3)byung ngo / /dpal rdo rje snying po rgya na gyi rgyu da las dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i shes rab kyi sdomatshan nyid brtag 96)pa'i le'u ste bcwa 7lnga pa'o// //de nas yang ni bshad bya ba/ /dngos kun cho ga shes med na/ /sgrub po dngos grub 'byung mi 'gyur/ /de phyir 'dir ni brtul zhugs bstan/ /sbyor ba'i rtsol ba thams cad ni/ /de nyid rig pas spang bar bya/ /rdo rje se mas dang nges 'dug pa/ /spangs nas gzhan du mi bya'o/ /dab/ pa de nyid la po/na sa pas//sbyor ba rna mas kyang mi bya ste/ /bdag med gnas pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /ci srid bar du so sor brtagan /dngos med go 'phang la gnas dang / /thabs bzang ri9dab/ dang ldan pa yis/ /rgyud las gang ci 'byung ba rnams/ /ma bte gas 51 )pas ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sgom pa'i sbyor ba'i stobs kyis ni/ /dngos grub ma tshan nyid gang yang rung / /de ku na skad cig tsam la ni/ /ra nga nyid gnas par gyur pa yin/ /de bas dge slong dngos gnas dang / /de bzhin rtog ge 1 rgan po dang ske/ /rang gi bu dang rgyal po la/ /de nyid yang dag bshad mi bya/ /je 1 ltar mar me bum nang gnas/ /pha rol du ni 'od mi gsal/ /bum pa de nyed chag 82wa 132

gyur na①/ /de 'og mar me gsal bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin rang lus bum pa nyid / / bla ma'i kha yis legs bcag nas/ /de nyid mar me nyid lta bu na)/ /sbyor ba'i de nyid ston pa yin/ /sbyor ba de nyid la gnas na/ /gang tshe bstan ri skupa mi rtag ④la/ /gnas shing 'jig rten pa spangs te/ /spyod pa thams cad byas na (sheni/ /de la de tshe sangs rgyas gzigs/ /kun du the tshom gcod pa yis(phyin / /rig tso)pas byis pa bzhin du spyad/ /gang tshe chags med rnal 'byor pa//de tshe phun sum tshogs 'phel 'gyur/ /sdig pa ma lus ldan pa dang / /gti mug sgrib pa rab gnas pa/ /smyon pa'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yis/ /zla drug gis 8)ni don yod grub/ /rang nyid sangs rgyas kun mthong zhing / /'dod pa kun gyis rab tu 'gengs/ /zad med gzhom du med pa dang / /dang ba'i sku tshe 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub mchog /'bad pa med par yang dag 'thob / /'dod pa kun gyi ri9 kyidaga' mos rnams/ /'bad 7bral bas ni nyu1'grub par 'gyur/ /'gro dang 'dug dang gnas pa na/ /mchog tu zab pa'i gnas la brtag /'od gsal ye shes lam mkhan pa/ /mtshan nyid rtog 32pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i/ /bsam gtan sbyor ba 'di yis nyu ni/ /sems kyi rin chen brtan par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab zhugs 1 )pa/ /byin gyis brlab pa'ang mdzad par 'gyur/ /de ltar gyur pas zhugs nas kyang / /ji srid sems ni mi skyo bar/ /mnyam gzhag 12yid ni bzang po yis/ /de la 17'bad pas bsgom par bya/ /de 'og la ni ci dga' ba'i/ /spyad pa yis ni gcig byas na/ /cung zad spyan phye ba yi mtshan/ /byang chub rgya nyu tshochen 'thob mi par 'gyur/ /dgod 19dam smra 'am 'dug tsho )pa 'am/ /la lar rab tu gar byed par/ /ji 1srid skyo 82—133

bar mi 'gyur bar/ /bsgom 1 pa'i sems la zhen par bya/ /de lta'i dam tshig ldan gyur cing / /rnam par mi rtog sngags pa yis/ /dus kyi nges pas yongs spangs nas/ /bla med byang chub 'thob ri par 'gyur/ /dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi nargyud las shes byed ku na du spyod pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //de nas mkha' 'gro de dag thams cad gcig tu 'dus nas (4)bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa la tshigs su bcad pas bstod pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyi (5)rang bzhin las/ /byung ba'i lha ste khyod mchog pas/ /sems dpa' kun gyi phyag rgya che/ /mkha' 'gro chen po phyag 'tshal lo/ /gti mug thams cad 'od gsal ba/ /mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas chen po ste/ /gzugs snang chos ni rnam dag pa6/ /bde gshegs mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /nga rgyal thams cad 'od gsal ba/ /mkha' 'gro re 'dod skong ba ste/ /sim 57)sogs chos ni rnam dag pa/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'dod chags thams cad 'od gsal ba/ /skyon gyis na/gos med mkha' 'gro che/ /mtshan mar 'dzin pa rnam dag pa/ /pad+ma 99mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phrag dog chos ni 'od gsal ba/ /mkha' 'gro sna tshogs las byed pa/ /mngon par 'du byed chos kun dgas /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mtshan mchog 'di yis khyod bstod pas/ /gang zag de yang bsod nams tshogs/ /ye shes tshogs chen yongs rdzogs nas/ /sangs rgyas 'gyur bar the tshom (77med/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos kun du bzang po'i bde ba chen po nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad du khyab pa'i bdag nyid chen pos/ de bzhin gshegs pa 82—134

thams cad kyi snying po mi shigs (1)pa'i zla ba skul (2bar byed pa zhes dbya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs 4)te/ rang gi thugs ku'i 95)mi shigs pa'i thig le las 56)shin tu dgyes (7 pa chen po zhes bya ba'i 'od zer gyi 8tshogs phyung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i snying po zla ba'i thig le'i (9dbus su rgyas par byas te/ nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad du yang snang bar byas nas steng 'og tu yang bzhugs te/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i ri dang sems can thams cad la thugasal bar byas nas shin tu dgyes pa chen po'i bde bas mnyes par byas te slar log nas bcom ldan 'das shin tu 11dgyes pa chen po'i bde ba'i bdag po'i snying po'i mchog gi zla ba'i thig le'i dbus na bde bar zhugs 12so / /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'od zer gyi tshogs kyi phreng ba mchog tu bde bar gyur pa'i snying po des bskul ba na gar mdzad cing rang rang gi ting nge 'dzin du dmigs nas bcom ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang po'i thugs ku'i nyu zla ba'i thig le'i dbus su gsang ba'i dgyes pa chen po'i bde bar gcig tu bsdus par gyur te/ rang rang gi sku bud med kyi tshul du bskyed nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka khanas mngon par byung bar gyur to/ /de nas mkha' 'gro'i mtshogs de dag thams cad rab tu dga' nas ca co'i sgra yang dag par 'byin cing dbyangs chen po brjod 7par gyur to/ /kye ma'o rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /rdo rje shin tu dgyes chen po/ /kye ma'o sna tshogs thabs ni bde byed sna che/ /sna tshogs ye shes bde ba che/ /kye ma'o kun du bzang po yi she/ /dge ba'i ye shes bde byed che/ /gang bde'i phyir ni rig ma yi/ /pad+ma 19nol ni gnas par mdzod/ /kye ma'o rig ri pa shin tu zab/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma 82—135

'di / /sems can kun la shes rab kyi/ /mun pa thibs (1/po sel bar mdzad/ /kye ma'o thams cad ngo mtshar che/ /mkha' 'gro 'dra (5bar gar mdzad cing / /rnam par snang mdzad myang ba dang / /mnye ba dang ni 'phrog pa mchog /kye ma'o shin tu rab tu dgyes/ /skal ldan skal spyod pa dang ni/ /sna tshogs skal bas bde byed che/ /sna tshogs rdo rje shin tu mdzes/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang chen pos ting nge 'dzin las ri bzhengs te 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la rnam par bltas te 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /ā li dang ni kā li cadang / /de byung zla ba rnam pa gnyis/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes te / /gcig tu gyur pa mnyam nyid do/ /sa bon mtshan mar gyur pa ni/ /so sor rtog par ngas bshad do/ /de byung sangs rgyas thams cad kyis(5)/ /'gro don byed pa bya nan tan/ /gzugs brnyan rdzogs pa chos dbyings te/ /lha yi dbang po sangs rgyas bskyed6/ /de la bar mas khu bas bskyed/ /bskur bas rang gi lhar bskyed nas/ /byin gyis brlab ri pa bya ba ni/ /rgyud rnams kyi ni thun mong ngo / /gsang dang gsang chen shin tu gsang / /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor chen po dang / /rjes su rnal 'byor zhes bya dang / /stong pa dang ni shin tu stong / /chen po stong pa zhes bya dang / /dga' dang dga' ba bar ma dang / /dga' bral gyi ni dga' ba rnams/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi spyi bo'o/ /phyir bzlog gnyis kyi cho ga dang / /gsang dang shes rab ye shes dang / /kha sbyor 'byed pa'i cho ga dang / /gtor ma rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang / /drag shul sgrub na pa'i cho ga dang / /rab tu gnas dang dkyil 'khor sgrub/ /gsang ba'i de nyid bcu yin no/ /dkyil 'khor ting 'dzin phyag rgya dang / /stang stabs 'dug stangs 82wa 136

po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje khu tshur dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mnyam pa nyid kyi sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i mdzod dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bdud kyi stobs thams cad rab tu 'joms pa dang / de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ri rab dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa dang thabs cig go/ /de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu dang byin gyi rlabs 91)kyis lha'i rgyal po'i khang bzang de ni / nor bu rin po che'i khang brtsegs dang / nor bu rin po che chen po'i tog dang ske/ kha dog sna tshogs rnam par bkra ba'i dar dpyangs dang / 'phan dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / bla bres dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi 2rgyan phreng dang / dra ba dang / dra ba phyed pa dang / rnga yab dang / me tog gi chun po dang / dril bu dang / dar gyi lda ldi rlung gis bskyod pa la sogs pa'i rgyan bkod phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan te/da/ dper na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa bzhin du kun nas mdzes par gyur to/ /ston pa bcom ldan 'das ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i dam tshig gi ye shes rnam pa sna tshogs pa khyad par 'phags pa dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rin po che'i cod pan gyis ca/khams gsum gyi chos kyi rgyal por 5)dbang bskur ba brnyes ne pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor chen po'i dbang 82—151

phyug yongs su rdzogs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid thugs su chud pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rmad du byung ba'i phrin 1las sna tshogs mdzad pa/ thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang la/ thugs rdo rje mnyam pa nyid la dus gsum du rtag par bzhugs pa/sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad kyi re ba yongs su skong 2bar mdzad cing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbastod cing bsngags pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis chos kyi ri 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba btab pa la bdag gir mdzad do/ /gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'dus pa'i gaṅgā'i 45diklung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang thabs cig ste/ dper na til gyi gang bus dzasbu'i 7gling yongs su gang ba bzhin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku re re las kyang gzhal du med cing grangs su ma mchis pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhing snang bar gyur cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag thams cad na yang gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba mchog tu gsang ba'i chos kyi sgo 'di nyid ston par mdzad do/ /yang de'i tshe na lag na rdo rje rdo rje 'chang chen po zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs la rab tu gnas pa / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyod pa yang dag par sgrub na par byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i phrin 9las rjes su skyong ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa 1 yongs su rdzogs par byed pa po ste/ de ltar rang gi rigs kyi chos la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor rjes su 'dzin par gnas pa 82—152

las / 'dus pa chen po'i dbus su rang gi lus mi snang bar mdzad do/ /de nas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis tshogs kyi nang na byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje mi snang bar gyur pa gzigs nas gsung 1dbyangs gcig gis ched du rjod tshanapa 'dis ched du brjod do/ /e ma lag na rdo rje 'chang ske/ /bdag cag yongs kyi byed pa po/ /'dus pa'i dbus nas mi snang ba//mgon khyod da lta gang du tshodabazhud/ /ces gsungs nas thams cad kyang so so'i mi shigs 4)pa rdo rje rin po che mchog gi byin gyis brlabs 5pa'i gnas su cang mi gsung bar bzhugs so/ /de nas lag na rdo rje rdo rje 'chang chen po des/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gnas lnga las byung ste bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i skur tshonebazhengs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chen por snang ba de dpag tshad 797)stong phrag gi tshad du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chen por nabyin gyis brlabs nas/ de'i dbus su gnas par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad slar yang 'dus par gyur nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rje bo la gsol ba btab bo/ /rdo rje chos phyir khyod legs so/ /rdo rje'i spyan phyir 9khyod legs so/ /rdo rje ye shes phyir khyod legs/ /sangs rgyas ye shes phyir khyod legs / /gong bzhin du sbyar ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams thams cad bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sangs rgyas kun la phan par mdzad/ /sems can mgon la gsol ba ni/ /khyab bdag theg pa chen po'i tshul/ /theg pa'i mchog ni bstan du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin 82—153

gshegs pa rnams thams cad la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /(1)bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams thams cad de skad ma zer cig /spro ba mchog gi de kho na nyid kyi tshul nges par bstan par de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis tshon rab tu gsungs so/ /ci'i rgyus rdo rje 'dzin 5)rab tu gsung 4kyi/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams thams cad kyis (5)dgongs/ de nyid kyi tshe 'khor chen po'i dkyil 'khor du byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams theg pa chen po mchog gi don gyi tshul chen po 'di thos nas/ rnam pa stong du rnam par bsnyil 96bar gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la gsol pa/ khyod kyis zhi bar byin brlabs pas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi (7)rnam pa can/ /khyab bdag de nyid rdo rje can/ /byin rlabs (snyamanyam par kun du spyod / /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes spyan gdangs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la legs so byin nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 9'khor lo chen po'i 'od zer gyis bkang 7nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs yang dag par skul 411bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhi rab tu byung bar gyur te/ shar gyi lha phyogs su hu mi zad pa'i gzugs 'dzin ma zhes bya ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po rab tu shin tu byung bar gyur tol/ /lho phyogs su 7rin po che yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po rab tu shin tu byung bar gyur to/ /nub phyogs su 'chi med rdo rje zhes bya ba'i nyi ma'i bodakyil 'khor chen po rab tu shin tu byung bar gyur to/ /byang phyogs su don yod pa'i dam tshig gi tshardo rje zhes bya ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 82wa 154
