bsam par bya/ /'dzam 17bu'i gling ni thams cad du/ /'o ma dang zhos kun du 'khrugs / /shing rta'i 'khor lo'i tshad kyis ni/ /pad+mas g.yogs par (0rnam bsgom bya/ /khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed/ /drag tu dgod (kyepa chen po sogs/ /rtag tu de yi dkyil 'khor gyi/ /de yi gzugs ni rnam bsgoms nas/ /khro chen khro gnyer rim par ldan/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i 'od/ /ji ltar rigs par kun bskyed nas/ /sgom par byed pa de der bshad/ /khro bo chen po dbyug pa sngo/ /'jig rten gsum 'jig nga)'phrog byed pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes su/ /'joms pa po ni rab tu gnas/ /ji skad gsungs pa'i gzugs gsum gyis5ci/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun du gang / /yi ge'i gzugs ni kun bskyed nas/ /bdag nyid snying gar rnam bsam bya/ /snying ga'i gzugs ni de tsho rnams su/ /lha yi rnam par sgom par byed/ /slar ni sngags pas bsdu bar bya / /de nyid la ni gzhug (pepar bya/ /cho ga shes pas bskal pa'i mer/ /bsams nas bsam gtan yang dag brtsam/ /zla 'od lta bur 'bar ba ni/ /btsun 8mo rtag tu bsgom par bya/ /lha nyid yang dag bskyed nas ni/ /de yi dbus su rnam bsgom bya/ /rang gzugs snying gar bsams nas ni/ /de yi dbus su rnam bsgom bya/ /rang gzugs snying gar bsams nas ni/ /ha yig tu ni rnam bsgom bya/ /'di de sngags rnams thams cad kyi(9)/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed/ /'di ni dang po'i bsam gtan brjod/ /rab tu 'bad pas bsgom par bya/ /rtag tu rigs kyi bdag po yis/ /bskal par bsregs 1 )par rnam bsgoms nas/ /sngags pas de yi rnam pa der311/ /bsam gtan brtson pas bsgom par bya/ /sangs rgyas gzugs kyi 1nyarab sbyor gyis/ /82—206

zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa ni/ /rang gi gzugs kyis ①kun bskyed nas/ /ba spu'i khung bur ②'di spro bya/ /ji skad gsungs pa'i gzugs gsum gyis/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun tu bkang / /'od zer (kyelnga yi rab sbyor gyis/ /rang tsas su ni rab gzhug bya/ /rig ma'i rgyal mo sogs sbyor bas/ /de rnams thams cad yongs brtag bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' khams ni/ /yongs su gang bar rnam bsgom bya/ /rang lus su ni rnam bsgoms nas/ /thams cad der ni rab gzhug bya/ /gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po chen por rig ma'i tshul la sogs pa'i las can gyi le'u ste bcu gsum pa rdzogs so// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po gsang sngags thams cad kyi gsang chen rig ma'i tshul gyi ④las gsungs pa/ nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par/ /dkyil 'khor chen po mchog gyur pa/ /dpag tshad kyi ni grangs kyi khyon/ /kun nas yongs su skum por ni/ /gsal ba gsal bar mtshungs bsams (penas/ /dbus su bdag nyid rnam bsam bya/ /'bad pas gnas lnga rnams su ni/ /rnam snang mdzad chen gzugs bsams nas/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /de rnams thams cad yongs brtag bya/ /snying gar rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /yang dag bskyed nas rnam bsgom bya/ /cho ga shes pas nyi rnam par/ /nam mkha'i khams ni gang bar byed/ /lha la sogs pa'i sbyor ba yis96)/ /slar yang de ni rab gzhug bya/ /de nyid tshul ni dge ba 'di / /rigs kyi dbye bas rtogs par bya/ /gzhan du gsang ba'i bsam gtan 82—207

ni / /rnam par spangs pas 'grub mi 'gyur/ /gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po chen por rig ma'i las kyi le'u ste bcu bzhi pa rdzogs so// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad lha thams cad kyi de kho na nyid kyi tshul bzlas pa'i cho ga ston par mdzad do/ /nam mkhar 'phrul 0)ni ston par ram / /gang du sems ni rab dgyes byed/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor bsams nas ni/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor mchod bsgom byadzonan/ /me tog bzang po de dbus su / /de nyid sbyor bas bsgom par bya/ /rang gzugs phyag rgya chen po ni/ /bsgom bya gzhan du brtson mi bya/ /snying ga'i dbus son phra mo ni/ /dri med ye shes dkyil 'khor ni/ /gsal ba 'od dkar 'bar la 9gyisogs/ /chu yi rnam par dgod par bya/ /de la sngags kyi yi ge'i tshig /dang po gsang ba rnam bsgom bya/ /rtse mo lnga pa rnam warabasgoms nas/ /slar yang de nyid la sbyar bya/ /blo dang ldan pas gnas lnga ru/ /gzugs brnyan yang ni yang dag bskyed/ /de nyid yi ge'i tshul mthun rtenapas/ /bsam gtan 'byung ba bsgom par bya/ /cho ga shes pas yig rnams kyi/ /phreng ba bskyed nas bsgom par bya/ /nas kyi tshad 'di thams cad du/ /bsam gtan 'byung ba bsgom par bya/ /rab tu 'bad pas 'og der ni/ /rtag tu nam mkha' gang bar bya/ /de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gang ba de la grags pa yin/ /yi ge gcig gi gsang sngags kyi / /rang gzugs rnam par bsgom par bya/ /rigs kyi bdag po 'byung ba ni/ /yi ge gsum gyi tsho6rtag shes bya/ /yi ge lnga la sogs gzung bas/ /ji srid yi ge 82—208

'byung ba'o/ /'od dkar 'bar ba'i phreng ba sogs/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba mnyam pa'i 'od/ /rigs kyi dbye bas las rnams kyi/ /thog ma tha ma 'di bya'o//ut+pal sngon po'i 'dab 6)rnam par/ /in+d+ra nī la mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /'od zer 'bar 'khrugs (migatso bo'i yum/ /yid kyis bsams pas (na/'grub par 'gyur/ /pad+ma rā ga dbang mdog 'od/ /dmar po 'bar ba mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /'jig rten khams ni kun nas su/ /cho ga shes pas snang bar bya/ /ge sar ser po dang mtshungs pa/ /ser po 'od zer 4)'bar la sogs/ /sgom pa'i go 'phang gis (5)bsgom bya/ /the tshom 6)med par bsgrub par bya/ /de nyid 'byung ba gang gsungs pa/ /rang gzugs yang dag bskyed nas ni/ /snying gar me tog bsams nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor de la bsgom par bya/ /cho ga shes pas de'i steng du/ /snying po phyag rgya rnam bsgom bya/ /ji lta'i go 'phang ri kun bskyed nas/ /ye shes de nyid rnam bsgom bya/ /bha gar a yig nges phyung nas/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa (8ril sogs bya/ /'jig rten khams ni kun nas su/ /cho ga shes pas spro bar bya/ /thog ma bar dang tha mar ni/ /slar yang bsdu bar bsam par bya/ /zla 'od lta bur yang dag sbyor/ /rang lus su yang bsgom par bya/ /'di ni de nyid tshul dge ba/ /rigs gsum du yang rtogs 9par bya/ /bya dang byed nyu )pa yang dag sbyor/ /sgom pa de ni 'grub par byed/ /sems kyi kun sbyor mtshan nyid kyis/ /gal te chags la chags par 'gyur/ /bsam gtan 'dus 17la rab zhugs /shenas/ /de la gzhug sna par bsgom par bya/ /'di de cho1risangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sgrub pa po/ /sgrub po rnams kyi de nyid 'di / /dngos grub bsgrub 515la dam tshig mchog /sangs rgyas gzugs su rnam 82wa 209

bsgoms nas/ /ral pa'i cod pan 'dzin bzhin pa/ /sangs rgyas slob dpon yang dag bskyed/ /snying gar de ni dgod par bya/ /rang 0)sngags mchog gi phyag rgya ni/ /bsams nas de yi snying gar dgod/ /'thung dang za ba'i dus rnams su/ /nye bar longs spyod byed rnams su'ang / /dri dang gzugs sogs bya ba rnams/ /'di ni de kho na nyid brjod/ /lha sbyor sangs rgyas slob dpon gyi / /rang gi bde ba rtag tu ni/ /cho ga shes pas dbul bar bya/ /gzhan du 'grub par byed min rin/nyid/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyisas)/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed/ /ye shes ( nyernams ni ( kun gyi gsang / /sngags kyi dngos grub byed de nyid/ /rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi/ /'chi ba de bzhin 'phrog par byed/ /de bzhin rang gzugs bsams (6)la sogs//bsten dang yon rnams kun dang ldan/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rab sgrub (37pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab sgrub (kyepas rdo rje ye shes sprul pa'o/ /gnas bzhi rnams kyi kun sbyor gyis(9)/ /lha yi sbyor ba mtshungs pa la/ /cho ga shes pas gzung bar bya/ /rig pa 'dzin par de brjod bya / /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /de nyid bya ba dri med bzang / /de yi sngags kyi sku byed 7pa/ /bsdus pa yis 37ni bsgom 3)par bya/ /thun bzhir bsam gtan 'di nyid ni/ /de nyid dam tshig gar mkhan no/ /thams cad du ni rigs dbye ba/ /bsdus pa yis ni bsgom par bya/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rnam bsgoms nas/ /'khor lo de yis nyi rnam bsgom bya/ /rang lag tu ni yang dag bskyed/ /ji srid srog de gtang mi mi bya/ /rdor sems la sogs sgom byed pa / /bsdus pa yis ni rigs gsum du 'ams/ /rdo rje sems dpas 57byin 82wa 210

brlabs zhi)pas/ /sgrub pos rtag tu bsgrub par bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dngos grub thams cad rab sgrub pa'o/ /sngags rnams kun gyi (5tshomanyes pa dang / /dngos grub dam tshig ston pa pol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'byung ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di ston par mdzad do/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor du gsungs pa/ /gang de thams cad nyid bya de(pe/ /shar du rang gi phyag rgya yis/ /mi bskyod pa (5)ni dgod par bya / /lho ru de la cho ga las/ /rin chen 'byung ldan bri bar bya/ /cho ga shes pas nub tu ni/ /'od dpag med ni mnyam par bri/ /cho ga shes pas byang phyogs su/ /don yod grub pa (6mnyam par bri/ /dbus su rtag tu bsdus pa yis / /sangs rgyas slob dpon kun tu bri/ /rtse mo lnga pa'i rdo rje che/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas rnam brgyan pa/ /rnam kun sangs rgyas slob dpon gyis/ /rab tu 'bad pas bsgrub par bya/ /phyag rgya rnams ni thams cad du/ /ut+pal sngon po mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /rtse mo bcu gcig chen po yi/ /rdo rje'i rnam par (7)kun tu bri/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par(8)/ /phyag rgya thams cad kun tu bri / /mkhas pas phyag rgya chen po ni/ /'khor los sgyur 99)ba zhes bshad do/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor grwa rnams su/ /pad+ma dang ni ut+pal bri/ /rin chen bzhi yi kha dog tu/ /de rnams dbus su mnyam par bri/ /'dod pas lha rnams thams cad kyi/ /lha gzhan de ni yang dag 'byung / /sgo ru bdud rtsi 'byung ba dang ske/ /mthun 7pa ru ni mnyam par bri/ /dkar po nag po de bzhin dmar/ /82—211

ser po ljang gu 07nyid dang yang rin / /rtag tu bsam gtan gdan la gnas/ /de la dgod par bya ba yin/ /cho ga shes pas de re rer/ /'joms byed bdag nyid can gyis gzhom/ /de la rtag tu gsang ba'i mchod/ /sgo bzhi ru ni rab tu brtsam / /slob mas ma dang chung ma mchog /sring mo dang ni bu mo bri/ /cho ga shes pas longs spyad da bya/ /dkyil 'khor de yi dbus su ni/ /rgyal byed rgyal ba'i rigs de la/ /phyag rgya dgod par rab tu grags/ /dziḥrdo rje chen po'i rigs mchog la/ / dzāḥyig rnam par /4)rtag tu bya/ /dzaḥphyag na pad+ma'i rigs byung la/ /āḥyig dag 5ni rtag tu bya/ /āḥ'adod pa'i rigs kyi cho ga las/ /ji ltar rig 6pa'i āḥ7yig go/ /āḥ(3/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'byung ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po rdzogs so// //de nas bcom ldan 'das sgrub pa dang nye ba'i sgrub (9༄pa ston par mdzad do/ /nya chang bza' ba'i gsang mchod sogs/ /mngon dgyes gyur nas gang du sems//sems can mi ldan gnas par byed/ /de la dam tshig chen po yi/ /rnal 'byor brtsam par bya ba ste/ /de yi sangs rgyas sogs dngos grub/ /zla ba gcig gis de mthar phyinang/ /ye shes 'khor los nyelhabaskul ba yis/ /de tshe de bzhin 32'grub par 'gyur/ /thog mar zla ba gsum du ni/ /dang po'i rnal 'byor brtsam par bya/ /phyag na rdo rje'i rigs 'byung la/ /'dir ni sngags chen bsgrub par bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ye shes kyi rigs la sogs pa rnams kyis dngos grub kyi dam tshig rin po che 'ching bar byed pa gsungs pa/ rnam par snang mdzad ces gzugs su/ /de ru bdag nyid yang dag bskyed/ /rang sngags tsakre zhes brjod na/ /'khor lo'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /rnam 82—212

par snang mdzad ces bshad par 1)/ /der ni bdag nyid yang dag bskyed/ /rang sngags khasgo (nazhes brjod na/ /ral gri'i rig (5)pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /rang nyid rnam par snang mdzad ces/ /der ni bdag nyid yang dag bskyed/ /rang sngags pasmyu (4)zhes brjod na/ /pad+ma'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /rang nyid rnam par snang mdzad ces/ /der ni bdag nyid yang dag bskyed/ /rang sngags tri shu lo zhes brjod/ /rtse gsum rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /rnam par snang mdzad ces bshad par/ /der ni bdag nyid yang dag bskyed/ /rang sngags brdza 5zhes brjod na/ /rdo rje'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /rang nyid 6rnam par snang mdzad ces/ /der ri7ni bdag nyid yang dag bskyed/ /rang sngags e ku shaṃ byas na/ /lcags kyu zhes par mngon brjod 'gyur/ /rang nyid rnam par snang mdzad ces/ /der ni bdag nyid yang dag bskyed/ /rang sngags pā shaṃ zhes brjod na/ /zhags pa'i rig 8)pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya che sogs mtshan nyid kyis/ /rang gi gzugs ni yang dag bskyed/ /de nyid yid bzhin nor bu mchog /rigs gzhan dbye bas rtogs par bya/ /'di ni dam tshig sgrub 59)thabs te/ /sgrub pa po yis bsgrub par bya/ /skye ba 'dir ni grub par 'gyur/ /rang sngags dril 1 ribu'i tshul gyis ni/ /rang nyid bdag po rang nyid du/ /khru gang tsam du yang dag bskyed/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang mthong mi 'gyur/ /cho ga shes pas gzhi rnams kyi'ang / /de nyid sbyor bas bsgom par bya / /gzugs kyi 11dbus su rnam bsgoms nas/ /myur du 'grub 1 'gyur gzhan du min/ /gzugs su sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyis/ /der ni bdag nyid yang dag bskyed/ /rang sngags ut+pa lo byas nas/ /ye shes rig pa 'dzin par 82—213

'gyur / /zla ba'i dbus nya su rnam bsgoms nas/ /nam mkha'i steng du yang dag brtsam / /snying gar rdo rje yang dag bskyed/ /ye shes rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur / /zla ba'i gzugs ni yang dag bskyed/ /rdo rje rin chen rnam bsgom bya/ /ji srid dag pa'i bdag nyid 'dod/ /de srid mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zla ba'i gzugs su na/yang dag bskyed/ /rdo rje pad+ma lag par dgod/ /pad+ma'i spyan ni bsgom par bya/ /sa bdun gyi ni dbang phyug 'gyur/ /zla ba'i gzugs ni rnam bsgoms nas/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrugs pa'i 'od/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni kun bskyed nas/ /sangs rgyas rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i gzugs su rnam bsgoms nas/ /sangs rgyas lnga ru rnam bsgom bya/ /'od zer ②lnga yis kun bkang nas/ /sangs rgyas sku dang mtshungs par 'gyur/ / bi sta ra shaḥnyi ma'i gzugs su (4)rnam bsgoms nas/ /las kyi rdo rje snying gar dgod/ /rang gi sngags ni yang dag bskyed/ /rdo rje'i sku dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /zla ba'i gzugs ni rnam bsgoms nas/ /brjo3rta (zhezhes bsgom par bya/ /snying gar rtse mo lnga pa 'am/ /rdo rje'i sku dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /zla ba'i gzugs su rab bsgoms nas/ /rdo rje 'bar bas rnam brgyan pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang gi gzugs/ /sems dpa'i gzugs ni 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zla ba'i gzugs su yang dag bskyed/ /'khor lo 'bar bas rnam brgyan pa/ /rang gi gzugs ni sangs rgyas gzugs/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zla ba'i gzugs ni yang dag bskyed/ /pad+ma 'bar bas rnam brgyan pa/ /rang gi gzugs ni chos kyi gzugs/ /chos kyi gzugs ni 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zla ba'i gzugs ni yang dag bskyed/ /dkar po 'bar bas rnam brgyan pa/ /82—214

'dod pa'i mchod pa rang gi gzugs/ /'dod mchod gzugs ni 'dzin par 'gyur / /dang por yi ge gcig pa sogs/ /rig pa'i rgyal po stobs po che/ /rigs kyi bdag po'i phyag rgya yis/ /rang gi phyag rgya sogs bsgoms pas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ru/ /mchog tu lho)phra ba'i bdag can bya/ /de nyid dam tshig dbus su ni/ /rdo rje'i gzugs ni sgom pa'o/ /nyi ma'i gzugs ni rnam bsgoms nas(kye/ /mu dro3rta rdo ༄zhes sgom pa ni/ /snying gar sngags (4)yig byas nas ni/ /bskyed (snyede 'dir ni the tshom med/ /sngags pas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor can / /bsams nas dbus su gzugs bsgom bya/ /rdo rje'i gzugs ni yang dag bskyed/ /bsam gtan 'byung bas bskyed par 'gyur/ /nye 6)sgrub cho ga byas nas ni/ /dngos grub mchog ni bsgrub par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i cho ga las / /de yis (7)'jig rten gsum sgrub 'gyur/ /dang por rang gnas ri gnas su/ /zla ba drug tu bzlas byas nas/ /sgrub pa po yis rtag tu bsgrub/ /rdo rje sems dpa' lhag par gnas/ /ji ltar klu mo lha'i bu mo/ /mi mo'am yang na lha min mo/ /ji ltar rigs 98)par bkug nas ni/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa yang dag brtsam/ /rnam par dben dang yid 'ong dang / /nags dang dgon pa rnams su yang / /de ru bkug nas nyer longs spyod/ /'dod yon lnga yi mchog rnams kyis(9)/ /ye shes rdo rje rab bskul bas/ /dam tshig mnyan par bya ba yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid kyang / /cho ga shes pas dgug par bya / /rang gi phyag rgya de rnams gzugs/ /rang gi brjod pa de rnams sngags/ /de nyid phyag rgya bcings nas ni/ /rang gi sngags 'di bzlas par bya/ /mtshan mo phyed du ji ltar bya/ /nyi ma'i gung la'ang de bzhin brjod/ /lcags kyu'i snying 82—215

po de nyid kyis/ /de rnams rab tu bsgrub par bya/ /bskal pa bsreg 1)pa ltar bsams nas/ /na rdo rje mtshungs pas/ /snying pos lcags kyu sbyar byas nas / /bkug la dbang du bya ba yin/ /khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed/ /de bzhin nyid du rta mgrin dang / /rdo rje'i 4)dbyug dang bcom ldan 'das/ /'jig rten gsum gyi bdag por brjod/ /khro bo chen po mi g.yo ba/ /khro gnyer can yang gang zhig 'gyur/ /khro bo chen po stobs po che/ /khams gsum pa yang dbang du byed/ /bdud rtsi zhes bya'i khro bo che/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon pa po / /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gnas pa/ /sangs rgyas kyang ni skyod par byed/ /rig ma chen mo dri sogs ni/ /bcas pa'i phyag rdor stobs kyis ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid kyang / /khams gsum pa yang 'bebs par byed/ /pho nya chen po 5)rdor sen mo/ /rab gtum la sogs rdo rje can/ /nam mkha'i khams kun gang ba yi/ /dug ni skad cig las 'joms byed/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad 96skudam tshig thams cad rnam par skrod par byed pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje gshin rje 97rimathar byed ces bya ba'i rdo rje'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /na mo badz+ra dz+nyā nā ya/sa ma ya sa tā ṭ+wāṃ/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ ma tshonam kār+ya tsho'o bhañja bhañja/ sarba birgyu 7da ha da ha/ sarba bi nā ya tsā/ mūrta ḍa 11ka dzī bi tān+ta 1geka ra/ ma hā bi kṛ 1 ta/ rū pi ṇi 7pa tsa pa ca1lha/ sarba du// ma hā ga ṇa pa ti/ ṭī bi tān+ta ka 17ra brnya brnya/ sarba gra 41 / ṣa ḍa mu kha ṣaḍa 12byu dza/ ṣaḍa tsa ra shā19ske/ ru dra 2 /mā na 31ya/ birgyu mā 2na ya/ braṅgā da sdi sarba de bā mā na ya/mā bi 25las lha'i phyobi lasba/ la hu la hu/ maṇ+ḍa lam rkye/ pra be 2 thosha ya/ sa ma ya/82—216

ma nusma ra/ rtsu hūṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs pa tsam la bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po de nyid sna tshogs pa'i gzugs 'dzin par gyur 0stanas/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad kyi rdul phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ma'i tshon/steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du gnas par gyur to/ /rang gi gzugs kyis nam mkha'i khams kun tu bkang nas / ched du brjod pas ched du rjod par (5)mdzad do/ /e ma'o sngags rnams kun gyis ni/ /rdo rje mi phyed bla na med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje gang / /sa yi gong bur 'gyur bar byed/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po ngo bo nyid kyi rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas cardo rje sgyu mar brjod pa zhes bya ba'i sngags 'di ston par mdzad do/ /oṃ badz+ra khu (5)ra bi kṛ tā (6)na na r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam la bcom ldan chos 7)'chang de nyid ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun kun skrag pa'i/ /ched du brjod 'di ched rjod 8)mdzad/ /e ma'o 9sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /rnam kun de nyid ston pa po/ /'joms byed rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bzhag tshepar gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po nam mkha'i khams thams cad kun du snang bar byed pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ sngags chen po 'di ston par byed 11do / /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la ha na da ha pa tsa bi dh+wan ya u tsuṣ+ṭha kro dha rtsu phaṭa/de nas 'di gsungs pa tsam la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang de nyid nam mkha'i khams thams cad kun du snang bar byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor lo'i 'od zer gyis kun du bkang 15nas ched du brjod pas ched du rjod 1582wa 217

par mdzad do/ /e ma'o sngags rnams kun gyis hu)ni/ /sngags kyi tshul gyi bdag nyid nga rin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi (5)sangs rgyas nyid/ /zla ba drug gis thob par 'gyur / /de nas bcom ldan 'das slar yang nam mkha'i khams thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid kyi tshul gsal bar byed pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /na maḥs man+ta ④badzā tsā a tsa la kā na ho ho mo ha ya mo ha ya/ ha sa ha sa/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ā bi sha ā bi sha95 /ma hā ba la 96)man+t+ra (7)tsa la dhu na dhu na/ ti na ti na/ khā da khā da/ bi mā 8ra ya mā ra ya/ duṣ+ṭa na bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa yi/ya/ saṅgā ka ra ka ra/ ki ri ki ri/ ma hā bi ṣa ma badzā sbo tshaṭa ya sbo ṭa ya/sto/ hūm̐ hūm̐ tri ba li ta raṅgā lhonyenarta thegekuḥtsa māṃ ṭ+wāṃ rmā ṭ+wāṃ māṃ lhu/lha/ a tsa la tsa ṭa/ sbo tshaṭa ya sbo chaṭa ya/ hūm̐ a/ sa marnyi ka tāṭa/ ma hā ba la/ sā ta ya/ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ māṃ shudh+yan+tu rtsonyelo ka stu ṣ+pe stun)/brdzu na martson )pra ti ha ta ba le bh+yo dzā la —1ya tāṭa/ a sa ha tsho nyen maḥswā hā/ de nas mngag gzhug gi khro bo 'di gsungs pa tsam la/ bcom ldan 'das gzugs sna tshogs 'chang chen po de nyid thams cad yang dag par bskyed nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po'i dkyil 'khor du ched du brjod pa 'di ched du ci snyerjod jipar mdzad do/ /e mtho rinasngags rnams 9kun gyi rteni/ /de nyid 'byung ba bstan pa nga 8/ /rdo rje mi phyed rang bzhin gyis te/ /ye shes rtog gis skyed so )par byed/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das slar yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kun du skrag par byed pa'i rdo rje byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje chen po khro gnyer can zhes bya ba'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /na mo bha ga ba zhinatri skṛ sa ku kyai snye/ oṃ lha ku ṭaṃ ra 7ta raṅgā badz+ra so ta 82—218

badz+ra ma hā ba la hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas 'di gsungs pa tsam la 'dod chags chen po de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi chos kyis kun du snang ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi ①gnas pa ched du brjod pa 'di ched du rjod 5kyepar mdzad do/ /e ma'o ①sngags rnams kun gyi ni(gel/ /chos kyi 'dod chags kun bsdus pa/ /rdo rje ye shes lta bu ste/ /sngags kyi dngos grub ces bshad (snyedo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das slar yang kun nas phyi spro ba'i rdo rje byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas / rdo rje stobs po che zhes bya ba'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la ha na da ha pa tsa bi dh+wan ya u tsuṣ+ṭha gro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas 'di gsungs pa tsam la bcom ldan 'das (3)gsang ba chen po 'dzin pa rin de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis kladagasungs pa gang yin pa ched du brjod pa 'di ched du rjod 0par mdzad do/ /e ma'o rtsonasngags rnams kun gyi ni/ /rdo rje'i dbye ba bla na med/ /de nyid dam tshig kun du dag /rdo rje yid bzhin nor bur bshad/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das slar yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi phyed pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi rdo rje byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje bdud rtsi thab sbyor du brjod pa zhes bya ba'i sngags chen po 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ kha kha khā nyi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ bharnya bharnya32/ groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍi12/ ha na ha san/ gardza gardza / bi sbo ṭa ya bi sbo ṭa ya/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ pra dzā la pra dzā la/ gra sa gra sa/sarba bi 0bi nā ya ṭ+wāṃ/ bibyā dha re/ ki tshe'i ki sna la dz+wa li ta hu ta ba ha shi ra ma hā / lha ra be ni stoṣa/ saṃ sbyin sbyin/snye/ ma hā badz+ra dhā ra/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ brnya 82—219

brnya / bdag che ge mo'i/ bi nā ya ka hro (1)da /tshoge/ sbo ṭa ya/ garnyarba hro ②da ā ske/ sbo ṭa ya/ nā ga skṛ 5 da yī/ sbo ṭa ya/ yak+ṣa skṛ (6da māṃ/ sbo rdzu steṭa ya/brah+ma rāk+ṣa sa hro 8da yī 9)sbo ṭa ya/ sarba gra ha hro mi )da yī sbo ṭa ya/ sarba dz+wa ra hre da yī 11slo ṭa ya/ sarba tsā kurji 12ka skṛ da māṃ 1 sbo ṭa ya/ rtsu kā re phaṭa phaṭa/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bi kurba bi kurba/ ā bi sha ā bi sha /ma hā badz+ra dha ra dula.ādz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ de nas 'di gsungs pa tsam la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kun du dgyes pa ched du brjod 15pa 'di ched du rjod 17par mdzad do/ /e ma'o (1 sngags rnams kun gyi ni/ /de nyid rdo rje bla na med/ /dam tshig thams cad yang dag 'byung / /de nyid mi phyed kun bsdus pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par dag pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rdo rje bārnya rī 12chen mo 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ e gye hi bha ga ba ti ma hā badz+ra bārnya 19ri tra yā ṇ+ḍaṃ sa no rat+na ṭ+wāṃ tsho 1sa h+ye na/ ā /rgya ā /rgyan / ba la de na rba/ ma he shwa raṃ/ ga ru ḍi/rin bi lha ni/ ku mā raṃ/ brah+ma ṇi/ in+d+ra 7/ tsan+d+ra/ ā di traṃ/ ya me/ ba ru ṇi / ku be raṃ/ dh+ri 7ta rā/ 8/ bi ru bye kai 9/ bi sa 7ru pā k+ṣ-i/ shasku kuṇ+ḍa 1/ di kuṇ+ḍa/ tri maṇ+ḍa na/ go maṇ+ḍar / sna la kuṇ+ḍa rmo )/ ma hā kuṇ+ḍa/ nān+di sheke shwa raṃ/r+bha ri gi tsho rī ṭi/ nā ya kai/ bi nā ya kai/ pā: kai/ lo ha rka/ ṣakhri de khri nye/ko ṭa gi ri 9/ oṃ kā ri/ durgo 8 tshokā t+ya ya tsā/ tsaṇ+ḍa 41tā t+ya g.ya tsā/ ma hā kā t+ya ya tī lha/ e shā nī/ ne+e ri t+yā lha/ kā lī 7/ ma hā kā lī / badz+ra kā lī she/ya sha sri nī 9/ sa kā 6gli5 / gha tra kā 6951/ asne lha/52/ bā ri ya byug )/ ha li kā / birte/ shasti/ 55sha tā ridzik+ṣi/ in+d+ra tsā5 / brah+ma tī/ kau 5 be bī57/ mā ‘ 82wa 220

he shwa 'ilho)/ be+et+ta bīs/ su bha hā ci// tsā mu:(pe/ ro tri(5)/ bā rā tī/ kau be 2(6)/ ye tsā rje(7)/ ma ma ye na/ tiṣ+ṭha (8)rnyi/ tā po)r+sā brta yiyi bla )mi shī rgyu/lha/ grosna grosna/7 tu lu hu lu/ tsu lu tsu lu/ mu lu mu lu/ dha ma dha ma/ raṅga raṅga / pu ra ya pū ra ya/ ā bi sha nya ā bi sha.a /bha ga ba ti/ ma hā badz+ra bārnya cho15ri si d+dha 617/ badz+ra pā ṇita 3/ rādz+nyā pa ya ti/ hrīḥhaḥhaḥhaḥhaḥrgyu phaṭa swā hā/'di gsungs pa tsam la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje chen po'i tshul gyis bskor bar gyur to/ /de ni nya de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 3)kyi rig ma de sgrogs par byed pa 'di ched du brjod pas ched du rjod 3 )par mdzad do/ /e ma'o rdo stesngags rnams kun gyi ni/ /kun gzhi 'bad ( snyepar byed pa bdag /rdo rje rtse can gang 'di dran/ /sangs rgyas la sogs 'bebs par 'gyur rte/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das slar yang zhi ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje sen mo zhes bya ba'i pho nya mo rdo 9chen mo 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ e h+ye hi badz+ra na khi badz+ra mu khi/ ha na ha na/ pa tsa pa tsa/ raṅga raṅga /alpa alpa/ ā bi sha ri ā bi shadzo ji /ha ya spyi bā tsho/ pa ya ti swā hā/ de nas 'di gsungs pa tsam snyel ji srid du dug chen po de rnams thams cad de rab tu bsgoms pas bcom pa bzhin du gyur to/ /de nas rig ma de tsho 6de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la rab tu btud nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du rjod par sha )mdzad do/ /e ma'o sngags rnams kun gyi ni/ /dug rnams thams cad sel ba bdag /pho nya'i mchog gang snyode brten nas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rnam par sbyangs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das slar yang rdo rje gsum mi phyed pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje gzhan gyis mi 82wa 221

thub pa zhes bya ba'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ dzi na ri ṭi ṭaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā / de nas 'di gsungs ①pa tsam la bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po 'di sems can thams cad kyi bde ba'i nor gyis nye bar bkang nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du rjod (kyepar mdzad do/ /e ma'o sngags rnams kun gyi ⑤ni / /bskyed pa yang dag 'byung ba bdag④ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab bsgrub don / /bskal ⑤pa'i rgya mtshor yibadag gnas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das slar yang chos kyi dbyings su spro bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje ral pa gcig ma zhes bya ba'i rig ma'i rgyal po mchog 'di gsungs so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ(pe sarba bit+yā ga ṇi bh+yaḥ o e gye hi bha ga wa ti/ yak+ṣi tī ye/ mā pe ṭi i ṭi pa ṭi dudzo su ra su ra dhisra ma tha ni/ e ka 7dza ṭi ni rak+ta sa hi ta 7de na bi ma bi he tha 8ya ni/ ri bi ti ri ka 8ri/ta yī rmogeri/ ka pā la ts+tsha tra/ pri ye ma hā ka pā li/ ma hā ba la7/ ma hā tsa pa le/ sidhi 'ozhesarba ar+sha/ sā dha ya/ sarba satwa bisna phy-i/pra sha ma ni swā hā/de nas 'di gsungs pa tsam gyis bcom ldan 'das pad+ma 'chang ba de nyid nam mkha'i khams thams cad rnam par spros nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi cod pan du gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di 17ched du rjod du )par mdzad do/ /e ma'o sngags rnams kun gyi ni/ /sngags kyi bdag nyid can 'byung ba/ /rgyal ba kun gyi zhi gang de 7/ /rnam par bsgoms pas mchod par byedas/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo thams cad kun du skrag par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin snyel snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje chen po khro gnyer can 'di gsungs sol/ /oṃ bha ya nā sha ni tā sa ya tā sa 9 steya/ ṣ+ṭṛ du steku ṭi ta ( iṭi be+e ta ṭi shwe te dza ⑦82wa 222

ṭi ni swā hādhi/ de nas 'di gsungs pa tsam la bcom ldan 'das zhi ba 'chang ba de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang dag par mchod nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du rjod ②par mdzad do/ /e ma'o sngags rnams kun gyi ni/ /ṭa (gyigang sangs rgyas yang dag 'byung / /chos kyi yum ni rab bsgrub don/ /'di ni bskyed par gsungs pa yin/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das slar yang ye shes 'du bar byed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ /rang gi rigs kyi snying po 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ ā ro lika /de nas bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad kyi dam tshig (gerdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rigs kyi yum 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ ru ru spru ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sidhi ⑧lo tsa ne 6)sarba an+d+ra sā dha ni swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das slar yang rang gi sku rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ shaṅka ri meshārnyi ka 2re ghu ṭa ghu ṭa yo)lhu ṭi ni ghu ṭi ni/ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ ghu tsaṭi ni rtsu phaṭa swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das ⑩de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes bskyed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rang gi sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ shwe te zhu pāṇ+ḍa ra bā si ⑩ni dza ṭā ma tsoku ṭa dhā skori ṇi swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rig pa'i rgyal po 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ rgyaḥ8de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rig pa'i rgyal po la (chubaka' stsal pa/ oṃ susta ni sum+bha nyunyertsu/ grosna grosna hu)rtsu/ gro ñcā ( )pa ya gro ñcā sanyapa ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho bha ga wī bit+yā zhu rā dza hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das chos rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms 82—223

par zhugs nas sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ a mṛ yo)tod+dha bodha bā (kyeya swā hā/de nas bcom ldan 'das nyon mongs pa 'joms pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ nyon mongs pa za ba'i sngags 'di gsungs so(ge / /oṃ kle shā sa (7ni bi dza ye swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das dam tshig chen po'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas chos kyi 'khor lo'i gtsug tor 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ sbyin sbyin/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ dīp+ta (petsakra 46/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzi brjid kyi mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas gzi brjid ⑦phung po 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ dha ka dha ka /da ra da ra/ bi da ra bi da ra/ tshin+da tshin+dar+shan/ bhin+da rnyin+da/ hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das slar yang 9)rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rgyal ba'i gtsug tor 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ dza yogyi ṣa dz+wa la dz+wa la/ brnya brta1 )/ da ma da ma/ r+ghaṃ hūṃ hūm̐/ ha na nyu)ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/de nas bcom ldan 'das dkar po 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar po 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ ma ma ma ma hūm̐ niḥ12 de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rig ma chen mo'i mchog 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ tā re tuta tā 32re tu re swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nges par sgom nyu )pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ khro bo gzegs ma'i sngags chen po 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ ka ni dhu ni hūṃ phaṭa/ 'jig rten gsum 'gugs par 82—224

byed pa'i sngags shin tu ma rungs pa'i las te ji srid du gdon gzhan 'byung ba gang yin pa de'ang (1)de kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor bsgoms pas las rnam pa gsum byed do/ /mi g.yo zhes bya'i khro bo che/ /gshin rje mthar byed gsum 'byung ba/ /kun nas sangs rgyas zhing rnams su/ /khams gsum pa yang des 'joms byed/ /khro bo chen po rta mgrin dang / /khro gnyer rim par ldan gyur gang 2/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid kyang / /khro bo 'di yis 'joms par byed/ /stobs chen bdud rtsi zhes grags dag /mi shes 'jig cing 'phrog byed pa/ /nam mkha'i khams dang mtshungs pa yang / /the tshom med par 'joms par byed/ /'bum du bzlas pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /kun du son par byed pa yin/ /blo ldan sangs rgyas nyid thob pa'ang / /'gugs par byed par the tshom med/ /khro gnyer rtsa ka ( ṭa rig ma/ /'jigs pa yang ni 'jigs par byed/ /lha min chen po sogs sbyor bas( kyi/ /g.yul du rgyal 5)bar byed pa yin/ /khro bo gzegs (6)ma'i mchog rtser skyes/ /sngags pas 'bum phrag gcig bzlas bya/ /khro ba'i sems kyis sbyar byas na kyi/ /nges par sangs rgyas kyang 'jigs 58)byed/ /lag par de ni yang dag bskyed/ /mi smra der son bsam pa yis9) pha rol dpung ni rengs ri par byed/ /brgya byin gyi yang nyu/the tshom med/ /gzi brjid phung po bzlas nas ni/ /'bum phrag gsum du legs bskor na/ /brgya byin sde yang rengs par byed/ /'ga' zhig min par 'joms par bstan/ /sgrol ma sgrol len yang dag 'byung / /'bar ba'i ye shes dge 'byung ba1 / /'og gi sbyor ba bsgoms pa yis/ /rdo rje'i 1 sde yang rengs par byed/ /de yi snying po'i cimachog skyes gang / /rigs dang rigs dbang rig par byed/ / de dang d+ku82wa 225

yang na 'di nyid du/ /sbyor bar bsams nas bsam gtan gyi0)/ /ting ②'dzin bsgom pas ser po'am/ /gzhan du dmar por nges sbyar bya/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis de skad ces gsungs so/ /sngags thams cad kyi rdo rje 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u bcwa tshogelnga pa rdzogs so// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis sngags thams cad kun las btus pa'i le'u gsungs so/ /zhi ba rgyas pa sogs las la/ /rang gzugs rnam pa bsgom pa yis/ /thugs kur pa)ye shes yang dag 'byung / /cod pan ye shes chos dbang phyug /sangs rgyas gzugs su rnam (5)bsgoms nas/ /rin chen sna tshogs mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /rnal 'byor pas bsdus gong bur bya/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni (6)rnam bsgom bya/ /khro bo rnams kyi ston pa 'di/ /rdo rje 'byung ba sgom byed pa/ /de yis 9)ngo bo rnam bsgoms pas/ /rigs dang rigs su 'di bstan no/ /rigs kyi dbang phyug rnam bsgoms nas/ /kha dog lnga pa legs mdzes par/ /sgom pa'i go 'phang (8)gis bsgom bya/ /slar yang rigs kyi bdag po'i sngags/ /'di nyid bsgom par bya ba ste/ /gtsug tor yang ni rnam bsgom bya/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /dgyes dang mgu bar byed par bshad/ /dngos grub thams cad byed par 'dod/ /rdo rje ye shes sogs rdzogs byed/ /rig dzo9)ma la sogs thams cad kyi'ang / /rig pa'i rgyal po 7rnam 'joms byed/ /pho nya mos kyang thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam sgom pal/ /'dod 'gyur 17sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /rang gzugs rnam pa sgom pas so/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /sngags kyi dam tshig 82—226

'byung ba ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi phan 'dod pas/ /rdo rje dpa' bo'i mchog gis ①gsungs/ /sngags thams cad kun las btus pa'i le'u bcu drug pa rdzogs so// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad skyod par byed pa'i las 'di gsungs so/ /skyod pa (kyel sogs bya ba la/ /sangs rgyas de nyid ye shes can/ /khro bo gsum po bsdus pa yi/ /rdo rje 'byung bas grags pa nyid / /gshin rje gshed ni ye shes rigs/ /bsdus pa'i don la mchog rtser skyes / /khro bo chen po rta mgrin ni/ /chos kyi ye shes rigs su bshad/ /stong phrag gam ni brgya yang rung / /ther 'bum gcig tu bzlas nas ni/ /rang nyid sangs rgyas shes pa yang / /cho ga shes pas skyod par byed/ /thod pa gsum la kun bzhag (kyenas/ /lho yi phyogs kyi dur khrod du/ /'dod pa 'di ni yang dag brtsam / /rdo dang shing gi sbyor ba yis/ /dngos po med pas (peyang dag brtsam/ /rdo dang phub ma yang dag ldan/ /bza' dang gsal byed rnam par spangs/ /khrag dang phabs su yang dag ldan/ /nim pa'i 'dab (sems bza' bya ba ta la'i 'dab ma 4)la bri bya/ /sngags pas 'khrul 'khor smad par bya/ /tsher ma can gyis bris nas ni/ /nim pa'i 'dab ④ma khar bcug nas/ /sbyor ba'i gnas su gzhag ⑧par bya/ /lha chen po yi 'og (9)tu ni/ /dri ma med pa kun gzung 7bya/ /cho ga shes pas lan bdun du/ /mngon par sngags nyunyate yang dag brtsam / /dgra yi sgo 'am yang na grong / /grong khyer ram 7ni kun 'byung ba'i/ /gnas 'di rnams su phung po ni/ /kun nas skyod par byed pa yin/ /snying po de 82—227

la mdor bsdus pas/ /bya ba tsog pu'i stan 1)la 'dug /dri ma med pa'i gzugs byas nas/ /khro bo khro bo'i (namachog 'byung ba/ /yon tan stong phrag kyang bskyed nas/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas kyang thob byed/ /nyi ma bdun nam so sor byas/ /gal te 'ga' zhig mi 'gro na/ /mgo bo tshal pa bdun du 'gas / /mi byed rdo rje rang gis gsungs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad skyod pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa 4)rdzogs so// // de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam par snang mdzad chen po rdo rje sems dpa' mnyes par byed pa pa'i las 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas slob dpon 'dab 6bzang nyid/ /rdo rje'i skyil krung 7)du gnas te/ /bya dka'i tsho8)nye bar longs spyod kyis/ /gang de 'tsho zhing gnas par byed/ /brjod pa'i lhag ma bstan par bshad/ /'gro ba dang ni gar 9)nyid dang / /de bzhin 'bel gtam du mi 'gyur/ /mthon po min nyid slob ma yis/ /chos kyi dus su'ang sdig pa sogs/ /gnas bya gal 1 tshote rmongs pa de/ /mnar med gnas su 'tshed par 'gyur/ /sngags tsam gal te tshangs pa la/ /lag pa gnyis kyis 11yang dag brtsam12 / /ji srid nam mkha' yang dag 'byung / /mnar med gnas su 'tshed par 'gyur/ /bud med gsang min brjod bya min/ /gang zhig la la slob dpon ched/ /bde dang lus sems sdug bsngal ba/ /sbyor ba ji srid 'tsho yi bar / /gal te slob dpon rnams kyi bka'/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis byas gyur na / /de tshe bdag la sangs rgyas sogs/ /'grub 'gyur 'dir ni the tshom med/ /de la ji srid 'tsho yi bar/ /brda 1nyayis kun du gnas par bya1 / /dku ru 82wa 228

brten ①pa'i lag pa sogs/ /ji srid 'tsho bar ( mi bya'o/ /dngos grub 'bras bu don gnyer bas9kye/ /slob dpon ming nas smos mi bya/ /ji srid nam mkha' yang dag 'byung / /mnar med dmyal bar 'tshed par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ji lta ba de bzhin du bya'o zhes so/ /bza' ba la yang rang slob shes/ /sangs rgyas gzugs su rnam bsgom bya/ /de yi ming gi yi ge gang / /ji srid 'tsho bar brjod mi bya/ /sangs rgyas grangs med bsad byas (4na/ /sdig pa 'di ni khyad par 'phags/ /gang tshe kha cig yon tan 'dis/ /bstod na bsod nams yang dag 'byung / /de tshe slob dpon rtog med pas/ /gzhan du gal te rmongs pa bdag(den /de tshe ngu 'bod ngu 'tshed 'gyur/ /gang tshe de be mā pā nyi(6no/ /gus pas nyan sogs bsnyen pa gang / /de tshe slob ma sngags zhu dang / /ji ltar kha cig slob dpon rnams/ /bde ba dngos su mthong bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig la la slob dpon rnams/ /bdag nyid thig nag 'tshod cing 'tshed/ /de dag ngu 'bod ngu 'tshed 'gyur/ /slob dpon gang zhig 75tshol byed pa/ /de ni de la dbul bar bya/ /gzhan du dngos grub med pa nyid/ /na slob ma'i ma brtag 79༄slob dpon gyi/ /chung ma'i don du bsgrub par bya/ /yang na sring mo de byin nas/ /'grub 'gyur 'dir ni the tshom med/ /slob dpon gang zhig slob ma'i phyir/ /phyag 'tshal ba ni bsgrub par bya/ /bskal pa drug cur 7de dmyal ba'i / /sdug bsngal myong bar 'tshed par 'gyur/ /de ltar yon tan khyad 'phags kyi/ /zla ba drug gis 11rab gsal bya/ /gal te gzhan du bdag rmongs na / /mnar med lta bur 'tshed par 'gyur/ /gang nyid slob dpon tshol byed pa / /de nyid so sor bsgrub par bya/ /rdo rje ye shes rab bskul bas/ /dngos 82wa 229

grub yangs par der 1'gro 'gyur/ /yon tan 'di rnams gang gis 'gas(mi/ /bsod nams 'byung bar shes par bya/ /slob dpon 'di yi rgyud la sogs/ /de lta bu sogs gsal bya min/ /de ltar bdag nyid dag pa thob/ /chos kyi de nyid cho gas gnas/ /de yis /slob dpon rab gsal 0bya/ /myur du 'grub 'gyur gzhan du min/ /sangs rgyas gnas la gnas pa yis/ /gang de mgu nas rdor 5sems mchog /myur du 'grub byed gzhan du min/ / sangs rgyas (6)sangs rgyas nyid thob rdo pa/ /de mgu byed pa mchog 'byung 'gyur/ /de yis 'jig rten gsum 'grub ste/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rang nyid kyang (nan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba rdo rje sems dpa' mnyes par byed pa'i le'u ste bcwa (7brgyad pa rdzogs so// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen pos sngags thams cad kyi le'u gsungs so/ /skyed 7mos tshal dang rnam par dben/ /chu klung rab tu 'bab pa dang / /ri dang rnam par bkra ba ru/ /sgrub pa'i go 'phang gis bsgrub bya / /zla ba gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur/ /gal te min na de 'grub min/ /dben dang gzhan pa'i yul rnams su/ /sems ni gang du rab dgyes byed/ /gsang sngags 'bar bas byin brlabs pa/ /de la sangs rgyas nyid 'grub 'gyur//rgya mtsho dang ni chu klung che/ /ri bo chen po'i 1lhartse rnams su/ /yan lag tha dad min sngags bzlas/ /nges par zla bas 'grub par byed/ /ske tshe dug dang yang dag 12ldan/ /tig 1 ta'i shing gi sbyin sreg nya gis/ /bsnyen pa sogs ni de bskyed nas/ /gsang sngags sgrub pa kun spyad bya/ /de la sdom pa bzung nyusnyenas 82wa 230

ni / /nges par 'grub byed gzhan du min/ /gsang sngags cho ga kun thob nas/ /sngags pas bsnyen pa 0 'grub par byed/ /de phyir sngags pas khyad par gyi/ /sdom pa so sor bsgrub par bya/ /gang nyid sdom par yang dag brjod/ /de nyid brtul 9bzhugs can gyis bsrung / /gzhan du nam mkha' (0ji srid par/ /mnar med dmyal bar kun tu 'byung / /ji srid 'tsho bar cho ga (debazhin/ /slob dpon sdom pa srung ba la/ /de yis (5risangs rgyas nyid du 'grub/ /sna tshogs 'dzin pa kun gzhi yi/ /mnyam med gsang sngags bzlas nas ni/ /sgrub (6pa'i bdag nyid can gyis bsgrub(7/ /zla ba gcig gis 'jig rten gsum/ /de yis (kye'agrub 'gyur the tshom med/ /rnam shes las kyang byung ba'i sngags/ /'bum phrag drug tu bzlas nas kyang / /rdo rje sems dpar 994)phyag byas nas/ /zla ba nya la de 'grub 'gyur/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i rab dbye bas/ /nges par sangs rgyas kyang thob byed/ /phyag rgya'i dbye ba rab bkod 51 )pa nges par lha rnams spyan drangs med/ /ngag bdag gang nyid tshol byed pa/ /de nyid rtag tu 'bad 37bya'o/ /mkhas pas rab mchog sangs rgyas la/lha/ /sogs pa'i phyag rgya bcing nyusnyebyas nas/ /de rnams sngags ni bzlas nas ni/ /rtag tu nges par sbyin par bya/ /sngags pas rgyal po'i bu mo gang / /gal te sangs rgyas bu mo'ang rung ske/ /bzung nas nye bar longs spyad bobya/ /ji srid yid ni tshim par 'gyur ni / /dug dang ske (19tshe yang dag ldan/ /yungs kur 1 snatil mar bsres pa dang ske/ /rus pa rdo bar yang dag ldan/ / ma tri traṃ de phye mar byanyu8/ /bshang dang gci ba rab bcug nas/ /brtul 17zhugs can gyi nokhyad par gyis/ /zur gsum mgrin pa'i me la bsreg /nges par myur du 'grub par byed/ /lha tsho 7sbyin 82—231

zhes ni byas nas 1ni/ /gang gis 'di ni rab gsal byed/ /gal te 'dir ni sangs rgyas rung / /gang de thal bar byed par 'gyur/ /mkhas pas mtshan mo phyed la yang nas/ /nyi ma'i 9 gung la sbyin sreg 0bya/ /bskal pa gcig gi bar gyi yang / /sbyin byed gzhan du nam yang min/ /gal te sangs rgyas sam 'ga' zhig /rmongs pa'i sems kyis 'das na ni/ /mgo bo tshal pa bdun du 'gas/ /byang chub sems ni rang 5gis gsungs/ /rengs dang 'bebs pa dang por grags / /gnyis pa sa zhes bya bar brjod/ /gsum pa lha yi mchog yin no/ /bzhi pa 'phags pa'i yul du yang / /phyag na rdo rjer grags pa yin/ /snying po kun gyi sbyor ba yis/ /bya ba myur du 'grub par byed/ /reg (6pa sna tshogs sogs dang gnas/ /skyed 7mos tshal dang dga' ston che/ /dkyil 'khor de la bya ba ni/ /bdug pa byin nas yang dag brtsam/ /gal te brgya byin nam tshangs pa / /sangs rgyas sam yang blo gros che/ /cho ga shes pas zhag bdun gyis/ /'joms 'gyur 'dir ni the tshom med/ /cho ga shes pas khrag gis byugs/ /rang nyid rang gi lus su bya/ /skra grol gtsug tor gyur nas ni/ /mi sdug mche (8nagatsigs 'jigs par byed/ /dur khrod khyim du yang dag sbyor/ /rang gis de yi 9ming bri bya/ /stong phrag gcig tu bzlas nas ni/ /nges par sangs rgyas kyang 'dzin byed/ /cho ga shes pas gsher ba'i gos/ /khro 97bo'i sems kyis rab zhugs nas/ /ling ga rkang pas mnan nas ni/ /sangs rgyas kyang ni nges par 'joms / /khyab 'jug lha min la sogs lha/ /rkang par byas nas brtsam 11par bya / /cho ga shes pas nyin bdun gyis/ /khams gsum po yang 'joms par byed/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po sngags thams cad 82wa 232

'chang bas de skad ces gsungs so/ / gsang ba chen po'i (1le'u bcu dgu pa rdzogs so// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen pos sgrub pa rin po thams cad kyi sdom pa'i le'u gsungs so/ /bshang dang gci ba bza' bar bya/ /sems can kun la bde ba sbyin/ /rdo rje 'chang rgyal de nyid ni/ /kun mchog sa yi dbang phyug go/ /rma dgu las ni yang dag byung / /'ga' zhig tu ni bza' bar bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /kun mchog sa yi dbang phyug go/ /'dod chags bza' bar bya ba ni/ /phan dang bde ba thams cad sbyin/ /de ni rdo rje 'chang rgyal po/ /kun mchog sa yi dbang phyug go/ /zhe sdang bza' bar bya ba ni/ /rdo rje ye shes rab rtogs byed/ /de nyid rdo rje 'chang rgyal po/ /kun mchog sa yi dbang phyug go/ /gti mug bza' bar bya ba ni/ /ye shes thams cad rtogs pa po/dkyi/ /de nyid zhi ba 'dzin rgyal po/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad gzhi/ /bde sdug bza' bar bya ba ni/ /slob dpon ji srid 'tsho yi cabar / /de nyid zhi ba 'dzin rgyal po/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad gzhi/ /slob dpon ji srid 'tsho yi bar/ /chos dang chos min bza' bar bya/ /de nyid rdo rje 'chang rgyal po/ /kun mchog de nyid ston pa po/ /ji srid 'tsho bar 'ga' 5zhig tu/ /sems can khams ni bza' bar bya/ /de nyid rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ /kun mchog sa yi dbang phyug go/ /ji srid 'tsho bar smad pa 6yi/ /bya ba thams cad mi bya'o/ /de nyid pad+ma 7'chang rgyal po/ /kun mchog sa yi dbang phyug gom/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 8thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa 82—233

thams cad kyi ye shes kyi chos nyid dang yi ge thos nas ngo mtshar thob nas rdo rje 'chang thams cad la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni ngo mtshar te gang du thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi bdag po de dag gi ming yang shes par bya ba ma yin na/ gzhan lta ci smos zhes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i thugs kur (1)gnas nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngags yid bzhin gyi (7nor bu'i le'u bstan par bgyi'o ri/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ni g.yo bar byed pa zhes bya ba bstan du gsol / de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gnas lngar yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i sngags kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u 'di gsungs so/ /byin rlabs (4)la sogs sngags sogs kyis/ /de nyid sna tshogs rnam bsgom pa/ /cho ga shes pas de steng du/ /yi ge bzhi ni rnam bsgom pa / /bdag nyid dbus su son byas nas/ /rang gi gzugs su gzugs mtshon pa / /rang sems byang chub yang dag 'byung / /cho ga shes pas kun dgang 55)bya/ /de yis sangs rgyas nyid 'grub 'gyur/ /sgom pa 'di nyid rab sgrub byed/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /shel dang zla ba mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ / bzhi lnga'i (6)yi ge rnam bsgoms nas/ /yi ge lnga ni rnam bsgom bya/ /sngags pas lus kyi dbus son par/ /oṃ yig ser po dang mtshungs pa/ /'od zer 7/lnga po kun du 'khrugs/ /der son bdag nyid sngags pas sgom/ /dbus su hūṃ yig yang dag sbyor/ /rang gzugs dge ba 82—234

bsgom par bya/ /'dzam bu nā da mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /gzugs brnyan tshul gyis bskyed nas ni/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /yid du 'ong ba bsgom par gyis/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan de rnams su/ /'od zer lnga ni rnam bsgom bya/ /rnam snang mdzad gzugs 'od zer lho)gyis/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang bar/ /bsams (2)nas cho ga shes pas der/ /bsdus nas de la ltung bar bya/ /zla ba 'char bas mtshan pa yi/ /mnyam med gzugs ni bskyed nas ni/ /gsal ba'i ral pa 'chang zhi ba/ /cod pan lnga ni 'dzin pa po / /sna tshogs 'od zer ①mnyam pa'i 'od/ /sangs rgyas gzugs su rnam bsgoms nas/ /dkyil 'khor du bzhugs (ge)bsams nas ni/ /de yi sngags ni rnam bsgom bya/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni de rnams su/ /rdo rje sems dpa' (5)rnam bsgoms pas/ /gtsug tor de yi 6)bzlas pa bya/ /khro bo gang gzhan 'byung bas kyang / /rigs rnams thams cad nyid kyi yang / /bskyed pa'i cho gar 'gyur ba yin/ /rdo rje gsum kun du 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin rdzogs sol// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje 'chang chen po (7rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin (shegasungs so/ /cho ga shes pas de thams cad/ /oṃ yig dbus su rnam bsgom bya/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas rnam brgyan pa'i/ /hūm̐ yig mthar ni rnam bsgoms nas/ /dbus su rdo rje 'chang bsams nas/ /in+d+ra nī la mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /zhi ba ral pa'i cod pan 'chang / /phyag na rdo rje rnam bsgom bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad rnam bsgoms nas/ /'od zer 9risna tshogs mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /bsams nas de yi thugs ka 7ru/ /zla bar 82—235

sngags kyi yi ge bsgom/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i 1)ting nge 'dzin rdzogs so// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen pos bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ting nge 'dzin 'di gsungs so/ /de bzhin nyid du kun byas nas/ /dbus su haṃ yig sgom pa ni/ /ngos su rang gi gzugs ltar byas/ /rdo rje dmar po rnam bsgom bya/ /dbus su chos 'chang bsams nas ni/ /pad+ma rā ga'i dbang mtshungs pa/ /phyag na pad+ma 'dab gebargyad pa/ /de yi dbus su rnam bsgom pa/ /thugs kur zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /bsams nas sngags ni rnam bsgom bya/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbang phyug gi ting nge 'dzin gyi cho ga rdzogs so// //cho ga shes pas gzugs byas nas/ /ngos su haṃ yig yang dag sbyar/ /dbus su rang gi rnam pa labasgom/ /'dzam bu nā da mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /'dod mchod gzugs ni bskyed par bya/ /lag tu mdung rtse gsum bsgoms nas/ /de yi snying gar dkyil 'khor dgod/ /chos kyi dbang phyug gzugs bsgoms nas/ /phyi 5nas bya ba yang dag brtsam/ /sgron ma 'byung ba zhes bya ba bcom ldan 'das 'dod pa'i mchod pa'i ting nge 'dzin rdzogs so// //yang na brtul zhugs can gyis ni/ /bsdu bas (67sangs rgyas gzugs bsgom bya / /gtsug tor sngags dang khro bo dang / /rig tsho77pa'i rgyal po rigs bcas pas ske/ /las rnams thams cad pa yi sngags/ /go rims 99bzhin du de bzlas bya / /dbus su bdag po bsgoms nas ni/ /ngos su lha rnams dgod par bya/ /snying po sbyor ba de rnams su/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /sngags kyi 82—236

yi ge mchod bsgoms nas/ /de yis lha rnams nyu)rnam bsgom pa/mi/ /thams cad kyi ni lag par ni/ /rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma bsgom/ /mdung dang yid bzhin nor bu yang / /bsgoms nas myur du sgrub par byed/ /sngags pas rang sngags bzlas bya ste/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms (0pa yis/ /ngos su zla ba yang dag sbyor/ /dbus su ser po rnam bsgom bya/ /bsdus te gong bu'i tshul gyis ni//rang gi lus la dgod par bya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab bskul bas/ /'di ni rengs (pepar byed pa'i mchog /dus rnams kun du rnam bsgoms nas/ /nges par bskal par de gnas 'gyur/ /cho ga shes pas mi bskyod sogs/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la dgod bya/ /rigs kyi dbang phyug rnam bsgoms nas/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dgod pa ni/ /thog ma tha mar bsam gtan 'di/ /bzhi yi dbus su bsam par bya/ /de yis 95nyesangs rgyas nyid bsgrubs 6)na/ /yun mi ring bar sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /de yi rang gi sngags kyi mchog /phyag rgya shes nas sgrub pa po/ /cho ga shes pas bskyed par bya/ /myur du 'grub byed gzhan du min / /phyag rgya chen por 57)rab bsgoms nas/ /nam mkha'i lam gyi dbus las ni / /dbus su nyi ma dang mtshungs pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor dge ba bsgom par bya/ /sngags pas dkyil 'khor las ngos su/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /bdag po'i gzugs ni yang dag bskyed/ /de yis mi (rinagayo bsgom par bya/ /rin chen bzhi byung sgo (9)nga ru/ /sbrang rtsi mar gyis rab tu dgang rme dī/ /sngags kyi yi ge rnam bsgoms nas/ /bsam pa de yis sbyin sreg ri11bya/ /dkyil 'khor lnga yi tshul gyis ni/ /dbus su rtsu gi yi ge 'gengs/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'thibs 12pa ni/ /kun nas rnam par 'phro bar byed/ /de la gnas pas 51gelha yi gzugs/ /82wa 237

tshim pa'i dam tshig gsum 'byung bas/ /cho ga shes pas gtsug tor gyis/ /gtsug tor rnams ni bsgom par bya/ /bdag po'i sngags ni yang dag bskyed/ /mnyam par bzhag 0)pas bsgom par bya/ /kun nas sor mo bcu gnyis pa'i/ /ut+pal (2)chen po 'dab /snarabargyad pa/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /de nyid kyis ni bsgom par bshad/ /rtse mo lnga pa'i rdo rje che/ /ut+pal sngon po mtshungs pa'i 'od/ / ā li 50bcu drug yang dag ldan/ /rtag tu bsgom bya 'grub par 'gyur/ /sngags pas sor mo nyi shu pa'i/ /rtse gsum ser po dang mtshungs pa/ /cho ga nyid kyis bsgoms byas na(pe/ /'grub 'gyur 'dir (6)ni the tshom med/ /pad+ma las kyi rdo rje dang / /yid bzhin nor bu gsum pa can/ /bdag po'i sngags ni yang dag bskyed/ /myur du sgrub byed gzhan du min/ /'khor lo de bzhin pad rdo rje/ /bsams nas rdo rje'i cho ga las/ /sgom pa'i go 'phang gis 97bsgrub bya/ /gzhan du 'di ni 'grub mi 'gyur/ /rdo rje chen po mdung sogs bcas/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /kun gyi las can gsang sngags kyi/ /rjod tsho pa rnams kyis ('o brjod byas nas/ /ral gri 'bar bas 'khrugs pa'i sems/ /'phro zhing 'thibs pa kun du 'khrugasabo/ /khru gang tsam du yang dag bskyed/ /khro bar byed pa'i 37khyad par bya/ /pho nya mngag gzhug sogs sngags rnams/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa'o/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sbyor 12ba las/ /sgom pas mchog tu mthong (1gebar 'gyur/ /dbyug pa tho ba dgra sta dang / /zhags pa partsi sa sgom pa'isnyi/ /cho gas bsgom par 15byas nas ni/ /rdo rje 'chang rnams mnyes par byed/ /'di de sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sgom pa ste/ /rdo rje ye shes can gyis 82wa 238

gsang ske/ /ye shes dngos grub can du brjod/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas 0)de skad ces gsungs so/ /gang zhig dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /cho ga shes pas sbyin sreg (0bya/ /de nyid gsang ba'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /rnam pa sna tshogs sbyin sreg ((brtsam/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi yi sbyor ba las/ /rigs kyi las ni sgrub par byed/ /oṃ yig sngags kyi dbye ba yis/ /sgom pas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhi ba can la dkyil 'khor zlum/ /rgyas pa can la zur bzhi pa / /mngon (shespyod la ni gru gsum mchog /dbang bya gzhu yi rnam pa'o/ /zhi la me yi dbus son par/ /bdud rtsi lta bur bsgom par bya/ /de nyid la ni lha yi gzugs / /rang gi tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /bdag nyid bdag po'i tshul gyis ni / /'di ni rdo rje'i tshul las byung / /kha ni rab tu gdangs byas nas/ /me stag 'thibs pas 'khrugs pa yi(ge/ /sngags pas lce yi dbus son par/ /r+ghaṃ yig de yis bsam 6)par bya/ /bcom ldan 'das sbyin sreg (7rdo rjes de skad ces gsungs so/ /cho ga shes pas 'o ma sbrang / /mar ni (na)zhi ba'i rigs la spyad/ /mar khu chen po'i bye brag las/ /ye shes rdo rje'i rigs su brjod/ /zhi la rdo rje slob dpon gyi/ /snying ga'i dbus son rnam bsgom bya/ /yid bzhin nor bu lag (9)bsams nas/ /'di ni dag pa'i tshul mchog go/ /rnam par snang mdzad gzugs brnyan che/ /pad+ma'i yon tan 'byung ba lam/ /gzugs ni 'dod chags rigs mchog go/lha/ /gzugs ni 'dod mchod rdo rje can/ /las bzhi'i rab tu dbye ba las/ /sngags kyi yi ge dgod byas nas/ /bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i sbyin sreg rtse rdo rje 'chang chen pos de skad ces gsungs so/ /gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po chen por de 82—239

bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngags yid bzhin (3)nor bu'i le'u ste nyi shu pa (9rdzogs so// //de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi stobs kyi sngags kun las btus pa zhes bya ba'i snying po'i le'u 'di rin)gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje chos chen po/ /'dod pa'i dam tshig dgyes pa po(ge/ /sngags rnams thams cad yang dag dmigs/ /de yi bsam gtan rab bskul bya/ /dam tshig ye shes sangs rgyas kun/ /rigs dmigs dkyil 'khor tshul gyis ni/ /gzugs ni sangs rgyas mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /oṃ yig ye shes dbye ba yis/ /'di ni rdo rje'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /ral pa'i cod pan longs spyod pa/ /kha dog dkar po shin tu mdzes/ /phyag bzhi pa la spyan yangs pa/ /me stag 'thibs ri5pas kun du 'khrugs6/ /rnal 'byor mchod phyir thogs la sogs/ /brgyan cing dkyil 'khor la sogs pa/ /cod pan du ni rdo rje sems/ /mdzes pa'i gzugs ni rgyal ba'i gzhi/ /dbang po gnyis kyi 5kherab sbyor bas/ /'di ni bsam gtan tshul mchog go/ /sku yi rdo rje'i sogs sbyor gyis / /mngon shes lnga yi rab sbyor las/ /rkang gnyis mchog de nyid shes pas/ /thod pa can gyi gtso bor brjod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'di ye shes/ /rigs zhes bya ba'i ting 'dzin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gi de kho na nyid byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rdo rje thams cad kyi dam tshig gi snying po 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba 'di gsungs so/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor tshul gyis ni/ /dbus su gzugs 82—240

ni rab brtag bya/ /nag po shin tu rnam 'gyur khros3)/ /ma rungs zhal ni rnam par gdangs/ /me stag 'thibs po 'bar ba ste/ /'jigs pa yang ni 'jigs par byed/ /phyag bzhi pa ste rab 'bad pas/ /dbang po gnyis kyis rinarab sbyor lasaXsne)ske/ /'di ni rdo rje'i tshul bstan 94pa'o/ /rdo rje thugs sogs yang dag grub//rab tu gnas pas de bsgrub bya/ /'dod chags rdo rje rab bskul bas(5/ /dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /rdo rje dam tshig ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin no(6kyi/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje chos thams cad 'chang ba'i dam tshig byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge ri7)'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas / chos 'chang ba'i dpal zhes bya ba na'adi gsungs so/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor sbyor ba las/ /dbus su gzugs ni rnam bsgom bya/ /dmar po 'dod 9chags 'dzin pa 'bar/ /sna tshogs rgyan 7gyis brgyan pa yi/ /phyag bzhi pa la yid 'ong bar/lha/ /dbang po gnyis kyi rab sbyor bas/ /de 12yi cho ga lha bsgom pa ni / /'di ni 'dod chags tshul bstan pa'o/ /gsung gi rdo rje gtso dngos grub/ /rdo rje chos rab sbyor sogs kyis/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid can gyis sgrub/ /sgom pa yang ni myur 'grub byed/ /chos 'chang ba'i dam tshig gi dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin nomu/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje 15dam tshig gi rdo rje'i 19rigs byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/rdo rje'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'di gsungs so/ /'dod pa'i dkyil 'khor bsam gtan gyis/ /gzugs ni dbus su dgod par byam/ /khyab bdag zhi ba ser po'i mdog /spyan gsum brtul zhugs can gyis bsgom / /kun du dag pa'i shel dang mtshungs/ /me stag tshogs ni 1 kun du 82—241

'khrugasal/ /phyag bzhi par ni cho ga yis/ /bsgom bya myur du 'grub par byed/ /rdo rje'i 1 mthar thug nor dngos grub/ /rab tu gnas pas de bsgrub bya/ /'di de sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /thar pa'i ting 'dzin snying po can/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sgom pa ni/ /rdo rje sems dpas sprul pa yin/ /rdo rje mdung gi dam tshig ces bya 2)ba'i ting nge 'dzin no da/ /ji srid gzugs ni kun sbyor ba/ /de la lha nyid rab tu grags/ /slar yang 'di yi tshul gyis ni/ /skyed (4)par byed pa'i cho gar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas de skad ces gsungs so/ /rang gi sngags yig dbye bas sam/ /yang na rigs kyi rig pa yis / /rigs kyi bdag po'i sngags kyis sam/ /brtul zhugs can gyi rig 5de rgyal pos/ /thams cad las can sngags kyis dang / /gtsug tor sngags kyis rnam bsgom bya/ /'di de sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba'i de nyid gsungs pa yin/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes de skad ces gsungs so/ /zhi ba'i las kyi rab dbye bas/ /rigs kyi sngags su rab tu grags/ /rgyas pa can la rigs kyi sngags/ /sgom pas nges par 'grub par byed/ /dbang du bya ba'i cho ga las/ /rig (6)pa'i rgyal pos bsgom par bya/ /thams cad las can sngags kyis ni/ /mngon spyod rnam par sgom par byed/ /skyod par byed pa'i cho ga las tsho/ /gtsug tor du ni rnam bsgom bya/ /sngags shes pas ni phur gdab sogs / /pho nya pho nya mo bsam bya/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes de skad ces gsungs so/ /'od zer lnga yi 8tshul gyis ni/ /rtog pas de la bsgom par bya / /gzhan du dngos grub med pa nyid/ /sgom pa rnams su shes par bya/ /rigs kyi las kyi rab dbye bas/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi rnam sgom pa'o/ /82—242

sngags kyi yi ge'i rab dbye bas/ /bsgom bya dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /snying ga'i dbus son phra mo ni/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi rnam bsgom pa/ / sngags kyi yi ge'i rab dbye bas/ /bsgoms pas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /snying ga'i dbus son phra mo ni/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi rnam bsgom pa/ /hurasteng du bkod pa'i dbye ba yis/ /'di ni bsam gtan tshul mchog go/ /dkar nag (yidamar po'i sbyor ba las/ /bsam gtan thams cad du brtag bya/ /gzhan du dngos grub med pa nyid/ /sngags rnams kun tu bzlas par bya sa yig oṃ yig dbye ba yis/ /swā hā hūm̐ yig gzhan gyi gzugs/ /skyed du )pa'i cho ga byas nas ni(pe/ /bsnyen pa gang zhig nges bsgrub bya/ /rigs gsum la yang hūm̐ yig dang / /oṃ yig ye shes rigs mchog yin/ /sngags kyi yi ge la sogs rnams / /dpral (5)bar bkod nas rnam (6)bsgom bya/ //com ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang gis de skad ces gsungs so/ /thun bzhi'i sbyor ba la sogs kyis/ /rdo rje can la bdud rtsi'i gzugs/ /spro ba dang ni gnas par bya/ /'di ni dngos grub tshul bstan pa'o/ /sgrub par (7nyerang gi lha yi gzugs/ /rdo rje can la bdud rtsi'i gzugs/ /nye bar sgrub pa 'dus pa la/ /'di ni dngos grub tshul mchog go/ /bdag gi sgrub pa'i las can la/ /bdag po'i gzugs dang yang dag ldan/ /bsnyen pa'i dus su rab bsgrub pa/ /gtsug tor gzugs dang yang dag ldan/ /me stag 'jibs pas 'khrugs pa yi/ /rang lha'i gzugs dang yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje phra rab dbye ba yis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'o / /grags par ldan pa'i dngos grub kun/ /'di nyid kyis ni byang chub thob / /de yi mchog tu bsgrub par bya/ /dngos grub chen po'i yon tan 'byung //82—243

bcom ldan 'das kun du bzang po rdo rje 'chang chen pos de skad ces gsungs so//gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po chen por sngags thams cad kun las btus pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gcig pa rdzogs so// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad slar yang 'dus par gyur nas phyag na rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i bkod pas yang dag par mchod nas gsung gi rdo rje chos kyi gsung gi lam nges par bskyed pa'i rdo rje'i 0)tshul 'di ston par mdzad do/ /gsang ba dag pa dmigs pa med/ /ye shes yon tan kun gyi gzhi/ /kun nas ye 92)shes bdag med pa/ /gsang ba'i ye shes phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gsang ba'i de nyid don dang ldan/ /mchog gi spyod pa rgya mtsho che/ /kun nas 'dod pa yang dag 'byung / /rdo rje ye shes phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gtso bo'i ye shes ji ltar gnas / /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gnas pa/ /rigs kyi pha rol phyin pa thob/ /byang chub spyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sems can kun skyes can gyi mchog /sangs rgyas tshon byang chub rab gzhug 94)mdzad/ /rang bzhin dag pa dag pa'i mchog /sems can skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chos sku thar pa chen po ste/ /yid bzhin nor bu mthong ba che/ /sems can kun dgyes byed pa po/ /dag pa'i spyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas yang yid bzhin gyi 5nor bu'i dam tshig gi tsho6rdo rje zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' 2phyag na rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' 82—244

de'i mthong ba'i chos kyi yon tan gyi khyad par so sor 'dod par bya ba gang ci ltar lags/ de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos byang chub sems dpa' de la 'di skad ces (1)bka' stsal to/ /the tshom na)med par mnyam par shes/ /sangs rgyas chos su dzodakyi'adod par bya/ /the tshom 4)med par 'du shes pa/ /chos rnams thams cad 'dod par bya/ /the tshom 55 med par 'du shes pa/ /'dus byas thams cad 'dod par bya/ /'di lta ste/ rigs kyi bu zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi sprin gyi sa la rab tu gnas pa ste/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi sku dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sprul pa'i sku rnams su rnam par rtog pa med cing the tshom med pa de bdag go 96zhes chos thams cad kyang nam mkhar mthong bar gyur to/ /rigs kyi bu mdor bsdus na byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje ye shes zhes 7ribarjod par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi skyes bu'i mchog la phyag btsal 98tshonas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sngags kyi spyad pa spyod par byed 9pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'di don dam pa'i gsang ba la dad par ci ltar 'gyur/ 'di lta ste/ yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ces bya ba stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i ri1 tsho'ajig rten gyi khams su sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams su yang dag par byang chub nas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang 17rgya bar ji ltar 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa 512thams cad kyis bka' stsal pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gcig pu mngon 82—245

par rdzogs par 'tshang 0)rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje 'chang bas gsol pa ji ltar mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang (7rgya bar 'gyur/ 'di lta ste gzhan yang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams ①rdul phra rab kyi cha shas ④su gyur pa gzhi'i (5)sems can rnams mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rdzunargya bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad phyag na rdo rje'i tshul 'di 7blta bar bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de rnams ya ⑤mtshan thob cing dga' zhing rab tu mgu ba thob nas de lta bu'i dbyangs 'di gsungs so//e ma'o ye shes ye shes che/ /rdo rje chen po rab tu mthong / /rmad du byung ba'i 'jig rten gyis99)/ /ye shes mig ni rnam sbyangs pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs 0so/ /snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das kyis 1rtagaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pa'i 'od zer 8bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phyung nas shar dang lho la sogs pa'i phyogs mngon par brjod du med pa'i yang nyi brjod du med pa'i gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yi༄rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i sku gsum gyi ye shes kyis skogang bar mdzad do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams byon nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /byang chub rang bzhin yang dag thob/ /byang chub sems dpas snying po byin/ /nam mkha'i khams la longs spyod pa'i/ /rdo rje byang chub rab tu gnas/ /mtshan nyid med pa'i chos rnams la/ /spros pa dag ni yod ma yin/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin ye shes kyis/ /nam mkha' 0lta bur dri ma med/ /ces so/ /de 82—246

nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs nas rdo rje chos la bos par gyur to/ /sems dpa' chen po dam tshig gang yin pa de mthong ngam/bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje skyes bu chen po de'i ①sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi dbye ba rin po che ②sgrom bu nges par rig nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams rang gi thugs su zhugs par mdzad do/ /de ji lta ba bzhin du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chabadag pos rang gi sku dang gsung dang thugs nam mkha' lta bur sbyor bas yang dag par gnas par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs yongs su dag pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi rdo rje zhes bya ④ba'i le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa rdzogs so// //'phags pa gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba (5)zhes bya ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po rdzogs so// //mkhan chen thar pa lo tsā ⑥ba'i phyag dpe'i gseb ⑦nas shog yar lnga byung ba sngar bsgyur ba las/ phyis stong (kyestod smon 'gro'i (7gtsug lag khang nas rgya dpe lhag ma rnams rnyed nas bsgyur bar rtsom pa na/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi mtshul la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob pa'i bla ma yang dag pasayi / dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyi brda tustesprod pa'i tshul la blo gros shin tu byang ba'i 'jig rten gyi mig chos grags dpal bzang po'i bkas bskul zhing sbyin bdag mdzad nas/ bu ston gyis bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong rin chen rgyal mtshan pa'olhonye// //rgyud min rgyud ltar bcos pa yi/ /chos min sun dbyung bya phyir dang / /82—247

dam chos snang ba spel ba'i phyir/ /ji ltar nus bzhin bsgyur ba lags/ /'di don 'byed pa'i 'grel pa dang / /rgya dpe'i dpe dpang ma rnyed 6)cing / /don zab sgra ni rtogs dka' la/ /saṃ skṛ tshon ta la ma byang bas/ /sgra don ji bzhin ma 'byor pa'i/ /nongs de tsho mkhas rnams bzod mdzad cing / /phyis 'byung skad gnyis smra rnams kyis/ /ma dag shes na bcos par zhu/ /rgyud chen 'di ni bsgyur ba las/ /dge ba bdag gis gang thob pa/ /de yis mtha' yas 'gro ba kun / /rdo rje 'chang chen nyid gyur cig/ // 'di dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba gcig tu 'dod pa yang dag par 'khrul par snang ngo / /rgya dpe zubs pa'i bar skabs nas ma tshang ba rnams su sa stong yod pas shes par bya'o// //yang gleng ba/ 'di la bu ston gyis/ dbu nas ma tshang ba rnyed na bsgyur bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa la/ dus phyis jing gir rigs kyi skad rigs smra ba'i lo tsā ba mgon po skyabs kyis/ rgya nag gong ma'i bka' bstan rin po che zhus dag byas pa'i tshe tshang bar rnyed pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chen por snang ba de dpag tshad stong phrag ces pa yan chad / bod skad du bsgyur nas spyir bod kyi bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal thams cad dang bye brag tu sde dge'i par la 'jug rgyur stsal ba'i tshe/ 'gyur byang la 'di ltar snang ste/ de ltar bu ston rin po ches bsab dgos par bka' chems su bzhag pa nas bzung ste lo lnga brgyar nye ba/ chen po ching gur gyi gnam sa'i dbang phyug rabs drug pa bdag nyid chen po gong ma lha skyong rgyal po'i gnam lo dang por/ jing gir rigs las bka' 'gyur khang gi do dam pa bod kyi slob 82—248

ma snyed/ (gyi〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sgri/9kye〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉te/249 3)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bkra shis par gyur cig /'di la dbu nas shog sto gcig ma tshang bas rnyed na bsgyur bar bya'o/ 'di dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba gcig tu 'dong ba yang 'khrul bar snang ngo / /'dis 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po myur du skems par gyur cig/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bkra shes par gyur cig /'di la dgra nas shog sto gcig ma tshang bas rnyed na bsgyur bar bya'o/ /'dis 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po myur du skems par gyur cig /rgyud 'di la kun mkhyen gnyis pa bu ston zhabs kyi 'gyur mi 'dra ba gnyis 'dug pa las/ 'di ni 'gyur bde ba de nyid las bris pa yin la/ rgya dpe zubs pa'i bar skabs nas/ tshigs bcad rkang pa re re gnyis gnyis tsam gyi hor kor/ 〈〈snar 〉〉de ltar bu ston rin po ches bsab dgos par bka' chems su bzhag pa nas bzung sgang lo lnga brgyar nye ba chen po ching gur gyi gnam sa'i dbang byug rabs drug pa/ bdag nyid chen po gong ma lta skyong rgyal po'i gnam yod dper/ jing gir rigs las bka' 'gyur khang gi do dam pa bod kyi slob grwa'i mi bzang mgon po skyabs kyis/ rgya'i bka' 'gyur nang gi rgya gar paṇa chen dan rak+ṣi tas bsgyur ba'i rgyud dpe tshang ma las blangs te ji nus bzhin bod skad du bsgyur nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa badz+ra dhā ra ta la'i bla ma la sogs pa'i bla chen mang por gzigs su phul bar/ tshang mas dgyes pa chen 82wa 262

pos legs so gnang ba la brten nas/ slar gnam lo gnyis pa'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga bzang po'i nyin/ dang stobs kyis mngon par 'phags pa ho shos thob chin dbang dang / ho shos hwa l+ya kha chin dbang gnyis brgyud de gong du zhus pas/ gong nas kyang legs so stsal ba gus pas dang du blangs te bod kyi bka' 'gyur nang kha skongs su tshud par byas so/ /ye dharmā he tu pra bhā wa he turnye ṣān ha thā ga ho h+ya wa daha/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro ṅgā e waṃ bā di ma hā tha ma ṇaḥ/ 〈〈khu 〉〉'di dang thun mong bod skad du bsgyur nas spyir bod kyi bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal thams cad kyi bar la 'jug snangaste/ rgyud dpe'i slar gnam lo gnyis pa'i zla 12tshes 16bzang kha skongs su tshud par byas so/ / 90〈〈zhol 〉〉'dir gleng ba/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas sdom gsum bslab bya thub bstan byi dor du/ des na gsang 'dus gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi rgyud yang dag par rdzogs pa bod du ma 'gyur kyang thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi phyag dpe'i nang nas rgya dpe shog yar 'ga' zhig rnyed pa la brten nas bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas bsgyur ba le'u dang po'i mgo nas cung zad tsam ma tshang ba'i le'u bzhi pa'i mgo yan chad dang le'u tha ma'i mjug cung zad gcig yod de/ rgyud yang dag 'di la le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis las med kyang sngar bod na yongs su grags pa'i gsang 'dus gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi rgyud le'u bdun cu don bdun yod pa dang / de'i rjes su 'brangs nas gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dkyil 'khor la bskal bzang stong du bzhis ma tshang ba bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang dbang bskur dang rdzogs rim kyi rnam gzhag sogs thams cad rdzun ma yin par shes par bya'o/ /bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas kyang khong rang gi de'i 'gyur byang du/ 'di la dum bu las med kyang sngar gyi gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi rgyud du 'dod pa le'u bdun cu don bdun yod pa de rdzun ma yang dag par rtogs pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /des na de dang de la brten pa'i dbang bka' thams cad rdzun ma yin pas rtogs ldan rnams kyis spang bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs kyang / da dung 'ga' zhig de'i cho ga dang dbang bskur byed pa snang ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod pa bya ba'i phyir du blun po nan gyis 'tshang bar byed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi rgyud che bar grags pa le'u don bdun yod pa de ni thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che dang / mkhas grub rin po che rnams gnyis kyis rgyud dzun ma yin par gsungs la/ kun gzigs lnga pa chen po'i gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun du'ang de dang mthun par gsungs pas/ mkhas pa mang du thos pa'i spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyis rgyud rdzun ma nyid du gsungs pa bzhin 'dir yang ma bcug la/ gnyis med rnam rgyal kyi rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa 'di ni rgyud yang dag pa nyid du bzhed cing / bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas bsgyur bar le'u dang po'i dbu nas cung zad tsam ma 'gyur ba sde dge'i par du/ yang gling ba/ 'di la bu ston gyis/ dbu nas ma tshang ba rnyed na bsgyur bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa la/ dus phyis jing gir rigs kyi skad rigs smra ba'i lo tsā ba mgon po skyabs kyis/ rgya nag gong ma'i bka' bstan rin po che'i zhus dag byas pa'i tshe tshang bar rnyed pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chen por snang ba de dpag tshad stong phrag ces pa yan chad/ bod skad du bsgyur nas spyir bod kyi bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal thams cad dang bye brag tu sde dge'i par la 82—263

'jug rgyur stsal ba'i tshe/ 'gyur byang la 'di ltar snang ste/ de ltar bu ston rin po ches bsab dgos par bka' chems su bzhag pa nas bzung ste lo lnga brgyar nye ba/ chen po ching gur gyi gnam sa'i dbang phyug rab sa drug pa bdag nyid chen po gong ma lha skyong rgyal po'i gnam lo dang por/ jing gir rigs las bka' 'gyur khang gi do dam pa bod kyi slob grwa'i ming bzang mgon po skyabs kyis/ rgya'i bka' 'gyur dang gi rgya gar paṇa chen dā na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur ba'i rgyud dpe tshang ma las blangs te ji nus bzhin bod skad du bsgyur nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa badz+ra dha ra ha la'i bla ma'i sku zhabs dang kun nying kun shin lcang skya'i zhal snga la sogs pa'i bla chen mang por gzigs su phul bar/ tshang mas dgyes pa chen pos legs so gnang ba la brten nas/ slar gnam lo gnyis pa'i zla 12tshes 15bzang po'i nyin/ dad stobs kyis mngon par 'phags pa ho shos thob chin dbang dang ho shos hwa l+ya kha chin dbang gnyis brgyud de gong du nus pas/ gong nas kyang legs so stsal ba gus pas dang du blangs te bod kyi bka' 'gyur dang kha skongs su tshud par byas so/ /zhes pa'i khungs bkod nas kha bskangs 'dug pa ltar 'dir yang bskos shing / yang sde dge par ma'i bu ston rin po che'i 'gyur byang du mkhan chen thar pa lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe'i gseb nas rgya dpe shog yar 'ga' shas rnyed pa bsgyur ba las/ phyis nyang stod smon 'gro'i gtsug lag khang nas rgya dpe lhag ma rnams rnyed de bsgyur bar zhes sogs 'gyur byang dang bcas lhag ma tshang bar 'dug pa ltar 'dir yang sde par sor gzhag gis bskos yod kyang / mkhas grub rin po che'i gsung gong du drangs pa ltar bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas bsgyur ba le'u dang po'i dbu nas cung zad tsam ma tshang ba'i le'u bzhi pa'i mgo yan chad dang / le'u tha ma'i mjug cung zad cig yod de zhes dang / bu ston rang gi 'gyur byang drangs par yang / 'di la dum bu las med kyang zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar na/ bar rnams bu ston rin po ches bsgyur bar mdzad pa lta bu zhig gsungs pa bcas 'gyur byang gnyis kyang mi mthun pas zhib tu dpyad dgos par snang mod/ dpe dpang gzhan ma rnyed pas slad mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyad par mdzod cig/ //82—264

thug /dpal de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba rnal 'byor chen po rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba mnyam pa nyid gnyis su med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rdo rje dpal mchog chen po brtag pa dang po'o//hu)༄7na /rgya gar skad du/ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta gu h+ya tan+t+ra yo ga ma hā rā dz+dza tsho dwa ya sa ma tā bi dza ya nā ma badz+ra shrī wa (kyer ma hā /lnga 'di/ bod skad du/dpal de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo kyi gsang ba rnal 'byor chen po rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba mnyam pa nyid gnyis su med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rdo rje dpal mchog chen po brtag pa dang po'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa yi ske/ /dus gcig tshe na bcom ldan 'das/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyil/ /sku dang gsung tsho skudang thugs rdo rje/ /rdo rje btsun mo rnams kyi ni/ /bha ga la ni snyoms par zhugs/ /gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba/ /gsang ba chen po 'di lta ste/ /de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi bdag /gsang ba pa rnams ma lus pa'i/ /sku dang gsung tshon dang thugs rdo rje/ /82wa 266

byang chub sems kyi snying po che/ /chos kun mnyam pa nyid dgongs pa'i/ /mnyam nyid gnyis su med pa'i gnas/ /spyod pa mnyam pa zhes bya ba'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /de nyid ngang la gnas pa yis/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dpag med la/ /gzigs shing mi phyed rdo rje las/ /ma g.yos lham hu)me lhang nger gnas/ /mi 'gyur gsang ba 'dus pa'o/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ /sna tshogs 'khor rnams 'dus pa ste/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug tshogs rnams las/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /kun tu bzang pos gsol ba btab/ /rang gi stan las langs nas ni/ /bla gos phrag par gzar gyur pas/ /pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni/ /thal mo sbyar te spyis btud nas/ /gsang ba zhes ni gang la bya/ /ches gsang ba ni ji (blta bu/ /gsang ba chen po ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsung du gsol/ /de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /'khor rnams kun la rjes brtse bas/ /rdo rje gsang ba kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje'i gsung gis bka' stsal pa/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /chos kyi dbyings ni snang ba che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal yongs su dag /nam mkha'i dbyings bzhin dri ma med/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i dngos bdag nyid/ /dkyil 'khor bsdus dang spros pa'i tshul/ /bskyed dang gnas dang sdud par mdzad/ /nyan thos rang rgyal la sogs las/ /gsang ba bya ba spyod pa ste/ /pha rol phyin pa'i mdo sde las/ /gsang ba rnal 'byor rgyud du grags/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i rim shes pas/ /gsang chen rnal 'byor bla med rgyud/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa/ /stong pa snying rje dbyer med 82—267

phyir / /bde chen byang chub sems mchog gsang / /de nyid dpal ldan 'dus pa ste/ /zab dang rgya che'i snying po (1 nyid/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /gnyis med mnyam pa ro gcig pas/ /phyag rgya chen po'i gnas 'di ni/ /thun mong ma yin rgyal po che/ /dam tshig spyod pa'i gnas 'di yin/ /legs so legs so sems dpa' che/ /kun du bzang po legs par nyon/ /rgyud rnams kun du ma bshad cing / /khyad par dngos grub 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rim pa bla na med pa'i chos/ /snying po khyod la bstan par bya/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ske/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /byang chub sems mchog bla na med / /rang 'byung 92ye shes bde ba'i mchog /'dod chags can gyi skyes bu rnams / /rab tu gdul ba'i don ched du/ /gsang ba'i spyod pa mchog gi chos/ /gzhung nyung rtogs par sla ba'i don/ /'dus pa chen po rdo rje'i tshig /rtogs dka' sangs rgyas spyod yul pas/ /sdom pa gsang ba rgyas gdab phyir/ /dri med ye shes 'byung gnas gter/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag /rdo rje 'chang ba chen po'i yul/ /thabs las ma lus sangs rgyas 'byung / /'di nyid gsang ba'i chos nyid can/ /sku yi gsang ba ma skyes pa/ /sems can lus dang snang ba khyab/ /gsung gi gsang (snyeb ma 'gags pas/ /thams cad sgra dang dbyer mi phyed/ /thugs kyi gsang ba skye ba med/ /phyag rgya chen po lam gyi mchog /'khor 'das chos dang ro gcig pas / /sbas pa gsang ba mi shes rnams/ /lus dang ngag dang sems rnams ni/ /dri mas khebs pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /'gro ba lnga sogs dag tu 'khod/ /gsang ba'i yi ge'i don ma mthong / /ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha 82—268

ḍa snyo ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/① pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha/ ji srid ya ra la ha'i bar/ /ka kha ga mtha' na dzha'i mtha'/ /da dha'i mtha' dang ma mthar bcas/ /de de rtsa ba'i yi ge gsum/ /thog mtha' gsang ba e dang rba / /dus gsum rdo rje'i yi ge'i gnas/ /'byung dang 'byung las lhur sgrar bcas / /'dus pa 'di ni sbas pa'o/ /rnal 'byor rgyud tshul sna tshogs rnams/ /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor nges pa yis/ /du ma nyid du dbang bskur bas/ /thabs dang shes rab spyod pa yi/ /ye shes 'bar ba'i phung po yin/ /thabs dang thabs las byung ba yi/ /khyad par rim pa gang gis ni/ /mdo don mngon par bsdus pa yin/ /a ā/ i khri/ u u/ ṛ rī/ bla lī/ e i/ o au/i aḥ(kye sa ni skye ba med pa'i tshul/ /shes rab pha rol phyin sbyor ba/ /dbyangs 0kyi yi ge tha ma'i bar/ /stong nyid nam mkha'i chos rnams kyis/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab mchog /snying po'i yan lag dag tu bshad/ /thub ④pa chen pos chos phung po/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa las/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i snod yin te/ /de bas 'di ni rgyud kyi rtsa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin las rdo rje sogs/ /rnam pa sna tshogs ston pa ni / /snying po kun las 'di bsdus yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa dpal rnal 'byor chen po'i gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid la gnas pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang dag par 'dus 82—289
