te bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid byang chub kyi sems rdo rje la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog rnams kyis / /nges par bgrod pa'i lam gyur pa/ /rdo rje'i gsung gis bka' stsal don / /bsgrub bya sgrub byed don bshad gsol/ /ces gsol ba btab pas rdo rje 'dzin pa 17chen pos ji lta bar mkhyen cing thugs su chud nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 2chos thams cad kyi sgo la 'jug pa ngo bo nyid med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor 'dus pa de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rang bzhin dag cing bdag med pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings ni spros dang bral/ /sna tshogs sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul ni / /rang 'byung dag par 'char ba yin/ /rnal 'byor rnams la dngos grub kyil/ /'bras bu nyams snang sna tshogs pa'o/ /khams gsum sems can thams cad la/ /las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal 'byung / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi/ /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /phrin las dag pa'i stobs su 'char/ /de nyid gzhan du mi rnyed de/ /shes rgyud gcig gis bsdus pa'i phyir/ /'brel pa can du brjod par bya/ /khyad par chos ni brtag dka' ba'o/ /stong gsum zhing 'di sprul pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor rgya che 'jig rten khams/ /gsal ba dri ma med pa ste/ /dag pa rang 'byung ngo bo nyid/ /sna tshogs chos nyid gcig pa las/ /kun du khyab ④pa dga' ba'i gzugs/ /rang bzhin sangs rgyas rdo rje'i sku/ /spro bsdu'i (ge)sprin gyis kun tu khyab/ /phyogs bcu 'od kyi phreng ba yi/ /snang bas rgyas pa 'phro zhing 'khrugs / /gsal dang gsal min gnyis ldan pa'i/ /rin chen pad+ma'i phreng 82—270

ldan pas/ /phyogs rnams kun du dus gsum gyi/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyod yul che/ /rigs lngar 'byung ba rnams dang ni/ /phyogs kyi dbye bas gnas pa yi / /lha rnams thams cad 'byung ba ni/ /yang dag ting 'dzin dbye ba yis/ /zhe sdang gti mug 'dod chags dang / /yid bzhin nor bu'i dam tshig ste/ /rigs lngar gyur pa 'di dag gis/ /'dod dang thar pa rab bsgrubs 0)pas/ /dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ /dag dang ma dag gyur pa rnams/ /'dir ni rigs la gnas pa ste/ /rags (midang phra ba'i cha brten pas/ /lus sems chos ni rab tu dbye/ /lus ni nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /sems ni sgyu ma'i rnam par 'byung / /ngag ni brag ca (kyelta bu ste/ /dbyer med rdo rje lhan cig skyes / /rten dang brten gepa dbyer med pas/ /thams cad chos nyid sems la gnas / /sems can sangs rgyas gnyis su btags/ /snod bcud snang ba'i yul rnams dang / /brtan g.yo khams gsum rang rig pa/ /srid gsum ma lus chos nyid de'i/ /snang ba gzugs dang sgra la sogs/ /dri dang ro dang reg bya dang / /thams cad chos nyid bag chags 'byung / /rgyu las 'bras bu bskyed pa'i phyir/ /gcig las du ma'i chos kun shar/ /du ma nyid du dmigs med de//thams cad stong phyir ma skyes pa'o/ /de skad ces gsungs pa dang / de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la sogs pa rnams rab tu dga' zhing yi rangs te(5) / bde ba dang yid bde ba bla na med pa thob nas lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs rdo rje la rab tu gnas par gyur nas ched du rjod (6 pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o rang lus sgyu mar grub pa dag /nam mkha' lta bur skye ba 82—271

medarka/ /dbang po'i gzhu dang mtshungs pa nyid/ /stong pa nyid ni rdo rje'i sku/ /lus ni rang bzhin mi dmigs pas/ /dag pa chen po 0)ye shes lus/ /ngag ni brag ca'i 92sgra dang mtshungs/ /brjod pa'i dus na stong pa ste/ /pi wang sgra bzhin rten 'brel gyis/ /rang grag brjod pa tha snyad tsam/ /sems ni rang 'byung dag pa la/ /ye shes chen po rang gnas nyid/ /rgyu rkyen tshogs pa bral ba las / /snang ba tsam du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos chos thams cad la zab pa'i tshul la dmigs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la 3snyoms par zhugs nas/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje bla na med pa'i don bka' stsal pa/ ma skyes mi 'gag rol par gang 'byung ba/ /byang chub sems ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med ston pa'i sku/ /sgyu 'phrul rgyal po bde chen 'di nyid de/ /chos rnams thams cad rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /mtshan ma med cing mi 'gyur 'ja' tshon ltar/ /gnyis med gnyis su med min mnyam pa'i sku/ /shin tu dri med nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid / /hūm̐ badz+ra jika /sgro 5dzi na dzika /ṭ+wāṃ rat+na jika(6 /hrīḥ.a ro lika /khaṃ pradz+nyā sgrika /lo de ṣa ra ti/ mi mo ha ra ti/ paṃ rā ga ra ti/ rta badz+ra ra ti/ya ya mān+ta kṛta / ma pra dz+nyān+ta kṛta9/ ta pad+mān+ta 1 ཿkṛta31/ ka bisnan+ta kṛtari12/rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang / /'khor lo bsnams pa'i 'od 'phro ba/ /dkyil 'khor rdzogs tshul lha rnams kun/ /yab yum bde ba nyid du bzhugs/ /dpal rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa 12mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi snying po gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rdo rje gsum bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //82wa 272

de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku rdo rje dang / gsung rdo rje dang ske/ thugs rdo rje gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ston par mdzad pa'i phyir/gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid kyis chos thams cad las rnam par rtog (shepa med cing rdul (5)med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/'khor 'dus pa rnams la yang dag pa'i snang ba ston par mdzad pa'i phyir 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams mi 'gyur nam mkha' bzhin/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bla ma nyid du ston par mdzad / /sngags kyi spyod pa spyod mchog gis/ /gsang ba'i tshul 'di spyad pa na/ /gang spyod de yis ye shes 'thob/ /tshul 'di shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o/ /mkha' dang mtshungs pa mnyam 'gyur bas/ /rnam par mi rtog ngo bo nyid/ /chos rnams rang bzhin dag pa las/ /yang dag sku rdo ni rab tu 'byung / /oṃ swa bhā ba shud ṅgāḥ(desarba dharmā95)ཿswa bhā ba shud ho3rta kyi / oṃ yo ga shud ṅgāḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud ho3rta(7kyi/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa ko3rtan/ dag pa'i sngags kyi (1)sgra rnams dang / /sngags dang rlung du sbyar ba nyid/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i ye shes lnga/ /chos rnams yi ge stong par brjod/ /rdo rje mi bskyod rgyal mchog ni/ /zhe sdang can gyi gdul bya la/ /rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyis/ /gtum zhing gdug pa thams cad 'dul/ /dkon mchog dpal gyi rgya chen gyis/ /nga rgyal can gyi gdul bya rnams/ /rin chen rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyis/ /ser snas 'jungs pa thams cad btul1 / /tshe dpag med kyis 'od byed kyis/ /'dod chags kyis ni bcings pa rnams/ /pad+ma rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyis/ /82wa 273

sred pa can gyi gdug pa btul/ /thogs med grub pa'i rgyal mtshan 0༄gyis/ /shin tu phrag dog che rnams la/ /las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyis/ /sems can ma rungs las can btul/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor yangs pas ni/ /rmongs 2dang ma rungs mche ba can/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /gti mug mun par tshud rnams btul/ /dkyil 'khor lnga yi sbyor ba yis / /de nyid rigs ni lnga ru bshad kyi/ /shin tu bsdus pa'i sbyor bas ni/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ye shes mchog /khru ni bcu gnyis tshad mnyam pa/ /ngos bzhi dag la mnyam pa yis / /bcu gnyis sa ni mngon rdzogs pas/ /bcu gsum pa la gnas pa yin/ /gsung gi dkyil 'khor bla na med/ /khru ni nyi shu mnyam pa ste/ /ngos re la yang lnga lngar brjod/ /rlung bcu sngags bcur gnas pa ni5/ /blo gros ldan pas shes bya ste/ /de brjod pas ni mchog tu brjod/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor khru bcu drug /ngos rer bzhi bzhir ldan pa las/ /bden pa bcu drug rtogs pa yis/ /ye shes skad cig de snyed do/ /mi bskyod rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / /tshe dpag med pa'i 96)snang ba dang / /rdo rje rtag pa chen po ste/ /bsdus pa sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /lus ngag yid ni rnam dag phyir/ /yang dag don du snang ba'o/ /gcig nas gsum dang rigs lnga ste/ /dgu dang bcu gsum nyi shu lnga/ /sum cu /rtsa gcig bar dag tu/ /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dag tu 'gyur/ /rigs lnga dag las 'byung ba ni/ /de 8/re nyi shur dbye ba yis/ /phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid las/ /nyi shu rtsa lngar yang dag pas/ /dam pa'i rigs ni brgya ru 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs tshogs mtha' yas pas/ /'dus pa chen po 'dir brjod byas/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams shes par gyis/ /de 82—274

bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi ngo bo snying po gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa dpal rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid (1rnam par rgyal ba las gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bla na med par bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /thams cad chos ni ston pa la(5)/ /gsang ba chen po rnam par rgyal/ /rgyud 'di yang dag ston par mdzad/ /rdo rje dam tshig gsum grub mchog /sku gsum rdo rje can du 'gyur/ /phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad kyi/ /yid bzhin nor bu rgya mtshor gyur/ /phung po lnga rnams sangs rgyas sku/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bdag nyid can )/ /sra ba sa yi (pekhams yin tel/ /zhu ba chu yi 2khams su 'dod/ /dro ba me yi 56)khams yin te/ /rgyu ba rlung du rab tu bsgrags/ /mi shigs rdo7)pa ni thig ler gsungs/ /bde ba nam mkha'i khams yin no/ /gzugs ni thogs par bcas (8༄pa ste/ /tshor ba rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /'du shes dmigs par 99dbacas pa ste/ /'du byed lus ngag yid sbyor ba/ /rnam shes sgyu mas don sgrub byed/ /reg pa las ni sa yin te/ /lha mo spyan du shes par bya/ /dro ba me ru rab tu grags/ /gos dkar mor ni shes par bya/ /sdud par byed pa chu yin pas/ /mā ma tī 1 skuyi ngo bor 'gyur/ /'gro ba'i bya ba nyu1bskyod pa rlung / /sgrol ma'i ngo bor brjod par bya/ /thig le snang byed bde skyong ma/ /bde ba rdo rje reg bya ma/ /de nyid bde chen ye shes ni//skad cig tsam du nyams myong bas/ /phral du yid ches byed yin te/ /log rtog ma lus 'joms pa po/ /dngos dang dngos med log rtog dag /bgags 1ge82—275

nas rnam par mi rtog pas/ /bskal pa stong phrag du mar yang / /gnas nas ye shes sbyor bar byed/ /de yang cung zad goms byas pas/ /gong nas gong du khyad par 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / 'khor 'dus pa de dag thams cad la rang bzhin gyis byin gyis brlabs pas yang dag pa'i ye shes khyad par du gyur pa bla na med pa las mngon du gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang /byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis ched du rjod 17pa 'di ched du brjod do//gang dang gang gis 'ching ba rnams/ /de nyid shes pas grol gyur 2te/ /'di la nges par 'khor ba yi/ /rgya mtsho'i nang nas dri med 'thob/ /sems can rnams kyi ye shes kyis/ /rgyud ni nges par grol 'gyur ba/ /khyad par las ni rtogs pas na/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas gnas su 'gro/ /gang du yang dag bla ma yi / /drin gyi ye shes yan lag bdun/ /phra ba'i yon tan mngon du byed/ /sku gsum dbyer med la phyag 'tshal/ /'di ltar gyur pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /tshe 'dir 'bras bu thob pas na/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas pas/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor dbang phyug tshogs/ /ring na bzhugs kyang gzigs 'gyur te/ /don kun sgrub par byed pa'o( ni/ /dga' dang dga' bral dag gi dbus/ /mtshan nyid dmigs pa brtan par gyis/ /thun nam zla phyed zla ba lo/ /bskal par ye shes che la sbyor / /mi rtog pa yi ting 'dzin gyis/ /sgrib pa rang dag lhun gyis zhagrub/ /bde ba chen po mngon byas 6pas/ /stobs sogs yon tan rnams kyis brgyan/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /dngos po thams cad brtag par bya/ /de las byung ba'i thabs bstan pas/ /bde ba'i khyad par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rgyu yi yan lag bdun 'byung ba/ /bla mas brten pa'i 82—276

rten 'brel gyis/ /ye shes dbab pas sbas pa'i tshul/ /ye shes mthong ba lus dang ngag /rtags 'char sgrib pa rang bdag 4)ste/ /byin gyis brlabs las 'char ba yin/ /bla ma slob ma'i khyad par dag /ye shes dbang dang cung zad kyis / /ye shes mthong ba'i spyod yul yin/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i mtshan dpe ni / /blo la gsal bar rang lus la/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan par bzhugs/ /kha sbyar e baṃ rnam pa gnyis/ /thabs dang shes rab rtsa yi gnas/ /bde ba chen po thig le yis/ /'du 'bral med pa'i ye shes can/ /snying rje chen po tshad med bdud rtsi'i rtsan/ /rgyun mi 'chad par bde ba'i byang sems 'bab/ /phrin las stobs ni gzhan don thogs pa med/ /de dag don du yang dag rang bzhin med//stong nyid rtogs pas dngos la chags mi 'gyur/ /'di ni rgyu yi dus zhes bya ba ste / /lam gyi dus ni dbang gi ye shes te/ /mtshan ldan rig )ma yongs su dag pa la/ /sa phyogs gtsang zhing rab tu dben pa 'am/ /rgyal nyid skyes gzhi zhi ba'i gnas rnams su/ /bshang gci chu la 4 sogs pa byug pa 'am/ /rgyal ba mchod phyir rtag par rab tu bya/ /nu ma'i dbus bar spyi gtsug mtha' yi 5bar//cho ga shes pas yang na rkang pa'i bar/ /lte ba rked pa gsang bar rgyal ba'i sras / /rigs lnga rnams ni rab tu dgod par bya/ /rab tu dge ba'i chos ni dri ma med/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes mtshungs med pa/ /thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /bde chen mchog tu dag pa 'dir thob byed/ /'bras bu'i yan lag bdun ni tha mar brjod/ /rang byin brlab pa'i lam gyis gang thob pa/ /mtshungs med 'dren pa bla med ngo bo nyid/ /nus pa brtan dang rdzogs pa mngon gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje gsum pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang / /82—277

gnas ni gnas kyi rnam par bsgom par bya/ /sngags kyi mtshan gyis shin tu mtshan spras pa/ /cho ga 'di yis bsgrub pa nyid du bya/ /'grub 17pa'i 'bras bu nus pa brtan pa yis/ /tshe 'dir skad cig gcig gis rdzogs byang chub/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa dpal rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las phyag rgya chen po sgrub pa'i don bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i bdag po byang chub kyi sems rdo rjes 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams la gzigs nas / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi don gyi phyir yang dag par snang ba'i ye shes rnam par spro ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te gsang ba 'di lta bu gsungs so/ /'khor ba dag la mi gnas pa'i/ /ye shes rdo rje khyod nyon cig /dngos po dngos min dang bral ba/ /dngos po gnyis ka spong ba ni/ /gnyis su med pa'i chos zhes bya/ /dag dang ma dag spang byar med/ /gzugs dang stong pa'i bar du yang / /dbus su mnyam par gnas pa yis2/ /gtsang dang mi gtsang dbus su ni/ /ma 'dres pa de mnyam par sbyor/ /rten dang brten can dbus su ni/ /mnyam pa nyid kyis rgyal ba 'byung / /lus ni mnyam par gnas pa dang / /ngag dang sems kyang mnyam gyur pas/ /mnyam par lta ba mthong ba rnams / /ye shes mnyam par rnam par rgyal ba zhes gsungs so/ /kun du 82—278

bzang po sems dpa' che1tsho/ /ji ltar mnyam par lta ba dang / /gnyis su med pa'i chos dag ni/ /bdag gis ji ltar 'tshal bar bgyi/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /ye shes rang bzhin gnyis med chos/ /du ma ma yin gcig min te/ /gsang ba'i rim pa bla na med/ /dang po las kyi rnal 'byor gyis / /lam gyi rim pa rab sbyor bas/ /cig car 'jug pa phyag rgya che/ /zung du 'jug pa'i rim pa nyid/ /bde ba chen por rtogs par bya/ /chos rnams yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ /ting 'dzin ro mnyam rdo rje yis/ /gsang chen gnyis med rgyal ba 'dir/ /gnas pa rtsa dang g.yo ba rlung / /mi shigs thig le'i ngo bo nyid/ /rang lus rdo rje'i rang bzhin la / /bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyis/ /sa lam rdzogs tshul lugs 'byung dang / /lugs las bzlog pa rim min pas/ /rgyud du sbas pa rnams gsal ba/ /de nyid nges par bstan pa ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la mngon sangs rgyas/ /zhes 5kyigasungs pa dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de dag shin tu rmad du byung ba'i tshul zab mo la ngo mtshar skyes te slar gsol pa/ ye shes thob pa'i lus can dag /tshe 'di nyid du sangs rgyas pa / /'di nyid rnal 'byor ji lta bu/ /mi gtsang lus las ji ltar 'gyur/ /rnam rtog ngan pa'i bag chags kyis/ /dri mas bslad pas 'di ma mchis/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje 'chang gis der bstan pa/ /dri ma bag chags bzlog bya'i phyir/ /lam gnyis rang gi gsang ba'i chos/ /'dir ni rtog pa ngan pa'i tshogs/ /rags 4 pa dang ni phra ba'i chos/ /rnam rtog bag chags nyes pa yis/ /'gro ba gsum po rnam rmongs la / /blo dang ldan pas legs bltas te/ /rnal 'byor rgyud ni 5sbyang bar bya/ /82—279

bla ma'i man ngag lam gyis ni/ /slob ma yongs su smin byas shing / /ye shes rgyud la bskyed pa yis/ /cig 1car rilam gyi stobs kyis ni/ /'dir ni yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /goms pa chung ba'i stobs kyis ni/ /yon tan mthun nacisnang ma gyur te/ /dri nga'i lus ni rgyal ba'i sku/ /sems ni dri med pad+ma la4/ /skyon gyi 'dam pas ma gos so/ /ji ltar 'dam pa'i lus dag las/ /ye shes lus ni rang dgar 'byung / /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor lam/ /rdzogs pas gnas lugs mngon byas te/ /ye shes spyod pas rnam sbyangs pas/ /shin tu dri med dag par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin te/ /thabs kyi myu gu dag gis ni/ /bas 5ka ni rgyas pa bzhin/ /sbrang rtsi bdud rtsi'i gnas yin te / /yon tan dri med de nyid kyi/ /me tog rgyas pa'i chu skyes pa'o/ /rdo rje theg par sbas pa yi/ /rnal 'byor mngon par sangs rgyas pa/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug rtogs pa las/ /spros bral mtha' dang 6bral ba'i chos/ /sgom pa'i lam zhes sa rnams bgrod / /skad cig ye shes 'char tshul lan/ /gom pa 9 goms pa'i lam gyur pas/ /sku bzhi'i go 'phang mngon du byed/ /ces bka' stsal pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang /sa'i snying po dang / phyag na rdo rje dang / nam mkha'i snying po dang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang / spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang / kun du bzang po la sogs pa rnams bde ba dang /yid bde ba dang dang ba khyad par can thob nas stan las langs te/ phyag dang bskor ba du ma byas te ched du rjod 1 pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o rang 'byung rgyal ba'i gzhi/ /rdo rje theg pa gsang ba las/ /phyi ma'i dus na gang byung 82wa 280

ba'i / /rnal 'byor pa rnams de bzhin gshegs/ /shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la/ /snyigs ri1ma lnga ldan dus dag tu/ /rdo rje'i theg pa gang 'dzin pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas sras nyid 'gyur/ /rdo rje sku gsung thugs la nges gnas pas/ /byang chub sems mchog rnams la rtag mchod byed/ /zhes gsungs te/ me tog gi char chen po mngon par phab nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la mngon par gtor to/ /rab tu gtor to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa dpal rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las phyag rgya chen po nges par 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /thams cad nam mkha' mi 'gyur chen/ /gsang ba 'dzin pa thams cad la/ /mchog ni ston phyir yang dag bzhugs/ /e ma'o gsang ba'i gnas kyi mchog /e ma'o snying po kun bsdus pa / /e ma'o chos kyi gnas zhi ba/ /e ma'o rdo rje rnam par rgyal/ /ston ku'i canam mkha' 5sprin med pa/ /zla ba'i 'od zer kun gsal ltar/ /gzung 'dzin spangs pa'i ye shes ni/ /bdag gzhan bcas pas 6snang ba'o/ /ston dus sprin med nam mkha' la/ /nyi ma gsal bar shar ba bzhin/ /thabs kyi ye shes gnyis pa ni/ /don dang sems bcas 7 snang bar byed/ /sprin med mkha' dang mun lta bu/ /snang byed ye shes goms byed pas/ /rang rig rtsal las grub pa yi/ /sgyu ma'i lus ni len par byed/ /de yang yid kyi lus ldan pa'i/ /rnal 'byor pa yis khams gsum du/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi don byas nas/ /mthar ni rang gnas 82—281

bde bar 'gro/ /sgyu ma'i lus tsam la brten la/ /ril por 'dzin dang rjes gzhig 1gis/ /dngos po thams cad bcom nas ni/ /de nas dag pa'i ngang du gnas / /thogs pa med pa'i ye shes kyis/ /snang ba thams cad nub byas nas/ /rang 'od rig ma dbyings kyi ngang / /snang ba'i ye shes khyab par 'gyur/ /bdag dang gzhan du rtog pa yi/ /rnam rtog dra 95ba bsal nas ni/ /bdag med dmigs pa med pa ru/ /mnyam nyid ye shes khyab par byed/ /snang ba med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /snang ba tsam yang 'dzin med par/ /yang dang yang du don dam pa'i/ /bden pa mngon du byed pa can/ /'ja' tshon lus kyis 'bad med pa'i/ /'dod pa thams cad nam mkha' las/ /'bad med par ni stsol da'agyur te/ /bdag dang gzhan rnams bde bar 'tsho/ /rdo rje 'od kyi lus bzung nas/ /bdag dang gzhan don sgrub 'gyur la/ /dmigs pa thams cad zad byed pas/ /bgrod 4med gnas su bde bar 'gyur/ /rang 'od ye shes ldan pa'i skur/ /'ja' tshon bzhin du mtha' mi dmigs/ /stong pa gsum la 'das pa po / /thogs med snying rje 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dang po sa ni chu la thim / /chu yang me la thim 'gyur te/ /me ni rlung la thim gyur nas/ /rlung yang rnam par shes la thim/ /rnam shes bzung ba de nyid ni/ /'od gsal bar yang 'jug par 'gyur/ /dang po sgyu ma lta bu la/ /dang po smig rgyu de nyid kyang / /'od zer lnga dang ldan par mthong / /gnyis par zla ba lta bu dang / /gsum par nyi ma lta bu dang / /bzhi par mun pa lta bu la/ /lnga pa sprin med nam mkha' lasal/ /mi rtog mtha' dbus med par 'char/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs la sogs pa'i/ /che ba'i yon tan rnams brgyan pa/ /bden gnyis sbyor ba zung 82—282

'jug sku/ /bde ba chen po des thob 'gyur/ /mkha' 'dra chos sku stong pa lasal/ /rtog med ye shes mkha' 'dra ba/ /tshogs dang smon lam stobs dag gis / /'bar dang bral bar lhun gyis grub/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku lus 1ni / /'bad pa med par sprul pa'i sku/ /mtha' med rdul bral ji bzhin pas/ /sems can don kun sgrub par mdzad/ /gang dag gang gis 'dul gyur pa/ /de de bzhin du so sor snang / /mos pa'i dbang gis tha dad par/ /sems can rnams ni 'dul bar 'gyur/ /lhun grub bde ba chen po'i sku/ /rang snang rig mas nyer brgyan pa'i/ /'og min gnas su dus rtag 2)tu/ /mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar bas bzhugs/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal po ltar/ /'bad med bdag dang gzhan gyi don/ /che ba'i yon tan rnams kyis brgyan/ /bde ba che las de 'byung 'gyur/ /rim pa thams cad kun rdzogs pa 'i/ /mnyam pa nyid du gnas sems kyis/ /khams gsum pa rnams 'jig dbyed pa/ /thams cad nam mkha' bzhin du gnas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa dpal rnal 'byor chen po'i gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las cating nge 'dzin bla na med pa mchog tu bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /byang chub sems kyi rdo rje che/ /dbyer med bde ba ston pa pos/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /mnyam nyid ye shes stong pa yis/ /bdag nyid gzugs ni sbyang bar bya/ /5mnyam nyid gnas pas thams cad du/ /ye shes can gyis sgom gyur pa/ /'jigs pa kun las thar 82—283

bar 'gyur/ /gsang ba'i yi ge bder 1gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang chen ni/ /sems can kun gyi lus la gnas/ /de nyid ye shes snang ba po / /ko ta k+ṣu/ ko ta wa/ ko ta k+ṣu wa dha/ ko ta ba sha /ku ti dha ri/ ko la k+ṣu/ ko la wa/ ko naril lo wa/ ko la wa shu/ ko la tāṣ+ṭha / gnas bcu sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba ni/ /thabs dang lam gyi khyad par sku gsung thugs//lta ba sgrub pa spyod tshul bla na med/ /'bras bu byang chub sems kyi dbang bsgyur bas / /stobs bcu rdzogs pa gang yin rnal 'byor che/ /snying po 'di ni rgyud rnams kun du sbas/ /dngos por 'dzin pa'i sems can rnams/ /dngos po'i rnal 'byor 'jig 'gyur ba'i/ / zla ba'i cadakyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /pad+ma'i gdan dag bsam par bya/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /gsal ba la sogs dkyil 'khor can/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dag /rgyal po rol pas bsam par bya/ /lus dang ngag dang yid rnams la/ /ye shes chen po'i dngos grub gsol/ /'khor lo 'di ltar bsgoms pa yis/ /shes rab 'bar ba'i lus su 'gyur/ /'od zer 'bar ba ma bu 5ru/ /dngos pos dngos po bsgom par bya/ /mchod pa'i mtshan nyid yongs ldan par/ /stong pa nyid du mnyam gnas pas/ /gnyis su med pa rnam rgyal ba/ /lhag pa'i lha ni bskyed bya ste/ /'khor lo 'di ni bsgom par bya/ /mnyam par bzhag nas bsgoms tshopa yis/ /'grub par 'di la the tshom 7med/ /mnyam med sngags ni bzlas nas su/ /sgrub po bdag nyid can gyis bsgrub/ /zla ba gcig grangs sngags kyis ni/ /khams gsum 'grub par the tshom 8med/ /rnam shes las ni sngags 'byung ba/ /mtshan nyid drug ldan bzlas nas kyang / /rdo rje sems 82—284

dpa' phyag byas nas/ /zla ba nya la de 'grub 'gyur/ /de la brtul 1zhugs spyad pa med/ /sngags med bgrang phreng 'dzin pa med/ /gzung dang sbyang ba sna tshogs dag /gcig nas gcig tu ldog 'gyur te/ /ya yi don gyis gang yang rung ske/ /dngos grub 'dod pas bya ba ni/ /ra la sogs pa gsum po nyid/ /rim pas 'gro don la 'jug bya(5/ /me dang rlung dang dbang tshon dang / /chu ste so so'i dkyil 'khor du/ /thun ni phyed phyed dus su ni/ /las ni gnyis gnyis gnas par 'gyur/ /mchod la brtson pas mchod par 'gyur/ /bzlas la brtson pas rnam par dag /me la sbyin sreg 5)brtson pas 'byor/ /bsam gtan brtson pas thar pa thobaca/ /sngags pas de ltar shes nas ni/ /byis pa'i tshul bzhin spyad (5par bya/ /spyod pa'i tshul ni bla 6 med pas/ /yang dag ye shes rgya mtsho 'thob/ /chos kyi rang bzhin dag pa ni/ /rang bzhin dag cing ngo bo med / /dngos po'i rang bzhin gang med de / /byang chub rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstanan ske/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang / /ye shes ldan pas zhus pa'i don / /dam tshig de nyid ston pa po9na/ /thams cad mkhyen pas 'di skad gsungasal/ /sku gsum mi phyed dkyil 'khor du/ /yid 'ong phreng ba kun bsdus pa / /rdo rje'i bzlas pa ye shes che/ /bla na med pa'i thabs mchog las/ /rdo rje sku yi bzlas pa yis/ /sangs rgyas skur ni byin gyis rlob/ /mnyam med ye shes thob pas na/ /rdo rje gsung gis ngag byin rlob/ /nam mkha'i ngang las rang byung ba'i/ /thugs kyi rdo rje sems nyid kyi/ /gnyis med ye shes rtogs gyur pas / /zab dang rgya che'i tshul gnas pa'o/ /'dir ni rtog pa rnam spangs te/ /brtan pa dang 1 tshoni myur 'gro nyid/ /de bzhin khyi dang ba lang 11dang / /srog 82wa 285

song mi ste ba lang 1chen po'i sha /sna tshogs sha yi sbyor ba dang / /khu ba dang ni rak+tar nabacas/ /mi bskyod pa dang snang mdzad dang / /go ro tsa na snying ga (gunas / /gang byung sgri tai ri stobs ldan pa/ /sgo dgu las ni gang byung dang / /srog chags yan lag lus las byung / / rdo rje (5kha sbyar rdzas bcu dang / /rdo rje can gyis myos byed ldan/ /rim par sbyar ba skye bdun sha /gang las rnyed pa stobs mchog las/ /ril bu tsa na ka yi tshad/ /sbyar te zos par gyur na ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rdo rje can kun mnyes par byed/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen rnams/ /thugs rjes dgongs te gzigs 'gyur te/ /gtso bo gzi can mdangs ldan pa/ /'dzam bu'i chu bo 'od 'drar 'gyur / /mi snang ba dang bcud kyis len/ /rkang mgyogs mig sman sa 'og dang ske/ /ral gri ro langs bum pa dag /sbyor ba 'di yis 'grub par gsungs/ /dngos grub kun gsol dam pa yi/ /ye shes rgya mtsho nges 'thob bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa dpal rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa dzimanyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las dngos grub mchog tu bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems rdo rjes chos thams cad zhi ba'i dam tshig gi mchog bla na 7med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te 8cang mi gsung bar bzhugs pa la9/ de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rin chen 'byung gnas dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag 82—286

tu med pa rdo rje dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje gdon mi za ba grub pa nyu)la sogs thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor 'dus pa chen po rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje nyid/ /ye shes snying po nam mkha'i dbyings/ /chos rnams kun gyi snang ba po/ /zab pa dang ni rgya che ba'i / /dkyil 'khor chen po bstan ri du gsol/ /zhes gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das de nyid kyis ye shes kyi snang ba'i tshul las byung ba 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las byung ba ni rdo rje dkyil 'khor ye shes las grub pa kun du snang tsho bar byed pa mtshungs pa med pa'i 'od kyis khyab pa ri bkod pa tshad med pa'i phrin las yon tan thams cad rab tu 'byung ba'i gnas rin po che sna tshogs 'dus pa las rang byung ba/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs rim pa du mas mdzes pa/ rdul med cing rnam par dag pa'i ye shes las byung ba/ sgo phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid can/ pho brang nang du ni dri ma med pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la 55)rdo rje'i ka bas bteg pa/ rdo rje rin po che'i gdung gis bcad pa/ dkyil 'khor nyi shu rtsa lnga rab tu gnas pa/ khyams 6phyi ma'i bar 7du ni dkyil 'khor drug dang / bar chad srung bar byed pa 'byung po kun 'dul dang ske/ ye shes kyi ri 'khor lo 9bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /mtshams bzhir ni 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi'i dkyil 'khor te 1 cibar bar du ni sangs rgyas stong mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul bla na 511med pa 'thob pa'o/ /rin po che sna tshogs du ma'i dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ ye shes lnga'i rtsig pas 'khor yug tu kun du 'khor ba/ sgo bzhi glo ri'abur du snang ba/ phyi nang med par gsal ba/so so'i bye brag gi dkyil 'khor ni rgyas shing yangs la rnga ma dang mda' yab dag 82—287

gis mdzes pa/ 'dod pa'i lha mo rnams 1kyis ni bkra shis pa'i mchod pa dang rol mo sna tshogs kyis khyab par byed par kun du tsho rgyu zhing gar byed pas mchod pa'o / /ri dgas dang / chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang / ba dan dag bsgreng bas mtshan 4pa/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yongs su dag pa'i bdag nyid du snang ba ston par mdzad do/ /'og min bde ba can gyi pho brang dag pa'i spyod yul du gyur pa de nyid du dpal rdo rje 'chang chen pos dkyil 'khor chen po mnyam pa nyid gnyis su med pa rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang rang byung bar gyur to/ /de dag gi ni spyi dang bye brag tu/ /dkyil 'khor sum cu rtsa drug rab tu 'byed/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang / /rnam par snang mdzad rin chen 'od 'phro dang / /'od dpag med pa gdon mi za ba rnams/ /phyogs bzhi dbus dang rnam pa lngar bzhugs so/ /mā ma tī dang spyan ma gos dkar dang / /sgrol ma rnams ni mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /byams pa sa yi snying po shar du ste/ /lhor ni lag na rdo rje mkha' snying po/ /nub tu 'jam dbyangs 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /byang du sgrib pa rnam sel kun du bzang / /mtshams kyi grwar ni gzugs sgra dri ro bzhi/ /phyogs kyi sgo skyong khro rgyal chen po bzhi/ /phyi rol mtshams bzhir mi g.yo mgon po dang / /'dod pa'i rgyal po stobs chen dbyug sngon can/ /steng phyogs gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba dang / /'og phyogs gnod mdzes rgyal po ste/ /lhor ni gsang ba'i bdag po dang / /byang du tshangs pa chen po'o/ /mtshams su 'jig rten skyong rnams ni/ /shar lhor yul 'khor skyong ba la/ /lha chen brgyad kyis bskor ba dang ske/ /lho nub 'phags skyes po la yang / /gza' chen brgyad bcas gnas 82—288

pa'o / /mig mi bzang ni nub byang du/ /klu chen brgyad kyis bskor ba'o/ /byang shar rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /gnod sbyin chen po brgyad ces 1pa'o lha srin sde brgyad yongs kyis ni/ /tshangs pa'i rgyal po yongs su bskor/ /gsang ba'i bdag po chen po la/ /lag na rdo rje drag po'i tshogs/ /brgyad ces 2'jig rten gsum 'dul te/ /'di dag rnam par bshad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas stong phrag gcig ni khyams su bkod pa dag /shar phyogs nyis dbargya bzhi bcu rtsa lnga dang / /mngon dga'i zhing khams shel gyi 'od du 'bar/ /lho phyogs nyis 4brgya bzhi bcu rtsa lnga dang / /rdul dang bral ba bai ḍūr+ya 5yi 'od/ /nub phyogs nyis 6brgya bzhi bcu rtsa lnga po/ /bde ba can zhes pad+ma rā ga'i 'od/ /byang phyogs rnga sgra sgrogs pa gser gyi mdog /nyis brgya bzhi bcu rtsa lngar yod pa dag /nyi shu dag ni rnam pa 7mtshon phyir gnas/ /rim pas phyogs su gnas pa dag /rgyas pa'i dbye bas 'di bzhugs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bla med gzhal yas khang ske/ /rten dang brten 8pa mnyam med chos kyi dbyings/ /dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa rnam gsal ba'i/ /rtsa ba'i lha tshogs rnams dang spros pa dag /'jig rten 'das pa'i sangs rgyas stong bzhugs shing / /'jig rten mgon po lag na rdo rje dang / /tshangs pa mi mjed bdag po la sogs te/ /rgyud 'di la ni smin par byed pa'i dbang / /dkyil 'khor chen po khru ni brgyad cu bar/ /ngos re zhing ni nyi shur mnyam par brjod/ /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sum cu gcig /de dag re re la yang de nyid kyis/ /rim bzhin rnam par 'gyur ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /thub pa'i dbang pos 'dir ni gsal bar bstan/ /lag na rdo rje'i 'khor dang rdo rje yi/ /drag po'i rnam pa khro bo brgyad bkod 982—289

pa'ol/ /rdo rje gtsug tor rdo rje gnod sbyin dang / /rdo rje drag po rdo rje stobs nyid de/ /rdo rje rnon po rdo rje be con rdo rje mche ba'o/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/ /tshangs pa'i rgyal po'i 'khor du bstan pa ni/ / lha yi nyudabang po brgya byin rdo rje can/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po rat+na ku be rasku kyi/ /ljon pa rta mgo gtsug na rin chen bcas/ /thags bzangs 95)ris dang mkha' lding rgyal po dang / /srin po'i rgyal po dri zar bcas pa'o/ /'di dag gsal bar nges par mtshon pa ste/ /snying po bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid de / /cho ga phra mo rim pa ji bzhin du/ /mdo rgyud rtogs pa rnams las (5rnam par rgyal/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa dpal rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las dkyil 'khor chen po gsang bar ston pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o // //de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'dzin pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga la sogs pa de dag thams cad rang gi ba spu'i bu gar thim par mdzad nas / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rnam par rgyal ba 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang gi gzugs rnams bud med kyi gzugs su byin gyis brlabs nas de nyid kyi ba spu'i bu ga rnams las 6)'thon par gyur to/ /de'i phyir btsun mo thams cad kyi ye shes rin po che'i mchod pa 82—290

thams cad bkod pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la yang dag par mchod pa ni nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar bya ste(1kyi/ slar sku rdo rje dang /gsung rdo rje dang / thugs rdo rje rnams la gnas par gyur na/to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes pa'i lha mo de dag bde ba chen po'i kun du spyod pas yang dag par mchod pa byed par gyur pa ni la la ni sangs rgyas spyan lta bu sa'i bdag mo'o/ /la la ni mā ma tī ltar chu'i bdag mo nyid do/ /la la ni gos dkar mo ltar me'i rnam pa'o/ /la la ni dam tshig sgrol ma ste rlung gi khams la kun du spyod do/ /de bzhin du gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang ske/ reg bya rdo rje lta bu ste/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad tu yang dag par mchod pa'i rgyun gyis mchod par byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po du rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la gnas pa 'di thams cad kyi sngags dang / bla na med pa 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo ske/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra sgrika 4no/ swā hā/ rdo rje 'dzin gyi sngags so/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra sparnye 5hūṃ swā hā/ rig ma bla na med pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ āḥdzi na dzika hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥrat+na jika (64 swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.ā 7ro lika hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥpradz+nyā jika 8/hūṃ swā hā/rigs kyi bu tsa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ āḥde ṣa ra ti hūṃ swā hā/oṃ āḥmo ha ra ti hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥrā tshog ra ti hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ra ti hūṃ swā hā / lha mo spyan la sogs pa bzhi'i sngags so/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra rū pe hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra shab nyu14 swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra gan dhe hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra rā se 1 rgyu swā hā/gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa'o/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra mi 1 tri nā tha shri ngaye hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ 82—291

āḥk+ṣi ti gar+sā 3)ya hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra pā ṇa (gele hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.ā kā sha gar+sā ya hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.ār+sā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya (5)rgyu swā hā/ oṃ āḥmadzi shrī ④sgo'i (snyeya tshone)rgyu swā hā/ oṃ āḥsarba ni ba ra ṇa bisko bhi 57)de hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥs man+ta bha dā ya nas swā hā/ sems dpa' chen po rnams so/ /oṃ āḥya 5rimān+ta kṛta 7rgyu phaṭa/oṃ āḥ pradz+nyān+ta kṛta nyu1rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ āḥpad+mān+ta hu kṛta 124 phaṭa/ oṃ āḥbighan+ta (8kṛta 15rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ āḥ.ār+ya a tsa la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥṭak+ki rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥnī la daṇ+ḍa 7rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ āḥm hā ba la hūṃ phaṭa/ /oṃ āḥ.u: nyu tshog tsakra brti hūṃ phaṭa / oṃ āḥs bha rā dza hūṃ phaṭa ces khro bo'i 3)rgyal po bcu'i sngags rab tu gsungs so/ /sngags 'di rnams kyi nus pa ni/ /thogs pa med pa nyid yin te//'byin dang sdud par byed pas na/ /gsang ba'i sngags 'di legs par sbas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa kyi bhā ba ād+ma ko3rta tsho/ gsal ba sems can kun gyi sems/ /zhi ba nyid ni 'od gsal ba/ /dngos po du mas ma gos pa/ /de nyid zhes bya bde ba sgom/ /sangs rgyas sku yi cho ga shes/ /de bzhin nyid du nye bar spyad/ /gzhan du sngags la sogs pa kun/ /dge ba 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang sngags mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin / /thub pa chen po longs spyod rdzogs/ /gsang ba'i dbang ni rab tu gsolam/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /thams cad chos ni ston pa po/ /mchog tu dga' ba bdag med pa/ /rgyal bas sngon dus bstan pa ni/ /sems can mos pa'i don du bshad/ /bya ba spyod pa rnal 'byor mchog /rtog pa'i rnal 'byor gsang mtha' ru/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dbye ba yis/ /ngas ni rim 82wa 292

pa gsum du bshad/ /dman pa mchog dang 'bring rnams te/ /tha ma mos spyod tshul dag tu/ /theg pa chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor / /de nas de bzhin gshegs 1pa thams cad kyi tshul rdo rje chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas thams cad bsdus pa'i tshul gyis gsang ba 'di gsungs so/ /thams cad lus la gnas pa rdo rje'i sku/ /mi chod mi shigs rang byung phra ba'i gnas/ /rtog pa'i rlung tshogs 'byung ba'i ngang du dag /rang rig sems ni gar yang g.yo mi 'gyur/ /rtsa yi 'khor lo bcu la gnas 'gyur gang / /rlung bcu 'od kyi snang pa khyab byed cing ske/ /mi shigs nathig le rab tu dang ba yi/ /bdud rtsi rab rgyas snang ba khyab byed pa'o/ /yi ge sgra yi rnam pa gar yod par/ /dran pa skyed byed srog gi rtsa bar 'gyur/ /kun la khyab byed snying po ye shes rlung / /rten dang brten 5pa mnyam gnas rin chen sems/ /gser dang gser 'od rab 'bar mtha' yas bzhin / /ji ltar rgya mtsho rab dngas 4rgya che la/ /zla zer 'od kyis khyab cing snang ba dang / /nyi shar mdangs kyis snga phyi med par 'byung / /rtog pa med cing mun pa rang sar dag /blo yis snang ba rab tu rgyas par gyur5/ /gang du lus can rnams kyis ni/ /'byung dang byung las gyur pa yi/ /dngos po'i snang ba bcings pas na/ /yid kyis lus ni brtag dka' 6bas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /de nyid shes pa'i dkyil 'khor te/ /'di ni bsgrub pa 7de nyid yin/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur naspyad/ /rnam shes sgyu ma'i ye shes lus / /yongs su rdzogs pa rang byung ba/ /de nyid mi shes byis pa rnams/ /slar yang 'khor ba'i gnas pa'o/ /ji srid 'od gsal gnas kyi nus/ /'byung 82—293

ba thim 'gyur rtog pas stong / /de srid sgyu ma phra ba'i lus/ /rlung dang rnam shes ldan pas ni/ /'byung dang 'jug dang gnas par byed/ /gzugs ni dngos por ma grub pas/ /thogs med rgyu zhing mtshungs par ldan/ /'on kyang byin rlabs 1nus pa dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /btsun mo'i bha ga der mi 'jug /chos dang chos min ldan par 'gro/ /rang lus lus byung ye shes me/ /thams cad kun nas 'bar ba ni/ /me 'od 'bar ba mnyam pa'i 'odarka/ /ye shes 'khor lo bsgoms nas ni/ /'og nas steng du blo yis ni/ /rab tu dmigs pas kha ba 'bab/ /thams cad du ni tshig par bsam/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i ye shes 'od/ /nyon mongs thams cad rab bsreg pa/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'bras bu smin/ /mnyam nyid ye shes bskyed pa ni/ /bdag nyid nam mkha'i ngo bor 'gyur/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dbye ba yis/ /thabs dang thabs ldan byang chub sems/ /du ma nyid du mi dmigs shing / /rnal 'byor dngos po ldog par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor zhes bya rdzogs ldan dus/ /rjes su rnal 'byor gsum ldan te/ /shin tu rnal 'byor gnyis ldan nyid/ /rtsod ldan dus ni rnal 'byor che/ /yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa dang / /rdzus te skyes pa dang po'i mi/ /'od kyi lus tsam 95gnas pa dag / lha yi dbadud rtsi spyod pa'o/ /de dag lus de spangs nas ni/ /shin tu phra ba'i khams zhugs shing / /sgyu ma'i lus su gnas gyur pas/ /srid pa mngon par len par 'dod/ /bag chags dri mas kun bslang ba'i/ /'dod pa log pa mthong ba yis/ /chags pa'i yid kyis lus la 'jug /tshor ba rnam gsum myong ba yin/ /sa zhag ro dang zas gzhan gyis/ /lus nyid carags pa nyer thob pas/ /dang po'i dngos po log 82—294

gyur te/ /bu ga dgu ldan dri nga'i lus/ /nyon mongs kyis ni dkrugs gyur te/ /bsod nams stobs nyams dman sar lhung / /rdzus te skyes dang drod gsher dang ske/ /sgo nga las byung mngal las skyes/ /'di dag rim pa rnal 'byor can/ /snyigs ma'i dus su rab tu 'byung / /ji srid pad+ma'i sems can gyi/ /lus ni shin tu phra ba ste/ /rnam shes lus 1byung sgyu mar gnas/ /rigs dang ldan pas dus gsum shes/ /stobs ldan de la rtog pa yod/ /rang nyid sgyu mar ma shes pas / /dngos 'dzin bdud kyis glags rnyed 'gyur/ /'di dag rgyun las bzlog pa na2/ /srid pa nye bar len mi byed/ /skad cig gsum gyis ye shes thob / /'chi med bde ba'i gnas thob ste/ /dag pa'i skus ni 'gro don 'byung //zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa dpal rnal 'byor chen po'i gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal dba'i rgyud las mchod pa dang gsang sngags mngon par 'byung ba rdo rje sgyu 'phrul ston pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste dgu pa'o // //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i gsang ba chen po'i ye shes bla na med pa'i ngang las rab tu dgyes par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i tshul rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di 82—295

gsungs so/ /dngos po med pas sgom pa med/ /bsgom par bya ba bsgom bya min / /de ltar dngos po 1dngos med pas/ /sgom pa dmigs pa med pa'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mngon par rtogs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /gzung nadang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa/ /chos bdag med pa mnyam nyid pas / /rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 94rdo rje mi bskyod pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mi zad pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs 5te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dngos po 'di dag ma skyes pas/ /chos dang chos nyid med pa ste/ /nam mkha' lta bur bdag med pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan tshopa'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 7mi bskyod pas gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rin chen dpal de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag med pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams thams cad dngos med cing / /chos kyi mtshan nyid rnam par spangs/ /bdag med chos las kun du byung / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 82wa 296

rin chen dpal gyis gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag tu med pa 'od zer 'bar ba rdo rje sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ma skyes pa yi 1chos rnams la/ /ngo bo med de sgom pa'ang med/ /nam mkha' 2gnas su sbyor ba yis/ /de ltar dngos por rab tu grags/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag tu med pas gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa na/rnga sgra'i rgyal po gdon mi za ba 4de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /gdod nas dag pa nam mkha' bzhin/ /byang chub med cing mngon rtogs med/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan 5pa'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa grub pa gdon mi za bas gsungs so/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi btsun mo spyan mas rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad mnyes par byed pa'i dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ srid med mya ngan 'das med pa/ /'di ni rdo rje bde chen po/ /sgom pa med cing bsgom pa'ang med/ /dgos pa mchog tu bsgrubs pas bde/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rdo rje btsun mo mā ma kris sangs rgyas thams cad rjes su mnyes par byed pa'i dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ stong zhing snang med gnas kyi mchog /rmi lam sgyu ma'i rang bzhin can/ /sems kyi rang bzhin sgom pa ste/ /ji srid du yang med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rdo rje btsun mo gos dkar mos sangs rgyas thams cad rjes su chags par byed pa rdo rje zhes bya 82—297

ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ dbyangs dang yi ge 1rnam bral te/ /de ni sems dang thig le min/ /'di ni dam pa'i bde chen te/ /dbri zhing bsnan pa yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rdo rje btsun mo sgrol mas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 2sku gsung thugs mi slu ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan rang bzhin te/ /de bzhin bsgom bya'i dngos gang yang / /stong zhing snang med gnas mchog ste/ /de tshe sdig dang bsod nams dag /ces gsungs so/ /de nas lha mo gzugs rdo rje dam tshig mchog gis mchod pa bla na med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ dper na chu dang zla ba ni/ /bden min brdzun pa'ang ma yin pa / /de bzhin dkyil 'khor 'khor lo 'di/ /dang zhing gsal ba'i rang bzhin no / /zhes gsungs so/ /lha mo sgra rdo rje nam mkha'i 'od kyi sprin rdo rjes tshim par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ stong zhing snang med gnas gyur pa/ /mi lam sgyu ma'i rang bzhin te/ /sems kyi ngo bo sgom pa ste / /ji srid yang dag bdag med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lha mo dri rdo rje rdo nakho na nyid mngon par byang chub pa kun du ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ bde ba chen pos 'gro khyab pa/ /bde ba spangs na rigs capa med/ /bde ba 'bar bas srid pa 'ching / /bde ba sus kyang bzlog mi nus/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lha mo ro rdo rje dam tshig chen pos mchod pa kun du rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ chos rnams bden pa ma yin zhing / /brdzun pa'ang ma yin pa yi don/ /blang dang dor bar byar med pa/ /de nyid ye shes mchog tu bstan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas 82—298

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal ba'i rdo rje spro ba'i sprin bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ bsam gtan med cing dngos po med/ /sngags med lha yang med pa nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang byung ba/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sku rdo rje zhi ba'i dam tshig mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ ye shes lnga yi rab sbyor bas/ /bsod nams med cing sdig pa'ang med/ /byang chub sems 'di bstan pa nyid/ /du ma nyid du mi dmigs so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thugs rdo rje dngos po dang phyadangos po med pa'i dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ sngags med bzlas pa'ang med pa ste/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyis/ /'gro ba gsum kun yod pa ste / /sgom pa med cing mngon rtogs med/ /ces gsungs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje nam mkha'i snying po ting nge 'dzin rdo rje dam tshig la gzigs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la 95)snyoms par zhugs te/kun rdzob tu ni 'jig rten yod/ /dpyad pas 'jig rten gang na'ang med/ /rtag tu 'jig rten ldan par 'jug /dag pa dang ni gnas dag pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gsung rdo rje ye shes mchog rdo rje 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/skye ba med cing dmigs pa med/ /mi phyed nam mkha'i 'byung gnas te/ /zab cing rgya che'i rang bzhin can/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i rdo rje chos thams cad kyi 82—299

tshul gcig pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ /don dam kun rdzob rten 'brel tsam/ /yang dag tu na 1gnas pa med/ /chos rnams dag pa ye shes che/ /gnas med dmigs pa med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po dam tshig rdo rje chos thams cad la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rgyu dang 'bras bu dag pa'i chosal/ /'gro zhing ldog pa'i khyad tshonapar gyis/ /rtog pa yang dag mi dmigs pas / /spros med gos pa med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po chos kyi dbyings thams cad dang dmanyam pa rdo rje mi zad pa sgyu mar rol pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ chos dbyings ye shes khyab pa'i sku/ /rtog pa med cing dri ma med/ /kun du 'byung zhing dus gsum du/ /phra zhing bdag med tshul mchog go/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas khro bo gshin rje gshed5/ /rdo rje 'khor 6lo'i ting nge 'dzin/ /thams cad chos nyid dag pa las/ /mi rtog nam mkha' dri ma med/ /snang ba sna tshogs rang grol ba/ /sems kyi mtshan nyid rtag tu med/ /ces gsungs so/ /gzhan gyis 7mi thub rdo rje yis/ /mngon par byang chub la zhugs te/ /sgyu mar snang ba 8mi lam tshul/ /rtog dang nam mkha' dbyer med mtshan/ /'du 'bral med pa'i ye shes mchog /phyag rgya chen po yang dag pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /khro bo pad+ma'i dam tshig mchog /rin chen 'byung gnas la brten te/ /chags pa med pa'i tshul mchog gis/ /skye med rten 'brel rang dag pa/ /chu rlabs g.yo ba rang bzhin med/ /gnas pa med de ston pa po/ /zhes gsungs so/ /khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa des/ /byin gyis rlob 9pa'i ye shes tshul/ /'gro rtsams byang chub 82—300

sems rang bzhin/ /khams rnams stobs su gyur pa dag /dag pa bde ba'i 'byung gnas te/ /ye shes brten pa de las 'byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo mgon/ /mkha' dbyings ting 'dzin la zhugs te/ /rtog pa thams cad dag pa'i dbyings/ /chos rnams thams cad rkyen la brten/ /rang 'byung 1ye shes thob byed pa/ /gnas pa med pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /khro bo ṭak+ki 5rā dza rgyal/ /bsam gtan rdo rjes brten na9pa nyid/ /yang dag ye shes dga' bas brgyan/ /lus dang lus med brten 4pa med/ /ye shes lus ni 5dri ma med/ /rtog pa med cing 'gag pa med/ /ces gsungs so/ /khro bo rdo rje dbyug pa 'dzin/ /'jigs par mdzad pa khros pa'i sku/ /snying rje chen pos gdug pa 'dul/ /ye shes chen po 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /byams pa'i thugs kyis khyab pa po/ /sems can mgon po dag pa'o56/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gtsug tor dam tshig khro bo ni/ /rig pa'i stobs mchog la gnas pas/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rgyas pa po/ /bstan pa'i don ni thob pa ste/ /nyon mongs zad byed ye shes mchog /gnas pa med pas ston par mdzad/ /ces gsungs so / /rdo rje gnod mdzes khro bo che/ /rab tu 'byung gnas la brten nas/ /yang dag stobs ni dag pa che/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas 'gag pa med/ /rol pa'i sgyu ma ston par byed/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes 7rigasungs so / /rdo rje khro bo stobs po che/ /sku gsum mi phyed la gnas pas/ /rtog pas mi shigs bdud rnams 'joms/ /kun du spyod pa kun du spyad/ /log rtog thams cad gnas su dag /ye shes 'byung gnas chen po'o/ /zhes gsungs so//byang chub kyi sems rab tu brtan pa ye shes kyi rol pa sna tshogs su ston pa rang 82—301

'byung ba'i rgyud rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba 'di nyid gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi snying po gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa dpal rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las gsang ba chen po'i byang chub kyi sems rab tu 'byung ba ston pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang dag par 'dus nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / lha mi rnams dang / rig pa'i rgyal po dang / khro bo'i tshogs thams cad la yang dag par bstod pa/ mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog 3)gi sku/ /rtag pa'i rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /mnyam med dag pa mchog gi mchog /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyal po che/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa thob / /ye shes dag pas yang dag 'byung / /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don grub rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs (2 rdzogs pa/ /gos pa med pa'i ye shes can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ /mo ha ra ti'i sngags las skyes/ /sa yi khams ni rnam dag cing / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yum gyur pa/ /lha mo spyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ṣa ra ti'i sngags las skyesal/ / chu yi khams ni rnam dag pa/ /rdo rje rigs kyi yum gyur cing / / mā 82—302

ma (1)khri la phyag (2)'tshal lo/ /rā 95)ga ra ti'i sngags las byung / / me yi 94)khams ni rnam dag cing / /pad+ma'i rigs kyi yum gyur pa/ /gos dkar lha mo phyag 'tshal lo/ /badz+ra ra ti'i (5)sngags las skyes/ /rlung gi khams ni rnam dag pa/ /las kyi rigs kyi yum gyur pa/ /sna tshogs sgrol ma phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems chen po/ /rtsa rgyus khams ni dag pa'i sku/ /nyon mongs rnam dag byams pa ni/ /rgyal ba'i rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /byeng chub sems dpa' sems chen po/ /mig gi skye mched sbyong mdzad cing / /sa yi snying po de bzhin gshegs/ /sku yi rdo rje phyag 'tshal 56)lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po ni / /rna ba'i skye mched rnam dag pa/ /phyag na rdo rje mthu stobs can/ /thugs kyi rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po ni/ /sna yi skye mched sbyong gyur pa'i/ /nam mkha'i snying po'i mchog gyur pa/ /ting 'dzin rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che(med/ /lce yi skye mched dag byed pa/ /'jig rten dbang phyug bla na med/ /gsung gi rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba che/ /yid kyi skye mched rnam dag cing / /dag pa'i sems mchog 'jam dbyangs sku/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' theg pa che/ /lus kyi skye mched dag pa po/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam sel mdzad/ /dam tshig rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyal dbang po/ /'gro ba'i sems rgyud sbyong mdzad pa/ /kun du bzang po ye shes rol/ /chos dbyings rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rin/gzugs ni yid du 'ong ske/ /snang stong kun du rol pa yis/ /chos rnams sgyu ma'i cho 9)'phrul ston/ /gzugs kyi lha mo phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje'i sgra ni yid du 'ong / /sgra dang sgra min 82wa 303

las grol ba/ /stong nyid rang sgra 'byung ba po/ /sgra yi lha mo phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje'i dri ni yid 'ong mchog /sangs rgyas thugs mchod bde ba che/ /log 1 pa sad 2par byed pa po/ /dri yi lha mo phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje ro ni dga' ba'i skul/ /dri med bdud rtsi 'thob byed cing / /dkyil 'khor ma lus mchod byed pa//ro yi lha mo phyag 'tshal lo/ /ya mān+ta kṛta 5sngags las skyes/ /sku yi gsang ba 4khro bo che/ /dbang po mnan cing shar phyogs bzhugs/ /gshin rje rigashed la phyag 'tshal lo/ / pradz+nyān+ta kṛta 6sngags las skyes/ /thugs las skyes pa'i khro rgyal ni/ /gshin rje mnan cing lho phyogs bzhugs/ /rnam par rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+mān+ta kṛta 7sngags las skyes/ /gsung mchog pad+ma rang 'byung ba/ /chu bdag mnan cing nub phyogs bzhugs/ /gsung mchog rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod / /bisgyun+ta rakṛta /sngags las skyes/ /phrin 9las sna tshogs mdzad pa po/ /gnod sbyin mnan cing byang phyogs bzhugs/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod / /rnam par rtog pas mi g.yo zhing / /ye shes gsang ba'i don ldan pa'i//khro rgyal 1 byin za'i steng bzhugs pa/ /mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtul zhugs chen po mi bzad pas11/ /log 'dren dpung rnams 12'joms mdzad pa/ /khro rgyal bden bral steng na bzhugs/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtum po srid gsum 'joms mdzad cing / /snying rje'i stobs dang ldan pa'i sku/ /rlung bdag steng gnas khro bo che/ /dbyug sngon can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /ye shes mchog gis dbang bskur ba/ /khro rgyal dbang ldan steng bzhugs pa/ /stobs po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dug gsum rtog pa dag byas shing /1na /sna tshogs sgyu mar gar mdzad pa/ /tshangs 82wa 304

pa'i steng bzhugs lha yi gtso/ /'khor los sgyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sku/ /spros med de bzhin nyid las byung / /kā la gro dha gnon mdzad pa/ /khro rgyal gnod mdzes phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems las rang byung ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi de bzhin nyid/ /sgyu ma dag la spros med sku/ /'od gsal bde ba'i bsam gtan nyid/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi//sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya las/ /rlung sngags las byung rang dag cing / /thams cad chos ni yongs rdzogs par/ /snang ba ye shes rang bzhin tshogs/ /spro dang bsdu ba 11nyid gyur pa/ /zung 'jug ting 'dzin la 'jug gang / /dbye bas ye shes dag pa'i gnas/ /mchod pas yang dag thob par 'gyur/ /de nyid bla ma'i sku nyid do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa dpal rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid 2rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las gsang ba chen po rab tu rgyas pa'i mchod cing bstod pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o // //rdo rje mi 'gyur ba zhes bya ba'i brtag pa'i rgyal po dang po rdzogs so // //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs dang yon tan dang phrin 4las kyi bkod pa du mar ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi sems rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu/ de bzhin gshegs pa du 82wa 305

ma'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po gsang ba bla na med pa'i rdo rje mngon par rdzogs pa'i tshul mi zad pa rdo rje 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi don du sems can nam mkha'i mthas klas par gyur pa'i khams brjod du med pa'i gnas kyi chos nyid dang gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid du rab tu ston pa/ rab 'byam tuchos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po tshad dang rgya yongs su chad pa med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas kyi zhing khams/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'gyur ba med par gsang ba'i 'brug sgra sgrogs pa'i spyod yul / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bye ba phrag brgyad cu mngon par bsngags pa dang ske/ rnal 'byor ma skul (5)byed ma dang / 'od zer can dang / ral pa gcig ma dang / ri khrod lo ma can dang / ku ru kul+le dang / rdo rje dbyangs can ma dang / dri ma med pa'i rnam par rgyal ma'i gtsug tor dang / gtsug tor mi zad pa bsngags pa rdo rje dang / gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo can rdo rje la sogs pa ri rab sum cu rtsa drug gi rdul dang mnyam pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams dang lhan cig tu/ gsang ba'i spyod pa rmad du byung ba ye shes bde ba chen po'i rol pa la yongs su spyod de/ de dag kyang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang lhan cig tu bde ba'i ros khyab par byed cing rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag po mchod par byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed khrag khrig phrag 'bum gyi bar gyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i gsang ba 'dus pa dpal mchog chen po snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di rtogs par byed pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa stong byang chub kyi sems rdo rje'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi rtse mo du ma las phyung 94ste/ gsang ba chen po'i chos gnas kyi 82—306

don mngon par brjod pa rgya mtsho dang mtshungs pa ston par byed do(1ri/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa log par dad sel gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ye shes la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams thams cad dmigs med par/ /sgyu ma lta bur bstan pa gang / /gsang ba'i ye shes rang 'byung ba/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gser thub kyis rnam par thar pa'i rdo rje bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /bcings pa med cing grol ba med/ /thams cad rnam par dag pa'i dbyings/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srung gis rin rdo rje mi zad pa byams pa chen po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams rmi lam mtshungs pa las/ /nam mkha' /cilta bur bdag med pas/ /dmigs pa rnams las yongs grol ba/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas sgyu ma lta bu dmigs pa med pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rang bzhin gyis ni dag pa'i bdag /srid gsum mig 'phrul mtshungs med par/ /stong pa nyid ni dag pa'i dngos / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa byams pas gsang ba'i yi ge rnam par dag pa'i 82—307

tshul rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du chos dang chos nyid med/ /thams cad rnam par mi rtog pas/ /brjod pa kun las 'das pa ste/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa seng ges ye shes sdong pos brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'di la rtog par gyur pa med/ /chos rnams thams cad ma skyes pa/ /dngos po nyid du rnam par grol/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rab rtsal gyis dri ma med pa'i snying po rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gsang ba byang chub sems kyi gsang / /chos kun snying po rdo rje'i sku/ /lhun gyis grub pa ye shes dbyings/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa me tog kun nas gsal ba'i snying pos ye shes rdo rje 'bar ba mi zad pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam par mi 'gyur snang ba med/ /dag pa'i ngo bo ro mnyam pa/ /phung po lnga ldan nyid kyi ngang / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa me tog gnyis pa kun du snang ba'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od zer bskul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du rang gi sems rtogs bya/ /de nyid chos kun rtsa ba ste/ /snying po 'di nyid sbas par gnas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /82—308

de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin 1gshegs pa spyan legs snang bas rang nadag par ston pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gsang ba gang 'gyur dbyings nyid la/ /ye shes rgyal ba kun gyi thugs/ /dam pa 'di ni 'dus par gsungs/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'gro ba'i ded dpon rgyal pos 'gro ba sems can thams cad yang dag par sgrol ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ji ltar pad+mo chu klung las/ /rab tu skye ba zil 'phro ba/ /de nyid sdong bu 'dir rtogs bya/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa lag chen rgyal pos 'gro ba thams cad yang dag par da'adul ba'i ting nge 'dzin mi zad pa'i tshul zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mnyam med nam mkha' yangs pa ni/ /kun la gnas shing mi 'gyur ba/ /dri ma med cing 'bar ba'i 'od/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs sol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa stobs mi zad pa'i dpal gyi 4ri rab brtsegs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du mi phyed rdo rje ni/ /stong nyid byang chub sems rdo rje/ /snying rje'i snying po dran par brjod/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rgyu skar rgyal pos dran pa'i snying po rin po che'i snang ba'i 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'dir ni 82wa 309

chos rnams stong pa nyid/ /chu dang zla ba mtshungs pa ste/ /sgyu ma nyid du 'gag med 'char/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rtsi sman mi zad pa'i ye shes stobs kyi rgyal pos phun sum tshogs pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du snang la rang bzhin med/ /stong pa mkha' dang mtshungs pa ste/ /rol pa rang 'byung mnyam pa nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa snyan pa'i tog chen pos 'od mi zad pa'i 'byung gnas 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so//rang nyid rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas te/ /rtog pa'i dra ba rnam gcod pa/ /rang las 'char gyi gzhan las min/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od chen po mi zad pa'i dpal gyis zla ba kun du ston par 'gyur ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'gro kun brtan (nya)dang g.yo ba yi/ /dngos po mnyam nyid rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /gcig dang du mar dmigs su med/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par grol ba'i phung pos ye shes kyi sprin rnam par bkod pa 'byung ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mnyam pa nyid la kun rtog bral/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa dus mi dmigs/ /yang dag nyid du kun grol ba/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas 82—310

bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od kyi rgyal po mi zad pa'i snang bas chos thams cad yang dag par khyab pa mi 'gyur ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs 917so/ /snang ba rnam bral mun pa med/ /gang du rtog las rnam grol zhing / /grol ba'i rgyu ni bden pas stong / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i snying pos kun du khyab par byed pa zhes bya ba'i byang chub kyi snying po 5)rdo rje'i rtse mo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'byung dang 'byung las (5)gyur pa gang / /de nyid srog chags srog gyur pa/ /sems can byang chub snying po can/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i 'od 'phro ba'i rgyal mtshan gyis snying po kun du rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge ri4'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du bdud kyi tshogs kun yang / /rang gi sems las byung bas na/ /phyi rol nye bar dmigs su med/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha'i bu la 'di lta ste/ sa bla'i lha dang / rgyal chen ris bzhi'i lha dang / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha dang / 'phrul dga'i lha dang / 'thab bral gyi lha dang /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha dang / dga' ldan gyi lha dang / gzugs na 5spyod pa'i 'og min gyi lha'i bar gyi me tog gi rnam pa la 'di lta ste/ pad+ma dang /ut+pa 6la dang / ku mu da ri kyidang / pun da rī rdo ka dang / pad+ma ge sar dang /dzi 9ma pa ka tshedang / na di ke 11sa ra dang / mdzi ṣa 12ka dang / mañju ṣa lhan82—311

ka chen po dang / man dā 1ra ba dang / man dā 2ra ba chen po la sogs pa ste/'dab ma lnga pa dang / bdun pa dang / brgyad pa dang / bcu pa nas 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i bar du me tog gis mngon par gtor/ rab tu gtor/mngon par rab tu gtor cing lha'i bu dang lha'i kyibu mo rnams mngon par rab tu dga' ba'i yid kyis yongs su mchod par byed do/ /kun du mchod par byed do//legs par rab tu mchod cing lha'i dbyangs kyis legs so zhes rjod 4par byed do / /de nas lha ma srin sde 5brgyad kyis mchod pa la 'ong skad ( lha'i rgyal po mi mjed 7kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / lha ma yin gyi rgyal po stobs bzangs ldan dang / srin po'i rgyal po lang ka mgrin bcu dang / mi 'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa rta mgo can gyi bu mo yid 'phrog ma dang bcas pa dang / gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rat+na ku be ra dang / klu'i rgyal po gtsug na nor bu 'khor dang bcas pa dang / nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gser lus stobs ldan dang / dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa 'khor dang bcas pa dang /rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pas so so nas mchod cing / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi sems rdo rje la mgo bos phyag byas shing lan brgya stong du mar bskor ba byas shing nam mkha' las song ste mi snang bar gyur nas / skad cig tsam gyis so so'i gzhal yas khang du stan la 8gnas par gyur tol/ /de nas sa gsum du khyab pa'i 'od kyi snang ba chen po mi zad pa byung ste/sems can thams cad bde ba dang reg par gnas pas khyab par byas te slar log nas bdag nyid kyi sku lus kyi ba spu'i bu gar mngon par zhugs par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang 82—312

ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba las 'dus pa chen po gsang ba'i mchod pa thog mar bstan pa ste le'u 1)bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od bzangs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'khor lo'i snying po nardo rje kun du khyab par bskor ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gnyis med ye shes rang bzhin can/ /ye shes snang ba mi zad pa'i/ /'od gsal brjod du med pa yi/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med pa'i snying pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi pad+mo rin po che 'byung ba'i 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /thams cad byang chub dam pa'i gzhi/ /lugs 'byung chos kyi rang bzhin dbyings/ /lugs zlog gsang ba nyer bstan pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa skar rgyal dbang pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rgya mtsho chen po ye shes kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /snang ba med cing dpe med pa/ /mtshon pa tsam gyis rtogs dka' ba/ /'dzub 4kyis zla mtshon bzhin du snang / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rab rtsal zla ba'i 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sgron ma 'bar 82—313

ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dri med myu gu bskyed pa yi/ /sa bon 'dis ni kun khyab pa/ /chos dbyings mngon par byang chub pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa nor bu'i phreng (1)ba 'dzin gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi don la rab tu sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /snang ba 'di ni rags dpa'i lam/ /mched 79pa 'di ni phra ba ste/ /thob pa mchog tu gyur pa nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan 'byung gnas 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi 'od zer rab tu skul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /stong pa dngos po yul gyis bral/ /lus kyis stong pa rten 'brel 'byung / /shin tu stong pa phyi nang med/ /byang chub sku tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa don yod par gzigs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sgyu ma'i sprul pa du mar 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rgyu mthun gang yin byed pa ste/ /'bras bu dbang sgyur rnam par smin/ /dri ma med pa lhan cig skyes/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mar me snang ba'i 'od mi g.yo bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'od zer gyi sprin 'phro ba bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rgyu 82wa 314

rkyen nye bar len pa dang / /lhan cig byed pa'i spyod pa can/ /mtshan nyid med pa'i ngo bo yi/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mthu dpung yang dag ldan gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi stobs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /kun du brtags pa'i rnam pa can/ /de yi dri ma rnam sbyangs te/ /'jug pa dang ni ldog pa yis/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa (1tsho sman pa'i rgyal pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kun du snang ba dam pa'i rgyan gyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /khams 'di gzhan gyi dbang du brjod / /spyi dang khyad par dbye ba med/ /skye ba med phyir brjod par bya/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa des pa chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi stobs kyi snying po glog gi 'od zer gyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos nyid yongs su grub pa las/ /ngo bo bden par 'gyur ba med/ /pha rol phyin pa'i tshul mchog ste/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu rab tu rgyas pa'i dpal gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rgyan yongs su dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'jig rten pas ni kun du ston/ /'das pa'i ye shes dag pa'i lam/ /mi 'gyur ba ni phyag rgya che/ /byang chub 82—315

tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa brtan 1ldan dbang pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ljon shing rgyas pa'i bsil grib ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'dod khams sgra dang dngos pos stong / /gzugs kyi khams ni lus kyis stong / /gzugs med khams ni yid kyis te/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa lha'i dpal gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byams pa chen po'i gdugs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam pa kun du 'byung 2ba dag /ye shes rig la rnam dbye bas/ /dman pa mchog dang bar ma ste/ /rigs ni chos kyi dbyings la gnas / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gdul dka' ba pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying rje chen po'i gru ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /thams cad chos nyid gcig pa'i phyir / /'di ni theg mchog yangs pa'i lam/ /grub pa kun du spyod pa nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan gyi rgyal mtshan gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dga' ba chen po yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos sku de bzhin nyid yin te/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku bde chen brjod/ /sprul sku sna tshogs 'gro don byed/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin 82—316

gshegs pa sgra gcan 1)ye shes kyi snying pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi btang snyoms tshad med pa rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sku gsum gcig tu bsdus pa ni/ /tha dad rtog pa spang ba'i phyir/ /snying po ye shes gyur pa ste/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshogs can 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bum pa bzang po lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gsang ba bla med khyad par ba/ /zung 'jug 'bras bu rab gyur pas / /rim gnyis gcig tu sbyor ba 75)nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi khang bzangs dbakod pa lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par rigazhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /snying po kun du bskul pa ni/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul pas/ /myur du mngon par 'tshang rgya'i lam/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshig bstan gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dran pa yang dag par skul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /byang chub sems kyi yi ge gsum/ /spro dang bsdu ba mi byed pas/ /bskul ba phrin las spyod 5pa min/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /de nyid shes pa'i gnas yin te/ /'di ni sgrub pa'i de nyid yin/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur spyod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams 82—317

cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba 1)las de bzhin gshegs pa'i kun tu spyod pa'i snang ba ston pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'gying ba dpal gyi sdes rdzusade bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi glang po'i stobs mchog snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /brtan pa dang ni g.yo ba yi/ /srog ni rlung la brten pa yin/ /khyab cing snying por ldan pa ste/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mdzad mi 'khrugs (kyepas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhing khams rab tu snang ba'i 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rig ma lha mo khro tshogs bcas/ /thugs ka nas ni bskul ba shis/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa lhun chen 'bar ba'i 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par grol ba'i ye shes kyi phung po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs sol/ /rnam grol snying po 94du ma'i phung po dag /bcings pa med cing rnam par 'thor med pa/ /tshul 'di thams cad rgyu dang 'bras bur 'byung / /byang chub tshul 'di nges par bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 82—318

de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje'i snying po rab tu 'joms pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mtshan bzang po yongs su rgyas par 'byed 6)pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni ye shes sku/ /bkra shis dge ba'i mtshan gyis spras/ /de nyid kun gyi rnam par stong / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sdom pa (mirab ldan dgyes pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpe byad yongs su dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sdom pa thams cad snying po ni / /'dir ni thabs dang shes rab nyid/ /gnyis med de bzhin gshegs pa yi / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mi bsnyems pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'gro ba 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la (5༄snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /srid gsum brtan dang g.yo ba yi/ /dngos po mi dmigs snang med pa/ /chos nyid mnyam pa nyid gyur phyir/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa (yerin chen dpal gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lam du gyur pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams rten cing 'brel 'byung ba/ /de nyid ro mnyam gcig pa'i bdag /rgyu dang 'bras bur bstan pa yin/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi pad+ma'i spyan rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i 5)sangs rgyas du ma'i rjes su 'gro ba ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting 82—319
