nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi 1)sems 'di gsungs so/ /spyan lnga ye shes spyod yul du/ /gnyis snang thams cad nub nas ni/ /zung 'jug ye shes mi gnas pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa stobs kyi sdes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 2bdud kyi dpung rab tu 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi 57sems 'di gsungs so/ /skye ba med cing gnas med pa/ /rang 'byung rang bzhin rang gnas pa/ /gnyug ma rgyun chad med pa'i ngang / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 4)me tog 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'bar ba'i sprin bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas ye shes 'od zer gyis / /snying gi pad+mo sad mdzad pa/ /de nyid mi 'gyur bde ba thob/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dpal ye shes dgyes par spyod pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gtsug tor mngon par rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /khams gsum ma lus sangs rgyas zhing / /dbyer med ye shes rgyas pa'i thugs/ /'gro ba'i mtshan ma dmigs su med/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid chen po dang ldan pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpa' bar 'gro ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /tshogs drug rang snang rtog pa med/ /rnam shes 82—320

brtags pa rnam bral ba/ /gzung 'dzin kun las rnam grol ba/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa snang bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa kun nas sgo'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs sol/ /don dam rnam par mi dmigs pa/ /yod med mtha' las 'das pa ste/ /gzigs byar med cing rtag tu stong / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba mi zad pas bde bas brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /snang la rang bzhin ma grub pas/ /mi rtag g.yo ba dngos la ni/ /bden pa dmigs su med pa ste/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i sbyin pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying rjes bsnyel ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sems ni dri mar bcas pa dag /bag chags rtogs pas rab dkrugs 1pa/ /sa ler bzhag 95 pas rang dngas 'gyur/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das /de bzhin gshegs pa brtan par gshegs pas 'gro ba'i 4blo rang 5chags pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rang 'byung ye shes nam mkha' ni/ /tha snyad rnams las yongs grol ba/ /'char ba med cing nub pa med/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa don yod mthong bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 82—321

ye shes rab tu rgyas pa'i nyi ma'i snying po tsa)zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dad dang ldan pa'i skye bo ni/ /shes rab snang ba rab bskul ni/ /mun pa la ni snang ba bzhin/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa brtson 'grus sbyin pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ri rab brtsegs ri na/pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam rtog dri ma spangs zhing gsal zhi)ba yi/ /kun nas kun du 'jug pa'i yid 0dag kyang / /rgyun las bzlog na rang bzhin med par 'gro/ /nges par gsang ba byang chub bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bzang skyong gis 'gro ba thams cad kyi mun pa sel ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam par mi dmigs mtshan ma med/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin gnas med par/ /mnyam rjes mi dmigs grol ba'i mtha'/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dga' bos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zab mo'i spyod yul la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'khor ba'i gnas ni sgyu ma ste/ /sgyu ma tsam du'ang mi gnas pa / /ye shes mngon par 'byung bas na/ /ngo bo nyid kyi tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /ma byon da ltar bzhugs pa dag /phyogs bcu chos kyi dbyings bcas par/ /dpag med dug lnga'i rtog (55tshogs ldan/ /skye bo shin tu 82—322

gtum pa dang / /chags dang ser snas 'jungs pa dang / /rmongs dang ma rungs las brtson rnams/ /rgyud lnga'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo las/ /sgrol mdzad dkyil 'khor chen po lnga/ /rgyun mi 'chad par don spyod 6cing / /sna tshogs thabs kyis 'dul mdzad pa/ /de dang de yi skur bstan nas/ /ris mthun lam du ston mdzad de/ /thams cad dbyer med dag par 'gyur/ /'di nyid bsdus pa'i bdud rtsi ste/ /rdo rje phreng bar 'gyur ba na/dang / /dgongs pa lung ston gsang ba'i rgyud/ /ye shes rdo rje (2)bsdus pa ni/ /khyad par ston pa 'phags pa'i chos/ /bzhis bsdus lha mo'i gsang chen dang / /thun mong ma yin ston pa yi/ /gsang ba bla med rgyud 'dir nges/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa mchog gi gsang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba bstan pa mi phyed pa'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'chi med bdud rtsi rgyal pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku bdud rtsi 'bar ba rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad kun/ /rang gi sems las gzhan med de/ /snang zhing gsal bar gyur pa nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis 82—323

sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mdzad pa rnam par spro ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'dir ni rang rig nyams myong ltar/ /gal te sems nyid ma yin na/ /'brel pa med phyir snang med 'gyur/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bkod pa kun du ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos nyid dang ni sems nyid dag /gang du rtog pas dpyad gyur kyang / /gcig dang du mar mi dmigs pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi rgyal pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen pa mi zad pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /spyod yul shin tu zab pas na/ /rang sems byang chub snying po can/ /gdod nas dag pa de nyid de / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal pos sangs rgyas kyi gdul (1bya sna tshogs kyi yul la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms 2par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /zab dang rgya chen dbyer med pas/ /snang stong tha dad med par 'dres/ /sangs rgyas zhes ni de la gsungs/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mi'i kha lo sgyur bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dri bcas rang rig ltos med phyir/ /rang 'byung ye shes de nyid 82—324

de / /rig pa'i phyir na gsal ba nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes par gshegs pas sangs rgyas kyi zab pa'i spyod yul la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rang rig yin phyir mi rtog pa/ /rkyen skyes gzhan dbang yin pa'i phyir/ /mi rtog rtog pa byed med pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa chu lha'i lhas dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sems nyid rnam par mi rtog pas/ /gsal la rtog med ye shes nyid / /thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyod yul can/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'ol/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan lag gis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdud kyi ba dan rnam par gnon pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so//rang rig 'od gsal nam mkha' 'di/ /gdod nas ma bcos par rtogs 1gang ske/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du btsal mi dgos/ khong chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa spos kyi lag pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /glo 2bur dri ma byung gyur kyang / /rang bzhin dag pa'i ngo bo la/ /gos dang ma gos med par gsal/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par mkhyen pas sangs rgyas 82—325

thams cad kyi glang po'i rtsal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /yod med gnyis ka las 'das pas/ /phan tshun ltos pa ma grub phyir/ /tshu rol ma grub pha rol bzhin/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ / de nas 51)bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra'i rgyal pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun nas snang ba tog gi 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /yod med tha dad ma grub ste/ /gnyis tsam du yang tshogemed pa'i phyir / /rnam par brjod med dmigs pa bral/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa legs pa'i seng ges srid gsum thams cad lhang nger gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /e ma'o 95sems nyid dri med kyis / /rnam 'phrul gzugs skus bsdus pa yi/ /zhing khams rnam par dag par snang / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yid bzangs kyis chos thams cad sgra brnyan lta bur snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dkyil 'khor rnam 'phrul sna tshogs pa/ /ngo mtshar ba yi rnam 'phrul dag /nam mkha'i mthas klas khyab par 'gyur / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang zhig sgrub pa gang bsgrub la95/ /de 82—326

sgrub pa la gnas med med6)/ /bsgrub par bya ba sgrub ma yin/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i snying pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rin po che'i 'od zer rab tu bskul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gsang ba mi zad chos kyi dbyings/ /ye shes rdo rje rol par 2bstan / /bla med gnas ni tshul thob pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa grags chen gyis pad+ma'i snying po kun du rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'khor ba'i 'dam las skyes pa yi/ /rang sems pad+ma'i sdong bu ni/ /zil par ldan pa dri ma med/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gtsug na nor bus sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul rab tu spro ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /kun nas kun du sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhing 'di'i snying po dad pa ste//mos dang brtson 'grus stobs de bzhin/ / byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa drag shul can zhes bya ba'i ri zab pa'i snying po gzhal med khang rnam pa du mar ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sa 'di kun gyi brten pa bzhin/ /byang chub sems la kun brten kyang / /gnas pa med cing 'gro 'ong med/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa seng 82—327

ge'i stobs de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mdzad pa mtha' yas par ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /nam mkha' kun du gnas med pa/ /de bzhin rtog bral dri med sems / /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs yin te/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /shes bzhin smon lam dbang gis ni/ /mngal 'byung rim pa gang yin dang / /zhing dang zhing du so sor yang / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ni/ /'dir ni yang dag brtul zhugs 1'dzin/ /gzhon nu'i rol pa thams cad dang / /de bzhin bzo 2gnas yang dag bstan/ /thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin las/ /rnal 'byor pas ni rtag tu spros/ /'dir ni sngon chad ma byung med/ /sngon gnas pa ni sbyar mi bya/ /de bzhin gshegs kun mdzad pa ni / /thams cad rdo rje'i dngos gzhi la/ /dus gsum lam gyi mthar thug pas/ /thams cad 'di bzhin blta bar bya/ /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dganyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba 4)las de de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par rol pa ston pa'i le'u ste bcwa 5)lnga pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ljon pa dri ma med pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi stobs bcu mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam par mi rtog mi dmigs pa/ /rang 'byung lhan cig skyes pa yis/ /snying po sgyu ma'i 82—328

snang ba nyid17/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par rgyal ba can de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po kun du bskul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /yang dag kun rdzob dag pa la / /brtan g.yor bcas pa'i snang ba ni/ /rang bzhin med pa nyid du snang / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab rnam par brtsegs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po yang dag pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams thams cad sems yin te/ /sems nyid sgyu 2)ma'i rnam pa dngos/ /de nyid kun rdzob stong nyid do/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa legs pa'i gnas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes sgyu mar ston pa'i rol pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sna tshogs sgyu ma 'khor 'das dag /sems nyid dag dang ma dag pa'i/ /snang ba bag chags khyad par nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang dbacom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros rgya mtshos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyod pa'i rol pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ /byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /yid bzhin nor bu rang las rnyed/ /de nyid sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ske/ /bla ma sangs rgyas drin gyis rnyed/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yan lag skyes 82—329

pa 1)de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes rin po che'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs sol/ /rnam par grol ba'i ye shes la/ /yod med mtha' las 'das pa ste/ /mi rtog ye shes kun rdzob nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs sol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa blo mtha' yas pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing nami 'jigs pa bzhi 'byung ba'i ye shes zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /e ma ho sku gsum 'dul ba'i zhing / /ma lus lus pa med pa rnams/ /thams cad byang chub sems kyi rgyan/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs dam pas bkra shis dga' bas brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /e ma ho stong gsum ma lus rgyal ba'i zhing / /rdo rje sems dpa'i sku la rdzogs/ /thams cad ba spu'i tshogs las kyang / /spros nas byang chub sems dgasungs so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen ldan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tho dgyes pa chen pos 95yongs su spyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /e ma ho sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /gsang ba bde chen byang chub sems/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul mchog ste/ /snying po'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od zer mtha' yas pa ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang 82—330

chen gyi tshul 'di gsungs so/ /e ma ho sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /skye ba med las thams cad skyes/ /skyes tsam nyid na'ang skye ba med6)/ /gsang ba'i tshul chen bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa brtul zhugs brtan pa 92kyisangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'gro ba ma lus pa'i dbyings la yang dag par dbang bskur ba'i tshul zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /e ma ho sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ( ni/ /gnas pa med las gnas pa'i chos/ /gnas tsam nyid na gnas pa med/ /gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bkra shis 'byung bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /e ma ho rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gsang ④/ /dmigs pa med las thams cad dmigs/ /dmigs tsam nyid na dmigs pa med/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bde ba'i tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi srid pa'i chu klung skems pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /e ma ho ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /'gro 'ong med las 'gro dang 'ong / /'gro nyid na'ang 'gro ba med/ /gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs 5/pa pad+ma'i snying po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi nam mkha' rdul med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /e ma ho rtog pa rang 'byung 82—331

bske/ /rtog tsam nyid na'ang rtog mi gnas/ /tha dad med pa'i tshul mchog gis/ /gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sred med kyi bus rgyal ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rol pa lding ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te / byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bcings pa med cing grol du'ang med / /lhan cig skyes pa rnam grol 17ba/ /ye shes brjod pa dang bral ba/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa lag bzangs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yid bzhin gyi na nor bu'i rtse mo'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos kun brjod du med pa ste/ /gsang ba zab pa'i gnas nyid la/ /brjod tsam nyid na brjod du med/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ye shes 'byung gnas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 'khor los sgyur dab zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /don dam rtog pa'i yul min phyir/ /chos sku ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /rang rig ye shes sgyu ma'i dngos/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das yon tan bde spros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes pararnga sgra kun du sgrogs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rgyal po dpung bcas yan lag ldan/ /pha rol rgol ba bzlog pa bzhin/ /ye shes rgyal po stobs chen ldan/ /dri med tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das tshangs pas 82—332

byin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi ri1)phyogs bcur sgrogs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /theg pa sna tshogs drang ba'i phyir/ /lam 'di rim par bstan pa yin/ /gsang ba'i theg pa gcig pa nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung gnas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi dung 'bud pa rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /e ma ho rmad du byung ba'i chos/ /gsang chen theg pa mchog gcig pu/ /ma lus dus gsum rgyal ba'i lam/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje'i spyan/ /gzigs pa'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gnas dang / spyod yul dang /zab pa dang / rgya che ba'i de kho na nyid chos nyid nam mkha' yongs su dag pa'i rang bzhin las nating nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa la dgongs nas dasacang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun du bzang po stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po khri phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu snyed kyi byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la smras pa/ gang du dpal rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs pa'i chos thams cad ni rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i chos yin te/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba gang yin pa 4 ni rang bzhin med pa'o/ /rten 'brel las skyes pa'i chos thams cad ni ma skyes pa/ma 'gags pa/ dmigs su med pa ste/ gnas pa med cing rang bzhin med pa 82—333

stong pa nyid de/ de yang dngos po bar (1)dngos po rdzusamed pa gnyis su dbyer med pa ste/ mnyam pa nyid khong du chud pa ni byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhes bya'o//zhes smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs 'dus pa de dag thams cad kyi sems kyi rtog pa yongs su chod nas legs so legs so zhes brjod nas cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba ( nyerab tu bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das lha'i me tog de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi yongs su dag par dmigs pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis/ /rang sems dri ma bkru bar bya/ /dag pa'i thugs ni ye shes che/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das don legs sems dpa'i 94nide bzhin gshegs pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul dag pa'i gsang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /pha rol phyin nam dag pa'i gnas/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa'i thun mong yul/ /snying po dgyes (5)pa'i rtsa ba ste/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi 'byung gnas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi sprin spro ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di 82—334

gsungs so/ /gsang ba chos nyid dag pa nyid/ /phyag rgya chen po'i tshul mchog gis / /'gro ba'i blo yis mun sel ba/ /ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das blo grags pa'i dpal de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes glog gi 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par rdzizhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /phyi dang nang du dngos po'i chos / /du ma nyid du mi rtog ste(kye/ /thams cad brten pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das spobs pa brtsegs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes mngon par rol pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs sol/ /rang bzhin rtog pa'i tshogs 'byung ba/ /rnam par brtags (kyepa rang byung gang ske/ /sems gsum snang ba'i ngang du dag /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das me tog de bzhin gshegs pa ( nardo rje rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mngon par rtogs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gsang ba rab tu 'dzin pa yis 3)/ /rnal 'byor pa ni byang chub mchog /spros bcas spros med tshul dag gis/ /gsang ba spyod pa'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phan par bzhed pa rdo rjes sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po khyab pa'i ye shes kun du 'phrul pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'dir ni gang du rnam shes dang / /ye shes gnyis su med pa ste/ /kun gzhi rtog pa med par gsal/ /byang chub rten 'brel tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /82—335

de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par rol par ldan pa'i snying pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes nam mkha'i snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ji srid nam mkha' stong ba min / /rang sems stong nyid nam mkha' las/ /rtogs pa'i ye shes stong nyid de / /kun ston tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mun pa dang bral ba'i rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rdo rje'i dra bas yongs su 'brel tshob rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dngos po med cing rang stong pa/ /bde chen phyi nang dmigs med pa/ /ro gcig ye shes sgyu mar snang / /zhen med tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi snying po dag pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dmigs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang zag dang ni chos dag la/ /bdag med rtogs phyir sems dpa' che/ /sa la gnas dang rigs kyi dang / /legs spyod tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ske /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das tshe sbyin dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rin po che'i gter gyi bum pa bzang po'i rgyan 2/zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du chos don snying po ni/ /rgyu dang 'bras bur 'byung ba yi/ /zab mo gter 'dra rang las 3rnyed/ /gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das nor bu'i 'byung gnas rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rin po che'i rgyan du mar ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs 82—336

te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug du ma yis/ /gsang ba'i spyod pa'i tshul kun la/ /rang gzhan khyad par don 'byung bas/ /spyod pa'i tshul mchog ldan pa ste/ /gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das skye dbang mtshungs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang 'byung ba snrel zhi zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rab rib med pa'i tshul can gyis/ /drang srong skyob pa'i spyod gnas te/ /thub pa mngon par nges 'byung ba'i/ /yon tan tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das stobs kyis gshegs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mngon par 'byung ba thob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /thog ma med cing tha ma med/ /dbus su 'byung ba yang dag spangasal/ /ye shes nye bar brgyan pa gang / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das blo gnas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par rol pa kun du bzang po ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ri bo sna tshogs 'dus pa la/ /ri rgyal brtan par 'gyur ba gang / /rtog med lhun po'i gnas su spro/ /de nyid byang chub tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gdugs mdzes pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub kyi snying por bskul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas ye shes nam mkha'i dbyings/ /kun du rtog med lham mer gnas/ /de nyid rab tu mi gnas pa/ /byang chub 82—337

tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gtso bo mchog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dbang phyug spyod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /shing dbang drung ni rdo rje can/ /mi 'gyur ye shes e dang baṃ/ /pad+ma bha ga'i dbyings nyu7can te/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shin tu 'phags pa'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshul gcig pa'i gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so//de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi yul gyur pa/ /chos kun bdag med mnyam pa nyid/ /zab mo'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal seng ge'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mdzad pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du bdag gzhan tha dad med/ /byams pa chen po'i snang ba yis/ /mi phyed chos ni don grub rgyu/ /sems kyi spyod tshul 'di bstan no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par grol ldan dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhing du mar me tog rgyas pa cher spro ba'i rgyun zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /yang dag ye shes bzang po nyidam/ /rdzu 'phrul 'byung ba'i blo yi nor/ /bdud rtsi'i snying po rang las rnyed/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas ye shes lhun grub pas/ /'di nyid rtog med rab gsal ba/ /bsam pa'i dngos po 'jug mi 'gyur/ /sems kyi kun rtog rab zhi ba'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de 82—338

bzhin gshegs pa (1)thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa (5)nyid rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba las rab tu mi gnas pa'i ye shes bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das klu'i 'od de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gdug pa can ma lus pa 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /shin tu rgyal ba dri ma med/ /sems kyi glang po bcing mi bya/ /rang grol gsal ba dag pa'i lam/ /rgyal bas tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das spos kyi dbang phyug rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgyes pa bskyed pa snang ba'i snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /chos kyi phung po de snyed las/ /rtog pa'i ye shes gyur pa na/ /tshul 'di gcig tu rdzu ribastan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das me tog gi ri bo sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems bskyed par nges pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /thog ma bar dang tha mar yang ske/ /byang chub mchog tu gnas pa nyid/ /nges pa bskyed pa 'byung ba yin/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das klu dga' ye shes 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi glang po rol pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bde 82—339

gshegs ye shes gdung rgyud ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 'dzin/ /'byung po du ma lam la 'dzud/ /ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs sol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shin tu grags pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi khyu mchog rlabs po che'i rtsal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rang sems rgyal po rang 'byung gnas/ /shar nub med pa'i nyi ma las/ /rtog med cir yang gsal ba nyid/ /gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das stobs kyi lha sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur ba'i gsang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te thun mong ma yin pa'i byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /de bzhin nyid kyis dbang bskur ba/ /thob pa'i 91/khyad par sems las byung / /'di ni dus gsum kun du 'byung / /byang chub zab pa'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phreng ldan yon tan dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan dpal rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dkyil 'khor du ma gsal ba yi/ /yon tan rin chen tshogs spro ba / /phyi dang nang du rnam phye bas/ /ye shes zab 2pa'i tshul brjod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das klu'i lag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mchod pa'i gnas kyis brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te / byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'dir ni snang ba bla med tshon pa/ /rgyun du rang sems chos kyi klong / /rgyun mi 'chad pa chos kyi sku/ /snying po'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das spyan 82—340

brgyan pa'i zhal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dag pa zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /de bzhin nyid 'di mi rtog pa/ /gsal ba brjod bral thams cad mkhyen/ /'od gsal snying po ye shes sku/ /spros pa med pa'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs sol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das legs par sbyangs pa'i blo sangs rgyas thams cad kyi so sor ma 'dres pa dri ma med ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te / byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /khyab dang rdo rje 1sku nyid dang / /mi 'gyur dus ni thams cad du/ /brtan 2pa med par rang 'byung gnas/ /bla med tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das zil gnon rdo rjes sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i ye shes zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /zab dang rgya che gnyis med pa/ /spyod yul thabs la mkhas pa yis / /rnam par grol ba'i 'bras thob pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ye shes la rol pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub bde ba'i snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gsang ba ro gcig rdo rje 'chang glu/ /gsang ba gsum na sku gsung thugs/ /de nyid lngar ni rab bsgrags pa / /dam pa'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mtha' yas pa'i spyan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba rnam par dben pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /lus dang ngag dang yid rnams ni/ /rdo rje gsum du rnam 82—341

dag pas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs/ /rdo rje'i tshul 'di bstan pa'ol/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das bden par gsungs 517pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po 'od kyi dra bar 'char ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas sku ni kun khyab pas/ /de nyid sku la rab snang ba/ /zhing khams rdul phran skur 'dus pa/ /mi zad tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das nyi ma'i 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes dag pa yongs su 'dzin pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas gsung ni kun sgrog na)pa/ /de nas gsung du rab brjod pa/ /sna tshogs sgra ni gsung gyur pa/ /de ni gsung gcig tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa nges pa'i blo sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnas pa med pa'i ye shes 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas thugs ni bsam mi khyab/ /ye shes mkhyen pa gcig pa'i thugs/ /dri med mnyam pa nyid gang yin/ /rtog med tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mtha' yas gzugs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po ye shes rdo rje mchog tu bstan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mnyam nyid gnas pas blang dor med/ /dus gsum tha dad gzigs pa med/ /skad cig ye shes bde ba'i dngos/ /chos nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'od mi zad pas 82—342

sangs rgyas thams cad kyis phas kyi rgol ba zlog 3)par mdzad pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rinabyang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dpa' bo seng ge'i lta stangs kyis/ /mu stegs bdud tshogs las rgyal ba'i/ /tshad med snying rjes bskul bar bya/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rin chen tog ri gis chos thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro ba'i sgo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rdo rje 'bar ba 'od 'phro ba/ /ye shes zla ba la gnas pa/ /byang chub sems ni 'dzin pa yis/ /dri med chu rgyun tshul bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas sangs rgyas the tshom 54rnam par spangs pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi me tog gi snye ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gcig tu mchog gnas mi 'gyur ba/ /tshig don dbye ba dam pa'i chos/ /bstan pa'i snying po bla med lam//byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus la/ /rab 'byam ri nomachod pa'i sprin gyis ni/ /kun du khyab cing ston pa po/ /'di ni ye shes kun gyi gter/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las/ 'byung 'jug gnas par dag pa kun du ye shes ston pa'i le'u ste bcwa 6)brgyad pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten las 'das pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la 82—343

snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mtshan rnams rdzogs pa ye shes sku/ /dngos po med cing snang ba'i dngos/ /rtog pa med pa mi gnas pa / /khyad par tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das don yod rnam par mthong ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi skye ba'i cho 'phrul ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam par grol ba zhi ba'i lam/ /bcing med ye shes bkod ma'i chu / /dam tshig gsang ba sdom pa las/ /gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rtogs pa 1mdzad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mngon par byang chub pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rtog med 'bras bu dag pa'i ngang / /chos rnams stong nyid snying rjer gcig /tha dad spangs pa lam gyi mchog /zab pa'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das me tog rgyal mtshan 92)thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'byung ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bla ma'i byin brlabs bdud rtsi las/ /'thung ba ye shes bcud kyis rgyas/ /tshe 'dir grub pa mchog ster ba/ /gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ri dbang gi rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun brjod pa'i cho 'phrul ston pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dam tshig 'di ni rmad po che/ /dus gsum 'byung ba rtag pa gang / /thams cad bdag nyid bde bar gshegs/ /snying po'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /82—344

de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid chen pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshul gcig pa spyod pa'i gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam pa kun tu sdom pa gang ske/ /rigs kyi gnas su gang byung bar1/ /sku gsung thugs ni ye shes can / /dran (5pa ma lus tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa don mdzad gzigs pa'i (nasangs rgyas thams cad kyi khams ma lus pa ri la byin gyis rlob 5pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /thams cad ye shes gcig par sdom/ /de nyid 'gyur med zag pa bral/ /snying po rol pa rang byung ba / /sangs rgyas tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mkhyen pa grags pa mtha' yas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos nyid kyi me long zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dri med ye shes sgyu ma'i ngang ske/ /phung po la sogs rtog bral ba/ /'di ni kun rdzob rnam thar sgo/ /rdo rje 7/tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das sgra gcan lhas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi kun nas ye shes kyi sgo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /las dang las kyi 'bras bu ni/ /kun nas dkris 8pa sna tshogs pa/ /stong nyid ye shes mes bsreg 9pa/ /rdo rje'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ri bo'i rgyal mtshan gyis 'khor ba sna tshogs pa'i mun pa sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te 82—345

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam par grol ba bde ba yi/ /'jig rten lha las 'das nas ni/ /snang ba med pa'i dbyings su 'gro/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan 1pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rin chen snying pos srid pa thams cad dbugs 'byin par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'gro ba'i mtshan ma'i dngos po rnams/ /srid gsum rang bzhin med mthong bas ye shes 'od gsal mi phyed pa'i/ /gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shin tu mthor gshegs kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos nyid gcig pa'i lam zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /snang ba dang ni mun pa dag /rtog pa'i chos nyid gzigs med phyir/ /tha dad snang ba nub pa'i dngos/ /ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das skar rgyal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'khor lo bskor ba chos kyi lam zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'di ni sgrib pa med pa'i lam/ /sdug pa rab zhi brtse ba can/ /byang chub sems kyi snying po nyid/ /dri med tshul 'di bstan napa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gtsug rings sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po mig 'phrul ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /thams cad ye shes snang ba'i dngos/ /sems can rtog pa yul med phyir/ /gnyis snang ma lus bcom nas ni/ /gnyis med tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rin chen grags pa sangs 82wa 346

rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes dbyings su gcig pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /snod bcud ma lus rin chen gzhi/ /lha mi'i snang ba ston pa che/ /thub pa 'gro ba'i don spyod pa'i/ /ye 4)shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das nyi zla'i snying pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 'pho (5)ba med par ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so / /lus la 'pho ba'i ye shes gang / /rnam par shes pa'i gzugs brten nas//gcig pu mi 'gyur dngos med sems/ /rdo rje'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das nyi ma'i 'od ldan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor bkod pa nyan zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dang po'i lus ni lha yi dngos/ /lus dben snang ba rten 'brel te/ /sems nyid ye shes stong nyid de/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang 4)bcom ldan 'das skar mkhan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje'i 5)snang ba bkod pa/ zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'di ni kun rtog ye shes che/ /bde ba chos kyi dbyings nyid las/ /zug rngu bral ba byang chub sems/ /rdo rje'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das seng ge'i rtog 6sangs rgyas thams cad kyi stobs mi zad pa'i ye shes chen po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du gnyis med mnyam pa'i dngos/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /mi zad phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhi/ /dbyer med tshul 'di 82—347

bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dus mkhyen rgyal pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phun sum tshogs pa bla na med pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bdag gzhan dbyer med byang chub sems/ /bde ba chen po sems la rnyed/ /ngal so'i gnas 1ni bla na med/ /dbyer med tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis nirin/ /sku gsung thugs ni gcig sbyor ba/ /byang chub sems dpa' che /rnams kyis/ /rjes su bsngags pa brjod pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa nye bar bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das dpal gyi snying po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes rnam par rol pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge ca'adzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du srog dang snying po med/ /gnas pa med cing kun 'byung ba/ /bar ma do yi rnam shes ltar/ /'byung ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das srid mtha' gzigs pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dbang po yul la rnam spro ba/ /de nyid bzlog ste 5sems gnas pa/ /lam du byed pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang 82wa 348

bcom ldan 'das glog gi 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsrung ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rgyal ba ye shes 'od kyis ni/ /rtog pa'i dri ma rnam sel ba/ /de nyid rnam grol bstan pa gang / /gnyis med tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gser gyi ri bos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od mchog 4)ma lus pa rnam par 'byed pa'i na/ye shes rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dri med lhun grub ye shes rang 'byung ba//'od gsal chos dbyings snying po bla na med/ /chos nyid chos can dbyer med bde ba che/ /mnyam nyid gnas pa tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas (5)seng ges byin pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phun sum tshogs pa'i bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mnyam nyid mnyam pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dag pa'i sa yi dbang phyug gar / /rdzogs pa'i gtsug tor dam tshig che / /gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rgyal bas ri rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rgyal ba rgyal 6)mtsho kun gyi rang bzhin thugs/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas skye med ngo bor mnyam/ /rnal 'byor rang sems gcig pur gnyis su med/ /khyad par med pa'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas sangs rgyas mchog dga' grags pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes mchog tu gsang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la 82—349

snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /snying po sgyu ma'i rang bzhin nyid/ /chos nyid yongs su dag pa gang / /sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid kyis 'grub / /'di ni byang chub tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa brtson 'grus bstan pa lhonyesangs rgyas kyi ye shes la spyod pa mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas gsang ba gnyis po ni/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rang la gnas/ /rang nyid rtog med ye shes sku/ /'di ni byang chub tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das grags pa rdzogs pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gdul 90bya'i snang ba nges par ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /lus med dbang po'i phug gnas shing / /ring du 'gro zhing gcig pur rgyu/ /gdul tsho )bar dka' ba'i sems 'dul byed/ /'di ni byang chub tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das bsnyems pa dang bral bas 'dul ba sna tshogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /blo ldan sa gsum 'grub pa'i gzhi / /yon tan 'byung gnas rin chen sems/ /bsam pa'i dgos 'dod skong byed la/ /khyad par tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mchod 'os lhas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so//khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje'i sku/ /'di nyid lus ni dri ma med/ /chos can ma grub rang sar dag /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de 82—350

nas bcom ldan 'das ma ༅sgrol ma chen po (kyezhes bya bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par mi g.yo ba'i bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /phung po la sogs dngos med pa/ /gang zag bdag med stong pa nyid/ /chos la dmigs pa rtog pa bral/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub snying po rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ril por 'dzin pa bsdu ba dang / /rjes su gzhig pa spro ba nyid/ /gnyis med bsam gtan la gnas pa/ /gcig pu (mibyed pa'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das spos dri zhim pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos nyid bde ba chen po'i tshul zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ye shes bde ba chen po'i ngang / /rtag tu bzhugs pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /rang 'byung 'gyur med snying po che/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das yon tan mchog 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa 'dus pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dri med sgyu ma'i chos nyid ni/ /yod med tha dad las 'das pa/ /snang la rang bzhin med pa nyid/ /'gag med tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mun pa dang rnam par bral bas 'gro ba thams cad kyi blo'i mun pa sel ba ye shes kyi rol pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'di nyid rang bzhin mi dmigs pas/ /82—351

yongs su dag par shes par bya/ /zung 'jug de bzhin nyid las ni/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das seng ge'i 'gram pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rtog med dbyings zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mnyam pa nyid las gang 'byung ba'i/ /bde chen rang 'byung rang nyid ni/ /mi zad rgyan 1gyi 'khor lo ste/ /gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rin chen grags pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnyis med mnyam pa rang byung rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gsang ba rang byung brtan nagayo bcas/ /thams cad rang nyid dkyil 'khor dang / /bde chen zab pa'i tshul rdo rje/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das skyon rab zhi bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes sgron me'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rtag tu dmigs par bcas pa yi/ /phyag rgya chen po dngos med de / /dngos med ngo bo nyid du dag /rin chen tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das bdud rtsi 'chang bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mig 'phrul ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa ni/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /byang chub sems kyi ngo bor gcig /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' che/ /kun du bzang pos slar gsol pa/ /dri med mnyam pa ye shes sku/ /sangs rgyas 82—352

thams cad bdag nyid de/ /gnas dang ston pa rang byung ba/ /che ba'i bdag nyid slad 1)gnas pa/ /dpal mchog gsang ba 'di nyid du/ /skal ldan rgyal ba bla na med/ /ces gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang ske/ gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor rang byung 5)du bstan pa'i bdag nyid rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las le'u nyi shu pa'o// //de nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs bcas dpag med dang / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs/ /rigs nadang lha mor bcas pa dpag med dang / /khro bo'i rgyal po du mar bcas pa dag /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'dus byas canas//bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gtso/ /byang chub sems kyi rdo rje'i bdag po la/ /tshogs pa 'dus pa brjod kyis mi lang ba'i/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams kyis dpag med ldan/ /mchod pa'i rim pa phyi nang gsang ba dang //de kho na nyid rnam pa mtha' yas pas/ /ye shes rgyal ba mi zad dam tshig gi/ /rin chen sprin gyis yang dag par mchod de/ /mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas ni 'di skad gsol/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus 'dus pa kun gyi gsang ba'i don/ /thog ma dbus mthar gnas pa ye shes che/ /gsang ba rdo rje snying po lhan cig skyes/ /brjod bya bla med gyur pas 'dus pa'i chosal/ /snying po'i 'bras bu kun gyi rtsa ba gang / /thabs dang bstan pa de yi khyad par mang 5/ /bcom ldan dri med gsang ba bshad du gsol/ /de nas 82—353

bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs/ /dpal ldan byang chub sems rdo rjes/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /gsang ba byang chub bka' stsal to/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i 'khor rnams la/ /rab tu gzigs nas dgyes gyur pas/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /gnas 'di zhus pa shin tu legs/ /legs so legs so sems dpa' che/ /zab cing rgya che mchog gi yul/ /'on kyang 'dir ni bde gshegs kyang / /the tshom (1)'jug pa'i gnas yin na/ /de las gzhan par gyur pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpar gyur pa'i tshogs/ /de las spyod yul lta ci smos/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das thams cad/ /mchog don ngo mtshar spyod pa dang / /thun mong gnas la dmang rin gyur pa/ /zab pa dang ni rgya che la/ /the tshom ( thams cad gcod mdzad pa/ /dkyil 'khor sa yi bdag po la/ /'di skad ces ni zhus par 'gyur( kyi/ /gnas dang dus dang phyag rgya dang / /'dus pa khyad par gyur pa la'ang / /gsang ba dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /tshad med ye shes zhing khams kyi/ /snang ba rab tu rgyas pa la/ /rgyu thabs khyad par gyur pa yi/ /gsang chen sku gsung thugs kyi gsang / /de nyid 'dus pa 'di mchog tu/ /ston pa 'phro bar ma gyur pa/ /de srid du ni kun mkhyen gyis/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i 'dus pa las/ /lus ngag yid ni byin brlab cing / /khyad par mchog dbang bskur mdzad de/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i rim phye ba/ /bum pa dang ni gsang ba dang / /shes rab ye shes de bzhin du/ /rab tu bskur bas smin byas nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba byang chub sems rdo rje/ /rtogs dka' mi phyed dam tshig gis/ /gang phyir dgongs te bshad pa dang / /dgongs min drang ba'i don gyur dang / /82—354

nges don ji bzhin pa dang ni/ /ji bzhin ma yin rnam phye bas/ /yi ge'i don dang spyi yi don/ /sbas pa gsum dang mthar thug gnyis/ /dang po gcig dang tshul gnyis ldan/ /dpag med rdo rje'i tshig gi rgya/ /nges 1phyir rab tu ston pa nyid / /'jug bya de dag lus ngag yid/ /rim pa gnyis kyi 92)bde ba dang / /yid bde rab tu myong bgyid pa/ /thabs zab rgya che myur ba'i lam/ /yan lag dam tshig ldan pa yi/ /thob bya thob byed khyad par pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes bla med pa/ / mngon pa'i ye shes bla na med / /(dmangon par byang chub gnas gyur pa'i/ /'bras bu yang dag thob gyur nasal/ /gsang ba'i rgyud mchog bstan du gsol/ /de ltar gsol ba btab gyur pas / /de nas bla med bcom ldan 'das/ /de bzhin gshegs kun gtso bo yis / /gsang ba byang chub sems rdo rje/ /de bzhin gshegs pa du ma rnams/ /stong pa nyid du 'jug pa yi/ /dpag med zil gnon rdo rje zhes/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs/ /de nas gsang ba'i bdag po de/ /'od gsal dri med dbyings nyid la/ /ye shes 'jug pa'i ngo bo yis/ /dbyer med gnas par gyur ma thag /rdo rje'i lus kyi rtsa gnas ni/ /stong phrag bdun cu la sogs pa/ /rtsa yi bu ga khong stong dag /thig le zhu ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ /byang chub rdo rje'i rnam par ni/ /zhu zhing yang dag gnas par gyur/ /de nyid chos sku'i ngo bo nyid/ /bde dang stong pa dbyer med pa/ /snying rje tshad med rnam pa las/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje/ /rnam par dben don nyid du gnas / /sgyu ma sbyong ba'i 4 dam tshig dang / /mngon par byang chub 'od gsal 82—355

ba'i / /stong nyid rdo rje rdzogs pa yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas(1)/ /rig pa thabs dang shes rab dag /dbyer med bde ba chen po'i sku/ /skyes bu'i rnam par gyur pa dag /gnas pa'i ngang las ldang ba ste/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /yul dang dngos po rnam dag pa'i/ /sku gsung thugs ni byin brlabs pa/ /ye shes chen po'i ngang gnas pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis pa/ /ston ku'i tsho 'dam bu'i mdog 'dra ba / /sprin dkar dag pa'i tshul can nyid/ /de ma thag tu snang bar mdzad/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i rjes zhugs pa/ /mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba dang / /rang 'byung ye shes lhag pa'i lha/ /thams cad bdag po rdo rje 'dzin/ /zhal gsum pa la phyag drug pa/ /sna tshogs rin chen gyis brgyan cing / /yin dra nī 5la 'bar ba dang / /dang po mgon po rnam par sprul/ /dung dang kun da 4ltar dkar ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /dkyil 'khor gnas pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /rnam pa gsal ba nyid du gzigs/ /de nas sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin/ /rnam par snang mdzad chen po nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /'dod chags kyis 'dul 'gro gzigs nas/ /'dod chags gsang ba'i tshul zhes pa'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bkod pa rab tu mi zad 5pa/ /de dag thams cad bsdus nas ni/ /nyid kyi sku la thim par mdzad/ /de nas 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kyis / /dbyer med gnas pa'i ngang las ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa gsang ba'i bdag /yongs su mnyes pa'i don du ni/ /nyid kyi sku las spros pa yi/ /ba spu'i bu ga'i 'od zer gyi / /rtse mo rnams las spros gyur pa/ /'jig rten 82—356

khams ni thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas spyan dang mā ma tī/ /gos dkar mo dang sgrol ma dang / /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro/ /reg bya rdo rjer gyur pa yis /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /tshad med yul dang spyod pa yis/ /chags pa chen pos rjes chags nas/ /bde ba'i rol pa ston par mdzad/ /rnam par snang mdzad ye shes che/ /de nyid me long sogs bdag nyid/ /gsang ba 'dzin pa thub pa'i rgyal/ /rdo rje mi bskyod rgyal po nyid/ /gsang ba 'dzin pa ma lus pa'i / /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rgyal/ /snying po rdo rje ye shes so/ /de nyid rdo rje btsun mo rnams/ /gcig tu gyur pa'i mkha' dbyings ni/ /1)dam tshig chen po'i mkha' dbyings te/ /rnyog pa med cing rdul med pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhir byin brlabs pa/ /phyogs mtshams mnyam par ldan pa la/ /grub pa'i gnas brgyad yongs bskor ba/ /zhing khams yongs su dag pa yi/ /'dzam gling pad ma'i lte ba la/ /sna tshogs mi shigs e dang bam̐/ /gsal ba de yi ngo bo nyid//sna tshogs gzugs kyi na/kun du rgyas/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyis kun du khyab/ /'od zer 'phro ba mang po 'khrug /gsal ba la sogs dkyil 'khor ldan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /de nas sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag /gsang ba rab tu 'dzin pa po/ /dkyil 'khor nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ /sum cu gsum par ldan pa yis / /pho brang yangs pa'i gzhal yas der/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stong dang ni / r+sha /gnyis dang byang chub sems dpar bcas/ /phyi rol 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi / /sna tshogs dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dbus su yang dag bzhugs gyur pa'o / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs/ /mi bskyod pa dang dkon mchog dpal / /tshe dpag med dang gdon mi za/ /dpal ldan rnam par snang mdzad 82—357

sogs1 / /de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa'i rgyal/ /de nyid sku gsung thugs ye shes / /phrin las ldan par bzhugs pa'o/ /de nas rang bzhin dag pa yi/ /chos kyi dbyings na gnas gyur pan/ /dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i/ /sems can khams kyi snod bcud dang / /yul dang dbang po thams cad kun/ /rdo rje sems dpas byin brlabs shing / /dbang bskur sngags dang phyag rgya dang //ye shes kyi 3ni dbang bsgyur bas/ /de dag thob pa'i khyad (4par ni/ /tha ma 'bring dang mchog rnams la/ /bde ba dang ni yid bde bas/ /gsang ba ye shes spyod yul thob/ /de las sprul pa'i sku byung ba/ /bcom ldan de nyid thugs ka nas/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor dpag med pa/ /bye ba grangs med bkye (snyenas ni / /gdul bya gdul phyir dbang bskur zhing / /spyi dang khyad par gyis 'dul 'gyur / /de nas sangs rgyas tshogs dag gis/ /bskul bas ched du brjod pa gsungs / /e ma ho sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /byang chub sems ni rang byung ba / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /rab tu rtog med mi gnas pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs/ /sku bzhi ye shes ro gcig pas/ /mdzad pa thams cad rdzogs byed pa/ /rab 'byam 6cho 'phrul ston pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo nges par sprul pas rgyud nges par bstan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /phyi rol yul snang rdzas su 'dod/ /g.yag rnga ne'u gsing (7lta bu la/ /bar du snang mun nashong ba tsam/ /sems las tha dad par gnas pa//skad cig mi rtag par 'dod pas/ /yul sems tha dad bye brag smra/ /phyi rol yul dag phra ba rnams/ / 'dus nas rigs pa 'byung ba ltar / /yul dus rnam par nges pa las/ /rigs pa 'dra ba'i rnam par bzhag /82—358

yul dgag 1)pa yi tha ma dang / /shes pa skye ba'i thog ma ru/ /phrad par 'dod pa grub pa'i mtha'/ /mdo sde pa yi dgongs pa smra/ /chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems/ /rnam par rig tsam skad cig ma/ /rang gsal rgyun gnas spros bral 'dod/ /rang rig skad cig gsal ba dang / /mi gsal sna tshogs rtog bral du/ /rnam med rnal 'byor spyod pa smra/ /dngos rnams stong pa sgyu ma bzhin / /snang yang bdag las rang stong pa/ /sems kyi rtog pa rnam bzlog ste/ /mkha' dbyings dri med rtog rgyun 'chad/ /'di ltar srid pa zhi ba las/ /rnam grol stong nyid snying rje dang / /dbyer med byang chub sems kyi mchog /zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas pa/ /dpal ldan 'dus rin 'dir grub mtha' kun/ /blo yi rim pas 'dir 'dus te/ /de bas 'dir ni chos kun gyi/ /snying po 'dus pa'i rtsa bar gsungs/ /gsang ba bla na med pa'i don/ /ye shes rnam gsum rim 'jug cing / /sgron me 'od gsal snang ba las/ /zung 'jug rdo rje mi phyed pal/ /lha yi 'khor lo sprul nas ni/ /dbyer med mi g.yo ting nge 'dzin/ /mchog ni dri med rang snang las/ /gnyis med ngang du rab zhugs pa'o/ /byang chub sems kyi ngang nyid las/ /rtag tu 'od gsal bar dganas kyang / /'gro ba'i don las 0rimi 'da' bas/ /dam tshig 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ /byang chub sems kyi za ma tog /bde ba can ni mi shigs pa/ /rin chen 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ /bde ba chen po'i byang chub sems/ /'gro ba kun la ster ba ni / /ma chags pa yi ye shes kyis/ /'dod chags 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ /rnam pa sna tshogs sgyu ma las/ /gdon mi za ba gnas med pa/ /'od gsal 'bras bu mngon phyogs pa/ /dam tshig 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ /zag pa 82—359

med pa'i dga' ba yis/ /ye shes chen po'i ros khyab pas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa mnyes gyur pa'i/ /dam tshig bla med ting nge 'dzin/ /yang dag ye shes nor bu ltar / /rin chen 'od 'phro sprin tshogs kyis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rjes su yang ske/ /mnyes byed rdo rje ting nge 'dzin/ /zag pa bsdus byas bde ba las/ /bcu drug 'gyur gyis khyad 'phags pa/ /'dod chags rjes su 'dzin byed pa/ /chags par byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /sku gsung thugs nyid rdo rje las/ /mi phyed 'od gsal bar thim la/ /sgyu ma slu ba rdo rje nyid/ /snang ba thim pas ting nge 'dzin/ /ye shes me long lta bu las/ /srid gsum snang bar mdzad pa ste/ /snang mdzad rdo rje 'khor lo ni/ /mi zad sku yi ting nge 'dzin/ /snang ba gsum las 'das pa yi/ /rang bzhin mngon par byang chub pa/ /rnam par dag pa rdo rje yi/ /'od gsal ba yi ting nge 'dzin/ /srid zhi mnyam nyid mnyam pa'i sku/ /chos rnams gnyis med ro gcig pas/ /rin po che ltar 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yon tan gter gyur ting nge 'dzin/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /gang las 'od gsal chos kyi sku/ /mngon par byang chub pa yi tshul/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin/ /bla med mngon par byang chub pa/ /gsang ba lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /ye shes rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin/ /rtogs pa'i ye shes mchog tu 'gyur / /chos nyid mi zad dbyings kyi ngang / /snang stong tha dad med pa ste/ /ro gcig 'du 'bral med pa nyid/ /stong dang snying rje'i ting nge 'dzin/ /chos rnams thams cad bdag med pas/ /kun du stong zhing ma bcos pa/ /lhun grub rdo rje'i ngang gnas pa/ /phyag rgya chen po'i ting nge 'dzin/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes kyi/ /'od chen rnam par snang bar byed/ /'od gsal 'bar ba rdo 82—360

rje yis/ /tshe dpag med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /snang ba'i dngos po sna tshogs pa//sgyu ma rkyen skyes zil gnon pa/ /rdo rje 'od gsal ting nge 'dzin/ /dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje can/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag rab tu dga' bas khyab cing dgyes pa chen po yongs su spyod par 'gyur ro/ /de nas gsang ba gsum gyi dngos / /rdo rje 'dzin pas 'di gsungs so/ /dka' thub sdom pa mi zad 1pas / /lus skams gyur cing sdug bsngal gyur/ /sdug bsngal gyi (5ni sems byings sate/ /de la cadangos grub gzhan du gyur/ /brjod pa thams cad yi ge ste / /kun gyi rtsa ba a las byung / /de las chos kyi phung po ni/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong dag tu snang / /dbyangs dang gsal byed ngag yin te/ /ngag ni rlung gi rtsa ba can/ /sgrar snang tsam nyid kun rdzob ste/ /thim pa don dam brjod pa'o/ /yang gnas 'di la sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin ni 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i yul la rang gi bsod nams dang ye shes gnyis su med par spyad pa spyod par byed de / rang rig pa'i ye shes sgyu ma dang mtshungs pas spyad pa spyod par byed do/ /'di ltar chos rnams thams cad gzugs brnyan dang / sprul pa dang / sgra brnyan dang / brag ca 5dang / dri za'i grong khyer dang / chu zla dang / smig rgyu dang ske/ rmi lam dang / dbang po'i gzhu dang / sprin dang / mig yor 6dang /glog 7)dang / chu'i chu bur dang / sgyu ma'i rnam par blta ste/ de lta nan yang don dam pa ni rnam par dmigs su med do/ /chos thams cad ni rang bzhin med pa'i phyir rten 'brel tshogs pa'i snang ba dgag tu med do/ /de yang dag par bden pas stong pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / sangs 82—361

rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs 'dus pa rnams kyis mngon par dga' ba'i yid kyis dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la legs so legs so/ /gsang ba'i gnas kyi spyod pa ngo mtshar zhing rmad du rab tu byung ba 17rab tu bstan pa gsang ba'i spyod yul la dgongs te rang rang gi stan la gnas par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las dman pa'i spyod pa las ring zhing lam bde ba chen pos ye shes la rol pa bstan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi gsang / /gsang ba gsum du gnas pa gang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ngor/ /gsang ba rab tu gyur pa gsungs/ /gsang ba'i yi ge rtogs dka' ba/ /ma 'ongs skye bo gdul rin slad du/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams thams cad kyi/ /phyi nang sbas pa rim pas bstan/ /e yi rnam pas lha mo spyan/ /baṃ gi rnam pa bdag mar brjod/ /ma ni lha mo gos dkar mo/ /yā dayi rnam pa sgrol mar brjod/ /shu lani byang chub sems rdo rje/ /ṭ+wāṃ ni shes rab pha rol phyin/ /me long ye shes e zhes brjod/ /ka ni mi bskyod rdo rje ste/ /smin 5zhes don yod grub pa nyid/ /rin chen 'byung ba sa zhes bya/ /'od dpag med pa ma zhes brjod/ /rtag pa'i rdo rje ye zhes pa'o/ /bha ni dri yi rdo rje ma'o / /yi ge ga ni ro rdo rje/ /bān ni gzugs kyi rdo rje ma'o/ /sa yi rnam pa reg rdo rje/ /rba ni sgra yi rdo rje ma/ /ta ni chos dbyings rdo rje yi/ /thā ni sgrib pa rnam par sel/ /ga ni 'jig rten dbang phyug brjod/ /yi ge ta ni sa snying 82—362

po'ol/ /kā ni nam mkha'i snying po ste/ /ya ni phyag na rdo rjer gnas/ /bāka ni kun du bzang po'o/ /tsita ni byams par brjod par bya/ /ta ni 'dod pa'i rgyal po ste/ /skṛ 0)da ya ni snying po nyid/ /ba ni dbyug sngon can du grags/ /dz+ra ni stobs chen 'bar ba ste/ /yo ni mi g.yo gtum po'o/ /ṣid 7mini bya ba nan tan te/ /bha ni gnod mdzes rgyal po'o/ /ge ni gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur/ /ṣā 90ni bgegs mthar byed pa ste/ /bi ni shes rab mthar byed do/ /dza ni gshin rje mthar byed de/ /ha ni mthar byed pad ma 'dzin/ /ra ni so sor rtog pa nyid/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor ba/ /phung po lnga ni sangs rgyas lnga/ /'byung bzhi lha mo bzhi ru brjod/ /yul lnga 'dod yon lha mo lnga/ /rnam shes brgyad ni byang chub sems/ /lus tshigs rdzun)la gnas khro rgyal bcu/ /bsdus pa ye shes lngar sbyor ba/ /bde ba chen po'i ye shes ni/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang gi dngos / /mig dang mi yis gnas pa las/ /de nyid kyis ni sbyar ba yis/ /de las gyur pa'i grangs rnams kyi/ /dkyil 'khor de snyed rnams su 'gyur ge/ /phyogs dang gdengs ka gdong pa dang / /ris byed rigs kyis phye ba gang / /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyur pa ste/ /gzhan du 'phros pa'i dkyil 'khor yin/ /ka nas bzung ste rim bzhin du/ /de bzhin ha yi bar dag tu/ /de dag sna tshogs rgyur gyur pa/ /stong phrag sum cu'i bdag nyid do/ /thabs dang shes rab ngo bo nyid/ /stong phrag sum cu rtsa bzhir 'gyur/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud dang bshad pa dang / /cha mthun yan lag rgyud gyur pas/ /de dag sde dang bcas pa yis/ /gsang chen rgyud sder brjod par bya/ /rnal 'byor rgyud ni thams cad du/ /lha 'di rnams ni thog mar bzhugs/ /'dis ni rgyud rnams gsang 82—363

chen kun/ /rnal 'byor rgyud ces rgyas btab pa'o/ /mdo sde rnams la gnas sogs 1pa/ /thun mong dbye bas phye ba nyid/ /yi ge bzhi ni thun mong du/ /bsdus pas chos kyi bdag nyid can/ /mdo kun yul du gyur pa'o/ /gsang ba'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /nyan thos rang rgyal la sogs pas/ /rnam pa kun du ma bshad de/ /'di skad bdag ces dang por brjod/ /dus gcig dus gsum skad cig ste/ /ston pa rang 'byung che ba'i sku/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bde bar gshegs/ /de bzhin du ni rtag tshonagashegs la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje zhes/ /pad+ma'i ming can btsun mo'i gnas/ /der ni mngon par bzhugs par mdzad/ /btsun mo rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /rin chen chos dang bcas pa yi/ /rdo rje las kyi sems mar brjod/ /de dag kun gyi bde ba'i gnas / /bskyed dang sdud par mdzad pa po/ /thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid can/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / / yul rnams mthams cad rten pa'i gzhi/ /yang dag btsun mo'i bha ga der/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams/ /mngon par rab tu zhugs mdzad de/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i ngo bo nyid/ /rab tu mi gnas dbyer med bzhugs/ /mdo dang gsang bar spyod pa'i tshul/ /don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i 5dbang byas phyir/ /gsang sngags theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /gsang ba bya ba spyod pa'i rgyud/ /shin tu ches gsang rnal 'byor rgyud/ /rnal 'byor bla med gsang chen no/ /'di ni sku gsung thugs gsang ba/ /mtshan dang dpe byad rnams dang ni/ /rjod 6byed rang gi mtshan nyid de/ /phung po khams dang skye mched sogs/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor la 82—364

zhugs pa(7/ /rten dang brten tsho par bcas pa ni/ /mkhas pa rnams la bsngags pa yin/ /rmongs pa de ltar 'dod pa rnams/ /skye dang 'jig dang gnas pa dang / /rgyud gzhan rnams la nges bstan (sne)pa/ /rtag tu rten 'brel tshul de brjod/ /'bras bu rgyus ni rgyas btab cing / /rgyu la 'bras bus rgyas gdab ci)par/ /bsam gyi gzhar 9gedu dngos grub ni/ /bskal pa bye bar yang mi 'gyural/ /rgyud kun la ni gsang chen gyi/ /snying po phyag rgyas rgyas gdab phyir/ /de nyid gsang ba yang (6)dag par/ /mi phyed par ni bstan pa yin(7)/ /sems can kun gyi lus gnas pa/ /sku yi gsang ba rtag pa nyid/ /sems can kun gyi ngag la ni/ /gsung gi gsang ba rang byung du/ /sems can kun gyi snying la ni/ /thugs kyi gsang ba snying po bzhugs/ /de nyid snying po gsum ldan pa/ /bde gshegs snying po 'jug pa nyid/ /sems can sangs rgyas sgras btags so/ /sku yi dngos grub snang ba'i dngos/ /mi zad sprul pas 'gro don spyod/ /gsung gi dngos grub brag ca ri ltar/ /brjod pa du ma'i sgra ru ston/ /thugs kyi dngos grub rtog pa'i tshogs/ /ye shes bde chen bsam mi khyab/ /ting 'dzin sems kyi spyod pa ni/ /stong nyid ye shes dngos grub bo/ /de nyid byang chub sems rdo rje / /bla ma nyid du bsdus pa yin/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'dzin pas dug 9tu 'gyur ba yin/ /dug nyid nye bar zhi gyur na/ /dag pas dug med byas pa yin/ /bdud rtsi 1 ririm gyis bsten 3)na ni/ /bdud rtsi nyid du nges 'gyur yin/ /de nyid ngo bo yongs shes pas/ /rgyud 'dir lam du gyur pa yin / /sngags 'dun 12thabs dang shes rab ste/ /dbyer med de 1 bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs/ /shes rab bha ga'i brdar brtags pas/ /dbyangs su 82wa 365

brjod pa gsang ba'i tshul/ / ā li 1)bcu gnyis rten 'brel te/ /ma rig la (kyesogs 'gag par bstanarin/ /ro hi ta (pel sogs pa dang / /khyim ni bcu gnyis rlung dag ste/ /dus sbyor ba dang mtshungs pas na/ /lugs 'byung de nyid lugs bzlog par/ /de nyid yang dag rim pas bstan/ /kā (geli sum cu rtsa bzhi 6 po/ /thabs kyi yi ge pha (7)zhes brjod/ /mi gtsang rdzas ni sum cu bzhi / /dag pa byang sems rang bzhin te/ /khams ni rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i / /de dag dag na pas 99)ye shes che/ /dag pa'i dus ni dpe ⑩byad dag /nyis 'gyur dag gis bstan pa ste/ /thabs dang shes rab phrag gnyis bstan/ /ā 11li shes rab ma ning bcas/ /'di dag mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis/ /cha gnyis rab tu dbye ba yis/ /sems can kun gyi lus gnas pa/ /kla zhes bya ba chu yin te/ /sla zhes bya ba sa yin no/ /l+la zhes bya ba me yin te/ /bla zhes bya ba rlung yin te/ /'byung bzhi'i dbye ba ma ning ste/ /ye shes dag pa chen po nyid12 / /yang dag lam gsal phyogs tsam dang / /mi gsal ba nyid rgyud las 'byung ske/ /rkyen nyid tshogs gnyis rdzogs byed pa/ /bsod nams bla med 'bras bur 'gyur/ /gzhi ni khong na gnos pa'i don/ /sems can kun gyi lus la gnas / /de yod pas na 'gro kun kyang / /ye shes snying po can gyur pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyu ru bshad/ /ma ning ye shes dag pa nyid/ /gnyis med ye shes 'bar ba yi/ /ā 12li snang ba thabs kyi cha/ /mched 7pa ka sogs shes rab cha15/ /ma ning thob pa gnyis med pa'o/ /sbyor ba don gyi yi ge bzhi/ /sbas pa'i tshul du bstan pa'o/ /char 17ni stong pa tsheg nyi drag dang / /thig les brgyan pa bde ba che/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la/ /kun du bzang po 82wa 366

sems dpa' ches/ /gsang ba zab dang rgya che ba'o/ /lhag pa'i gsang chen ①rgyud kyi don/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen rnams/ /khyad par nges shes bskyed don du/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa nges gsal ba'i/ /bla med dgongs rgyud bshad du gsol/ /de nas gsang ba 'dzin pa po/ /rdo rje 'chang ba tshul 'di dag /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sbas pa'i don/ /gsang ba rin chen snying po gsungs / /gsang chen gling gzhi'i (mikhyad par dang / /rim pa gleng slong gyur pa dang / /gsang bar bya ba'i gzhi gang dang / /gsang ba'i dam tshig nges pa dang ske/ /gsang ba bsgrub pa'i cho ga dang / /'jug pa'i rnal 'byor ji ltar bstan / /gsang chen rnam bshad thabs dang ni/ /de nyid dang 'brel brjod bya gang ske/ /rjod dbyed thun mong bstan pa'i tshul/ /lam la 'jug pa'i dbye ba dang ske/ /gsang ba grub pa'i 'bras bu dang / /gsang ba lhag pa'i lam dang ni/ /gsang ba mchog gi spyod pa dang / /gsang chen rnam par bsdu ba'i don/ /mi 'gyur rkyen gyis ldog bya dang / /dgag sgrub gsang chen 'byung ba'i tshul/ /phyogs dang thub pa'i rnam dbye ba'i/ /gsang ba 'di dag gnas zhes bya/ /'di nyid 'jug pa'i tshul shes nas/ /grub pa sgrub pa'i tshul spyod do/ /gsang ba rnam par dag pa ye shes kyi ting nge 'dzin bstan pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /dang po'i mgon po bcom ldan 'das/ /dpal mchog gsang ba 'dzin pa yis/ /'dus pa'i 'khor la 94)bka' stsal pa/ /gsang ba zab pa'i rgyud 'di ru/ /spyod pa'i tshul 'di shes par bya/ /dang po'i sa ni pad+ma ltar/ /ge sar kha dbye'i 'od 'bar ba'o/ /gnyis pa chu rgyun lta bu ste/ /dri ma sbyong zhing 'byed 5par 'gyur/ /gsum pa rab tu gsal ba yi/ /'gro ba'i snang ba 82—367

ye shes sgron/ /bzhi pa ye shes 'od 'phro ba/ /nyi ma'i snying po ltar 'char pa'o/ /lnga pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ltar/ /'dzag dang smin (17cing sdud pas sbyor/ /drug pa sgyu ma'i gzugs brnyan ltar/ /chos rnams rang bzhin shes pa'o/ /bdun pa lta ngan phyogs las ni/ /rgyal 'gyur rdogeseng ge'i rgyal po bzhin/ /ri bo mchog ltar ting 'dzin rgyal/ /ji srid rlung ni mi rgyu dang / /snang ba mi g.yo bar gyur (ldepas / /bdag gi dngos por rab tu brtag /thabs ldan (4byang chub sems mchog gis/ /don mdzad 'khor los sgyur ba'i stobs/ /legs thob phyir mi ldog pa'i lam/ /sems dpa' chen po bla ma nyid/ /ji srid sprin ni sna tshogs pa / /kha dog dbyibs ni tha dad pa/ /mkha' dbyings dag tu 'byung 'gyur zhing ske/ /deng 5nyid du ni ldog par 'gyur/ /de bzhin rang bzhin thams cad kyang 6/ /snang ba gsum gyi rgyun chad dngos/ /ma lus yul la zhugs nas ni/ /de nyid du ni rang thim 'gyur/ /snang ba gsum po dag pa'i lam/ /rin chen sprin gyis 'gro don du/ /bsam pa'i tshul gyis char pa 'bebs/ /'dod chags rnam par dag pa'i dngos/ /de nyid byang chub sems dpa'i yul/ /'di ltar zhe sdang rnam par dag /de nyid byang chub sems dpa'i gnas/ /gang du gti mug dag pa'i ngang / /de ni byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /snang ba dag pa'i yul gyur pa/ /thams cad 'od gsal ngang gnas pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mngon 'dus pa'i/ /'od zer snang ba bsam gtan mes/ /dri ma ma lus sbyangs gyur pas/ /mngon par byang chub dag pa'o/ /ye shes chen po'i 7dri ma med / /snang ba med cing dngos med pa'i/ /ma 'dres 'od kyi snang ba 'gyed/ /pad+mo rin chen ge sar las/ /nor bu sna tshogs sdong pos brgyan/ /ma rig 82—368

mun sel chu bo'i rgyun/ /thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa/ /bde chen sa ni bcu gnyis pa/ /nam mkha' lta bur bdag med pas1)/ /rab tu mi gnas dngos med pa'o/ /zung 'jug chen po dag pa'i sku/ /thams cad mkhyen pa rtog med pa'i(na / /sku gsum rdo rjer gcig pa'i bdag /sar gyur pa ni bcu gsum pa/ /btsun mo'i bha ga bde can du/ /rang 'byung 'gyur ba med par bzhugs / /'phags lam yan lag brgyad pa gang / /dbang phyug brgyad ni dag pa'i dngos/ /sgom pa'i lam ni 'di nyid du/ /lam gyi khyad par bstan pa'o/ /mthong lam yan lag bdun ldan dpa/ /sku gsum rtogs phyir yan lag brjod/ /tshogs lam dang po dag la ni/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gang / /smin rnyi/byed dbang gis gzhi bzung bas/ /bum dbang lus ni lha ru ste/ /gsang dbang tshor ba bde ba nyid/ /gsum pa chos ni ye shes dran/ /bzhi pa sems ni 'od gsal du/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag phyir brjod/ /tshogs lam bar pa nyid la ni//ting 'dzin ma skyes bskyed pa dang / /skyes pa brtan phyir bogs dbyung dang / /yang dag spong ba bzhi po dag /de nyid goms par byed pa la/ /dgag 5dang bsgrub pa'i phyogs gyur pa/ /spangs thob rim par ldan par brjod/ /tshogs lam chen por gyur pa dag /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhir nges pa/ /chu rlung rdo rje mgon po yi/ /mā ma tī yi rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /snying ga'i gnas su yang dag ldan/ /me rlung pad+ma mgon po yi/ /gos dkar mo yi rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /gyen rgyu mgrin par brjod par bya/ /sa rlung rin chen mgon po yi/ /sangs rgyas spyan ma'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /thur sel gsang bar brjod pa nyid/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor lte bar ni/ /las kyi mgon po'i rigs dag pa'i/ /lha mo sgrol ma'i rdzu 'phrul gyis//82—369
