me dang mnyam pa'i las zhes bya/ /re re'ang lha mo bzhi bzhi ste/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi dang ldan pa yi/ /lam du rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis brjod/ /gnad ni rnam pa bzhi dag ste/ /lus dang dus dang yul dang ni/ /rlung gi gnad du shes par bya/ /dang po'i ye shes bla na med/ /pad+ma ltar gsal rab 'bar ba sa ni thog mar mngon par bde/ /rgyu lam yan lag bdun ldan pa/ /'jug 1)gnas rgyu lam rang bzhin bcas/ /dbang gis 'jug 9bdang rang byin brlab/ /phyi nang gsang ba mchog tu gyur/ /'bru gsum e bam̐ ma yar bcas 'bras bu snying po phyag rgya che/ /rang bzhin med pa dag pa'i dbyings/ /'od gsal mngon par byang chub pa/ /tshad med snying rje bsdu dngos kyis/ /nges par rab gang mi dmigs pa'o/ /sems can sna tshogs 'dul don du/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni yang dang yang / /sems bskyed gyur pas lam sbyangs te/ /mdzad pa du ma'i cho 'phrul rnams/ /rgyun mi 'chad phyir sems bskyed pa'o/ /dri med sems ni rnam kun du/ /rang rig ye shes thogs med pas/ /'gag pa med cing skye med kyang / /sems can don du 'khor zhing lding / /byang chub sems ni mi zad pa/ /de phyir phrin las rgyun mi 'chad/ /rnam par mi rtog mi dmigs pas / /kun mkhyen ye shes nam mkha'i dbyings/ /gdul bya'i khams dang mthun par 'jug /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sgyu 'phrul gar/ /de ni sprul pa'i sku zhes brjod/ /rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /yon tan du mas rab brgyan cing / /mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba dang / /ye shes skus 95)ni gzhan don phyir/ /snang ba'i 'od 'byed 94nodag pa'i don/ /rtag tu bde ba can du bzhugasal/ /bde ba chen po dbyer med cing / /thabs dang shes rab mi phyed 82—370

pa'i / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das/ /kha sbyar sbyor ba gsang ba che / /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor ba/ /me tog dang ni de yi dri/ /dbyer med rten dang brten 3)par gnas/ /mchog tu dag pa bdag med pa/ /sku gsum tha dad bstan pa ni/ /gdul bya'i dbang la gyur pa yin/ /khyad par yan lag nges par ni/ /sku gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i don/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsang chen mchog /'bras bu rdo rje'i theg pa zhes/ /thams cad mkhyen pas bshad pa yin / /sbyor ba'i lam las yan lag bcu/ /rlung gi gnas su brjod par bya/ /rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dbang po lnga/ /stobs lnga de yi khyad par te/ yan lag rlung gi gnas pa yin/ /snga ma'i go rims chal ltos nas/ /khyad par gong du 'phel ba sten(dkyi / /dad pa la bsogs chos rnams yin/ /'bras bu'i dus su sangs rgyas kyi / /gsang ba ye shes stobs bcur ni/ /gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pa sogs / /khyad par thob pa bstan pa'o/ /mthar phyin lam ni rnam gnyis te/ /slob pa'i zung 'jug dang po yin/ /rang rang rig tu bcas pa yi7zhe/ /tha dad med pa'i bde ba'i lam/ /rang bzhin dag pa gzugs kyi sku/ /blo (6bur dri ma rnam bsal ba/ /mnyam rjes khyad par gang gyur pa/ /rtog pa sbyang ba sems mngon gyur/ /'dir ni ngo bo nyid med pa/ /de nyid chos rnams chos nyid de/ /de ni yang dag mi slu ba/ /de rtogs sangs rgyas yin zhes brjod/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes lam/ /sangs rgyas snying po byang chub sems/ /stong nyid seng ge'i nga ro yis57)/ /log par lta ba'i tshogs skrag na mdzad/ /de las snang ba med pa'i dbyings/ /sku gsum yongs su 'byung dang po/ /mi slob zung 'jug gnyis pa ste/ /dbyer med rig ma'i skyes bur bcas/ /rgyas btab drug ldan bde ba 82—371

che / /lhan cig skyes pa'i rol par 'char/ /ngo bo nyid kyis dag pa ste/ /sems nyid 'od gsal snying po nyid/ /chos sku dri ma med pa las/ /lus sbyangs ye shes ro gcig pa/ /rdul bral bcing 3)grol med pa nyid/ /ting 'dzin mnyam nyid tha dad med/ /byang chub mchog ces bstan pa yin/ /'od gsal de nyid dus kun du/ /chos nyid dang ni bsam gtan dang / /lam du byed pa'i ting 'dzin las/ /brgyal dang gnyid dang snyoms 'jug ste(2/ /thams cad du ni 'gyur bā med/ /rang gis 'phrog cing rang gis ster/ /sa bon rkyen dang phrad pa bzhin/ /myu gu rten 'brel tshogs las 'byung / /rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi sa dang lam rnam par nges pas bstan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /'di ni gsang ba thams cad kyi/ / yi ge (geganas kyi ston pa po / /shrī gnyis med ye shes mchog grub pa/ /bde legs kun gyi gzhir gyur pa'i/ /dpal ldan rnam par thar pa'i sgo/ /shes rab snying rje dbyer med pa'o/ /gsang ba'i snying po bla na med/ /mthar thug chos rnams rab 'jug pa/ /sgyu ma'i rol pa bsam mi khyab/ /byang chub sems las kun du 'byung / /bde ba mchog las mchog grub pa/ /'khor 'das spang 5thob med pa nyid/ /srid zhi mnyam 6pa nyid rtog 97pal/ /byang chub sems kyi spyod yul can/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis bstan pa'i lam/ /bde don spros med ngang du 'dus/ /khams gsum rlung las sprul pa ni/ /rnam par shes pa yul la 'jug /de las bdag dang gzhan du rtog /rten bcas rang stong g.yo ba yin/ /'dir ni rlung sems 'dres pa las/ /snang ba gsum gyi rang bzhin 'char/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyis bdag dang gzhan/ /tha dad mi rtog spyad pa bya/ /kun gyi bla mar gyur pa ni/ /mchog gi phyag rgya chen po'i 82—372

gnasal/ /kun rdzob snang ba sna tshogs pa/ /ngo bo nyid kyis (17rang stong pa/ /gnas gsum tshul ni rgyud gzhan las/ /snying po 'od gsal mngon byang chub/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i yul las gzhan/ /ting 'dzin nges par 'dir bstan pa'o/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi(5)/ /gsang chen rgyal po zung 'jug lam/ /sku gsum dbyer med nam mkha'i ngang / /ye shes tha snyad las 'das pa'o/ /yon tan rdzogs shing kun dbang sgyur/ /mchog ldan rgyal po mdzes shing 'bar/ /zab dang rgya che gnyis su med/ /rang gzhan tsho ciganyis med chen po yin/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du rnam bshad pa/ /lha mo rnams dang skyes bu yi/ /gsang ba'i rgyud 'dir gnyis med brjod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa las gnyis su med par ston pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen gyi gnas nges par bstan pa mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes gtan la phab pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste nyer gnyis pa'ol brtag pa gnyis pa rnam par nges pa gsal ba zhes bya ba ste gsang ba'i dpal mchog chen po ye shes kyi de kho na nyid rab tu brjod pa'o/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin / /sku gsum mchog tu brtag pa nyid/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje gsum gyi ngang / /brtan zhing mchog tu bzang po che/ /snying po byang chub bla med pas/ /gsang ba dam pa bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rnam pa gsal zhing dag pa'i sku/ /bsdus pa'i pho brang rgya che bas/ /mi bskyod rdo rje sems 82—373

dpa' dag /gcig tu gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /khyab 917par snang mdzad dkon mchog dpal/ /'od dpag med dang gdon mi za/ /rigs kyi dbye ba lnga ru brjod / /spyan dang mā ma tī mchog dang / /gos dkar mo dang sgrol byed ma/ /mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor gnas pa yi/ /gzugs sgra dri ro lha mo bzhi/ /bar khyams gnas pa grwa bzhir dgod/ /byams pa sa yi snying po dang / /phyag na rdo rje mkha' snying po/ /'jig rten dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /sgrib sel kun du bzang po ste/ /sems dpa' brgyad ni lha khyams la(mi/ /khro rgyal bzhi dang ldan pas na/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga nang du dgod/ /phyi khyams dag la khro rgyal drug /de ltar sum cu rtsa gcig gis/ /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bsdus pa yin/ /phyag na rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba/ /tshangs pa chos kyi 'khor lo ste/ /sum cu gsum par gnas pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bskur ba mnyam pa nyid ye shes ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin nyid du mngon par brjod pa'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi'i zla ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje mi dmigs pa'i ye shes 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams du mar snang ba'i dngos/ /ljon shing 'bras bu ldan pa bzhin/ /phra ba'i dbye ba shes par bya/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shin tu gzigs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i spyod tshul kun tu ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i 47ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gnas med gnas pa'i mkha' lta bur/ /mi rtog rang byung 5'od gsal ba/ /don dam dmigs med ngo 82—374

bo nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes 'bar bas rab tu brgyan pa zhes bya ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba dag par sdom pa'i ngo bo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du chos rnams dngos med cing / /ngo bo nyid dag ye shes sku/ /bden pa 1'dis ni khyab par byed/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan na pa'o/ /zhes gsungs sol/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nor bu'i ri chi'od kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid ye shes gcig pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'khor ba skyug bro rmongs pa can / /rab rib ldan pa'i rtog pa nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mchog /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab brtsegs pa'i rtse mo rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rgya mtsho ltar mi phyed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dpag med ye shes rgyal mtshan tog /yid bzhin nor bu'i snying po las/ /rang bzhin 54bde chen gnas mchog 'grub//byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen lha'i lha sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gzi brjid mtha' yas pa'i 'od 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rgyal ba ma lus kun gyi gsang / /ye shes rol pa bde ba che/ /tha dad spangs pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa don gnas gzigs pa dag pa'i 82—375

dbyings kun nas sprin gyi snang ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems//tshad med bde ba'i char 'bebs pa/ /rang 'byung ye shes rgyal po nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsam pa rdzogs pa dpal rgyal po bden pa gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo kun tu 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'di ni rgyal ba ma lus pa'i/ /ye shes sku ste skyon med pa/ /bsam pa blo yi yul las snang / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med pa'i dpal rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po yang dag par 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /kun snang ye shes cir mi rtog /nam mkha'i dri med mtha' khyab stong / /rnam rtog ye shes me 'bar sku/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa kun du rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba rdo rje dbyings sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhing khams rin po che'i sprin kun du ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dri ma med pa dag pa'i zhing / /pad+mo rgyas pa snang ba'i dbyings/ /rin chen 'od 13'phro mi zad dang / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sra ba'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rol pa ston pa'i dpal rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun nas 'od kyi phreng ba dam pa'i dkyil 'khor 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te 82—376

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad sems su gcig /de nyid ye shes dag pa'i ngang / /dbyer med rtag pa'i tshul mchog ste/ /bde gshegs gsang ba 'byung 1)ba'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa me tog spyan yangs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mnga' dbang dam pa rnam par 'phrul ba dri ma med pa'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes dbyings//gsang ba 'gro snying rnam dag pas/ /blang dor med pa'i bde ba thob/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rnam par dbyes pa'i sku'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dbyangs kun du sgrogs (na pa'i snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i dba' /rlabs kun/ /dbu mar gcig tu thim gyur pas/ /ye shes rgyas pa'i snying po dbye/ byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa chos kyi 'od zer 'byung ba rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po'i ye shes 'byung ba dam pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs 4te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /kun du seng ge'i rtsal gyis ni/ /zil gyis gnon pa rdo rje zhes/ /yongs su bsdu ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od gsal ba'i yon tan 'byung ba rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgyes pa'i yon tan du ma ston pa mi gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /kun nas snang ba med pa'i ngang / /rtog pas bskyod 82—377

par mi 'gyur ba/ /mnyam nyid ye shes lhang nge bzhugs/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das zla ba'i zhal mnga' ba rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sgyu ma'i rol pa sna tshogs su ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'byung ba rnams dang srog bcas dang / /mi zad rtsa lcug ma lus kun/ /de bzhin nyid las snang ba yin/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs sol/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu 'od mi zad pa'i rin chen sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 'gro ba'i mig rnam par sbyong ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du lus can thams cad la/ /gdul bya dus la bab gyur na/ /nam mkha' las kyang sgra byung nas / /chos kyi 'byung gnas der ston mdzad/ /ces gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen dkon pa'i tog rang 'byung du 'char ba'i ye shes rol ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'di ni rang 'byung ston pa po1/ /ye shes 'jug pa 'bad med par/ /thob bya byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /rang rig rang las rnyed par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bla ma phan par grags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku kun du ston cing 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so//dus gsum pa yi sangs rgyas rnams/ /dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i 'khor lo dag /gdul bya'i blo yis mthong bar byed/ /de nyid bsam pa'i tshul gyis 'byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rdo rje 'dzin/ /tshe 'dis 'grub gyi 82—378

gzhan du min/ /lus ngag yid ni legs gnas pa/ /med par 'grub par mi 'gyur gsungs/ /gsung (1)gcig rdo rje 'dzin pa che/ /thub pa chen po rnam par rgyal / /gnyis med mnyam pa'i rgyal po che/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod rgyun mi 'chad / /'di med rol pa rgyu med 'gyur/ /ji ltar 'dod pa nyer bsten pa/ /zhen med ye shes longs spyod pa/ /bde bar bstan pas sangs rgyas 'thob(5 /ces gsungs te/ yang dag pa'i longs spyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las/ shin tu bde ba chen po'i gnas/ mngon par ston pa'i le'u ste nyer gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas snang ba mi zad pa'i ye shes rab tu 'byed pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nam mkha'i gnas mi 'gyur ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du dmigs pa kun bral ba'i/ /snying rje chen po'i 'od zer gyis/ /yul rnams sgyu mar spyad dpar bya/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer dpag med gzi brjid mtshungs pa med pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi snying po gsang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du stong nyid chos kyi sku/ /de nyid snying rje dbyer mi phyed/ /'bras bu snying po byang chub 82—379

sems / /ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dus mkhyen dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gdugs khyab par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'gro ba ma lus kun gyi snying / /mi shigs ye shes gcig pur bzhugs / /'gro 'ong med cing khyab par 'byung / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes stobs mchog seng ge'i sgra 1can sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 'gro ba kun la rang bzhin nagyis dbang bskur ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ngo bo nyid kyis dus gsum du/ /phyogs bcu'i sems can ma lus la/ /rgyal ba kun gyis dbang bskur mdzad/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par sbyangs pa'i 3mkhas pa'i blo can sangs rgyas thams cad kyis khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /khams gsum skye (4'gyur lus can gyi/ /lus ngag sems ni mi dmigs par/ /byang chub snying por dbang bskur mdzad/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal bar dka' ba'i blo can sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 5'gro ba rnams la yang dag par rtogs pa'i dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 0ye shes dbang / /rtag cing khyab pa'i tshul du bskur/ /de nyid rnam dag dbang bskur mchog /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas 82—380

de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan phung po mi zad pa sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes kyi 'tsho ba ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /glang chen myos 'dra'i spyod spangs nas/ /bar snang bya bzhin rjes chags med/ /thams cad dus su snyoms par spyad17/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tog gi zla ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod snyoms spyod pa dran par bya ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du grong khyer rgyu ba sogs/ /sna tshogs spyod lam bag yod pas/ /dran pas ma yengs gzhan don phyir/ /byang chub tshul 'di spyad 2pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so//de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mthu chen thob sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyod lam rnam par dag pa'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du 'gro dang 'chag pa dang / /nyal dang zas kyi dus la sogs/ /byang chub sems kyi ngang las ni/ /ma yengs tshul bzhin spyad par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mthu stobs mtha' yas pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun du spyod pa snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so//tshul bzhin ma yin rnam spangs nas/ /bag med gnas las bzlog par bya/ /'di ni ye shes bdud rtsi yin/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba rnam par dag pa'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyod pa dag pa'i snang ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du 82—381

lus sems bde gnas shing / /ldog pa med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /dkar po'i chos la spyod par 1bya/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs sol/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa don thams cad gzigs pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lta ba rnam par dag pa'i gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos/ /chud mi za ba nges 'byung phyir/ /shin tu dag (0tshe sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /de nyid phra ba rtogs par dka'/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mthu stobs mtha' yas rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun du spyod pa snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /tshul bzhin ma yin rnam spangs nas/ /bag med gnas las bzlog par bya/ /'di ni ye shes bdud rtsi yin/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa yin / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dpa' bo chen po rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nges pa'i lta ba yang dag pa dran pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dag pa'i 'bras bu bde ba ste/ /ma dag pa las srid par ltung / /rnam par nges pas ye shes che/ /byang chub 4)tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'byor ldan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nges pa'i lam rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi nges 'byung lam/ /de ni thar ba'i rgyal mtshan te/ /rang sems dag pa tshul khrims mchog /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de 82—382

bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams rab rgyas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams mi zad pa'i gter 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bla na med pa'i nor bu ni/ /zhen med ye shes rgya mtsho che/ /kun du longs spyod rang las 'byung / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan 'bar ba'i 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 'gro ba skyob pa dpal rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /byang chub ye shes nam mkha' ltar/ /bdag med phung po la (1)sogs stong / /stong nyid sgyu mas 9gesnying rjer gnas/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs sol/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa snying po thugs yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi (2)gnas pa med pa'i tshul rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas thugs ni chos kyi dbyings/ /'gyur ba med cing kun rtog bral/ /mi g.yo mtshan ma med pa nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa legs skyes ri4risangs rgyas thams cad kyis 95༄'gro ba'i gdung ba sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mi shes nyon mongs nad kyis gziratsi/ /de sel dam pa'i bdud rtsi bstan/ /bla med thugs rje'i mo sman gyis gso/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs sol/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lha chen po nor 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 8)rol pa 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi 9sems 'di gsungs so/ /'phags pa rnams kyis sbyangs pa'i lam/ /nang las 82—383

byung 1gi phyi las min/ /de nyid 'bras bu mchog las skyes/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yid gnyis spong sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang sngags kyi tshul byin gyis rlob lapa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so//'dir ni khyad par byin rlob cing / /dpag med bde bar gshegs pa yis/ /dus drug tu ni byin rlob pa / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis med ye shes dag pa las/ /ci ste min na ldog (depa ltar/ /de bas sdug bsngal brgyud ma las/ /mthar phyin sngags kyis 6)byin brlabs (7pa'i / /mkhas pa dag ni ye shes spyod/ /ji ltar chu yi thigs du pa ni/ /rgya mtshor bab na lan tshur gyur/ /lan tshwa 'o ma'i mtshor zhugs pas/ /de nyid slar yang bdud rtsir 'gyur/ /dag pas dug med byas nas ni/ /ye shes bdud rtsi longs spyod pa'o/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer bzhi pa'o de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dpag med stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyis rlob pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ /bdag po de nyid kun 'dus pa/ /rig pa'i rgyal pos byin 82—384

gyis rlob91)/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mchog tu srid tshon pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bla na med pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mo da'abyung ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs pa rnams/ /so so'i rig pa'i rtsal gyis ni/ /snying po gcig par shes par bya/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bcom pa med pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnga sgra'i dbyangs kyis 'gro ba bskul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du zhing khams sbyong ba 4nodang / /gang du 'gro ba 'dul ba dag /nam mkha'i dbyings kyis kun du brdung / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi gnas pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams rang byung 5stong nyid sgra/ /gdul bya mos pa'i snang ba la/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis kun du rbesgrags / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bde gnas dbang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zab pa'i gnas mi phyed pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams zag med 'od gsal ba/ /skye ba med cing shin tu phra/ /mtshan nyid dngos pos 6stong pa'i 75chos/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshogs can gtso bo sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin mi zad pa 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya 82—385

ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sna tshogs sems can sems rgyud ni/ /ngo bo nyid kyis rang stong pas/ /mi phyed ye shes gnas pa po/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'gro ba'i 'od zer sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od zer 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /kun du ma smin smin byed dang / /smin pa grol phyir 'bad pa ste/ /ye shes spyod pa byang chub che/ /gsang ba tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa phal chen rgyal ba kun du rtog pa nges par sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dngos po mi rtag skad cig ma/ /de nyid slu ba'i chos can phyir/ /'dzin pa med pa'i gnas zhes bya/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid mtha' yas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi sgo la 'jug pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i tshosangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ngo bo nyid kyi nadag pa'i dngos/ /dbu ma ye shes rtog bral bas/ /mtha' las 'das pa zung du 'jug /gsang ba gnyis med tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa don gyi blo gros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas la 'jug pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams thams cad skye ba med/ /chos gang 'gag par 'gyur ba med/ /rnam par rtog pa rab 82—386

zhi ba/ /de nyid byang chub tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bla /①med sman pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rtog pa'i dra ba gcod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i bdag /rtog pa med cing dmigs med pas/ /mtha' yas dri ma med pa'i sku/ /snying po byang chub tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa srid pa'i gdul dka' ba spangs pa zhes bya ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 'brug sgra'i dbyangs sgrogs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /snying po rdo rje stong nyid dang / /dbyer med lhan cig skyes pa'i bdag /rtog pa med cing dmigs rin/med pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dag pa'i stobs rims mind med pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi seng ge'i sgra bsgrags (sku)pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du nad rnams bya ba'i gzhi/ /las dang nyon mongs rtog las spyad/ /de nyid gnas las dag par bya/ /thams cad ye shes spyod pas sbyong lde)/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa legs par snang ba'i dpal sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi ljon shing dag pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa mchog /gsang ba zab dang rgya che'i dbyings/ /spang blang med par grol ba nyid/ /gnyug ma byang chub tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa grags pas byin sangs rgyas thams 82—387

cad kyi ye shes kyi snying po don sgyu 'phrul ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /gcig las du mar snang byed tsho1)cing / /de nyid du mar yongs sprul pa/ /sgyu 'phrul byang chub tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa me tog sbyin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsam gtan 'dzin pa rdo rje 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'byung ba rnams dang khams gsum dang / /rnam shes ye shes khams 'dus pa/ /rten dang brten (5pa sbyang bar bya/ /gsang ba tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bus byin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi nyi ma'i snang ba kun du ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so//srid pa dag pas snang ba dag /rang lus dag pas rnam (5)shes dag /ye shes spyod pas 4rnam par sbyang / /'di ni rdo rje'i tshul mchog yin/ /zhes gsungs sol/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje sde sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshul zla ba'i snang ba 5zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du rmi lam dag par ni/ /rdo rje blo yis rnam par sbyang ske/ /de nyid ye shes rgyal ba yis/ /bdud las rnam par rgyal bar bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje phal cher 6sbyin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba pad+mo rnam par rol pa'i 97'od zer 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /zhing khams kun gyi snang ba'i gnas/ /rin chen 'od kyis rnam 82—388

par spras/ /sgyu ma tsam du ston pa nyid/ /snying po ye shes gzhir gyur pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba'i blo gros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhing ma lus par bkod pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho sprin tshogs las/ /dus gsum kun tu dge ba yi/ /zhing khams ye shes 'od kyi skul/ /chos rnams sems kyi snang las 'byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /gsang ba'i dbang phyug bcom ldan gyis/ /ye shes spyod pas bsgrub pa yi/ /lhan cig spyod pa bka' stsal to/ /ji ltar mi gnas nam mkha' ni/ /khyab cing mtshan nyid med pa nyid/ /don dam de nyid dmigs med de/ /brjod pa spangs pa stong pa che/ /mi shigs gsang ba bla na med/ /kun du bzang po zhes grags pa/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug phyag rgya che/ /ye shes rtag pas chos kyi sku/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan gang / /rnam pa gsal bar 'char ba ltar/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas ye shes ni/ /snang ba me long lta bur brjod / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /ye shes rang rig gzhan rig pa / /tha dad med par thugs chud pas/ /de nyid mnyam nyid ye shes brjod/ /gdod nas dag cing skye ba med/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal ba/ /phan tshun khyab pa'i ye shes la/ /so sor rtog pa zhes brjod do/ /kun nas ma lus sangs rgyas kyi/ /mdzad pa sna tshogs la spyod pas/ /bde bar gshegs gnas gcig mdzad pas/ /khyab pa nan tan ye shes brjod/ /gang tshe nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib/ /thams cad las grol de yi tshe/ /rnal 'byor mchog thob rdo rje 'dzin / /shin tu rnam dag ye shes brjod/ /mchog gyur rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 82—389

ni / /chos rnams ngo bo nyid med pas/ /rab tu mi gnas ye shes gzhi/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o/ /rang byung dri ma med pa ni/ /rtog pa thams cab yang dag spangs/ /dngos dang dngos med rang bzhin gyis/ /gnyis kyi bag chags 'ching ba nyid/ /mi rtog pa yi rang bzhin gyis/ /bsam mi khyab pa nyid kyis gcod/ /rtog pa'i dri ma'i dra ba yis/ /rin chen sems ni dri mar byas / /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes nyid/ /dri ma bral phyir sangs rgyas brjod/ /ces byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po la sogs pa rnams kyis gsang chen gyi 1tshoganas yongs su brjod pa la rab tu dga' ba'i don ched du brjod do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang /thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes mngon par rol pa bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer lnga pa'o// //de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /thams cad stong pa mi 'gyur che/ /ye shes dam pa ston pa pos/ /kun du gsang ba bka' stsal to/ /dam chos snying po bcud las byung / /sangs rgyas mchod pa bla med pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul/ /shes rab thabs ni tshul thob byed/ /ji ltar gdul bya'i chos rnams dang / /'dod yon kun la sangs rgyas rnams/ /thams cad longs spyod tshul gcig pas/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku zhes bshad do/ /mtshan rnams kun dang yang dag ldan/ /sna tshogs sku ste mtshan nyid med/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis sprul pas na/ /sprul pa'i sku zhes 'dir bshad yin/ /phyag rgya chen 82—390

po rab bsgrub phyir/ /shes nas rnal 'byor dbang phyug sgom/ /kun rtog thams cad rnam spangs pas/ /rgyal ba chos sku ye shes nyid/ /bla ma'i byin brlabs 1skad cig gis/ /ye shes mi zad rgya mtsho ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyural/ /mi phyed rdo rje dbang phyug nyid/ /gnyis med mnyam par ro gcig pasal/ /rdo rje 'chang chen rang byung du/ /grub pa bde chen ngo bo nyid/ /thob med thob pas cig car (5)grol/ /spangs thob med pa mnyam nyid che/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa spos kyi glang po'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi gnas 'byung ba rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zab pa'i rdo rje ye shes sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'dir ni chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /snying po ye shes bde chen po / /byang chub rten ( cing 'brel 'byung ba'i/ /gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa stobs mi zad pa sred med kyi bu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi dbyangs kun du bskul 45ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs ter / byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bdag med dngos po med pa ru/ /ma skyes zag pa med pa'i ngang ske/ /spros pa kun las rnam grol ba'i/ /ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'gro ba skyob dbul po nges pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi glang po'i rtsal thogs 6pa med pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'byung gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te / byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid de/ /rang sems zla ba kun+da (7 ltar/ /sa bon gnas te rgyu yi cha/ /gsang ba'i tshul 82—391

'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi tshugs pa ye shes mtshungs pa med pa'i 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zab pa'i mdzod rdo rje dbyings zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i thugs/ /rab tu mi gnas brjod med pa/ /byang chub sems su gcig pas na/ /thams cad dbyer med dag par brjod/ /ces gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nyi zla sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rin po che'i nor bu'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dngos po kun gyi bdag nyid gang / /stong gsum 'jig rten rang gi lus/ /phyi nang gnyis med ye shes che/ /gsang ba zab pa'i tshul 4)bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad tog gi 'od zer sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po 'od zer kun nas 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i don du ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can cho rina'aphrul gyis/ /gdul bya ye shes lam la bkod / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mchog gi mchod pa'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes mkha' lding rol pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du byams pa'i 'od kyis ni/ /'gro ba kun la khyab par bya/ /des ni dpag med gzhan don du/ /mtshungs med ye shes gnas thob pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gyi snying po sbas pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis da bdud thams cad rnam par 'jig 82—392

par mdzad pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /byams pas bdud dpung 'joms mdzad cing / /snying rje g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /byang chub sems kyis phyir mi ldog /ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba ye shes rdo rje'i stobs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub 6)kyi sems 'di gsungs so / /rin chen 'bar ba glog gi 'od/ /dri med chu shel zer 'bab pas tha mal lus ni rgyal bar bsgyur/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes don grub sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mdzad pa rigs sna tshogs su ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du lha mo bye ba dang ske/ /byang chub sems dpa' khrag khrig tshogs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs brgya dang / /bde gshegs stong sogs tshul 'dir bstan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab lhun po brtsegs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi snying po sgyu ma'i rol pa ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos/ /ngo bo nyid dag rang byung ba/ /bdag med ye shes gnas med pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gdul dka' 'dul ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas la spyod pa rdo rje zhes (mibya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mchog tu sa yi mthar thug pa/ /bcu gsum ye shes 82—393

rdo rje 'dzin/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas bla na med/ /gsang ba tshul 'di bstan pa'ol/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das pad+mo'i 'od zer rnam par rol pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas mi zad pa 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du mnyam nyid ye shes dang / /'gro ba'i bla ma chos don gyis/ /tshad med thugs rjes 1yongs su bsdu/ /de nyid mi rtog gsang ba'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom grags pa'i 'od zer sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun nas chos kyi sgra 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du sdud (0cing spro ba dang ske/ /mtshan bcas dmigs pa med pa ru/ /ye shes rgyal la phyag rgyas btab//'di ni dag pa'i don ston pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes grogs rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba nges par rtogs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis nam mkha'i khams/ /yongs su gang ba til 'bru bzhin/ /sems can smin cing grol byed pas/ /ye shes mngon par bsdus pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes nyon mongs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phro ba'i sprin bkod pa'i (da rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du dngos dang dngos med pas/ /mi phyed ye shes bde ba che//sna tshogs 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang / /ye shes phyag rgya chen por bstan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'dam bu'i 'od sangs rgyas thams 82—394

cad kyi ye shes mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi spyod yul bas/ /rang bzhin gyis ni mi dmigs bzhin/ /don dam thob tu med pa'i don/ /gzhi med 0)tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa spos bzang rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po'i 'od zer kun nas rgyas pas lta ngan skrag par byed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te (ge byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mtshan nyid dang ni mtshan gzhi med/ /gang du ro mnyam zung 'jug pas/ /dbyer med rtogs pa rgyal po che/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yul 'khor rangs pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gshegs pa dang byon pa rjes su 'gro ba ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mi g.yo 'gyur ba med pa las/ /de bzhin nyid du bstan pa yis/ /'jug cing 'byung ba gsang ba che/ /snying po ye shes tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bde grags dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dngos grub gnas pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dngos grub snying po bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /grub pa'i bla ma'i gdams pa las/ /thob 'gyur de bas gzhan du min/ /gsang ba tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /mdzad pa'i ri sna tshogs gdul don du/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams ma lus par/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i tshul dag gis/ /theg pa mchog tu yongs grags pa'i/ /rdo 82—395

rje theg pa'i lam gyur 'di/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma lus pa'i/ /thugs kyi snying po gsang ba yin/ /sku dang gsung gi rdo rje 'dir/ /snying po kun du 'dus pa'i phyir / /rnal 'byor pas ni rtag tu spros/ /'dir ni sngon chad bstan pa'ang med / /ma 'ongs pa na'ang 'byung bar dka'/ /de bas gsang chen rnyed dka' bas / /sangs rgyas rnams ni 'jig rten du/ /'byung bar 'gyur ram ma byon yang ske/ /gsang ba'i yi ge rnam dag pa/ /'phel 'grib ①sbangs pas gnas pa yin / /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba'i gnas/ /gsang chen rang 'byung mnyam pa nyid/ /dpal mchog 'di ni bsdus pa'i tshul/ /ye shes chen po'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la gsang ba 'jig rten du 'byung bar dka' bar gdams shing bstan pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mdzad pa bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer drug pa'o// // de nas pade bzhin gshegs pa srid mtha' gzigs sangs rgyas thams cad kyis tsho srid pa'i chu klung (4skoms pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'dir ni srid pa'i dra ba dag /rnam par gcod cing ye shes mes/ /sdug bsngal gnas 'di bsreg par bya/ /de nyid bde ba kun gyi gnas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba sgra gcan tshogasangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'khor ba'i (6)ri bo 'joms par 82—396

byed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rtog pa sna tshogs las bcas pa/ /g.yeng bas sdug bsngal phung por gyur/ /de bsal ye shes byang chub sems/ /blang dor med pa'i ngang du gnas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen zla ba sangs rgyas hu)thams cad kyi phyag rgya'i gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /kun du phyag rgyas rgyas btab pas/ /mi phyed ye shes bdag nyid gyur/ /de nyid phyag rgya bzhi ldan pas/ /thams cad sdom par shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal mtshan seng ge'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sems rgyud sna tshogs chos nyid gcig par gyur/ /de nyid ngang la dag pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog /dbyer med byang chub sems kyi snang ba las/ /gsang ba bla med tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsam gtan dgyes sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rdo rje rnam rtog gi ri bo 'joms pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du rtog las rnam byung ba/ /de nyid 'joms pa'i rdo rje ni/ /stong nyid bde chen byang chub sems/ /de nyid ye shes tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdzogs ldan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi grub pa rdo rje gsang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du byams pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /'gro ba 'dul ba'i 82—397

don gang spyod/ /sna tshogs ngo bo nyid med pas/ /de nyid mi dmigs tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par rol pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po ye shes la rol pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sgyu ma'i dngos po snang med pa/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i don/ /gnas med bden gnyis dbyer med pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs sol/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan rin po che (1)mnga' ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bkod pa mi 'gyur ba dbyangs na zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba dbyings/ /thos bsam bsgom pas rtogs dka' ba/ /gsang ba'i ye shes dag pa che/ /dri med tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom grags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshul gsang ba rdo rje dmigs su med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam dag 'od gsal dri ma med/ /ma skyes nam mkha'i bdag nyid kyis/ /sgyu ma dngos las darnam grol byed/ /de nyid tshul 'di bshad pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa pad+ma'i 'od zer snang ba'i ngos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi glu'i dbyangs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi bdag nyid can/ /'dus byas rtog las rnam grol ba/ /'dus ma byas pa rdo rje'i ngang / /de nyid dag pa'i tshul bstan (4pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 82—398

mdzod spu ldan pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa ni/ /thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa/ /dus gsum de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs/ /'du 'bral med pa'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa spobs pa grags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dngos grub gdul bya la ster bar mdzad pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'dir ni so so rang rig pa/ /ye shes rgyun chad med pa'i lam/ /de nyid lam du bsgom pa'i mchog /bsam gtan ye shes tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje nor bu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi na bza' mi zad pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /nor bu'i snying po bsam 'phel bzhin/ /rtog med bsam pa rdzogs byed pa/ /rang byung chos kyi sgra ston pas/ /mi gnas ye shes tshul bstan pa'ol/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag tu med pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi khyu mchog rdo rje'i rtsal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs hu)so/ /srid dang zhi bar mi gnas pa/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dam pa'i dbyings/ /sku gsum lam gyi ye shes bcas/ /sa gsum dag pa'i nanadabang phyug thob/ /ces gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nor bu bkod pa'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rin po che sna tshogs pa'i mdangs bkod pa/ rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 82—399

'di gsungs so/ /rjes su dran pa'i gnas ni mthong ba'i lam/ /ye shes skad cig dga' ba bcu drug las/ /phyi nang gnas pas 'od gsal don rtogs pa/ /stong nyid rang 'byung 1rnam dag tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dbang chen seng ge'i nga ro sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mchod pa'i rgya mtsho mchod pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sna tshogs snang ba du mar 'char ba nyid/ /yul ni sgyu ma dngos po gdod nas dag / dag pa'i 2ngo bo chos dbyings nam mkha' che/ /sems snang rol pa gsang ba 'dir bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan 'byung gnas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba rmad du byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ma btsal ma spangs ngang gis dag pa'i sku/ /rnyed par mi 'gyur rab 'byam 3bde ba che/ /bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam ni lhun grub pa/ /byang chub sems chen gsang ba theg pa'i mchog /ces gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lhun po grags sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba mtshan rab 'bar ba'i cardo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i mtshan dang dpe byad rnams/ /sems can kun gyi lus la nges par bzhugs/ /dbri bsnan med par 'char bas gsal bar byed/ /de nyid sbas pa'i don du tshul 'di bstan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer bcu pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po gzhal g.yas khang nye bar brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dkyil 82wa 400

'khor 'khor lo'i gzhal yas khang / /tshad med bkod pas rab spras pa/ /rgyan rnams bye brag mtha' yas tshogs/ /snang ba de nyid tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ma dmad ①pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po yang dag par ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sgyu ma'i chos ②rnams mkha' lta bur/ /dag pa'i ye shes rang srog go(kye/ /snying gi pad+ma sad par bya/ /de las ye shes blo rgyas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de dag kun gyi gsang ske/ /ye shes dam pa mchog grub pa/ /gsang chen ye shes lam 'di yis/ /'dod dang thar par bsgrub ④pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las gsang ba chen po'i ye shes kyi don gtan la phab pa'i le'u ste nyer bdun pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa glang po'i 'gros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bla na med pa'i ye shes la dmigs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ye shes mchog tu gsang ba gang ske/ /de nyid bsdus par gyur pa ste/ /rtog pa'i dra ba gcod mdzad yin/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yid 'thad dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od zer kun nas rgyas pa'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du sangs rgyas 'od zer snang bas khyab/ /de 82—401

nyid 'dom gang 'od ni dba' 3rlabs gnyis/ /gnyis med gcig tu dag pas dbu ma nyid/ /dbyer med ye shes tshul 'di 2bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs sol/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen zla ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub kyi shing mchog la dmigs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rin chen brtan pa'i ljon pa'i shing / /de nyid byang chub sems las byung / /skyes pa sems bskyed rten gyur pas/ /rang byung tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nyan thos chen po rnams kyis dpag par dka' ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /zab pa shin tu zhi ba'i gnas/ /rdul med rnyog pa med pa'i thugs/ /bsam gtan rdo rje tshad med pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rab gsal rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nyan thos dgra bcom pa chen po rnams kyis brtag par dka' ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gnas pa med pa'i gnas gyur pa/ /khyu mchog chen po byang chub sems/ /rang gzhan mi phyed mi dmigs pas/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa kha lo sgyur ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas rgyun du zhugs pa rnams kyis dmigs su med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'khor ba'i rgyun 'di mya ngan 'das/ /de nyid spang du med pas na/ /ye shes shes rab rab naganas pas/ /dag pa 82wa 402

tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dge ba'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes phyir mi 'ong ba rnams kyis rtogs par dka' ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang phyir ldog pa med pa'i sems 'di ni ye shes chen po'i ngang / /bla na med pa snying po'i sku/ /de bzhin nyid kyi tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gtsug na rin po che'i 1'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 2lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams kyis dmigs su med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /khams gsum snang ba sems yin phyir/ /sems de stong nyid rgyu med pas/ /gang du dri med gzhan don 'byung / /'di ni tshul chen gsang ba yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa snyems bral sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zag pa zad pa rnams kyis dmigs su med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du zag med 'byung ba med/ /khams dang dbang po yul med par/ /shin tu dri med nam mkha' bzhin/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba rang rgyal ba thams cad kyis dmigs su med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du lus kyi kun du spyod pa yi/ /rdzu 'phrul snang ba bstan nas 'dul byed pa/ /rang 'byung bsam gtan thob ste 4ltos med pa/ /gsang ba 'dir gnas ye shes tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs 82wa 403

sol/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i zhal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba tshangs pas dmigs su med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /thog ma med cing mtha' med pas / /srid rtser mi gnas dbang phyug che/ /dngos po med cing rtag pa che/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med par grags pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas brgya byin gyis dmigs su med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du ma 1'khrug rtog pa med/ /ye shes rgyal ba kun gyi yul/ /gzugs sogs yul ni rtog tu med/ /thams cad dag pa'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba'i gzi brjid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyod yul lha drag pos dmigs su med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /nyon mongs 'ching ba dag pa yi/ /sred len rkyen grol log pas na/ /dmigs med ye shes gsang ba nyid/ /ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin 2gshegs pa thub pa dga' ba'i tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba khyab 'jug gis dmigs su med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang nas gang du khyab bya ngo bos stong / /thams cad bdag med stong pa zhi ba'i phyir/ /sems can khams med 'jug par mi gnas pas / /ye shes chen po'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sgra gcan lalha'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 82wa 404

gsang ba lha ma yin rnams kyi dmigs su med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du sa 'og sa steng 1dang / /sa bla rnams su bstan pa yin/ /dngos grub bdud rtsi thob byed pas/ /gsang ba tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs dpa dpal na tshod bzang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes gsang ba klu rnams kyis dmigs su med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes sku/ /dug med gdug pa rnam bral bas/ /skyorne med gtsang ba'i rang bzhin can/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lha cadaga'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa mngon par rol pa srin mo rnams kyis dmigs su med pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bdag med mnyam pa nyid thob pas/ /grub pa med pa'i gnas la ni/ /'chi med ye shes tshul mchog gis/ /gsang ba tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs sol/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen phung po sangs rgyas thams cad kyis sbas pa ye shes nam mkha'i bu mo rnams kyis dmigs su med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du mkha' la spyod 'gro ba'i/ /tshi gyur spyod pa'i ye shes can/ /de nyid de zhes rnam brtags pas/ /gsang ba tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mdzes par gshegs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes gnod sbyin rnams kyis rtogs par dka' ba thams cad kyi gnas pa rdo rje'i 82wa 405

ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rin chen gter 'chang mdzod po che/ /nor gyi rgya mtsho mtha' yas pas de nyid sa dbang bde gshegs rgyal/ /gsang ba dam pa bka' stsal pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i gnas pa'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 1sbas pa 'jig rten pa thams cad dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad kyi skye nadagu'i chos las dben pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /skyes bu chen po thams cad kyi/ /ye shes gnas ni mnyam med pas/ /rang gzhan mi phyed canabyang chub che/ /sems dpa' tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gang du 'gro la gnas gyur pa'i/ /gsang chen 'dir ni gnas gyur na/ /gang la'ang dri mar mi 'gyur zhing / /dgag par bya ba ci yang med/ /las rnams thams cad byas kyang ni/ /rang byung skur ni rnam par grol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las dag pa'i skyes bu bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer brgyad pa'o// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu mthor gshegs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi mchod rten 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dri med ye shes dag pa'i gnas/ /rin chen phung po gsal ba yi/ /dang zhing yid 'phrog 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /sa le sgrib 5med tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so//82wa 406

de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par skye ba'i dbang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rdo rje mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te / byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mngon par 'byung 3)ba 'phags pa'i lam/ /nyes pa spongs 2pa'i tshul mchog gis/ /rnam par mthor gshegs 'og min te/ /zab pa brjod med tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros bzang po mthong ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rgyal ba'i gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin mchog /chos kun mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /kun mkhyen kun 'gro thams cad pa/ /dri med tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dpal 'jig rten 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid gnas pa gcig pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams kun gyi rang bzhin 'dzin/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa po/ /mnyam nyid 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gzi brjid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun rtog pa med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin gnas/ /cher mi g.yo ba rang bzhin med/ /rtsol med 'byung ba dag pa yi / /gsang ba tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skal ldan shing rta chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpe byad las 'das pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi 82—407

mor 1gyur pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa legs par skyes pa'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes gsang ba chos rdo rje rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rang byung ye shes zhi ba'i dngos/ /dag pa rnam dben mngon par 'byung / /phun sum 2tshogs pa lam gyur ba/nas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa dpe med pa'i tshogs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba rigs rdo rje rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du lha dang lha mo dang / /byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa/ /ye shes las skyes mtshungs med pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje'i rigs rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gdug pa can rnams gdul bya'i phyir/ /snying rjes gtum pa'i nga ro yis/ /tshar gcad 3pa nyid bla med bsgral/ /de nyid gsang ba'i tshul bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bden pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rdo rje rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /lha dang lha min lto 'phye dang / /grul bum la 4sogs sna tshogs pas / /bstod cing mchod pa'i ye shes gnas/ /rin chen 'khor lo ci brjod pa yin / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dka' thub chen po 82wa 412

sangs rgyas thams cad 1kyi ye shes rin po che'i nor bu rjes su dran pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs sol/ /de nas ye shes nor bu ni/ /sna tshogs 'dod pa don byed pa/ /dpag med yon tan 'byung ba'i dbyings/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan (2pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lhun po'i 'od zer sangs rgyas thams cad kyi pad+ma'i phreng ba rjes su dran pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du 'dam skyes me tog dang / /chu skyes pad+ma gsal ba yang / /'bar ba kha phye 'od khyab pas/ /dag pa ye shes tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan brtsegs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi las kyi ral gri rjes su dran pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du rtog pa gcod pa dag /rnam par bdud tshogs rab 'joms pas/ /ye shes me 'od rgyas pa yis/ /kun du rgyas pa'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mchod par grags pa sangs rgyas thams cad 4kyi sna tshogs 'dul ba rdo rje rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i drung / /gsang ba mi zad mchod pa'i gzhi/ /de nyid kun du khyab byed pas/ /gsang ba dag pa'i mchod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi grags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du de bzhin gshegs pa 82—413

yil/ / sku yi 1'dul ba mtha' yas pa/ /sna tshogs zhing khams spyod mdzad pa/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba sbyin pa'i 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'dir ni brjod pa kun gyi gzhi/ /thabs dang shes rab sgra rnams las/ /sna tshogs skad du chos ston pa/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa glog 'byin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dag par byed pa khrus yin te/ /sgrib pa 'phyag byed spyod lam du/ /thal sbyar 'dud pas bag yod lamal/ /dran ldan tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bden par gsung 2ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan rdo rje rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rin chen sna bdun rang byung ba'i/ /yon tan sgyu rtsal sna tshogs pa/ /thams cad bsam pa'i stobs yin pas/ /de nyid gsang ba'i tshul bstan dpa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'tsho cabyed gsung ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin 5las rdo rje rjes su dran pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi stobs bzang ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du sna tshogs dbang po'i rim de nyid thabs tshul tha dad pas/ /ldog pa'i dbye ba du mar bstan/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa na 82wa 414

tshod 19bzang po 2sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mtha' yas pa la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rigs can sna tshogs du ma'i snang ba la/ /ye shes rang 'byung 'gag pa med par ni/ /thugs rje chen po mi zad stobs la )'byung //sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin calas tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa legs pa'i tshogs can sangs rgyas thams cad kyi khro bo rjes su dran pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du gdug pa 'dul byed pa/ /'byung po ma lus tshar gcad cing / /rjes su gzung 5phyir khro bar bstan/ /de nyid thugs rje'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par nges pa'i blo gros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 6sems can rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs sol/ /gang du dmigs pas 'jug med par/ /sna tshogs khams gsum skye gnas pa ske/ /mi g.yo ngang las snang med par/ /chos dbyings gcig par tshul bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa srid na mtha' nor bu'i spos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ma skyes pa rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang gi skye bas bsdus pa'i dngos/ /stong nyid gcig tu ma skyes pas/ /skye ba med pa'i tshul can te/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba dgyes 9pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rig pa rdo rje rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 1 zhugs te/ byang chub kyi 82wa 415

sems 'di gsungs so/ /ngo mtshar sna tshogs 'phrul ba yi/ /gzo 19yi gnas dang gso sbyong 2sogs/ /mkhyen pas thabs la mkhas par bya/ /de nyid ye shes tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i 'od zer sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snang ba rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /blo snang yul dang dbang po yis/ /du ma'i dngos po snang ba la/ /ldog pa dang ni rjes su 'gro/ /de nyid gsang ba'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lus gnas cha shas med par rtogs/ /nges 'byung de bzhin cha shas med/ /cha shas can dang cha med pa/ /shes nas 'dir grol the tshom 4med/ /dngos po thams cad mnyam pa ste/ /myur du 'jug pa dka' ba nyid/ /dpe dang gtan tshigs 5rnam par spangs/ /rang bzhin gyis 6ni 'od gsal zhing / /gnyug ma 'dir ni snang ba ste/ /spyod pa'i yul las 'das pa yin/ /rtsod med zhi ba mtshon bya med / /nges pa'i chos kyi dbyings la gnas/ /skal ba med cing rgyu ba med/ /shin tu stong zhing rdul med pas/ /sgra las 'das shing yon tan spangs/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin can/ /ye shes kyi snang ba rgyas pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung 7dang ske/ thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las/ 'gro ba 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste sum cu pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 82wa 416

sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mi zad pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du dngos po rnam dag pas/ /yul rnams sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid can/ /dus gsum gcig par bsdus pa yis1/ /thams cad mkhyen par tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa'i mchog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mi zad pa /rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam par sbyong ba'i 3tshul las ni/ /tshul bzhin ma yin rnam gcad cing / /dben pa nyon mongs las ldog gang / /tshul 'di gsang ba thob pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa rab zhugs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mi zad pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge la'adzin la snyoms par zhugs te / byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /lus ngag yid kyi las rnams la/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzhan don du/ /dpag med dka' spyad khur byed pa/ /ye shes bzod pa chen po yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa nor bu'i zla ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi brtson 'grus mi zad pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /phyir mi ldog par gzhan don du/ /byang chub sems kyi brtson pa yis / /tshad med dbugs 'byin chen po nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'ol/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa drag shul 'od zer sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsam gtan rdo rje mi zad pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'jig 82—417

rten bsam gtan bzhi gnas shing / /ye shes bsam gtan mchog spyod pas/ /phyi nang rtsol med ngang las ni/ /byang chub sems kyi tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa brtul zhugs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdo rje mi zad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di 1gsungs so/ /chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /snying po byang chub mchog sems las/ /tha dad rgyas thebs gcig pa'i sku/ /ye shes de nyid tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'gro bas kun du mchod pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 2'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so / /kun du dri med dge ba ni/ /rten 'brel sna tshogs spyod pa'i ngang / /rkyen las 'byung ba bla na med/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ / de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nor bu'i tshogs 'chang ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdo rje mi zad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bdud tshogs rnams las carnam rgyal ba/ /de nyid ye shes rlung las ni/ /zag med zhi bas mchog tu bde/ /gnyis med tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten bla ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdo rje mi zad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /zhing khams rnam dag rnams dang ma dag dang / /gdul dka'i sems can rnams phyir 'dul bar 82—418

ni / /bung ba me tog bzhin du rab 'jug pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' 1'byung ba'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa glang chen seng ge sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdo rje mi zad pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs sol/ /ye shes gang du 'du ba yi/ /ye shes mngon par 'byung ba gang / /de nyid chags med rnam dag pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po dbang phyug gi rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /kun du rgyas rinapa'i gnas bstan pa/ /rnam par 'phrul ba'i dbang phyug gis/ /lhun grub phyag rgyas rab rgyas pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od zer sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spong ba'i nardo rje mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge ca'adzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam par spyod pa sna tshogs la/ /bde bar gshegs pa mtshungs med spyod/ /'di ni sngags kyi spyod mchog ste/ /de nyid gsang ba'i tshul thob pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sgra gcan 5bral ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpal gyi be'u rab tu rgyas par ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi 6sems 'di gsungs so / /'di ni dpal gyi stobs mchog ste/ /dri med chu skyes yongs 'dzin pa/ /phra ba ge sar mchog thob pas/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs sol/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan rgya mtsho sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 82—419

rdul med pa'i gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam pa kun du dri ma med/ /bskyod pa med cing 'dzin bral bas/ /chos nyid ngang du ro mnyam pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer mnga' dbang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye 1shes 'brug sgra dbyangs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i rating nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so / /chos rnams kun gyi snang ba ni/ /rtogs dka' bdag med mtshan ma med/ /byams pa'i rang bzhin gzhan phan brtson/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu zhi ba'i stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun du 'jam dbyangs ka la ping ku'i /rdo rje zhes bya ba'i citing nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs ldan gsung 5gi gnas/ /yan lag drug cu thogs 6med du/ /'gyur ba'i brjod pa las skyes pa'i/ /skad du ye shes tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten bzang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje dgyes pa'i mchog rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mnyam par ma bzhag stong pa yis/ /rtag tu mnyam pa'i tshul gnas nas/ /'gyur med sna tshogs khyab byed pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med pa'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'khor ba'i chu klung skems par byed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /srid pa 'di nyid spang 82wa 420

med par/ /mi gnas mnyam pa'i ngang las ni/ /bdag med seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rlung shugs bcu pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phyir mi ldog pa'i 'jug pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /skye gnas 'byung las gyur pa la/ /'dod pa'i snang ba 'gro zhing lding / /de nyid sems can gnas mthong phyir/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa stobs la dgyes pa'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lha klu thams cad kyis mchod pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du mchod phyir ye shes kyi/ /chags 1med kun tu bzang po yi / /bden pa'i byin brlabs /thogs med pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung 3dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par 4rgyal ba las rnal 'byor chen po'i 'dul ba don yod pa'i mchog bstan pa'i le'u ste sum cu gcig pa'o// //de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje gsang ba gsum gyi mthar/ /rdo rje bkod pa snying po che/ /gsang ba dam pa bka' stsal pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa'i/ /ye shes snang ba bstan ci pa'o/ /rang lus lhar gsal byang chub sems/ /gang du srog dbus bzhugs pa na/ /ā li kā li mnyam sbyor bas/ /man ngag gis ni rlung bsdus te/ /de tshe bzlas pa brtan 82—421

gyur pas/ /de nyid ye shes mchog thob 'gyur/ /mi g.yo mi rtog phra ba'i sems//mi mngon gsal min dbu mar bzhugs/ /de nyid rnal 'byor mchog ces bya/ /stong pa nyid dang mnyam sbyor bas/ /de nyid mngon par byang chub pa'o/ /de nyid gsal bas bde ba ni/ /sgyu ma goms pas 'chang bar 'gyur/ /ji srid sgyu ma la gsal ba/ /de srid goms pas 'jug par bya/ /rab tu gsal ba'i gnas thob pas/ /rang dge'i ye shes thob par 'gyur/ /de nyid ye shes bde chen po/ /thig le'i gzugs can gcig pu nyid/ /snying dbus mi shigs sems gcig bdag /de nyid ye shes rang stong pa/ /sgyu mar ngo bo nyid kyis gsal/ /gnyis med ye shes rnal 'byor pas/ /ye shes 'byung ba'i rdo rje'i blos1/ /mkhas pas mthong bas brtag 2par bya/ /thog mtha' med pa'i ye shes ni/ /ma byung bcos min lhan cig skyes/ /rang rig gnas ni 'dir thob pa'o de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes gsang ba chen po la dmigs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mthu dpal snying po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du ye shes sa gzhi las/ /sna tshogs myu gu bskyed pa'i rgyu/ /rten 'brel tshogs phyir thob pa nyid/ /ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mthu stobs dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba'i rgyal po rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mnyes par byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod sna tshogs pa/ /rin chen bdun dang nye bdun gyis/ /brgyan zhing mchod pas bde 82—422

de 0)thob/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mthu chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'byung gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so//lus kyang sems la mi gnas te/ /sems kyang ngag la mi gnas te/ /kun du gnas med mkha' lta bur/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan snying po sangs rgyas na thams cad kyi sna tshogs mchod pa'i bkra shis rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mchog stsol bkra shis rgyun du ni / /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /skyes bu de la stsol ba ster/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bden par spyod pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bsil riba'i char 'bebs pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du 'dod chags la sogs pas/ /zil gnon de las thar ba yi / /char pas zug rngu sel byed pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dge ba'i mchog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid 5sku rdo rje ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /zhing khams kun la khyab gyur pa'i/ /lus can kun la rnam par snang / /de nyid rdo rje'i skur gyur pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal po'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid gsung rdo rje ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs 82—423
