so / /stong gsum khams su grags byed pa/ /gling kun skad cig dbyangs kyis ston / /du mar de nyid ston pa po/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skar rgyal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje ngo bo nyid ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du 'khor los sgyur ba yi/ /chos kyi 'khor los dbang bskur bzhin/ /'gro kun ye shes dbang bskur ba'i/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid bsgyur 1ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs sol/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gang / /chos nyid mnyam pa'i de bzhin nyid//mtshungs med da ltar 'dir rtogs na/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa glog gi rtse mo sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun du 'phrul pa'i spyod pa ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dpag med sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul gyis/ /ma /dag dag par gang bsgyur ba/ /thams cad blo gros bzang po thobaske/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan rgya chen sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rin po che'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba 3zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bdud kyi 'ching ba las 'das phyir/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan chen po yis/ /khams gsum kun la khyab par bya/ /de nyid gsang ba bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i 82wa 424

'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'jig rten snang bar byed pa re re 1zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'od gsal shin tu rnam dag pa/ /dngos po ma spangs ye shes che/ /chos dbyings klong na bde bar gnas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa dpal gyi 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje'i gdugs kyis 2khyab par byed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /skye bas bsdus pa'i sems can rnams/ /skyob phyir tshad med gdugs kyis ni/ /kun nas kun du khyab par byed/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bdud 'dul bar mdzad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bdud ma lus pa ca'ajoms pa rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /log lta ma lus mun pa'i gzhi/ /sangs rgyas ye shes sgron me yis/ /skad cig gcig la sel mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan 6pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa go cha bgos pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje mchog tu sra ba snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /yan lag bzhi ldan mtshon cha mchog /de nyid bsrung ba bla na med/ /pha rol rgol ba bzlog pa po/ //zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i phyag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kha lo sgyur 9ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /phyag rgya sna tshogs thabs rol pa/ /'bar phreng du ma'i spro ba can//82wa 425

mi zad ye shes byang chub sems/ /stong nyid de nyid tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa me tog bzang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi dung bla na med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams mtha' yas par/ /rab ston dam pa'i chos kyi sgra/ /rnam pa kun du grags pa'i dbyangs / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mthon 1po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dam pa chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi 2rab tu brdungs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du chos kyi don ston pa/ /tshad med bsdu dngos bzhi dag gis/ /sdud cing grol byed theg pa'i mchog /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgya mtsho'i sa 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dam pa'i chos kyi rnga bo che sgrog pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rtog pa med pa rin chen rnga/ /bde gshegs gsungs 5ni bstan pa'i phyir/ /rtag tu skul ba'i sgra 'byung ba/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa don gyi blo mnga' ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gdul bya'i bsam pa mkhyen nas ni/ /rtog med ye shes khams 'jug pas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bstan pa ni/ /byang chub tshul mchog bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs sol/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen gyis/ /rig pa'i lha mo sna tshogs dang //82—426

thabs cig rol pa bstan mdzad de/ /gsang ba gsungs pa'i don brjod do/ /ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang / /dngos po ci bzhin rang rig la'ang / /rgyu 'bras bye brag tha dad pa/ /ma 'dres ye shes tshul du gnas/ /nang gnas 1ji bzhin phyi rol 'byung / /bar ma gsang ba mchog spyod pa/ /rmad du byung ba chen po ste/ /ngo bo nyid kyi ye shes gang / /de nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de yi rjes su 'brang bar byed/ /de nyid gnyis su med pa yi/ /rnal 'byor gsang ba bde ba che/ /rgyal ba kun gyi 'byung gnas yin/ /bskrad dang gsad dang dbye ba 2dang / /mngon spyod kyi ni las rnams ni/ /thabs gzhan med par gyur pa la/ /thog ma dbus dang mtha' rnams su/ /gang gis snying rje ma nyams la / /de nyid de yis byed par 'gyur/ /gzhan du bstan pa'i don las dman / /nye bar 'grub par dka' bar gsungs/ /de nyid gsang ba'i spyod yul min/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin bstan pa'i le'u ste so gcig 4pa'o// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi bdag po chen po byang chub kyi sems rdo rje la mchod pa'i sprin du mas mchod cing phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi / /gsang ba bsdus pa'i dgongs rgyud de/ /mi phyed ye shes mchog sgrub pa/ /82—427

bcom ldan snying po bshad du gsol/ /zhes zhus shing gsol ba btab pa dang /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang thugs kyi 1rdo rje'i bdag pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol ba btab par mkhyen cing byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs 'dus pa chen po de dag gi sems kyi kun du rtog pa yang thugs kyis mkhyen nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gang du yang 'di ltar lhan cig g.yo ba dang ldan pas dbang po sgo lnga'i rjes su mngon par 'gro 2la snang ba dbang po don dang phrad par gyur pa mched dpa gsal ba las dbang pos dngos por dmigs pa thob pa dang ldan pa'o/ /gal te sems de nyid dngos po'i rang bzhin du ma gyur na de lta na'ang 'di dag sems nyid yin pas rnam pa thams cad du phyi rol gyi don skye ba yod pa ma yin te/ 'di ltar ma lus pa'i rang bzhin 'di dag brtags pas stong pa'i sems nyid de/ skye ba dang 'gag pa dang bral zhing rang bzhin gyis dag pa gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rnam par yongs su gsal ba'o/ /chos rnams thams cad sems yin te/ /lus dang sems ni dbyer med de/ /rten dang brten pa 'jug ldog gis/ /kun gyi gnas su shes par bya/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje stong nyid de/ /dbus gnas 4mngon par byang chub brjod/ /de nyid me long ye shes ldan/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rab tu brtag /nyi ma mnyam nyid ye shes te/ /bdun dang ldan pa'i dbus nyid du'o5//sngags ni dbus su gnas gyur gang / /sa bon so sor rtog pa ste/ /mngon par byang chub pa nyid do/ /rtso rje la sogs gang gnas pa/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /zhal gsum rtsa 82—428

gsum brjod par bya/ /sku gsum lus ngag yid yin te/ /de nyid mngon par byang chub brjod/ /rnam par 'phro bar bsam bya ste/ /rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma dang ske/ /nor bu ral gri 'bar ba las/ /'gro drug rtog pa gcod phyir te/ /ye shes drug pa'i bdag nyid can/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor bas/ /bla med mngon par byang chub brjod/ /lus ngag yid ni byang chub pa/ /gsang ba dngos po'i don yin te/ /lus ni byang chub rnam lnga dang / /rtsa dang byang chub sems dang ni/ /mi gtsang rdzas dang rnam rtog gis/ /lus kyi chos ni gnas pa yin / /ngag ni 'byung ba lnga dag dang / /yi ge sgra dang sngags rnams te/ /brjod pa dang ni dbyangs rnams kyis/ /ngag gi chos ni bsdus pa yin/ /sems ni ye shes lnga dag dang / /thig le bde ba nyid dang ni/ /snang ba gsum dang mi rtog pas/ /sems kyi chos ni gnas pa yin/ /sna tshogs gzugs can sems kyi dngos/ /srid gsum chos dang chos min dang / /sa 'og sa steng 1sa bla ba/ /skye gnas 'byung ba brtan g.yor 2bcas/ /sems nyid lus ni nam mkha'i khams/ /gzhi 2dang rten dang khyab byed pa'o/ /mi gsal phra zhing brtag dka' bas/ /rnam par shes pa'i snang ba la/ /snang ba mngon par thob pa las//bag chags sa bon yul rnams kyis/ /thams cad rang las 'byung ba nyid/ — /mi gnas ye shes lus la gnas/ /ye shes lus ni 'gag med de/ /dngos med stong par mi 'gyur te/ /lus med lus ni ro mnyam pa/ /lus la thog ma dmigs su med/ /tha ma 'gag pa med pa ste/ /gsang ba gsum du rnam sbas pas /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes sku/ /'di ni 'khor 'das kun gyi rtsa/ nyams dang myong ba dbyer med de/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong gzugs can yin/ /82wa 429

bde dang gsal ba 1mi rtog pas/ /snang ba gsum gyi rnam pa ste/ /de nyid zhen pas 'ching bas na/ /srid pa gsum ni rtag pa'i dngos/ /phra ba'i lus ngag yid gsum la/ /gsang ba'i sku gsung 2thugs ye shes/ /rdo rje gsum du gsang ba nyid/ /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /'gro kun bde gshegs rang bzhin can/ /lus ni sna tshogs mi bzad pas/ / sku yi 4gsang ba bsam mi khyabaske/ /du ma'i gzugs kyis ston par byed/ /'gro ba chos lam dpal ldan pas / /ngag gi brjod pa mtha' yas pa/ /gsung gi gsang ba bsam mi khyab/ /sgra dbyangs so so'i skad du sgrogs/ /sems can sangs rgyas snying po can/ /sems ni dran rtog dpag med pas/ /thugs kyi gsang ba bsam mi khyab/ /sems can sku gsung dbyer med pas/ /lus ngag yid gsum mi phyed pa/ /rdo rje gsum du rtag riganas pas/ /de phyir rgyal ba'i ye shes sku/ /dbyer med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa brjod du med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' che/ /kun du bzang pos legs zhus pa/ /rnal 'byor rgyud 'dir gsungs pa yi/ /rlung gi dbye dus mtshan nyid dang / /spro bsdu rim pa rgyu tshul dang / /khyad par gsang ba bshad du gsol/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'chang / /gsang ba'i dbyings nas bka' rgyunishā/ pa/ /yig lha// skyogo tsholhag/ sngo/ lhani/ ces skyes7 myos skyes e 95ཿ de nas gzhan yang rab bshad pa/ /de la rlung gi mtshan nyid ni/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /'byung ba bzhi yi bye brag gis/ /mgon po rdo rje re re la'ang / /spyan la 2sogs pa'i lha mo ni/ /re re la yang bzhi bzhi ste/ /dkyil 'bo/ ra bzhi ru mngon par brjod/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod rnams/ /mkhas pas 82wa 430

shes nas spyad par bya/ /rlung gi bye brag bstan pa ni/ /tho rangs khyab gnas dus yin te/ /spyi bo'i gnas las kun khyab pas/ /yi ge a ru mngon par brjod / /de ni sku yi bzlas pa'o/ /nam nangs 1)thur sel dus yin te/ /gsang ba'i gnas su 'byung bas na/ /ā zhes brjod pa dbyangs yin no/ /rdo rje gsung gi bzlas par brjod/ /nyi ma shar ba mnyam gnas rlung / /lte ba'i gnas su brjod pa yi(mi/ /i zhes sgra tsam du brjod pas/ /rdo rje yon tan bzlas pa steni/ /cung zad dros pas byadrod yin te/ /snying ga'i gnas su mi shigs pas/ /yi ge sī ru mngon par ni(snye/ /rdo rje thugs kyi bzlas pa ste/ /phyed dus gyen du rgyu ba nyid/ /mgrin pa'i gnas las bskyed pas na/ /u zhes thung rgyu ngag tu gyur/ /rdo rje thogs med bzlas par bshad/ /phyed yol dus su rgyu ba'i rlung / /mig la gnas pa'i rnam pa yis/ /u (7zhes rab tu brjod pa nyid / /rdo rje 'dod chags bzlas par brjod/ /dgongs ka rab tu rgyu ba nyid/ /rna ba la ni rab gnas pa/ /e zhes kun gyi brda ru brjod/ /mtshan mo'i cha la rnam par rgyu/ /sna yi rnam shes ldan pa ste/ /e mezhes gsang ba ser sna 'dzin/ /rdo rje gti mug bzlas par brjod/ /srod (8༄la shin tu rgyu ba ste/ /lce la mngon par dbang bas na/ /o zhes sna tshogs sgra brjod pa/ /'gog pa khro bo'i bzlas par brjod/ /nam phyed yang dag rab rgyu ba/ /ba spu'i tshigs kun khyab pas na//au zhes tshig tu smra bar ston/ /'di ni dam tshig bzlas par gsungs/ /srog rtsol dbu mar 'jug pa ni/ /e zhes bde bar ldan pa ste/ /rtsa gnyis gzung 'dzin rlung 'gags nyu)pas/ /aḥzhes stong pa'i sgo yin no/ /gung gnyis rtsa ba'i rtsa yin te/ /gzhan du yan lag nyid du 'gyur/ /ā ⑩li bcu gnyis dag 82—431

dang 'dres/ /de dag dbye ba rim pa yang / /bla ma'i kha las rtogs par 'gyur / /rlung gi bye brag bshad pa ni/ /tshes gcig snga dro zla ba ste/ /stong pa'i srod 1la nyi ma rgyu/ /tshes brgyad tho rangs rlung nyid de/ /nyi shu gnyis la cha snyoms 2pas/ / de yi grangs ni bstan pa la/ /chu ni nyis brgya nyi shu lnga/ /sa dang me dang rlung dag la'ang / /de nyid bzhin du mnyam par 'byung / /dbyug rtso gu gnyis la chu tshod gcig /de la bzhi brgya lnga bcu yin/ /chu tshod gnyis la 'pho ba gcig /de la dgu brgya phrag gcig ste/ /'pho ba gnyis la thun gcig ste / /de la stong dang brgyad brgya'o/ /thun ni rnam pa bcu gnyis yin/ /de la nyi khri cig stong ste/ /spyir sdom 5nyin zhag gcig la ni/ /'pho ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi yin / /khri phrag gnyis dang stong dang ni/ /drug brgya 'byung bar rgyu ba yin/ /chu tshod sum cu gnyis la ni/ /dbyug ( gu drug cu rtsa bzhi yin/ /de dag 'byung ba 'dzin pa ni/ /chu sogs nyi shu rtsa bzhi rgyu/ /zhi ba'i las ni nyi shu bzhi//sa ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi las/ /de yi dus su rgyas pa'i las/ /gnyis pa'ang de dang mnyam pa la/ /dbang dang drag po'i las la shis/ /rlung gi rim pa de dag kyang ske/ /lugs 'byung dang ni lugs bzlog pa/ / dgra thun du ni rgyu ba dang / /ma dang bu ru rgyu ba dang / /rang thog tu ni rang rgyu dang / /gzhan thog tu ni gzhan rgyu dang / /pho mo phrad par 'byung ba dang / /ma ning dag tu 'byung ba dang ske/ /bsnol 8mar rgyu dang rkyang pa ste/ /de dag don ni gsal rnyed 'gyur/ /sa dang chu ru phrad pa sogs/ /de bzhin gzhan la'ang sbyar bar bya/ /gsal dang mi gsal rnam pa yis/ / de yi 9bye brag shes par bya/ /phrin 1 las bzhi yi bye brag gis/ /chu yi rlung ste ngos gzung ba/ /phyogs dang dbyibs dang mdog 82—432

rnams dang / /ring thung rgyu ba phyi nang gis/ /lha mo bzhi dang gnas bzhi dang / /dal dang rtsub dang sbom pa dang / /shin tu drag pa rnam pa bzhi/ /chu yi mtshan nyid 'dzin pa'i dus/ /zhi ba'i las ni bya 1bar bshad/ /sa dang me dang rlung dang gsum/ /gong ma dag gis bsgre bar bya/ /spyir ni rlung gi rnam pa ni/ /'byung ba drag po'i rang bzhin yin/ /'jug pa dbang dang rgyas pa ste/ /gnas pa shin tu zhi ba yin/ /thams cad rlung gis byed pas na/ /sdig pa mi dge ngan song ltung / /'chi dus 'og sgo gnyis nas ltung / /'pho bas 'bras bu ngan 'gro yin/ /dge bcu spyod pa rlung gi las/ /mtho ris thar pa rnams la ni / /bgrod 2pa rlung gis byed pa ste/ /tshangs pa'i sgo nas mkha' spyod du/ /'pho bar 'gyur ro sems dpa' che/ /rlung 'khrugs pas ni las rnams 'khrugs//zhing sogs 'khrugs pas las mi 'grub/ /ro snyoms pas ni nad med cing / /yon tan phun sum tshogs pa 'byung / /dbu ma legs pa'i lam bzang pos/ /phyag rgya chen po'i gnas thob nas/ /sku bzhi ye shes lnga 'byung ba/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa 'grub/ /rig 'dzin mos par spyod pa ste/ /dang po las kyi sa zhes pa/ /'dod khams gnas pa'i gzhi yin te/ /de phyir las rnams rlung gis byed/ /ces dpal rdo rje 'chang gis spyod pa'i gnas grol ba'i don du rab tu gsungs so/ /srog dang rtsol ba rab 'jug pas/ /g.yas g.yon rgyu dang khong nas 'byung / /thabs dang shes rab cha dag gis/ /gsang ba 'dir ni brjod pa yin/ /zla ba dang ni nyi ma yi/ /rab tu dbye ba bstan par bya/ /g.yon dang g.yas su rab sbyor bas/ /rim pa ji bzhin rab tu rgyu/ /g.yon gyi mgrin pa nas brtsams te/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor mthar gyur pas/ /zla ba'i 82—433

bdag 'joms pa the tsom 1med/ /g.yas nas chu tshod bzhi dag dang / /de bzhin g.yon nas chu tshod bzhi/ /dbu mar shin tu bsdams ri byas la/ /bdud las rnam par rgyal ba thob/ /rdo rje gsang ba 'chi bdag 'joms pa dang bdud las 3rnam par rgyal bar byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas gsang ba'i bdag po yis/ /'dus pa'i 'khor la bka' stsal pa/ /spyi dang khyad par tshul gyis ni/ /ngo bo rlung gi chos rnams kun/ /rnam phye rim pa shes par bya/ /sems dpa' chen po 'di shes byos/ /'di dag rgyas par phye ba ni/ /rgyas par gyur pa khri phrag bcu/ /nyon mongs phung po de snyed dang / /rlung dang mnyam par 'gags lapa las/ /chos kyi phung po de snyed 5thob/ /sa re thob cing rlung 'gags pas/ /bcu pa'i sa la gnas pa'i tshe/ /dam tshig mngon du gyur pas na / /nyon mongs thams cad spangs pa yin/ /sa brgyad par ni gyur pa'i tshe/ /nyon mongs phung po rags tshopa ni/ /khri phrag brgyad pos spangs pa na/ /phyir mi ldog pa zhes brjod do/ /lhag ma drug brgya stong phrag gcig /snga ma'i gnas su rang dag ste/ /las kyi rlung rnams dag pa yin/ /khri phrag gnyis ni zag med rlung —/ /sa bcu pa la phyin dus su/ /grangs 'bum gyi ni rnam pa nyid/ /dam tshig dag tu bstan pa'o/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong ni/ /sa bcu po la gnas pa yis/ /chos kyi sprin du gyur pa yin/ /phrin las rigs 7lnga'i bzlas pa yis / /sa lnga pa ni mngon du byed/ /khro bo dam tshig bzlas pa yis/ /drug pa mngon du gyur pa thob/ /dus gsum dag pa'i bzlas pas 9ni/ /legs pa'i blo gros thob par byed/ /dam tshig mi 'da' bzlas pas ni/ /sa bcu mngon du gyur pa ste/ /rgyal ba'i rlung las 'phos 1 pas ni/ /bsam 1/mi khyab du 12gyur pa 82—436

ste1 / /zag par bcas pa'i rlung dag ni/ /rags 2par gnas pa de snyed yin//phra bar gyur pa'i rtog pa ni/ /khri phrag brgyad las 'das nas ni/ /stong phrag bzhi bcu 'das pas ni/ /spang bya de snyed dang 3rtog pa/ /bag la nyal ba spong ba yi/ /zag med rlung ni khri phrag gnyis/ /ye shes dam tshig mngon 'byung ba/ /'bum du brjod pas bsdus 4pa'o/ /khri phrag gnyis dang stong phrag gcig /lhag pa drug brgyar bcas pa gang / /las kyi rlung du brjod par bya/ /de yang bsdus pas thun grangs la/ /dus sbyor chen po bcu gnyis te/ /dkyil 'khor nyi shu rtsa bzhi yin/ /ro hi ta dang mo hi ta/ /bha dra pri ṣa bha snye sha pa/ /kur ma ma ka ra raṇ+ḍa / / mi ki ra dang bi /dri ka /byā ku li dang swa pa na/ / kā ma na 1 ru brjod par bya/ /'byung dang 'jug dang gnas pa dag /gcig tu gyur pa dbugs yin te/ /dbugs drug chu srang gcig yin te/ /chu srang sum cu dbyug 1 gu phyed/ /dbugs drug gis ni dbyug 1 gu phyed/ /dbyug 1 gu gnyis la chu tshod gcig /chu tshod sum cu rtsa gnyis las/ /thun ni rnam pa brgyad du phri / /'pho ba'i tshul ni bcu drug go/ /dbyug 15gu dag pa'i gnas yin pas/ /drug cu rtsa bzhir gnas pa'o/ /spyir na 1 sems can khams la ni/ /rtog pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /de snyed yod phyir shes pa des/ /rlung yang bsam gyis mi khyab bo / /de yang bsdus pa'i don du ni/ /nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong pas/ /rnam par dbye ba mkhas pa yis/ /zag bcas rlung ni khri phrag brgyad/ /lhag pa stong phrag bzhi las ni/ /zag pa med pa'i rlung gyur pa/ /khri phrag gnyis kyis dag pa yin/ /rlung rags pas ni rtog / pa'i tshogs/ /de dang mtshungs par 'jug pa yin/ /rtog pa bag la nyal gyur pas/ /rlung ni phra 82wa 437

bar gyur pa 1ste/ /phrag lderags rtog pa dag pas ni/ /rlung ni shin tu phra bar 'gyur / /rnam rtog dang ni rlung gnyis gang / /mtshungs par mnyam par 'byung 'jug las/ /rlung gi 'jug pa 'byung med par/ /rtog pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur bas/ /de phyir las kyi rlung dag ni/ /khri phrag gnyis dang stong dag dang ske/ /drug brgya dag tu shes par bya/ /yi ge'i dbye ba'i gnas kyis ni/ /rang bzhin mngon par 'byung ba yin/ /yi ge dang ni rang bzhin gnyis/ /gnas dang rten du shes par bya/ /yi ge dag pas rtog pa dag /rtog pa 'od gsal gnas su spyod / /yi ge rnam pa lus gnas pas/ /drug gsum rang bzhin brgya 4drug cu/ /nyin mtshan sbyor bas 'byung bas na/ /lus gnas yi ge brgya dang ni/ /drug cu gnas las 'byung zhing 'jug /de phyir gsang ba'i yi ge yis/ /thams cad za zhing lding bar 'gyur/ /nam mkha' mtha' med rtag pa'i don/ /sems can kun gyi gnas chen po/ /dpal gyis 5'byor pa bla med rgyal / /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed pa'o/ /ā li bcu drug phrag gnyis las / /zhe sdang las gyur rtog pa 'byung / /de yi rtsa ba thig ler bcas/ /sum cu gsum du gyur pa yin/ /kā li sum cu rtsa bzhi dang / /ya ra la wa da dha ste/ /bzhi bcu mngon par gnas pas na/ /'dod chags rtog pa de snyed yin / /zung gyur drug ldan thig ler bcas/ /mtshan ma bdun gyis mtshon pa'i phyir / /dbus ma la brten 6gti mug pa'i/ /rang bzhin ma rig gyur pa'o/ /snga ma g.yas rtsa la brten pa/ /skyes pa rdo rjer bcas gyur brjod/ /gong du g.yon rtsa las 'byung ba/ /bud med pad+ma'i mtshan mas brjod/ / rtsa yi 7byed pa mi 'dra ste/ /khams dang rnam shes 'du ba yi/ /rten du gyur phyir rtsa yin te/ /82—438

rnam par bzlog na gnyis su 'gyur/ / thig le 'pho 1'gyur phyi rol bzhin/ /zla ba lus la 'pho ba ste/ /tshes gcig la sogs rkang g.yon nas/ /mthe nabo sogs 'phel spyi bor gnas/ /de nas g.yas kyi cha la ni/ /zla ba rim gyis 'grib par 'gyur / /'phel dang 'grib pa'i khyad par gyis/ /bcwa 5lnga byang chub sems skyed byed/ /dkar phyogs nag po rim shes bya/ /spyod pa'i tshul ni de bder spyad/ /gnam stong nyi ma gsang bar 6te/ /zla ba nya gang tshes gcig 7rgyasal/ /khyad par sgra gcan /rim shes bya/ /bla na med pa rags pa dang phra ba'i gnas 'jug ldog bstan 9pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas gsang ba rab tu 'dzin pa pos/ /khyad 1 par sems gsum rim pa bka' stsal te11/ /snang ba zhes bya rnam par mi rtog pa/ /gsal ba'i cha ste gzung rtog spangs pa lasal/ /'byung ba mi mngon rlung dang bcas pa gang / /lhang 12nger gnas pa skad cig dang po yin/ /mched 1 pa'i snang 1 ba rab tu mi rtog ste/ /ches gsal ba las 'dzin rtog ma zhugs pa/ /ye shes phra ba rlung ldan mi snang ba/ /lhan ne gnas pa skad cig gnyis pa yin/ /thob pa'i cha ni shin tu mi rtog pa/ /gsal ba tsam du'ang mi gnas shin tu phra/ /rlung sems mi phyed gsal bar 'char ba min / /lham same gnas pa skad cig gsum pa yin/ /nye bar thob pa dri ma med pa ste/ /rang byung rang gsal bde ba dmigs su med/ /phra rags rab gsal ting nge 'dzin du gnas/ /skad cig bzhi pa mi 'gyur khyab byed yin/ /'od gsal ba ni bsam gtan zag pa med/ /rdul med sa bon med pas mi g.yo ba / /lhan cig gnas pa chos sku'i snying po ni/ /lhun grub byang chub sems kyi ngo bo nyid/ /sgyu ma 'di nyid yod med las 'das shing / /dbu ma tsam du'ang mi 82—439

gnas kun rdzob ste/ /chos rnams thams cad sgyu ma'i snang ba las/ /'gag pa med pa'i rol pa rang byung ba'o/ /zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i mtshan nyid can/ /chos dbyings chos nyid dbyer med dag pa'i sku/ /tha dad rnam bral mi phyed ye shes te/ /gsang ba chen po'i lam las 'dir rtogs bya/ /thun mong 1dbang phyug dang ni /rtags bcas pa/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan 'char ba 'di nyid do/ /phra zhing yang la phra bar nub 3pa dang / /spyod par nus dang bdag nyid chen po dang ske/ /dga' mgur byed cing thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ /ci 'dod byed dang dbang phyug don du 'char/ / sku yi cadabang phyug gsung gi dbang phyug dang //thugs kyi dbang phyug de nyid phrin las dang / /rdzu 'phrul kun du 'gro ba'i dbang phyug dang / /gang 'dod bskyed dang khyad par don brgyad do/ /phung po khams dang skye mched bsdus pa yi k+ṣ-i/ /lnga po'i dbye ba lnga ru byas pa la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa so sor byin gyis rlabs7/ /'khor ba'i las rnams dag ni rnam dag pas / /de bzhin dbang po'i phyi rol yul bcas lnga/ /re re zhing yang bde gshegs lnga rnams kyi/ /de la rang rang rtag tu byin gyis rlob/ /ye shes lnga dang gsum du gnas pas yang dag 8bsdus/ /zhes gsungs te/ gsang ba zab pa'i tshul bstan pa rdo rje mi phyed pa'i ye shes kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa ste/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las mnyam pa nyid 'byung bar bstan par gyur pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste so gnyis pa'o// //82wa 440

rtag 1pa gsum pa rdo rje gsang ba ye shes 'byung ba'i rgyal po zhes bya ba rab tu gsang ba'o/ /de nas bcom ldan bde gshegs kun/ /gsang chen ye shes rdo rje 'dzin/ /sems can don du yang dag 'byung / /blo ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /don kun thub pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /rgyal ba de la btud byas te/ /gsang ba dam tshig mkhyen pa la/ /mchod cing bstod pas gsang chen gyi/ /rdo rje dbyangs 2ni bshad pa yin/ /e ma tshul bzang sangs rgyas pa/ /de nyid rigs brgya bsdus pa'i sku/ /de nyid tshul mchog byang chub pa/ /rigs kyi sangs rgyas lngar bsdus pa/ /byang chub snying po tshul zhi ba/ /gsang ba rigs gsum bla na med/ /gsang ba'i tshul ni gcig pa nyid/ /rgyas gdab rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /ye shes rim pa nyid du bstan/ /ma skyes pa yi 3rang bzhin las/ /khyad par ngo bo rang byung ba/ /yang dag rnam par mi rtog pas/ /bla med mngon par 'byung bar grags/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas paral/ /dpal ldan chos kyi rang bzhin sku/ /rtog pa'i dri ma 'gag byed pas/ /sku gsum ye shes dkyil 'khor du/ /phra ba'i rnam par gzhug par bya/ /de nyid rnam shes 'pho ba'i dngos/ /gdan bcas sa bon thim par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bar snang khams/ /khyab cing bzhugs par rab bsgom pa/ /yi ge gsang ba rang sngags la/ /them 4pa gcig tu bsdu bar bya/ /thugs kyi ngo bor bsam par bya/ /thams cad sgyu ma'i sbyor ba yis/ /dngos kun rang bzhin mtshungs par blta/ /sangs rgyas thams cad sems su yang / /slar yang bsgoms nas de rab bsdu/ /gsang ba gcig tu dbang bya yi/ /'pho ba sku gsum rim par 'byung / /chos dbyings mnyam pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /mi 82wa 441

shigs 'od kyi gong bu las/ / nā da 1)tsam du snang ba gang / /mi 'gag rang bzhin dag par gnas/ /gsang ba rdo rje'i rin chen gyi/ /rab tshon/snang byed pa'i ting 'dzin bshad/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan mtha' yas bsags pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes mngon par rol pa 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams bdag med pa yi dngos/ /gnyug ma dbyer med stong nyid dang / /zad pa med cing 'phel med pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'ol/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan 'bar ba'i tshogs can sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dri ma med pa'i me 'od rin po che mnga' ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi pad+mo rnam par rol pa'i 'byung gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams thams cad ma skyes pa/ /skye med snying gi pad+ma la/ /sa bon rdzogs pa'i snying po gang / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'bar ba'i phung po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang byung gi 4rgyal po rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /zla ba'i snying po 'od 'phro ba/ /chu rgyun 'bab pa'i zer ldan gyis/ /bsam pa'i ye shes rgyun gyis ni//thogs 5med ye shes tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das srid pa las rgal ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rgya mtsho la rol pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sna tshogs dngos po'i chos nyid ni/ /spros pa med phyir snang 82wa 442

med pas/ /theg pa mchog gi chos nyid kyis/ /gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan 1pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa srid pa ldan pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rdo rje dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i dngos/ /rtag dang chad pa las grol na zhing / /yang dag don mthong rang grol gnas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dbyangs snyan par sgrogs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ tsho byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dri ma med pa'i chos nyid ni/ /gdod nas dag pa de bzhin gshegs/ /snying po ye shes byang chub pas/ /gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan dpa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i me tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes seng ge'i rtsal rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gsang ba chos kyi dbyings nyid las/ /thub pa don kun rdo rje 'dzin/ /mchod de rdo rje dbyings 'dir gsungs/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshogs chen gtso bo sangs rgyas thams cad kyis caganas 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gnyis su med pas 'du 'bral med/ /rnam par grol ba'i phung po can/ /bde chen sku ste skyon med pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o5/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sgyu phung po lnga dag pa'i stobs kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 82wa 443

'di gsungs so/ /ji srid 'gro ba'i bya ba dag /'dus pa las ni skye bzhin pa//de yang yul las rab tu 'byung / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa khyim bdag drag shul can gyis byin pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi grangs 1chen po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te / byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /de nyid mnyam pa med pa yi/ /rdo rje zla ba 'dus las 'byung / /tha dad dmigs pa rab zhi bas/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi dbang phyug rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes skyob pa bla na med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ye shes 'byung gnas sa chen ltar/ /de nyid bden mthong chos kyi spyan/ /shes rab zab mo'i spyod yul gang / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'ol/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid mtha' yas pa'i 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhing khams yongs su dag par ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mkhyen pa dag pa chos kyi dbyings/ /rnam pa kun tu rang byung bas / /'gro ba'i bsam pa rdzogs mdzad pa/ /thub pa ye shes tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer chen pos khyab par mdzad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 3thogs pa med pa'i gnas pa spyod pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /zil gnon chos ni gsang ba che/ /mi zad rgyan gyi sgrub pa'i gzhi//de nyid nges pa stobs gyur pas/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes 82wa 444

gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen grags pa'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mdzad pa sna tshogs ston pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i 1ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'jig rten khams ni sna tshogs su/ /'gro ba 'dul ba'i thabs kyi phyir/ /rnam rol ye shes spyod pa yis/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshogs can gsal ba'i snying po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mi 'gag pa rol pa'i sgra rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /zhing khams bye ba mtha' yas par mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dbyings gcig gis/ /tha dad du mar khyab byed pa'i/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa mtha' yas chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par mi rtog pa rdo rje'i snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rtog pa sna tshogs bsdus pa yi/ /ye shes gcig gis gnas pa las/ /tha dad ting 'dzin dag pa'i ngang / /rdo nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa don yod 'od zer sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i yul rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 2zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes rdo rje ro gcig par/ /lan tshwa chu bzhin spyod pa ni/ /skal bzang natshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lha'i drang srong skyob capa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dri ma med pa'i rdo rje skyob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ /byang chub kyi 82wa 445

sems 'di gsungs so/ /lha dang mi yi ston pa gang / /rkang gnyis thams cad mkhyen pa ste/ /ma 'ongs bla ma'i gzugs kyis 1gnas/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skye ba'i dbang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nardzu 'phrul mi zad pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad bskul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /brtan dgayo ma lus snang ba'i gzhi/ /de nyid kun du bsgyur ba po/ /de nyid de bzhin gshegs pas sprul/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dge 'dun brtan 4pa'i blo sangs rgyas thams cad kyi klu dbang gnon pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gdug pa ma lus gdon byung ba/ /de nyid rtog pa'i dra ba las/ /kun byung 5dag par 'dul byed pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs sol/ /gsang ba'i rgyal po bcom ldan gyis/ /de nyid byang chub sems dpa' la/ /rab tu bskul te bstan pa gang / /rab tu nyon cig rdo rje 'dzin/ /dkyil 'khor gang du bsgrub pa yi/ /gsang ba mngon par byang chub pa/ /rgyu dang rtags dang go cha dang / /rnam pa lngar ni bstan pa ste/ /'jug pa sbyor ba'i rim pa yis/ /dmigs pa bsdus pa nyid yin no/ /rlung dang sngags dang sgra las ni/ /rdo rje bzlas pa'i rim pa'o/ /gang du sems kyi snang ba las/ /rab dben rim pa gnyis par brjod/ /rmi lam sgyu tshoma'i chos can las/ /bdag byin brlab pa'i rim par gyur/ /bsam gtan sbyor dang 'od gsal ba/ /mngon par byang chub rim pa nyid/ /de las gnyis med de bzhin nyid/ /rim 82wa 446

pa lnga pa zung 'jug lam/ /lus sems ngag gi chos bsdus pas/ /tshul gsum mngon par byang chub pa/ /de nyid ye shes lnga dag tu/ /rigs kyi dbye bas bstan pa yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / /thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las chos kyi tshul bsdu ba mngon par byang chub pa'i le'u ste so bzhi pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs bzang rtog skyes bu kha lo sgyur ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /thabs dang bsam pa gang gang gis/ /lus 'di spyod pas sgyur tsho1bas na/ /sems ni ting nge 'dzin gyis te/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas /de bzhin gshegs pa yul 'khor me tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ku sha'i rtse mo ltar phra mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs —rgyas kun gyi rol pa yi/ /bsam gyis mi khyab ye shes sku/ /rang rig nyid las tha dad med/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ rmo /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi blo gros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bkod ma'i 4)chu 'dzin pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bde gshegs gdung ni rgyas pa gang / /thugs rje dag pa'i stobs yin te/ /'gro ba gso ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /byang chub ye shes bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rlung gi shugs 82—447

'chang ba ltar gshegs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sman pa'i rgyal po 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'gro ba kun gyi 'khor ba yi/ /nad sel thabs mchog byams pa'i dpal/ /brtse sems tshad med srung ba po/ /zab pa'i tshul 'di bstan pa'ol/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa legs bsam grags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi blo'i dri ma sel bar byed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rang bzhin rtog pa'i dri ma rnams/ /gzung 'dzin chos kyis bsdus pa'i dngos/ /dbu ma'i ngang du rang dag pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa snang ldan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes chu bo'i rlabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ /byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi chos kyi lam/ /tshul gcig theg pa gcig pa nyid/ /byang chub chen po bla na med/ /byang chub tshul 1'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lha'i tshogs chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gzhal med kyi gnas ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /thams cad rang bzhin stong pa'i dbyings/ /gzhi med rtsa bral 'a dus ma byas/ /brjod med nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan 2pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan 'grib pa med par bsrung ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshul rin po che'i zom zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos dang chos 82wa 448

nyid med pa ste/ /pha rol phyin pa mnyam pa nyid/ /snang ba med cing rnam pa med / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa don gyi blo gros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi blo gros snang ba bkod pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'jig rten mun pa sel mdzad cing / /sa gsum gsal bar byed pa yi/ /glog gi 'od kyis 6)'char ba po/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsnyengs med sangs rgyas thams cad kyi (7pheg rdob pa'i sgra snyan lta bur du0ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du chos kyi don 'byung ba/ /bla na med pa byang chub sems/ /ye shes rgyu dang 'bras bur ston/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan ④pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa grogs ⑤brtan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'gro ba'i mig ston pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ ci/sems can bsam pa'i dbang gis ni/ /lam gyi rim pa thams cad par/ /'dam bzangs chu yi (5)bdud rtsi ltar/ /skal bzangs de nyid tshul shes byos/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od gnas mtshungs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gzhon nu'i zla ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos kyi tshul ni zhi ba nyid/ /bcu drug ye shes brgyan pa nyid/ /skad cig bden pa byang chub pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nor bu'i zhal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od zer kun 82wa 449

la dga' zhing / /tshig don bdud rtsi'i rgyab kyis phyogs/ /de la dngos grub rnyed 1)dka' ste/ /gsang ba 'dzin pa spong bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las yongs su dag pa'i gnas rdo rje'i le'u ste so lnga pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa blo bzangs (misangs rgyas thams cad kyi glog gi phreng ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rten 'brel yang dag 'byung ba las/ /kun rdzob nyid kyi chos nyid ni/ /dbyer med don dam rnam par dben/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa stobs dzo sbyin pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rin chen sgron me 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di (gegasungs so/ /dngos po 'di dag ma skyes pas/ /de nyid dngos por mi gnas shing / /rang bzhin 'od gsal rtag pa nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ri dgas 57kun du rgyu ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rdo rje lam du rab zhugs nas / /nor bu dri med zla ba yi/ /skyon gyis ma gos ye shes nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan 6pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa me tog gi tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rtog pa'i dba' rlabs g.yo ba med pa rdo rje 82—452

zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rdo rje gsang ba bla na med/ /mnyam sbyor bde ba dri ma med/ /mi 'dzag mya ngan 'das par 'gyur/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes 'byung gnas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rlung gi shugs kyis bskyod 6)pa med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /kun du mngon par mi gnas pa/ /gnyis med ye shes chos kyi rgyal/ /rnam par mi rtog chags med pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan 4kyepa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa me tog ster mdzad sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnga sgra'i snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /snang srid ma lus bcom ldan 'das/ /thams cad stong pa nyid las skyes/ /de nyid ye shes rgyu 'bras can/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan ri nipa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan snying po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi smyo tshim par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /stong nyid nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /sems nyid mnyam par mtshungs pas na55/ /mi 'gag go 'byed khyab gyur pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen grags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi skye dgu'i bdag po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /stong nyid dngos po ma yin te/ /dngos min gyur pa'ang stong pa min / /ngo bo nyid ni rnam dag pa/ /stong nyid ye shes tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes 82—453

gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa chen po rmad du byung ba sangs rgyas kyi gdul bya smin par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'byung ba bzhi dag nam mkhar gnas/ /de nyid gang la'ang mi gnas te/ /sems can sangs rgyas la brten pa/ /sangs rgyas mi gnas tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi tshugs 1)pa thub pa chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnga sgra'i snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gzod nas ma skyes dag pa nyid/ /srid zhi mnyam nyid rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro 'ong rnam bral tshul thob pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsnyengs med sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpag bsam gyi shing lta bur bskyed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i geting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du sa bon myu gu dang / /sdong bu 'dab ma 'bras bu'i bar/ /tshul brgyad 'gyur ba'i bye brag gis/ /rten 'brel de nyid tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ljon pa'i shing chen po ltar rgyas pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i (guting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'gro snying rnam rtog zhes bya gang / /rang rig byang chub snying po'i gnas/ /de las ( )yon tan brjod mi lang / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ ci/zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs par gshegs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lha'i sil snyan 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/82—454

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mi rtag bdag med zhi ba yis/ /'du shes sems pa sngon rgyu las/ /bag chags spangs pas gnas thob gyur/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lha'i mthu rtsal 0)sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sgra bung ba lta bur lding ba'i gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so / /rnam par rig byed las 'das shing / /de spangs bsam pa'i ldog pa yis//dbye bas tha dad shes par bya/ /'di ni snying po'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes la dgyes pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpal zhing khams bkod pa phreng ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi zhing khams gang / /snang mdzad rgyal po'i 'od kyi skus/ /rten mdzad ye shes snang ba nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa lha bden sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi snang ba bai ḍūr+yar (55ston pa'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'gyur ba med pa'i rin po che/ /gcig tu sgyur bar byed pa can/ /nor bu rtog pa'i blo bral ba/ /nges par tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nor bu'i snying po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mun pa smag sherum sel ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'khor ba'i mun pa sel ba yi/ /byin brlabs cana'od kyi sgron ma yis/ /snang ba ston cing 'joms pa gang / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs 82—455

so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dpal ye shes kyi snying po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rtog pa'i rgyal po dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te / byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /snying por gyur pa rang srog las/ /mi shigs go 'phang gnas spyod pa/ /de nyid rlung sems dbyer med pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan 3)pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa bcings pa med pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spro ba dpag med ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos dbyings ye shes spyod yul pas/ /mi gnas mi dmigs mnyam pa nyid/ /tshad med rang byung mi rtog phyir/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa brtul zhugs brtan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mdzad pa mi zad pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /nges 'byung rnam par mi gnas pa/ /'khor ba dag pa'i sems gnas pa/ /de nyid ye shes tshul gsum gyur/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gang du sngon byung sangs rgyas dang / /ma 'ongs byon gyur de bzhin gshegs/ /da ( ltar phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /gsang ba 'di las yang dag 'byung / /sems kyi bslab pa la phyogs shing / /zab pa rig pa 'dzin pa dang / /de nyid mdo sder gang bstan pa/ /phyi nang gnyis su bstan pa yin/ /gsang ba bla na med pa'i don/ /snying po'i don rnams ston byed pa/ /'bras bu rtogs pa'i ye shes ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la mngon gyur pas/ /thabs kyi khyad par gyur pa ste/ /rdo rje theg pa zhes brjod do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams 82—456

cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las gsang ba bla na med pa'i don yongs su skyong 6)ba'i le'u ste sum cu drug pa'o// //de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /ye shes don kun 'dzin mdzad pa/ /dus gsum bdag po dpal ldan pas/ /gsang ba ye shes spyod pa gsungs/ /gnyis med mnyam pa mi 'gyur ba/ /dus gsum rtag tu rang byung nyid/ /skye ba med pa las sprul zhing (ge/ /ma skyes rang bzhin brjod du med/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi chos rnams ni/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam gyur pa/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes las / /sgyu ma tsam du bstan pa yin/ /rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bur ni/ /gnas pa brjod bya don gyi chos/ /de nyid nges par don ston (8)pas/ /rjod byed sgra yi phyogs su bshad/ /gsang chen theg pa snying po'i don/ /rgyal po che ba 4rang la gnas/ /mchog tu brtag pa 'dus pa ste/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug ston pa'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzigs pa lha'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rdo rje lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te5) / byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /de nyid gsang ba'i ye shes che/ /snying po phyag rgya chen po'i ngang / /zab dang rgya che'i tshul gnas pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs dbu sgyu ma lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus 56)rig pa'i ngang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa gnas pas/ /sku bzhi ye shes mchog rtag pas/ /dri med 'dul ba'i 82—457

tshul mchog go/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dal gyis bzhud pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi seng ge rnam par bsgyings 6)pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i byang chub sems/ /'bad pa med par 'byung ba ni / /chos rnams dbyer med gcig pa'i sku/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o②//zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa brtul zhugs dka' thub sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpa' bar 'gro ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mthong chos don yod snying po ni/ /'bras bu grub pa'i rkyen 'byung ba/ /de nyid sad (mibyed rnam par thar / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer phung po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi skam sar gnas pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sems can rnams kyi bsam pa yi/ /spyod yul sna tshogs 'byung ba na/ /thar pa'i lam la spyad par bya/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o//zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bden pa dag pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi stobs kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bsam gtan sbyor ba sgyu ma yis/ /nye bar 'grub pa yang dag pa'i/ /gsang mtha' tshul 'di nges bstan yin/ /de nyid spyod pa bstan (47pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tsam pa ku'i mdog can sangs rgyas thams cad kyi drang srong skyob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub 82—458

kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bsod nams mthar thug stobs chen po/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba brtan las 'byung / /'bras bu bzhis ni thub pa'i rgyan/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan 0)pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dga' mdzad sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rnam par thar pa'i sgo bstan gepa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /de nyid stong nyid mtshan ma med/ /smon pa med pa byang chub gzhi//rnam thar ye shes 'bras thob pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshogs can bzang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi (bsgyu ma lta bur ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos gang skye ba med pa dang / /'gag pa med par 'byung ba dang (4)/ /bla med gsang ba'i don bstan pas / /de nyid tshul 'di bstan 55)pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 4)smig rgyu lta bur ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan rmi lam dang / /sprul pa mtshungs par ston pa gang / /de nyid rang bzhin 'byung ba'i dngos/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes pa chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams rmi lam gzugs snang ltar/ /bag chags snang ba rang dag par/ /dri ma sbyang phyir bstan pa dag /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /82—459

zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba'i me tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi (1)chu zla lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gcig gis du mar khyab pa yi/ /ngo bo rang stong thig le gcig /zhen med phyag rgya 'byung ba yi/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshogs can 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dri za'i grong khyer lta bur 'char ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /dag pa'i ye shes yang dag pa/ /bcings pa med cing grol ba'ang med/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skrun par mdzad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprul pa lta bur ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du sangs rgyas rnams dang ni/ /nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems/ /de sprul dman par mos pa 'dul/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mdangs 'gro dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi (5)chu'i chu bur lta bur mkhyen pa bla na med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /lan tshwa rgya mtshor thim pa ltar/ /dba' (5)rlabs zhi ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /thob med ye shes sbyor don 'gro/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa don legs des sangs rgyas thams cad kyi /4)mig yor stong pa'i dngos po rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs 82—460

so / /gang du sad pas sad byed pa/ /kun nas ldang ba zhi ba yi/ /bsnyengs med don gsal byang chub pa/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa khyu mchog tshad med sangs rgyas thams cad kyi me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /srid las grol zhing bde thob dang / /mchog don gnas pa dag pa'i gnas/ /byang chub tshul dag 'khor lo yis/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lag bzangs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi (1)dbang po'i gzhu dang mtshungs par ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bstan pa 'di ni byang chub lam / /de nyid snying po sdom pa nyid/ /bslab pa yongs dag 'ja' tshon ltar/ /nges pa'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi (na glog gi 'od 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so / /thub pa'i rdzu 'phrul chen po ni/ /glog ltar 'byung ba'i yid kyis ni/ /kun du phrin (5)las bya ba las(4)/ /'jug pa'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsam pas 55)byin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprin 'phro (6)ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas dus gsum thams cad du/ /dri med rtag par 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /legs mchod bsam pa'i rgyun 'bab ste7)/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas gsang ba'i rgyal 82—461

po che/ /'bras bu ston pa'i lam byung tsho1)ba/ /mi phyed ye shes mnga' bdag 'chang / /zab dang rgya che'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /de nyid dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i che tho/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i dngos po kun/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' yis / /gzod nas dag pa'i ye shes gnas/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas med / /gsang chen bde ba'i go 'phang can/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las / theg pa'i lam rnam par dag pa'i gnas bstan pa'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa bdun pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams rgyal po'i 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dul ba'i stobs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rtog pa'i dra ba bsal dab yi/ /ye shes rnam thar dag pa yi/ /gsal ba yongs dag rjes 'gro bas / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen dbyangs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje dbyings 'byung zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so / /gsang ba chos 'byung yangs pa yi/ /dag pa dri med gnas kyi cha/ /cha dang cha min rnam spangs pa'i/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje'i sde sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nam mkha' dag pa'i gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/82—462

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dngos dang dngos med las grol zhing / /'bar ba thig le nā da 6)bral/ /ye shes sku ste rnam dag pas/ /gsang ba tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'byor ldan 'od kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyod pa'i gnas rdo rje rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so / /phyogs bcu kun du snang ba yi/ /'od zer 'phro bas 'khrugs pa yi/ /lha mo gar gyis mchod byed pa'i/ /gsang ba tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mtshan dang dpe byad dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te / byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /lha dang mi rnams kun la yang / /de nyid ye shes skal ba can/ /bzang po srid gsum spyad ①par bya/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i spyan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bde ba'i gzhal med dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ②ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams kun du mi phyed pa'i/ /tha dad blo ni rnam spangs nas//yang dag ye shes snang ba can/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srung sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bkra shis gdugs lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gling rnams kun gyi sems can khams/ /byams pa'i gdugs kyis khyab byed pa/ /mtha' skor bgrang mi lang bar ston/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs 82—463

pa blo gsal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nya'i lto lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i chos kyi gnas/ /'dren pa bdud rtsi 1)spyan yangs pas/ /thugs rjes rgyun chad med par gzigs/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes 'gros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi pad+ma lta bur ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bden pa'i mthus/ /drang por smra ba'i ljags dbang po/ /ge sar dmar po ltar ston pas/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid drag shul can sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dung lta bur ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /tshad med thugs kyi gter chen po/ /rnam par dkar ba'i chos phyogs kyis/ /bar mtshams med par gnas thob pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bum pa lta bu rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bdud las rnam par rgyal ba yi/ /bum pa chen pos don byed pa/ /thog ma med pa'i byang chub sems/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpal gyi be'u rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du tshangs dang brgya byin dang / /'jig rten skyong bar bcas pa yi(na/ /mchod cing rdo 82—464

rje'i dbang phyug sku/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i 'od 17sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rin po che'i (mirgyal mtshan rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /lha srin sde brgyad ma lus pa'i/ /kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu ltar/ /mi nub dam pa'i gtso bo yis/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid rnam par mdzes pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhabs dang phyag gi mthil ri 'khor lo'i mtshan gyis brgyan pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /thub pas 'gro ba'i ngan song rgyun/ /yongs su gcod cing sbyong mdzad pas/ /rnam par gnon pa'i mchog mnga' ba'i//byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dpa' bo khengs med sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sbyin pa'i sgo nas 'gro ba bsdu ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'dir ni 'gro ba 'dul don du/ /lus srog zas dang longs spyod kyis/ /kun la chags med tshul du bskyang cad/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje sbrang rtsi'i zhal mnga' ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snyan par smra ba'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /skabs dang 'brel ba'i don 'gyur bas/ /cung ra zad yang dag don sbyor ba'i/ /phan pa ster ba'i byang chub kyis/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zla 'od dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi don mthun 82—465

pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'dul ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te / byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mthong na mi mthun med pa yi/ /dpal gyi zhing du bgrod 6)pa'i lam/ /yang dag don la sbyor byed pas/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa glog 'byin (2sangs rgyas thams cad kyi don spyod pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ci byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rmad ②du byung ba'i khyad par gyis/ /gtso bor gzhan don sems pa gang / /kun snang dpe med mkhas pa po/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu zhi bar gshegs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mi gnas pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ri rab rin chen lhun po ltar/ /brjid cing dpa' ba'i thub pa'i skus/ /sprul pa dngos por mi gnas pa/ /de nyid byang chub /4)tshul 5)bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'khrug 6)pa mi mnga' ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mnyam pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du thog ma mi dmigs shing / /tha ma med pa'i ye shes las/ /rnam par dben don dag pa nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas gsang ba 'dzin pa pos 7)/ /ma 'ongs byang chub don gyi phyir/ /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'dzin/ /sku gsum snying po bsdus pa'i bdag /'gro don spyod phyir 'byung ba ste/ /stobs chen 98)sna tshogs nags khrod du/ /thub pa dpal gyi rgyal po ste/ /shākya'i dge slong lits+tsha gri9)/ /gzhon nu 'phags pa'i blo can gyis/ /82—466

rim dang cig car 6)rgyas par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las/ gsang ba dag pa mchog gi le'u ste sum cu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa grags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /stong khams kha lo sgyur byed pa/ /chos kyi rgyal po dge ba'i stobs/ /dpung chen thabs la mkhas pa nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi yon tan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rang sems dag pa'i nor bu ni/ /yon tan du ma 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /mi zad dge ba rdzogs las 'byung / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa zhing bzang po mtshungs med sangs rgyas thams cad kyi (gyichos 'dzin pa'i btsun mo rin po che 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /shes rab pha rol phyin sbyor ba/ /mnyam med bla ma mchog dgyes pa'i/ /tshul 'di dri med 'od du 'gyur/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bkod (7pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje rab 82—467

rib sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'dam skyes pad+ma mdangs thon ltar/ /rang rig gsal ba'i ye shes nyid/ /skyon gyis ma gos phra ba nyid/ /ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mngon par 'phags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snang bar byed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dri med ut+pal 'bar ba la/ /rnyog pa'i dri mas ma gos ltar/ /rang grol byung ba'i ye shes mtshungs/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sbyin byed 'od 'phro sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sgron me lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so / /mnyam nyid mi 'gyur snang ba bral/ /thob med thob bral 'gro 'ong med/ /dbri ba dang ni gang med pa'i/ /ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa pad+mo'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyis nam mkha' lta bu'i 1)ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams nam mkha'i mtshan nyid las/ /'gyur ba med cing 'pho ba med/ /rnam pa kun du mkha' dbyings klong / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen bkod pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun du son pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /skye ba med las gang skyes pa/ /de ni ma skyes sbyor ba'i dngos/ /tshad med ting 'dzin sbyor ba po/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de 82—468

bzhin gshegs pa shin tu bzang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kun du rol pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du 'gag pa bral ba yi/ /chos nyid rang byung lhun gyis grub/ /de ni 'gag pa med pa'i dngos/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i mchog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdul dang bral ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /de bzhin nyid las dben pa yi/ /don dam dmigs pa'i yul min phyir/ /'dres pa rdul tsam med pa las/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thugs shin tu zhugs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ri bo gnon pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gnas pa med pa gnas pa'i mchog /mchog gyur rang byung mkha' la lding / /thugs stobs chos kun 'bras bu che/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba mi zad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ri rab lhun po'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi nam mkha'i khams/ /yongs su gang ba'i chos can ma/ /til gyi 'bru bzhin rgyas pa yi/ /sangs rgyas tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgya mtsho sbyin sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bdud dang bdud kyi ris thams cad 'joms par byed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bdud dang log 82—469

'dren ma lus rnams/ /byams pa'i ye shes chen po yis/ /log rtog ma lus zhi mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sna tshogs dag pa'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal be'u/ /'bar ba 'od 'phro nyi ma'i dbus/ /dra ba rin chen nor bu ste/ /ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i gzugs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gzhal med kyi gnas dag pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dpe med ye shes dag pa'i gnas/ /bkod pa mdzes spras rnam brgyan pa'i/ /rang gzhan dkyil 'khor snang 1)ba 'byung / /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa 'od 'phro ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'byung gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /kun 'gro dbang phyug rdul bral ba/ /de nyid byang chub dam pa'i yul/ /btang (7snyoms dag pa bla tshod med pa no/ /byang dzor chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dri med rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'dren pa mchog rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /lta bas mi ngoms chog mi shes/ /rig pa dang ni zhabs mnga' ba/ /ngan 'gro'i srid pa legs skyob pa'i/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes grags 82—470

pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yongs su dag par bsngo ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /yul dang dngos po byed pa po/ /rnam par mi dmigs stong pa nyid/ /'khor gsum yongs su dag pa ste/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa kun du rgyal ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'gro ba'i sde dpon dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te6)/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /thar pa'i lam na (5)theg pa che/ /gsang ba dam pa chos 'khor lo/ /rnam pa bcu gnyis yongs bskor ba/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par rtog pa'i dba' rlabs gnon pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin (pa snyoms par zhugs te / byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dpag med ye shes phra ba yis/ /dngos por 'dzin pa'i gyis pa rnams/ /skrag nas lam mchog dgod mdzad pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /ye shes bla med gnas thob pas/ /gtsang (guma'i gnas mchog legs gnas pas/ /bcom ldan 'og min der rtag bzhugs/ /kun du spyad pa'i sa phyogs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las dag pa de bzhin nyid kyi cho ga ston pa'i le'u ste sum cu dgu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang /82—471

gsung dang / thugs rdo rje 'dzin pa de bzhin gshegs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ dper na nam mkha' gang du yang / /mtshan can kun la mi gnas te/ /de nyid khyab cing bdag med pas/ /mi ldan pa yang ma yin te/ /nam mkha'i chos nyid de la ni/ /kun du rtog pa yod min te/ /rtog cing rjes su spyod pa yi/ /bdag dang gzhan du rtog mi byed/ /de bzhin chos rnams thams/ cad kun/ /rmi lam lta bur snang ba ste/ /rjes su 'gro dang ldog pa bral/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan 51)bzhin/ /rmi lam dam tshig las byung ba//de nyid sgyu mar gyur pa dang / /khyad par cung zad yod min te/ /rmi lam dang ni dngos snang gnyis/ /khyad par cung zad yod min te/ /gzhan du de nyid rtogs par bya/ /rlung dang bcas pa 'pho ba'i gnas/ /'gro ba kun gyi mgrin par skyes/ /yi ge oṃ bcas gnas pa nyid/ /a nu ta ra brjod pa gang / /gzung zhing bsgyur dang spel ba dang / /sgyu mar dran dang rgyas gdab pas/ /rmis pa bsam btan lam du 'gyur/ /kye bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rmi lam de ni bdag gis khams gsum du rmi lam mthong bar bya'o snyam du'ang mi sems so/ /skyes bu de yang bdag gis rmi lam gyi chos mthong ngo snyam du'ang sems pa 2med de/ de bas na khams gsum du snang ba'i bya ba de rnams kyang / /bag chags gzugs su snang daraba'i phyir/ /rmi lam lta bur bstan pa yin / /'khrul pa de nyid rgyu med pas/ /rmi lam nyid dang mtshungs par bstan/ /snga ma mi gnas rang grol te/ /phyi ma 'byung ba mi 'gag phyir/ /rmi lam las ni 'byung bar bshad/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 82—472

thams cad phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed pa rnams dang / sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyang rmi lam la bdag med pa 0)rdo rje yang dag par bden pas stong pa'i gnas su rtogs par bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sgra rnam par bsgrags (na pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes gsang ba dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams rnam par dag pa sa ni/ /khams dang dbang po mtha' yas dang / /bsam pa'i dri ma rang dag pa'i(5) / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba rgyas pa'i zhal mnga' ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rtag par brtse ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te / byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sems can tha ma 'bring dang ni/ /mchog rnams bdud rtsi thob bya'i phyir/ /lhag par spro ba bskyed pa gang / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa pad+ma'i 'od zer sangs rgyas thams cad kyi klu dbang 'dud ri pa'i rgyal po rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /tshe dang gzugs dang longs spyod kyis/ /gling gsum gnas las mngon 'byung ba/ /las dang spyod pa rtog pa las/ /bzlog dang ye shes tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa brtul zhugs bzang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul rmad du byung ba 5)rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'jig rten khams ni du ma yi/ /gling rnams kun du 'jug byed pa/ /cho 82—473

'phrul bsam mi khyab pa ni/ /'byung ba tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sgron ma'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnyog pa sel cing bsil ba tsan+dan ltar ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du skye dang 'chi ba dang / /nad dang rgas dang rgyad las grol/ /chu bo che las sgrol ba po/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa glog gi tog (1risangs rgyas thams cad kyi spros pa tshad med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gtong ba spro dang smra ba dang / /mtshungs pa rgyan (snyelas 'byung ba gang / /de nyid dad pa'i sems grol bas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od mtshungs pa med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'di yi 'od zer gang spros par/ /ting 'dzin bskyed dang dad pa thob/ /bde ba skyed la sdug bsngal zhi(mi/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skar ma can sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ma rig pa dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /byang chub sems gcig dag pa las/ /gzhan du ye shes ma rnyed pas/ /btsal du med pa'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa rdzogs ldan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi pa'adu byed rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la 82—474

snyoms 6)par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du sangs rgyas zhing dag pa/ /de snyed byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs/ /nyan thos rang rgyal 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /rnam dag tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so//de nas de bzhin gshegs pa pad+ma'i snying po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ming dang gzugs rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du bsam pa dug med pa/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhi can te/ /zla ba tshes pa'i ngo bzhin te/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dpal rgyal mdzes sangs rgyas thams cad kyi (bskye mched drug rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so / /longs spyod gtsang ba'i (kyebasgrubs pa dang / /lus dang yan lag dngos po yi / /rdul phran gyur pa legs phul ba/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnyog pa med pa'i don sangs rgyas thams cad kyi (gernam par shes pa'i chos rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par (gezhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so / /de bzhin nyid kyi spyod yul ni(6)/ /bsod nams tshogs ni sgyu ma ste/ /ye shes tshogs ni nam mkha' ltar/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa drag shul sde can sangs rgyas thams cad kyi (7)reg pa ṭa rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /yan lag bzhi ldan dpung tshogs bcas/ /bla med rnal 'byor pa yi gnas/ /zhing dang bsam pa dag pa 82—475

yis / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams gzi brjid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshor ba rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i sbyor ba yis/ /'gro ba kun la snyoms pa gang / /brtul zhugs khyad par bstan pa ste/ /tshul 'di byang chub snying po yin//zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mthu rtsal mnga' ba 0)sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sred pa rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpal dgyes pas khyab pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma lus pa'i/ /ye shes spyod pa rnam dag pa/ /zhing khams 'gyur med rang snang ba/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thogs med dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi len pa rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te(gu/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ / gang gā (7klung gi bye ma snyed/ /dpag tu med pa'i sangs rgyas gang / /zhing khams gcig par yongs su dag /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lha'i sgra can sangs rgyas kyi srid pa rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dmigs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /phyogs bcu rnam pa thams cad du/ /gang zhugs cadabade bar gshegs pa'i tshogs/ /mdzad pa gcig pa'i rnam thar gyis/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes phung po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi skye ba 82—476

rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi4 sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du ma byon 'byung ba dang / /'das dang da ltar bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas khams rgyud gcig pa'i ngang / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa kha lo sgyur ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rga shi rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos kun rtog pa zhi ba yi/ /zab pa dang ni rgya che'i bdag /mdo dang rgyud dang rtog pa las/ /byang chub sems 'di bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skye dbang mtshungs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rten 'brel dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sems can smin par byed pa dang / /sangs rgyas zhing sbyong 0)phrin las dag /de nyid mtshungs pa gcig pa'i sku/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje 'dzin pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /bsam gtan gnas su bde ba'i stan la ni/ /gnas nas dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /dmigs te sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin 'khrigs pa/ /dang por spro tshogs blo ldan gyis bya zhing / /dge ba rnams ni 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags pa la sogs (nadabya/ /gang zhig thog thumed srid pa'i chu klung du/ /ma lus kun rtog gis bskyed rnyog pa rnams / /thugs rje che ldan spyan sngar de dag ni/ /rim bzhin cho gas thams 82—477
