par grags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 0)klu'i gdon rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dmigs pa kun dang bral ba'i sems/ /nam mkha'i ngang las 'ja' tshon ltar/ /de nyid thogs med ye shes kyis/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od gtsang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dri za'i gdon rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sna tshogs rol mo'i cha dang ni/ /sil snyan rnams las sgra byung ba/ /ston pa'i chos kyi tshig grags pa/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lha'i nyi ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lha ma yin gyi gdon dag pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'di ni rnam par gtsang ba yi/ /dri ma rnam spangs bde ba'i lam/ /ye shes phyag rgyas brgyan pa yi/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab sbyin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nam mkha' lding gi gdon dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /nam mkha'i gnas kyi spyod yul ba/ /'di ni rnam dag byang chub lam/ /rnam grol rang rig bde ba che/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mnyam par bzhag 2pa'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mi 'am ci'i gdon dag pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa che/ /gsang (5)ba 'dzin 82—528

pa mtshungs med pa/ /rgyal ba rigs kyi bdag po'i dpal/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzi mdangs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lto 'phye chen po'i gdon dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sa la gnas pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /dag pa chos kyi dbyings gnas pa'i/ /shing rta chen po'i 'khor lo bzhin/ /bzhi drug ldan pas bgrod zhi)pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal rigs chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mtshungs pa med pa chos kyi don/ /spros pa med pa de bzhin gshegs/ /'bras bur ldan pa'i gnas 'di las5)/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes (8)gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skal ldan shing rta lto 'phye chen po'i gdon dag pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gnas pa med pa dri gsum spangs/ /thub pa rgyal ba spyan rdo rje/ /blo gros mi zad ye shes te/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dpal mchog gi ka na ka sangs rgyas thams cad ( kyi yi dgas kyi gdon dag pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /skye ba med cing 'byung ba'ang med/ /grub pa med pa'i chos nyid las/ /kun du snang ba mi slu ba/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par grol ba'i gtsug sangs rgyas thams cad 82—529

kyi srul po'i gdon dag pa rdo rje'i sangs rgyas 0)thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mi 'jigs pa yi ②dngos po las/ /zag med dngos grub 'byung ba yi/ /dben pa rnam par mi rtog pa/ /ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chos ldan dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ①lus srul po 4)gdon 5)dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyal/ /thub pa byang chub shing drung du/ /bdud dpung sde rnams rab 'joms pa'i/ /ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa spos 6)gnas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi skem byed kyi gdon dag pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /smra ba'i seng ge bla na med/ /glang 6)po chen po thogs pa med/ /pha rol 'joms pa gyad bzhin te/ /de yi nor bu'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dregs pa spangs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi smyo byed kyi gdon dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du sna tshogs cho 'phrul tshogs/ /sems can mos pa'i snang ba la/ /du ma nyid du bstan gyur pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes kyi mdzod sangs rgyas thams cad kyi brjed (nyabyed kyi gdon dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mthun snang gang zag mos yul te/ /de bas yang dag sangs rgyas la/ /kun rtog mi 82—530

mnga' lham me bzhugs/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs par gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi grib gnon gyi gdon dag pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /'bad dang rtsol ba'i rtog mi mnga'/ /mtha' yas byang chub sems kyi ngang 6)/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tsan+dan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sha za'i gdon rnam par (5)dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /tha dad rtog pa yongs mi mnga'/ /rang rig ye shes 'gro 'ong med/ /thams cad grub mtha'i 'dod pas brtags(5)/ /de nyid ye shes tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med bdud kyi dpung las rgyal ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ma chags thogs med rdo rje yi/ /char sprin mdog 'dra'i 4)rtog spangs nas/ /tshad med byams pa chen po yis/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i 'od zer sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dmigs pa med pa 55)rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /yang dag byang chub thabs ldan pa/ /gang tshe sgyu ma lta bu'i dngos/ /de nyid rang bzhin stong nyid grub/ /mtha' med ye shes tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'dir rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la dag gsang ba'i spyod pas gnas shing gsang ba bla med kyi ting nge 'dzin la nye bar gnas pas ni nyan thos dang / rang rgyal dang /82—531

byang chub sems dpa' dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i yongs su spyod pa thams cad kyang yongs su rdzogs par spyod par byed do/ /gsang ba 'dzin par byed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs kyi sgo dang / rnam par thar pa ma lus pa yang tshe 'di nyid dang 67yongs su rdzogs shing kun du spyad pas spyod par byed na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan dang ye shes gzhan dag lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de la 'jig rten pa'i lha thams cad kyis sung bar byed / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha thams cad kyis kyang sung zhing skyob pa dang sba ba (midang yongs su srung bar byed do/ /gsang ba'i rgyud 'di gang gis 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / nyan pa dang / phan tshun 'dre (8)bar byed pa dang / sems pa na lha dang / klu dang / gza' dang / rgyu skar thams cad kyi gdon gyis kyang bar chad mi byed de/ bsrung gzhing yongs su mchod par byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las srung ba yongs su dag pa dang bar chad med pa'i don bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi bcu brgyad pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yul 'khor tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyal po chen po bzhi'i ris kyi gdon rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'phags pa rnams kyi ye shes gang / /phyin ci log (5)dang rnam bral ba/ /de nyid 82—532

skye 'gag bral ba la/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa pad+ma'i snying po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 6)klu chen po brgyad dag pa rdo rje'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i ye shes ni / /gsang ba mchog gi don gnas pa/ /dmigs pa las 'das byang chub sems / /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid dag pa lha chen po brgyad dag pa'i rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gzung 'dzin btags pa'i dbang gis ni/ /mthar gyur de nyid lam gyur pa/ /btags pa'i dri ma dag par bya/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin (migashegs pa lha'i 'od zer sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ( rigaza' chen po brgyad kyi gdon rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du rkyen las bskyed pa yi / /rnam pa phan tshun ltos las byung / /gzhan dbang dag pa'i ye shes ni/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yul 'khor tog (4)sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyu skar gyi gdon ma lus pa rnam par dag pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du phyin ci ma log pa'i/ /gnas tshul yongs su rdzogs grub pa/ /de bzhin nyid dang ye shes don/ /mi 'gyur de bzhin tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa pad+ma'i ge sar sangs rgyas thams cad kyi (5)lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi ris kyi gdon thams cad rnam 82—533

par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams dag pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /rang bzhin sgyu mar snang ba gang / /ngo bo lhun grub dbyer med las/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid dpag med sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phyogs skyong ba bcu'i gnod pa'i gdon yongs su dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /ma nor mngon par thugs chud pas/ /skyob pa thugs rje'i ngo bo las/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lha'i 'od zer sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rā 6)hu la rnam par dag pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bag chags dag pa'i rgyud las ni/ /ma rig pa dang bral gyur pas / /bdag skyes dag par gnas par bya/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab me tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsnu rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /khams rgyud rnam par byang ba las/ /phyir mi ldog par gyur pa na/ /rang rig bdud las grol bar 'gyur/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mkhas pa'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi drang srong thams cad rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so / /gang du gdon rnams 'byung ba'i tshe/ /rags pa 'og la brten (9nas te/ /82—534

phra ba'i sgo ni steng nas 'jug /dag pa ye shes tshul gnas bya/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes 'byor ldan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi khyab 'jug gi gdon rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /byed pa 'jigs pa'i tshul spangs te/ /zhe sdang dag pa'i byang chub las/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon byed pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi (1)dbang phyug chen po'i gdon rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du drag po 'jigs par ston/ /dus mtshan bcas pa 'dod chags bdag /'di nyid nyon mongs tshul dag pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa phyag na rin chen sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshangs pa dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'jig rten srid pa gnas pa yi/ /dag pa bzhi las sprul 'dod pa/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i bdag /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dbang ldan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'jig rten gsum rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du chags dang 'jig pa dang / /gnas dang stong ②pa'i rim pa 'di'i/ /dag pa gtsang ma'i zhing du smon/ /tshul 'di sangs rgyas bstan pa'o(8)/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdzogs par gsungs pa (4)sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sa 'og dang sa stengs phyinodang 55)sa bla ba rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting 82—535

mchod do/ /rab tu mchod do/ /kun du mchod do0)/ /yang dag par mchod cing me tog gi char phab par gyur to/ /rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs rab tu sgrogs par gyur to/ /rin po che sna tshogs kyi char phab pa la 'di lta ste/ rin po che yin da rnyil (shedang / margad dang / ke ke ru dang / ke ke ru chen po dang /spug dang / rdo'i snying po dang / man shel dang / bai ḍūr+ya (bdang / mu tig dang / mu men (4)dang / mu sa la galba (5)dang / rin po che'i rgyal ba 6)bsam 'phel gyi bar du gtor zhing yongs su byur bur rab tu gang bar gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las gdon la (7)yongs su dag cing kun du mchod pa'i le'u ste bzhi bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal ye shes brnyes pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lha'i bu'i bdud 'joms pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mtshan nyid med pa'i chos rnams la/ /phyi rol dngos po dag pa la/ /yang dag ye shes sgyur ba po(8)/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa grub pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi (4)nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /nyon mongs rnam rtog glo bur pa/ /de nyid ma rig tshi/bag chags dag /rtsa ba 82—538

bral bas des bcom pa'i/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rma bya'i stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phung po'i bdud bcom pa'i rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam pa las/ /rmi lam tshul ltar ma 'gags pa/ /gang du dag pa bdag med pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mchod 6)sbyin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam par dag pa ye shes sku//'gro 'ong med cing dbri bsnan (5)med/ /gang du 'du 'bral ( med pa'i don/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de lanas de bzhin gshegs pa phan (5)par bzhed pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdud bcom zhing legs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dpal dang grags dang ye shes dang / /dbang phyug dang ni gzugs bzang gis/ /brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa (6)ste//drug po 'dis ni ldan par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes ldan pa ye shes lnga dag pa'i dbyings rdo rje sangs rgyas (7)thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so//gang du chos kyi dbyings dang ni/ /me long mnyam nyid so sor rtog /bya ba grub pa nyid dang ni/ /lnga po 'di ni ye shes brjod/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gshegs pa dang byon pa rjes su rtogs pa rdo rje sangs 82—539

rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du gshegs shing gang du byon/ /gang du gnas pa rdo rje'i ngang / /zag med dpal ldan de bzhin nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer gyi dra ba 6nyesangs rgyas thams cad kyi dkar po rnam par dag pa'i sa rnam par dag pa rdo rje sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du so so'i skye bo yi/ /tha mal mos pas lam 'jug (7pa/ /dge ba'i don mthong nyan thos lam/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par 'joms pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin rigs kyis rnam par dag pa rdo rje la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam par dkar ba'i don ldan pas/ /bdag med bzod pa mnyam pa nyid/ /chos gang lhag par dad pa na/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bai ḍūr+ya'i ③snying po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi brgyad pa'i sa rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du chos kyi don rnyed pa/ /thog ma'i 'bras bu mngon gyur pa/ /de nyid 'phags pa'i tshul bstan pa'i/ /bla (4)med tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa me tog lha'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi (gemathong ba'i sa rnam par byed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang gang mthong ba'i chos nyid la / /sgrib pa med par rang gsal ba/ /don dang mthun par spyod pa las/ /82—540

byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba dra 6)ba'i 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bslabs pa'i sa rnam par dag pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dug nyid dag par byas pa yi/ /dug med gnas ni phra gnas pa/ /bral ba bag la nyal ba zhi/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ba'i 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 6)'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa rnam par dag pa ②rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du chags med ye shes mchog /rags pa dag pa spangs pa'i don/ /dman pa las ni phyir 'ong bas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan kun mchog 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byas pa rtogs pa'i sa rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bya ba byas pa bstan ④pa'i don/ /byed pa byas pa khur bor te/ /rtag chad las grol byang chub lam/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsrung ba'i (5)sa rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /nyams pa med pa'i tshul khrims las/ /rnam par rtog pas mi phyed pa/ /dri med dgra bcom don thob pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan (6dpa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu zla ba can sangs rgyas thams cad kyi (7)'phags pa nyan thos kyi sa dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te 82—541

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bdag med don ldan dngos med pa/ /spyi dang bye brag mtshungs med pas/ /'bras bu grol ba thob pa nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sgra gcan ca1sangs rgyas thams cad kyi (5tshorang sangs rgyas pa'i gnas rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so//spyod pa rmad byung rgyal ba'i skus/ /'dul med zhing du rdzu 'phrul bas/ /rtog pa de las spyod par bcas/ /rang rgyal gnyis po'i tshul du brjod/ /ces gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi'i 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi (kyeye shes ji lta ba mkhyen pa rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /thogs med khyab par spyod pas na / /ma 'dres dus gsum mnyam pa nyid/ /mkhyen pa'i phyogs bral dag pa ste / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes ji snyed pa mkhyen pa dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas nyag gcig spyod yul du/ /mngon du ma gyur med pas na/ /thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpal/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skar ma'i 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /kun du rtog pas ma (gebartags pa/ /dran pas yid la byed pa bral/ /rab tu mi gnas pa yi yod(5)/ /dmigs pa med pa'i bdag nyid can/ /gang du dmigs med skye ba med/ /82—542

rten 'brel dag pa rang byung ba/ /lhun grub 6)ngang las ma g.yos pa'i/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan (9pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyisal/ /rigs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs/ /sna tshogs mchod cing bstod byas na/ /ye shes mchog gi gnyen gyis gsungs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rigs brgya yis/ /re res brgya phrag bcu yi bar/ /de ltar stong phrag brgya dag gis/ /'bum du bzlas pa yin par brjod/ /bdag nyid mi bskyod par byas te/ /rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor pa/ /sangs rgyas lnga dang yum bzhi dang / /sems dpa' drug dang lha mo lnga/ /khro bo'i rgyal po lngas bsdus (5)te/ /nyi shu pa yi bdag nyid kyis/ /gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje 'bar ba rab bsgoms te/ /de las byaspro dang bsdu byas pa'i/ /bzlas pa stong phrag nyi shu pas/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i bsam gtan ri5)bsdus/ /de ltar (7'khor lo nor bu dang / /pad+ma ral gri'i bar du yang / /re re'i sngags kyi don bsgom tso)pa/ /gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas te/ /spro ba dang ni bsdu ba yis/ /gti mug nga rgyal 'dod chags dang / /phrag dog dag pa'i dkyil 'khor las/ /rigs ni bzhi po kun la yang / /stong phrag nyi shu phrag bzhi yis/ /khri phrag bcur ni bzlas byas pas/ /bsnyen pa nye bar bsgrub pa yi(9/ /bzlas pa gsang sngags tshul bstan pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen 6)po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las gsang chen thun mong ma yin pa'i rab tu byed pa bstan pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu pa'o// //82—543

de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba'i stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje rin po che rab tu snang bar byed pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rgyal ba'i byang chub 'od po che/ /rtag tu chos rgyal thob pa'i don/ /rang rig mi gnas nam mkha' bzhin / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes rgya mtsho sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshad med pa'i zhing yongs su sbyong ba 91)rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du mngon par sangs rgyas kyang / /rgyu med 0rkyen grol byang chub sems/ /'di nyid 'gag par 'gyur med de/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ri'i dbang po'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyun mi 'chad par ye shes 'byung ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te (8)byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ye shes mngon par mi gnas pas/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i chos kyi dbyings/ /rjes 'gro mtshungs pa tha ma med/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu zhi ba sangs rgyas thams cad mi g.yo ba rdo rjer 'char ( ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam par dag pa thar pa'i tshul/ /rgyud 'di bstan pa med pa'i ngang / /kun du gsang ba mi 'khrugs pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan mtha' yas stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ther zug dang bral ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so//82—544

ngo bo nyid ni gnas med pa/ /sgyu mar snang ba kun rdzob tu/ /srid zhi mnyam pa nyid bstan pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lha'i dbang po thub pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis zhi bar mi gnas pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /shes rab kyi 0)ni rang bzhin shes/ /ye shes kyi (kyeni shes bya mkhyen/ /gnyis med shes rab ye shes dag /'dres pas rtogs par bya ba nyid/ /ces gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dbyangs snyan pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag med pa'i gnas rjes su rtogs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rang sems stong nyid dag pa ni/ /mthar thug don dam ma yin te / /chos sku rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ngos bzangs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro ldog nges pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos sku don dam la mi gnas/ /ci yang ma yin don dam la/ /byed pa spongs (5)pas 'bras bu'ang med / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan (4༄pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa don la gnas pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos thams cad de bzhin nyid du ston pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rang rig skad cig 'gag med pa'i/ /snga ma phyi ma la ltos phyir/ /rgyun chad mi 'gyur ltos med pa'i/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan gzi brjid 82—545

sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yongs su thim pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'das pa'i sems ni rang grol ba / /ma 'ongs pa ni ma thob cing / /da ltar gnas 6)med mtshan nyid can/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen ldan zla med sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rnam par grol ba'i dpal gyi (0ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ji ltar nam mkha' rnam dag bzhin/ /theg pa 'di ni nimakha' 'dra ste/ /spong ba med pa'i nyer zhi ba/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nga ro dpag med sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun rdzob dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /grub pa med pa'i snang ba tsam/ /rten 'brel tsam du'ang gang skyes pa/ /chos rnams dbang po'i gzhu mtshungs par/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu thugs bzhugs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bkod ④pa'i rnam par thar pa la 'jug pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rgyal ba bla med byang chub pa'i/ /'di yod pas ni 'di 'byung la//'di med pas na (57'di mi 'byung / /bstan pa de nyid tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa don (snyadagongs gti mug bral ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mtshungs pa med pa'i theg pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rgyu med rgyu nor ma tshang ⑦dang / /log pa'i don dang ngan pa spangs/ /tshogs pa gcig par ma 82—546

grub la/ /'byung ba med phyir rten 'brel bstan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dbyangs kyi yan lag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par rol pa'i ye shes rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rgyu las skyes shing rkyen gyis bskyed/ /gzhi la gnas shing 'bras bur grub/ /srid zhi mtshungs phyir bstan pa yin/ /byang chub de nyid bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa khyad 6)par du 'phags pa thub pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes mngon par 'byung ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /brtags na dben zhing don byed nus/ /mthun par snang la rkyen las bskyed/ /kun rdzob chos kun mtshan nyid de/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mchog tu mdzes par gshegs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam pa las bral ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /yul dang dbang po bdag po'i rkyen / /de ma thag pa'i mtshungs med pa/ /rang bzhin byung laba'i skad cig la/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba'i don sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang gi ngo bo dag (5)pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ngo bo 'bral med chos kyi sku/ /mi 'chad 'byung ba longs spyod rdzogs/ /rang gi mtshan nyid bde ba che/ /dbyer med (4)tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so//de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba'i don sangs rgyas thams cad kyi grub pa rdo rje'i tshul gyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di 82—547

gsungs so/ /ming dang nges tshig ngo bo gang 6)/ /mtshan nyid dbye ba'i don gyis na/ /rgyu 'bras chos las rgyal ba 'byung / /tshad med tshul 'di bstan pa'o//zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skyon med sangs rgyas thams cad kyi (gyispangs pa med cing thob pa med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du bskal pa bye bar yang / /spong bar zhugs shing spyad pa las/ /byang chub ring song (mi'agyur ba med/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi (perang grol 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa blo dbyangs dge ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phyin ci ma log pa'i don rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /skye ba med pas chos kyi sku/ /'gag pa med pas longs spyod rdzogs/ /gnas pa med pas sprul pa'i sku/ /dbyer med tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /rig pa'i rgyal po rdo rje can/ /ye shes bla na med pa'i chos/ /bstan pa nges par legs pa'i gnas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las rab tu mi gnas pa'i don bstan pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu gcig pa'o/ / //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa pad+ma'i mdzod sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dus kyis grol ba rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dus gsum dus med ston pa po/ /tshad med 82—548

ye shes stobs chen po/ /srid zhir mi gnas bde bar gshegs/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer bzang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dus mi dmigs par grol ba rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bskal pa grangs dang grangs med las/ /'das pa ye shes skad cig ma/ /bsam gyis mi khyab don 'char 'gyur/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa spobs pa'i tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shes rab kyis rnam par grol ba rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gsang ba'i chos kyi tshig gcig gis/ /grol ba ye 6)shes thob pa ni/ /nga yi (2)chos rnams des mthong ba/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa lam bzang (5)po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnyis ma'i ⑨cha las grol ba rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i phyogs dag dang / /las las grol ba 'phags pa'i chos/ /de nyid nges pa bla na med/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshogs bzang po grol ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas de bzhin snang ba'i rdo rje'i ( ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /gsum la nges par (phyiraskyabs song na/ /dag pa ye shes spyod pa yi/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so//de nas de bzhin gshegs pa snyengs (7)dang bral ba rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 82—549

sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas la ni skyabs song ba/ /ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas kyi/ /lta bas 6)mi ngoms sku ②mthong zhing / /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes brjed (8)pa med pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos rjes su dran pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dam pa'i chos la skyabs gi)'gro ba/ /ma 'ongs pa na rgyal ba la/ /dam pa'i chos sgra thos nas ni/ /byang chub tshul 'di thob byed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa spobs pa'i spyan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phags pa'i tshogs rjes su dran pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun skyabs song gang / /ma 'ongs pa na nyan thos dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams dang / /lhan cig spyod pa ston par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa blo'i mchog thub pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan pa gcig tu ston pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so / /rgyal ba'i rin chen rnam gsum po/ /dbang phyug tshogs pas mthar thug dus / /gcig pu 95nyid du thugs la bzhugs(5)/ /de nyid byang chub tshul bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa zla ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi rjes su mthun pa'i phyogs la zhugs pa rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so / /sku gsum rang las lhan cig skyes/ /de nyid lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas/ /82—550

ye shes spyod pa gnas 'di nyid/ /ston pa'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen zla ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rjes su mthun pa'i spyod pa'i chos rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po dang / /bcu gnyis dag pa bdag med pa/ /'byung gnas 0)sgra tshul skyob pa'i chos/ /de nyid phun sum tshogs par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa stengs ②pa med pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rjes su mthun pa'i chos la spyod pa rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems/ /bla med sems dpa' chen po ni/ /don dam bstan pa'i mchog brnyes (kyepas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzigs pa chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mthun par zhugs pa rdo rje rnam par dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rang nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rig pa rnams/ /rang las 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi drang por zhugs pa'i spyod pa'i yan lag rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub ri kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bsam gtan yan lag lngas gnas shing / /rnam par 'gog pas mi g.yo ba/ /bde chen mnyam nyid gnas pa'i tshul/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 82—551

dbyangs bzang 0)po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rigs pas zhugs pa rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so / /dam pa'i yul la 'jug pa na(gyi/ /mgon po bdag nyid chen po'i ngang / /tshangs pa'i gnas kyi dmigs las grol/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab chen po'i bzhon (9pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi legs par zhugs pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /tshul chen thabs ldan dri ma med / /yan lag 'byung ba chos dag pa/ /so sor ma yin mkha' dbyings klong //byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros mtshungs med sangs rgyas thams cad yang dag pa'i lam la zhugs pa rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du mngon par mkhyen pa la/ /rlom sems med pa'i bdag nyid du/ /gcig pa bkag ( pa'i rgyun las ni/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal po rdo rje mkhregs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 5)lam yan lag brgyad rnam (6)par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /yan lag 'di dag ldan pas na/ /nges par 'jug pa mi ldog pa/ /sems dpa' chen po dge ba'i mthu/ /gsang ba de nyid bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub blo gros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshad med pa rdo rje'i gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang / /btang snyoms 82—552

bdag med mnyam pa'i dngos/ /tshad med chu bo'i rlabs las ni/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ljon shing bzang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi skyob pa mtshungs pa med pa'i rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sā 0)la chen po'i shing ltar na / /'dab rgyas rgyal ba rgyun mi 'chad/ /re re'i don du'ang du mar bzhugasani/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /rgyun du chos spyod skal ba can/ /ye shes dam pa'i gnas thob pas/ /yan lag bcu pa bstan pa yin/ /phyag 'tshal bskor ba yi ger 'dri/ /sbyin dang mchod pa kha ton dang / /nyan dang 'chad pa de bsam zhing / /ting 'dzin ldan pas spyad par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ④kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las sde snod kyi tshul yongs su dag par spyod (5)pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gdangs snyan pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'khrul pa med cing 'dres (6)pa med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /kun du thun mong (7)yul min zhing / /khyad par gyur pa thub pa yi/ /phrin las dag pa tshad med pa'i / /byang chub sems 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ca co med pa'i rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so//82—553

rags pa dang ni phra ba yi/ /kun nas ldang ba dag pa yis6)/ /dkrugs pas 'khrug pa mi mnga' ba/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mthu'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsnyel ba med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sems can don la dus kun du/ /bskyed dang dbri ba med par ni / /rgyun chad med pas 'jug pa (snyedag /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'phags pa dgyes pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes mnyam par ma bzhag pa med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mnyam par ma bzhag spyod pa na'ang / /rtag tu dri med gnas pas na/ /btang snyoms tsam du'ang mi gnas te/ /byang chub ( nitshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mthu stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tha dad du gzigs pa mi mnga' ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ma spangs mi gnas mnyam nyid de/ /blang dor med pa'i ye shes can / /sangs rgyas chos nyid dag pas na/ /byang chub tshul 'di dag pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa drang srong skar ma la dgyes pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi so sor ma brtags ④pa'i btang snyoms med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /yongs su sbyang dang brtag (5)pa dang / /gsal dang dbye ba 'byung ba las/ /khyad par btang snyoms med pa ste/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gyi sgron me sangs rgyas thams 82—554

cad kyi 'dun pa nyams pa med pa sangs rgyas kyi rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dus rnams phyogs bcur rgyal ba yis/ /spro ba byang chub snying po'i don/ /sangs rgyas gdung las gzhan mi rtog /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa spyan mdzes mnga' ba'i zhal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi brtson 'grus nyams pa med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sems can gcig gi don du yang / /bskal pa gaṅgā'i bye snyed du/ /rdul phran grangs/ 'das rtsom zhinapa che/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes bzang ldan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dran pa nyams pa med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dpyad pa mi dmigs ma 'dres par/ /yongs su dag pa'i mkhyen pa can/ /snga ma la sogs rtag med phyir/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas (nade bzhin gshegs pa 'byor par ldan pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin nyams pa med pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ting 'dzin du ma gcig sdud cing / /gcig las du mar spro ba yang / /de dag snyoms par 'jug pa yi/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan bzang po'i phung po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shes rab nyams pa med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so / /mkhyen pa rig pa du ma las/ /'gog pa med par bzo (8)yi gnas/ /bla 82—555

med mi bzad lho)tshul thob pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gsang 6)ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par grol ba (5)med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ye shes stong nyid me chen gyis/ /'khor ba'i dri ma ma lus pa/ /chos dbyings ngang du sreg mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lus kyi las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dus rnams kun du thogs med par/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes las/ /'byung zhing 'jug dang gnas par mdzad/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes rol pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngag gi las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /zhing khams ma lus thams cad du/ /khyab byed snying po rdo rje la/ /'jug gnas ldang ba dbyangs/ brjod pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ④yid kyi las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mkha' dbyings chos nyid rnam dag dang / /rnam rtog 'gro 'ong mi gnas (5)pas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas 82—556

de bzhin gshegs pa mchod sbyin nga ro sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'das pa'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes mthong bas 'jug pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du brtan 0)g.yo bcas ②pa yi/ /dngos po de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /phun sum tshogs pa thogs med pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan zhi)pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes rnam par bkod pa'i nga ro sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ma 'ongs pa'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa'i 4)'jug pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'jig rten khams kyi rdul phran dang / /sems can spyod pa sna tshogs dang / /dpal ldan bde gshegs mdzad pa dag /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer yon tan gzi brjid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi da (5)ltar ba'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes dang ldan pas 'jug pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rtog med me long gzugs lta bu/ /gsal ba 'dzin pa bral ba yi/ /rim (gyedang cig car 'bad med par/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa drang srong dbang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yongs su ma 'dres pa'i chos bcwa gabargyad rnam par dag pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i bdag /gsang ba 'dzin pa snying por gyur/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa blo dang 82—557

ldan pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'khrug pa med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /tha snyad rnams las 'das pa yi1)/ /bden par ma grub sgyu ma'i chos/ /dag pa'i ngo bo nyid 'byung ba/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gang du mdo don spyod pa yi/ /byang chub mchog (5)tu sems bskyed (mipa/ /deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bar du bsod nams ye shes kyi/ /grangs med du ma'i rgyalam bgrod de(ge/ /gang du sa bcur gnas pa yis/ /sprul pa du ma ston par byed/ /lha dang mi yi 'jig rten du/ /ji ltar mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /sprul pa sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul gyis/ /sna tshogs gzugs su ston par byed/ /dngos dang sprul dang byin brlabs 4)dang / /cho 'phrul ngo mtshar bskyed pa dag /gdul bya'i don dang bye brag pa/ /spyi dang dngos dang dngos med dang / /brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos gang dang / /srog dang srog ma yin par 'gro/ /gzugs dang sgra dang yi ge dang ⑦/ /rtswa lcug 'khril shing la sogs pa/ /du ma'i rnam par ston byed 'gyur/ /ye shes 'og min stug por ni//'dod chags chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /rnam par snang mdzad byang chub mchog /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po che/ /dang po'i 'og min chos kyi dbyings / /rang byung nam mkha' dag pa'i zhing / /bsam gyis mi khyab spyod yul lo/ /de nyid mngon par byang chub pa/ /'og min gnyis pa ye shes yul/ /rnam par snang mdzad gang (87chen mtsho/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul gyur to/ /gnyis pa 'od gsal lhun gyis grub/ /'og min zag pa med pa'i yul/ /bde chen rgyal ba gtsug tor gnas(9)/ /byang chub mchog dang rab bcings pas/ /82—558

byang chub sems dpa' 6)spyod yul can/ /sems dpa' chen po gsum pa'o/ /yang dag lam ni lnga ldan pa/ /gsang ba 'dzin pa goms pa'i lam/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug phyag rgya che/ /dbang gi rgyal po yon tan gter/ /skad cig gcig la goms byed cing / /shin tu sgrim (bzhing brtson ldan gyis/ /rang byung thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /nor bu rin chen lta bur ni/ /'gro ba'i dgos 'dod skong byed pas/ /thams cad rdo rje gsum du ni/ /lhag pa'i mchog gis dbang bskur te/ /dus gsum phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rig mar bcas/ /lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa yis / /khro bo'i rgyal po du ma yis/ /dbang bskur gyur pas gsang ba'i rim/ /sbas pa'i tshul gyis 'tshang rgyar 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsum gyi zhing khams bstan pa'i spyod yul bla na med pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas ④de bzhin gshegs pa spobs pa'i mchog 'dus pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par mi 'gyur ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i 'byung gnas gang / /rnal 'byor chos kyi rgyas gdab (shepas/ /khams gsum ye shes gcig par sgyur/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chos sbyin sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la mngon par rdzogs pa byang chub pa la mi 'jigs pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 82—559

'di gsungs so/ /chos can ma lus rgya mtsho kun/ /rang lag skyu ru ra bzhag 6)bzhin / /rnam par tho 'tsham las rgal ba'i/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes bzang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zag pa ma lus par mkhyen pa mi 'jigs pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ye shes rdo rje'i stobs kyis ( ni/ /'jig (0tshogs srid pa bcom nas ni/ /mi ldog byang chub chen po nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i zhal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bar du gcod ④pa'i chos rnam pa gzhan du mi 'gyur bar nges pa'i lung bstan pa la mi 'jigs pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bdud las byung ba'i rtags dang brda/ /mtshan ma'i gnas kyi gtan tshigs las//bdud las rnam rgyal lung bstan pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu gzigs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 95)tshim par 'gyur ba'i lam nges par de kho na nyid du 'gyur ba la mi 'jigs pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /kun 'byung sdug bsngal spong byed pa/ /lam dang 'gog pa'i bden pa la(61/ /de nyid nges par 'byung bstan pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdul dang bral ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mi 'jigs pa bzhi rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so//ston pas khyu mchog rlabs (7)chen gnas/ /bla med seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa/ /yang 82—560

dag chos kyi 'khor lo yi/ /byang chub de nyid tshul 6)bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan tshogs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rkang gnyis gtso bor gyur pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mkha' la rgyu ba'i bya dag ni/ /'dab ma mi ldan 'phur nus med/ /de la zung 'jug don ldan pa'i/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tog (gyidang ldan pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa gcig tu dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams bslab pa'i sdom pa la/ /gzhi dang rgyu lam 'bras bu dag /ma nyams sa bon myu gu bzhin/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi skyes bu khyu mchog rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /nam mkha' dag pa'i gnas mtshungs par/ /yul dang yul can dag pa las/ /dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yul 'khor spobs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun du spyod pa dag pa rdo rje sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du chos can chos nyid med/ /kun rdzob blo yi spyod yul te/ /chos kun sgyu ma tsam du gnas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen rab sbyin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phyin ci ma log pa'i dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 82—561

'di gsungs so/ /shes dang shes bya kun gyi ni/ /spyod yul blo yi snang ba las/ /rten dang brten hu)med ngo bo nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba rgyas pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mi zad pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dag pa'i chos sku skye med pa/ /dri ma bral ba de 'od gsal/ /mtha' las grol ba'i ngo bo nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mi gnas pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /srid pa'i dra ba gcod (0pa yi/ /rnam par zhi ba'i sems spangs te/ /mgon po ye shes gcig par 'byung / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dbang sgyur rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 'byung ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ma 'gags gos pa med pa dang //ma 'dres thabs kyi (5)pha rol son/ /gsal ba blo la 'char ba gang / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi gsal ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyan bkod pa snang ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rgyun chad med pa'i byang chub sems/ /thams cad de las skyes pa'i dngos/ /phra mo rkyen byung dag pa'i don/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsam gtan snyoms pas (4)sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di 82—562

gsungs so/ /rang bzhin gyis ni rnam par dag /khams rgyud yul dang dbang po dag /rab tu dag par rdzogs pa ni/ /byang chub sems 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'khrug pa med pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos 'byung rol pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gnas dag bar chad med pa'i lam/ /chos rgyal zhing khams yongs su dag /mi ldog ting 'dzin zad mi shes/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan mngon par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam par smin pa bsod nams stobs/ /bral ba ye shes spyod yul ba/ /khyad par rnam par mi rtog las/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs ma 6)bslad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thabs rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so//sems can mos pa sna tshogs la/ /ye shes spyod pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis/ /bstan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /byang chub tshul (ge'adi bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa mdzes pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi phreng ba dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs par/ /ye shes 'khor lo bskor ba yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rjes ston/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /rig pa'i rgyal po rjes dran pas/ /82—563

gsang ba dam pa bstan pa yin/ /dang po dbang gi dus yin te/ /mngon par rtogs pa dang po'o/ /ye shes mthong ba'i dang po las/ /sbyor ba rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /lus dang ngag dang sems dmigs pas/ /rig pa gcig gi ngang nyid las/ /sngags kyi rim pa rdo rje ltar/ /yul sems rlung ni mi phyed pas/ /gcig tu gyur pa'i rim pa las/ /sems la dmigs pa ye shes che/ /rlung sems 'gro ldog gcig pas na/ /nges pa rnam par dben don bstan/ /phyi rol yul snang sgyu mar 'char/ /rang rig 'od gsal mngon byang chub/ /thams cad bde chen ye shes su/ /yang dag rdzogs pas rdzogs pa'i rim bsam gtan bsdus pa'i rim pa yis/ /ril bar hu)'dzin pa rjes gzhig pa/ /gcig tu byed pa gsang ba yis/ /zung 'jug ye shes thob par 'gyur/ /dngos po med pa bsgom pa dngos/ /bsgom ②par bya ba bsgom pa min/ /de bas dngos po dngos med pas/ /bsgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /gang du lus sems kun rdzob bcas/ /don dam rnam dag zung 'jug ste/ /gang du dmigs pas bsdus pa ni/ /brtson 'grus ldan pas rab 'jug yin/ /rim gyis mngon 'dod le lo can/ /g.yeng ba thams cad ( nyespangs nas ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' tshe 'di la/ /rnal 'byor brtson pas rab bskul bas/ /zla drug goms pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /ye shes mngon du byed pa 'am/ /zhag bdun gyis ni gzi che yi / /rnal 'byor ye shes mchog sbyor bas(ge/ /rim pa rdzogs par gnas pa'i lam / /skad cig zhag dang lo yi dus/ /dus ni thung ngus (5)'grub par 'gyur/ / bskyed pa'i (6)tshul 'di dang por bstan/ /mthar phyin brtan par gyur pa yis/ /gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor te/ /rim gnyis mnyam par sbyor ba yis/ /82—564

rnal 'byor pa yi sku gsung thugs/ /rim gnyis bla na med pa las/ /gsang gsum rdo rje thob par 'grub/ /'dir ni yi ge'i dbye ba yis/ /sgra las khyad par don rtsol ①ba/ /rkyen dang byed pa ston pa yi/ /sngags ni gsang bar brjod pa yin/ /de bzhin gshegs (0pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyud kyi don bstan pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /thub pa chen pos bka' stsal (5)pa/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje/ /gsang gsum rdo rje 'chang ba'i bdag /sgyu ma'i snang ba las 'das te/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i ngo bo nyid/ /mngon par byang chub mtshan nyid can/ /ye shes dmigs med ngo bo nyid/ /'dus pa gsang ba gnas med pa/ /yi ge'i tshig ni dmigs med pas/ /de nyid brjod pas rnam par dben/ /dgongs pas cang ni mi gsung bzhugs/ /gsang ba'i sku mchog dri ma med/ /gzhon nus dbang phyug 'dir rtog go/ /ye shes sku ni mi 'gyur zhing / /ma skyes skye med mchog gi yul/ /rdo rje gsung ni 'gag pa med/ /mtshan ma med cing dri ma med/ /'od gsal nam mkha' zhes bya ba/ /de nyid las byung der ston pa/ /thams cad dmigs med rtogs su med/ /yang dag snang ba kun rdzob ste/ /legs par bzung yang ma skyes shing / /sgyu ma tsam du'ang dmigs su med/ /log par zin las ldog par 'gyur/ /de nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sogs/ /thams cad kyis ni 'di skad gsol/ /rdo rje'i tshig gi 82—565

yul min pa/ /kun du 'byung ba'i dri ma las/ /phyin ci log las rnam par 'das / /de nyid brjod dang bral bas na/ /rnam par dben pa spros dang bral/ /tha dad gcig tu brtag 6)mi bya/ /de nyid ci yi slad du ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba ni/ /byang chub sems su gyur pa nyid/ /skye med tsam du'ang mi gnas la / /sgyu ma'i dbyings nyid las 'das shing / /ngo bo nyid ni rang byung ba/ /yang dag spyod par gyur pa gang / /de bzhin nyid du gshegs gyur cing / /ye shes 'jug pas gshegs par mdzad/ /ldog pa'i khyad par rjes su 'gro/ /de nyid gang gi slad du na/ /'jig rten dbang po la sogs pas/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni/ /ngo bo nyid ni ma ②dmigs shing / /ye shes 'jug pa med pas na(kye/ /slar zhing yang dag yul 'di la/ /'di snyam du ni rtog gyur te/ /bdag cag ston pa de bzhin gshegs/ /'di nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /de nyid gsang ba chos dag pa/ /yul dus ma bral brjod bral ba / / rtogs dka' (4)brtag par dka' ba nyid/ /rig na'ang ⑤mi rig pa yi chos / /gsang ba'i yi ge'i (6)rnam par dben/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i bdag /ji ltar rtog cing ston par byed/ /de ltar sems par gyur pas na/ /bsam pa de dag rab shes pas/ /gsung stini 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba mi 'gyur rdo rje'i bdag /'dir ni de bzhin gshegs kun yang / /de nyid gzigs pa med pas na/ /bla med byang chub mi shes so/ /phra zhing bdag med stong bas na/ /byang chub sems dpa' lta ci smos/ /de nyid ci yi duphyir zhe na/ /sgyu ma skye ba med pas na/ /rdo rje mngon par byang chub pa6)/ /ngo bo med cing gnas med pa/ /mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa las/ /gnyis med snang ba'i ye 82—566

shes 'byung / /de ltar shin tu rtogs dka' zhing / /kun dang thun mong ma gyur pas / /mos dang rig par ldan pa yi/ /sems can rnams kyis ji ltar 'gyur/ /rigs kyi bu zhes skal bar ldan/ /sems can chen po'i rigs can gyis/ /bla med mngon par byang chub pa/ /snying po mchog la gnas pa yis/ /tshe 'dir rdo rjer sangs rgyas te0)/ /de nyid sku gsum dbyer mi phyed/ /rdo rje chos nyid dag pa'i phyir/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba che/ /ye shes rdo rje'i gnas thob 'gyural/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed sbas pa'i don/ /thig le srog gi rnam pa ni/ /snying ga'i dbus su mi shigs pa/ /gsal ba zla ba'i gzugs brnyan la/ /sems kyi rten du gyur par brjod/ /rten 'di gzugs brnyan dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /chos sku gnyis su med pa'i thugs/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i gsung rdo rje/ /sprul sku yongs rdzogs grub pa'i 'bras/ /dbyer med rdo rje bde ba che/ /lus ngag sems ni sku gsum du/ /'byung zhing 'jug par mdzad pa gang / /sku bzhi'i (gyingo bo rdo rje 'chang / /de nyid bla mar gsungs pas na / /gnas pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sku/ /gang du'ang mi gnas mnyam pa nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba ni/ /bden gnyis yang dag rab sbyor ba/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i khyad par gyis/ /rigs gcig tha dad med par sdom/ /rdo rje 'chang chen nyid du nges/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /bla med 'byung ba'i lus can la/ /bdud rnams 'joms par mdzad pa gang / /'khor lo'i sbyor ba byang chub rim/ /yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa yi/ /cho ga legs par byas na ni/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje'i mthar klas par/ /phur bu 'debs par gdon mi za/ /'di 82—567

ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /phur 'debs de nyid las byung ba/ /sku gsung 6)thugs kyi mchog sbyin pa'i/ /sngags kyi de nyid don bsdus (snyepa'o/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa gnas pa yi/ /rab tu dga' ba nas brtsams te/ /mngon du gyur pa'i bar du bgrod(mi/ /ring du song ba bdun pa nas/ /mi g.yo ba yi bar dag tu/ /sbyor ba gsum gyis nges par sbyangasasti/ /las la sbyor bas brgyad pa'o / /snang ba gsum la zhugs pa dag /sa bcu la ni nges gnas pa/ /rang bzhin brgyad dang drug cu po/ /'od gsal ba la thim gyur pas/ /sbyang bya sbyong byed gnyis la ni/ /bcu gcig bcu gnyis bde gshegs pa/ /deng (snyeganas bde ba chen po yi/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin la gnas/ /ko ṭak+ṣa zhes gyen du rgyu ba'i rlung / / dang po'i (7dbang po mi phyed gyur pa ste/ /tshe la dbang ba stobs bcu'i mchog gyur gang / /gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen par brjod / /ko ṭa wa k+ṣu thur du sel ba nyid/ /brtson 'grus dbang po rtsom pa'i mchog yin te/ /byang chub sems las dbang ba lha yi gtso/ /mos pa sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs zhes brjod/ /ko ṭa wa dha 9)me dang mnyam gnas pa/ /chos kun rtsa ba snying po srog yin te/ /mi brjed dran pa'i dbang po sems la dbang / /bsam gtan nyid dang ting 'dzin mkhyen stobs gyur/ /ko ṭa ba sha srog 'dzin rlung gyur pas/ /mnyam bzhag ting 'dzin dbang po dang longs spyod/ /rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab dang / /snyoms par 'jug pa mkhyen pa'i stobs zhes brjod/ /ku ti da ra khyab byed rlung du gyur/ /chos rnams 'byed pa shes rab dbang po ste/ /skye ba la dbang kun nas nyon mongs dang / /rnam par byang ba mkhyen pa'i stobs zhes brjod/ /ko la ṭa k+ṣu 'di ni rgyu ba'i rlung / /spyod 82—568

yul dad pa'i stobs dang ldan pa las/ /rdzu 'phrul ba dang las kyi 'jug pa dang / /las kyi rnam par smin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs/ /ko la bh+ya zhes rab tu rgyu ba ste/ /rgyun chad med pa brtson 'grus stobs mchog gyur/ /mos pa la dbang 'byung 'jug phrin las la/ /thams cad nyid du son pa'i las mkhyen stobs/ /ko la lo bha mngon par rgyu ba nyid/ /gzungs 6)'gyur dran pa'i stobs las rdo rje che / /zhing khams spyod pa'i ②sgron lam gnas mkhas pa/ /sngon gyi gnas rnams ma lus mkhyen par brjod/ /ko ṭa rnyi zhes khyad par rab rgyu ba/ /dri med ting 'dzin stobs ni rtsal ldan pa/ /ye shes la dbang phun sum tshogs pa'i yul/ /'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba'i gnas stobs gyur/ /ko la ta thā chan zhes kun du rgyu/ /shes rab stobs ldan chos la dbang ba ④gang / /zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs yin no/ /'di dag gnas zhes mnyam bzhag spyod pa can/ /nye ba'i gnas zhes mnyam longs spyod pa'i yul/ /zhing ni dbang po lnga yi (5)yul nyid de / /nye zhing 'dod yon rdo rje'i spyod yul gang / /tshan dho dkyil 'khor rang ( nil rdzogs pa'i gnas/ /nye (7)tshan brtan g.yo dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yi(gu/ /'dus byas byang po)chub sems kyi rdo rjer 'gyur/ /nyer 'du tshad med bzhi ldan rang byung ba/ /dur khrod bde chen lhan cig rol pa che/ /nye ba'i dur khrod ye shes rgyas par 'gyur/ /gnas bcu 'di dag gsang 'dzin nga yi yo )yul/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug phyag rgya chen po'i ngang / /gcig dang du mar dmigs med bde ba che/ /chos dang chos las byung ba'i yul mi dmigs/ /ko ṭa 447/ ko ṭa wa k+ṣu/ ko ṭa wadhatunye/ ko ṭa ba sha /ku ti da ra/ ko la ṭa k+ṣu/ ko la bh+ya/ko la lo bha/ ko ṭa gi/ ko la ta thā dzinan/ bcom ldan mgon po rdo rje 'dzin/ /82—569

khyod ni glang po lta 4)ba che/ /khyod ni bzang po'i rgyan dang ldan/ /khyod ni rnam par gnon pa yin/ /khyod ni rin tshichen 'byung gnas gtso/ /khyod ni bden pa'i 'dren pa yin/ /khyod ni gzugs sdug yid 'phrog yin/ /khyod ni 'joms pa cir yang (gyisnang / /khyod ni me lce'i phreng ④ba can/ /khyod ni gnas la skyo ba med / /khyod ni yid bzhin nor bu ste/ /khyod kyi sku ni mdzes par (gyebastan/ /rgya mtsho bla na med pa ste/ /bstod pa'i mchog tu gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje nges par ston pa'i gsang ba gcig tu bsdus pa bla na med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /gang las bla med dkyil 'khor rab gsal ba/ /rgyud rnams ma lus pa la khyab pa dang / /chos kun la ni 'di yis rgyas btab pas/ /'dus pa rtsa bar gsungs pa don bstan pa'o/ /snying po'i 'od zer dpag med las sprul pa'i/ /thub pas rab rib kun du nges bsal nas/ /ma lus sems can sangs rgyas rdzogs byas te/ /gsang sngags rig pa'i nang du chud par bya/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i rnam pa ma gtogs pa'i/ /'dzin pa de ni dngos su mthong mi 'gyur/ /bzung (6)ba dag kyang cung zad yod min la/ /gzhan pa'i dra ba yis 97)kyang mthong du med/ /'khrul pa'i shes rab bya ba gang yang med/ /yongs su 'dzin pa yod par ma mthong ste/ /cig car skye bzhin pa ni gzugs mchog yin/ /'di dag 'dzin pa po ni yod pa min/ /dkar dmar la sogs gang zhig mthong ba rnams/ /de nyid dus gzhan dag tu mthong mi 'gyur/ /'di dag gcig la gcig gis ⑧'gal snang phyir/ /rtag tu 'phrul 6)pa'i shes pa dag dang mtshungs/ /thog mtha' la sogs bye brag snang bas na/ /gzugs la sogs pa 'di dag gcig ma yin/ /rdul phran rnams kyang snang ba ma yin pas/ /82—570

du ma'i gzugs su min pa'ang de dang 'dra/ /rdul phran cha shas 6)med pa nyid kyang ni/ /phra rab du ma 'dus par ma grub pas(gye/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor la sogs pa yi dugazugs/ /bsags pa 'ga' ④yang 'dir ni med par 'gyur/ /de bas 'dzin pa po la sogs bral bas/ /rang rgyud la sogs btags pa'i ngo bo nyid / /brtan ⑤dang g.yo ba'i dngos rnams ma lus gang / /dri za'i grong khyer dag dang mtshungs pa yin/ /bdag dang bdag gi rnam rtog 6)rgyun gyis ni/ /ngo bo dag gis de ni 'khor ba ste/ /dag pa phyin ci log dang bral ba yi ngo bo tsam ni rnam ⑦par brtags 6)gyur pa/ /srid dang zhi ba yi ni mtshan nyid 'dir/ /chos nyid kyis ni dbye ba gang yang med/ /gang phyir gzung ba la sogs rnam pa dang / /bral bar thams cad du ni rtag tu bsgrub/ /so sor snang ba rang bzhin kun rtog las/ /thams cad kyang ni ci yang yod ma yin/ /chos rnams sems las gzhan pa yod min dzi༄pas/ /bdag dang bdag gir btags pa ma grub pas / /gang zhig gzugs las so sor zhugs gyur pa/ /de yi bdag nyid gang yin de nyid gzugs/ /de bas thams cad khyad par med pa'i blos/ /dngos po thams cad khyad par med par brtag /snang bar gyur pa'i yul rnams gang yin dang / /gang zhig rtog pa'i gnas su gyur pa rnams/ /de de gnyis su sbyor dang bral bas na/ /des na rnam par dbye ba du mas min/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas dbyangs kyi brjod pa rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i tshul las 'byung ba'i gnas 'di yang gsungs so/ /dang po a nas brtsams nas aḥyi mthar/ /bcu gnyis dbyangs ni gsung rab yan lag gyur/ /a gang ⑩mdo tsam gyi ni spyi yi don/ /rnam par bsdus nas ston pa mdo yi sde/ /ā chos rnams thams cad 82—571

spyi dang bye brag gi/ /rnam pa yi ge tha snyad gsal bar gyur/ /de ni tshigs su bcad par rjod 6)byed pa/ /rgyas par dbye ba dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa'i sde/ /i chos rnams rgyu rkyen 'bras bu dngos po rnams/ /phyin ci ma log yang dag ston byed pa/ /ma 'ongs pa na 'di las 'di 'byung ba/ /thams cad ston pa lung du ston pa'i sde/ /yī (gertsa ba niyan lag 'brel bar bcas pa'i tshig /tshigs su bcad par ston pa 'di yang sde/ /u zhu ba po dang gnas dang dus dag gi/ /yi rangs dga' bas rgyas pas ched brjod sdeli/ /u da ltar gnas dang ma 'ongs 'byung ba dang / /rang bzhin bcas pa ston pa gleng gzhi'i (gesde/ /e bdag dang gdul bya gzhan dang gzhan dag gis/ /skye ba sngon dang tshe rabs thams cad du/ /gnas dang gnas (5)kyi gtan tshigs spyod pa yi/ /'di ltar 'byung ba'i sde zhes bstan pa'o/ /i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa sna tshogs las / /kun du don spyod bzhis bsdus skyes stirabs te/ /o lam dang 'bras bu zab dang rgya che las/ /ma rgyas spros pa shin tu rgyas pa'i sde/ /au sangs rgyas rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / /'phags pa rnams kyi khyad par gyur pa yi/ /lta spyod chos kyis 'dul ba lam ston pa/ /rmad du byung ba'i sde zhes bstan pa yin/ /i chos kyi gnas lugs gnyis su med pa nyid/ /nges par 'byed pa gtan la phab pa'i sde/ /aḥgasang ba'i spyod yul pha rol phyin pa yi/ /bden gnyis dbyer med ston pa mchog gi sde/ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /ka la ku ṭa ta/ ka zhes pa ni 'byung ba'i sgo yin te/ /la zhes bya ba gang yang blang dor gnyis/ /ku ni gdug pa can gang phyogs gnas pa/ /ṭa 82—572

ta zhes gnod rab tu zhi bar byed/ /phyogs bcu kun du yang dag pa dang ni/ /yang dag ma yin 'jig rten 'jig rten 6)'das/ /dngos por 'dzin pa'i gdon ni phyi nang gang / /gnas pa 'di ni sa gsum kun du spyod/ /gsang bar bya ba phyogs bcas phyogs med pa/ /khro rgyal yum bcas rol pas rab tu 'joms / /dngos por 'dzin pa'i gdon bcu rnam par dag pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /gsang ba'i tshul ni spyi dang khyad par te/ /mchog tu gsang ba chen po'i tshul gyis ni/ /mngon par byang chub lngas grub dang po ste/ /thabs dang shes rab gcig bsdus gleng (migazhir brjod/ /rig pa'i dbang dang dkyil 'khor nges byas pa/ /'bras bu nye 'grus spyod pa'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /mi ru 'khrungs pa dang po'i tshul nges sde/ /rab tu byung ba nges pa gnyis pa'i tshul / /'dul ba'i sdom pa nges pa gsum brjod pas/ /zab mo'i ting 'dzin bstan pa tshul bzhi pa/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i spyod pa thub pa yig/ /de nyid bla na med pa bstan pa yin/ /kha sbyor las byung gzugs ni de song yid bsgoms na/ /gso bar dka' ba'i nad tshogs thams cad 'phrog byed cing / /'o ma'i rgyun ni bab pas thugs ni mnyes gomadzad pa'i/ /'chi ba'i dus la bab pa drag po kun kyang rab tu 'joms/ /'chi bdag 'joms par byed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas par gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pa dkyil 'khor chen po rab tu sdud pa dang spro ba'i tshul rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems rdo rje mtshungs pa med pa/ brtag (getu med pa/ bltar (7med pa/dpyad du med pa/ ldan pa med pa/ mi ldan pa med pa/ snang ba med pa/82—573

dpe med pa'i rang bzhin la yongs su gnas so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'di lta ste/ lus dang / ngag dang / sems dang / chos thams cad dang / rdo rje'i gnas kyi dam tshig ni thams cad kyi rjes su song ba ngo bo nyid gcig pa'i phyir 'di lta ste sems kyi ngo bo nyid do/ /lus dang ngag dang sems kyi khams gang yin pa dang / nam mkha'i khams de dag kyang gnyis su med de gnyis su byar med so so ma yin tha mi zhi)dad de(mi/ dbyer mi phyed pa rdo rje'i gnas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir ni yang dag bsdus par gyur pa yi/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor bla med bstan pa yi/ /snying po yongs su bsdus pa rdo rje 'chang / /de nyid dkyil 'khor tshul ni bstan pa yin/ /dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu g.yo 'gyur zhing / /'jig rten skye bo dam pa phrad rnyed dka'/ /de bas thabs dang shes rab la gzhol ba'i/ /yid la byed pa mchog de bsgrub par bya/ /de la thog mar re zhig (khubastan pa yi/ /sangs rgyas theg pa bsam pa rig gi)'jug ste/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa snying rje'i stobs kyis ni/ /byang chub mchog tu sems ni bskyed pa dang / /gtong ba la sogs yon tan rnams kyis brgyan/ /zab mo'i tshul dag la ni rab tu mos/ /dpal ldan 'dus par dkyil 'khor chen po ni/ /rang nyid dbang bskur phun sum tshogs ldan pa'i/ /cho ga rim bzhin rjes gnang thob pa yi/ /blo dang ldan pas gsang sngags bsnyen par bya/ /la lar dri med chu ni phun tshogs shing / /'bras ldan ljon shing mdzes pas rnam brgyan pa'i/ /ri bo'i tshang tshing gnas su bcom ldan 'das/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa bsgrub par byos/ /dang por tho rangs snying gar zla dbus su/ /82—574

'od zer rab 'phro dri med yi ge hūm̐/ /dpal mchog de nyid rnam dgod 6)brtser ldan pa'i/ /kha gdong la sogs shin tu dag par bya/ /tsan+dan dri zhim byug pas legs byugs shing / /bzang po'i me tog sil ma gtor nas kyang / /stong nyid ye shes mchog gi sa yi char/ /rim gyis bskyed pa rdzogs tshul ldang ba ②ni/ /de 'og hūm̐ yaṃ raṃ baṃ lo bcas hūm̐/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi dkyil 'khor kha dog dang / /dbyibs dang mtshan ma'i bye brag 'byung ba ni/ /shin tu gsal zhing dag par rnam par bsam/ /kun bzang las byung bsam par bya ba ni/ /ston ma'i zla ba lta bur rab dkar ba/ /mtha' yas phyogs gnas sna tshogs 'od dang ldan/ /gru gsum gyen du gnas pa'i ngo bo ni/ /nam mkha' rang gi ngo bo rang rig pa/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas bha ga'i pad+ma nyid/ /de yi dbus su rig 'dzin dbang po dang / /byin za gzhon nu bdag mo'i rang bzhin can/ /so so'i bye brag gzhi yi khyad par bsam/ /de steng ri yi rgyal po lhun grub pa/ /gru bzhi zur ldan mdzes pa'i ba gam bcas/ /rin chen bzhis skyes phyogs kyi 'od kyis khyab/ /gter mchog yon tan rgyas pa'i bdag nyid gnas/ /de steng pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rjes mdzes / /de dbus hūm̐ las byung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs gabacu gser gyi rang bzhin mu khyud ldan/ /der ni bdag nyid dbus su gnas pa yi/ /dpal ldan zhe snang rdo rjer gnas nas ni/ /de yi thugs kur nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /gnas pa'i yi ge hūm̐ las spros pa yi/ /raṃ bcu las ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / /de steng rtsu bcu rab 'phros khro bo bcu/ /zhal phyir gzigs nas phyogs bcu'i gdon la yang / /gtso bo'i bka' bsgo'i don du phur bu yis/ /lus ngag yid la brdabs dang brdungs par gyur/ /'di ni bgegs kun 'da' bar mi nus 82—575

pa'i / /bsrung ba chen po yongs su bsdus pa yin/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhir dra hu)ba gur dang ni/ /pad+ma 'khor lo rdo rje'i bla re dang / /phyogs bcur me dong ②'bar ba rgyas pa yin/ /me 'od 'bar bas kun nas 'khrigs pa gang / /rdo rje phur bu bcu phrag gsum dag gis/ /rdo rje'i tho ba 'bar bas brdungs pa yin/ /'di ni bsrung ba'i dkyil 'khor tshad med pa/ /bar chad las rgyal bdud rnams 'joms pa yin/ /skad cig de las rang nyid mi dmigs par/ /yongs su bsdus te phroṃ las byung ba yi/ /rnam par snang mdzad rgyal ba'i sku lta bu/ /thub dbang 'od kyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs pa'i/ /zer gyis phyogs mtshams ma lus kun du khyab/ /mi mnyam bdag med de ( phyir gzur bzhi mnyam/ /dran dang dbang po mchog bzhi sgo rnams yin/ /bsam gtan bzhi po dag ni rta babs dang / /ting 'dzin kha khyer gyis ni kun nas bskor/ /kha khyer mda' yab rten pa'i mchod pa'i rten/ /dam pa 'dzin pa gzungs kyi tshogs rnams yin/ /sna tshogs rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam spras pa/ /gang phyir 'gro ba'i bsam pa kun rdzogs pa'i/ /rlung gis bskyod (5)pa'i ba dan phreng ba dang / /dril bu sgra sgrogs phyogs bcu kun khyab pa/ /gang phyir dam chos gsung rab yan lag dgu/ /gdul bya thams cad la ni bskyod (6)pa'o/ /rlung gis bskyod ⑦pa'i ba dan phreng ba dang / /me long dra ba dra phyed me tog gi/ /phreng ba sna tshogs kyis brgyan mnyam pa med/ /ye shes me long dri med byang chub kyi/ /yan lag dri ni me tog phun sum tshogs/ /ka ba bzang po brgyad kyis nyer mdzes pa/ /rnam thar brgyad po rnam par dag pa yin/ /rdo rje'i gdung dang yang dag ldan pa ni/ /re'u (kyemig pho brang dbus kyi mtshan nyid de/ /rdo rje 'dod yon snam bus yongs 'khor ba/ /82—576

gru chad 6)rim gnyis lha snam nang skor yangs/ /pañca re ga ye shes lnga ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje'i rtsig ②pa ma 'dres gsal ba las/ /phyi nang med par shel sgong dngas pa ltar / /dag cing dri med ye shes pho brang ste/ /rin chen pha gu (0sna tshogs 'phras spras ④shing / /dra ba dra ba phyed (5)pa'i do shal can/ /rta babs (6)chos kyi 'khor lo ri dgas bcas/ /byams sogs tshad med gdugs kyis khyab pa yi/ /rtse mo rin chen bum pas bsdus pa nyid/ /theg mchog gcig tu nges par bsdus pa ste/ /tshad med mu tig rdo rje'i ra ba dang / /me 'od phreng ba 'khrigs (7)pa'i rang bzhin can / /chu skyes ge sar du ma'i rnam pa can/ /rigs kyi ye shes bla med brgyan pa yi/ /rdo rje theg chos 'khor lo rab bskor ba'o/ /bla med mtha' yas 'dod yon rig ma yi/ /lha mo bcu drug dag gis yongs su bskor/ /stong nyid shes rab rang bzhin ngo bo yis/ /gzugs sogs yul rnams rnam dag pha rol phyin/ /rjes su dran pas (nyamachod pas nyer brgyan tsa)pa/ /chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i rgyu mthun yin/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur legs gnas pa'i/ /nyi zla'i mgon bcas lha yi ( )gnas rnams dang / /rin chen ma lus pa yis rnam spras pa'i/ /gzhal yas khang pa de ltar bsam par bya/ /de yi dbus su rdo rje 'dzin pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'byung ba thams cad kyang / /skad cig gcig las (nyeskyes pa'i bdag nyid de/ /dpal ldan gsang ba'i rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin / /rang 'od bcas pa'i rig mas 'khyud pa ni/ /zhal gsum phyag drug dung dang kun+da tu ltar/ /rin chen du mas spras pa'i sku mchog can/ /rnam par snang mdzad shar du rnam par gnas/ /dkon mchog dpal lho zhuge'od dpag nub tsotu gnas/ /gdon mi za ba byang gi phyogs su'o/ /shar lho'i grwar skoni lha mo spyan 82—577

ma dang / /lho nub grwar ni mā ma tī 6)mchog dang / /nub byang grwar ②ni lha mo gos dkar mo/ /byang shar grwar ni lha mo sgrol ma ste/ /shar lhor gzugs dang lho nub sgra rdo rje/ /nub byang du ni dri yi lha mo dang / /byang shar mtshams su ro yi lha mo dag /mkhas pas rim pa bzhin du bsam par bya/ /byams pa'i mgon po sa yi snying po dag /shar gyi snam bu dag la legs par dgod(kyi/ /gsang ba 'dzin dang nam mkha'i snying po ni/ /lho yi snam bur gnas pa'i sems dpa'o/ /'jig rten dbang phyug dang ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /nub tu rnal 'byor mkhas pas bsam par bya/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang / /kun du bzang po byang gi snam bur dgod/ /gshin rje gshed po shar sgor gnas par bya/ /gzhan gyis mi thub lho yi sgo drung gnas/ /rta mgrin rgyal po nub kyi sgo drung dgod / /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa byang sgor 'byung ba ste/ /shar lho mtshams su mi g.yo mgon po dang / /'dod pa'i rgyal po lho nub grwar lidagod cing / /(snyebyang shar du ni dbyug pa sngon po can/ /steng phyogs gtsug tor ⑥'khor los sgyur ⑦ba ste / /'og phyogs gnod mdzes rgyal po rnam par bsam/ /de ltar rnam par bsams (7pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /thams cad zhal gsum phyag ni drug pa ste/ /rnam pa ma lus gsal ba'i rgyan dang ldan/ /rin chen 'od 'phro 6)nor bu'i snying por bcas/ /ji bzhin bltas te de yi gtso bo yi/ /thugs ku'i zla gnas mchog gi sa bon las/ /'od zer du ma'i rnam pa rab spros pas/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bla mar bcas pa dang / /rig ma lha mo'i mchod pa khro bor bcas / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams ma lus pa/ /bar snang zhing khams rab tu khengs gyur la/ /sdig pa bshags sogs mchod pa rgya mtsho dbul/ /82—578

skyabs su 'gro zhing bzod par gsol nas kyang / /gshegs su gsol ba bsod nams tshogs rab bsags0)/ /de nas phyi dang nang gi dngos po rnams/ /ma lus stong pa nyid du ngas bsams (5)te/ /thams cad ye shes chos nyid dag pa'i ngang / /brag ca ①lta bu'i sgyu ma'i sgras brjod do/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra (4)swa bhā (5ba ād+ma ko3rta(6)/ chos nyid nā (7)da tsam du bsdus pa'i dngos/ /de nyid rtog med sems kyi snang ba'i ngang / /gsang sngags de nyid skur ni ldang ba'i phyir/ /stong pa tsam du gnas pa chos nyid las/ /rang byung rta bdun rgyal po rnam par bsam / /bcu drug cha dang de (8)tshogs las byung ba'i/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag gi dbus nyid du/ /'od zer dpag tu med pa'i tshogs ldan pa/ /dbus ma'i gdan la yi ge gsum gyi po)ni/ /cho gas pad+ma nyi ma'i 1 )ldan pa dag /dpal mchog dang po'i snying po las byung ba'i/ /rdo rje 'bar ba nor bu'i snying po ltar/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i dngos po ma lus pa/ /dpag med thub pa'i tshogs rnams 'od 'phro ba/ / phyogs sgo (nyamatha' yas khyab yo par rab bsgrub yonyepa/ /de nyid ye shes ngang las rang byung ba/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i ngang du blta(1 )/ /oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā tsob ād+ma ko3lhayi/ de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes 'byung ba'o/ /dang po mgon po'i snying po bsgoms nas ni/ /nga rgyal de ldan mtha' yas sprul pa yis/ /'gro ba'i mchog dang thun mong don byas shing / /yi ge gsum dang gang du zla bar bcas / /de las 'od 'phros rdo rje snying por bcas/ /thub mchog phra rab bsgrub mtshungs med pa yi/ /kun+da 6)zla ba ltar dkar mdangs ldan pa'i/ /bcom ldan dang po'i mgon po zhes bya ba/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal ni sngo dang dmar / /zhal gsum phyag drug mdzes pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /sna tshogs rin chen 82wa 579
