rgyan 6)ldan phyag gnyis kyis/ /rig ma 'khyud cing rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /'khor lo bar ma tha ma pad+ma ni/ /g.yas pa'i phyag (migis bsnams par mdzad pa'o/ /nor bu rin chen ral gri 'bar ba ni/ /g.yon pa'i phyag na bsnams pa zung gis (kyimadzes / /khams gsum khongs ni rnam par brgyan ④pa yi/ /thub pa'i sprin tshogs du ma rnam par 'gyed/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum rnam dag pas/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid snying rje'i mchog /ma lus 'gro ba'i de nyid gcig pu nyid(ge/ /rgyal ba skyed byed nyid kyi sku ru bsam/ /mchog tu rjes chags dpag med phun tshogs pas/ /'dul ba'i 'jig rten ma lus dmigs nas ni/ /dga' ba'i sgyu ma'i sgras ni de dag dang / /rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams ma lus bzhugs 4)par bya/ /der ni spyan la sogs pa'i lha mo dang / /gzugs sogs ma lus yul gyi rang bzhin du/ /byung nas rig pa de dag thams cad ni/ /rang gi rig pa'i nang du chud par bya/ /de yi pad+ma'i lte ba'i nang du ni/ /rnam snang la sogs rgyal ba'i tshogs bcug pas/ /zla ba zhu ba'i gzugs su gyur pa dang / /des na (7)de rnams de 'og dbang bskur bya/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rig ma sras bcas dang / /lha mo khro bo'i bsrung bar bcas pa dag /yi ge gsum gyi gzugs su thim nas ni/ /de nyid cha dang bcas pa ho dang ha/ /nā (shedar bcas pa 'dres pa sems kyi sku/ /snying ga'i chu skyes la ni gnas par bya/ /gang du rig ma bdag nyid bcas pa yi/ /lus la dkyil 'khor rim pa 'dir dbye (9)bya/ /gshin rje gshed dang gzhan gyis 7mi thub dang / /rta mgrin rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil par bcas/ /mi g.yo 'dod rgyal dbyug pa sngon po can/ /stobs po che dag phyogs mtshams khro bo rnams/ /gnod mdzes gtsug tor 82—580

'khor los sgyur ba'i bar/ /rim bzhin dzaḥ7rgyu baṃ hoḥ0rgyu drug bcas/ /lag g.yas mgul pa de bzhin g.yon pa'i mgul(mi/ /kha dang gsang gnas mtha' dang bcas pa dang / /dpung g.yas tshigs pa g.yon bcas de dag dang / /pus mo g.yas dang g.yon dang rkang pa'i mthil④/ /spyi gtsug dag tu nges par dgod par bya/ /byams pa dang ni sa yi snying po dang / /phyag na rdo rje nam mkha'i snying po dang / /'jam pa'i dbyangs dang spyan ras gzigs dbang ste/ /sgrib pa rnam ⑤sol kun du bzang po dag /rim pas mi shrī yis dang a dang ni/ /a dang hrīḥdang slo dang saṃ rnams ni/ /rtsa rnams lte ba dang ni mig dag dang / /rna ba ⑦sna dang lce dang rnam shes rten/ /mtshan ma dang ni tshig (8)la khyab par gnas / /rab tu bsam pa yi ge rnam dag bstan/ /lo rma paṃ tai lha mo rim bzhin du/ /spyan dang mā ma tī dang gos dkar mo/ /sgrol ma rnams ni khams bzhi'i ngo bor brtag /o āḥ dang swā hā rim bzhin du/ /spyi bo po)mgrin pa snying ga lte ba dang / /gsang gnas rnams kyil rigs kyi sangs rgyas lnga/ /phung po lnga yi ngo bo dag par bzhugs/ /de ltar phra ba'i sgo nas yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /lha yi 'khor lo lus la bskyed pa yin/ /rang nyid bcom ldan sku yi skyob spu las/ /'od 'phros rtse mo las ni rang byung ba/ /spyan dang mā ma tī mchog na bza' dkar()ske/ /rgyan spras rig ma phyogs su rnam par bsam/ /oṃ āḥtsū zhes bya ba'i yi ge ni/ /'di tsobacas ha ho spel bar rim pa bzhin/ /pad+ma'i nang du bzhugs pa mnyam med pa/ /shes rab chags pas zhu bar byas par bsam/ / de yi tsomathu yis de dag gnyis ka yang / /zla ba zhu bar gyur par mthong ba dang //lha mo spyan la 7sogs pa de dag gis/ /glu yi sgra yis bskul bar gyur par 82—581

bsam / /de ltar glu yi nga ro gyur pa na/ /chos kun sgyu ma lta bur yang dag rig /snang ba'i 'od zer gyi ni dkyil 'khor can/ /gsang sngags rang nyid lus su yongs gyur nas/ /de yi 'od zer ma lus pa rnams kyis/ /rang lha dang mtshungs sprul pa'i thub 5)dbang po/ /dpag tu med pa yid kyis bsdus pa las/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin/ /zhal gsum phyag drug rgyal ba'i bdag po ni/ /ut+pal sngon po mthon ②mthing mdog 'dra la/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar kun+da (5)byi ru'i mdog /g.yas g.yon dang po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /g.yas gnyis 'khor lo nor bu 'od ldan dang / /g.yon gnyis pad+ma sdong bu ral gri bsnams/ /rin chen dbu rgyan rna cha gdu ④bu dang / /dpung rgyan do shal sna tshogs rgyan dang ldan/ /yid bzhin nor bu gtsug tor dbus mtshan pa/ /lha yi na bza' stod g.yogs sham thabs bcas/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i dbus su gsal bar bsam / /ma lus 'od kyi 'od 'phro 'bar ba dang / /thub pa'i dbang po spro bas rnam brgyan (55cing / /skyob pa nam mkha' yongs khyab zhing khams yin/ /dngos rnams thams cad gzung dang 'dzin pa dang / /bral ba dngos po med pa nyid du shes / /rnam byang (5)gcig tu mngon par zhen pa ni/ /med par byin gyis brlabs pa 'di nyid bya/ /oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā (7)ba ād+ma ko3rta(kye/ de 'og rang rig sa bon 'od rnams kyis/ /rang gi mig sogs gti mug rdo rje sogs/ /ji bzhin bkang nas rang snying dri med zla ba yi/ /rdo rje lte ba'i dbus gnas 5)rgyu yig ste/ /thugs kyi rdo rje de bzhin mgrin pa dang / /mgo bor gnas pa pad+ma 'khor lo yi/ /āḥdang o ni gsung gi rdo rje dang / / sku yi kyirdo rje nyid du bsam par bya11/ /de yi thugs ma'i 'od kyi tshogs rnams dang / /shes rab dam pa 82—582

'dus pa'i 'od rnams kyis/ /kun nas rgyal ba'i dbang po mchod nas ni/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la sogs byin gyis brlab/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i ngo bor rdo rje gsum / /mtshan nyid dag dang bral bar dmigs nas ni/ /phyogs tshogs kun na bzhugs pa'i ①thub pa'i tshogs/ /snying po'i 'od zer rnams kyis yang dag bskulal/ /thub pa mchog gi 'od zer las byung ba'i/ /rig pa'i tshogs rnams bum pa phyag bsnams te/ /ye shes chu yis mngon par dbang bskur bas/ /rang rigs gtso bos cod pan rgyas btab gyur/ /de las bdag nyid dam tshig sems dpa' yi/ /thugs kur zla bar gnas pa'i ye shes sems/ /rang 'dra mtshungs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' bsam/ / de yi ②thugs kur gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /ting 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje sa bon bcas/ /khyad ①par gsang ba dam pa dang por gnas/ /de bzhin rang gi lha 'dra rang sngags kyis/ /sprul pa'i rig ma nyid ni yang dag blta/ /skye mched byin gyis brlab ④cing yi ge gsum / /rnam par dgod pa lus ni 'od dang ldan/ /legs par bslabs pa'i phyag rgya de nyid kyi/ /lus la lha yi sa bon bkod nas ni/ /mnyam par bzhag nas byin gyis brlab pa nyid/ /yang dag ye shes phyag rgyas rgyas btab ldan/ /de nyid shes pas spyi bo mgrin pa dang / /snying ga'i gnas dang lte ba gsang ba la / /oṃ ༷āḥrgyu dang swā hā'i yis bon rnams/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las tshogs/ /lnga po rnams kyis shin tu byin brlabs te/ /'od kyi phreng ba dam pas 'gro kun khyab/ / de yi (pe'abyung ba dag la lha mo bzhi/ /spyan ma la sogs rim pas yang dag dgod/ /de yi gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ni/ /ro dang reg bya rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid/ /nye ba'i spyan sogs lha mo bzhi dang bcas/ /82—583

sems ma brgyad kyi rnam par yongs su bsam/ /bde ba chen por snyoms par zhugs pa'o/ /rdo rje ro langs ma dang rnam par rgyal ba ma/ /rdo rje khro gnyer ma dang ral gcig ma/ /bde bar gshegs yum rdo rje ma dang ni/ /sna tshogs rin chen sna tshogs pad+mar bcas/ /sna tshogs las ma nam mkha'i rdo rje ma/ /sa 'dzin rdo rje ma dang bcas pa yi/ /rol pa'i khro mo bde bas rgyas par dgod/ /'dir ni gnyis su med par 'dus byas pa/ /dga' bas yongs su rgyas pa'i ting 'dzin can/ /oṃ gyis ye shes 'od zer ldan par gyur/ /āḥyis sna tshogs pad+ma lte bar bcas/ /hūṃ gi rdo rje las byung dri med pa/ /yid tshul dam pa'i chu skyes la gnas pa'i/ /shes rab dam pa'i rgyu mthun ngo bo nyid/ /thabs dang bcas par 'byung 6)ba rang gi lus/ /de yi (gebade gshegs rjes su mnyes bya zhes / /sngags la midaga' ba kun du brtsam par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3rta0)/ thugs kur zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnas pa yi/ /lha dang sngags dang bcas las byung rnams kyis/ /ma lus sangs rgyas sogs rnams bcug nas ni/ /rang gi snying po las byung ma lus pa'i/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor sa yi (57gzugs bsam la/ /cho ga 'di yis sems ni brtan por ldan / /'jig rten rnams la phan phyir yang dag dbyung / /ye shes bla med dam pa'i mchod pa brtsam/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā (6)ba ād+ma ko3rta4)/pad+ma'i gnas su rin chen dkyil 'khor pa'i/ /rnam pa du ma rdzogs pa'i dpal dang ldan/ /der ni so sor mngon par byang chub pa'i/ /ye shes las byung rdo rje mi bskyod pa/ /bha ga'i gzhal yas las ni rang byung ba/ /rnam pa yongs su rdzogs par dbyung bar bya/ /badz+ra sgrika (nyaces gsang sngags las byung ba/ /82—584

thugs kyi rdo rje mgon po thub pa ni/ /skye bo'i don mdzad dam pa yang dag bskul / /mthing shun gsal ba ye shes rgyal po'i 'od/ / nor bu sngon po'i 'od 0)'drar yang dag 'bar/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i zhal nas ②dkar dang dmar/ /dam pa dang po lta bu'i phyag dang ldan/ /dang po gnyis kyis ()yum la 'khyud pa dang / /rdo rje dril bu 'dzin par mdzad pa'o/ /bar ma gnyis kyis li'akhor lo nor bu dang / /tha mas pad+ma ral gri legs bsnams pa'o/ /rin chen du ma'i rgyan rnams yongs rdzogs pas/ /tshad med nor bu sna tshogs kyis spras yin/ /dbu ma'i lam nas gyen du brgyud nas ni/ /thugs ka nas ni byon te legs bltams dunas/ /phyogs bcur gzigs shing 'od zer grangs med las/ /zhing khams mtha' yas khyab par legs spro ba'i/ /thub pa mchog gis gdul bya'i don du ni/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /sems can tshogs rnams ma lus go 'phang bkod/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i sku mchog thob byas te/ /kha dog dpag tu med pa'i 'od tshogs las/ /blo dang ldan pas legs bsdus bdag nyid la/ /dngos po thams cad kyis ni zhugs par bya/ /skad cig de la bdag nyid yongs bsgyur te/ /slar yang bcom ldan zhe sdang rdo rje ni/ /rin chen in+d+ra nī la'i kha dog ltar/ /mthing nag cung zad khros pa'i bdag nyid can/ /rdo rje skyil krung (7dag gis 6)legs bzhugs pa'o/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la gnas mdzad yin/ /dzi na dzika (7sngags las ni rang byung ba'i/ /rnam snang mdzad ces bya ba sku rdo rje/ /ston ku'i sprin dkar dag pa lta bu'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag drug sna tshogs rgyan 5)gyis mdzes/ /g.yas mthing g.yon dmar rtsa ba sku dang mtshungs / /dang po gnyis kyis 'khor lo dril bu 'dzin/ /rig ma ye shes 82—585

legs par 'khyud pa'o/ /bar ma gnyis kyis rdo rje rin chen dang / /tha mas pad dkar ral gri legs bsnams pa'o/ /de nyid thugs ka nas ni phyung nas ni / /mdzad pa spyod 0)de gti mug can sbyangs nas/ /stobs mchog glang po'i gdan khri'i steng du ni/ /shar gyi pad+ma zla ba'i dbus su bsam/ /rat+na thoka (misngags las ni rang ①byung ba'i/ /dkon mchog dpal zhes bya ba rin chen sku/ /'dzam bu'i chu bo gser gyi 'od dang mtshungs/ /zhal gsum phyag drug nor bu'i tshogs kyis brgyan④/ /g.yas sngo g.yon dkar gzhon nu rin chen tog /dang po'i g.yas g.yon phyag gis lag ⑤bsnol te/ /yid bzhin nor bu dril bu legs pa 'dzin/ /bar mas 'khor lo dang ni rdo rje dang / /tha mas gser gyi me tog ral gri 'chang / /de nyid 'od zer phung po dang bcas pa/ /phyung ste ⑥g.yas logs ngogs su bton nas kyang / /mdzad pa spyod (7)de nga rgyal can don byas/ /slar log rdzu 'phrul rta yi khri la bzhugs/ /pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la lhor gnas pa'o//ā ⑧ro lika 5)sngags las ni rab byung ba'i/ /'od dpag med pa gsung gi rdo rje ni / /pad+ma rā ga lta bu'i mdangs dang ldan/ /zhal gsum pa la phyag drug nges byung kyiba'i/ /g.yas nag g.yon dkar rtsa ba sku dang mtshungs/ /dang po gnyis kyis pad+ma dril bu dang / /bar pas rdo rje rin chen snye ma can/ /tha mas 'khor lo ral gri 'dzin mdzad pa/ /rin chen du mas spras pa'i bdag nyid che/ /thugs ka nas phyung spro bsdus 'gro ba'i don/ /'dod chags can gyi don byas slar 'dus pas/ /mdzes pa rma bya'i khri la dzub phyogs bzhugs/ pradz+nyā sgrika tso ces gsang sngags las phyung kyib/ /gdon mi za ba phrin las rdo rje ni/ /rin chen margad ljang gu'i tsho mdog 'chang ba/ /zhal gsum phyag drug sna tshogs nor 82—586

bus spras/ /g.yas dkar g.yon mthing rtsa ba sku dang mtshungs/ /dang po gnyis kyis ral gri dril bu bsnol①/ /bar pas ⑤sna tshogs rdo rje pad+ma sngo/ /tha mas 'khor lo nor bu 'od 'phro bsnams/ /de nyid thugs ka nas ni legs byon nas / /mdzad pa spyad de phrag don can don byas/ /'dab bzangs mkha' lding khri la legs bzhugs pa/ /byang phyogs pad+ma nyi ma'i dbus bzhugs 6)pa'o/ /'di dag dbus dang phyogs bzhi'i le'u tshe yiX/ /rnam pa dag la legs par rab bzhugs (snyepa'o/ /de dag mtshams kyi grwa ⑥bzhir 'byung ba ni/ /rigs kyi lha mo bzhi ni legs gnas pa'o/ /ral pa'i cod pan mdzes dang sna tshogs pa'i//rin chen mchog gi 'od zer 'bar bas brgyan/ /rig pa'i mgon po dang bcas 'byung ba'i sku/ /thams cad pad+ma nyi zla dag gnas bsam/ / ma hā ⑦ra ti zhes bya lha mo spyan/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa la gnas pa/ /mchog tu sgeg cing sku yi rdo rje 'dra/ /me yi phyogs nyid du ni bsam par bya/ /de tā (sher ti zhes bya dga' ba che/ /yid 'ong mchog stsol mā ma tī 6)zhes pa/ /zhal mdzes phyag rgya thugs kyi rdo rje 'dra/ /rnam par sgeg pa bden bral mtshams su bsam/ /rā ga ra ti zhes bya yum mchog ni/ /dri med rin chen 'od kyi phreng ba yis/ /phyogs kyi tshogs khebs charang gi ngo bo ni(ste/ /rlung du gsung tsog rdo rje mtshungs par bsam/ /badz+ra ra tis rab bskul sgrol ma ni/ /rdo rje dga' ma yon tan mtha' yas pa/ /dri med sku ni don yod rdo rje ltar/ /dbang ldan phyogs su nges par bzhugs mdzad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas yum gyur 'di dag rnams kyi ni/ /dang po g.yas mthar ut+pal dkar po dang / /gnyis pa'i g.yas mthar ut+pal sngo (lhadang ldan/ /gsum pa'i tha ma g.yon par ut+pal dmar/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gis 82—587

'byed mdzad bsnol 6)ma nyid/ /bzhi pa'i g.yas mthar ut+pal dkar po'o/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje lha mo spyan mtshungs pa/ /rtsa ba'i phyag gis me long 'dzin mdzad pa / /de nyid mchod byed lha mo rgyan rnams rdzogs/ / me yi ()gru chad rgyadag la gnas par bsam/ /sgra yi rdo rje lha mo bden bral du/ /dang po ga nyis ni rgyud ④mangs spreng (5)mdzad pa(nya/ /kun du mchod byed mdzes ⑦pa'i gar ldan pa/ /mā ma tī dang mtshungs pa (kyedagod par bya/ /rdo rje dri yi lha mo rlung lha'i phyogs/ /dang pos lha rdzas dri mchog dung phor 'dzin/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i yon tan rgyan spras pa/ /nam ⑨bza' dkar mo dang mtshungs rnam par bsam/ /rdo rje ro yi lha mo sgrol mar mtshungs/ /rin chen pad snod legs bkang btung ba 'dzin/ /'di nyid rol pa'i ye shes gzungs ⑩ma lha/ /dbang ldan phyogs kyi grwar ni legs bzhugs pa'o/ /reg bya rdo rje lha mo ye shes yum/ /gsang ba dbyings phyug ma ni dbus gnas pa'o/ /pad+ma zla nyi dag la legs gnas pa/ /byams pa'i mgon po sprin dkar dag pa'i 'od/ /klu shing me tog 'bras ldan legs 'dzin pa/ /rin chen rgyan ldan rol pa'i sems dpa'o/ /sa yi snying po dung dang mtshungs par mdzes/ /'khor lo 'dzin pa dar dpyangs cod pan ldan/ /rnam par 'gying bag ldan pas bzhugs pa ni/ /shar gyi lha snam (7dag la skyil krung yonyaganas/ /gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pa ni/ /gur gum bzang po'i mdog ltar dmar ser la/ /phyag na rin chen rdo rje 'bar ba 'dzin/ /sna tshogs rgyan bcas kun nas 'od 'bar ba'o/ /nam mkha'i snying po gser gyi 'od mnga' ba/ /margad ta yo ni cha dgu pa 'dzin cing / /legs par gtso la blta ba sems dpa' ñca/che/ /lho yi lha snam dag la dgod par bya/ /'jig rten dbang 82—588

phyug spyan ras gzigs dbang ni/ /ban 6)lhu ri ga'i me tog ltar mdzes pa/ /g.yon pa'i pad+ma nges par g.yas pas 'byed/ / sems dpa'i skyil krung phyidag gis bzhugs pa'o/ /'jam pa'i nidabyangs ni dmar ser dngas pa ④la / /ut+pal dmar po sdong por (nyabacas 'dzin pa/ /g.yas pas kha 'byed phyag rgya ldan pa ste/ /nub kyi lha snam dag la bzhugs par bsam/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba ni/ /margad ljang gu'i (6)mdog dang mtshungs pa ste/ /phyag na ral gri 'bar ba dang por 'dzin/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan par bsam/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po ni/ /drar 9)ba'i lo ma'i kha dog mtshungs pa nyid/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa 'gying bag can/ /byang phyogs lha khyams dag la bzhugs par bsam/ /'di dag so so'i gtso bo'i sku mtshungs te/ /zhal gsum phyag drug nges pa gsal bar brjod/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad rtog pa sbyangs nas ni/ /slar 'dus so sor (nyagasal bar gyur par bsamal/ /ya mān+ta yod 7ces bya gshin yirje gshed/ /mtha' yas 'jigs 'od phyogs kun khyab dang ldan/ /dus mtha'i 7mi bzad sbyin gyi tsodakyil 'khor mdog /thugs kyi rgyal po dag dang sku mtshungs pa/ /drag po rigs kyi 'od zer dpag med 'phro/ /gshin rje mthar byed shin tu gdug pa yi/ /sbrul gyis lus kyi yan lag rnam brgyan pa/ /dpal ldan shar gyi sgor ni bsam par bya/ /pradz+nyān+ta kṛd 8ces bya bla med 'od/ /drag cing phyag sogs sku yi rdo rje 'dra/ /gzhan gyis mi thub ces bya gtum po ni/ /lho yi phyogs kyi sgo ru bsam par bya/ /pad+mān+ta yod yices bya nub phyogs kyi/ /'khor lo'i 'od kyis mngon par khebs byed pa/ /'od mdangs 'jig 7dus me 'dra 'jigs par ldan/ /phyag la ⑩82wa 589

sogs pa gsung gi rdo rje 'dra/ /gdug pa ma lus rnam gnon 'jigs pa'i zhal//thub dbang ha ha zhes ni bzhad pa yis/ /ri bor bcas pa skyel bas skrag mdzad pa / /rta mgrin de bzhin nub kyi phyogs su bsam/ /bigha nān ta kṛd yo)ces bya dpa' bo ni/ /dus mtha'i me ltar drag pa (0bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /'phags pa'i zhal phyag phrin las rdo rje mtshungs/ /de bzhin byang gi sgor ni bsam par bya/ /rdo rje tho ba dbyug pa pad+ma dang / /rdo rje gtun shing khyad par 'di dag 'dzin/ /thams cad rigs kyi gtso bos dbu brgyan pa'i(gu/ /cod pan ye shes rgyas gdab bstan pa yin/ /'di dag khro bo mngon par 'byung ba dag /gsang sngags las byung cod pan lhar bcas pa/ /zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i cha byad ④ston / /me dpung klong dkyil 'bar bar rab tu bzhugs/ /me yi mtshams su khro rgyal mi ga yo ba/ /in+d+ra nī la'i mdog mtshungs gtsigs pa'i zhal/ /g.yas zhi 55)dkar ba 4)g.yon dmar bzhad pa las/ /dbus ngam tsomache ba rnam par gtsigs (7pa'i sku/ /dang po ral gri sdigs mdzub ⑨zhags pa 'dzin/ /bar mas 'khor lo pad+ma 'dzin pa nyid/ /tha mas dgra sta nor bu bsnams ⑩pa ste/ /pad+ma nyi mar g.yon brkyang 17zhabs kyis bzhugs/ /bden bral du ni 'dod pa'i rgyal po ste/ /shin tu drag po be+e ḍūr+ya yi tsomadog /dang pos sdigs mdzub ⑫bsnol ma mthe'u chung sbrel/ /rdo rje'i lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin pa dang / /ral gri ut+pal dmar po tha mar 'dzin/ /'jigs rung gsus che pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs / /rigs 'dzin du ni khro bo dbyug sngon can/ /char sprin sngon po lta bu'i kha dog 'chang / /dang pos dbyug pa sdigs mdzub 7me dpung 'phro/ /bar mas ral gri nor bu legs 'chang ba/ /tha mas 'khor lo pad+ma legs 7bsnams 82—590

pal/ /gtum po 'jigs pa sel mdzad der bzhugs yin/ /'byung ngo 'jigs mdzad rdo rje stobs po che/ /me tog ut+pal sngon po'i 6)'od mtshungs pa/ /dang po rnga yab rdo rje sdigs mdzub (5)dang / /bar pas ral gri zhags pa 'dzin pa'ol/ /tha mas 'khor lo nor bu 'bar ba ste/ /gdon 'joms sgeg po pad+ma nyi mar gnas/ /steng phyogs shar sgo'i rtsa bar 'byung ba yini/ /khro bo gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ni/ /mkha' 'dra sngo bsangs gtsug tor phyag rgya ni/ /spyi bor dang po'i phyag gis bcings pa ste/ /bar ma rdo rje dang ni pad+ma 'dzin/ /tha ma ral gri sdigs mdzub (gemadzad pa'o/ /rnam 'tshe 'joms mdzad g.yon brkyang gnas pa yis/ /tshangs gnas der ni pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs/ /'og (5)phyogs nub sgo'i rtsa bar bzhugs pa yi/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu ba yi gdug pa'i dug /ka la ku ṭa 'joms pa gnod mdzes ni/ /mthing 4)shun bzang po'i mdog dang mtshungs pa yi/ /dang pos rdo rje sdigs mdzub 7zhags pa can/ /bar pas 'khor lo pad+ma tha mas kyang / /ral gri dang ni nor bu rin chen 'dzin/ /sa bdag ma lus gnod mdzes rdo rje bzhugs/ /khro bo bcu po kun gyi rnam pa ni/ /spyan gsum sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs pa dang / /thung zhing sbom la gsus 'phyang (9sbrul brgyad kyis/ /rab tu brgyan cing dbu skra gyen du brjes/ /zhal gsum phyag drug dpa' ba'i nyams dang ldan/ /smin ma gyen bskyod ag tsom gyen du 'khyil/ /sna tshogs nor bu'i rgyan bcas stag sham can/ /mche ⑨gtsigs zhal ni bzhad ⑩cing sgra sgrogs pa/ /ha ha zhes brjod mi bzad (nyagad rgyangs mnga' / /bka' bsgo rdzogs byed ma lus bgegs 'joms mdzad/ /g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum 8pad+ma nyi mar gnas/ /de ltar sum cu rtsa gnyis dkyil 82—591

'khor pa'i/ /lha rnams phyag rgya bzhi ldan bskyed nas ni/ /sku bzhi dbyer med ye shes ngang du blta/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog 0)ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las gsang ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor rab tu ston pa rdo rje'i le'u ste lnga bcu rtsa lnga pa'o/ /brtag pa lnga pa dri ma med pa'i ye shes byin gyis brlab pa zhes bya ba brtag pa'i rgyal po'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang 'dus par gyur nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i bdag po de bzhin gshegs pa la de bzhin gshegs ②pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i dam tshig gis yang dag par gsol ba btab pa ni/ /gsang ba 'dzin pa ma lus pa'i/ /sku gsum chos kyi dbyings 'byung ba'i/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi / /dam pa'i snying po mchog stsol mdzod/ /ces gsol ba btab ④nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs chen por dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag po dang bcas pa la sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin nam mkha' dang mnyam pas zhing khams ma lus pa kun nas khyab par byas te de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i sprin gyi rin po che 'bar ba du mas brgyan pas (5)rnam pa ma 'dres pa'i tshogs kyis kun nas snang bar gyur pa ni 'di lta ste/ rin ngo che du ma las byung ba'i gdugs rin po che dang / ba 82—592

dan rin po che dang / rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang / nor bu'i 6)rgyal po las byung ba'i lha'i bla re rin po che dang / rin po che du ma'i rgyu las byung ba'i dar 'phen ②du ma'i tshogs dang / sna tshogs rin po che'i gos las byung ba'i ba dan rgyud rings du ma'i tshogs dang / sna tshogs 'phyang ba dang / sna tshogs chun 'phyang bskyod pa las dril bu g.yer ma'i (5)sgra sgrogs pa'i ba dan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa dang lha'i rol mo'i tshogs du mas yang dag par mchod par byas so/ /gzhal yas khang rin po ches rgyaspras pa ni rin po che mu tig gi dra ba dang dra ba phyed pas bai ḍūr+ya'i ⑤gzhi yongs su bkod pa dang / rin po che gser gyi pha gu sna tshogs pa'i 'phra yidu mas bkod pa ni kha bad kyi tshul du brgyan par gyur to/ /ba ku la'i gser gyi skar khung gis brgyan pa dang / phyi rol dang nang du yang 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi lha mo rin po che pad+ma rā ga'i stegs bu la 'khod cing kun nas yongs su mchod par byed do/ /rin po che sna tshogs bkod pa'i kha bad ni mda' 97yab kyis mdzes par yongs su brgyan par gyur to/ /yongs su mchod cing rgyas par byed pa nyid do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zhal bzangs lasangs rgyas thams cad kyi glu'i sgron me dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i ye shes lam/ /mnyam pa nyid du gnas pa la/ /rnam par zhi ba mi gnas pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shugs gnas rdo rjes sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bden pa mthong ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /yongs su dag pa'i sgo dang ni/ /mtha' dbus dag pa rdo rje'i dbyings/ /mtshungs par 82—593

ldan pa dag pa ste/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes ldan pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kun tu gzigs pa med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te ①byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sems kyis sems ni mi mthong zhing / /sangs rgyas rnams kyis don dam che/ /rnam par gzigs pa med gyur phyir/ /byang chub sems 'di gsungs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsrung ba'i dbang pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shin tu rnam par dag pa'i ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /shes rab rnam par dag pa yi/ /snang ba chen po'i ye shes me/ /ma lus stong nyid rang byung las/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid chen po ②sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mtshungs pa med pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /rnam par shes pa skye med de/ /skye ba tsam du bgyid ③ma lags / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros rgya mtshos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes mngon par rol pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas ye shes sgyu stim las/ /rnam pa'i dra ba dag pa'i phyir/ /dpe bral bde ba'i sa gcig pu/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi'i sridapal gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yid las ma byung ba rdo rje rnam par dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin la 82—594

snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rgyu rkyen yul dag mi dmigs pas/ /rdo rje dag dang ma dag med/ /spros med tshul ni rnyog pa bral/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi stobs kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zil gnon dpe med rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dpag med yongs su bsdu ba'i gnas/ /zag med rmi lam gnas med pa/ /thams cad byed pa po med phyir/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mchod par ldan pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mngon par bsgrubs pa'i tshul rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /tha snyad gdags pa bral ba'i phyir① / /dngos med ngo bos stong pas na/ /ye shes (mitsa ma la dmigs med de/ /mngon par mi gnas tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa me tog 'od kyis gsangs rgyas thams cad kyi mtshan nyid gnas pa med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs sol/ /dben zhing rnam dag de bzhin nyid/ /chos dbyings ye shes rdo rje las/ /'gyur ba med pa'i ngang la bzhugs/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa khams gsum mchod gnas kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba mi zad pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las/ /rnam par zad med 'gyur ba ltar/ /sangs rgyas ye shes de bzhin te/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de 82—595

bzhin gshegs pa sgra gcan 6)nyi ma'i snying po ②sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'jigs pa med pa'i tshul rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du bdag med las byung ba'i/ /dam chos seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pas/ /'dzin pa'i rtog ①pa dengs par byed/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lha yis ④mchod pas (shesangs rgyas thams cad kyi mi 6)'gyur ba'i gdan ⑦'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du rdo rje'i 2rlung gis ni/ /rin med dbang chen rdul phran dag /rdo rje ye shes 'gyur med pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thar ⑨pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dbyangs kun nas snang ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bden par smra ba'i gsung gis ni/ /thogs 7med rdo rje yonyedabyangs gcig gis/ /stong gsum kun du sgrog par byed/ /byang chub thabs 8tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dge ba'i tshul gtsug gis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rjes su thob par ston 7pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du mos pas 'jug pa'i sems can la/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa zhi ba dang / /bdag med ye shes stong nyid ston par byed / /'di ni ye shes dag pa'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos nyid mnyam pa'i sku'i rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 82—596

'di gsungs so/ /mngon par bsgrub pa 'phags pa'i chos/ /de nyid mtshan ma rtog bral ba/ /spong ba med cing lhun gyis grub/ /byang chub tshul 'di 0)bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dpal thub pa'i rdo rjes sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mi gnas pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /phyag rgya chen po mchog chen po/ /dus gsum mi mnyam chos kyi sku/ /don dam rab tu mi gnas pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dpal brtan ②pa bzang pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 'byung ba sgyu ma'i rnam par ston pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sgyu ma don dam par mi gnas/ /sgyu ma'i tshogs gnyis 'bad med pas/ /de nyid ngang du thob cing grol/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen phung pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes brjod du med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rang bzhin rtog pa dag pa'i ngang / /de nyid spang blang las grol phyir/ /'od gsal ngang du smrar med don/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mdzes par gshegs pa (bsangs rgyas thams cad kyi (7rgyan mngon par bstan pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so//lkog gyur gnas pa'i rten dag cing / /tshad med bzhi las 'char ba gang / /de bzhin gshegs pas yongs su mkhyen/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa yi/ /snying po mngon 82—597

par byang chub pa/ /stong nyid ye shes nam mkha' ltar/ /chos sku rang byung mnyam pa nyid/ /'gog pa med phyir snang ba po/ /'od gsal snying po 'bras 'byung 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung yo)dang thugs rdo rje gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las dbyings dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don gyi le'u ste lnga bcu drug pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma ltar gshegs pa (mithams cad kyi lus dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /lus kyis lus kyi rjes ④lta zhing / /de nyid rang bzhin med par yang / /cha shas med pa'i rnam pa can/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dag pa'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshor ba dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du bde sdug btang snyoms kyi/ /tshor ba rang bzhin med par ni/ /dag pa rkyen bral chos nyid de/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan gtsug tor gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /yul dang yul can mi dmigs shing / /'du shes 'du byed rnam dag pa/ /rang las byung ba'i gnas med pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dpal 82—598

rdzogs pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sems dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rdo rje 0)zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so//zab cing phra ba rtag ②med pa/ /rten byed rnam shes sa bon tshul/ /rtog pa med par gnas pa ni/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'di dag lam la nges par zhugs pa yi/ /bla na med pa'i 'dun pa mi phyed pas/ / gong du bgrod ①par byed pa'i mchog 'di ni/ /tshogs pa 'di ni byang chub tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gyen du 'phags pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dkar po'i phyogs rgyun rab 'phel zhing (ge/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba mi zad pa/ /yang dag ye shes rtsom pa'i tshul/ / byang chub dag pa'i tshul (5)bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa me tog byin gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rgyun chad med pa'i bsam ⑥gtan gnas/ /yengs med tshul la gnas gyur cing / /bden don spyod pa rnam par 'dzin/ /rnam par sad byed rten gyur pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan ⑦pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so//de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dgyes sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang 82—599

chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /khyad par gyis 6)ni bsam gtan la/ /sems ni ye shes ngang gyur pas/ /mtshan mas stong pa'i rigs ②pa nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa pad+ma'i dpal gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa bskyed pa (kyerdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs (geso/ /dge ba'i bag la nyal gyur pa/ /rnam par sad byed rten gyur pas/ /bdag nyid thar pa thob pa'i chos/ /(5)byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes dgyes kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnam par dag par bsrung (6)ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /yang dag nges par gnas pa yi /dag pa'i dge ba phyogs med pa/ /brtan zhing phyir mi ldog par ni / /gnas pa byang chub tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bkod pa mdzes pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams spong ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sdig tor gyur pa'i phung po dag /log pa'i lam rnams nges spong ba(7/ /tshul khrims ngo bo bstan pa'i mthu/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gti mug med par gshegs pas (8nasangs rgyas thams cad kyi mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi skyed pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'di dag dngos po mi dmigs pas/ /yongs su dag pas rtsa ba bral / /ldog pa med pa'i tshul gnas pas(9)/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /82—600

zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bla na med pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dad pa'i dbang po rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rgyu dang 'bras bus bsdus pa yi/ /dngos po zhing dag rnam dag pas/ /phra rab brten pa 'dod pa dag /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tog gi rgyal mtshan gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi brtson 'grus kyi dbang po rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dge ba dang ni lhag par spro ba'i chos/ /pha rol phyin pa drug la spyod pa ste/ /sgyu ma'i ye shes 'dis ni spro ba gang / /byang chub tshul 'di nges par bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bde bar dgongs pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dran pa'i dbang po rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mi brjed gzungs su gyur pa ni/ /bde ba bstan pa'i ngang 'byung ba/ /lhung ba bag med gnas spong bas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i rgyal pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mnyam par bzhag 0)dang rjes thob la/ /sgyu ma khams gsum lam snang ba/ /dben pas (2)de nyid thob pas so/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa cho ga mkhyen pas (dasangs rgyas thams cad kyi shes rab kyi dbang po rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das 82—601

pa yi/ /spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid rnams/ /ngo bo nyid dag rab ston pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dag pa'i rgya mtshos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par grol ba rdo rje'i hu)ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam par dben don kun shes pas/ /bsam gtan bde la ma zhen cing / /khyad par byang chub sems dpa' chos/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mnga' bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par grol ba (5)dgyes pa'i tshul rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang (gyichub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dang du blang ba rlom sems med/ /gang du chos dbyings ngang 'jug pa/ /gcig dang du mar dmigs pas grol/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rtog pa mi mnga' bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par grol ba gnyis sum̐ med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so / /bral ba med cing mi shigs pa/ /'khrug ④med bye brag ma spangs nas/ /'dren pa chos kyi gter gyur pa95)/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di ni gzhal yas khang min yul ni dbang po min cing 'byung sogs min/ /gzugs la sogs pa ma yin srog gnas min zhing mir gyur 'di ni rgyal ba ste/ /'khor lo'i gtso yi (6)chos nyid yin te des ni dkyil 'khor du mar sprul/ /khams gsum 'di na (7sna tshogs 'khor lor shes na sems ni ci ste 'khrul bar byed/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang (8)ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa 82—602

nyid rnam par rgyal ba las rigs kyi dkyil 'khor 'byung gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i le'u ste lnga bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa skye bo dga' bar mdzad pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dad pa'i stobs rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gzhan rkyen na bas mi rdzi ba'i / /ye shes mngon par 'phel bas na/ /mchog tu rten 'brel yid ches yin / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rma bya'i nga ros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi brtson 'grus kyi stobs rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du sems bskyed gzhan don du/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa las/ /le lo rnam par spangs pa can/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ma zhum pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dran pa'i stobs rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /yang dag spro ba tshad med pa/ /rgyun du chos rgyun gzungs thob pas / /rtag tu dge bas dus mtha' gang / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sred pa'i dri ma spangs pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam par g.yengs pa'i 0)dri ma bral/ /'khrig pa bral ba'i bde ba rgyas/ /gzhan du dga' ba tshad med pas//de nyid gsang ba'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin 82—603

gshegs pa spyod pa'i lam gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shes rab kyi stobs rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du shes rab 'chal spangs nas(3)/ /rab tu byed pa thogs ②med pa/ /stong nyid ye shes thugs rje'i bdag /byang chub sems 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lha thams cad kyis snyan par bsgrags pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin yang dag pa byang chub kyi yan lag rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam pa kun tu khyab pa yi/ /rang rig ye shes 'du 'bral med/ /khyad par mngon par rtogs pa nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /phyin ci ma log khyad par la/ /rang gi lus dang longs spyod tshogs/ /sems can kun la ster bas na / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa phyag na pad+mas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /lkog tu gyur pa las 'das shing / /gzhin nu'i bde ba rtog bral bas / /zag med bde bas rgyas gyur pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dpal rdo rje 'dzin pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /nyams 82—604

pa med cing 'phel ba'i chos/ /bde ba dang ni dgyes spyod (1)pa/ /ldang ba dang yang zo bdog chabade/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra las rnam par rgyal bas (kyesangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs bzlog pa'i/ /spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid las/ /chos kun rnam par 'byed pa yi/ /rab tu mi gnas tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'byor ldan grags pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ye shes go cha dang ldan zhing / /gong nas gong du 'phel byed bsti/ /de nyid 'phel bar gyur pa ni/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yul 'khor bzang pos (gyesangs rgyas thams cad kyi btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can la/ /phyogs ris med par khyab pa yi/ /gnyis med mnyam par gnas pa po(6)/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa me tog 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yang dag pa'i lta ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /phyin ci ma log ye shes ni/ /mngon sum dag pa'i ngo bor gyur/ /lhag pa'i sdom 'phel 'gyur ba ni/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 82—605

seng ge'i nga ros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yang dag pa'i rtog pa rdo rje'i 6)ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sems dpa' rtogs (0pas mi phyed pas/ /kun slong (5)ngan pa rnam rtog ste/ /byang chub sems kyi rjes 'gro bas/ /bsgom par bya ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba ltar shar bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yang dag pa'i ngag (4)rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ma 'dres dri ma med pa yi/ /rang gi ye shes der ston mdzad/ /rnam par dag pas tshul bstan pa/ /byang chub de nyid bshad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'dzin pa'i mchog gis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bdag nyid byang chub chen po ru/ /ring ba'i chos dag mngon gyur pas/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i sems thob pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas 57de bzhin gshegs pa mi g.yo bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yang dag pa'i 'tsho 6)ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /lus ngag yid gsum gzhan don du/ /nges par sngo ⑦ba bla na med / /yang dag don la rgyun spyod pa'i/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa phan pa dang ldan par gshegs pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yang dag par rtsol (kyeb rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /shin tu nges par gzhan gyi don/ /dngos dang brgyud (9)pas mdzad pa po7/ /ro mnyam ye shes 82—606

rol pa ni/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams stobs kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yang dag pa'i dran pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /thugs rjes khyad par yul gyur pa/ /bde ba nyams pa med pa dang / /bstan pa snying po 'dren pa po/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o(1)/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sgron ma'i rgyal pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin rdo rje'i mchog tu dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /phra rags rtog pa ma lus pa/ /chos kyi dbyings su nub nas ni/ /zung 'jug chos spyod ngang gnas pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun du bzang po'i (5)ye shes kyi snang ba mi zad pas dus gsum du rgyun mi 'chad cing phyogs bcu kun tu khyab pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i gnas kyi dbang phyug dam pas ston par byed do/ /de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la dgyes pa'i mchog stsol ⑧bas dri ma med par spyod la/ /'phags pa thams cad la mchod pa dang / sems can thams cad yongs su smin pa'i lam mtshungs pa med par tshad med pa'i 'od zer du mas snang ba dang yongs su dag par byed pa nyid de/ /'dir gsang ba chen po'i tshul la phyin ci ma log pas gnas shing byang chub kyi sems rdo rje las nges par thob pa ston pa (peni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ston pa yin / bla ma yin/ bkur gnas yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin ye shes mi zad pa'i gter yin/ mtshungs pa med pa'i rgya mtsho 82—607

yin / yon tan dri ma med pa'i gling yin/ gzi brjid mi zad pa'i nyi ma yin/rin chen du ma'i rgyal mtshan yin/ mi shes pa'i rab rib sel ba'i zla ba yin/mun pa la gnas pa'i sgron me lta bu yin/ nad thams cad zhi bar nus hu)pa'i sman pa'i rgyal po chen po yin/ srid pa las sgrol bar byed pa'i gru chen po yin/dgos 'dod du ma'i gzhi rin po che bsam 'phel yin/ phun sum tshogs pa du ma'i ljon shing chen po tshad med pas skyob pa nyid de byang chub kyi sems rdo rjes rgyud rgyas par byed pa'i bla ma ni byang chub kyi sems rdo rje dang tha dad med cing dbyer med pa nyid do/ /'dis ni rim pa nges par ston pa ni 'di lta (miste/chos thams cad kyi lam ma lus pa rdzogs par byed pa 'di nyid de dkar po rnam par mthong ba'i sa dang / rigs kyi sa dang / brgyad pa'i sa dang / srabs pa'i sa dang / mthong ba'i sa dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa dang /byas pa rtogs pa'i sa dang / bsrung ba'i sa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /mos par spyod ( )pa dang / 'jug pa'i sgo la spyod pa dang / lam gnas pa la spyod pa rdzogs par byed do/ /rab tu dga' ba dang / dri ma med pa dang / 'od 'phro ba dang / 'od byed pa dang / sbyang dka' ba dang /mngon du gyur pa dang / ring du song ba dang / mi g.yo ba dang / legs pa'i blo gros dang / chos kyi sprin gyi bar du ye shes yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /dpe med pa'i sa dang / ye shes chen po'i sa dang / dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bar du ma lus pa'i ye shes thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa nyid de(pe/mngon par 'byung ba rol pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i spyod yul ston pa nyid do/ /de phyir kun nas kun du nges par bla ma la mchod cing brten (5)par bya 82—608

ba la 'bad pa nyid do/ /'di dag gis kyang lus gcig gis ye shes du ma yongs su sdud par byed pa'i phyir tshe gcig gis mngon du byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las gsang ba bla na med pa'i lam yongs su rdzogs par ston pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu brgyad pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dbyangs 15kyis bskul bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rin po che'i mdzod rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gsung (2)ba 'dzin pa ma lus pa/ /ye shes chu dang 'o ma bzhin/ /snga phyi gcig tu 'dres pa yi/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gi ta ma ye shes mngon par rol pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje'i (5)sprin gyi 'od rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du 'byung ba'i ye shes kyis/ / sku yi 44)rdo rje'i rol pa gang / /ma skyes de bzhin nyid sbyor bas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mdangs stobs kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje ye shes kyi chu bo 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /brjod pa tha snyad bral ba yi/ /gsung gi rdo rje'i dbang phyug gang / /skye med (5)ngo bo nyid ston pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa blo gnas 82—609

pa'i rang bzhin gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rdo rjes log lta'i ri bo 'joms 0)pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam par rtog las grol ba yi/ /ye shes phung po'i rang bzhin can/ /mnyam nyid byang chub mi phyed pas/ /ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba bzang pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje ye shes kyi spyod pa kun du rol pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /zab mo'i gnas la bsam gtan gang (snye/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen gyis/ /shin tu dgyes par spyod pa ni/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub me tog gis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'byung bar ston pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gnas lugs de bzhin nyid stong pas/ /rgyu dang rkyen las rnam grol nyid/ /ma 'gags tha snyad rnyog pa med/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bkra shis snying pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshad med ye shes ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rtogs par bya ba'i (gudon dam ni/ /rten 'brel mtshan nyid ston pa las/ /stong nyid ye shes chos kyi sku/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa legs stobs kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dmigs pa rab tu zhi ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dmigs su med pa'i don dam ni/ /bsam pa 82—610

shes brjod yul 'das pa/ /dmigs pa kun las 'das pa ste/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes gzi brjid kyis/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i 'od zil gnon rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'jig rten srid pa'i brten 6)pa dang / /g.yo ba'i sna (mitshogs gang 'byung ba/ /dpag med 'di yis gnon pa po/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa stobs kyi rtsal ①gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bskal pa 'khor ba'i mun pa sel byed rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa yi/ /blo yi mun pa ma lus pa/ /ye shes snang bas 'joms par mdzad④/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dge ba'i sgron mes sangs rgyas thams cad kyi (de'agro ba'i don mdzad sgron me 'bar ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'od gsal shes rab me 'bar bas/ /nyon mongs ma lus khyod kyis bsregs/ /zag pa'i dri ma sel mdzad pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o6)/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mthu 7rirtsal ston pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thogs med rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bdud sde shin tu mi zad pa/ /thams cad 'dul mdzad dpa' bo che/ /stobs chen 'jig rten gsum las rgyal/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lha sgra thub pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gdul dka' ma 82—611

lus pa 'dul bar mdzad pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi stobs mchog rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du byams pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /snying rje'i 6)yul gyur gzigs nas ni/ /pha rol rtog pa rtsad gcod pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu zhi bas phyisangs rgyas thams cad kyi lhag par gnas pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin tshul snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mtshungs med ston pa gcig pa dang / /du ma las ni yongs grol zhing / /kun rdzob tha snyad zad byed pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i zhal gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun nas dag pa'i klong rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /kun nas sangs rgyas ma lus pa'i/ /bstan pa gzhan don phyir 'byung ba/ /thub pa brdal ba chen por 'byung / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa (4) thar pa (rgyathar pa'i brtul zhugs kun nas 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bcu gnyis spyod pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /yon tan sdud pa'i tshul 'chang ba/ /dmigs med kun rdzob dag pa che/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshul khrims dri med 'od kyis (6)sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhal bzangs 9)rgyas pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /kun nas zhal gyi snang ba'i sgo/ /dpag med zhal dang phyag rgya dag /du mar snang ba'i ston pa po//82—612

byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa brtul zhugs gnas kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshul zab par ston pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /drang srong spyod pa gtsang ma'i gnas/ /ri 0)sul gnas la brten (5)pa yi chog shes bag ①yod stengs bral ba/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdul med pas sangs rgyas kyi (4)snang med 'od kyi rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /zhi ba spros bral mkha' lta bu/ /mtha' dbus med pa'i ngo bo nyid//go 'byed ye shes lhun gyis grub/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa snying po 'phags kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mngon par rtogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam par mi rtog rang byung ba/ /snang la rang bzhin med pa ni/ /ma grub grub pa'i lam gyur pas / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sems bskyed nges pa dang po ste/ /tshogs bsags pa ni zung (5)'brel 'byung / /tshad med drod la sogs par 'gyur6)/ /stong nyid ye shes mthong ba nyid/ /dang por rdo rje sems dpa' nas/ /dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs goms byed pas/ /bsdu ba yongs su dag pa nyid/ /bla na med pa'i tshul nyid do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las ye shes nges par byed pa gnas gtan la dbab pa'i don gyi le'u ste 82—613

de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mig sman rgyal pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /stong pa'i mtshan nyid mtshon pa las/ /chu shing snye ma'i bdud rtsi bzhin/ /snying po med pa'i snying por gyur/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'phel bar mdzad pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun tu rol pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam shes ye shes gzugs can ni/ /mtshan ma med pa'i rnam pa can/ /dri med sa bon 'byung gnas las/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa spos kyi 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes mngon par rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'di ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub lam/ /'od zer kun du 'bar bcas pas/ / nā da 6)'dzin med gnyug mar grol/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dus mkhyen 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tsan+dan gyi dri rgyal po rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so//sngon du 'gro ba yid yin te/ /yid kyi (2)'jug pa'i rang bzhin rnams/ /dag pa gsang ba chen po nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dran pa'i dbang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thogs 82—614

med spyod pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mi g.yo 'gog pa'i lam spangs shing / /ma rig rdul dang bral ba yin / /snying gi pad+ma sad byed pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thogs pa med pa'i rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes yang dag par sdud pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mtshan ma med pa'i sku gcig pu/ /nyon mongs bral ba'i phyag rgya che/ /dogs pa med par rten cing 'byung / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub mchog bgrod 6)rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi don phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med dang / /zhi ba'i tshul gyis thabs mkhas pas/ /sems can ji srid skyo bskyed ( pa'i/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa spyod pa gsal ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mchog tu sprul pa ngo bo nyid dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du 'jig rten ma lus pa'i/ /sems can khams dang bsam pa dang / /bag la nyal ba mkhyen pas ni/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ / zhes gsungs so/ /③de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen dgyes pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul dmigs pa med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /tshad med thugs rje'i dbang gyur pas/ /sna tshogs 'dul ba'i tshul can gyis/ /chos kyi dbyings dang tshul gcig par/ /82—615

'gro don de nyid bstan pa'o/ /zhes 0)gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi dbang phyug sangs rgyas thams cad kyi de kho na nyid kyi rnam par rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /thub pa'i sems can thams cad kun/ /ma lus zad med dbyings nyid du/ /ma gyur de srid bzhugs mdzad cing / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lha thams cad pa'i rgyal ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos nyid gcig pa'i tshul rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus par/ /ye shes dbyings su ma gyur tshe/ /mya ngan 'da' ba ston mi mdzad/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bshes gnyen chen pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes bsod nams gzhal du med pa'i rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rang dang gzhan dang bdag dang ni/ /bdag gir (mi'adzin pa'i gnyis snang zhing dkyi/ /gnyis med mnyam par rab sbyor bas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bzang po'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpag med bde ba'i rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du phan pa 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal 'gyur med pas/ /gcig las du mar sprul pa dag /byang chub ngang las sprul pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu zhi ba'i stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'gro drug 'dul ba'i rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 82—616

'di gsungs so/ /sems can ma lus srog gyur pa/ /snying po bdud rtsi byang chub sems/ /'pho ba med par rang 'dir rgyal/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi'i bdag pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyal ba 'gro ba skyob pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /yang dag tshad med bzhi ldan pas/ /rgyu dang lam dang yul gyis ni/ /dmigs bcas dmigs med rim pa dag /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lhun po'i 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mdzes pa bla na med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'dus ma byas shing rnam dbye med/ /chos nyid ngo bo nyid 'byung ba / /dag pa'i phyir na 'od gsal ba/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'phags pas 0)bstod pa dri ma med pa yongs su dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sems nyid nyon mongs can min pa/ /blo (7bur dri ma rlung las byung / /des blangs 'dzin pas (5)rnam 'khrul te/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa snang ldan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lhan cig tu 'byung ba ye shes dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos nyid ngang la rang gnas pa'i/ /rlung ni phra bar 94)'jug byed cing / /dag pa ye shes tshul du 'jug /byang chub tshul (5)'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid 'bar bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 82—617

dag pa chen po rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mtha' gnyis las ni rnam par gnas/ /sgrib gnyis snyoms par 'jug bcas pa/ /lhan cig 'byung ba mi gnas pas/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba gzigs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyal ba ye shes gsang ba'i mdzod rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i ngang nyid las/ /dba' rlabs sna tshogs cho 'phrul ston/ /'di nyid yon tan 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rtog med ye shes dbyings gyur pa/ /nam mkha'i ①kun du rtog bral bas/ /rlung sems mnyam par gyur pas na/ /mtshungs med nor bu'i gter mchog 'gyuraphyi/ /chos nyid ngang du bzhugs pa dag /thun mong tshul 'di bstan (kyepa'o/ / zhes gsungs so/ /(4kyis)de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung yidang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nor bu'i tog tso)gi rgyal po'i ngo bo'i le'u ste drug cu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa legs spyod rnam par smin pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi cha med phyogs chas stod ⑧pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rang byung ye shes gnas med rgyal/ /mtha' dbus las grol de bzhin nyid/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyis mi gzigs pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs 82—618

so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa legs dgyes rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa gcig tu 'gyur ①ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mi gnyis tha dad med pa'i chos/ /gsang ba ngo bo nyid dag par/ /skye ba med la chos 'byung ba/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan bral sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rab tu nyams pa med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam par dmigs pa rtog bral te/ /kun nas zag ②med 'phel med pas/ /yon tan rgyal bas bsdus pa nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes yang dag par 'du ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'dir ni mi rtog (1)ye shes nyid/ /mnyam bzhag rjes thob rtsol bral nas/ /gnyis mi gzigs pas rab tu skye( dī/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa spyod pa dang ldan pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyis yid la mi byed pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /yid la byed pa mtshan mar byung (ge/ /de nyid dngos med rtog bral bas/ /yid la mi byed bde ba che/ /rang byung tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun nas 'brel pa dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du bdag nyid gcig pa dang / /rgyu 'bras thabs dang thabs byung dang / /82—619

de las byung ba'i tshul med pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan rgya mtsho 6nyesangs rgyas thams cad kyi yang dag ye shes dra ba 'dzin pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dngos por 'dzin pa dag byed cing / /dngos med phra bar 'byung ba ni/ /mi slu 'byung ba dgra bcom pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rmad du byung ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dngos po'i chos nyid dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gcig dang du ma las grol ba/ /gnyis med mthong bas yongs su bsgom/ /de nyid rgyun chad med gyur pas/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung don bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nga rgyal spong sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes mi zad pa'i gnas rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'di ni yongs su dag pa'i lam/ /bar chad med par mtha' ( riphyin par(5)/ /rnam shes phung po'i ye shes 'byung / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rlag par mdzad nga/ bdud 'dul rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dngos dang dngos med las grol zhing / /sems dang sems las byung ba yi(4)/ /'du byed dag pa'i sems pa gang / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chags pa thams cad las yang dag par rgal ba'i stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phyi nang du gnas pa med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te 82—620

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sgyu ma'i rnam pa lta bus kyang / /bde dang sdug bsngal kun byed de/ /rgyu 'bras byed pas so sor smin/ /de bas byang chub sems bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi phyed pa'i blo mnga' ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje'i sku ston pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /snang stong tha dad med pa yi0)/ /ngo bo ro mnyam sgyu ma'i dngos/ /dus gsum dngos las 'das pa'i chos/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgya mcho1re dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpa' bo'i 'khor lo dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /bden pa brdzun pa las 'das shing / /dngos stong dri za'i grong mtshungs dang / /byed pa spangs ( pa'i tshul 'di ni/ /de nyid ye shes bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dag cing dga' bar mdzad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes grub pa med pa'i chos kyi tshul rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /skye ba 'di ni ma skyes pas/ /rang rig bdag nyid ji ltar bskyed/ /dngos med gnas las grol bya'i ( phyir/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshogs can bla med sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdud rtsi'i phreng ba dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mos pa dman pa'i sems can la/ /nyan thos rang rgyal la gi)sogs pa/ /rdzas su grub 'dod de bral chos/ /stong nyid tsam du'ang bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa grol 82—621

ba'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spros pa med pa'i tshul rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /thob pa med cing 'brel med pa/ /bye brag mdo sde'i rigs las 'das/ /sems tsam du yang 6)bshad pas na/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes (migasungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ba'i 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi don yongs su sdud pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'dren (7pa'i thar lam gsang ba ni/ /skyon med shin tu yongs gsal bar/ /thub pa nyi ma bde ba'i lam/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rin po che'i ri rab kyi zom la gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyal snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ring gnas sa gsum gnas pa yi/ /ye shes dpag med nor bu yis/ /blo yi gter dang mtshungs par 'gyur / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes rin chen sangs rgyas thams cad kyi (5)phrin las dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so//gang du byang chub mchog gnas pa/ /rgyal ba bye ba khrag khrig gis/ /bsngags pas yid 'ong tshig gcig tu/ /byang chub tshul 'di legs bstan yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu bsil ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tsho 'gro ba'i sman gyi snying po rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dri med zhi ba'i ngo bo nyid/ /rnam pa kun tu 'gro ba yi/ /dri ma sel mdzad sman chen po/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan 82—622

pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /chos rnams yid la byed pa kun bral ba'i/ /gzugs can ma yin dngos por ma grub pa/ /stong pa gcig pur mi gnas mnyam pa nyid/ /chos nyid bdag med 'di ni rtogs par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung 6)dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa dpal rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las de bzhin nyid yid la byed pa med par ston pa rdo rje'i le'u ste drug cu gcig pa'o / / //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa rgyal ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rab tu zhi ba chen po'i ②ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /phyi rol gyi ni phyogs med cing / /sems las gyur pa ma gtogs par 95)/ /dngos po gzhan yod ma yin te/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes dgyes sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rtog ge ba'i yul las 'das pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sems nyid dngos dang dngos med kyi/ /mtshan ma'i chos las yongs grol ba/ /rnam par thar pa'i don bstan pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdzu 'phrul rtogs byasangs rgyas thams cad kyi rtog med zhi ba'i (geting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub 6)kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sems dang de yi 9)chos nyid dag /rnam dag snang ba sdud (8)pa po/ /bsam pa de yi rkyen can zhes/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /82—623

zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skye med mtshungs pa sangs rgyas thams cad rnam rig tsam du'ang 1)mi gnas pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sems kyi spyod pa'i khyad par las/ /'das pa smon pa med pa'i ngang / /ma grub pa la gdags bya med/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sa'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas thams cad kyi brtag par dka' ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par (bzhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sems ni dngos por ma mchis te/ /rtog pa mi ldan dbyings gnas pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di legs bstan pas/ /zag med stong pa nyid gnas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma dgyes pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mnyam pa med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du sangs rgyas zhi ba dang / /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho dag /don dam pa la 'dzin med phyir/ /spang blang med par grol ba'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sgra gcan (5)zla ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par dben pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sgra tsam thos pa'i yul yin gyi/ /rtogs par byed pa sgra ma yin/ /mi rtag ④dngos med las grol phyir/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa me tog 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mya ngan las 'da' ba ma yin pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas sku ni 'gyur med cing / /des gsungs chos ni rgyas pa las/ /'dren pa yang 82—624

dag byang chub pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sman pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rtogs par dka' ba'i gnas rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'gro ba nyon mongs nad kyis ni/ /rnam par gzer (17zhing nyen pa la/ /'chi med bdud rtsi ster mdzad pa/ /snying po'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mdangs mnga' ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag med zhi ba'i tshul rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dri med pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs shing / /mnyam pa seng ge'i khrir gnas las/ /g.yos med rnam 'phrul du ma las/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa yin(5)/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams dgyes pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rig tu med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dngos rnams gang la'ang mi gnas pa/ /bar snang rgyu ba'i bya bzhin du/ /rtag tu thugs rjes rjes 'gro zhing / /byang chub sems 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dge ba'i stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam par dkar zhing gtsang ba yi/ /zhen med gzhan don dge spyad tsa)pa/ /zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin te/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dbyangs snyan pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mchog tu zhi ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /zhing khams bye ba phrag brgya 82—625

ru / /mdzad tshul mtha' yas ston pa ni/ /ye shes spyad 6)pas don mdzad pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi dbang phyug sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shin tu zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /drag cing gdug pa rngam pa yi/ /tshul ni dag pa bde ba'i lam/ /bla med dri med tshul zhi ba'i / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gcig dang du ma las yongs su grol ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du tha snyad ②las 'das shing / /rnam par mi phyed pa yi sems / /mtshon du med las mtshon pa nyid/ /byang chub sems 'di bstan pa yin / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa spyod pa bzang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sgra las 'das pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ā li kā li las byung ba/ /de nyid brtags zhu)pa rkyen sbyor bas/ /'byung gnas mtshon pa don ston pas/ /byang chub sems 'di bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'khrul pa med pa'i blos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ④mthong du med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so//ma rig pa las rkyen stobs kyis/ /rlung gis blangs nas 'dzin byed par/ /glo bur dri ma zhes bya gang / /stong pa de nyid tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dbyangs chen pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyod pa'i gnas thams cad las 'das pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs 82—626

te / byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dri ma rnams ni rlung las byung / /rnam shes bdag 'dzin dra ba gang / /mtshungs par dag pa mchog gyur pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa snyan par grags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi 6)'gro ba skyob pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams sems dang rlung las ni/ / rnam 'phrul (gyis gsum khyab 'byung ba/ /dri ma kun nas rlung la brten①/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /thabs chen yang dag ldan pa yi/ /rnal 'byor 'jig rten don grub pa/ /sems can kun gyis smad (gepa yi/ /bya ba 'di (5)la mi bya med/ /shes rab thabs dang ldan pa la/ /sdig par grags pa yod min zhes/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sprul pa la/ /rdo rje can ni nyid kyis gsu/ngas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung (gyedang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpal mchog chen po de kho na nyid 'byung ba bstan pa'i le'u ste drug cu gnyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tog ldan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mi 'gyur ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /shin tu gdul dka' (7)dag byed pa/ /ma lus skyed 58byed rang byung sems/ /gnas pa'i ngo bo byang chub sems/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid rnam 82—627

par grags pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ye shes de bzhin nyid la ni/ /mi rtog rab tu mi gnas pa/ /rgyus stong lam dang 'bras dag pa'i / /byang chub de nyid tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'gro ba'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mgon po dri ma med pa zhes bya ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /kun du son zhing dge ba yi/ /du ma'i ngo bo dag pa'i gnas / /ye shes bsrung 53)ba med pa'i tshul/ /byang chub sems 'di bstan pa'o//zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'gro ba'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpal ljon pa 'du shes yongs su dag pa'i ting nge ②'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam par sdud pa'i rlung dag gis/ /'phral du bag chags rtog pa gang / /sbur ma lta bur sdud pa'i phyir / /dag pa de nyid tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gti mug rab zad rdo rjes sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'dus ma byas pa'i chos nyid rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /kun mkhyen dbang po mchog 'byung ba/ /dngos po'i chos las 'das pa yi/ /dri ma kun nas spangs pa dag /gsang ba de nyid tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 6)dpag tu med pa'i ye shes can sangs rgyas thams cad kyi brjod du med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'dren pa'i rgyal po bla na med/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes skyong ba po/ /tshad med bde ba'i 82—628

'byung gnas ni/ /de nyid ye shes bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba bzang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi brjod du med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gdung ba sel ba'i sman gyi mchog /gsang ba 'chi med ye shes chu/ /rang gzhan mchog tu thob pa ni/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa spobs pa mtha' yas tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi brtag tu med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas ye shes lhun grub pa/ /de bas mi rtog par bshad de/ /bsam pa'i byed pa yod min te/ /med pa'i sems su gyur 0)ma yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa brtul zhugs bstar (nab sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyod yul kun las 'das pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te (5)byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams rtogs pa 'gag med pa/ /mi rtog snying po gsang ba'i rgyan/ /bde chen byang chub dbang po'i gnas/ /spyod yul bskyed (4)pa tshul gnas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mchod par gnas pas sangs 5)rgyas thams cad kyi gzod (6)ma nas stong pa'i gnas rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /thub pa bdag gzhan mnyam nyid du/ /rtsal ldan 'jigs pa kun sgrol mdzad/ /bsil bas tshad pa kun skyob pa/ /byang chub sems 'di bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan rgyal bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sems pa thams cad dang bral ba (7)rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di 82—629
