gsungs so/ /sems 'di kun gyi rtsa ba ste/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa la/ /ljon pa'i shing ltar 'dab 1)rgyas pas/ /dmigs med tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dge bar dgyes pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par rgyal ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam rtog bdud las rnam rgyal ba/ /mchog tu dgyes pa rin chen mnyes/ /'khor lo lta bu'i shugs 'chang ba/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'gro ba'i blo gros kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos thams cad la tha dad med par rtogs pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa yi/ /chos la dbye ba rdul tsam med/ /so sor brtags pa blo yi lam/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bde bar 'gro ba'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun du rgyal ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /rmad du byung ba'i spyod pa dag /bye ba dpag med ston mdzad pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zhal mdzes sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshan)dus gsum kun du khyab par ston pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mdzad pa du ma'i spyod yul du/ /snang grags srid pa rtog ge ba/ /thams cad zil gnon rdo rje k+ṣ-i ches/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ut+pa la'i 4kā'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun du ston pa rdo 82—630

rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /kun mkhyen sa ni 'jig rten du/ /u dus ra'i 1)me tog bzhin/ /du ma ma yin gcig pa nyid/ /de bas dam chos mchog tu'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dus (9gnas me tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpe dang bral ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so / /gang du dam pa'i chos gnas shing / /kun du dge ba dag pas na/ /rnam par 'tshe ba du ma 'byung / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so//de nas de bzhin gshegs pa spobs pa mtha' yas tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 'brug sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /srid gsum gnas pa'i sems can la/ /dge ba ye shes tshul gnas kyang / /thob med dam pa'i sgra sgrog (mibyed/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par brtse ba seng ge'i stobs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chu klung 'bab chu rnams dang ni/ /rgya mtsho'i chu ni tha dad par(4ste/ /sna tshogs gcig par rgyun 'bab pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa drang srong gsal bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi drang srong 'dul ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ / lha yi (5)drang srong thams cad kyis/ /bstod cing bsngags par gyur pa gang / /bden pa'i stobs las byung ba nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pas (nerabaskal pa 82—631

gaṅgā'i klung (17gi bye ma snyed khrag khrig brjod kyis mi lang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i spyod yul la 'di lta ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gsang ba chen po 'di'i ngang la (5ciganas shing kun du ston pa dang / /ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma mngon par sgrub par byed pa ste/ /'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i gnas nges par lung ston pa nyid do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las gsang ba dag pa chen po'i tshul bstan pa'i le'u ste drug cu gsum pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan brtson (5)'grus sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dbyings 'byung ba'i snying po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'khor ba'i tshang tshing thibs po dag /ma rig rkyen can rlung las byung / /'jig rten dra ba gcad (4)pa'i phyir/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa snying po thub pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zag pa med pa'i chos nyid rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'dir ni kun du khyab pa yi/ /rlung las sdud (sridang spro ba dang / /smin (nedang nyams par byed pa yi/ /tshul 'dis phra ba'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lha'i bdag pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'byung gnas bde ba'i rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /zag bcas rlung las rtog pa ste/ /zag med ye shes chos nyid 82—632

rlung / /gnyis su med pa'i dbyings gyur pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mthon 517pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun du ston pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /nges 'byung bla na med pa'i lam/ /yongs su smin pa'i (5)lam rdzogs pa/ /kun du sbyor ba spangs pa yi/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gsal ba'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par grol ba rin)rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du bstan pa'i sgor 'jug pa/ /rjes 'brangs gzhung lugs gnyis gsungs pa/ /gang zag dang ni chos yin te/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skal ldan shing rta can sangs rgyas thams cad (4)kyi rab tu zhi ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du 'ching dang grol med par/ /rlung ni 55cirnam par 'jug ldog pas/ /byang chub mi rtog chos nyid de/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams blo gros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yongs su rdzogs pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /lam bzang theg mchog bla med pa'i/ /yon tan 'phel byed bzang po yi/ /rgyal mtshan gsang ba chen po nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sbyin byed (6)'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par rtog pa las ring du 'gro ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te 82—633

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'gro ba'i bsam pa'i nor bu ni/ /ye shes re ba rdzogs byed pa/ /phyi nas 'byung med rang gnas phyir/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan mtha' yas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdul med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /yang dag stong nyid nam mkha' ste/ /shes dang shes bya rnam par spangs/ /blo yi byed pa dang bral ba / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzi 1)brjid phung pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnyog pa med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /snang ba med cing kun brjod bral/ /gnyis med dag pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sngags kyi de nyid rab gsal ba/ /byang chub sems 'di bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsal na)ba chen po rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dag pa mkha' ( dang mtshungs pa nyid/ /rnam shes rlung dang 'dres pa yis/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal dag pa nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi g.yo bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shin tu gsal ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dge dang mi dge'i spyod pa dag /rlung las byung phyir 'di dag pas/ /dri ma ma lus dag par byed//byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rab rtsal thub pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par rgyal ba rdo rje'i ting nge 82—634

'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /thog ma tha ma med zhi ba/ /rkyen byung las kyi rlung dag pas/ /ye shes ngang du zhi ba ste/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od tu)spyod pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shin tu rtul (mimed pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dngos por snang ba rgyu las byung / /de nyid dngos med rkyen bral ba/ /gcig tu mtshan nyid med par gnas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan (55pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa glu dbyangs 4)rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpe med pa'i tshul rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mi phyed rdo rje mtshon du med/ /ngo bo nyid dag 'phral byung ba'i / /dri mas gos pa med pa nyid/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor lo 'dzin pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yongs su dag pa'i ri5skurdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /kun du sbyor ba rlung nyid de/ /de nyid bya ba 'jug byed pa/ /thams cad rdo rje'i dngos po ru/ / brtag pa ye (6)shes tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dbyig gi mchog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zab pa rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /yang dag rab tu sgrub 57)pa yi / /snying po'i don du byung ba ni/ /'phags lam gsang ba 'di nyid de/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten dga' bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phyag rgya dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 82—635

'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /'khor ba'i chu bo zlog byed pa/ /spyi las khyad par so sor 'byung / /mngon par brtson 6)pas thar pa che/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas grags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi skyob ⑤pa tshad med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /las kyi sgrib pa rgyun chod pas/ /'di ni bsam gtan mchog tu gsungs / /lus can kun la byin rlob mdzad/ /byang chub sems 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gyi tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyis srid par lhung ba nges par 'don pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du blang dang dor med pa'i/ /byang chub skam sar 'jog mdzad pas/ /ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyal po nyid/ /de nyid byang chub tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gang du phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba 'di nye bar lta zhing sems pa dang / rtse gcig tu yid la byed pa dang / thos shing 'dzin par byed pa 'dzam bu'i gling 'di'i nang du gnas pa'i gsang ba mtshungs pa med pa'i blo can de la kun nas kun du mkhyen cing gzigs par byed/ chos nyid gcig tu 'jug pas nye bar spyod par byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid gcig par ston pa rdo rje'i le'u ste drug cu bzhi pa'o// //82—636

de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab 'gros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnyis su med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos kun dngos po med pa yi/ /de bzhin nyid kyi rang bzhin dang / /gzhan ma yin pa'i chos nyid de/ /byang chub sems 'di bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa spos bzangs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ngo bo nyid kyis yongs dag pas(1/ /sku ni nam mkha'i khams mtshungs pa/ /gzi brjid zil gyis mi non pa'i/ /byang chub sems las 'byung ba yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i dbyings sangs rgyas thams cad kyi don gyi blo dang bral ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /so sor rtogs (gyipa bral ba yi(nas/ /dmigs med bsgom rgya du med pa yi/ /mthar thug 5lam las 'das pa po/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa lha sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mthong ba spyod pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so//yang dag tu ni rtog med pa'i/ /dus gsum dus med mtshan ma grol/ /grub pa rdo rje dbyings gyur pa/ /byang chub sems 'di bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lha'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun nas brjod du med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 6zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sna tshogs dngos las byung ba yi/ /mchog dang mchog 82—637

ma yin pa'i tshul/ /mnyam nyid tha dad med pa'i phyir/ /byang chub sems 'di bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nor bu gsal ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yang dag par sgrub 6)pa med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du bde ba'i mthar son pa/ /mi 'gyur g.yung drung dpal 'byung ba/ /mkhyen du med cing rnam 'byed bral/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nor bzangs (5)sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mi zad pa'i ye shes kyi nor bu 'byung ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /khyad par ye shes rin chen blo / /tshad med dge ba'i stobs 'byung ba/ /mi gnas byang chub rgya mtsho'i gnas/ /khyad par ye shes mchog bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sgron ma khurgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mchog tu zhi ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du rtog bral brjod 'das pa/ /'gro ba'i mtshan ma dag pa'i dngos/ /tshad med rtog pa rab zhi ba/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen nga ro'i dbyangs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snang ba dmigs med rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /yul dang dus dang bsam pa dang / /rnam par rig pa las 'das shing / /rnam pa ma lus nub pa'i bdag /byang chub sems 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skye dbang rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rtog med rdo rje'i gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms 82—638

par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos dang chos nyid med pa yi / /rnam par rtog dang mi rtog med/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin kun grol bas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sgra gcan sbed sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mngon par byang chub pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dbang gi rgyal po be+e ḍūr+ya0)/ /de nyid rin chen bsam 'phel zhes/ /bsam pa'i don kun sgrub byed mal/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dge ba'i (kyimadzad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dmigs med rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so//dpe med brjod 'das blo yul bral/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /gdod nas snying po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i blo gros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lhun grub rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rang sems 'od gsal dag pa las/ /'phrul byung rkyen grol chos nyid dang / /rgyun chad med pa'i lam gyis rgyas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen grags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bag chags gcod pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam pa kun du shes bya dang / /nyon mongs nye ba'i kun nyon mongs/ /mkha' yi 6)sprin tshogs dengs pa ltar / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa don mdzad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos thams cad la dmigs 82—639

pa med pa'i gnas rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /kun gyis mthong med lta ba bral/ /rtsa ba'i rten med stong nyid dbyings/ /don dam chos nyid rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mdzad mtha' gzigs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun nas bral ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan pa/ / dag pa'i (1nide bzhin nyid la brten(5)/ /snang la zhen med rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa srid pa'i me tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ma skyes skye med sbyor ba yis/ /chos kun mngon gyur byang chub kyi / /rnam par mi rtog de bzhin nyid/ /khyab pa nam mkha' ltar sangs rgyas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mdzod spu ldan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam grol rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi 4sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams sems su bsdu ba dang / /sems kyang lus la bsdu ba dang / /lus ni ye shes nyer sbyor ba'i/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa spobs pa mtshungs med rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes mngon par 'phrul pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mthong chos 'bras ldan gzhan gyur dang / /de las gzhan pa'i rgyu tshul las/ /skyob pa 'dren pa bla med gnas/ /ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes 82—640

gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes rnam 'byed nga ro sangs rgyas thams cad kyi seng ge rnam par rtse ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rtag tu byang chub sems las ni/ /mi g.yo 'od gsal lhun gyis grub/ /tshad med ye shes mkha' khutshob thugs1/ /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang 'byung gi gnas mtshungs pa med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i mche bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhing gi lhun rnam par phye ba'i ye shes rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sems can lus su dmigs med kyang / /de dag skye ba yongs grub par/ /rang gi sku ni der byin brlab/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mdzes par gshegs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes mngon par sgrub napa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sems can mos pa du ma yi//tshul gzigs ngag dang sku dag kyang / /phra dang rags dang yangs dang dog /rnam par dbye ba ston par mdzad/ /ces gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams sgron me sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phyogs kyi dra ba rnam par tshad med ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du las dang ye shes la/ /'jug pa nam mkha'i rang bzhin can / /phyir mi ldog par gyur pas na/ /byang chub sems 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bkra shis ldan pas sangs rgyas 82—641

thams cad kyi yang dag par 'jug pa mi zad pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos kyi dbyings dang dbyer med pa'i / /bsam gyis mi khyab la gnas pas/ /bde gshegs spyod pa gcig nyid la / /'jug pa ye shes tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yul 'khor mya ngan med pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul 17pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di sasungs so/ /ting 'dzin gcig la mnyam bzhag (snyepas/ /'jig rten khams ni du ma ru/ /grangs med ting 'dzin la 'jug pa/ /zad mi shes par bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros sems pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid rnam par snang ba med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /mtha' dang dbus med dag pa yi/ /zhing dang sems can khams rnams dang / /chos rnams mnyam nyid yang dag pas/ /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa blo dang ldan pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mngon par 'du bya ba dang bral ba ye shes rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gang du chos rnams 'byed med par/ /mnyam nyid spyod pas kun du yang / /sangs rgyas zhing ni mnyam nyid de/ /phrin las mnyam nyid tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi sgron me sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rab tu phye ba'i don gyi mdzod rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /nam mkha'i khams ltar chags med pas/ /ma chags 82—642

thog mtha' med par ni/ /skye 'chi med pa'i lus ston cing / /ngag dang sems kyang de ltar gsungs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa spyan ldan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rab tu gnas med chos rnams ni/ /rang bzhin med pa'i 6)gzhi yin te/ /chos rab shin tu zab pa ste/ /yongs su rdzogs par bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu gzigs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshad med mtshan nyid gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rgyun chad med cing thogs med pa/ /sgrib pa med cing 'pho ba med / /ldan dang mi ldan med pa nyid/ /'dzin med tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shugs kyis (midor ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi smon lam rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gzhi med tha dad med pa dang / /dam chos rgya mtsho tshad med pas/ /rnam par spros pa yang med de(gyi/ /dag pa byang chub tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa stobs chen sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dbang bskur ba tshad med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /nyer len med cing nye bar mi len med/ /rjes 'brang 4)med cing rjes su ldog pa'ang bral/ /thob pa mngon par chags pa bral ba gang / /chos nyid de bzhin nyid 'di 'dres pas bstan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab me tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rab tu gsang ba dbyings rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la 82—643

snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gnas med rgyun gcod bral ba'i chos/ /phyir mi ldog pas 'gyur med pa/ /sprul zhing grub dang dbang byed 1med/ /gang du g.yo med tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas nade bzhin gshegs pa brtan pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor tshad dang rgya yongs su chad 8)pa med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /shin tu dang zhing dmigs med pa/ /'dren pa med cing phyi nang bral/ /gol med (gegayang sa dag pa yi/ /nam mkha'i dbyings mtshungs bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa don dang 45ldan pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi len pa med cing dor ba med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi 4)sems 'di gsungs so/ /sgra dbyangs mi zad brjod med pas/ /rdo rje'i tshig la mi gnas pas/ /yi ge med par rab shes pa/ /yan lag tshul 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa don gsung ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mtshungs pa med pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams rnam dag ye shes gang / /de ni don dam ma yin te/ /spyad 7dang rgyu dngos bskyed pa'i phyir/ /don dam gnas med tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes pa gsal ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gang du bsgrub pa med pa'i rgyan rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /rnam/ pa'i mchog rnams kun ldan pa'i/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i bdag nyid kyis/ /'dul ba tshad med dag pa las/ /byang chub sems 'di bstan pa yin/ /zhes 82—644

gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i zhal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dus gsum mnyam pa nyid rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /thog ma tha ma med zhi ba/ /ngo bo nyid kyis mi rtog cing / /sku gsum rdo rje'i spyod yul las/ /byang chub sems 'di bstan pa'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gtsug zhi)phud sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i gsang ba mi zad pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos dbyings zad med kun rtog bral/ /du mar snang zhing mi 'gyur ba/ /yang dag ye shes spyod yul du/ /dmigs med tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa snang bar mdzad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa mi zad pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /sgrib pa bkod pa tshad med pas/ /dbyangs sgra du ma brjod med pas / /mi zad thog mtha' rab zhi ba/ /gsung gi rdo rje'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi sems pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par rgyal ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin tshon)la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /gsang ba 'dzin pa ma lus pa'i/ /dbang bskur mngon thob rdo rje can/ /mi phyed mi zad stobs gyur pa/ /byang chub sems 'di bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi blo gros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo yang dag par bskul ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so / /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i don bskul ba/ /tshangs pa'i gnas kyis /khyad 82—645

par du/ /bskul ba tshad med byang chub sems/ /de nyid yang dag bstan pa yin / /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar de la mtshungs med lha dang mis mchod pa/ /ye shes phung po rnam mang nye bar sgrub par mdzad/ /rgyal ba'i chos sgrub pha rol mtha' yas bzhugs (1)mdzad pa/ /de la sngon gyi byang chub spyod pa char mi 'gro/ /khyu mchog rnams kyis ye shes sa mchog 'di thob nas/ /phyogs bcu kun du skad cig gcig gis rgyas 'gengs pa/ /ye shes zhugs dang ldan zhing mngon shes mchog thob pas/ /rgya mtsho cher phyin gru chen rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin/ /ched du bskyod sems bral zhing ye shes phrin las gnas/ /zhing khams kun du gnas pa rnam par spyod par byed/ /khams rnams bzhi po kha dog tha dad yangs pa dang / /phra zhing che dang rnam par phye ba yang dag 'jug /stong gsum shin tu phra ba kun la 'jug byed de/ /khams bzhi 'gro ba'i lus kun rnam par phye ba dang / /rgyud drug rin chen rnam par phye ba'i rdul phran rnams/ /rnam par phye ba'i tshad med 'jug byed pa/ /smon lam byin gyis bde gshegs yang dag skul bar mdzad / /rgyal ba rnams kyi stobs mchog don dran mngon 'dod pa/ /ye shes yon tan dbang bskur sangs rgyas kun las (mi'athob/ /brgya stong phrag bcu'i ting 'dzin grangs med gang yod pa/ /spyod yul shes pa tshe 'di nyid la thob gyur nas / /de yi rjes la thams cad mkhyen par dbang bskur (5)'thob/ /yul yangs ting 'dzin de dag thob pas g.yo mi mnga'/ /gang tshe de nyid sangs rgyas mngon par dbang bskur tshe/ /pad+mo rgya chen rin chen kun spras brgyan pa 'byung / /de yi 'od zer khrag khrig (4nyamatha' yas stong phrag can/ /phyogs bcu'i 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rab zhi byed/ /chos rab don du rgyal sras dbang bskur thob par 82—646

mkhyen / /sangs rgyas mdzad pa rgya mtsho rnam thar las/ /bdud rtsi dri med ye shes mngon dga' 'thob/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi 6)spyod pa 'di yang dag par gsungs pa na 'jig rten gyi tshukhams rdo rje'i dpal rgyas kyis rtsibargyan pa zhes bya ba dag nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba dag ni (7drung nas lhags pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i (9snying po zhes bya ba 'dug par gyur pa dang / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnam par grol ba'i zla bas (6)'di skad ces smras so//de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin dang lta ba mtshungs pa med pa spyod pa zab pa'i snying po 'di gdul (7bya la ji ltar 'jug par 'gyur grang /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying pos smras pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa stong mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma dang / chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo nyid ston pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhing khams yongs su sbyang ba dang / sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa smin (kyecing grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / /tshad med pa rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir lus can ye shes ldan pa dag la kun du 'jug par byed do/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyis zab pa bla na med pa brjod du med pa'i gnas las rgya mtsho ltar rnam par grol ba ston pa shin tu ngo mtshar te legs so legs so zhes bya bar brjod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun du bzang po spyod pa tshad med pa dang ting nge 'dzin 'byam klas pa rab tu bsgrub pa'i dgongs pas chos kyi dbyings dang gnyis su med par kun tu rol pa ston par 82—647

mdzad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rmad du gyur pa ston pa'i le'u ste drug cu lnga pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa stong 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 1kyi zhing du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par gyur cing gsang ba chen po'i 2sku'og min gyi gnas su 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi spros pa las 'das shing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa sangs rgyas stong mngon par sangs rgyas nas re re zhing la yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / bla na med pa'i 'bum phrag dpag tu med pas yongs su bskor cing (5)mdun du bdar te gnas pa la chos kyi (4'khor lo bskor ba dang bcas pa re re zhing la yang byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' tshangs pa'i rgyal po drung na 'khod pa yongs su snang bar gyur to/ /de dag kyang byang chub kyi snying po gsang ba bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa yongs su snang ba chen pos 55khyab par gyur te/ sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i 'jig rten du de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'jug par byed cing byin gyis rlob (6par byed la/ ye shes yangs pa'i 77spyan gyis chos kyi dbyings mi zad pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la rab tu gnas par mdzad do/ /gsang ba 'di rab tu bstan pa na de'i tshe de'i dus na de nas byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing chen po 82—648

bcu drug gi sems dpa' rnams kyi (1)de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od zer gyi snying po sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa du ma thob bo/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhing bye ba phrag brgyad kyi byang chub sems dpas gnas pas ni ye shes rgya mtsho mtshungs pa med pa la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin du ma mngon par thob bo/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bye ba phrag brgyad cu'i grangs de snyed kyang gsang ba chen po rdo rje'i tshul gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang las skad cig re res mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa ( thob par gnas par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos gsang ba nye bar bsdu ba'i don du gsol pas)/sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzugs sku mtha' yas pa/ /rgyal ba'i snying po ye shes sku gcig tu/ /rnam par phyed pa 'od gsal ba yi gnas/ /gsang ba chen po'i gnas 'dir mngon sangs rgyas/ /gang du sems nyid byang chub mchog gyur pa/ /'dren pa chos kyi rgyal po tshul 'di yin/ /zhes smras pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag ma lus pa'i thugs yi (4)rangs shing / rab tu dga' bas rgyas par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos bla na med pa'i yongs su 'dus pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams la gzigs te bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba chen po bstan pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo 'di lta ste/ thun mong du gyur pa'i bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / khyad par yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / mchog tu gsang ba thabs kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /yang de nyid las byung rgya cher ston pa dang / /zab mo dang ni bla med tshul mchog ste/ /phyi nang gsang ba de nyid ye shes kyi/ /dkyil 'khor tshad med 'dir 5)ni bstan pa yin/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa stong dag gi/ /sku 82—649

yi dkyil 'khor spro dang sdud pa dang / /gsung gi dkyil 'khor gsang sngags 'bum phrag ste/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ye shes lngar 6)bsdus pa'o/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i rnam dbye gsal (mib yis/ /dam pa'i rigs ni brgya ru 'gyur ba ste/ /de nyid dkyil 'khor mngon par phyung ba yin/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor lnga yi dbye ba yis/ /rtsa ba gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gsum du bsdus/ /mdo don spyod dang theg pa'i don/ /de nyid bsdus pa gcig pa sdom pa che/ /tha dad pa dang 'byung ba nye bar gyur pa las/ /lus dang yul dang dbang po'i spyod yul du/ /gsang ba du ma nye bar sdud pa'i tshul/ /spyi dang bye brag dkyil 'khor 'dir gsungs so/ /bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad dkyil 'khor du/ /reg bya rdo rje'i (5)dbus su mngon gnas nas/ /rdo rje mi bskyod shar gyi gnas su dgod/ /rdo rje skyil krung 54)gnyis med (5)sbyor bas bzhugs/ /lhor ni dkon mchog dpal lo / /nub tu 'od dpag med pa'o/ /byang du don yod grub pa'o/ /shar lho'i grwar (6)ni lha mo spyan ma'o/ /lho nub tu ni mā ma khri'o/ /nub (7)byang du ni gos dkar mo'o/ /byang shar du ni rdo rje sgrol ma'o/ /de ni nang gi pho brang la gnas pa'o / /de'i phyi khyams kyi grwa (8)bzhi la me'i phyogs su gzugs rdo rje ma'o/ /bden bral du ni sgra rdo rje'o/ / rlung gi phyogs (9)su dri rdo rje'o/ /dbang ldan gyi phyogs su ni ro rdo rje'o/ /shar gyi snam bu la byams pa tu )mgon po dang sa'i snying po'o / /lho'i snam bu la phyag na rdo rje dang nam mkha'i snying po'o/ /nub kyi snam bu la 'jig rten dbang phyug dang 'jam dbyangs rdo rje'o/ /byang gi snam bu la sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang kun du bzang po gnas pa'o/ /shar gyi sgor 11ni gshin rje mthar byed do/ /lho tu sgor ni shes rab mthar byed do/ /nub 82—650

sgor ni pad+ma mthar byed do/ /byang sgor ni 6)bgegs mthar byed do/ /shar lho mtshams kyi grwar (sheni mi g.yo ba'o/ /lho nub tu 'dod pa'i rgyal po'o/ /nub byang du ni dbyug sngon can no/ /byang shar mtshams su ni stobs po che ste khro bo'i rgyal po nyid do/ /steng phyogs shar gyi sgo drung du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur (guba'o / /'og phyogs nub kyi sgo drung du ni gnod mdzes rgyal po rnam par dgod par bya'o/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi sku'i dkyil 'khor 'byung ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin du gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'od dpag med pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /reg bya rdo rje dbus su mngon gnas nas/ /bcom ldan mi bskyod 6)nub tu gnas pa ste/ /bde (5)chen ye shes tshul mchog legs par bzhugs/ /shar du 6)ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /lhor ni dkon mchog dpal lo/ / nub tu 'od dpag med do/ /7byang du don yod grub pa'o/ /shar lho'i grwar (kyeni lha mo spyan ma'o/ /lho nub tu ni mā ma khri'o6)/ /nub byang du ni gos dkar mo'o/ /byang shar du ni sgrol tsoma'o/ /de ni nang gi pho brang la gnas pa'o/ /de'i phyi khyams kyi grwa bzhi la me'i phyogs su gzugs rdo rje ma'o/ /bden bral du ni sgra rdo rje'o / / rlung gi phyogs su dri rdo rje'o/ /(1dbang ldan gyi phyogs su ro rdo rje'o/ /shar gyi snam bu la byams pa (nyemagon po dang sa'i snying po'o/ /lho'i snam bu la phyag na rdo rje dang nam mkha'i snying po'o/ /nub kyi snam bu la 'jig rten dbang phyug dang 'jam dpal lo/ /byang gi snam bu la sgrib pa rnam par sel ba dang kun du bzang po'o/ /shar sgor tu ni gshin rje mthar byed do/ /lho sgor ni shes rab mthar byed do/ /nub sgor ni pad+ma mthar byed do/ /byang sgor ni bgegs mthar byed do/ /shar lho mtshams gesu khro rgyal mi g.yo ba'o/ /lho nub tu ni 82—651

'dod pa'i rgyal po'o/ /nub byang du ni dbyug sngon can no/ /byang shar du ni stobs po che ste/ /de ltar gyur pa'i khro bo rnams so/ /steng phyogs su shar sgo'i rtsa bar gtsug tor (1)'khor los sgyur ba'o/ /'og phyogs nub sgo'i rtsa bar gnod mdzes rgyal po dgod par bya'o/ /de ltar pad+ma'i rigs kyi gsung gi dkyil 'khor 'byung ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin du gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 97rin chen 'byung ldan dkyil 'khor du/ /reg bya (8)rdo rje dbus su mngon gnas te/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa lho yi le tser bzhugs/ /de nyid dkon mchog legs par gyur pa'o/ /shar du ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /nub tu ni 'od dpag med do/ /byang du ni gdon mi za ba nyid do/ /shar lhor lha mo spyan ma/ lho nub tu mā ma tī/nub byang du gos dkar mo/ byang shar du rdo rje sgrol ma'o/ /de nas (genang gi pho (5)brang la gnas pa'o/ /de'i phyi khyams kyi grwa tsho6)bzhi la me'i mtshams su gzugs rdo rje ma/ bden bral du sgra rdo rje/ rlung du dri rdo rje/ dbang ldan du ro rdo rje'o/ /shar gyi snam bu la byams pa rdo rje dang sa'i snying po(7)/ lho'i snam bu la phyag na rdo rje dang nam mkha'i snying pon/ nub kyi snam bu la 'jig rten dbang phyug dang 'jam dbyangs dpal/ byang gi snam bu la sgrib pa rnam par sel ba dang kun du bzang po'o/ /shar sgor gshin rje gshed do/ /lho sgor rnam par rgyal ba'o/ /nub sgor rta mgrin no/ /byang sgor bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'o/ /shar lhor mi g.yo ba/lho nub tu 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ nub byang du dbyug sngon can/ byang shar du dzi)stobs po che'o/ /shar stod du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur khri )ba'o/ /nub smad du gnod mdzes rgyal po ste/ khro bo'i rgyal po bcu dang ldan 31bcas nyunyapar 'byung ba'o / /de ltar rin po che'i rigs yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor 'byung ba rdo rje'i 82wa 652

ting nge 'dzin 'di gsungs so/ /bcom ldan gdon mi za ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /reg bya rdo rje 6)dbus su (miganyis med par/ /rdo rje 'dzin la tsho byang gi phyogs su dgod / /bde ba'i stan lil legs par bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du rnam par snang mdzad do/ /lhor ni rin chen 'byung ba'o/ /nub du 'od dpag med do/ /byang du don yod grub pa(5)/ shar lhor spyan ma'o/ /lho nub tu mā ma khri'o/ /nub byang du gos dkar mo'o/ /byang shar mtshams kyi grwar (6)ni lha mo sgrol ma'o/ /de ni nang gi pho brang la gnas pa'o'adi/ /de'i phyi khyams kyi grwa bzhi la me'i phyogs su gzugs rdo rje ma'o/ /bden bral du sgra rdo rje'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su dri rdo rje'o / /'byung po'i mtshams su ro rdo rje'o/ /shar gyi snam bu la byams pa dang sa'i snying po'o/ /lho'i snam bu la phyag na rdo rje dang nam mkha'i snying po'o/ /nub kyi snam bu la 'jig rten dbang phyug dang 'jam dbyangs dpal lo/ /byang gi snam bu la sgrib pa rnam par sel ba dang / kun du bzang po'o/ /shar sgor ni gshin rje gshed/ lho sgor shes rab mthar byed/ nub sgor pad+ma mthar byed/byang sgor bgegs mthar byed pa nyid do/ /shar lhor ni mi g.yo ba'o/ /lho nub tu ni (gyi'adod pa'i rgyal po'o/ /nub byang du ni dbyug sngon can no/ /byang shar du ni stobs po che'o/ /steng du gtsug tor 'khor los ( sgyur ba'o/ /'og tu khro bo gnod mdzes rgyal po gnas pa ste/ khro bo bcu mngon par 'byung ba'o/ /de ltar las kyi rigs phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor 'byung ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin 'di gsungs so/ /gang du lha mo spyan ma gtsor gyur pa/ /dkyil 'khor der ni rdo rje 'dzin pa gtso/ /reg bya rdo rje shar lho'i grwar bzhugs pas/ /dkyil 'khor nges par sprul pa'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /rdo rje mā ma tī las gtsor gyur pa/ /rdo 82—653

rje 'dzin pa de dang gnyis med de/ /reg bya rdo rje lho nub grwar 5)gnas te/ /lhag ma gzhan rnams sngon dang mtshungs (gyipa'o/ /rdo rje gos dkar mo dang rdo rje 'dzin / /gnyis su med par dbus gsu bzhugs pa ste/ /reg bya rdo rje nub byang gyur bzhugs pas/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo nges par sprul pa'o/ /lha mo sgrol ma dang ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /gnyis med bde bas rgyabazhugs pa de nyid de/ /reg bya rdo rje byang shar gyur bzhugs pa/ /tshad med lha mo bzhi yi dkyil 'khor ro / /gzugs kyi rdo rje dang ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /gnyis med bzhugs pa dbus kyi gtso bo ste/ /reg bya rdo rje me yi (5)phyogs su'o/ /sgra yi rdo rje dang ni rdo rje 'dzin / /gnyis med bzhugs pa dbus kyi gtso bor gyur/ /reg bya rdo rje 6)srin po'i phyogs su'o/ /dri yi rdo rje dang ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /gnyis med dbus ⑦kyi gtso bor gyur pa ni/ /reg bya rdo rje rig 'dzin phyogs su'o/ /ro yi rdo rje dang ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /dbus gnas mnyam par sbyor ba'i tshul nyid do/ /reg bya rdo rje dbang ldan phyogs gnas pa'o/ /'di dag mchod byed lha mo bzhi dag gi/ /dkyil 'khor so sor nges par bstan pa yin/ /'di dag rigs ni so sor bstan pa yi tsho/ /dkyil 'khor tha dad rim pa bstan pa'o/ /byams pa'i mgon po gtso bor gyur pa ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa shar phyogs dang po'i sar 'pho ba'i rim pa bstan pa bla na med/ /reg bya rdo rje dbus su 'khril po)par bzhugs/ /sa yi snying po gtsor 1 gyur dkyil 'khor la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa der gnas 'pho ba ste / /reg bya rdo rje'ang dbus su gnas pa'o/ /phyag na (sterdo rje reg bya rdo rje dang / /gnyis med dbus gnas tshul 'di bstan pa'o(she/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa dang po'i gnas der 'pho/ /rdo rje dbang phyug reg bya rdo rje dang / /gnyis med 82—654

dbus gyur gtso bo 'pho ba'i tshul/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nub tu 'pho ba mdzad/ /'jam dbyangs rdo rje reg bya rdo rje dang / /gnyis med bde chen nub tu gtso bo bzhugs / /sgrib pa rnam sel reg bya rdo rje dang / /gnyis med rdo rje 'dzin pa byang du gnas/ /kun du bzang po reg bya rdo rje dang / /gnyis med dbus bzhugs rdo rje 'dzin pa ni/ /byang phyogs lha snam 6)dag tu bzhugs par mdzad/ /'di dag kun du rim pa shes par bya/ /gshin rje gshed po dang ni reg rdo rje/ /gnyis med bzhugs pa gtso bo 'pho bar bstan/ /shes rab mthar byed dang ni reg rdo rje/ /dbus bzhugs rdo rje (2)'dzin pa lhor gnas pa'o/ /rta mgrin dbang dang reg bya rdo rje ma/ /dbus bzhugs rdo rje 'dzin pa nub sgor bzhugs/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang ni reg rdo rje/ /dbus bzhugs rdo rje 'dzin pa byang sgor gnas / /mi g.yo mgon po dang ni reg rdo rje/ /dbus bzhugs rdo rje 'dzin pa shar lhor gnas/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po dang ni reg rdo rje/ /dbus bzhugs rdo rje 'dzin pa nub byang gnas/ /dbyug sngon can dang lha mo reg rdo rje/ /dbus bzhugs rdo rje 'dzin pa nub byang du'o/ /rdo rje stobs po che dang reg (5)rdo rje(gi)/ /dbus bzhugs rdo rje 'dzin pa byang shar gnas/ /gnod mdzes rgyal po dang ni reg rdo rje/ /dbus gnas rdo rje 'dzin pa 'og phyogs su/ /gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba reg rdo rje/ /dbus 'gyur rdo rje 'dzin pa steng du dgod/ /'di dag thams cad zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /sum cu rtsa gnyes rnal 'byor mkhas pas dgod/ /rdo rje'i gdung dang rdo rje'i ka ba ni/ /rin chen bum pa pad+mar mdzes byas pa/ /du mas bteg pa'i tshad med phreng ba can/ /re re la yang sgo bzhi rta babs (5)ldan/ /dkyil 'khor chen po tshad med (6)sgo bzhi las/ /lhor (782—655

ni gsang ba'i bdag po'i dkyil 'khor la/ /dbus su sna tshogs bde ma dag dang ni/ /gnyis su med par sbyor ba bstan pa'o/ /zhal gsum phyag drug rdo rje dril bu dang / /nor bu 'khor lo pad+ma ral gri ste/ /shin tu mtshungs pa rdo rje gdengs po ste/ /rdo rje be con rdo rje 'bar ba dang / /rdo rje drag po bzhi yang gtso bor mtshungs/ /sgeg mo phreng ma glu ma gar ma dang / /me tog bdug nyu)spos mar me dri chab ma/ /khyams su rdo rje gtsug tor rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / /rdo rje nyi ma rdo rje spyan dang ni/ /rdo rje ba dan rdo rje 'ching mdzad dang / /rdo rje nag po rdo rje las bcas pa/ /phyogs gnas shin tu gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor lo/ /thun mong 2khro rgyal bcus ni yongs bskor ba'o/ /tshangs pa'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor byang du ste/ /lha mo zhi ba mo dang gnyis med pa/ /zhal gsum phyag drug ser zhing thal mo sbyar/ /'khor lo sdigs mdzub su noral gri nor bu ste/ /shar du brgya 4byin khyung mgo lho ru yang / /dbang phyug shang shang gdong dang nub dang byang / /khyab 'jug seng mgo can dang glang po'i mgo/ /phyogs kyi bdag po dag dang mtshams 5bzhir yang / /zhi ba mo dang dbang mo drag mo dang / /tsa muṇ+ḍir 6bcas rgan byed ma dang ni/ /gtum pa 7rim dang phreng ldan me tog ma/ /de dag dang bcas lha srin sde brgyad dang / /phyogs skyong 8)bcu yis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /khyams kyi phyi rol khor (9yug mtshams bzhi la/ /rgyal chen bzhi bcas rol pas yongs bskor ba/ /bkra shis dang ldan pad+ma'i shing bcas pas/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i thun mong gnas/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog tu bshad pa yin/ /de ltar yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /dngos po thams cad kyis ni bltas nas kyang / /snying po sngags kyi 'od zer 82—656

lcags kyu yis/ /drangs nas bde bar gshegs rnams bsgom par bya/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin dri med pa'i/ / ting 'dzin las byung bum pa'i bdes gang ba'i/ /0)'khor lo bsams nas de nas gshin rje yirin// /mthar byed tshogs bcus bar chad bsrung bar bya/ /rang gi snying po mngon bzlas mchod yon ni / /tsan+dan bzang sogs me tog gis mdzes dbul/ /rang la ji lta bzhin du kun dbang bskur(gu/ /cho ga 'di yis thams cad mchod par bya/ /pad+ma'i nang gi sa bon 'od rnams kyis/ /gzugs la sogs pa thams cad drangs nas ni/ /yang dag byang chub yid kyi ngo bo ni/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor dag tu bsgom par bya / /shes rab ba spu re re las spros pa'i/ /'od zer rnam pa sna tshogs rgya chen tshogs / /ma lus nam mkha'i khams ni kun du khyab/ /de las blo dang ldan pas rab tu spro/ /'od kyi sgo las nges par 'byung ba yi / /yan lag dri med rgyan kun gyis legs brgyan/ /me long pi wang gling bu rdza rnga dang / /bzhad ma glu ma phreng ma gar ma dang / /rdza rnga che dang me tog bdug spos dang / /mar me dri chab zhal zas snod 'dzin dang / /gos dang chos 'byung la sogs 'dzin pa yi5/ /bcu drug rig ma lha mo rnam sgeg cing / /rol pa'i lag pas kun du sgyur ba ni/ /'od kyi snang bas sprul pa sna tshogs pa'i/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyi dra bas khyab pa dang / /dngos rnams sgyu ma lta bur so sor ni/ /yang dag rig cing 'jig rten lta mkhas pa/ /rtog pa ma lus kun las nges grol zhing / /mchog tu bde ba bskyed (6)pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ /gzugs la 7sogs pa lha mo rnams dang ni/ /de bzhin phyi yi dri sogs thams cad kyis/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po rnams ni legs mchod cing / /tha dad rnam par rtog las nges grol ba'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta 82—657

pū dza badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3rta6)/ sgra yi yul rnams ma lus pa rnams ni/ /brag ca'i ⑤sgra dang mtshungs par nges brtags la/ /rang yid lhag pa'i lha ru gnas pa la/ /chos rnams bstod pa'i sgra ni sgrogs par bsam/ /'bar ba'i oṃ gyis byin brlabs (5)rlung dang me/ /dkyil 'khor la gnas rab 'bar bdud rtsi lnga/ /de nas yi ge gsum bzlas dpag med pa'i/ /thub pa'i dbang po'i nang du chud par bya/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i ngo bor bsams nas ni/ /hūm̐ dgod rdo rje'i lce ni bzang po dang / /snying ga'i zla ba'i dbus su ma lus pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i 'khor lo des ni tshim par bya/ /dad dang brtson 'grus rnam par dag pa dang / /de bzhin dran dang bsam gtan rnam dag pa/ /sgo bzang srung bar byed pa'i ngo bo nyid / /shes rab rnam par ma lus yul du snang / /mtshan ma med pa'i dga' ba rnam dag pa/ / ma lus ri4)lha mo'i tshogs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /dbang po'i skyisgo dang bdag dang rnam rtog dang / /'jug pa'i rnam shes rnam par dag pa yang me long la sogs (phyiradri med ngo bor bsam/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yang rang bzhin te/ /de nyid rnam dag rnal 'byor 'khor lo'i gtso/ /de yi sems ni rnam par dag pa yin/ /gzugs la 7)sogs pa mi shes rnam bral bas dri med phung po la 98)sogs ngo bor grub/ /ser sna la kyi)sogs dag par gyur pas ni/ /pha rol phyin pa dkar po'i chos rang bzhin/ /bdag gzhan 7rnam rtog med par snang ba ni/ /'ching ba med par gyur kyang go rims (1bzhin/ /zab pa dang ni rgya che ba yis ni/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid can sems yin/ /dam pa'i don du dbye ba med pa dang / /rnam 'byed med cing ci yang mi snang ste/ /gang du gzhan du 'dzin pa'i rnam ldog pa/ /de bzhin dbye ba la sogs rtog bral yin//82—658

de ltar brtags na rang snying dri med la/ /zla ba la gnas mtshan ma bsgom par bya / /gsang sngags dam pa thig le'i gzugs su ni/ /rang yid kyis ni 'od zer dang bcas bsam/ /rang sems 'od zer dri med las 'das pa'o/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mchog gyur pa/ /slar yang de nyid du ni nges bzhugs shing / /ye shes bdud rtsi 'bar bas bsam par bya/ /nang gi lus dang de bzhin thams cad kyang / /de yis kun du mthar ni snang byas nas/ /ba spu re re'i khong (1nyenas byung ba yi/ /'od zer tshogs kyis kun du dag par bya/ /yang na mtshan ma phra mo bsam pa ni/ /'od ldan sna rtser gnas pa thub pa yi/ /'khor lo nang du chud byas snying rje yi/ /nang gi shes rab dam pa nyin mtshan bsam/ /mtshan ma brtan po mthong na spro ba yi/ /'od zer de yi sprul pa'i thub dbang dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs pa yi phyag mtshan bsnams(ge/ /blo dang ldan pas yang dang yang du spro/ /yang na bzlas pa rtse gcig sems nyid ni/ /dngos kun bdag nyid rang gi sems dbang po/ /rang gi sngags ni sna tshogs 'od ldan 'bar/ /de nyid blo dang ldan pas bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsang ba nye bar bstan pa las rgyal po mchog mngon par 'byung ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin 'di bstan pa'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi ye shes mngon par rol pa 'byung ba'i rgyal po 'di bstan to/ /skyes bu la la bsod nams ldan gyur pas/ /gter gyi 'byung gnas chen po rnyed gyur pas/ /brgyan pa'i gnas kyi rgyan du rab sbyangs nas/ /de dag lus dang mthun pa'i rgyan du byed/ /de nyid mkhas pas chos kyi rgyan thob nas/ /sems dang blo yangs rgya mtshor gyur byas shing / /ji ltar sngon thos chos rnams rtogs 82—659

par byed/ /mi mthun tshul du mos pa tshol mi byed/ /de ltar rgyan gyur shin tu mthun par spyod/ /rnam par mi bsgom chos ni gang yang med/ /de dag chos rnams ji bzhin rgyan byed cing / /chos kun khong du chud pas mdzes par byed/ / mkhas pa (1rnam dag rin chen rgyun (2༄gyur pas/ /rgyud 'di'i gnas la legs par brgyan na mthong bas/ /dga' ba'i sems yid dang bas spro ba bskyed④/ /chos kyi yid la bdag nyid che ba brtson/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung chos la rab tu 'jug /chos rnams mnyam pa nyid la de brtson te/ /dkyil 'khor rnam par bsgom la rnam par brtson/ /rgyal ba gcig pur gnas thob mi byed cing / /chos rnams mi mnyam med par rab tu spyad/ /de ni bsam pa mthar thug rab brtan pas/ /rgyal ba'i byang chub spyod pa'i gnas 'di yin/ /ri rab bzhin du mi g.yo brtan pa yis/ /de yi bsam pa byang chub mchog la brten/ /mnyam bzhag sems dang ldan pas de brtson te/ /bsam gtan ye shes yid kyis rab tu spyod/ /bskal pa stong du spyad pa spyod byed kyang / /gsang ba 'di dang bral bar mi byed cing / / de yi 5)brtson 'grus 'jig par mi 'gyur ro/ /gsang chen theg pa 'di ni gang rnyed pa/ /mi de phyir mi ldog la gnas pa yin/ /srid pa lta ba snyom lus gcod byed pa/ /skyes bu dpa' bo nyid ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'di dag gsang ba yang dag don 'jug ste/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mthar thug nges rtogs yin/ /chos nyid zhi ba'i mthar thug thob gyur pas/ /de la mi dga'i yid byed gang yang med/ /dpe med ye shes ji skad gsungs pa ltar/ /de yis chos rnams mnyam pa nyid du byed/ /mi mnyam tshul du rtogs par mi byed cing / /ye shes mnyam nyid yongs su rdzogs par bsgrub/ /dam tshig gnas la 82wa 660

nges par brtson pa yis/ /nyams 1)pa med par sdom las rgyud bsdams te/ /gsang ba'i ting ge'adzin mtha' yas sgo thob pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rtsa ba'i rgyud dag tu/ /gsungs pa thub pa'i dgongs pa ma nor bar/ /don gsal khong du chud pa rgyal ba'i sras/ /tshe 'dir bla med mngon par byang chub 'thob/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gsang ba bla na med pa'i tshul yongs su 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /spyod lam kun du mnyam pa'i yid kyis ni/ /srog dang rtsol ba shin tu ma bsdams pa/ /gsang sngags rgyal po gsal bar brjod par bya/ /sku la sogs pa bzhin du'ang bsam pa ni/ /cig car spro ba dag ni legs par bya/ /nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam pa'i sku sogs pa'i/ /'od kyi sgo yi snang bas yang dag gang / /de nas snga ma bzhin du sna tshogs pa'i/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyis kun du bkod pa spro/ /yongs su sbas pa'i rig ma mchog rnams ni/ /bde chen bcas pas gzhan gyi dbang mthong nas/ /rnam par sgeg pa'i thub dbang tshogs rnams ni/ /mthar ni rang gi lus la gzhug par bya/ /rang gi snying po de nyid nges rtogs pas/ /sems kyi spyod pa skyo bas zhugs da)gyur na/ /rig ma'i tshogs kyis ye shes glu blangs pas/ /rab tu bskul bas yang dag mchod par bya/ /sems ni bzang po'i chu rgyun srog dang ni/ /rtsol ba 'od kyi lcags kyus 4drangs nas ni/ /ji bzhin sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje sogs/ /bdud rtsi des 5dbab ye shes nyams mi bya/ /de ltar lan re ngal so byas nas ni/ /sngar bshad cho gas bstod pa de nyid shes/ /gsang sngags dam pa nyin mtshan bzla 6ba ni/ /sngags las kun du chags pa med par bya/ /mchod cing bstod dang gshegs su gsol ba ni/ /82—661

sngags pas rab tu 'bad de rnam bya zhing / /oṃ la 6)sogs la 'khor lo bsdus nas ni/ /sku la sogs pa brtag pa dag tu bya/ /de ltar de nyid mthong zhing rnam grol bas/ /sems can khams rnams kun du dmigs nas ni/ /snying rjes 'gro ba kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /smon lam kun du ( bzang po nye bar gnas/ /ldang zhing dag pa'i sems pa rang lha yi/ /rnam pa'i nga rgyal yid la byas nas ni/ /kun du snang bar bya ba'i yul rnams ni/ /thams cad snga ma bzhin du yongs su bsam / /'di ni gsang ba'i spyod yul bya ba ste/ /las rgyal mchog ①ces bya ba'i ting gi)'dzin yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po/ gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po rol pa mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste drug cu (nyedrug pa'o// //brtag pa drug la gsang ba ye shes rdo rje byin gyis rlob pa'i rgyal po zhes bya'o/ /de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /nam mkha' ye shes rdo rjer 'byung / /byed skyed dam pa mchog gi gtso/ /gsang ba'i bzlas pa 'dir rab gsungs/ /oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhā /6)ra ya dhā (7)ra ya/ marta marta badz+ra blaka (8)phaṭa a 5)rtsu swā hā/ oṃ shā shwa 1 7ta sa nā ma sha sha e h+ye yonyanyi dzi na dzika ā (steḥ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ badz+ra dharma sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hu lu hu lu ā yinaro lika hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ badz+ra srur+ya ḍa tso ta dharma na sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a haṃ rat+na sgrika lirgyu phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ badz+ra phrab phrub hriḥ hriḥ.a pradz+nyā sgrika 4)rgyu phaṭa swā hā/ o ru ru sgu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid dha lo tsa na sarba at+pa sā dha ni swā hā/ oṃ shang ka re shārnying ka re gha ṭa lhabatunye/ ghuḥ 82—662

oṃ sum̐ bha ni sum̐ bha ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ o groṇ+ḍa 6)griṇ+ḍa ②rgyu hūṃ phaṭa/ gro: 'a)pa ya griṇ+ḍa (de pa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ā nā 6)ya ho bha ga bān bit+yā rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ na maḥ sa man+ta kā ya bā ka 6)tsit+ta badzā shāsti/ oṃ āḥ(8)usnri po)ga badz+ra tsakra warti sarba lo gī /ḍo )shwa (ter/ lo kota ta ra/ yan+t+ra man+t+ra tan+t+ra/ tsuṇ+ḍa 8pra yo gā di/ ma tunyem kṛ ④te ye na ke na tsit+ta 8ni/ kṛt+ta ⑩nidzi— tsho/ sar+pā yini bhin+dha gisayi/ tshirnya tshirnya/ ku ru ku ru/ mu ru mu ru/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ rka bha ya kai bha ya / bi dh+wan 63 sa ya bi dh+wa (nyan sa ya/ sha ta sa ha sra bi ṣa ( shebi tsun(nye/ usnri zhusteṣa (39bi dza ya/ tsakra warti/ sgro bh+rūṃ sgrotso/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūṃ/ a mu rka sarba sha hūṃ nā sha ya / sto bha ya s+t+waṃ bha (meya/ gdug ⑤pa can thams cad mā ra ya rbad phaṭa swā hā/na ma s+t+ri ya dhī kā māṃ/ ta thā ga tā ṭ+wāṃ/ sa tra a pra ti ⑩ha tā wa ( )pa ti dharma te/ba li ṭ+wāṃ/ oṃ a sa ma sa ma sa (nyaman+ta to nan+ta tā/ wa du pa ti shā sa ni/ ha ra ha ra / sma ra sma ra ṇi/ bi ga ta/ rā ga bud+dha/ sa ra sa ra/ sa ma ba lā/ ha sa ha sa/ tra ya tra ya/ ga ga na/ ma hā ba ra lak+ṣa ṇi/ dz+wa la dz+wa la na/ sā ga re swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /brtan g.yo khyab pa'i de bzhin gshegs/ /rigs rnams brgya yi bdag nyid 'gyur/ /de las ye shes lnga bdag nyid/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang / /sna tshogs rgyal ba lha yi sgo sku/ /phyag rgya bsdus pa nyid du gnas/ /sku gsung ( )thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /snying po gsang chen gcig tu bsdus/ /chos lnga dag (gyegi phung po can/ /bag chags bcas pa'i nyon mongs pa/ /de dag rnam par spyod byed pa/ /chos kyi sgo las gyur pa yi/ /khri phrag brgyad dang stong phrag bzhi/ /yi ge dam pa ston pa nyid/ /ting 'dzin yan lag lnga ldan pa'i/ /mnyam nyid dag pa'i tshogs su brjod/ /ji ltar 82wa 667

mkha' la nyi shar yang / /dmus long (1gis ni mthong ba med/ /de bzhin lam ②gyi rtags rnams kyang / /blo gros ldan pa de dag las/ /kun gyis mthong ba'i yul ma yin/ /rab rib med na de mthong 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i lam rtags gang / /de nyid dag pa'i spyod yul te/ rang gzhan gnyis mas (gum mthong yang / /de ni med par mi 'gyur te/ /zhing khams dag pa rnams su 'char / /rdzu 'phrul sbas pa'i tshul du gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med mnyam sbyor rnam rgyal thugs rje stong pa ro 4mnyam srid dang zhi ba'i rgya mtsho las brgal 5rab tu mi gnas bde ba che/ /mkha' dang mtshungs pas 'gro 'ong rnam bral dus gsum las 'das dngos dang dngos med phyogs cha mtha' dang dbus las rnam grol dag cing dri med rnam par dben/ /gsang ba chen po mi zad dpal ldan 'dus (tsho'adir rtogs dka' zab cing rgya che de bzhin gshegs kun mtha' yas pas ni yang dag don/ /rgyal ba thams cad bla med gnas 'dir byang chub dam pa bdag dang gzhan don sku bzhi rab rdzogs ye shes mngon gyur gter mdzod gsang chen dga' ba'i snying po'o/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo du ma rab tu 'byed cing spro dang bsdu ba'i 7rgyud kun ma lus 'dus pa'i bdag / rgyu dang mi rgyu kun la rnam par g.yogs na te bzhugs pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen bdag nyid dngos/ /chos rnams dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs las yang dag gsal ba'i rim pa kun ldan mchog spyod yul/ /byin brlabs 9dngos grub rgya mtsho'i chu las skal ldan 'thungs te rnal 'byor dbang phyug tshe 'dir skad cig dag gis thob/ /slob dpon las ni drin thob bla med brtan pa'i blo ldan dngos po kun/ /gsal dag shin tu phra ba mchog zhi'i rang bzhin sangs rgyas bde ba chen po'i gnas/ /82—668

gnyis med rtog 0)bral dpe med ye shes de nyid rnal 'byor pas mnyam bzhag /bsod nams min grol rang byung dpal ldan gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa' 'gyur/ /sems ni rab dang phan pa'i sems kyis rdo rje nyid du gyis/ /rang gi sdom pa mi zad de bzhin bslab pa rab bsten gyis/ /de ring tshegs chung bde bas shin tu myur du 'gro ba'i sems dpa' dang / /rab tu mnyam zhing mtshungs la dpe med rtag pa chen po nyid du rtogs par 'gyur/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa ta yā mi ②su ra te (5)sa ma 8)ya s+t+waṃ zhes byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa ni zla ba la rdo rje rtse lnga pa lta zhing rdo rje bzhag ste/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya thā 5su khaṃ zhes pas 'khor lo bskur bar 96)bya'o/ /deng khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlob par 'gyur gyis/ khyed rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje mchog tu gsang ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi byed cig77 /dad pa dang mi ldan pa rnams la yang ma yin no / /o tiṣ+ṭha tshon)badz+ra/ dṛ 9)phyo me bha ba/ sā swa 1 to me bha ba/ 119 15da yad+me/a rnyi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sirnyi ma me pra yats+tsha hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ/ a khaṃ r+pā 1 tshor hūm̐/ pra ti ku su ma/ pri tīts+tsha ge/ añja sali nā tha hoḥ1 zhes pas me tog dor bar bya'o/ /oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta kyi ya ma hā su kha sgrika 19a bhi ṣe 2 kun tā/ badz+ra satwa a dhi dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca/ a dhi pa dhi twe rdzo 1no dṛ ḍho 2bha ba sa ma ye hūm̐/ oṃ badzod zhu ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ su ra te stam 2 haṃ/ oṃ shrī badz+ra dhā tu shān ti a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ o sarba ta thā ga ta bud+dha 'ges bhi nu ṣiñca hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca āḥ oṃ badz+ra dharma a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ / oṃ badz+ra kurma a bhi ṣiñca 28kho/ oṃ gha gha/ ghā 9ta ya bhā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭan ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ tī la ya tī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra dha ro ā dz+nyā 82wa 669

nyid ting 'dzin bstan pa yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi 1gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las gsang sngags dang mchod pa bstan pa'i le'u ste drug cu bdun pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dbang bskur ba bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad yang dag par ston pa gsang ba tshad med pa mngon par 'byung ba 'di rab tu gsungs so/ /de nas gsang ba rdo rje 'dzin/ /dkyil 'khor du ma'i bdag nyid can/ /byang chub mchog tu gnas pa yi/ /ye shes dri med dra ba gsungs/ /'gro kun 'khor ba'i mun pa yi/ /nyon mongs rtog pa gzhom pa dang / /tshe 'dir mchog don thob bya'i phyir/ /dgyes pa chen po 'dir gzhug bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' che rnams kyis/ /gsang ba'i don la gsol pa gang / /yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /thar pa'i grong khyer bstan du gsol/ /de skad lan gsum brjod pa yi/ /gzhan don tshul 'di bstan pa ste/ /bsnyen pa nye bar sgrub pa dang / /sgrub pa sgrub pa chen po ste/ /rnal 'byor bzhir 2ni brjod pa yin/ /dang po'i mtshan nyid gsang ba dang / /nyer spyad 5cho ga tshul bzhin te/ /byang chub sems las rab byung ba/ /gsang ba tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /gsang ba cho ga nges bstan bya/ /sa btsal ba dang sa brtag 5pa/ /sa bslang 67sa gzung sa gnas pa/ /sbyang dang dag byed rim pas bya/ /ri bo'i ngogs dang dben gnas dang / /tshal dang skye bo med gnas pa/ /dur khrod chu 7ngogs gling dag 82—672

dang / /byin rlabs 517ldan sogs gnas su shis/ /shar dang lho dang nub dang byang / /rim pas dus kyi dbye ba yis/ /nyams dga' ba yi sa phyogs su/ /ye shes ldan pas nye bar 'grub/ /snum zhing mnyam la tshwa 95)sgo med/ /skyon med phyogs na na yid 'ong yin/ /ring du brkos sa slar khengs shing / /lhag par 'phel na shis par grags/ /phyed gyur mnyam dang bri dang mtho/ /rim shes lto 'phye chen po yi/ /mdun phyogs lto bar kha bltas brko/ /yul der gnas pa'i lha klu dang / /gang yang rung ba sa lha mo/ /mchod bstod gtor ma sngon 'gro bas / /nges par gnang ba byin par bsam/ /khro bo chen po du ma dang / /yang na bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yis/ /bsrung zhing bdag la mchog stsol bar/ /bsam pa ye shes rnal 'byor yin/ /de rjes sa yi lha mo dag /bdag la gnang ba byin nas ni/ /bar snang bzhugs pa de nyid kyang / /shin tu dgyes pas brtan par bzhugs / /thun mong ba dang khyad 4par gyis/ /sbyang ba sngon du 'gro ba yin/ /de nas dkyil 'khor dbus nyid du/ /khyad par zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 5bya/ /bdag nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis/ /sngags brjod reg pas gnas par gyur/ /de nas spyan drang mchod bstod pa/ /sngon 'gro gsol ba gdab pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi 6gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /gsang chen dkyil 'khor bshad du gsol/ /mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs/ /kun du bzang po sku yi mchog /gsang chen dkyil 'khor bshad du gsol/ /zhi ba'i mchog ni chos las byung / /spyod pa ye shes rnam sbyangs pa/ /kun du bzang po gsung gi mchog /gsang chen dkyil 'khor bshad du gsol/ /sems can 82—673

kun gyi sems chen po/ /spros med ye shes dag pa yi/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo sgyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /de skad ces ni phyogs bzhi nas/ /gsol ba gdab (1)cing phyag byas nas/ /mthong ba gzigs phyir khro bo yis/ /shin tu lta stangs bgegs gzir zhing / /brtul zhugs drag pos rdo rje'i gar/ /rdo rje sems dpa' (0khros pas bya/ /de nas bgegs la bka' bsgo zhing / /rol pa'i sgyur bas blta bar bya/ /gsang sngags phyag rgyar bcas pa yis/ /slob ma'i bgegs dbyung (kyebar chad bsal④/ /sbyin sreg (5nyegator ma sngon 'gro bya/ /khro bo'i phur pas gdab pa dang / /gtor mas bgegs bsal cho ga bstan/ /de nas bsgrub pa lhag par gnas/ /sa yi lha mo lhag gnas pa/ /phyag rgya 6)bcas shing mchod gyur pas/ /bskyed cing bstod pa brtsam par bya/ oṃ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyis/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /dpa' bo byang chub shing ⑨drung du/ /mi bzad bdud kyi sde bcom ltar3ni/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ /pham par bya phyir bla med pa'i/ /rgyal ba gsang chen dkyil 'khor bri/ /de ltar lan gsum brjod pa yis/ /der ni thim par rnam par bsam/ /de nas dkyil 'khor de nyid kyi/ /kun du bdud rtsi lnga dang ni/ /ma da 6)rna gis legs par byug /rdo rjes dri yi thig le bya/ /lha gnas go rims yo )shes par bya/ /me tog sil mas gtor bar bya/ /bskyed cing bstim dang bzhugs pa la/ /spyan drang (spedabang bskur mchod pa dang / /bstod pa la 1 sogs sngon 'gro bya/ /lha la gsol ba gdab 1 par bya/ /gnang ba byin nas bzhugs su gsol/ /rdo rje bum pa'i 82—674

mtshan nyid ldan/ /khyad par ldan pa rtsa ba yi/ /lha grangs dag dang mnyam pa 'am / /yang na nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar/ /las bum dang ni bkra shis pa'i/ /bum pa dag dang ldan pa ste/ /'di dag kha rgyan mgul chings can/ /snying po lnga dang sman lnga dang / /'bru lnga spos lnga rin chen lnga/ /chu klung chu bcas khyad par te①/ /tha dad pa dang gcig pa yi/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis sta gon bya/ /khyad par bar chad bsrung don du/ /bsrung ba'i phur bu khro bor bskyed/ /mchod bstod gnyis med ldan byas la/ /gtor ma ldan pas bka' bsgo bya/ /de nas slob ma 'jug pa'i rim/ /spro ba bskyed dang gnang ba sbyin/ /sdom pa dbog dang bsrung ba gdags / /so shing dor bar bya ba dang / /de ltas ( lung bstan ku sha las/ /sngas dang stan sbyin gzengs 5)bstod nas/ /rmi lam gdab phyir nyal du gzhug /slob mas maṇ+ḍal me tog byas/ /khrus byas phyag btsal (4)mdun gnas la/ /khyad par spro bskyed rjes 'jug bya/ /rigs kyi sdom pa sbyin par bya/ /blang ba bye brag shes par bya/ /rang gi lus tshad mnyam pa yi/ /sum sgril srad bu btsos pa yis/ /gsang sngags brjod cing bcing bar bya/ /so shing tshad ldan gtad byas pa/ /lho phyogs ngogs su maṇ+ḍal la/ /lhung ba'i rjes su brtag par bya/ /rtswa (snyemachog byin pa mi smra bar/ /seng ge'i stabs (6)kyis nyal bar bya/ /nub mo'i rmi lam ci byung ba/ /ci byung nang par smra bar gyis/ /khyad par gzengs (7nibastod nyal du gzhug /nang par rmi lam ngan (8)gyur gang / /gsang sngags sbyin sreg 5)rim pas zlog /de nas rdo rje slob dpon dang / /sgo bzhi'i phyogs kyi rnal 'byor dang / /las kyi skyes bur tsobacas pa yis/ /mchod bstod lha la gsol ba gdab(lha/ /ma lus phyogs bcur bzhugs pa yitshoste/ /dus gsum sangs 82—675

rgyas bdag la dgongs/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa 'di zhes pas/ /gsang chen dkyil 'khor 'byung ba yi/ /deng 'dir sangs rgyas kun gshegs shig /dngos grub ma lus bdag la gsol/ /zhes ni lan gsum brjod par 51bya/ /de nas las kyi cho ga ni/ /sar pa legs par bkal rin)ba dang / /tshad ldan mdzes pa'i srad bu yis/ /rang 'dod lha yi gzugs gnas pas/ /shes rab can gyis thig gdab bya/ /khyad par ye shes ldan pas ni/ /slob dpon shar lta slob ma nub/ /slob dpon lhor 'dug slob ma byang / /gnyis pa yang ni gdab par bya /tshangs pa'i thig nas brtsams nas ni/ /mkhas pas cha shas (5)gdab par bya/ /me yi phyogs su gnas pa yis/ /byang ltas shar gyi thig gdab bya/ /rlung du gnas te lhor bltas 4pas/ /nub kyi thig ni gdab par bya/ /de nyid nas ni byang ngos gdab/ /mer gnas lho phyogs thig bya zhing / /de nas rlung gi phyogs su bya/ /bden bral gnas pas dbang ldan par/ /tshad ldan rim pas gdab par bya/ /kun nas yongs su zlum po yi/ /pho brang le 95)tse dgu par bya/ /so so'i lha khyams dang bcas pa/ /sgo bzhis kun nas brgyan par dgod/ /spyi khyab pho brang nang ma la/ / le tse tshonyi shu rtsa 7lnga pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor so sor shes nga/ra bya/ /bar khyams 8la ni dkyil 'khor drug /gsang ba'i bdag po'i dkyil 'khor dang / /tshangs pa chen po'i pho brang ste/ /sum cu gsum du bri bar bya/ /bar bar shar du rdo rje dang / /'khor lo sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin kau /lhor ni nor bu rin chen 'bar/ /nub phyogs pad+ma ut+pa la/ /byang du ral gri rgya gram bcas/ /stong dag gi ni gnas yin no/ /de nas sgo bzhi rta babs bcas/ /bcu drug ka bas bteg pa yi/ /gzugs sgra dri ro lha mo dang / /82wa 676

rim pas zung du steng du dgod/ /rus 6)sbal rdo rje rgya gram bcas/ /rin chen pad+ma nor bu yis/ /spras pa bsnol ma'i stegs byed pa/ /stegs bu dag las glang chen dang / /sha ra bha dang pad+ma yi/ /lcug phran yal gar bcas pa yi/ /bkra shis dang la zung gyur pas/ /mu tig chun 'phyang (snyemadzes pas brgyan/ /de stengs (5)rin chen brtsegs pa la/ /bya khyung logs gnas phyir bltas pa'o/ /zur gnyis chu srin bsnol ma dang / /seng ge shang shang de steng du/ /ru ru gnyis dang chos 'khor che/ /gdugs dang bcas pas kun nas brgyan/ /'dod yon pañca re ga (gedang / /ba ku la yi rtsig (gepa'i gseng / /rin chen shar bu sna tshogs dang / /dra ba dra ba phyed pas brgyan/ /rin chen pha gu ba gam can//rtse mor mda' yab bkod pa la/ / kra ma shīr+ṣa'i (5)phreng ba dag /yongs su bkod pa mdzes par gyur/ /tshad med thar pa'i grong khyer gyi/ /mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs par bsam/ /de nas rin chen rnam lnga sogs/ /nor bu'i tshogs ni du ma yis/ /byin gyis brlab cing tshul shes pas/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i tshon gyis bya/ /khyad (7par sgrub cing rgyan bkod pa/ /mchod pa du mas yongs su bskor / /sgrub pa chen po slar bstan pa/ /dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas bdag 'jug bya/ /de nas slob ma 'jug don du/ /yan lag 'di dag ldan par bya/ /stod g.yogs smad g.yogs gtad pa dang / /gsol ba gdab cing gdong g.yogs bcing / /me tog phreng gzung sems bskyed cing / /don dri khas blangs (8)nang du gzhug /tshogs bsags (9ramana' bsgag dam chu blud/ /dam bsgrag bka' bsgo (1 tshoye shes dbab/ /me tog dor rjes mthong ba dri/ /spyi gtsug me tog phreng ba gdags/ /gdong g.yogs bgrol nas lha ngo bstan/ /dkyil 82—677

'khor rnam dag don bstan cing / /'dod lha ngos gzung rigs shes bya/ /'di dag cho ga rtogs par bya/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i lam 'jug pas/ /sems bskyed mchog tu dmigs ldan zhing / /tshad med blo bskyed bslab par bya/ /gsang bar ye shes rdo rjer bslab/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs dang ni/ /ye shes yon tan phrin las kyi/ /byin gyis brlab (1)pa lnga bya ste/ /rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma dang / /rin chen ral gri'i (2)spro bsdu dang / /rigs lnga lha mo lngar bcas las / /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /ma lus 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kun / /ye shes chen po'i byin brlabs (5)kyis/ /dngos grub skal ba 'bab par mdzod / /rtags dang brda dang mtshan ma kun/ /rnam pa yongs su shes par bya/ /zhi ba'am ni rgyas pa yi/ /sbyin sreg (4)nye bar dbul bar bya/ /thun mong dang ni khyad par gyi/ /phyag bya slob ma mdun gnas te/ /lha sras nyid du bskyed bya ste/ /shar nas 'jug pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /me tog phreng ba dang por sbyin/ /maṇ+ḍal me tog sngon 'gro bas/ /mdun gnas de la dbang bskur sbyin/ /byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /ji ltar che ba'i byin brlabs pa/ /bdag cag bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /gsang ba'i snying po deng bdag gsol/ /lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab/ /bla med dbang ni bskur mdzad de/ /rdo rje gsang chen dbang bskur ba/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /gnas las byung ba ( 5)sbyin par bya/ /de nas gang du rdo rje dpal mchog chen po 'dus pa gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang yang dag par bskur bar bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa stong mngon par 'byung ba de dag kyang ye shes kyi snang ba las yang dag par 'byung ba'i rdo rje rin po che'i sdong po du ma las sna tshogs pa'i pad+ma 'bar ba 82—678

du mas rgyas pa kha phye ba la seng ge'i khri dang bcas pa gsang ba 'dzin pa po dang /lha tshangs pa yang re re zhing du gnas pa las 'di lta ste/ rdo rje'i rigs nyis brgya phrag gcig dang / rin po che'i rigs nyis brgya phrag gcig dang / pad+ma'i rigs nyis brgya phrag gcig dang / las kyi rigs nyis brgya phrag gcig dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs nyis brgya phrag gcig ste/ 'di rnams de bzhin gshegs pa re re'i sku'i ba spu'i bu ga las kyang 'od zer bye ba phrag du ma byung ste/de re re las kyang sprul pa'i sku dpag tu med pa 'phros te 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du snang ba chen pos khyab nga/ra byas shing mdzad pa mtha' yas pa'i rol pa mngon par 'byung bar mdzad do/ /thams cad kyang bla na med pa'i theg pa la 'dzud par mdzad de/ mchog tu skyabs su 'gro ba ston cing 'jig rten pa'i lta ba la mngon par zhen pa dag la ni tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa'i gzugs kyis mngon par dbang skur (1)bar byed do/ /nyan thos kyi theg pa la mos pa rnams la ni chos thams cad bden pa bzhi'i sgo nas dbang skur (babar byed do/ /rang rgyal ba'i theg pa la mos pa rnams la ni rten cing 'brel pa (5)bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas dbang skur bar byed do/ /de dag gi lam dang lta ba dang spyod pa yang dag par bstan cing de dag gi tshul gyis 'dul bar byed do/ /gang du byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la mos pa rnams la ni byang chub tu sems bskyed cing de nyid kyis pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod de/ sbyin pa chen po gtong ba'i sgo nas dbang skur bar byed do/ /tshul khrims yongs su mi nyams pa'i sgo nas dbang skur bar byed do/ /bzod pa la gnas pa'i sgo nas dbang skur bar byed do/ /brtson 'grus rgyun mi 'chad ( )pa'i sgo nas dbang skur 82—679

bar byed do/ /bsam gtan gyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa'i sgo nas dbang skur bar byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid shes pas dbang skur bar byed do/ /de dag kyang tshad med grangs med pa'i nam mkha'i khams la gnas pa'i sems can thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis chos ston cing dbang skur bar byed pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la ni tshad med pa bzhi'i sgo nas chos ston cing dmigs pa thams cad dang bral ba'i tshul gyis chos thams cad la don dam pa'i bden pa rnam par dag pa'i tshul gyis dbang skur bar byed do / /chos thams cad la mi gnas pa'i kun rdzob kyi bden pa rnam par dag pa'i tshul gyis dbang skur bar byed do/ /'dir ni rin po che'i gzhal yas khang zhing khams rnam par dag par dpal longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mngon par 'byung ba'i sgo nas dbang skur bar byed do/ /bla na med pa'i sems dpa' chen po dpag tu med pa la ni thabs dang stobs dang ye shes dang smon lam rnam par dag pa'i tshul gyis phyir mi ldog pa'i lam las bcu'i rnam par dag pa'i tshul rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis yongs su dbang skur bar byed do/ /gang de sangs rgyas kyis mi 'dul 17zhing dus 95)la ma bab pa de'i tshe 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po rin po che sna bdun dang dpung chen po bzhi dang bcas pa thams cad la dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam mngon par 'byung bas bstan cing dbang skur bar byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs de dag kyang bsdus pa'i tshul gyis nyi shu rtsa lnga po re re las yang lnga lngar rigs brgya'i sgo nas dbang skur bar byed do/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rnams la ni ( tshosangs rgyas rigs lnga'i tshul gyis rin po che'i 82—680

rgyan thams cad kyis nye bar brgyan pa'i snang bas rig ma dang lha mo'i tshogs du mas 'dod pa'i longs spyod mi zad pa yongs su dag pa la dgyes pas yongs su spyod par hu)mdzad cing khro bo'i (gergyal po du ma dang / byang chub sems dpa' so so'i rigs dang bcas pas rig pa dang brtul zhugs brtan par byed pa dang /chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur (8)ba bla na med pa khyad 9)par du bstan to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs 'dus pa chen po bla na med pa la rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga'i nang du chud par gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo tshad med pa chos kyi pho brang dam par de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i bdag nyid gsang ba yongs su rdzogs pa sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las du mas (5)bdag nyid du dbang bskur (6)bar mdzad pa'i dpal rdo rje 'chang chen pos phyag mtshan dang zhal la sogs pa'i rnam par snang bar gyur pa ni 'od zer dpag tu med pa bkye (7)ba de dag tshur bsdus pas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi sku'i dkyil 'khor dang / de bzhin gshegs pa de dag so so'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par (8)snang bar byas shing 'od zer spro ba dang bsdu ba'i rim pas snying po'i dkyil 'khor du rigs kyi 'khor lo nam mkha' la gsal bar snang ba bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor dang tha dad pa med pa'i sbyor bas thams cad gnyis su med pa thabs dang shes rab kyi sbyor bas bde ba chen po'i bde ba'i sgyu ma'i sgras bkug pa'i zhing khams yongs su sbyangs pa'i sku rnams so so'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ rtsa dbu ma brgyud de yum gyi pad+mar byon/ de nas gyen du gshegs te nam mkha'i khams ma lus pa khengs pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyis dbang skur 59ribar byed do/ /de yang bar snang gi phyogs mtshams khyab par byas te/ sems can gyi khams ma lus shing 82—681

lus pa med pa thams cad la gsang ba chen po'i dbang skur 6)bar byed do/ /sangs rgyas spyan ma'i rnam pa yis/ /sa yi khams (snyernams dbang bskur te/ /rdo rje'i lus su byin gyis brlabs/ /mā ma tī yi bdag nyid kyis/ /chu yi khams la dbang bskur te( / /rdo rje dag byed byin gyis brlabs/ /la skyil gos dkar mor snang bas/ /drod kyi khams ni dbang bskur te/ /rdo rje'i 'od dpung byin gyis brlabs/ /lha mo sgrol ma'i bdag nyid kyis/ /g.yo ba dbugs la dbang bskur te/ /rdo rje skyong ( byed mar byin brlabs/ /lha mo gzugs kyi rdo rje mas/ /sna tshogs gzugs rnams dbang bskur bas/ /snang stong gnyis su med par bsgyur / /lha mo sgra yi rdo rje mas/ /sna tshogs sgra yis (9)dbang bskur bas/ /grag stong gnyis su med par gyur/ /dri yi rdo rje lha mo yis/ /sna tshogs dri yis dbang bskur 7)bas/ /gsal stong gnyis su med par gyur/ /lha mo ro yi rdo rje yis / /sna tshogs bcud len dbang bskur (nyabs/ /myong stong gnyis su med par gyur/ /lha mo reg bya rdo rje mas/ /'khor 'das reg bya'i dbang bskur bas / /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes las/ /bde stong gnyis su med par gyur6)/ /mig gi rnam shes sa snying po/ /rna ba'i rnam shes gsang 'dzin pa/ /sna la nam mkha'i snying po dang / /lce ni 'jig rten dbang phyug ste/ /lus la sgrib pa rnam par sel1 tsho/ /yid la kun du bzang pos so/ /nyon mongs can yid byams pa ste / /kun gzhi 11'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis tu ni/ /de ltar byin brlabs yonadabang bskur temi/ /rnam shes brgyad ni dag phyir ro/ /dngos por 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dag /'joms byed khro bo'i rgyal po bcus/ /tshigs tshogs dag par dbang bskur ro/ /de ltar phrin las tshul gyis ni/ /gsang ba bla na med par gyur/ /82—682

de nas yang bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos ni srid pa dang zhi ba mnyam pa nyid gnyis su med pa/ thog ma dang bar dang tha mar rgyun mi 'chad pa / chos thams cad la 'du 'bral 0)med cing tha dad par rtog pa med pa/ /'gro ba dang 'ong ba med cing rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba rnam par dag pa/dbyings dang ye shes zung du 'jug pa/ mnyam pa nyid mi gnas pa bde ba chen po'i tshul du yang dag pa'i snying po'i gsang ba chen po'i dbang bskur bar gyur to//'di ltar yang dag pa dbang bskur ba 'di bstan pa na so so'i skye bo bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag bcus mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i don la gnas par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed bcus tshe de nyid la 'jig rten gyi khams 'og min de nyid du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brjod kyis mi lang ba'i yang brjod kyis mi lang ba rnams 'jig rten gyi khams bsam gyis mi khyab par sku gsum gyi rol mo mngon par ston cing mi zad pa'i ngang las yang dag par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang / 'dzam bu'i gling bye ba phrag brgya'i bar du yang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug du ma'i skur bstan nas thogs pa med par de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du mngon par spyod par mdzad do/ /de nas gsang ba 'dzin pa pos/ /gsang chen ye shes dbang bskur ba/ /mnyam nyid bde ba chen po yis/ /ye shes dri med dbang bskur ba'o/ /rdo rje dang ni dril bu dang / /cod pan nyi shu rtsa lnga yis(mi / /rig pa'i dbang ni ston par mdzodadzo ri/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin par gyur/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' che/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtsor gyur pa'i/ /mi (4)bskyod rang byung byang chub sems/ /rdo rje rigs kyi dbang bskur ba'o/ /82—683

dpal ldan rnam par snang mdzad 'od/ /'khor lo 'dus pa'i rgyal chen por/ /rdo rje rtag pa ye shes can/ /de bzhin gshegs pas dbang bskur ro/ /dpal ldan yid bzhin gter 'chang ba/ /dbang phyug chen po chags pa med/ /rin chen 'byung gnas nor bu 'dzin/ /rin chen rigs kyi dbang bskur ro/ /dpal ldan pad+ma 'bar ba'i mdangs/ /rab 'bar rgyal ba'i spyan 'chang ba/ /'od dpag med pa thub pa che/ /pad+ma rigs kyi dbang bskur ro/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas phrin las sku/ /ye shes rgyal po sgyu 'phrul che/ /gdon mi za ba thogs pa med/ /las kyi rigs kyi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a dhi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca sa ma ya shri (1)ye hūm̐/ oṃ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi tikhri rin7badz+ra bud+dha a bhi ṣiñca sa ma ya shri 55)ye rgyu(4sku/ oṃ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi tiṣ+ṭha (5nibadz+ra rat+na 67a bhi ṣiñca sa ma ya shri ( )ye ishun/ oṃ na maḥ(9) sarba ta thā ga ta a rnyi tiṣ+ṭha 1rtabadz+ra pad+ma a bhi ṣiñca sa ma ya shri tsho1ye hrīḥ i na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi tiṣ+ṭha 1rtabadz+ra kurma a bhi ṣiñca sa ma ya shri nyu ye khaṃ/ de yang chu'i dus su ni mi bskyod pa'i bum pa'i chus bkru bar byed do/ /rin chen gyi ni me tog phreng ba rna ltag g.yas par ro/ /pad+ma yi ni bum pa rdo rje dang bcas pa'o/ /las kyi ni rol mo sna tshogs sgrogs pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ni bkra shis du ma'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan gyi 1 ni dbu rgyan kertse lnga pa nyid do/ / rdo rje 7mi bskyod pa ni bum chus char dbab pa'o/ /pad+ma'i ni rdo rje bum pa'i steng du bcas pa'o/ /las kyi 1 ni sgra sgrogs pagle/ /brtag pa'i bkra shis brjod pa nyid do/ /snang ba mtha' yas kyi ni rtso rje 'bar ba gtad pa'o/ /rdo rje'i ni khrus char ro rin po che'i 18ni me tog rab tu gtor ba'o/ /las kyi ni sgra brnyan gyi tshogs so/ /82—684
