sangs rgyas kyi ni gsang sngags brjod pa'o/ /don yod grub pa ni dril bu gtad pa'o / /rdo rje'i ni khrus char ro/ /rin po che'i 6)ni me tog char ro/ /pad+ma'i (mini rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lo mas so/ /sangs rgyas kyi (7ni tshigs su bcad pa brjod pa'o/ /rnam par snang mdzad kyi (4)ni gsang mtshan gdags pa'o/ /rin chen gyi (zheni me tog spyi bor ro/ /pad+ma'i rdo rje mgo thog tu'o/ /las kyi 56)ni dril bu mgo thog tu'o/ /rdo rje ni rdo rje dril bu bsnol bas mgo thog bzhag cing bum chus gtor ba nyid do/ /de ltar rigs kyi dbye bas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar du rab tu shes par bya ba nyid do/ /gsang sngags dang / rig (7)sngags dang gzungs sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi sku sna tshogs pa lta (8)bas ni kun du sku'i dbang ngo / /gsang sngags dang rig (9 sngags dang gzungs sngags du ma'i sngags brjod pa dang sgra du mas yini kun du gsung gi dbang ngo / /gsang sngags dang rig 17sngags dang gzungs sngags kyi snying po dang ting nge 'dzin du mas ni kun du thugs kyi dbang ngo / /chos kyi rgyal po mngon par thob par 'dod pas ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /gsang ba'i dam tshig sbyin par 1gebya'o/ /spyod pa brtsam par 'dod pa la ni brtul zhugs kyi dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /sems can kun la phan bya'i phyir/ /'jig rten khams ni stong dag tu/ /ji ltar thabs kyis 'dul gyur pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /gzhan dag drug dang bla ma ni/ /dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /chos gos ri dgas rna ba ltar/ /mar me mdzad dpal phyag rgya las/ /gsang ba chen po'i tshul bstan pas/ /'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te/ /thub pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtso/ /rkang gnyis gtso bor 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mi 'jigs phyag rgya sbyin mdzad de/ /82—685

dngos po mchog tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro 6)rnams las bton/ /dbang mchog thob pa tsam gyis ni/ /slob ma yon tan bdag por gyur/ /khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /rgyal ba'i bdag por bstan pa dang / /der ni bdud las rnam rgyal zhing / /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yis/ /deng 'dir sangs rgyas nyid thob par/ /khyed rnams the tshom med pa yin/ /de nas gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rig ma rnam par (gegazhug bya zhing / /bla na med pa'i bla ma las/ /bdud rtsi dag pa'i blo blang bya/ /thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba yis( sku / /bde ba'i byang chub sems kyi rgyun/ /rang 'bab ye shes bcud kyis (4)len / /'chi med ye shes dbang bskur ba/ /ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis / /byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar/ /de bzhin byang chub sems bzang pos/ /bu khyod dbang ni bskur bar bya/ /de nyid longs spyod rtsal sbyangs te/ /gsung gi rdo rje rab bsgrub phyir/ /rtog med bde ba'i gnas las skyes / /dri med gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /de nas rig ma'i dbye ba ni/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dbye ba yis/ /glang po can dang ri dgas ma/ /dung can ma dang sna tshogs can/ /pad+ma can ni rim shes pas/ /phyag rgya'i dbang ni thob byed yin / /las kyi phyag rgya ma shes rab ma ste/ lo bcu gnyis ma 'am/ brgyad gnyis ma 'am/ bcu gnyis gnyis ma'i rim pa ste/ de yang gnas dang nye ba'i gnas la sogs par skyes pa 'am/ sngon gyi smon lam rnam par dag pa'i stobs las grub cing ye shes kyi rgyu mthun las byung ba 'am/ dbus kyi yul du skyes pa/dbang po tshang batshor/ yan lag nying lag yongs su rdzogs shing mtshan dang ldan pa/dbang bskur ba thob cing sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes pa las a ba dhū (6)khri ston 82—686

pa 'am/ ston pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor ma de las kun 'dar 91)gyi sna rtse las bskyod pa'i bde ba las dga' ba dang / mchog dga' dang dga' bral dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba las ye shes mngon sum du nyams su myong ba skyed cing / de las thob pa des snang grags brtan g.yo ma lus pa la rgyas btab pa'i ye shes ro gcig ( pa'i ngang du rtag tu gnas par bya/ des ni gsang ba'i spyod pa la gnas na shin tu myur ba nyid du rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub par byed do/ /chos kyi phyag rgya ni 'od kyi rig ma las byung ba rang snang ba'i lha mo las rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya chen po ni lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes byin brlabs (55)bla ma'i brgyud pa las thob par byed do/ /dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni thabs dang shes rab mi phyed pa'i ye shes las 'da' ba med par spyod pa ste/gsang ba zab dang rgya che ba'i/ /ye shes rab tu mi gnas pa/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong ro gcig tu/ /bla med gsang chen dbang bskur ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs ( pa thams cad kyi/ /sras bcas 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dpal mchog 'dir ni gang bstan pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i spyod yul du/ /rigs kyi dbye ba bsdus pa'i lam/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i khyad par gang / /bya ba spyod pa'i tshul kun gyi/ /rgyud sde sna tshogs lha rnams kyi/ /dbang bskur rab tu thob pas na/ /gnyis su med pa'i rgyal zhes brjod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 5 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las dbang bskur ba chen po tshad med pa rdo rje'i le'u ste drug cu brgyad pa'o// //82—687

de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /gsang ba dag (1)pa'i tshul gnas te/ /phrin las sna tshogs sbas pa yi/ /de nyid (5)rab tu bstan pa'o/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi gsang ba'i dbang chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyod pa'i tshul yang dag par dbang bskur ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin mi phyed pa ste/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba la spyod pa de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sras thu bor gyur pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' (kyernams kyis grogs tshangs par tsho4)mtshungs par spyod par blta ste/ khro bo'i rgyal po du mas ni yang dag par srung bar byed do/ /lha mo'i tshogs rgya mtshos ni kun nas de la yongs su mchod par byed/ tshangs pa dang / brgya byin dang / dbang phyug chen po dang /khyab 'jug dang / gu lang la sogs pa du ma lha ma srin sde brgyad dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa du ma rnams kyis yongs su bsrung ba dang bskyab (5༄pa dang mchod pa'i rten du byed la/ dngos po phun sum tshogs pa sgrub tsho par byed do/ /de'i phyir de'i gnas kyi sems bskyed pa rdo rje lta bu yin te/ 'di nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams kyis ji lta ba bzhin du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi snying por bla na med par gnas pa kun du bzang po'i spyod pa ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mtha' yas pa la gnas pa/ dkyil 'khor du ma'i sgo nas sems can gyi bsam pa rdzogs par bya ste/ gdul bya'i 977'gro ba'i tshogs ma lus pa rnams la spyod pa'i rab tu dbye ba'i sgo mang po tshad med pa bstan pas yang dag par mgu bar bya ba dang / yang dag par dga' bar bya ba dang / yang dag par dbugs dbyung 82—688

ba dang / gzengs 6)bstod pa dang / lung bstan pa thob par byed pas 'bras bu'i lam las mngon par dga' bas rgyas par byed pa'o/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor bzhugs/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtsor gyur pas/ /yang dag ye shes mtshan nyid can/ /gnyis med mnyam pa nyid sbyor bas/ /sna tshogs du ma las 'phro ba/ /'jig rten khams ni ma lus par / /dpag med 'od zer tshogs las ni/ /dbang bskur gyur pa'i lhag pa'i lha / /'gro ba kun gyi rang bzhin gyis/ /lus ngag yid la gnas nas ni/ /ye shes rdo rje'i rgyun (shelas ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /dbyer med ngo bo nyid gcig pa/ /bde ba chen po'i ngang bzhugs pas/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga las / /mnyam par sbyar ba'i yan lag gis/ /bde dang bde chen lhan cig skyes / /dpal mchog rang byung phyag rgya che/ /'di las bcom ldan 'das bdag byed / /sangs rgyas rol pa bsam mi khyab/ /yang dag dbang ni skur byed pa/ /de nyid bla ma yin par brjod/ /'dir (snyedabang skur ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /slob dpon de las gces pa yi/ /srog ni gzhan du yod ma yin/ /rdo rje byang chub sems nyid dang / /tha dad med phyir bla ma ni/ /rgyun du mchod cing bsten byar gsungs/ /dngos po thams cad yongs su ni/ /bla ma la ni nges par dbul / /'dis ni dngos grub ma lus pa'i/ /'byung gnas de bzhin gshegs par bstan/ /dpal ldan dbus kyi gnas gyur pa/ /'khor lo mchog gi 'khor lo nyid/ /bla ma mchog la dus rtag tu/ /spyi bos btud de phyag byar 'os/ /'di ni spyod pa bstan pa la/ /zab pa yi ni spyod pa dang / /de bzhin rgya che ba yi tshul/ /gnyis med bde ba chen po yis/ /brtul zhugs tshul 'di bstan 82—689

pa'o / /lha mo nyi shu'i bdag nyid kyis/ /'dod pa'i yon tan kun rol pa/ /'dir ni rgya cher gyur pa ste/ /stong chen rab tu 'joms ma dang / /so sor 'brang tshotshodang rma bya che/ /tshal 'dzin ma dang rjes 'dzin ma/ /tsun da (midang ni ral gcig ma/ /nor rgyun ma dang rin chen sgron/ /'od zer can dang dug sel ma/ /ri khrod lo ma can dang ni/ /gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma ( )dang / /mtha' yas sgo dang rdo rje lcags sgrog (4rim/ /shes rab 'phel byed las sgrib sel/ /ye shes mi zad za ma tog /sangs rgyas chos kyi mdzod dang ni/ /ku ru kul+le gdugs dkar 95 mo/ /'di dag gzungs kyi lha mor brjod/ /zab pa'i (nyaspyod tshul bla na med/ /lha mo dgu dang lhan cig tu/ /gsang 4)ba'i ye shes rol pa ni / /mgon po kun du spyod (8pa'o/ /gnyis med ye shes bde ba che/ /lha mo lnga dang bcas pa yi/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'dus pa ni/ /mnyam bzhag (94)chen po'i spyod pa yin/ /'di dag spros bcas spyod pa dang / /spros med ye shes tshul gyur pa/ /1 shin tu spros pa med pas ni/ /'dod dang bsam pa 'jug pa dang //dus kyi khyad par rnam dbye bas/ /bhu su ku dang kun du bzang / /rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyod pa yis/ /nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs dag /tshar bcad pa dang rjes 'dzin gyi/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba yi/ /brtan g.yo dbang du sdud 11pa'i phyir/ /bag med 'tshe ba rnam spangs pasakyi thams cad sgyu ma'i tshul sbyor ba1ni/ /stong nyid ye shes shes rab mas/ /khyogs dang brlabs dang khyung lding dang / / bkal ba 'dang ni bskyod pa yis/ /tshangs par spyod dang bde bar rol/ /de nas gsang ba'i tshul gnas ma/ /rdzogs par rlung gi rnal 'byor bslab/ /rnal 'byor rtag tu mnyam bzhag skalas/ /82wa 690

'jug pa'i rlung ni bgrang bya zhing / /ji srid 'bum gyi bar du ni/ /sgra dang bral bar rtag tu bzlas/ /sgrub pos sgra dang bral bar 6)ni/ /'bum bzlas yongs su rdzogs pa na/ /'chi bdag 'joms par 'gyur ba ste/ /ye shes lnga yi bar dag tu/ /'chi ba bslus par the tshom (5)med/ /rtag tu nang par tho (5)rangs dus / /stong phrag gcig tu chags (gemed par/ /de nyid rdo rje bzlas byas pas/ /bar du gcod las bzlogs (5)pas na(6)/ /de phyir rlung gi rnal 'byor la/ /kun du mnyam bzhag gnas par bya/ /de nyid bum pa can bcings pas/ /bdud las rnam par rgyal ba 'thob/ /de nyid rig pas lus kun las/ /lus kyi khong stong rtsa sbubs dag /rlung gis nges par dag rigebyas pas/ /de nyid rngub pa dang bcas pas/ /khyad par 'joms pa rlung gi las/ /dbu ma nyid du gnas pa ni//'byung ba zag pa med pa dang / /shin tu bde ba skyed byed yin/ /rlung gis sems ni skyon (8)med par/ /rab zhi 'byung ba ldog pa dag /gcig tu gnas par byed pa'i las/ /'di ni rnal 'byor lam du gsungs/ /sgo lnga'i rlung ni bsdu ba yang / /dbang po nang du zlog pa las/ /phyi rol nye bar dmigs mi 'gyur / /'di ni yid kyi rlung zin pa'o/ /g.yo bcas rnams la rengs byed pa/ /srog ni brtan pa'i tshul gyis su/ /'gyur ba med par gyur pa gang / /snang ba'i rlung ni brtan pa'o/ /brtan pa'i yal ga rlung gi lam/ /rab tu gtod pa'i (9risbyor ba yis/ /srog rtsol 'bog par gyur pa na/ /g.yo med brtan pa nus pa thob / /tshad dang grangs las 'das pa yi/ /mnyam meng kun 'dar samar gnas pas/ /rtog pa ma lus nub pa'i tshe/ /nyon mongs bdud las rgyal ba nyid / /rtog pa kun las mi g.yo ba/ /de nyid ye shes rgyal ba che/ / skyil krung nyu182—691

gcig la gnas byas te/ /byang chub shing la rgyab rten nas/ /mnyam bzhag nye bar bcings pa la1)/ /bsdams grol khyad med gyur pa dang / /kha zas gos kyi rtsol med pa(2ri/ /phung po'i bdud las rgyal ba yin/ /rlung ni rgyu ba mi tshor dang / /dbu mar 'byung ba brtan pa yis/ /dngos rnams sgyu mar mthong ba yis / /lha yi bu yi bdud las rgyal/ /rang rig ye shes kyis dag pa/ /nyon mongs dug gsum rlung dag la/ /tshar bcad pas ni 'jig rten lha'i/ /gzugs dag 'gas par byed pa yin/ /rjes gzung (5)bas ni slar sdud pa/ /gcig tu byed pa 'di las 'grub/ /nang du zla ba'i rlung bzung nas/ /'khrul 'khor drag spyod gtum pa can/ /ā li las byung dag pa las/ /zla bas 'pho bar mi nus so/ /gsang ba bzlog pa'i ting 'dzin las/ /chu tshod lnga yi bar dag tu/ /nyi ma'i rlung la kā li yis/ /bcings pas nyi ma 'pho mi 'gyur/ /gzung 4ridang 'dzin pa rnam bral bar/ /rags (5)pa sgra zhes bshad pa nyid/ /phra ba sems kyi rnam pa las/ /rnam rtog ri bo bcom pa'i phyir/ /phyi rol ri bo 'joms pa dang / /thal bar yang ni byed nus pa/ /bsam pa phun sum tshogs pas so/ /dug gsum las ni rang bzhin rnams/ /log rtog dri ma ma 6)lus pa//gzhom byed mi g.yor gnas byas nas/ /dpung chen dengs (7)par the tshom med/ /'khor ba'i chos nyid spangs pa na/ /dug nyid bdud rtsir (8)sgyur ba dang / /rang byung bdud rtsi sbyangs gyur pas/ /bkres skom med par 'gyur ba yin/ /bsam pa rnam par dag gyur la/ /dug sbrul 'tshe bar mi 'gyur te6nye/ /de las gzhan du bzlog pa yis/ /dug sbrul gzhan la spong bar byed/ /shin tu khros par gyur nas kyang / /klu rnams la ni bka' bsgo bas/ /log par lta ba'i rgol 82wa 692

ba kun/ /dug sprul chen pos za bar (1)'gyur/ /gal te dad gyur de dag la/ /ting 'dzin spo (miba'i sbyor ba yis/ /dug rnams skad cig gcig gis sel/ /ye shes rlung las gyur pa yi/ /'pho med mi chod rdo rje las/ /sems can gdug pa'i srog ( )chags che/ /stag sogs kha ni 'ching bar byed/ /gang du thabs dang shes rab las/ /mnyam sbyor khu ba'i rnam pa ni/ /btsun mo'i bha ga de las ni/ /bskyil dang bzlog pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /gang gā la ri sogs chu bo rnams/ /gang zhig bzlog ste 'bab par gyur/ /rtsa gsum las ni byung ba dang / /rtsa phran gzhan las 'bab pa dag55ni /gal te bzlog par gyur pa dag /shin tu chu bo skems par byed/ /srid rtse la 6sogs 'jig rten pa'i/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin gnas byas la/ /de nyid stong par bcug na ni/ /lha chen dag kyang 'jig 'gyur la/ /gzhan du a rdza ka bzhin byed/ /de nyid du ni gsang chen gyi / /phrin las phran tshegs bstan pa ste/ /rgyud kun du ni ma bstan cing / /sbas pa lkog tu gyur pa yin/ /gzung 'dzin rtsa las rlung 'jug pas/ /'khor ba'i srid pa skyed par mdzad/ /yang dag kun 'dar nyid gnas na/ /rnam grol zhi ba mchog thob 'gyur/ /lte ba'i gnas su srid zhi dag /sna tshogs 'dus par 'byung gnas te/ /rtsa bcings lha yi bu yi bdud/ /'byung po bye ba la 57)sogs pa/ /phyi rol du ni 'dul bar mdzad 5ni/ /skyon dag yon tan gyur pas na/ /mtshon cha'i char la 9 sogs pa yang / /rin chen me tog dag tu 'bab / /sdug bsngal bde bar shar ba'o/ /snying gar yang dag yongs gsol 10bar / /mtshan ma'i rtog pa nus 17gyur pas/ /yid bcings pas ni phyi rol du/ /nyon mongs dri mas mi gos pa/ /spangs pa rnam dag lam gnas pas/ /nyon 82—693

mongs bdud ni bcom pa'i phyir/ /mnyam pa nyid du bzhugs pa las/ /rnam par bskyod 17pa mi mnga' ba'o/ /mgrin par longs spyod yongs grub pas/ /rlung bcings pas ni ro drug la/ /longs spyod bkres rgud mi mnga' ba/ /gnod pa sna tshogs zil gnon 95)cing / /yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs 'byung zhing / /phung po'i bdud las rgyal bas ni(gu/ /mdangs dang 'od zer lhag par 'byin / /rlung 'bog zag med gnas thob pa'o/ /spyi bo gtsug tor 'byung gnas der/ /thig le 'gyur ba med brtan pas/ /'chi zhi)bdag bdud las rgyal ba ste/ /dge ba ye shes dri med lam/ /mthar phyin rnam par rol pa yi/ /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /bcings pa med cing grol (5)med la(6)/ /'gyur ba med par bzhugs pa'o/ /nyi khri dang ni chig ⑦stong dang / /drug brgya bcas pas 8)rlung dag na9/ /thams cad dbu mar thim pa ni/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa thob/ /steng dang 'og tu rgyu ba'i rlung / /kha sbyor du ni gyur pa las / /sbyor ba de la goms byed na/ /des ni 'od gsal go 'phang gnas/ /gang gi rnal 'byor spangs pa dang / /rlung gi rnal 'byor spong byed pa/ /des ni bde ba mi 'thob cing / /skyes bu tha shal de dag brlag /dus kun du ni g.yo ba yi/ /rlung la rnam par goms pas ni/ /lus sems gnas rnams byin brlabs 1 7phyir/ /kun du son (1par gyur pa'o/ /de las bde dang sdug bsngal dang / /mtho ris ngan song gar 'jug pa/ /lus kyi sgo nas 'pho ba nyid/ /rang dbang du ni 'byung bar bstan/ /snying ga'i rtsa yi yan lag ni/ /brgyad po bkra shis yan lag gyur/ /de nyid lha mo lus gnas pas/ /dpal be'u la yonasogs mdzes par byed/ /mgrin yi pa'i gnas su skyes pa yi/ /rtsa yi yan lag 82wa 694

'byung ba las/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang / /las kyi rigs las byung ba yi/ /sems dpa' bzhi bzhir yang dag 'byung / /de nyid 6)rnal 'byor rgyud du bstan / /lte bar mngon par 'byung ba yi/ /rtsa yi ljon shing 'dab (gergyas pa/ /rdo rje rigs kyi pho nya mo/ /drug cu rtsa bzhir 'byung ba'o/ /spyi bo'i gnas su skyes pa yi/ /tshul ni yang dag (gsum cu gnyis/ /mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis dag /yul dang yul du 'byung ba yin/ /nang du dbu ma'i khong stong du/ /du ba lta bu'i snang ba 'char/ /de las rnam par mngon gyur pas/ /gnod pa sra ba'i skyon bral te/ /rtsig ④pa dag la mi rdug ste/ /bar snang bzhin du thogs pa med / /nang du dbu mar rang byung ba'i/ /smig rgyu lta bu 'char ba ni/ /brtan pas lus la dbang thob byed/ /chu la sa bzhin bya ba la/ /nges pa nyid du mngon par 'byung / /kun 'dar ma yi stong pa der/ /'byung ba me yi rang bzhin las/ /srin bu me khyer mthong gyur pa/ /'bar ba de nyid brtan (5)pa las / /bsregs kyang mi 'tshig grogs su 'char/ /brgyal bar gyur pa'i bde bar 'gyur/ /dbu ma'i khang pa'i mthongs su ni/ /mar me 'bar ba gang gis mthong / /phyi nang rten 'brel 'dzom pa na56)/ /sna tshogs rlung gi stobs chen gyis / /bskyod par mi nus phrin las te/ /gal te myur bar ye shes 'gro/ /gal te a ba dhū tī'i (7)nang / /gzhal yas ye shes dag pa der/ /thams cad nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /stong pa nyid du 'char ba la/ /ye shes sprin med nam mkha' ltar/ /chags med mkha' /na kyil lding bar 'gyur/ /bu ga dgu nas rgyu ba'i rlung / /rnal 'byor pas ni mnyam zin pas/ /byung ri9)ba spangs pas gnas pa nyid / /de tshe dri chen dri chu dang / /ngar snabs mi 'byung stobs su 'gyur/ /82—695

sku yi 1rdo rje'i rtags yin no/ /gang du lus kyi 'byung ba bzhi/ /me rlung mgrin (5par brtan gyur pas/ /de nyid du ni sprul pa dang / /stod las me 'bar 'od zer stod/ /dgug pa'i las kyis 'grub pa yin/ /chu rlung snying gar brtan pa las/ /'byung ba chu ru 'bab byed cing / /kun du sdud par byed pa dang / /zhi ba smad canas chu 'brub 'char/ /rlung gi rlung ni lte ba ru/ /mnyam par zin na phyi rol du/ /du mar sprul par nus pa dang / /rdo rje rkang mgyogs nyid thob byed / /sa yi rlung ni gsang gnas su/ /zin pa de la ri bo ltar/ /mi g.yo skyil krung 5mi phyed cing / /glang po lta bu'i nus par 'gyur/ /de nyid srog dang rtsol ba ru/ /rab tu thim phyed 6cirdo rje yin/ /snying gi rtsa mdud grol ba las/ /pad+ma'i 'dab 7ltar rgyas par byed/ /smin mtshams gnad kyi sgo phye nas/ /mdzod spu kun du 'byung bar byed/ /'dis ni 'gro ba'i lus kun la/ /'jug pa rdzu 'phrul cher ston to/ /'phel bar byed pa'i rlung gis ni/ /yon tan rgyas pa'i gter thob pas/ /bum pa bzang rin po grub pa'o/ /yon tan dri ma med pa'i rlung / /sna tshogs lha mo rol pa can/ /bcu drug phrag ni bzhi dag tu/ /brgya phrag gnyis dang nyi shu lnga/ /de las kun du spyod pa yis/ /gnod sbyin mo la sogs pa 'grub/ /'dir ni bdud rtsi bcud len du/ /nyams pa med pas dbang thob pas/ /mi snang bar ni byed pa yi/ /rdo rje bcud len mchog yin no / /rtog pa'i tshogs ni bde don du/ /mi rtog ye shes rgyal po ru/ /bsgyur ba rlung gis byed pa can/ /gser 'gyur rtsi yi 9tshomachog tu 'gyur/ /gang du dngos po yongs bsgyur nas/ /bde ba chen por spyod pa can/ /mi ro lus las dngos grub brten/ /ye shes ro langs dngos grub yin/ /chos kun sgrib med 82—696

rang gsal du/ /rgyu 'bras mtshan nyid don spyod pas0ni/ /sa 'og gter mthong sa le ba/ /dngas pa'i ting 'dzin ngang las byung / /ting 'dzin ye shes log rtog la/ /rnam gcod ral gri'i dngos grub ste/ /gar 'dod dbang phyug grub pa'i rgyal/ /'dir ni rlung sems sbyangs pas 'grub/ /dpag tshad bye ba'i pha rol du/ skad cig gis phyin nyi zer zhon/ /dngos po du ma'i snang ba la/ /sgyu mas sprul pa cher ston pas/ /mchil lham dngos grub phra mo yin/ /rags napa mchog ni mkha' la spyod/ /gang du rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas/ /mkha' la brten )pa'i pho brang las/ /dag pa'i tshul gyur lus kyis ni/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i gzhal med la/ /khyad par mkha' spyod zhes brjod do/ /sa 'og lha min phug stong las/ /gang du brgyud pa rnyed nas ni/ /ri rab la ni mngon 'dzegs nas/ /gnas pa thun mong mkha' spyod de/ /gzhan du rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi/ / skyil krung 4rdo rjer sangs rgyas pa/ /snying po mi 'gyur 'byung 5gnas yin/ /gnas gzhan longs spyod 'phags pa'i yul/ /ri rab zhes bya mi yi lus/ /'byung ba bzhis ni bsdus pa dag ne /rin chen sna bzhi'i rang bzhin can / /sum cu rtsa gnyis dkyil 'khor ba'i/ /lha tshogs dag tu gyur pa ste/ /de yi rdul phran lus las byung / /de nyid rten dang brten ri par bcas de snyed bcas par yang dag 'byung / /dur khrod brgyad dang bcas par ni/ /'khor /yug 'jig rten sprul pa dag /nges par 'byung ba bstan pa yin/ /dbugs rgyu zhes bya'i rig pa ni/ /dur khrod du ni mgon po rol/ /phyi nang spyod pa'i dbye ba yis/ /lus kyi gnas su kun du rol/ /mar me'i rtse dang rab 'bar bcas/ /chu bo'i rgyun ni 'bab pa'o/ /rtsa ni rgyas pa zhing skyong la/ /82wa 697

rlung bcu phyogs bcur gnas pa las/ /phyogs mtshams dbye bas phye ba yin/ /shing ni rdo rje can gyi rtsa/ /drung ni spros pa med pa ste/ /byang chub 'od gsal zhes bya ba/ /rtsa ni dbu ma nyid las sten6)/ /rten dang brten (9par bcas pa dang / /srid zhi mnyam par spyod pa'o/ /'gro ba kun la khyab pa yi/ /bla med byang chub sems kyi mthus/ /zhe sdang gi ni gnyen po ches/ /khyab 'jug 'dul bar mdzad pa'o/ /bdag nyid phung po khams dang ni/ /skye mched lha ru gsal ba las/ /'dod chags rtog pa dang bral ba'i/ /dbang phyug chen po 'dul ba'o / /tha mal rtog pa dag nas ni/ /zhen med sku ru gnas pa yis/ /tshangs pa'i rgyal po 'dul dbyed pa/ /gti mug dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /rdo rje ra ba la sogs pas/ /brgya byin la sogs phyogs skyong bcu/ /nges par 'dul mdzad bsrung ba che/ /bka' yi 'khor lo bstan pa yin/ /tshad med bzhi ni goms pa yi / /ye shes mthu yis skar mda' gtong / /'di yis dga' rab dbang phyug ni / /phrag dog bcom pas de bzhin gshegs/ /'jig rten 'jig (brten las 'das pa/ /gsang ba 'dir ni mngon brjod pas/ /'dir ni skyes bu gang 'jug pa/ /blo gros ldan pas chos 'byung ba'i/ /kun du bzang po nges par ni//'gro ba'i don du bstan pa yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las las phran tshegs (murabastan pa dang spyod pa bstan pa'i le'u ste drug cu (6)dgu pa'o// //de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis mchod(7)/ /82—698

sangs rgyas kun bdag mchog mkhyen pas/ /gsang ba'i ye shes bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par6)/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /dpag tshad brgya yi khyon tsam du/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsam pa yis / /dkyil 'khor gyi ni ngos re zhing / /dpag tshad re (gyel cha chen te/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dbye ba yis/ /logs re la ni gnas pa ste/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i dpal mchog las/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor che/ /rnam par mkhas pas rtag par yang / /rigs rnams rab tu dgod bya ba/ /sangs rgyas dang ni lha mo dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor ba/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje la sogs dang / /khro bo'i rgyal po (5)bzhir bcas pa'i/ /so so'i dbu mas gyur pa yi / /'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor dgod par bya/ /re re zhing du rigs kyi bdag /gsang ba rigs kyi bdag po yis/ /rgyas gdab dkyil 'khor khyad par bya/ /lha rnams khyams ④la dgod pa ni/ /khro bo drug dang bcas pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis las bsdus pa yi/ /tshangs pa dang ni gsang 'dzin gyis/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag 'byung bas na/ /sum cu rtsa gsum brjod pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stong dag ni/ /dbus su nye bar gzigs pa gang / /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang / /ral gri 'bar bas khyab pa dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor lo ni/ /phyogs bzhir khyab par gnas pa ste/ /shin tu rgya che'i rnam (5)pa yis /dpag tshad bye ba'i khyon tsam du/ /gru bzhi shin tu gsal ba yi/ /mdzes pa rta babs dang ldan pa'i/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i pho (6)brang las/ /mchod rten rin chen sna bzhi pa/ /'od zer phreng bas rnam brgyan pa/ /gsal zhing rang bzhin dri ma med/ /dam pa'i rigs ni brgya la sogs/ /gsang ba rab tu mchod pa'i 82—699

phyir / /shes rab can gyis gnas su bsam/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams kyis / /de la mchod pa rgya mtsho dbul/ /de nyid phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /rim pas rab tu phye ba yi/ /phyogs dang dus kyis gnas pa yi/ /lha mo drug brgya bdun cu dang / /rtsa lnga yi ni mchod pa nyid/ /nges par bsdus pas nyis 6)'gyur du/ /rin chen na bza' la sogs pas/ /byang chub 'dod pas rtag tu mchod / /ye shes rgya namatsho dus gsum gyi/ /gnas de yin par ①rnam par bsam / /bdag ni thugs 94)ka'i sa bon las/ /mchod pa'i sprin rnams spros nas ni/ /nye bar gsang ba'i rim pa yis/ /mchod pa rnam pa lnga rnams kyis/ /rtag tu lus kyi lha rnams mchod/ /de nas de nyid 'dus pa yi/ /snying po bskul ba 5brjod par bya/ /gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi/ /khams kyi sangs rgyas thams cad kun/ /so so'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du/ /dpag med bye ba la gnas te/ /ye shes mngon par ston mdzad kyang / /mi zad khams kyi ye shes las / /'dod yon sgyu mar rol pa yis/ /yongs su spyad pa spyod byed pa/ /de nyid rnam par mi rtog pas/ /bskul ba med pas mi g.yor bzhugs/ /gang du gsang ba la spyod pa'i/ /rig 'dzin mngon par brtson gyur la/ /spyan ras kyis ni mi gzigs te/ /gang du snyomangon par mi 'tsho la/ /kye nya ma rigs kyi bu 'di dag /gsang ba de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /gsang chen spyod pa'i tshul gnas la/ /yongs su rdzogs par gyur to zhes/ /spyod pa med phyir rgyu 'di ru/ /snying po rab tu bskul bar bya/ /gang du mi mjed la sogs pa/ /bye ba phrag ni brgyar gnas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas chos 'dzin rgyal po ni/ /sprul pa'i skur ni gyur pa yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig la/ /dmigs pa tshig gi lam brjod 82—700

pas / /gsang sngags mchog gi snying po yi/ /snying po rab tu gsang ba gsungs/ /gzugs kyi khams nyid oṃ du bsdu/ /'dod khams kyi ni ā lho)las te/ /gzugs med rtsu du brjod par bya/ /khams gsum bdag nyid gcig pa'i ngang / /mchog gi khyad par gsang ba yi/ /snying po bskul ba nyid yin no/ / rgyal ba (snyede bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i 'byung gnas nyid/ /sku gsung thugs ni ro gcig tu/ /dam tshig la ni dmigs par gsungs/ /spyod yul byung ba oṃ yin te/ /dmigs pa med pa āḥyin no/ /mi shigs hūm̐ du gyur pa'i phyir/ /tha dad med pa'i spyod pa'o( ra/ /'di ni longs spyod rdzogs sku yi/ /snying po mchog tu bskul bar gsungs/ /gsang ba rigs kun bdag po yi/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po la/ /mi g.yo gnas med rtag pa las/ /gcig tu gyur byed don du ni/ /gsang ba sku yi cadango bo oṃ/ /dri med 'byung ba skye med āḥ/ /rtog med stong nyid ye shes hūm̐/ /sku gsung rirathugs kyi rdo rje ni/ /mi phyed gcig gyur lam 'di las/ /rgyun mi 'chad du bskul gyur na/ /zhag bdun gyis ni nyer 'grub ste/ /dam pa'i rigs ni brgya dag gis/ /thun mong (5)ma yin gnas pa'o / /ye shes yongs su dag pa'i gnas/ /sku yi snying po rab tu bskul no/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor bye brag tu/ /rang gi rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /ma 'dres dag par bskyed pa las/ /rnam par snang bar ston pa'o/ /de nyid rigs ni lnga dag gi / /rnal 'byor yongs su spyod pa las/ /bla med phyag rgya chen po'i gnas/ /gsung gi snying po bskul gyur pas/ /tshad med byang chub ngang las bskul/ /'di ni dam tshig chen po yin/ /mchog tu gsang ba bdag med pas/ /sa gsum du ni khyab pa yis/ /bde ba lhan cig skyes par bskul/ /de nyid dbyer 82wa 701

med sgyu ma'i lam/ /yi ge mchog gyur gcig pa las/ /rlung sems gnyis su med par ni/ /thugs kyi snying po mchog tu bskul/ /gang du lhag pa'i lhar gyur cing —/ /rdo rje 'dzin par gnas pa las/ /'od zer lcags kyu ma 'dres pa/ /nyi shu rtsa lngas spros pa las/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin nyer spyod pa/ /spyi bo nas yonyeni bskul bar mdzad/ /'di nyid dri med dbyangs gyur pa/ /'od zer kha dog lnga dag gis/ /gsung gi sgo nas bskul ba gang / /ye shes sprin ni 'phro byed pa'o / /'dir ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /khyad par thugs las bskul gyur pa/ /sa gsum du ni khyab byed yin/ /mi phyed rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur phyin/ /grub pa'i rdo rje 'bar ba yis/ /thams cad ro mnyam ngang du bskul/ /gang du rnal 'byor mchog 'dod pas/ /rdo rje dang ni bha ga dag(ge /thabs dang shes rab tshul dag tu/ /mnyam par sbyar ba'i dbang po yis/ /snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde thob pa/ /zla ba dang ni nyi ma dag /rtsa gnyis 'dus par dbu mar ni/ /gcig tu gyur pa'i dngos po yis/ /srog rtsol gnyis kyi rlung dag dang / /e bam̐ kha sbyor sbyar ba gang / /des ni chos kun ma lus la/ /yongs su rgyas gdab gyur pa yin/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang sngags dam tshig ting 'dzin yin/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i snying po rab tu bskur ( ba bstan pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi phyed ye shes rab bsgrub pas/ /'dus pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du/ /yang dag ye shes 'di gsungs so/ /'dod khams dbang phyug 'jig rten na/ /go 'phang la ni byed 'gyur ba/ /dbang dang de bzhin dgug pa dang / /bskrad 82—702

dang gsad pa ①nyid dang ni/ /rmugs byed rengs byed rmongs byed pa/ /tshig 'phrog bya dang brgyal ba dang / /sna tshogs gzugs su sgyur ba dang / /gzhogs skams byed dang nus med du/ /byed pa las kyi cho ga yin/ /'di dag nyer 'grub tshul 'di ni/ /rgyu dang mtshan ma thabs dang ni/ /las dang spyod tshul rim pa ste/ /phyag rgya rig ②sngags 'khrul ②'khor te/ /ltas dang nges par zlog 6)par byed/ /rnal 'byor pas ni grub dkyil 'khor/ /ye shes phrin las bstan pa'o/ /'di grub pa yi nges pa yang / /rdo rje slob dpon dag gis ni/ /rjes su gnang ba byin pa dang / /dbang gi dus su phrin las kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul (5)zhugs thob pas 'byung / /lam du lhag pa'i lha yis ni/ /brtan pas byin gyis brlab pa dang / /rig sngags phreng ba 'dzin pa las/ /grangs bshad pa las bdun 'gyur du/ /bsnyen pa nye bar grub par 'gyur/ /kha cig phran tshegs las rnams las/ /bzhi 'gyur bsam gtan ldan pas 'grub/ /rlung gi nus pa brtan pa dang / /lta stangs thogs med 'byung ba yi/ /nye bar 'tshe (5)ba'i gnod pa dag /bltas pa tsam gyis zhi ba yi/ /rang sems gnyug ma'i shes pa la/ /dbang thob rdo rje'i stobs gyur pas/ /'byung ba'i skye mched zil non phyir/ /las tshogs thams cad nges par 'grub/ /byang chub sems ni rjes dran zhing / /pha rol gnod byed gyur pa yi/ /srin mo sha za gtum mo dang / /'byung po dag gis gnod par bcas/ /de dag kun la dpa' bo yi( )/ /rdo rje sems kyis rab sbyar na/ /gnod par nus pa ma yin te/ /me dang chu dang gcan gzan (gyidang / /rgyal po'i chad pa mi rgod dang / /seng ge glang po srin po ste / /'jigs pa brgyad sogs mi 'byung byed/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor rdo rje 82—703

can / /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas pa'i/ /khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje gshed / /zhal gsum phyag drug sbrul gyis brgyan/ /sku mdog nag po 'bar ba'i sku / /rang gi yum dang gnyis med pa/ /rang gi 'khor lo'i dbus gnas pas/ /oṃ ya mān+ta kṛta tshos hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ 'dis ni rdo rje can gyi bka'/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi las rnams la/ /ma lus 'grub par byed pa yi/ /gsang ba nye bar 'grub pa yin/ /de nas bcom ldan dam tshig che/ /rdo rje khro bo zhes bya ba'i / /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas/ /khro bo'i tshogs rnams ma lus pa/ /kun du skrag par byed pa yi/ /rdo rje khro bo 'jigs byed pa/ /nyid kyi sku gsung thugs las phyung / /khro bo thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /kha dog nag po 'jigs chen po/ /bdud dang log 'dren ma rungs pa/ /gang gis gdul dka' 'dul (5kyimadzad pa/ /mi srin ma he'i zhal phyung zhing / /gtsigs pa khrag 'dzag kha dog dmar / /steng du mngon par phyung ba dang / /dbang phyug brgyad dang ldan pa'i sku / /rigs kyi zhal drug 'bar ba mnga'/ /bcu drug zhabs kyis gshin rje gnon / /de phyir 'jigs byed chen por brjod/ /tshangs pa'i rgyal po gdul don du/ /sum cu rtsa bzhi'i phyag rgya can/ /dbang phyug drug po gdul ba'i phyir / /gsang ba gyen du bsgreng ba'on/ /khyab 'jug gdul phyir ma he'i zhal/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras pa dang / /rang gi 'khor lor dbus bzhugs tshe/ /lha mo rdo rje bde ma dang / /gnyis su med par gnas pa'o/ /de nyid zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa yis/ /ljon shing 'dzeg ltar sbyor bar mdzad/ /gsang sngags rgyal po 'di yis ni/ /bsam gyis mi khyab gsang ba 'grub/ /oṃ hrīḥdhīḥ5li kṛ 7tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā / me thab dang 82—704

ni dur khrod ras/ /gsal shing bskyon (1)dang rdo rje yi(9/ /tho ba rdo rje'i 95)sbyor ba dang / /rdo rje dgra (4)sta thod tshal dang / /rlung gis khyer ba'i ras dag gis/ /'dus par 95)dgug dang nges ster ba/ /gsad dang rab tu brdung ba dang / /rnam par mnan dang shin tu gsad(6)/ /chu bo bzlog dang rlung bcing ba/ /las kyi sbyor ba bstan pa ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis shes par bya/ /de las gzhan du gyur pa yi/ /las kyi sbyor ba sna tshogs pa/ /'dir ni mi 'grub gang yang med/ /de ltar tshar bcad (pelas mdzad cing / /thugs rjes nye bar mi gtong phyir/ /zhi ba'i zhal ni spyi gtsug nas/ /kun nas nor bu'i snying por (8༄mdzad/ /rdo rje khro bo rab tu 'bar ba dkyil 'khor 'byung ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin las yang dag bstan pa'o/ /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang ni/ /zhing dang nye ba'i zhing dag dang / /tshan do nye ba'i tshan do dang / /'du sa nye ba'i smyo 'du sa dang yi/ /'thung gcod nye ba'i 'thung gcod dang / /dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod dang / /phyi nang bslab pa'i tshul dag gis/nya/ /sa ni bcu gnyis tshul du brjod/ /gnas ni sum cu rtsa gnyis su/ /chos rnams rmi lam tshul 'char ba/ /mi nyugeslob nyugezung 'jug thob byed phyir/ /sgyu ma malta bu'i tshul du 'byung / /de nyid rim pa shes par bya/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yi/ /yan lag bcu gnyis dag gyur pa/ /tshul 'di rtogs par bstan pa'o/ /ming dang gzugs dang skye mched drug /rig dpa dag pas 7sku rdo rje/ /tshor ba srid pa len pa dag /mi dmigs gsung gi rdo rjer dag /srid pa skye ba rga shi rnams/ /rdo rje thugs kyis dag byed pa'o/ /ma rig pa dang 'du byed dang / /rnam par shes pa rnam pa gsum / /ye shes dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dbyer med rang 'byung tsho ngo bor gyur/ /82wa 705

rtog pa med par bde ba'i ro/ /snang ba ngos bzung 6)med pa yi/ /gnyis med bde ba'i rnam par snang / /bcom ldan ye shes sku gcig tu/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab sgrub pa/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yi/ /ye shes rdo rje rang byung ba'i / /de nyid dang las sprul pa ste/ /sangs rgyas chos nyid dag pa 'di/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i snang ba la/ /mi 'gag lam ni mngon gyur cing / /gsang ba (gyirdzogs pa'i lam dag pas/ /yang dag ye shes 'byung bar gnas/ /'di dag sangs rgyas skyes bu ste/ /sngags kyi rig pa zhes bsgrags pa/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /dam tshig dag gis rdzogs gyur pa/ /gsang ba chen po'i lam gyur ni/ /sngags kyi rim pa yan lag bzhis/ /lam gyi spyod pa'i tshul mchog gis/ /tshe gcig gis ni byang chub 'thob/ /gsang ba'i pad+mar nyi ma 'khyil / /mdzod spu'i gnas su bdud rtsi yi/ /zla ba sangs rgyas kun gyi nya/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das las grol/ /gang du rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor las/ /zhi bar byed pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /mā ma tī dang gnyis med pas/ /tshad med bum pa bzang po 'thob/ /rin chen nor bu'i dkyil 'khor las/ /rnal 'byor rgyas pa'i 'phel byed pa/ /sangs rgyas spyan gyi sbyor ba yis/ /dpag bsam shing chen rab grub pa'o/ /pad+ma 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor las/ /sngags pas chags med dbang sdud pa/ /gos dkar lha mo ye shes che/ /'dod 'jo'i ba ltar rab grub byed/ /ral gri 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor las/ /gang du sna tshogs phrin las spyod/ /rdo rje sgrol ma'i khyad (5)par las/ /cang shes rta yi stobs kyis bgrod / /'khor lo 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /ye shes de bzhin gshegs pa'i rlung / /chos kyi dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas/ /bsam 'phel nor bu thob 82—706

byed pa'o/ /rgyu ba'i rlung ni rab zin pas/ /'jig rten gsum po kun gyi ni/ /gzugs gsum phra rags med par ni/ /blo yi yul du mthong bar byed/ /rab tu rgyu ba rab zin pas/ /phyogs bcu kun du khyab gyur pa'i/ /rdo rje dri yi bye brag kun/ /ma lus tshor bar gyur pa yin/ /mngon par rgyu ba zin pas na/ /sa gsum po ni grag pa yin/ /sgra yi tshogs rnams ji snyed ①pa/ /de kun drung na grag bzhin 'byung / /shin tu rgyu ba zin pa yis/ /rdo rje ro yi bye brag kun/ /ma lus lus pa med pa dag /myongs ②'gyur rdo rje 'dzin pa kye/ /yang dag rab tu rgyu ba ni/ /shin tu brtan pa thob pa las/ /srid zhi reg byar gyur pa dag /de yis nges par tshor bar 'byung / /gang du rdo rje brtan pa las/ /mi phyed srog ni gcig gyur pa/ /de snyed snying las 'od 'byung ba'i/ /bsil zer rta bdun cha mnyam pas/ /ā li kā li las byung ba/ /sna tshogs rdo rje gar bcas pa'i/ /thabs dang thabs ldan bskyod pa'i rlung / /'dis ni mkha' la rab lding 'gyur/ /nyin dang mtshan mo'i cha las ni/ /phyag rgya'i shu tra len byed pa / /gsang ba rdo rje nang du ni/ /bde ba skyes pa til 'bru bzhin/ /de nyid yongs su dag pa ni/ /kun 'dar mar ni de bzhin gshegs/ /mkha' dang thig le sangs rgyas sku/ /rab tu mthong byed rnal 'byor che/ /bde ba nyams pa med pa las/ /bcu drug cha yi rin chen rtse/ /ri rab steng du dbang po ni/ /thur ①bltas sum cu rtsa gsum pas/ /ri bong 'dzin phyir mi ldog pas/ /de nyid zag med khang bzangs na/ /bde ba chen por gnas gyur pa'o/ /khams rnams las ni gyur pa yi(4)/ /sdud dang 'bar dang smin 45)pa dang / /'degs pa brtan byed 'khrul kyi'akhor las/ /zag bcas rlung ni ldog pa dang / /zag med 82—707

ting 'dzin thob pa las/ /sba ba sbubs su nub pa dang / /brtan byed rgyu mthun rtags mthong phyir/ /'jug cing ldog pa med pas na/ /dbu yi gtsug tor de nas 'byung / /rang gi ngo bo'i sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin las thams cad kun/ /sangs rgyas stong dang gnyis bcas pa'i/ /rnam 'phrul ye shes las byung 1ba'o/ /de skad ces ni gsungs pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa' chen po ni/ /kun du bzang pos legs thob pa/ /gsang ba'i don ni 'di zhus yin / /gang du sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi/ /gnas sogs dbye ba sa yi cha de nyid nye bar bstan pa dang / /sgyu ma'i dpe ni bcu gnyis las/ /chos nyid ji ltar rtogs par 'gyur/ /ro hi ta la sogs pa yi/ /dus sbyor bcu gnyis dag las ni/ /khyad par ji skad thob pa'i tshul/ /'dir ni nye bar bstan du gsol//de nyid rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /khyad par don du bka' stsal pa/ /gnas ni pu li ra 2yar brjod/ /de bzhin dza lan dha ra dang / /au can ar bu ta (7nyid de / /rab tu dga' ba'i sar brjod pa'o/ /ba glang bdag po nyer gnas te/ /ra me 4shwa ri nyid dang ni/ /de ba sku ko tsha (67myu la ba577 / /dri ma med pa'i sa rab gnas / / kā ma rū pa o ṭa ni/ /zhing du brjod pa nges pa yin/ /'od 'phro'i ltas ni 'dir thob byed/ /tri sha ku ṇi nya ko sa la/ /nye ba'i zhing steng 4nyas bzhi pa/ /ka ling ka dang lam pa kha ka /tshan do ha ste sa lnga pa/ /na: kyi gyi ma la yar 'di/ /nye ba'i tshan do sa drug pa'o/ /pre ta pu ri khyim gyi lha/ /'dus pa can te sa bdun pa/ /sau rāṣ+ṭa tshagaser gling ste/ /nye ba'i 'dus pa sa brgyad pa / /na ga ra dang sin+tu ste/ /dur khrod tsholas ni dgu pa yin/ /ma ro ku lu tha 'di dag /nye ba'i dur khrod sa bcu pa/ /chos kyi sprin du mngon par brjod/ /82—708

kong kha na dang kha ba'i ri/ /tsa ri tra dang kai po trehunye/ /'thung gcod ②sa ni bcu gcig pa/ /ha ri ke la haṃ bha la/ /tsa ra sing ha ri ldan pa/ /ni ri ti pa'i gling ①gyur pa/ /nye ba'i 'thung gcod brjod par bya/ /'di dag sa ni bcu gnyis te/ /khyad par 'bigs byed gzhon nu'i gnas/ /bcu gsum pa yi sa brjod la/ /yongs su gnas pa bde ba che/ /khyad par gling ni bcu gnyis su/ /gsang ba'i rgyud rnams bstan pa ni/ /kla klo'i gling ni bcu gnyis su/ /rdo rje 'chang gis bstan pa yin/ /thams cad sgyu ma'i snang ba las/ /yang dag tu ni ston (gepar byed/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /rgyu dang las las ⑤kun du byung / /ngo bo med cing gnas med pas / /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don la bla med byos/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas rigs skye bar/ /'dir ni the tsom yod ma yin/ /chos rnams sprul pa lta bu ste/ /de nyid rjes su spyad pa na6)/ /rnam pa kun du zhi ba yi / /tshul gnas las dang mnyam par 'byung / /'di nyid mthar rtogs shin tu dben/ /rnam par mi rtog bye brag las/ /khyad par byin brlabs gasprul pa yis / /dngos po rgyas 'debs gyur pa'o/ /chos rnams sgra brnyan (8)lta bu ste/ /brag ca 6)lta bur rang stong zhing / /phyi nang med pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /brjod du med pa'i sgra rnams la/ /rnam dag sgra med sgrar 'jug med/ /chos rnams rang bzhin med pa'i gnas/ /mngon par ston pa'i tshul gnas kyang / /de nyid sgra kyil gnas pa min/ /chos rnams dri za'i grong khyer ltar/ /phyi dang nang dang bar du yang / /dngos po med de nges par snang / /sgro skur med de tha snyad 'das / /chos nyid mngon par bsgrub dag pas/ /tshad med bslab pa nus ma 82wa 709

yin / /chos rnams chu zla lta bur ni/ /snang ba ngos gzung med pa'i dngos/ /yang dag grub par gnas med de/ /de nyid khyab pas stong pa'i sar/ /gzung med bcing dang grol med pas/ /yang dag snang ba 'dir mtshon rnol/ /chos rnams smig rgyu lta bu ste/ /grub pa med pa'i dngos po las/ /de nyid chur mthong 'khrul pa'i lam/ /de ltar sna tshogs snang ba yang / /grub med stong pa'i snang ba las / /gzhan med 'khrul bar ma byed cig /chos rnams rmi lam lta bu ste/ /rmi lam du ni 'jig rten dang / /'jig rten 'das pa ma grub ste/ /khams gsum brtan dang g.yo bar bcas/ /'pho ba med cing skye ba med/ /kun nas nyon mongs rnam byed med/ /de nyid med bzhin snang ba yang / /'gag pa med par 'byung ba'i phyir/ /rnam dag gnas med snang ba bral/ /de ltar chos kun rmi lam dang / /ngo bo nyid gcig shes bya ste/ /rmi lam gyi ni tshul du yang / /kun nas spyod pas khyab par bya/ /dngos snang ma lus chos khyab pa/ /thams cad rmi lam ri mo ltar/ /dngos med snang ba rab shes bya/ /rmi lam gyi ngo bo nyid kyi tshul dang / rmi lam la mngon par chags pa spong ba dang / rmi lam rab tu dben par tsho shes pa dang / rmi lam gyi rang bzhin shes par bya ba dang /chos thams cad la rmi lam lta bur byin gyis rlob pa dang / chos thams cad rmi lam dang tha mi dad par 'char ba'i don dang / chos thams cad rmi lam lta bu'i 'du shes sngon du 'gro ba dang / rmi lam nyid du'ang rnam par mi rtog cing mi spyod pa dang / rmi lam gyi 'jig rten khong du chud pa lta bur rab tu rtogs par bya ba nyid do/ /de nyid bla med tshul 'di rtogs par bya/ /'di dag rmi lam lta bur khong chud cing / /chos kun srid pa ma lus snang ba yang / /rmi lam ngo bo nyid du 82—710

rab tu rtogs/ /'di ni yul dang phyogs la mi gnas te/ /rmi lam rab tu zhi la de dag gzhol/ /rang bzhin mkhas shing rnam par rtog med ldan/ /rtogs pa'i yid ldan sems la 'gyur ba med/ /kun du rmi lam lta bur shin tu spyod/ /dus gsum ma lus bag chags gzugs brnyan rnams/ /shin tu nyer 'byung lus 'das ①sbyang bar bya/ /mi lam sgyu ma lta bur rab shes bya/ /de lus shi med 'gyur med skye ba med/ /phyogs rnams kun du yod min med pa'ang min/ /khams gsum thams cad rmi lam tshul lta bu/ /'di la rnam par rtog med tshul byas shing / /shin tu mkhas de'i sems la bcings pa med/ /'gro kun rmi lam rang bzhin tshul 'dra la/ /de dag mi gnas 'jig rten las rab dben/ /rten (9med mi rtog 'jig rten rnam rtog med/ /rmi lam chos rtogs mkhas pas spyod pa (gubya/ /rmi lam 'gro ba rnam pa du ma snang / /tha dad rnam pa gzhan dang gzhan dag tu/ /bye brag rnam mang rtog pa yongs su sbyang / /de nyid tshul gyis rnam pa (gerab tu rtogs/ /mtshan nyid rnam 'das skal ba mnyam pa nyid/ /gcig las rnam mang (gedu mar gang snang ltos/ /rnam bkod yirnam par 'gro ba rab tu shes/ /kun la ⑦mi lam 'dra ba'i chos can dang / /zhing rnams rmi lam chos rnams rmi ltar byed/ /kun nyon mongs dang rnam byang tshul 'di la/ /rab tu rtog med rmi lam spyod pa yis/ /yang dag 'grub par 'gyur ba'i lam yin te//rmi lam smon lam rnam pas gnas med pa/ /de ni chos rnams kun la mi gnas so / /tshul 'di la ni cung zad byed gnas med( da/ /'jig rten 'di 'drar 'byung ba po)shes shing dag /tshul rtogs 'gro kun mi 'jigs chos la sbyor/ /'dir sbyong ⑨srid pa kun du chud mi za/ /rmi lam brgyud bzhin de dag rab tu 82—711

shes / /de nyid rmi lam mdzad pas sangs rgyas zhing / /yongs su sbyangs shing sems can smin byed la/ /rnam thar sgo thob chos kyi 'khor lo yis/ /tshad med ye shes gzhal med gnas 'dir 'thob/ /chos thams cad la rmi lam yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du bstan pa ste mngon par 'byung ba'o/ /chos rnams dbang po'i gzhu lta bur/ /rang byung dngos po med pa yi/ /'od snang lus kyis 6)spros pa med/ /bde ba zhi ba'i gnas zhes bya/ /chos rnams nam mkha'i sprin bzhin du/ /stong pa'i ngang nas kun nas ldang ②/ /rlung las yang dag 'byung ba'i phyir/ /nyer len rang sar grol ba'i (9gnas/ /chos rnams (gebar snang glog bzhin du/ /rang rig yid kyi rnam shes kyis/ /kun du khyab par rgyu ba ni/ /rtsa ba las rlung dag par bya/ /chos kun chu yi chu bur ni/ /rgya mtsho las byung ji bzhin par/ /chos nyid sna tshogs rgya (5)mtsho las/ /rtog pa'i dra ba dag par bya/ /chos rnams sgyu ma lta bur 'char ba yang / /gang du rlung sems gcig tu ma dag na / /'khrul pa sgyu ma lta bur dngos la zhen/ /de nyid srid pa kun du ston pa yin / /de nyid dag pas snang ba'i mngon zhen bral/ /rtog pa log pas brtan g.yo sgyu mar 'char/ /dngos rnams kun la chags pa med pa ni/ /rnam pa sna tshogs sgyu ma'i tshul shes phyir/ /sgyu ma rab zhi spros pa med pa ste/ /gnas med chos kyi dbyings la de gnas byed/ /chos rnams kun dang sgyu ma tha dad med/ /dbye ba rdul tsam 967du ni dmigs mi 'gyur/ /rang lus sgyu ma'i rnam par rab shes pas/ /'gro kun skyes pa bud med sna tshogs pa/ /thams cad gzugs ni sgyu ma'i snang ba las/ /mkhas pas su dag de las (7tshogazhan du spyod/ /de ltar sgyu ma chags med sna tshogs pa'i/ /gnas kyi dbang phyug de la zhen mi byed/ /82—712

'jig rten dngos dang dngos med gang gnas pa/ /sgyu ma'i 1)tshul gyis gnas pa med par gnas/ /sgyu ma nyid du yang dag rab grol bas/ /de bzhin nyid la mnyam par gzhag (snyepa dang / /rjes thob gnyis med sgom dang bsgom bya bral /sems med de la sems las gzhan pa'i chos/ /'jig rten tha snyad ①tsam du'ang mi brjod de/ /ngo bo nyid kyis lam skyes sgyu ma'i sku/ /skye med nam mkha'i sgyu ma 'di la ltos⑤/ /thams cad stong nyid gzugs kyi glang po dang / /shing rta ma he 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi/ /rin chen bdun dang dpung chen thams cad kun/ /sgyu ma'i gzugs nyid de yi 'bras bu las/ /gang du 'byung zhing gang du'ang song ba med/ /'gro 'ong gnas sgyu rgyu 'bras sgyu ma'i chos/ /'di ni ljon shing rin chen 'bru 'bab cing / /'dzam bu'i chu bos shing gi 'bras bu yang / /mi mnyam mnyam med dus gsum phyogs bcu po/ /rgyal ba'i zhing khams sgyu ma'i bkod pas sbyong (6)/ /sems can sgyu mar tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs pas/ /'bras bu sku bzhi sgyu ma'i ye shes can/ /'di ltar gang shes 'di ni mi skye ba'i/ /chos la bzod pa thob par (perig par bya/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i (shes la gnas pa'o/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis chos thams cad yang dag par sdud pa zhes bya ba'o/ /ro hi ta po)ste brgyal bar byed/ /mo he 7te ni yan lag 'byung / /bha dra bkra shis byed pa'o/ /bre sha pa ni dge ba steraXn/ /bi sha pa ni 'dus pa la/ /kurmā 4)pa la 'tsho ba skyong / /ma ka ra dharnya ba ni/ /mi phyed dbang po 'byung ba'o/ /ma ska ra yi ni dag par byed/ /bi mutri ka ni rnam par rgyal/ /bha ku la ni rten pa ste / /swasna gezhes pa bra yib gang / /ka ma ni zhes rgyan yin te/ /'di dag lus ngag yid dag la/ /dkar phyogs bde ba 'phel byed yin/ /de las rnam par 82—713

bzlog 6)pa ni/ /nag phyogs ②ma rungs mngon brtson pa/ /bar mas gti mug rmongs par gnas/ /rnal 'byor pas ni 'dir shes pas/ /las rnams thun gyis 'dir dag pas/ /bcu gnyis dag gtu bstan pa yin/ /khyad ①par bsdus pa'i tshul shes pas/ /rgyu dang thabs dang khyad par gyi/ /bla med ye shes tshul 'di bstan/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las/ /de nyid rnam par 'khrul gyur pas/ /rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis su/ /lugs su 'byung bas 'khor ba yin/ /chos nyid sna tshogs 'khor lor ni/ /lam du spyod par rim ⑤shes bya/ /log pas lta dang brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /de 'bral gol bas thar pa med/ /dman pas mngon mthong spyod pa las/ /dkar po'i phyogs gnas skyabs gsum las / /mos pas nyan rang zhi ba'i lam ngal bso 0tsam las rnam dag min/ /khyad kho par byang chub sems dpa'i lam/ /rtsa ba sa bon byang chub sems/ /de las rin chen ljon ( shing gi/ /pad sdong lo 'dab po)me tog rgyas/ /'bras bu bde gshegs yid bzhin nor/ /dgos 'dod dri ma med pa'i gter/ /rten 'brel lugs bzlog chos 'byung ba'i/ /zab dang rgya che'i snying po ni/ /grub mtha' du ma rtogs pa'i gnas/ /de ni yang dag gnas mi 'thobakyi/ /gsang ba rdo rje theg pa las/ /rgyud sde'i snying po 'dus pa'i don/ /dug lnga'i rtog pa sbyangs gyur pas/ /dbang dang las kyi rim pa las/ /sku gsum sa yi dbang phyug 'thob/ /phyi nang spyod pa'i don gnas la/ /dam tshig gnas pa'i tshul bzhin spyod/ /spyi dang khyad par sku gsum dang / /sku bzhi ye shes rdzogs pa'i gnas / /mngon par byang chub lnga dang ni/ /drug pa dang po'i mgon po las/ /ye shes rgya mtsho sprin 'phro bas3ste/ /rigs ni brgya dang 7stong dag tu/ /spros 82—714

dang sdud pa gsang chen gyi/ /gcig pa mi zad sems bskyed pa/ /byang chub sems 'di bstan pa yang / /dkyil 'khor snying por 'byung ba yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las snying po mchog tu bskul ba dang yongs su dag par ston pa'i le'u ste bdun cu pa'o// //de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi mchod pa gsang ba bla na med pa 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las rab tu phyung ngo / /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /bdag gi khu ba la sogs pas/ /cho ga bzhin du kun mchod na/ /sangs rgyas byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /rig ma gzugs bzang 0)mdangs dang ldan/ /lo grangs bcu drug lon pa la/ /byin gyis brlabs kyi (miganas gsum gyis/ /dben par mchod pa rab tu brtsams)/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i btsun mo mchog /spyan la sogs par bsgom ④par bya/ /yi ge hūṃ dang oṃ dag dang / /āḥdang phaṭa kyang rab tu bsgom/ /'od zer sna lngas khyab pa yis/ /pad+ma rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ /'bar bcas zla 'od bzhin du dgar(mi / /yid du 'ong ba bsgom par bya/ /dbang po gnyis ni (6)mnyam sbyar bas / /sangs rgyas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /bha ga la ni liṅga gzhagatso /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rnam bsams 58)nas/ /ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas/ /rang rigs las byung rab tu spro/ /'di ni bde ba mchog gyur pa/ /gsang ba ye shes grub pa'i gtso/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i tshul du bya/ /rab tu dben 82—715

pa'i sa phyogs su/ /dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi legs byugs ①pa/ /shes rab yum gyi bha ga yi / /dkyil 'khor pad+ma'i dbyibs gnas pa/ /kha dog dmar po e yi dbyibs/ /de la gsang ba'i lha tshogs kyi/ /thig le dkar po sum cu gcig /baṃ gyi (gyirnam par brjod pa yin/ /der 'jug cho ga brtag ④pa yis/ /mkhas pas rim pa shes par bya/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs dang / /dmangs rigs gdol pa'i rigs can las/ /sme sha can ni bcu gnyis ma/ /lang 75)tshor ldan zhing sgeg pa dang / /bzhin bzangs yimig dkyus ring ba ni/ /mkhas pas mtshan nyid yongs shes pas/ /rig ma yongs su sbyangs pa gzhug /bla ma la ni dbul bya zhing / /gang du maṇ+ḍal me tog dang / /mchod pa ye shes sngon byas te/ /bha ga'i dkyil 'khor de nyid du/ /rdo rje slob dpon gsang ba 'dzin / /me tog bcas pa'i lha mo la/ /mnyam par phyag bya gsol ba gdab/ /mgon po gsang ba 'dzin pa po/ /sems dpa' chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes che/ /thams cad stong ⑦pa bla na med/ /mtshan nyid nyams myong gcig pa nyid/ /rdo rje gsang bas bdag la stsol(kyi/ /las dang skye ba las grol ba'i/ /tshe 'dir byang chub mchog thob la/ /khyod zhabs pad+ma spangs nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan du skyabs ma mchis/ /'gro ba'i dpa' bo thub chen po/ /de bas blo mchog mnyes par mdzod/ /de ltar gsol ba gdab pa mchog /dam pa des ni thob gyur nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma yon tan mtshos(9 nye/ /snying rje slob ma la bskyed 7de/ /bzhin ni rab tu dang gyur nas/ /rang gi brtse bar rab dga' zhing / /gsang ba rgyud las bde thob pa/ /bzang po'i dam tshig dkyil 'khor bstan/ /de nas slob dpon snyoms zhugs nas/ /ka la sha 82—716

'am dung chos su/ /byang chub sems ni rab dbyung ste/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra :ka 6)rtsu/bzang po'i phreng ba nye bar sbyin/ /de nas slob ma de la ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis byin brlabs te/ /rgyal ba'i phyag rgyar bcas pa yis/ /dam tshig gsang ba sbyin gyur pa/ /rdo rje can ni phyed dus su/ /dbang bskur ba ni sbyin par bya/ /bkra shis sgra ni bsgrags pa dang / /rol mo'i sgra skad sna tshogs kyis/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rgyal ①po yis/ /khams gsum rdo rjes dbang bskur ba/ /slob ma 'dud gcing thal sbyar ba/ /'dir ni rab tu bskur ④ba yis/ /khyad par nang du nges dbang bskur⑤/ /phreng ba chu dang rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje dril bu ming dang ni/ /slob dpon dag dang gnang ba sbyin/ /dbugs dbyung gzengs yibastod lung bstan pas/ /dbang bskur rim pa 'di sbyin bya/ /de nas bdag byin brlab pa'i rim/ /bcud du bya ba'i thabs bstan pa/ /kun rdzob bden pa yang dag sbyin/ /byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /khyad par bde chen dbang bskur ba/ /rig ma dag par sbyangs pa dang / /maṇ+ḍal me tog bcas pa yisaphya/ /de nas gsol ba gdab par bya/ /slar yang bla mas gsang ba brjod/ /kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba/ /de (kyering bshad pa'i rin chen gyis/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin 465po) / /khyod zhabs pad+ma spangs nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis /'gro ba'i dpa' bo thub chen gyis/ /bdag la nges par dbang bskur cig /de ltar lan gsum brjod nas ni/ /bla ma la ni bka' stsal zhu/ /lha mo gzugs bzang mdangs ldan pa/ /lo grangs bcu gnyis lon rnyed la/ /rigs kyi sbyor bas rab bsgoms te/ /bdag gi khu bas mchod par bya/ /rdo rje slob dpon blo 82—717

gros ches sna)/ / de yi ②lag pa der gtad de/ /gzungs ma shin tu nyams dga' 'di/ /bsten ②byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags/ /rdo rje pad+ma rab sbyor ba'i she/ /bde ba dam pa yang dag myong / /bde ba dpag med 'byung ba'i gzhi(snye / /ye shes chen po 'dir rtogs bya/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs mi rgya/ /'di las gzhan pa mchog med de/ /'gro ba gsum po dag rig par/ /dga' ba yang dag rtogs par gyis/ /de bas nam yang 'di dang ni/ /khyed kyis bral bar ma byed cig /'di de 6)sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs nabla na med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /de nas dri zhim me tog spras/ /gcer bu chu skyes ston par mdzad/ /bshang 8)gci la sogs za ba dang / /khrag dang khu ba de bzhin sha /rtag par bud med mchog gus pas/ /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed dang / /ji ltar spro bar byed dam ci/ /ji ltar bde bar smros 6)shig bu/ /de ni nye bar gzung bya ba/ /bshang gci'i bdud rtsi bza' bya ba/ /bud med rtag gus cis mi bgyid/ /gsang ba'i pad+mar 'o byed pa/ /lha mo bdag ni cis mi spro/ /de ni nye bar gsan mi pa yis/ /gsang ba'i tshig 'di brjod par 'gyur/ /e ma ho bdag gi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad kyi (1ni gnas/ /gang zhig cho ga bzhin sten pa/ /de yi mdun na bdag gnas te/ /sangs rgyas bsten 7pa la sogs pa/ /pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin gyis/ /bde chen rgyal por rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ /bhañja 1nyamok+ṣa ho/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa yibadz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma skako3lhatshoge/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar 7/ /khyod kyis nam yang ma byed 82—718

cig /bde chen rang byung phyag rgya'i dbus/ /rdo rje skyil krung ①la sems ni/ /nor bu'i nang du brtag par bya/ /rgyu mthun la sogs bde ba las/ /ye shes skye bas de bzhin du/ /dri ma med pa'i don du ni/ /thob pa ②sbyor ba las byung bske/ /bha gar liṅga gzhag bya ste/ /byang chub sems ni dbyung mi bya/ /khams gsum ma lus thams cad las/ /sangs rgyas gzugs su bsgom par bya/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bde 'thob pa'o/ /tshangs spyad ①brtan pas gnas pa ni/ /yongs su sdom pa rig pa 'dzin/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug gar mkhan te/ /sdom pa bcom ldan yang dag 'dzin/ /'dir ni rim pa 'di shes bya/ /sha chen dam tshig mchog gis ni/ /rdo rje gsum mchog bsgrub par bya/ /rdo rje'i rigs las nges bstan pa'i/ /spyad bya stobs ldan mchog 'di yin/ /gho/ sangs rgyas rigs ni dag pa yi/ /lha mo rnams kyis byin brlabs dupa/ /ba glang ⑤ka yi rigs dag pas/ /rdo rje dgug pa'i dam tshig yin/ /ku/ za byed 'thung zhing kun du rgyu/ /rin chen rigs la nges 'byung ba'i/ /khyi sha dag gi dam tshig gis / /dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /dha/ myur du 'gro zhing shugs dang ldan/ /pad+ma'i rigs kyis byin brlabs (7pa'i/ /rta sha dag gi dam tshig gis/ /mi snang ba yi bdag por 'gyur/ /ha/ g.yul du dpa' zhing mi ldog pa/ /las kyi rigs kyis byin brlabs (3)pa'i/ /glang po'i sha yi dam tshig gis / /mngon shes lnga dag thob 'gyur ro/ / mu/ pad+ma'i rigs kyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /rta sha dag gi dam tshig gis/ /mi snang ba yi bdag por 'gyur/ /ha / g.yul du dpa' zhing mi ldog pa/ /las kyi rigs kyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /glang po'i sha yi dam tshig gis/ /mngon shes lnga dag thob 'gyur ro/ /(8)mu/82—719

phyag rgya chu yi rnam pa las/ /zhe sdang dpa' bo rdo rje 'dzin/ /bshang gci dam tshig mchog 'di 91)ni/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i gtso bor 'gyur/ /gi/ bzhi ②mnyam lus las 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gti mug 'dren pa 'khor lo che/ /rnam snang dam tshig mchog gis ni/ /yid ①bzhin nor bu'i dpal ldan 'gyur/ /maḥ / sgo dgu nas byung rgyungs pa dang / /klad ④pa rkang du bcas pa las/ /rin chen nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i skus/ /'dis ni pad+ma'i mdangs can 'gyur/ /rā dza'i bu gar rang byung ba'i/ /rā ga 'bar ba'i 'od can ni/ /'dod chags chen po'i 'byung gnas las/ /'dzam bu'i 97chu bo'i 'od ltar 'gyur/ /shu/lus kun las ni 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /kun da 96)lta bu'i byang chub sems/ /las kyi phrin las ral gri che/ /phrin las sna tshogs dbang thob 'gyur/ /mi/ kun du myos 97byed bcud bsdus pa'i/ /snying po 'chi med rtog med pa'i/ /ye shes 'byung gnas khu ba 'di/ /rnal 'byor pa yi grol ba'i rgyu/ /'jig rten kun du rgyal byed pa/ /gsang ba dag pa'i (kyedam tshig gnas/ /rtsu r+ghaṃ 99)rta hrīḥkho lo ⑩mi paṃ rta āḥ sgron me lnga ni rnam dag pas/ /yid bzhin nor bu mchog ster byed/ /dug lnga bdud rtsir dag pas ni/ /ye shes lnga thob phyir mi ldog /'khor lo 'od 'phro mdangs mchog can/ /rang gi sngags kyis rab bsgoms (nyanas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gzhug par bya/ /'dis ni gsang ba 'dzin par 'gyur/ /gsang ba shes rab la brten pa'i/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan dag pa ni/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug kun gyi gnas/ /'di dag rim pas sbyang bar 7bya/ /ji bzhin gzhi la spyod pa las/ /dngos po'i gnas lugs lam gyur pa'i/ /thabs dang shes rab rol pas ni/ /'dod yon lam du byed pa'o/ /gang du phyag dar 82—720

khrod pa yi/ /gos 'chang ①spyod pa ku su lu/ /bskus ②te bor ba'i sman za bas/ /'dir ni sna tshogs chos su spyad/ /spyod lam kun du 'dris pa las/ /phying bu tshal pa tsam 'dzin pa/ /'di ni phyogs med gos can te/ /rnam pa thal ba yis byugs yin/ /gang du chos gos gsum pa ni/ /stod g.yogs glang po'i pags ⑧pa dang / /mi yi pags ④pa nyid la rten/ /smad dkris stag gi ko bas dkris/ /phyis mi len pa lan cig ste/ /spros pa gcod par byed pa yis/ /byin gyis ma brlabs zas dang gos/ /skad cig tsam du sten mi byed/ /rang nyid lhan cig phyag rgyar bcas/ /snod gcig za ba'i gtsang sbra las/ /du mar 'byung ba ma yin pa/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo gcig tu grags/ /lam gyi bzhi ⑤mdo'am shing gcig drung ⑥/ /gdug pa ma lus gdul don du/ /phyag rgyar bcas pa'am gcig tu yang / /brtul zhugs sbyor bas gnas par byed/ /chu gling ri sul bla gab ( )med/ /der ni gcer bu'i rol pa yis/ /bdud rtsi za zhing rig ma dang //gcig par gnas pa'i spyod pa che/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ḍa (gyim rur bcas shing / /thod pa'i tshal bus rdzas khyer te/ /shin tu gsang bas spyod pa ni/ /bas mthar gnas pa dben pa'o/ /dur khrod rab son dge 'dun sar/ /chos kun bdag med mi rtog pas/ /rtog pa dor bas gnas pa gang / /dur khrod pa zhes brjod pa'o / /tha dad med pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /du ma'i snang ba ro mnyam pas/ /kun du bsod nams byed pa dag /ro snyoms ye shes spyod pa yin/ /'di dag ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /dge slong chen por shes par bya/ /tshangs par spyod pa mi ldog pas/ /kun du ye shes 'bral mi byed/ /'jig rten sgyu ma'i snang ba las / /chags pa 9 med pa'i dgra bcom pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 82—721

'thob 6)pa'o/ /gsang ba sbyangs pa'i tshul 'di ni/ /gzhan du rtogs par mi 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas bstan pa yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i dbang dang / spyod pa bstan pa'i le'u ste don gcig pa'o// //de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /chos rnams thams cad mi 'gyur te/ /thams cad dbang bskur ye shes mchog /ye shes dkyil 'khor gsang ba bshad/ /zhing 'dir rin chen bdun dag gisal/ /mkhas pas khyab par yongs bkang ste//khyad par ye shes bde don du/ /shes rab ldan pas bla mar dbul/ /de mdun yan lag rnam dag pas/ /dpe med rol pas dbul bar bya/ /khu ba byung bas rang lus las/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spro ba ste/ /rigs kyi lha rnams cho ga bzhin / /lus la nye bar dgod pa'o/ /ye shes 'bras bu thob 'dod pas/ /gnyis su med par btung bar bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor lo'i tshogs/ /bsdu ba nyid kyis nyer gsad pa / /'di ni dngos grub rgya khyimatsho yi/ /bla med 'bras bu thob 'gyur ba'o/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje stong pa nyid/ /dbus gnas mngon par byang chub brjod/ /de nyid me long ye shes ldan/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rab tu brtag /nyi ma mnyam nyid ye shes te/ /bdun dang ldan pa'i dbus nyid do/ /sngags ni dbus su gnas gyur gang / /sa bon so sor rtog pa ste / /mngon par byang chub pa nyid do/ /rdo rje la sogs gang gnas pa/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor bsgom 95)par bya/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku gsung 82—722

thugs / /zhal gsum rtsa gsum brjod par bya/ /sku gsum lus ngag yid yin te / /de nyid mngon par byang chub brjod/ /rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma dang / /nor bu ral gri 'bar ba las/ /rnam par 'phro ba bsam pa 6)ste/ /bla med ye shes byang chub brjod/ /spro dang sdud par byed pa'o/ /rnam pa'i ②mchog ni kun ldan pa / /skad cig gcig la rab rdzogs pa/ /rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes brjod do / /byang chub sems ni dag pa dang / /gsang sngags sa bon bskyed ①pa can/ /phyag rgya'i tshogs su brtags pa yis/ /rim gyis gzugs ni rdzogs byed ④pa/ /de ni bskyed par brjod pa ste/ /rnal 'byor cho ga yin par gsungs/ /de nas gsang ba'i dngos bsdus pa'i/ /ye shes bsam gtan gnyis kyis ni/ /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa yi/ /dngos po sreg byed ye shes med(snye/ /bsam gtan gnyis pos gcig tu yang / /stong nyid ngang du gnas byed pa'o/ /ril por 'dzin pa'i ting (7'dzin gyis/ /gzung ba'i rtog pa spong byed cing / /shes rab zab mo'i ngo bo nyid/ /de nyid bsdu ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /sgyu ma'i lus kyi ⑦snang ba nyid/ /dngos po'i chos nyid stong nyid 'jug /rjes su gzhig pas (kyeting nge 'dzin/ /'dzin pa'i rtog pa 'joms byed panyunye/ /thabs nyid rgya che'i rang bzhin can/ /de nyid spros pa'i tshul bstan pas/ /stong nyid gcig tu gnas pa ni/ /kun khyab ye shes mkha' mnyam 'gro/ /stong nyid ye shes chen po'i mes/ /rang bzhin rtog pa'i gnas ngan len/ /mngon rgyu bag chags bcas pa yi/ /rang bzhin brgya dang drug cu dang / /thog mtha' med pa'i byang chub sems/ /rang 'byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ngang / /dngos dang dngos min rtog pa'i tshogs/ /snang ba tsam du 'dzin med par/ /stong nyid 'od 82—723

gsal nam mkha' la/ /dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pas①/ /bde ②bar gshegs pa'i ngang ①du 'gro/ /de nyid kun khyab kun gyi duganas/ /brjod du med pa'i chos kyi sku/ /thams cad 'od gsal mngon ⑤byang chub/ /de ltar ma rtogs ma rig pas/ /sgyu ma ⑥lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin/ /de dag rab tu mi shes shing ske/ /thog med dus kyi nyon mongs kyi/ /bag chags rab tu bsags byed ⑦pa / /de dag sngon (kyigyi las kyis ni/ /skye dang 'chi bar 6)yang dag 'byung / /rig pa 'od gsal dbyings gnas kyang / /'gyu byed rlung las ma rig byung / /de las snang 7ba dang po dang / /mched ⑩pa dag dang thog kyipa dag /lugs su 'byung bas rnam shes la/ /rlung gi spyod 7pa shin tu 'khrul/ /nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa nyid/ /yid kyi rnam shes 'gyur chab yi/ /rlung las kun du 'khrul pa'i las/ /'byung ba kyide nyid kho na la/ /ma rig rmongs pas ltung ba ni/ /bla ma med phyir 'khyams pa'o/ /kun du brtags tshupa'i ma rig pa/ /dngas ⑩snyigs gnyis su rlung gis phye/ /dngas tsom stong nyid ye shes sems/ /kun gzhi rang byung chos nyid gnas/ /snyigs ma'i tu)snod bcud khams gsum du/ /dug gsum ngang las 'byung ba ni/ /srog 'dzin rlung las zhe sdang skyes/ /gyen rgyu las ni 'dod chags byung ( nya/ /gti mug khyab byed dus kun du/ /'bral ba med pas tsho rtaganas pa yin/ /de nas me dang mnyam pa las/ /phrag dog 'byung bar gyur pa yin/ /thur sel las ni nga rgyal dang / /ser sna mngon par byung ba yin/ /rlung rnams gang las 'byung ba ni/ /rig pa kun du rten gyur pa/ /sa bon cha las 'byung bzhi gnas/ /de las rtsa ba'i rlung du byung / /phyi rol 'od lnga'i snang ba las/ /zhen pas rgyu 'bras la rmongs shing (ste/ /ma rig pas 82—724

ni de dag las/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis tshul du 'khor/ /dug gsum las ni rtsa gsum ste/ /chags sdang dbang gis pho mor byung / /de phyir sngon 6)gyi las kyis ni/ /skye ba dang ni 'chi ②'phor 'gyur/ /rab tu dngas pa ②rnam par shes / /'od gsal byang chub gnas 'di yin/ /cung zad tsam du dngas pa labya / /bde ba las ni 'dod par gyur/ /gsal bas gzugs khams kun du skye / /mi rtog pas ni gzugs med du/ /nges par 'char ba chos nyid can/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yin/ /khams ni snyigs mar gyur pa las/ /kun du 'pho zhing rgyu byed pa'i/ /nus pa yon tan cung zad can/ /bskal pa dang po'i mi ltar 'byung / /yul gyis 'dod chags sad pa las/ /tshogs pa ma rnyed de srid du/ /bar ma do yi srid par gnas/ /srid par ltung ba'i sems can ni/ /bgrod pas 'gro ba ji bzhin du/ /las kyi dra ba'i zhags pa yis/ /'gro ba drug tu 'joms par byed/ /de nyid rgyu rkyen sngon 'gro bas/ /nyer len 'jug par 'dod pa dang / /rang dbang med par 'jug pa dang / /skyabs gnas tshol (snyeba'i yid 'gro bas/ /'phen pa stobs byung 'jug par 'gyur/ /gal te mi ru skye ba na/ /pha ma'i kun du 'khrig mthong bas/ /sdug bsngal nyid kyis gdungs gyur te/ /bzhon par bcas pa'i myur 'gro ltar/ /rlung gi bzhin ( phyirapa la brten te/ /skad cig thang cig yud tsam la/ /shin tu myur bar 'ongs gyur pa/ /dga' dang bcas pa'i bsam pa yis/ /bde ba'i ngang du sems zhen pas/ / kha yi myuralam nas thur du 'jug /ngan 'gro'i gnas la pha yi ni/ /bshang ba'i lam nas khang bzangs su/ /mthong nas kun du 'jug par 'gyur/ /dus der pha ma gnyis dang ni/ /dus gcig bde ba myong byas pa'i/ /rtsa phran 82—725

stong phrag bdun cu las/ /rab brgyud de yi ①skad cig la/ /ā li kā lir zhugs gyur te②/ /mchog tu dga' ba yang dag 'thob/ /khu ba dang ni khrag bcas pa'i/ /dbus su bar do'i shes pa ni/ /'dus pa thig le'i gzugs su gnasal/ /dang po'i rnam pa nur nur po/ /de las mer mer po ru gyur/ /ltar ltar po dang gor gor po/ /rlung rnams kyis ni bskul gyur pas/ /sha yi rnam pa mkhrang gyur du/ /lnga pa'i dus su rkang lag 'gyul/ /yan lag lnga ni dod gyur pas / /bdun du gyur tshe mtshan ma dang / /skra dang sen mo ba spu'i tshogs/ /mkhrang ba'i cha shas ④rdzogs gyur pa'o/ /brgyad pa'i dus su cher rtags rgyashing / /zla ba dgu na (7lus kun rdzogs/ /bcu pa yul gyi rtsol ba byed/ /nur nur rang bzhin mi bskyod pa/ /mer mer po ni dkon mchog dpal/ /ltar ltar po ni 'od dpag med/ /gdon mi za ba gor gor po/ /rnam snang mkhrang ⑨gyur dag tu brjod/ /gnas skabs 'byung ba lnga ldan pa(kyi/ /chu dang rlan gyis sdud pa dang ske/ /drod dang me yis smin par byed/ /sas 6)ni brtan yidang bskyed ()pa las / /rlung gis g.yo zhing 'phel bar byed/ /nam mkha' kun du rten gyur pa'o / /dri chu khrag ni 'dus pa yi/ /dri chu'i cha ni mi bskyod zhugs/ /bzhi tsomanyam rnam par snang mdzad de/ /khrag ni 'dod chags (nyamed pa'i cha/ /sha ni rin chen rgyal po nyid/ /khu ba gdon mi za ba'i lus/ /zla ba me long ye shes te//nyi ma mnyam pa nyid gyur pa/ /sa bon rnam 7pa so sor rtog /phyag mtshan las ni de nyid de/ /thams cad gcig gyur nan tan brjod/ /lus kyi snyigong bu bsdus pa yisayi/ /stong nyid chos dbyings ye shes brjod/ /mngon par byang chub lnga yis ni/ /bskyed dang gnas dang sdud 7par mdzad/ /de nyid ye shes 82—726

yongs dag pa/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi byang chub sems/ /gsang ba mchog tu bstan pa yin/ /skye gnas dbus su rtsa gnyis ni/ /g.yas dang g.yon na de bzhin gnas/ /g.yon nas khu ba de bzhin te/ /g.yas na ①de bzhin khrag yin na② / /de dag gcig tu gyur pa ni/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin no/ /las kyi sa bon dbang thob pas/ /rlung gis yang dag bsgyur nas ni/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas pad+ma'i snod/ /gdong ni nges par phyogs par gyur/ /dku ⑧ g.yas su ni brten nas su/ /tsog pur mngon par phyogs te gnas/ /dku ④g.yon yang dag brten nas ni/ /shes rab g.yas su mngon par phyogs/ /sa bon lhung bas ⑤dus kyis ni/ /mkhas pas dus kyis skad cig las/ /nges par brtag ⑥par bya ba yin/ /g.yon nas rlung ni rgyu ba na⑦/ /thams cad du ni skyes bur byed/ /g.yas nas nges par rgyu ba ni/ /kun du bu mor 'byung ba yinam/ /thabs dang shes rab cha las ni/ /bzlog pa'i go rims dushes par bya /gnyis ku'i dbus su rgyu bas 6)na/ /ma ning dang ni za mar ⑩'byung / /'di dag 'gyur ba ngo shes pas/ /thob pa mtshan nyid brtag par bya/ /'di ltar gsang ba'i lus 'byung ba/ /bskyed dang gnas pa 'jig tshul du/ /'dir ni rgyas par bstan pa'o/ /de ltar bcom ldan mgon gsungs la/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs/ /thams cad dgyes pa bskyed gyur cing / /kun du bzang po'i tshul 'di zhus/ /mngon par byang chub ye shes las/ /rigs kyi yistekhyad par 'byung ba'i don/ /'gro ba sangs rgyas rnam pa can/ /ngo bo nyid shes snying po'i gnas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas gang gsungs pa/ /gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes dang / /'du byed rnams ni phung po ru/ /rags 7dang phra dang shin 82—727

tu phra/ /lus 'di dngos po'i tshul rtogs pas/ /phung por nges par skyes pa yin/ /srid pa skye ba'i rim shes pas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir / /'di ni rnam pa kun mkhyen pa'i/ /ye shes mchog gi gnyen gyis gsungs1) / /de dag sgrib pa rnam sel sogs/ /kun gyis thos 97shing khong chud la / /legs so legs so zhes brjod cing / /ngo mtshar gyur cing rmad byung ba'i//dgongs pa cang ni mi gsung bzhugs/ /'di dag chos kun rab tu zhi zhing gnyis med pa/ /phyogs bcu kun nas snang ba'i rgyal ba de bzhin gshegs/ /dus gsum sems can khams rnams 'dul ba'i dbang bskur ba/ /lam rgyud ma lus gnas las grol byed mchog 'dir rgyal/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las sangs rgyas thams cad kyis sems can gyi khams bskyed pa dang bsdu ba'i don bstan pa'i le'u ste bdun cu 6)gnyis pa'o// //de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /gsang ba dpal ldan byang chub sems/ /srid zhi mnyam par sdud mdzad pa/ /'bar ba drag pos tshul 'di gsungs/ /dpal ldan yid bzhin nor bu'i gnas/ /spyod pa sbyin pa'i tshul bstan pa/ /gsang ba 'gro ba'i dgos 'dod skong / /nor ster lcam dral 'dir bstan pa'o/ /ṭ+wāṃ rgyu lda/ 'phags pa yid bzhin nor bu'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag drug gser gyi mdog /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan spras pa/ /sku mdog las byung rigs 'phro bas / /don grub rgyal pos dbu brgyan pa/ /g.yas pa sngo zhing g.yon dmar ba/ /82—728

dang po gnyis kyis ne'u le yi/ /kha nas skyug byed nor bu 'dzin/ /g.yas g.yon 0)gzhan gyis rgyal mtshan dang / /bī ②dza pu ra ③rin chen gyi/ /bzang po'i lisnod bcas 'dzin par bsam/ /de las gsang ba bdud rtsi'i chu/ /rtsa lam lag mthil brgyud phyinas ni/ /dbul ba mkhas pa dag gis bya/ /nyin re zhing du mchod byas nas(5)/ /de la dngos grub nges ster byed/ /'phags ma nor ldan ma bskyed pa/ /zhal gsum phyag drug gur kum ⑦mdog /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ljang spyan gsum/ /dang po pi tsu da (nyal dang / /g.yon pas 'bru yi (1)snye ma 'dzin/ /lhag mas bum pa pad+ma snod/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpal be'u 'dzin/ /'di ni rin chen sna tshogs pa'i/ /phreng ba 'od 'phro bsam par bya/ /de las spro dang bsdu ba ni/ /gnod sbyin mo ni rnam mang po/ /zla ba bzang dang rab bzang ma/ /bde sbyin ma dang stobs chen mo/ /lha mo bkra shis sbyin pa mo/ /dpal sbyin ma dang don grub ma/ /rab dgyes bde sbyin mi 'khrugs tsom/ /yang dag rgyan ma 'di rnams te/ /'khor los yongs su legs bskor ma/ /rin chen gzhal /1yas khang nyugeganas pa'i/ /lha mo rnams la dus gsum du/ /bsreg spos dbul zhing yi phrin las gzhol/ /'di ni gsang ba ma lus pa'i/ /gnod sbyin mo yi rtog 8par gsungs/ /'di las 'da' bar byed pa ni/ /gsang ba tshul gnas ma yin natshe/ /de nas bcom ldan 7de bzhin gshegs / /'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba yi4 tsho/ /gsung gi rnam par 'phrul pa yi / /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /'di nyid de ma thag phyung nas/ /ye shes dam pa bka' stsal to/ /hrīḥshin tu dben zhing rab tu nyams dga' bar/ /dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug bsgom par bya/ /de nyid nam mkha'i dbyings 82—729

kyi dbus gnas par/ /gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab tu bsgom par bya de yi 6)dbus gnas sa bon dmar por 'phro/ /de las spro bsdu'i 'od kyi snang ba las / /ma lus 'gro tshogs legs par sbyangs nas ni/ /dag par byed ②pa'i sa bon la zhugs te/ /pad+ma ge sar du'od bcas yongs gyur pas/ /skad cig de las rje btsun spyan ras gzigs/ /zhal gsum phyag drug pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs/ /g.yas pa kun+da li.ut+pal sngo 'dra g.yon/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan spras thugs rje can / /dang po gnyis kyis ye shes rig ma la/ /rdo rje se gol sbyor bas 'khyud par snyemadzad/ /bar mas pad+ma sdong bu nor bu 'dzinadu/ /tha mas ral gri 'khor lo bsnams (7pa'o/ /dar gyi 6)cod pan sna tshogs kyis brgyan mdzes/ / de yi ⑨thugs kur zla ba la gnas pa/ /rang srog sa bon hrīḥyig rnam par bsam/ / de yi bo'od zer ma lus tshogs 'phros (nyupas/ /'gro ba ma lus don ni phun tshogs pa'o/ /rtog pa'i rtog ma ma lus sel byed pa/ /thub pa'i dbang po tsophyogs mtshams 1snyerab 'phros pas8/ /sna tshogs nor bu 7'gro ba'i don mdzad nasam/ /slar 'dus rang la 8phyung ba'i dkyil 'khor pa'i/ /'khor lo'i lha tshogs du ma bsam par bya/ /rdo rje chen po'i snying po yi/ /kha dog dkar po rnam par bsam/ /(ཿkyi'od kyi ḍo/)sprin gyis shin tu 'bar/ /zla ba'i 'od zer bzhin du bsil/ /gnas bzhi dag tu sbyor ba yi()/ /de ma thag tu 'byung bar byed / /lan gsum legs par bsgoms ( nyapas ni/ /skyug pa dag tu rnam bsams nas/ /nam mkha' 6nyagang ba'i dug ( )kun yang / /de ma thag tu med par byed/ /'di ni dngos kyi 6)dug zhi bar byed pa'o/ /āḥ'abras dang phol mig 'brum bu dang / /gang gzhan nad du bshad pa rnams/ /phyag na rdo rje'i 82—730

bka' bzhin du/ /bsam ①pa tsam gyis med par 'gyur/ /pad+ma 'bar ba 'dab ②brgyad pa/ / de yi sridabus su dug bsams ④nas/ /'od zer lnga ni rdzogs par spro/ /dug bsdu ba ni kha dog nag /bskul ba'i 0zhi byed dkar po yin / /bsam gtan gnas ni gsang ⑥ba gang / /ye shes dri med gsang chen yin / /de la 'dis ni nye ⑦ba'i dug /thams cad drang ba'i snying po'o/ /gang du sa bdag klu las gyur/ /gnod pa ngan pa byung gyur pa/ /'dis ni skad cig dag gis kyang / /nges par zhi bar byed pa yin/ /dpal ldan seng ge sgra sbyor bas / /gdug pa'i 'tshe ba zhi byed pa/ /pad sdong thod pa bdud rtsi (shebacas/ /de ni me tog rab bkang ba/ /tri shul kyi)sa gsum gnas las skyobs0/ /rgyal po rol pa'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /thugs rjes dug sel bar mdzad pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dam tshig chen po (nyede kho na nyid 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas dam tshig chen po'i rdo rje gsum gyi tsogasang ba gsang tsob gsum gyi tsodam tshig gi 8de kho na nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyungs pa'o⑩/ /na maḥs man+ta kā ya bārtsit+ta yon badzā 〈(she/ oṃ āḥ.usnri 4)ga badz+ra/ tsakra birnyis )/ bi tsār/ usnri sosteg ( shebi dza ya/tsakra bin+tiḥ6) rgyu r+ghaṃ rgyu(ste/ hūm̐ rtsu rgyu(nye/ a mu kai mā ra ya phaṭa/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /rig pa'i rgyal po rjes su dran/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sku gsum la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par bsgoms(be/ /zhags pa rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin / /sangs rgyas 'gugs ( tshopa dam tshig yin/ /sangs rgyas sku gsum sbyor ba yin // /'khor lo tsochen po'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal chen po / /rtag tu nges par 'gugs zhu dpar 'gyur/ /'di ni ye shes me sbyor bas(nya/ /82—731

spar ba'i 0)dngos grub gnas thob byed/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ②rdo rje che/ /rdo rje lcags kyu'i 'od zer gyis/ /sngags ③rnams thams cad 'gugs pa'i mchog /rdo rje las byung thams cad pa/ /rang sngags geskyes bu (5)bsgoms nas ni/ /rab tu mdzes ma'i mchog rnams kyis( )/ /snying gar shudzhardo rje 'bar bar (0sbyar/ /rlung gi po)dkyil 'khor sbyor ba yis/ /nges par rtag tu 'gugs par 'gyur/ /sku gsung thugs kyi kyirdo rje 'am/ /rang sngags don gyi (17yon tan gyis/ /gtsug tor 8'khor los 8sgyur sbyor bas/ /bka' yi 'khor lo sbyar bar bya/ /sngags kun bsrung phyir ye shes mchog /rdo rje can gyis bya ba ste/ /'di ni rdo rje ma lus pa'i/ /byang chub srung yiba'i don ⑫chen bya/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi sku ye shes rdo rjes de skad ces gsungs so/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor /tshadam pa ni/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus su bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /rdo rje rta mgrin du bsgom pa/ /khro bo'i 'od zer mang po dag /thams cad du ni rnam par 'phro/ /klu rnams ma lus zhabs kyis mnan/ /mthong ba dang ni reg pa dang / /kha rlangs dug rnams zhi byed pa / /klu rnams kyis 7ni rgyan du byas/ /kha dog 'bar ba dmar ba'i sku/ /rdzogs sangs dpag med dbu rgyan can/ /bsams na rdo rje can 'di mnyes/ /'di ni ye shes rdo rje can/ /khro bo kun gyi dam tshig ste/ /gsang ba nye bar bstan pa yin/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos tshe dpag tu med pa rdo rje 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas pad+mo 'byung ba'i khro bo chen po 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung (1snyedang thugs rdo rje las rab tu phyung ngo / /o na maḥs man+ta kā ya bārtsit+ta badzā 67shā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra kro dha pad+mān+ta kṛta 8)ha ya sgyu 9 nye82—732

ba rdzu hūm̐ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas 'di ni gsungs 6)tsam gyis/ /chos kyi rdo rje che mchog skyes/ /de nas 'jigs shing brgyal ②bar 'gyur/ /ye shes rgyal po rjes su dran/ /mkha' dbyings dug gis yongs gang ba/ /rdo rje ha la ha la (kye'odam/ /khro bo'i rgyal po bskul ba yis/ /dug rnams skad cig gis med byed/ /rdo rje rta mchog bskyed pa 'byung ba rdo rjes gsungs so/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus su bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab ④bsgoms la/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bcud gyur mchog /'bar ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba can/ /rdo rje sprin ni kun du 'khrugs(snye/ /khros shing khro bcas gnag pa dang ne/ /mche ba rab tu rno ba ni/ /rnga sgra'i dam tshig dbu brgyan pa/ /bsgoms na khro bo mchog 'di mnyes/ /'di ni khro bo thams cad kyis/ /'da' bar dka' ba'i dam tshig yin/ /bcom ldan 'das sku rdo rje'i (6)dam tshig gi 'od zer (pestug po'i mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas khro bo mi 'chi gsang ba 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang (8)thugs rdo rje'i dam tshig 'di rab tu phyung ngo / /oṃ āḥhū/ oṃ āḥ5)bighan+ta kṛta tsho —)a mṛ 517ta kuṇ+ḍa li tsho ha na ha na hūṃ 4)phaṭa/ rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyal po che/ /rdo rje phur bu rab tu bsgom/ /'bar ba me stag yi'aphro ba yisatso/ /phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor la gdab bya/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yisatso/ /gdug cing khro ba tshar gcad zhu la/ /sangs rgyas gzugs kyi dngos gyur pa/ /rdo rje'i 9/2sbyor bas byas pa na/ /spyi bo dang ni mgrin pa dang / /snying ga nas ni rkang pa'i bar/ /rdo rje phur bus nyu rab tu bsgom / /dam tshig 'di las 'da' mi bya/ /'di ni phur bu'i (2 nirnam par 'phrul / /bsam gtan rdo rje phur bu yis/ /sangs rgyas dag kyang nges par 82wa 733

'debs / /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /phur bus 0)btab na med par 'gyur / /mi yi rus pa'i phur bu ni/ /rdo rje sku yi phur bu ste/ /gti mug gnas la (migadab par bya/ /pho rlung dag pa'i gnas gyur pa'o/ /seng ldeng rtsa li 5phur bu ni/ /rdo rje gsung gi phur bu ste/ /'dod chags gnas la gdab bya ba/ /mo rlung dag pa'i gnas gyur pa'o/ /lcags las byas pa'i ④rdo rje gces(5)ske/ /rdo rje thugs kyi phur pa (6)ste/ /ma ning rlung ni gnas gyur byed/ /zhe sdang gnas la nges gdab ⑦yin/ /dngos po tha dad 'dzin pa yi/ /ye shes (kyesku gsum 'jig byed 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 6)mnyam bzhag pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyi sku yi kyimathar/ /rig ma'i bha ga'i (stodakyil 'khor gnas gyur pa/ /de dag gsal bar dmigs nas ni/ /lha rnams gnad la dbab 7bya ba/ /byin rlabs shin tu myur 'dod pas/ /'od 'phro 'khrug nya cing mdangs ldan pa'i/ /gzugs brnyan rdo rje (7phur bu yi7/ /bha ga la ni nges gdab yipa/ /'di nyid sku gsung thugs gyur pa'i/ /rdo rje phur bu'i sbyor ba can/ /sku gsung thugs gsum lha bskyed pa/ /gnas gang 6)du ni snyoms yo 'jug pas/ /phur bus yigadab par gyur pa yin/ /gsang ba'i pad+ma nyams dga' bar/ /rdo rje phur bu ling ga yi tsho/ /byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi yis/ /bdud rtsi 'bab pas phur gdab yin/ /bsam gtan rdo rje'i sbyor ba yis/ /rang gi phyag rgya'i bha gar ni//bde bas phur bu nges par 'debs/ /de yi de ma thag tu yang / /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /lus kun la ni gnas gyur pa'i/ /lha rnams bdud rtsi'i cha dag tu/ /nges par zhu bas de las bskul/ /shin tu zhu bar gyur pa las/ /byang sems bde ba'i khu ba dag /snang ba dkyil 'khor bdag nyid 82—734
