de / /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /phur bus btab ①na nges par 'chi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum/ /gsang ba'i tshul la gnas pa yis/ /rtsa rlung byang chub sems rnams ni/ /bde stong gnyis med gyur pas na/ /'chi ba zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /phyi rol nad gdon nyon mongs dag /bdud bzhi bcom pas ldang bar 'gyur/ /gsang ba dam pa bsdus pa yis / /snying po mchog tu 'byung ba nyid/ /rdo rje phur bu bstan pa gdab par bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin bstan pa'o/ /de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /'gro ba'i gnod pa zhi byed pa/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rgyas pa po/ /de nyid ngang la ①gnas par gyur//bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad dpal/ /sku yi rnam par 'phrul pa ni/ /nges 'byung rdo rje'i ting 'dzin la/ /snyoms par zhugs te tshul 'di gsungs/ /'od 'phro 'khrug cing mdangs bzang ba'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mnyam bzhag ④nas/ /rdo rje gsum gyi sku yi mthar/ /gzugs brnyan bsams nas sbyang bar bya/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor mchog dag ni/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus bsams pa/ /sngags kyi rdo rje rnam pa bzhi/ /'dis ni rdo rje gnas gsum byed//chos nyid ye shes ngang las bsdus pa yis/ /stong nyid byang chub sems kyi ngang nyid las/ /rang byung rten dang brten ⑤par bcas pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo ⑨spro dang bsdus ( )byas la/ /hūm̐ dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba/ /gur kum (0bzang po'i mdog can 6)dmar ser la/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i zhal ni dkar dang sngo/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa yi/ /phyag gnyis shes rab dam pa 'khyud pa dang / /mdangs ldan ral gri dang ni ut+pa la/ /shes rab mda' gzhu legs par 'dzin pa mdzad/ /de nyid shin tu gsal ba'i 82—735

sku ru bsgom/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun gyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /sa bon rgyas gdab de 'dra gnyis med bstim0)/ /ye shes dbang bskur dam pas rgyas gdab bya/ /ma lus rigs kyi 'khor lo spro ba yi/ /tshul gnas ye shes spyod pa ②go 'phang nyid/ /sa yi snying po phyag na rdo rje dang / /nam mkha'i snying po 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bar bcas/ /dpal ldan kun du bzang po zhes bya ba/ /de dag mig la sogs pa grangs bzhin du'ol/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro dag dang / /reg bya dang ni chos dbyings rdo rje dang / /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung rnams ni/ /ngo bo nyid gyur spyan la sogs par grags/ /gzugs dang tshor ba de bzhin 'du shes dang / /'du byed dang ni rnam par shes bshad pa/ /rnam par snang mdzad la sogs bde gshegs te/ /rdo rje sa bon gyis ni dbyung bar bya/ /ṭī rdza khaṃ gi ṭ+wāṃ saṃ zhes bshad pa/ /'di dag mig la sogs pa rnams kyi yin/ /dzaḥyis baṃ hoḥ༅kho ro zhes bshad pa/ /de dag gzugs kyi rdo rje la sogs pa'o/ / māṃ lī māṃ ṭ+wāṃ (5)zhes bya bzhir bshad pa/ /de dag spyan la sogs pa rnams kyi yin/ /r+ghaṃ i rdza (7)khaṃ hūm̐ zhes bya ba dag /rim pa ji bzhin rtag pa la sogs pa'i(7) rang rang gi ni ngo bo rnam dag pa/ /rim bzhin sku yi rdo rje la sogs gyur/ /dpal ldan rdo rje na'adzin pa lta bur ni/ /chos nyid kyis ni phan tshun khyad par med(9)/ /phyin ci log gi rtog pa las grol bas/ /bya ba ma lus par ni rdzogs par bya/ /thub pa'i 'khor lo ma lus mchod par bya/ /mchog 'di de dag kun du rab tu dbul//zas la spyod tshe snying ga'i zla ba yi/ /'khor lo'i gtso bo rang gi gsang sngags kyis / /kun du dmigs te byang chub sems kyis ni/ /ngo bo nyid gyur 'od dang 82—736

ldan par bsam/ /dngos po de dag gsum gyis bzlas bya ste/ /thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rnam dag pa0)/ /de nyid sku yi rdo rje la sogs pa/ /lha rnams kun du tshim pa nyid du bya/ /phyi yi sbyin sreg (2cho ga ji lta bar/ /yid kyi spyod yul sems kyis bya ba ste/ /phung po'i bud shing rnam par sreg byed pa/ /ye shes 'bar ba bla na med par bshad/ /dam tshig nyams la snying gar zla ba la/ /snying po sna tshogs rdo rje ji bzhin bsam/ /dpal ldan dam tshig rdo rje rnal 'byor pas / /'gro ba rang bzhin gyis dag ①rnam bsams la/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i 'dab (snyama'i dbus su nizhu)/ /sngar gyi rim pas dbang bskur kun du blang / /phyi rol dag tu khrus kyi cho ga la/ /rim 'dir khyad par yang dang yang bsam bya/ /thun mtshams rnams su (6)de bzhin mchod la sogs/ /sngon du 'gro ba'i bzlas brjod byas nas ni/ /snying ga'i 'khor lo'i nang du chud par bya/ /snying rje shes rab ldan pas dbyings su nyal/ /ldang ba'i dus su dam tshig lha mo yi/ /yang dag glu yis dpa' bo yongs bskul ba'itshur/ /ldang bas thub pa (8)bzlas brjod la po)sogs pa'i/ /cho ga snga ma bzhin du bya ba yin/ /dngos grub nye ba'i mtshan ma mthong nas ni/ /de nyid gsum brjod byas nas rang gi sems/ /sngar bshad dkyil 'khor dag la gnas nas ni/ /rang 'dod go 'phang the tshorab tu bsgrub bya yin/ /bgegs rnams bdud rtsi thab /1sbyor 'khor lo yi/ /bsrung ba bka' yi ke'akhor lo rab sbyar bya/ /de nyid bdud las rnam par rgyal byed yin/ /dbang bskur byas pa'i 'bad pas nges par gzhom/ /gang zhig dbus su gnas par gyur pa kyi yi/ /'khor lo de yang de yi cho 'phrul 'gyur/ /tha mal rnam rtog r+sārgyun las ma gtogs par/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal yod pa ma yin te/ /de ni 82—737

rnam par 'gog par 'gyur ba'i sems/ /sems ni mngon sum byin brlabs ①kyis mngon 'gyur/ /zab cing rgya che ba yi ②bdag nyid can/ /der ni kun rtog gang yin snang mi 'gyur/ /yang dag sems las tha dad ma yin nizhing / /kun brtags mtshan ma sngar ni bsgrub log pas/ /srid pa lan cig tsam du ldang mi nus/ /gang du ldog pa med pas bgrod phul byung ④/ /'dir ni mthong ba dang ni bslabs 'phel bas/ /rnam dag rtog pa yang dag 'gog pa ste/ /tha mal pa yi rang gzugs dngos po yis/ /bdag med sbyin sogs mi zad gter mi 'gyur/ /'dir ni gnas med ye shes dge ba'i lam/ /'dir ni bden yang der ni ldog mi 'gyur/ /de ltar rtogs nas ①snying rjer ldan pa dag /ye shes bsam yas 7skad cig gis bsgrubs pa/ /dpal ldan kun du bzang po'i ngo bo nyid/ /mkhas pas gang zhig nges par bsam mi byed/ /gang du dpal ldan 'dus pa'i lam las ni/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams kyis bgrod ⑦pa'i don//rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ye shes dam pa'i gzhidu/ /tshad med byang chub rgyan gyur gsang ba'o / /'di ni mtshungs med dam pa mchog gi gnas/ /dug lnga'i rtog pa de nyid ngo bo nyid/ /yongs su shes pa'i lam gyur bsam mi khyab/ /'phags pa nyan thos dgra bcom zag pa zad/ /de la thog mar rgyun du zhugs pa dang / /phyir mi 'ong dang lan cig phyir zhugs pa/ /de dag 'khor ba dag par 'dod pa'i lam/ /rang sangs rgyas ni 'byung tshul gnyis su gnas/ /smon lam 'bras bu thob pa ngal bso'i 6)lam/ /byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i rgyal po ltar/ /ri dgas ⑩phya mo skrag byed 'dir 'byung ba/ /ngang pa 7glang chen khyu mchog rtsal gyis ni/ /ri dgas 7seng ge sha ra ṇa 7mchog dang / /mkha' lding ga ru ḍa li tso82—738

lding gyur pa/ /'brug sgra sgrogs byed cang shes rta yi rtsal/ /bya khyung chen po shang shang ru ru ste/ /ri bong dag gis rang spyod shugs bstan pa'o/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 6)nor bu gnas pa'i gzhi/ /klu dbang rnams dang chu srin chen po dang / /ltos 'gro za byed shin tu mi bzad ②pas/ /rus sbal dung ltar ma 'dres gnas byas pa/ /de las (minu tig la sogs sna tshogs pa/ /gang du yon tan ldan yang bag med gnas/ /bag la nyal ba'i phyogs ni zlog pa gnyis/ /skabs las ma bab nus pa 'byung mi nus/ /sa bon phra mo kun nas ldang ba na④/ /dus la bab tshe slu ba med par 'byung / /ded dpon thabs la mkhas pa'i gzings bcas pas / /thar pa thob byed yan lag kun ldan pas/ /rin chen nor bus dgos pa rab sgrub pa/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rgyud du shes par bya/ /dbang thob byed pa rdo rje'i theg pa 'dir/ /bum pa bzhi ldan lam bgrod rdo rje dang / /dkyil 'khor chos 'byung pad+ma'i sdong por 'byung / /sa lam khyad par rigs dang ldan pa'i chos/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal rin chen bdun ldan pa'i/ /gsang ba'i (dems 'jug yas babs tshul shes pas/ /spre'u khwa ta'i (phyiratshul las (7bstan pa yin//rdo rje gsum dang zla ba nyi ma dang / /mun pa dag gis rtogs pa gang yin pa/ /me long gzugs brnyan rdo rje sems dpa'i sku/ /ye shes 'ja' tshon chu yi zla bar ston / /me 'od 'bar bas kun nas snang ba che/ /des 57khyab kun du ston pa de bzhin gshegs/ /rigs kyi sku dang sa bon mtshan mar snang / /de nyid sangs rgyas mchog tu 'byung ba las/ /de dag gnas skabs phrin (9)las dngos grub kun / /du ma'i mthu stobs yon tan dpal du 'char7/ /du ba spre)smig rgyu srin bu me khyer ba/ /mar me 'bar dang mkha' snang dag pa ste/ /sna tshogs rtags dang 82wa 739

yon tan mi zad pa/ /grub pa spyod pas rgyu 'bras tha dad pa/ /ma 'dres yongs su dag pa dus 1)med pa/ /bskal pa grangs med skad cig sgyu ma yis/ /gsum gyi dus la 'da' ba dbang phyug mchog /kha sbyar bde chen sku ni rdo rje 'chang ⑧/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po dpal ldan byang chub sems/ /des ni dag dang ma dag zhing khams su/ /mdzad pa rgya mtsho 8sprul pa'i snang ba yang / /bsam gyis mi khyab ye shes rol par ston/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dang po'i mgon por ni/ /spros med bde chen mi 'gyur gcig pa nyid/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i rang byung ngang la bzhugs/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / 'dus pa rnams kyis dgyes pas yongs su khyab cing sems kyi rtog pa yongs su chod de cang mi smra bar rang rang gi stan la 'dug par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba la gnas 8)par bstan pa'i le'u ste bdun cu (gegasum pa'o// //de nas gsang ba rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje rgyal po 'khor lo'i gtso/ /bdag med ye shes rgyal po che/ /ci yang mi gsung bzhugs pa la/ /rdo rje dpal mchog chen po yi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' che/ /ma lus kun gyis bkur 6)bar mdzad/ /'dir ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba'i gnas ni dag pa nyid/ /gsungs shig gsungs shig 97)tshul chen po/ /yid dang ye shes spyod pa las/ /dam tshig mchog 'di 98)bstan du gsol/ /de nyid nye bar dgongs gyur nas/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /gsang (9)ba'i tshul ni rgya mtsho 82—740

ltar / /zab cing rgya che tshitshul bstan te/ /sngags kyi spyod pa tshad med cing / /sangs rgyas ye shes bsam ②mi khyab/ /rigs kyi phyi rol phyag rgya che/ /'di las gzhan du ma rtog cig /rigs kyi bu rnams mdor bsdu na/ /'di ltar sngags kyi spyod pa ni/ /btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang dag tu/ /'dod yon mngon par rol gyur kyang / /zag med bde ba chen po yi/ /ye shes kun du spyod pas na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod pa yin/ /dba' nirlabs med pa'i rang bzhin gyis//rtog med lhan cig skyes par 'char/ /rigs kyi bu lidag 'di lta ste/ /dper na nam mkha'i khams 'di ni/ /kun gyi (7rjes su song ba ste/ /chos rnams ma lus dkyil 'khor dag /nam mkha'i khongs su gtogs pa'o/ /de bzhin chos rnams ma lus pa/ /de dag ngo bo nyid dag pas/ /khams gsum kun du mi gnas shing / /'byung ba bzhi la gnas mi byed/ /gang du 'gro 'ong rnam bral ba'o / /rigs kyi bu de des bsten na/ /ngo bo nyid kyi (5)dag pa yi/ /chos rnams de ltar rjes rig bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /don gyi dbang ni bla na med/ /'di ltar mkhyen pas 'chang mdzad pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu rnams de ltar na/ /nam mkha'i tshig ltar nges brjod pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ⑦tshig dag kyang / /de dag de ltar rjes rig (7bya/ /'di ni gsang ba'i gnas yin no/ /chos can gcig la rtog pa ni/ /rnam pa sna tshogs snang ba yin / /bde sdug 'gro bar 'byung ba rnams/ /las kyi khyad par goms ri9༄pa'i phyir / /de phyir dge dang mi dge'i las/ /lus la tshesogs pa'i rnam rtog byung / /rtog pa thams cad med grol maXsto/ /der rtog yi pa la gnas pa med/ /rtog pa las ni ye shes med/ /ma rtogs nyes pas ye shes 'joms/ /mi rtogs /shepa 82—741

las rtog pa ru/ /ldog pa nam yang mi srid do/ /gzhan du rtog pa'i gnyen po ru / /ye shes bsam pa ma yin te/ /spang bya gnyen po gnyis med pas/ /gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang nyid du/ /skye 'byedang 'gag par mi 'gyur ro/ /de nyid bsam pa rdzogs pa'i lam/ /nges par 'di ni rtogs pa rtags/ /ngo bo rgyu tshul 'byung ba khams/ /las dang dbye ba de nyid rlung / /'byung 'jug gnas pa rnam par brtag /'bru gsum sngags kyi ②ngo bo nyid/ /ā li kā li sbyor dbul bas/ /brtag pa grangs ldan bzlas ①pa nyid/ /sbyor dang byed ④par rtags ldan pa/ /ngag dben rlung gi rnal 'byor brtan/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu sbyor ba gang / /snang ba gsum po 'char tshul te/ /dus dang 'byung (ge'agyur thabs khyad par/ /dbyer med ye shes gnas thob pa/ /spyod pa ye shes mngon du byed/ /slob dang mi slob der spyod pa'o/ /rang 6)bzhin shes pa'i lam gyur pa / /rnam shes sgyu mar mtshan pa'i ༷chos/ /khyad par las dang spyod pa gang / /dngos grub thob phyir bdag byin brlab/ /phyi nang mngon par byang chub tshul/ /rnal 'byor thob pa'i bsam gtan gnas/ /'jug dang 'byung ba rtags (mibacas pas/ /spyod tshul ye shes des 'thob bo/ /lta dang nyams myong po)lus dang ngag /bsam gtan mnyam rjes spyod pa dang / /slob dang mi slob gnyis med cing ske/ /rab tu mi gnas zung du 'jug /ji ltar gsungs pa'i sdom ldan pas / /ji skad thob pa mnyam par spyod/ /dam tshig med la blo ldan gyis/ /gzhan la gsang ba 'dus rig bya/ /snying rje yiganas pa las byed pa/ /sangs rgyas mchod dang 'gro don dag /mthong na lus dang ngag las 'byung / /phyag rgya sngags kyi bdag nyid do/ /'di ni gsang ba nges bstan pa/ /yan lag kun 82—742

bsgoms las 'das shing / /rtog pa'i tshul ni rnam spangs nas/ /gug skyed ①thig le las 'das pa/ /'dir ni dkyil 'khor mchog yin no/ /sems can thams cad 'jug pa ni/ /rang bzhin med pa'i rang bzhin spangs/ /sems ni skul ②zhing rtog byas pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor lta bu'o/ /yod dang ⑧med pa gnyis ka mtha' yin te/ /dag dang ma dag gnyis ka 'di yang mtha'/ /de bas mtha' gnyis rnam par spangs nas ni/ /mkhas pas dbus la'ang gnas par mi byed do/ /gang du nyan rang theg la mi bslab cing / /byang chub spyod pa de la nges bslabs na/ /byang chub spyod pa spyad pas rgyal yon tan/ / gling bzhi ④'di las rab ༷byung chen por 'gyur/ /chos thams cad 'gro ba dang 'ong ba med pa'i spyod yul la gnas pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i 'khor lo spro ba dang sdud pa'i bdag nyid can gyis yis bon yang dag par phyung ngo / /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed sbyar ba las/ /gang du phreng ba bkod ⑦par byed/ /sde tshan drug pa'i gsum pa dang / /gsum pa yi (0ni gsum pa dang / /mthar gnas pa yi po)gnyis pa sbyar/ /lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa la/ /an+ta thi yi gnyis pa sbyin/ /gnyis pa'i gsum pas mtha' brten ⑩pa/ /dbyangs kyi bzhi pas brgyan par bya/ / urmi yi ni ⑩mthar gyur pa/ /gnyis pa'i thig le 8brgyan pa nyid/ /dbyangs kyi drug pas 0brgyan pa ni/ /mi bskyod pa yi tsogasang sngags brjod/ /gsum pa yi ni gsum pa la/ /dbyangs yig bzhi pa dang ldan pa/ /lnga pa yi ni lnga pa 7sbyin/ /gsum pa yi ni gsum pa la/ / uṣ+ṭha ṇa yiyi mtha' ma sbyar/ /gnyis pa'i gsum 82—743

pas mtha' brten pa/ /dbyangs yig gsum pa sbyin par bya/ /drug pa yi ni bzhi pa la/ /mthar gnas pa yi 6)gnyis pa sbyar/ /dbyangs kyi lnga pa sbyin par bya / /steng du thig le nā das brgyan/ /'di ni rtag (gepa'i snying po (7brjod/ /lnga pa yi ni dang po la/ /mthar gnas pa yi gnyis par 0sbyar/ /steng du dbyangs kyi bcwa tsho'ulnga pas(6)/ /brgyan gyur 'di ni sa bon yin/ /mthar gnas pa yi 7)gnyis pa la/ /lnga pa yi ni gsum pas brgyan/ /lnga pa'i lnga pa tha ma (kyesbyin / /lnga pa yi ni bzhi 67pa la/ /an+ta sbya yi gnyis pa'o⑩/ /gnyis pa'i gsum pas mtha' brten pa/ /dbyangs kyi bzhi pas brgyan par bya/ /'di ni rin chen rgyal po yi/ /gsang sngags bsdus pa'i tshul du brjod/ /dbyangs kyi dang po nyid la yang / /an+ta thi yi gnyis pa dang / /dbyangs yig bcu gsum pa sbyin bya/ /dbyangs kyi bcu pa nyid la ni/ /gnyis pa khyanyagasum pas mthar brten 12pa'o/ /uṣ+ṭha ṇa tsho/nyani bzhi pa la/ /dbyangs yig bdun pas steng dang 'og /dbyangs kyi bcwa sgyu lnga pa dang sbyar/ /'di ni 'od dpag med pa yi/ /gsang ba 'jig rten dag pa'o/ /gnyis pa'i gnyis pa nyid la ni/ /dbyangs kyi thig le nā das brgyan/ /drug pa yi ni dang po la/ /an+ta thi yi gnyis pa sbyar//gsum pa yi ni gsum pa la'i/ /gsum pa yi ni lnga pas brgyan/ /lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa la/ /an+ta sba yi gnyis pa'os// /gnyis pa'i gsum pas mtha' brten pa / /dbyangs kyi bzhi pas brgyan par bya/ /gdon mi za ba'i rjes 'gro ba'i/ /gsang ba las kyi rigs 1 tsho'abyung ba'o/ /mthar gnas pa yi kyi gsum pa la/ /dbyangs kyi bcwa 17lnga pas brgyan bya/ /lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa la/ /dbyangs kyi bcu gnyis pas brgyan bya/ /uṣ+ṭha yi ni dang po dang / /an+ta sbya yi gnyis pa las/ /82—744

lnga pa'i dang po nyid 1)dag la/ /urmi (min yi gsum pas brgyan/ /dbyangs kyi gsum pas sbyin par bya/ /drug pa yi ni lnga pa la/ /dbyangs kyi bcwa lnga pa dang sbyar / /drug pa yi ni lnga pa la/ /dbyangs kyi bcu gsum pa sbyin bya/ /uṣ+ṭha ③na yi tha ma las/ /mthar gnas pa yi gnyis pa dang / /bzhi ba'i dang po nyid dag la/ / urmi na yi gi)gnyis po sbyin/ /dbyangs kyi gsum pas brgyan par bya / /drug pa yi ni dang po la/ /gnyis pa'i lnga pas brgyan par bya/ /an+ta thi yi gnyis pa la/ /gnyis pa yi ni gsum pas dang / /mthar gnas pa yi gnyis pa la/ /lnga pa yi ni dang po la/ / urmi yi ni (sheganyis pa sbyin/ /dbyangs kyi bzhi pas sbyin par bya/ /lnga pa yi ni dang po la/ /gnyis pa yi ni lnga pas brgyan//sde tshan drug pa'i gsum pa dang / /gsum pa yi ni gsum pa sbyin/ /mthar gnas pa yi sbyo/gnyis pa sbyar/ /an+ta sbra du yi gnyis pa las(kye/ /lnga pa yi ni dang po lathor/ /urmi yin yi gsum pa sbyin/ /dbyangs kyi bzhi pas brgyan tunyepar bya/ /'di ni 'byung ba dag pa yi/ /rigs kyi yum bzhi'i snying por brjod/ /mthar gnas pa yi sa dang po las/ /drug pa yi ni lnga pa la/ /bzhi pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /bzhi pa yi ni dang po dang / /gnyis pa yi ni dang po la/ /mthar gnas pa yi gnyis pa sbyar/ /lnga pa'i gsum pa bcas pa la/ /dbyangs kyi gsum pa / sbyin par bya/ /drug pa yi ni dang po la/ /an+ta sba yi gnyis pa sbyar/ /lnga pa yi ni gsum pas mdzes/ /gsum pa yi ni bzhi par ldan/ /lnga pa yi ni dang po la/ /gnyis pa yi ni dang po la'i/ /mthar gnas pa yi (tshoganyis pa sbyar/ /lnga pa tso gsum pa ldan pa nyid/ /dbyangs kyi bzhi pa sbyin par bya/ /drug pa yi ni dang po dang / /lnga pa yi ni gsum pa sbyar/ /drug pa'i tha ma gzung bar bya/ /lnga pa 82wa 745

yi ni dang po la/ /gnyis pa yi ni dang po la/ /an+ta sba yi ①gnyis pa sbyar/ /lnga pa'i gsum pa dang ldan pa/ /dbyangs yig bzhi ②pas brgyan par bya/ /drug pa yi ni bzhi pa la/ /gnyis pa dugasum pa sbyar ba dang / /dbyangs kyi gsum pa steng ④nas sbyin/ /lnga pa yi ni lnga pa la/ /bzhi pa yi ni lnga par bcas/ /lnga pa yi ni dang po la/ /gnyis pa'i dang po dang bcas pa/ /mthar gnas pa yi ⑤gnyis pa dang / /bzhi pa'i gsum pa dang ldan par⑥/ /dbyangs yig bzhi pa thog mar sbyar/ /'di ni khro bo'i rgyal po bzhi/ /bla med rigs kyi sgo bzhi ⑦'byung ske/ /gsang sngags 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus rig pa'i gtso/ /rtsa bar gyur pa'i don shes pas/ /nus pa sngon du 'byin ⑧par byed / /thams cad rigs kyi bye brag gis/ /sngags kyi khyad par bstan pa yin/ /dbyangs yig bcu bzhi pa la ni/ /bcwa ⑨lnga pa yis sbyar ba gang / /'di ni sku ni gzi brjid mchog /spyan 'dren pa ru gyur pa yin/ /sde tshan brgyad ⑩pa'i tha ma la/ /dbyangs yig drug pa sbyar bar bya/ /sde tshan gnyis pa'i tha ma sbyin/ /'di ni sdud cing gshegs gsol ba(1/ /dbyangs yig dang po'i rang bzhin can//gnas shing bzhugs par byed pa'o/ /mi phyed ye shes 'byung ba ste/ /khyab cing dri ma med pa'o/ /bu mo lo grangs bcu gnyis ma'am/ /khye'u lo grangs bcu gnyis pa/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yongs rdzogs pas/ /bzung nas dbab pa 4)rab tu brtag /rdza yi phye ma so ma dag /so so yi ni rkang 'og tu/ /nyi zla gnyis su bri bar bya/ /de las khrus bya 6)rgyan btags nas/ /de nas langs pa'i skyes bu 'di'ang ski/ /thal mo snying gar sbyar byas shing / /steng 'og rlung la bslab par bya/ /de nyid mi yi sha dang ni/ /bdud rtsi sbyar ba bsres snyide 82—746

yang ske/ /gu gul nag por bcas pas bdug /dang po rkang pa'i mthil ①dag tu / /yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngo/ /ba dan gyis ni mtshan pa ②bsam /mdoms bar du ni me yin no/ /sa bon dkyil 'khor 'bar ba bsam/ /lte ②bar baṃ ④las chu yi gnas/ /dkar po zlum po dgod par bya/ /de steng ⑤sa yi dkyil 'khor dang / /lo las ⑥byung ba rdo rjes ⑦mtshan/ /gru bzhi mdzes pa nyid du bsam/ /lte bar dzhai ⑧dmar skul yo)bar byed/ /'bar ba 'od 'phro mi zad pa'o / /snying gar rtsu mthing bya'od 'bar dang / /spyi bor haṃ dkar bsil bar gyur(7 / /mgrin par a dmar rim pa ste/ /de dag kun la bla ma yis/ /hūṃ tram̐ tso a lha 8zhes bya ba'itshu/ /rig 8sngags rdo rje bzlas pa dang / /lha yi sa bon phreng sngags kyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyis kyang bsam/ /nam mkha'i dbyings bzhin mi rtog cing / /rtog pa gzhan dag ma gos pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i lus gnas su / /mi bskyod pa dang sku rdo rje/ /chos 'dzin pa dag rang gis ⑩bsam /rang gi lte ba'i sna 7'od las/ /'od zer dpag med byung nas ni/ /lha gsum po ni bskul byas te/ /de nas khye'u lus kyi yo ni/ /yi ge sna la bskul yibar bya/ /de las rlung dang bcas pa'i sgra/ /myur du zhugs te rkang mthil gyi( — )/ /rlung dang bcas pa'i ba dan bskyod( ste/ /nyi zlas nam mkhar bteg nas ni/ /sum mdo'i me sbar chu yang khol/ /snying gar sa g.yos 'khor ba las/ /yi ge snga ma gsum bskul ()te/ /'od kyis lus kyi nang khengs shing / /sna bug g.yas nas byung nas kyang / /der gnas pa yi 'gro kun gyis/ /sna bug g.yon du zhugs byas te/ /kun la ( sku'od 'bar 'khor ba yis/ /lus nang rab tu khengs par bsam/ /de nas bdud rtsi ( gelus la gtor/ /rol mo'i sgra ni sna 82wa 747

tshogs bya/ /des ni bskul bar the tsom med/ /gal te lus ngag yid gsum la//rtags rnams nges par ma byung na/ /lan gsum bar du bzlas par bya/ /des ni nges par bskul gyur pa'i0)/ /'gul ba dang ni bskyod pa sogs/ /ma lus sngags kyi tshig 'byung ste/ /'di yis ②bskul ba ma lus pa'i/ /gsang ba rab tu gyur pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi gsang ba yi/ /ye shes mchog tu brtag pa'o / /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi bdag /sku gsum gnas ni yongs dag pas/ /rdo rje gsung gis bka' stsal to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi kun rtog dag par byed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu bstan pa'o/ /gang du dug gsum cha las ni/ /rtog pa'i snang ba rgyas pa las/ /rang bzhin 'byung bar gyur pa chadag /thabs kyi rang bzhin shes rab kyi/ /yi shes (4)dag par byed pa dang / /shes rab rang bzhin gyur pa la / /thabs kyi yi shes dag par (nyabyed/ /gang du 'gron 6)par gyur pa la(pe/ /tha mi dad pa'i yi ge yis/ /rtog pa mngon par sbyang ba ste/ /g.yas rtsa (kyel ni brten nas ni/ /zhe snang rtog 99)pa gtso ⑩gyur pa/ /g.yon rtsa la ni brten pa yis / /'dod chags rtog pa gtsor byed 'byung / /sgra gcan la ni brten nas ni / /ma 1lharig pa ni 'byung zhing 'gro/ /gnas pa lus kyi 7yi ge las/ /'khor ba skyed 91)byed rtog pa yi'abyung / /de nyid rang bzhin rtog pa yis/ /srog dang rtsol ba la sbyangs te/ /pho mo ma ning yirlung 'di dag /cung zad dul bar gyur pa na/ /lam gyi chos 'byung rtags 7'char byed/ /rlung nyid shin tu dag pa yisayi / /yi ge gsang sngags dag gyur par1ste/ /rtog pa ye shes chen por (1'char / /a zhes bya ba mi chags byed/ /ā zhes bya bas bar mar gnas/ /i 82—748

zhes bya ba chags chen te/ /yī zhes bya ba g.yeng bar 'gyur①/ /u zhes bya ba 'jug pa'i yid/ /u zhes mya ②ngan bskyed 'gyur bas/ /ṛ ②zhes mya ngan gyis gdung byed/ /rī ④zhes mya ngan gyis gnon ⑤byed/ /bla ⑥zhes cung zad zhi bar gnas / /lī ⑦zhes kun du rtog pa nyid/ /e zhes 'jigs pa tsam gyur pa/ /e zhes bar ma'i 'jigs bcas pa/ /o zhes 'jigs pa chen po yin/ /au zhes srid pa'i zhen pa nyid/ /e (mizhes bar ma'i sred zhes po)bskyed/ /māṃ ⑩zhes sred pa chen po yin/ /a zhes nyer len gzhis tunyeyin te/ /ā zhes mi dge log lta can//i zhes pa ni bkres ⑩pa ste/ /khri zhes skom pas gdungs pa yin/ /u zhes tshor ba'i bye brag myong / /u zhes tshor ba'i bar ma (geganas/ /ṛ snyizhes tshor ba chen po dang / /rī 8zhes rig par byed pa poyi/ /lo yizhes mi 'gyur rig pa 'dzin/ /lī (nyezhes rig pa'i yid 'jug zhi(pe/ /e zhes so sor rtog sbyong ba( )/ /e zhunyezhes ngo tshas bag yod byed/ /o ( )zhes snying rje bar sems pa/ /au zhes brtse sgo ba byams par bcas/ /a sogezhes bya bar dog (nyepar byed/ /a ( nyezhes bsags pa sna tshogs pa/ /k+ka ()zhes phrag dog rtog pa ste/ /'di dag rang bzhin rtag sa bcas yin / /ka zhes bya ba chags ( 7)sems yin/ /kha zhu )zhes zhen par 'byung ba dang / /ga zhes dga' ba'i chags pa can/ /gha zhes bar ma'i dga' 4nyab can/ /nga zhes shin tu dga' ba'i dgesas / /tsa ri nyezhes bde bas yi sosterangs te/ /tsha zhes rab tu mgu bas rangs/ /dza zhes bya ba ngo mtshar skyes/ /dzha nunyezhes bya ba dgod par byed/ /nya zhes de nyid kyis tshim yin/ /ṭa zhes 'byung bar 'dod pa yin//ṭha zhes 'o byed par 'dod pa/ /ḍa zhinazhes 'jib par byed pa yin/ /nye zhes brtan pa'i sems gnas yin/ /ṇa zhu zhes brtson 'grus skyed byed pa/ /ta zhes 82—749

nga rgyal rtog pa yin/ /tha zhes lus ngag bya ba byed/ /da zhes 'phrogs pa 0)bskyod pa yin(snye/ /dha zhes stobs skyed ③khyad par ④la/ /na zhes sems spro dang ba bcas(ge/ /pa zhes tha dad med bdag dugyur/ /pha zhes tha dad med btang snyomasate/ /ba zhes tha dad med pa'i dngos/ /bha zhes drag po'i bde ba 'dod/ /ma zhes sgeg par byed pa'o/ /ya zhes rlung gis 'gres ⑦byed pa/ /ra zhes cung zad 'bar ba'i (kyedage/ /la zhes gsal ba'i tshig brjod pa/ /wa zhes bden tho)smra g.yo med pa/ /sha zhes brdzun du smra byed pa/ /ṣa zhes de bzhin nyid des byed / /sa zhes nye bar mi 'dod pa/ /ha zhes sbyin par byed pa yin/ /k+ka ⑩zhes kun 11du bskul ti'adod pa/ /kla zhes pa ni de bzhin des/ /sla zhes pa ni dpa' bar 'dod/ /l+la zhes bag med shes bzhin bral/ /bla 0zhes g.yo sgyu ston pa dang / /dha zhes mi srun dhipar 'byung zhing / /da zhes byas gyur 'gro bar byed / /'di ni kun du rtog par 'gyur7/ /a ā zhes par gyur pa gang / /bar ma'i chags gyur ma rig che/ /i khri zhes ⑩pa bar ma ste/ /rjes su 'dzin pa med pa la/7/ /u kyi u zhes pa rnam (1gnon pas/ /'grub (nyapa nyid du gnas pa yin / /e e zhes pa thob pa'i cha/ /'gog pa la ni 'jug pa'o/ /o au ( nyazhes pa tha ma ste/ /yid ni skyo bar gyur pa'o/ / a aḥ( stebacas ( pa 'thibs pa nyid/ /le lo snyom gi tsholas gyur pa'o/ / ṛ rī bla lī ( mi'abyung ba las/ /mi phyed the tsom gyur pa ste/ /'di dag phra dang rags pa dang / /bar ma'i dbye ba bstan pa yin / /thog ma dang ni tha ma dang / /dbus su 'byung ba'i skad cig ma/ /skye dang 'gag dang gnas pa las/ /rang bzhin tha ma rtog las 'byung / /de nyid 'gro dang 'ong ba dang / /gnas pa yi ni rlung gi 9 gyicha/ /thabs dang shes rab 82—750

dbye ba yi0/ /nyin dang mtshan du 'byung ②ba ni/ /brgyad cu phrag gnyis nye bar 'byung / /sa bon cha dang rnam par smin/ /yul gyur rkyen 'byung 'di dag ni / /kun du rtog pa chen po ste/ /'di las dge dang mi dge byung / /de las bag chags las byung ba/ /bde 'gro dang ni ngan 'gro'i rgyun/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis dag gis 'khor/ /'di dag lugs las bzlog gyur na/ /rang byung rnal 'byor pa ni ②'gyur/ /'dir ni tshogs pa las skye bdu/ /rten 'brel tsam du 'byung ba yin/ /rigs kyi bu dag 'di lta ste/ /dper na gtsub shing gtsub stan rgyadang / /skyes bu'i lag pa'i rtsol ba yiyi/ /rkyen gyis rab tu bskul gyur na /du ba med ( )dang 'bar bcas pa/ /ji bzhin bar nas ni'abyung mod kyi/ /legs par brtags shing btsal khyab na/ /me de gang du'ang mi gnas pa/ /rigs kyi bu dag de ltar na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos rnams kyis7/ /bla med rang bzhin 'di dag kyang / /dam tshig stong pa nyid gnas pas/ /chos rnams rang bzhin rnam dag pa/ /'gro 'ong med par rjes rig bya/ /de nyid 'di ni bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs de dag thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/ rmad du gyur nas rngam zhing mig gdangs te tshig 'di skad ces smras so/ /rmad byung chen po tunyechos rnams ni/ /nam mkha' dang ni mtshungs 'gyur cing / /rnam par mi rtog dag pa la/ /kun rdzob tsam du gsungs pa mtsharatunye/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa 8rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin rnam par dag cing don dam pa'i gnas kyi dag pa chen po de kho tson nyid du bstan 82—751

pa'i le'u ste bdun cu 3)bzhi pa'o// //de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /kun mchog dbang phyug 'khor lo'i gtsos/ /rab tu byin brlabs (0snang ba las/ /bka' stsal rdo rje ③tshig 'di bstan/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gang du byin gyis rlob nga)pa 'di/ nges par gyur pa (5)'di phyung ngo / /gang zhig skyes bu'i spyod yul du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /gang zhig mthong zhing gang babs pa'i/ /yang dag ye shes rtogs ⑥par bya/ /sku babs pas ni 'dar labar byed/ /'phar zhing gar dang phyag rgya 'byung / /thugs kyi snying po rab bskul ba(kyi/ /srog rtsol 'gog pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /rings 9pa nyid kyang gsum du 'gyur/ /rnam rtog dang ni yul rnams dang / /'byung ba 'gag cing bde bar 'gyur/ /smig rgyu 7la sogs mthong bar (1'byung //lha chen dag kyang dbab pa 'byung / /tshangs pas lus la byin brlabs na/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs ni ston par byed/ /brgya byin gyis ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /lkog tu gyur pa mthong 8bar byed/ /drag po bas ni stobs rnyed cing / /rig 8byed dag ni ska'adon pa dang / /u mā 'de bī 7la sogs pas/ /rtse 'jo chags pa skye bar ston/ /lha chen dag ni gang babs pa/ /'khor lo 'dzin pa'i brda tunyedag dang / /sa 'og sa steng sa bla'o/ /dbang du byed pa ston par 'gyur/ /'phags lam bzhi ni bden pa bzhi/ /chos rnams rtogs pa ston par byed/ /nyan thos rang rgyal rnams kyi ni/ /grub pa'i mtha' ni ston pa dang / /spyad (shepa'i yon tan 'byung ba las/ /sde ba rnams kyang kyi spyod pa dang / /bse ru lta 82—752

bu'i spyod tshul lo/ /theg pa dman par ltung 0)ba'i rtags/ /byang chub sems dpa' 97spyod pa gang / /tshad med bzhi dang de la sogs/ /lus ngag yid kyis gang byung ba/ /sems dpa'i lta stangs byed pa na/ /byang chub sems nyid 'grub 'gyur ba/ /ngo bo nyid med tshig brjod 'gyur/ /khru (5)gang dag tu 'phags pa ni/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa brtan par byed/ /khru do ba ④ni rdzogs pa'i rim/ /khru brgyad kyis (5)ni phyir mi ldog /lnga pas lam lnga mthar phyin pa/ /tshe gcig 'bras bu thob par 'gyur/ /gsang ba grub pa dag gis ni/ /'bad pas dbab pa brtag (6)par bya/ /rdo rje sku (7)ni byin brlabs shing (kye/ /gzugs kyi phung po babs gyur pas/ /rnam par snang mdzad ye shes ni/ /gti mug rigs kyi dam tshig spyod/ /rdo rje gsung gis byin brlabs 5)shing / /'du shes phung po babs 7gyur pas/ /'od dpag med pa'i ye shes ni/ /'dod chags rigs kyi dam tshig spyod/ /rdo rje thugs kyis byin brlabs shing / /rnam shes phung po dag byed babs/ /mi bskyod pa yi ye shes ni/ /zhe sdang rigs kyi dam tshig spyod/ /rdo rje yon tan gyis byin brlabs/ /tshor ba'i phung pos bdag byin brlabs/ /dkon mchog dpal gyi 47ye shes ni/ /nga rgyal rigs kyi dam tshig spyod/ /rdo rje phrin las byin gyis rlobs/mi/ /'du byed phung po babs gyur pas / /gdon mi za ba'i ye shes ni/ /phrag tsho dog rigs kyi dam tshig spyod/ /sangs rgyas spyan ni babs gyur cing / /sa yi khams ni byin brlabs na/ /dbang chen ri rab ltar brtan cing / /rdo rje rgyas pa'i las 57'grub 'gyur/ /mā ma khris ni bdag rgyud kel/ / chu yi tshekhams ni byin brlabs ni/ /gdung ba 1 rnams las bsil byed cing / /lha mo sgrol rnams 'grub pa'o/ /na bza' 82—753

dkar mo bcas ①pa yis/ /me yi khams ni byin brlabs ②pas/ /bag chags de ni sreg dubyed cing / /rdo rje dbang du sdud par byed/ /lha mo sgrol ma'i rjogazi brjid kyis/ /rlung gi ⑤khams ni byin brlabs pas/ /thams cad skyod pa'i las byed de⑥/ /rdo rje mngon spyod cher spyod do/ /lha mo gzugs kyi rdo rje ma / /smig gargyu lta bur mthong bar byed/ /lha mo sgra yi rdo rje mdu/ /du ba lta bur 'char ⑨bar byed/ /lha mo dri yi rdo rje mtshu/ /skar ma srin bu me khyer 'char//lha mo ro yi rdo rje ma7/ /mar me 'bar ba ltar gsal zhing / /lha mo reg bya rdo rje matso / /thams cad stong pa'i chos nyid la/ /nam mkha' 8khams ni babs gyur pas / /bde ba chen po'i ye shes skye/ /de yi mig gi rnam shes la/ /sa yi snying pos 8byin brlabs pas/ /gzugs kyi dngos po sna tshogs dang / /lkog tu gyur pa'i rdzas rnams mthong / /de yi rna ba'i 8rnam shes la/ /lag na rdo rjes ⑩byin brlabs pas/ /phra rags ⑩sgra rnams thos pa dang / /lung bstan pa yang thob par 'gyur/ /de yi sna yi rnam shes la/ /nam mkha'i snying pos byin brlabs pas / /sna tshogs dri rnams tshor ba dang / /sna rtse'i 'od zer tshogs mthong 'gyur / /de yi lce yi rnam shes la/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gis byin brlabs/ /lha yi bdud rtsi myong byed cing / /gsung thoshedabyangs snyan pa sna tshogs 'byung / /de yi lus kyi rnam shes la/ /sgrib pa sel bas byin brlabs 6)pas 'jig rten khams ni gsum dag gi/ /reg bya'i khyad par mchog rnams thob/ /de yi yid kyi rnam shes la/ /kun du bzang pos byin brlabs 6)pas/ /dus gsum shes pa'i ye shes ni/ /zhag gsum lon pa bzhin du dran/ /de yi yid la khyab byed par/ /byams pa mgon pos byin brlabs 6)pas/ /nyon mongs ye shes 82—754

gyur nas kyang / /rtog pa med par 'gro zhing lding / /de yi kun gzhi'i ①rnam shes la/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin brlabs pas②/ /lus kyi cha shas ①g.yo 'gyur zhing / /mkha' la spyod pa nyid du 'gro/ /sku ni snang ba sgyur bar byed / /gsung ni grag ④pa sngags su brjod/ /thugs kyi snying po rab bskul bas / /srog rtsol bzlas pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad kyi(snyel/ /de nyid byin gyis brlabs gyur na/ /bar chad bdud dpung ma lus 'joms / /brtan pa mchog tu 'bebs par byed/ /khro bo'i rgyal po bcu rnams kyis / /lus la nges par byin brlabs 6)na/ /phyag rgya byed cing sdigs mdzub ⑦byed / /phyogs skyong bcu po 'joms par byed/ /g.yon brkyang g.yas brkyang rdo rje'i gar/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi (kyebasgyur ba dang / /hūṃ phaṭa rngams 6)pa'i gad mo yis / /rlung bcu dbang du sgyur bar gnas/ /khro bo du ma spro zhing sdud/ /ye shes thugs rje khros pa yis/ /dngos por 'dzin pa'i gdon rnams 'joms /lus kyi cha shas 'bebs par byed/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du byin gyis brlabs tīpa so sor rab tu bstan pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /bcom ldan rdo rje mi bskyod pas(nya / /gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyis / / ta thā saṃ gra 8ha yi rgyud/ /sangs rgyas rin chen dpal gyis ni/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba chen po'i rgyud/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa yis/ /zla gsang thig le'i (stergyud gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas thogs 7med grub pa yis/ /dam tshig gsum bkod 7rgyal po bshad/ /sangs rgyas spyan mas mnyam 7sbyor rgyud/ /mā ma tī sa dzi snani he badz+ra/nye/ /gos dkar mas (7ni 'khor lo sdom/ /sgrol mas sa )sgyu 'phrul chen po nyid/ /dpal ldan rdo rje dbyings phyug mas/ /rdo rje gdan bzhi 82—755

gtsug lag rgyud/ /gzugs kyi rdo rjes ①gsang ba'i mdzod/ /sgra yi rdo rje'i lha mo yis(mi/ /bde ba dam pa rtogs skyed ①gsungs/ / dri yi ④rdo rjes ⑤sangs rgyas thod/ / ro yi ⑥rdo rje'i lha mo yis/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud mchog gsungs / /byams pa mgon pos rig ⑦mchog dang / /sa yi snying pos sku gsung thugs / /rdo rje gsang ba'i rgyan (kyebakod gsungs/ /gsang ba'i bdag pos dbang bskur rgyud/ /nam mkha'i snying pos dpal ldan ni/ /gsang ba thig le'i rgyud mchog gsungs/ /'jig rten dbang phyug mchog gis ni/ / pun+da rī ⑨ka dra ba can/ /'jam dbyangs dpa' bo rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam ⑩sel bas/ /a mo gha yi rgyud bstan pa/ /kun tu bzang pos gsang ba'i rgyud/ /byang chub sems dpa' mchog gis gsungs/ /gshin rje'i yigashed pos dgra ⑫nag po6nya/ /shes rab mthar byed khams gsum rgyal/ /rta mgrin tsogasang ba mchog tu rol/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pas rdo rje sgo/ /mi g.yo mgon pos tsogasang ba'i rgyud/ /'dod rgyal thabs kyi zhags pa phreng / /dbyug sngon gdug pa tsokun 'dul ba/ /stobs po che yis sgra rgyal rgyud/ /sum̐ bha rā dza chas rdo rjes/ /gtsug tor rdo rje gtsug tor rgyud/ /khro bo'i rgyal po mchog rnams kyis/ /rim par gsungs pa 1 bstan pa'o/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud (7gyur 6 )sum cu gnyis/ /re re la yang phyi nang gsang ba 9 nyabacas/ /khyad par phyi yi mnya'abum phrag sum cu drug /yi ge'i dbye ba stong phrag sum cu bzhi/ /byang chub sems dpa' rig mar bcas / /khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyis nges par gsungs pa'o/ /'di dag 'gro ba'i don slad du/ /sngon rgyu'i nus pa rten can la/ /de nyid khro chags sku ru ston / /bag la nyal dang phra ba yi/ /zag pa med pa'i spyod yul la/ /zhi ba 82—756

spros med mdzad pa byed/ /zhing khams bye ba stong phrag tu/ /mdzad pa rnam pa tha dad pas/ /gcig las du ma ①rnam par 'phrul/ /sems can khams rnams skyes pa dang / /'byung ba gnas pa'i srid pa ru/ /rgyu dang rkyen las grub tshul dang ske/ /nyon mongs khams dang dbang po dang / /bag la nyal sogs dri ma rnams / /khams gsum brtan dang g.yo ba yitshi/ /rgyu 'bras phra ba'i phra ba la/ /lag mthil skyu ru ra bzhag 'dra/ /rdo rje'i spyan dang rdo rje'i snyan/ /rdo rje'i thugs dang rdo rje zhuganas/ /rdo rje spyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul rnams/ /sangs rgyas mngon shes lnga don 'grub/ /yongs su ma dag kla klo'i gling / /tha dad par ni nyon mongs can/ /de dag shin tu dul bar mdzad/ /drag po'i nyams ni gar dgu ④rol/ /dbang la chags tshul drug cu bzhi/ /rgyas la khyad par bcu drug ste / /zhi ba'i tshul ni bcu gnyis yin/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ni yang / /gsang ba yongs su rdzogs pa nyid/ /dpal mchog rtog pa bdun pa ste/ /rtog pa dang po gling ⑤slong ba(5)/ /gsang ba rgyas par bstan pa yin/ /rtog pa gnyis pa rdo rje'i rigs/ /mchog tu brtag pa chen po las/ /brjod bya rjod ( )byed tshul ldan pa/ /ting nge 'dzin dang bcas pa'o/ /rtog pa gsus (kyepa rin chen rigs / /'od zer snang ba'i ye shes che/ /tha dad med pa chos kyi dbyings/ /byang chub chen po 6)brjod pa'o/ /rtog pa bzhi po pad+ma'i rigs/ /ma chags bde ba 'od 'bar ba/ /so so'i ting 'dzin la bzhugs yinas/ /rtog (1pa'i ye shes 'char byed pa'o/ /rtog pa lnga yo las kyi rigs/ /sna tshogs don kun sgrub byed pas/ /shes rab ral gri (/nyeyongs gcod pa'i/ /khyad par bsgrub skepa brjod pa'o/ /rtog pa drug pa chos kyi dbyings/ /sangs rgyas du ma'i dgongs 82—757

pa dag /gcig tu yang dag bsdus pa ni/ /de nyid mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'o/ /rtog pa bdun pa snang ba rgyas/ /ye shes lnga ni rab 'byung ba/ /'od zer sna tshogs tshad med pa/ /bkod pa mtha' yas sprin tshogs pas/ /rab tu 'bar ba'i 'od mnga' ba/ /dpag med tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa ni/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyis sbyar hu)ba dang / /g.yon brkyang du ni nyer sbyor ro②/ /zhal gsum phyag drug rnam par 'byung / /khro bo skyil krung ①longs spyod pas/ /thams cad ma lus bdud 'joms mdzad/ /rten cing 'brel las 'byung ba las④/ /dngos po thams cad rnam par brtag /bla ma sangs rgyas chos gyur cing / /dge 'dun kyang ni 'di nyid de/ /de yi drin gyis shes 'gyur ba/ /de bas dkon mchog gsum bdag ⑤yin/ /mi shes rab rib kyis ldongs ⑥la/ /'di ni lam rab ston byed yin/ /bde ba kun gyi ⑦mchog gyur dang / /'dod pa'i don kun ster byed yin/ /de bas de dang mnyam pa yi / /mchod bya gzhan ni byed ma yin/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /brtul zhugs ldan pas bla ma mchod/ /de mnyam 'gro ba 'jig rten na/ /khams gsum kun las mi rnyed de/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'jig rten du/ /phun sum tshogs pa ston phyir gsungs/ /rnal 'byor pa 'di ci spyod kyang / /thams cad du ni smad mi bya/ /rtog pa kun las rnam grol phyir/ /ji ltar 'dod pas bya ba med/ /de ni dngos kun ngo bo ste/ /khyab bdag sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin / /rang byung 97ji ltar 'dod pa spyad/ /sems can kun gyi snying la zhugs / /de nyid thams cad bla na med/ /'di ni rnal 'byor dbang po mchog /rnal 'byor skyes bur bshad pa ste/ /rjes su rnal 'byor rigs (9)pa mchog /82—758

gnyis 'dus shin tu rnal 'byor te/ /gnyis med ye shes rnal 'byor che/ /rnal 'byor de ni sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /ye shes rgya mtsho dam pa nyid/ /'o ma'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las/ /mar ni shin tu 'du ba ltar/ /dba' 0rlabs 'dus pas stobs gyur pa/ /gzhan yang thams cad skye 'gyur zhing / /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa dang / /brtan dang g.yo ba'i chos kun gyis/ /srid gsum bdag po rnam par 'phrul/ /de ltar bdud rtsi las ni langs/ /nyan thos rang rgyal 'byung ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i sa las ni/ /khyad par 'gro ba gcig pa nyid/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa sa dge ba/ /bcu gsum du yang rnam bshad pa/ /gru gsum rnam par 'byung ba ni/ /'dir ni chos kyi 'byung gnas brjod/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ni/ /ji ltar kun du snang gyur pa / /de bzhin gnyis med ②ye shes 'dir/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bsam mi khyab / /nam mkha' lta bu'i chos rnams la/ /rnam par rtog pa'i rgyan ②gyis brtags / /rang byung gcig nyid gnyis su med/ /sems can bsam pa'i dbang gis ④ni/ /lta dang grub mtha' sna tshogs bstan/ /tha dad lta bar 'jig rten pa/ /kun mkhyen gcig pu gnyis su ⑧med/ /gang du bdag dang phyag rgya dag /gnyis med bde bas brgyal ⑨gyur tshe/ /de yi bde bas kun khyab byed/ /chos kun ngo bo gcig par ni/ /ye shes 'du 'bral med pa nyid/ /rnal 'byor pa yi gsang ba yin/ /dga' ba skyed (7byed bzang po ste/ /ma lus don gyi 'bras rab ster/ /dngos po'i bdud rtsis lus gang zhing / /nor bu rin chen sten ⑧par mnyam/ /yon tan mtha' yas 'byung ba'i gzhil/ /bde ba rdo rje can gyi ⑩gnas/ /nyon mongs ye shes gnas gyur pas/ /myur du bgrod (nya82—759

pa'i go 'phang gis/ /ro mnyam mi mnyam 'phel ba las/ /bde bas ma lus sa gsum po/ /thams cad tshim par byed pa po/ /gnyis med ye shes rgya mtsho las//'gro ba'i nor bu ster byed pa/ /ded dpon chen po 'dir gnas pa/ /bla ma'i gzugs su gang byung ba/ /nga yo)nyid thugs rje ②der zhugs pa/ /mi yi gzugs su nyer bstan pa'o/ /de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /mi phyed rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kun/ /rab tu dga' zhing yi ③rangs te/ /dgyes pas yongs su khyad ④par 'gyur/ /de ni gsang ba'i chos can yin/ /rdo rje'i gdan du bzhugs phyinas kyang / /mnyam pa'i skyil krung ⑥tshul gnas nas/ /nyi ma snang ba mched pa'i cha/ /gsal la (7)snang ba mtshan mo'i cha/ /mtshams las thob pa mun par bcas/ /dug gsum rang bzhin kun rnams (8)las/ /nges 'byung bsnyen pas rtsa gnas las/ /zag bcas 'byung ba zlog par byed/ /bsgrub pas yi ge ⑨gsang ba las/ /thos pas sgra rnams dbyangs dbyung nyid/ /nyer sgrub shin 7tu mi shigs (1pa/ /khams las bdud rtsi dngas par gyur7/ /srod dus mun pa'i smag tu rum du/ /bdud bcom lha yi yibu yi tshogs/ /rgol ba ngan pa zlog 7gyur cing / /de nyid kun du brtsams ⑩pa'o / /tho rangs dus su 'das cha las/ /shin tu nyer thob rang byung las/ /bcu dang brgyad du mthar son khri 7tshe/ /skya rengs nges par 'char dus su/ /mngon par byang chub legs mthong ba/ /'di ni mchog tu 'byung ba nyid/ /gsang ba yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsgom pa mchog gis bsgrub 'gyur ba'o//'di ni thabs dang shes rab dag /gnyis med ye shes snyoms 'jug pas/ /de yi chos kyi 'byung gnas su/ /bde chen 1stesgyu ma'i rol pa yis/ /kun du 82—760

dbang bskur gyur par ①ni/ /dngos grub ye shes thob byed yin/ /snga ma 'jig rten log rtog dag /dgag phyir mi rtag gzugs su brtan/ /de nyid yongs su dag pa yis/ /rgyun mi 'chad par gnas bsgyur bas/ /gzhon nu'i tshul du bstan pa ste/ /'gro kun rang dbang med pa ste/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyod yul lo/ /de ltar ye shes gnas thob pas/ /skad cig gis ni sangs rgyas 'gyur / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa (mirnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa/ mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dngos po thams cad phyin ci ma log pa dag pa bsam pa sna tshogs pa'i don rab tu bsgrub pa'i le'u ste bdun cu rtsa lnga ②pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes gsang ba'i spyod yul phun sum tshogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i spyod yul gdul bya'i skye bo'i bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pas yongs su ston par mdzad de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad slar rab tu 'dud cing mchod pa rnam pa du mas yongs su mchod la gsang ba'i don 'di dag rab tu zhus (gso/ /de nas gsang ba 'dzin pa pos/ /mi 'gyur ba ni rgyas pa'i tshul / /mgon po byang chub chen po ni/ /zab dang rgya che'i gnas 'di gsungs/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas phyogs bcu yi/ /gnas sogs zhing khams ma lus pa'i/ /rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa ni/ /til 'bru lta bu gang ba yi(5ni/ /ma lus rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs la/ /gsang ba dam pa bka' stsal to/ /rdo rje sems 82—761

dpa' rgyal po che/ /yang dang yang du bskul bar bya/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig mchog tu brtag pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das nam mkha' kun du rnam par 'phrul ba'i ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ⑨ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rdo rje ral pa gcig ma'i dam tshig chen po'i/ rgyal mo rdo rje mchog gi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra e ka dza ṭi khu li ni swā hā/ rdo rje ral pa gcig ma yi/ /gsang ba ye shes rang byung bas②/ /zhal gsum pa la phyag drug ma/ /kha dog mthing nag 'bar ma che/ /g.yas g.yon dkar dang dmar ba'i mdangs/ /gri gug thod pa 'dzin par mdzad/ /rdo rje dang ni thod dbyug ni/ /g.yas pa'i phyag tu bsnams par ①bsgom/ /dril bu rdo rje'i zhags pa ni/ /g.yon pa'i phyag tu bsnams par 8)bsgom/ /rin chen sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ /shin tu sgeg cing 'gying bar bsam/ /'di ni klu yi bu mo rnams/ /rab tu 'gugs ⑤pa'i mchog gyur pa/ /sa g.yo ba yi ①dus su ni/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par shesasti / /de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ / klu yi ()bu mo mthu chen rnams/ /tshig par gyur cing gos dang bral/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rjes su dran/ /gsang sngags rig pa 'di yis ni/ /klu rnams 'gugs ⑨pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /klu yi bu mo mig bzangs rnams/ /bkug nas nye bar spyad par bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i dam tshig 'byung ba 0rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ chos chen po'i dam tshig 'di rdo rje khro gnyer ma 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ sarba bha ya nā sha ya tra sa ni tra sa ya tra se yā bha yonyata ri skṛ 7ku ṭi ti dhi bho re tī ṣ+pe ⑩tā she ta dza ni 82—762

ṇi ①su hā/ rdo rje'i ②lha mo khro gnyer can/ /sku mdog sngo ljang sridangs pa la/ /zhal gsum phyag drug spyan gsum ma/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar cung zad khros//dang po gnyis kyis bde bar ni/ /thugs kur bsnol bas ④'khor lo dang / /rin chen 'bar ba 'dzin pa'o/ /ral gri dang ni rtse gsum pa/ /g.yas pas nges par 'dzin par mdzad/ /sdigs mdzub 0zhags pa bum pa ni/ /g.yon du nges par 'dzin pa'o/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan/ /rdo rje skyil rjokrung bzhugs par bsam/ /sku la ⑦'bar ba'i 'od 'phro bas/ /gnod pa ma lus zhi byed bsam/ /'di ni gsungs ma thag tu yang / /rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po kun/ /rab tu 'dar nibar gyur nas ni/ /ye shes rgyal po rjes su dran//rig pa 'dzin pa'i lha mo mchog /gser gyi rna 6)cha g.yon pa rnams/ /sngags kyi rig pa 'di dang ni/ /dam tshig la sogs pas bkug bya/ /gang du phrin tshulas ma lus pa/ /gsang ba mchog tu bsgrub pa ni/ /'gog pa'i rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin / /yongs su rdzogs pa mdzes mchog gis/ /ye shes rdo rje gsum las 'byung / /kun nas de ma thag tu 'gyur(nye/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kun nas dbyangs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rdo rje chen po'i bsgom pa'i dam 8tshig 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /rtsu oṃ ma hā bibyā dha ra tsa tso li tsu li citsun+da tsole dz+nyā na bi shud dha yisarba dharmā burnye swā hā / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /nam mkha'i chardo rje'i dbus su bsam/ /kun nas 'bar ba'i ye shes spyan(nya/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyi cho ga yis/ /rdo rje gsum gyi gnas chen ni/ /lus dang ngag dang sems la dbab/ /lha mo skul byed rdo rje bsam/ /zhal gsum pa la phyag drug ma/ /dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje 82—763

dang ske/ /pad+ma 'bar ba bsnams pa'o/ /rin chen nor bu rdo rje sprin/ /zla ba chu shel 'bar ba dang / /phyag gzhan rnams kyis 'dzin par mdzad/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /bsams la sngags kyi yi ge dgod/ /nad rnams ma lus zhi byed pa/ /gsang ba ye shes rgya mtsho nyid/ /bde ba mchog tu bsam par bya/ / 'di na 6)zhi ba'i las bsgrub ②pa / /gsang ba nye bar bsdus pa'o/ /rdo rje'i dam tshig ye shes kyi/ /'od ces bya ba'i ting la'adzin to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa dpa' bo rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas rdo rje ④bsam gtan gyi dam ⑤tshig gi (6)mchog 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /bī/oṃ a badz+ra yak+ṣa 'chigar+bha ya rat+na sgrika niphaṭa swā hā/ sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor 'od bzang po/ /nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbus su bsam/ /rdo rje sku gsum sbyor ba yisate/ /skyed pa 'di ni rnam par bsam/ /zhal gsum pa la phyag drug pa/ /margad 6)ta dang cha dgu pa/ /'khor lo ut+pal sdong bu dang / /ral gri 'bar ba bsnams par bsam/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /cung zad ser po rdo rje 'gying/ /zhi ba thor tshugs dbu rgyan can/ /de bsams rgyas pa'i las kun la/ /myur ba nyid du grub par byed/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o/ /rdo rje dpa' bo'i rlabs kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /sku gsung kyithugs kyi rdo rje las/ /lus dang ngag dang sems bsgom pa/ /sbyor tshul nyid kyis bya ba ste/ /'dis ni (1dngos grub myur 'thob zhi byed/ /dam tshig bskul ba byang chub sems/ /'gro ba'i don du rab 'jug pa/ /rdo rje gsum dbyer med gzugs can/ /de nyid 82—764

las kyi phyag rgyar brjod/ /dam tshig stong pa bde ba che/ /'od zer spro zhing sdud par mdzad/ /'gro la dngos grub rgyun byed pas/ /chos kyi phyag rgya ye shes che/ /gsang ba dam tshig bod pa ni/ /srog gi snying por gyur pa yi/ /sa bon sngags las rab grub pa/ /de nyid las ni 'da' mi byed/ /rtsa gsum rlung gsum sku gsum ni/ /thig le sngags kyi sbyor bas ni/ /bcing ba rab grol phyag rgya che/ /de nyid sku gsum dag pa'i bdag /sku dang gsung dang thugs dang ni/ /dbyer med rdo rje'i dam tshig gnas/ /dbang bzhi'i lam gyi dam hu)tshig las/ /rang gi ngo bo'i ③dam tshig dang / /spyod pa'i lam dang ldan pa dang / /longs spyod yan lag dam tshig ste/ /gsang ba bsrung ba'i gnas dang ni/ /de nyid bza' ba'i dam tshig ste/ /rnam pa rang bzhin ngo bo dang / /mtshan nyid ldan pas dang po yin/ /snang ba rang bzhin bdag nyid can/ /dbyer med sbyor ba'i ②tshul ldan pa/ /rigs su dbye ba khyad par gang / /rigs su sgrub pa thun mong tshul/ /'di dag gsum pa'i don bstan pa'o/ /longs spyod thob bya mi gnas litshul/ /'di ni dam tshig dag par brjod/ /'dis ni dam tshig rgya mtsho yi(pe/ /sngags kyi gsang ba bsdus pa'o/ /sems ni rab tu dang bas rtse gcig rdo rje nyid du gyis/ /dam tshig gsang ba mi zad rgya mtsho rab bstan 56)na/ /de ring gatshegs chung bde bas 'gro ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /rab tu mnyam nyid rtag pa nyid du mngon du 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor thams cad bcom ldan 'dasal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /ma las (8)khams gsum sa rnams kun/ /dbang phyug de yi (9)longs spyod cing / /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rgyal sras thams cad bdag nyid yin/ /phung po 'di dag 82—765

sangs rgyas te/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub rkyen du gyur/ /gnyis med de bzhin nyid sbyor bas/ /de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchog /ma lus sangs rgyas rgyu can te/ /rgyal ba rgya 6)mtsho'i 'byung gnas sems/ /dkyil 'khor spro dang sdud pa'i gnas/ /bla na med pa tshad med mchog /mkhas brtson spro ba'i las bdag nyid / /shin tu rmad byung ye shes can/ /bla na med pa'i chen po'o/ /sems bskyed smon dang 'jug pa dang ②/ /zab dang rgya che dbyer med pa/ /mi ldog pa yi mngon gyur pas/ /khyad par 'phags pa (mitheg pa che/ /'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das pa/ /dag pa dang ni ma dag pa'i/ /ye shes ye shes khyad par che / /bsam pa zag med tshul thob pa'o④/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /bla med ye shes 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gsang ba dag pa dkyil 'khor gyi/ /ye shes dam pa bka' stsal mdzad/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i gnas nyid dang / /dpa' bo dang ni dpa' mo dang / /ston mor gyur pa nyid dang yang / /sna tshogs ston mo'i rim shes pas/ /thabs dang shes rab gsang ba yis/ /mchog tu gyur pa 'dir brjod yin/ /'dir ni nam mkha' la gnas pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su yi ge hūṃ las 957bskyed pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte ba'i cha la hūṃ gnas pa nyid de / 'og tu yo las bskyed pa'i rlung gi 6)daskyel 'khor zla gam ⑦rgyal mtshan sngo ljang gis mtshan pa'o/ /de'i steng du rlo dmar po las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa 'bar ba du mas mtshan pa rnam par bsam par bya ste/dkyil 'khor ba'i lha rnams thams cad thun mong (7du bdud rtsi myang bar bya ste/der po 99 las byung ba'i thod pa skya bo gsum gyi steng gi bar snang gi char a dkar po las byung ba'i pad ma'i snod du blta ste/ de'i nang du bkod 7pa gur gum tunye82wa 766

dang ske/ /sman dang / ga pur dang / pad+ma dang / me tog ste/ mu bi ①thu ra ma ste/ bdud rtsi lnga'i cha 'og tu glang po che dang / rta dang / ba lang rgyadang /khyi'i sha dang / sna tshogs pa'i sha ste/ ha dha go ku na ①ste so sor thabs dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid du sgyur ba ste/ hūṃ r+ghaṃ ṭ+wāṃ trī khaṃ 0steng gi cha'odu/ /i lī māṃ r+pā ṭ+wāṃ ①rnams 'og gi cha la ste yang na phyogs dang mtshams kyi cha'o/ /de dag kha dog so sor gsal bar ma 'dres par blta ste/ rdo rje las byung ba'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa dang / de'i 'od phyir log pas de nyid kyi nang du thim nas yi ge gsum mngon par bsngags te/ me'i dkyil 'khor de'i 'od 'bar ba rnams kyis de dag zhu bar gyur pa dang / dag cing skyon med par bya ba dang / dpe med pa'i ro mchog rdo rje'i mthu dang ldan zhing yongs su smin pa'i bdag nyid du mos pa ste/ de'i steng du ye shes dang ldan pa'i yi ge oṃ dkar po 'bar ba dgod par bya'o/ /de'i 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams de'i nang du yongs su thim nas/ oṃ āḥ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags las 'od tshuspro ba dang bcas pas mngon par bsngags (nyapa 'di nyid 'byung ba dang 'jug pa dang / gnas pa'i ngo bo nyid du bzlas par bya ba dang / rang nyid kyi rig ma dang gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba dang ldan pas rang gi snying gar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gsal bar dmigs te/ sbyang ba dang / spel ba dang / ye shes kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa'i bdud rtsi las blangs pa'i tshul du yi ge gsum zhu zhing 'dren pa'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'od zer gyi rnam par byon te de dag snga ma dang tshul gcig tu gyur par blta'o/ /de nas yang bdag gi thugs ka nas 82—767

'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rig ma lha mo khro bo'i tshogs du ma'i snang bar gyur pa bar snang rab tu gang ba'i tshogs thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor rnams dang bdag dang bcas pa thams cad kyi ljags la hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po nas kyi 'bru tsam pa de'i lte ba hūṃ dang bcas pa las 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs nas bdud rtsi gsol bar bya'o / /des zhi〉bdag gi lus kyi lha dang dkyil 'khor ma lus pa yongs su mchod cing mnyes te tshim par blta'o/ /'dis ni ye shes bdud rtsi'i gnas/ /bla med khyad par 'byung ba nyid/ /bdud rtsi tshim byed mchog gyur pa/ /bde ba chen pos gnas par bya/ /gang zhig bdud rtsi'i rnam pa ru/ /rab 'bab gispyi bo nas rtag tu/ /lce (snyedabang gis ni de btung (grwab/ /de las rga shi 'jig (snyebyed 'gyur/ /pad+ma'i sdong po las ji ltar/ /nus pa chu ni 'dren pa ltar/ /bcud rnams nye bar 'thung 967byas pas/ /stobs 'gyur rnal 'byor 'tsho bar byed / /gang du nang gi bdag nyid dus/ /de ni gsang ba bstan pa'o/ /nang gi 7bdag nyid can dus 'gyur/ /de nas ye shes phrin las 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das nang gi bdag nyid can gyi dus zhes gang la bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba'i bdag po nang gi bdag nyid can gyi dus zhes bya ba 'di ni gsang ba chen po shin tu gsang ba/ shin tu phra ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yin te/ de nyid rnam par mi rtog pa/ /chos nyid ye shes ches phra bas/ /de nyid rtsa las rgyu ba can/ /khong stong med pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /sems can grol byed ye shes yin/ /gsang sngags rnal 82—768

'byor dngos grub ster6)/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa dang / /dbang dang dgug pa mngon spyod la/ /drag po 'chi byed 'joms pa po/ /ye shes mngon par grub pa ste / /bcom ldan de la zhi ba gces/ /rang rig dbyings su de bzhin gshegs/ /me tog dang ni dri bzhin du/ /rten dang brten (7par dbyer med pa/ /dngos med ngo bo gcig pa'i bdag /g.yo ba med par kun tu gnas/ /de nyid 'gro snying rnam dag pa/ /ye shes phra ba'i tshul gnas pa/ /dmar dang nag dang ser po dang / /dkar po de bzhin mdor bsdus pa/ /thun phyed kyi ni dus dag tu/ /lus las 'gro dang 'ong ba dang / /gnas pas g.yo bar byed pa ni/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi ③rim bzhin du/ /nyin dang mtshan du mngon par 'byung / /de las srog 6)dang rtsol ba ru/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pas/ /dbu ma ru ni gnas pa yin/ /mi gnas de las rtog pa byung (snye/ /dge dang mi dge'i las rnams lasal/ /'khor ba mngon par sgrub pa yin/ /rtog pa dag las (6)rlung dag ste/ /ye shes kyis ni mya ngan 'das/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po de dag dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje rab tu dgyes shing tshim par gyur to/ /'di ni thabs kyi khyad par las byung ba rdo rje gsang ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu bstan pa 'di nyid do/ /bdag nyid sems dpa' gsum brtseg 7)tu/ /gnas pa gsang ba 'di 'byung ba'o/ /teng (gyi'adzin sems dpa'i cha las ni/ /'od zer dpag med phyung nas ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo gsal ba las/ /'gro ba kun la'ang thabs ldan pa'i/ /dri ma med pa'i rang bzhin gyi/ /ting nge 'dzin dngos las byung ba/ /bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gyi/ /dkyil 'khor 82—769

'khor lor gyur phyinas kyang / /de nyid ②du ni thim khyed pa'o/ /shin tu phra mor gyur nas ni/ /tsa na ka yi 'bru tsam gyi/ /thig le 'bar ba'i dbus nyid du/ /dkyil 'khor lhar bcas gyur pa dag /rten dang brten ⑧par bcas pa las/ /byung ba'i 'od zer dpag med pas/ /ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / /dam tshig dag gis bskul ba na/ /de dag las byung 'od kyis ni/ /nang du ma lus gang byas te/ /des ni kun du mtha' yas par/ /ba spu'i bu ga las byung ba'i/ /snang ba chen po dpag med pas/ /'jig rten khams kun khyab gyur te/ /slar log de nyid la zhugs gyur/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi/ /bdag nyid nye bar bsdu ba'o④/ /de yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang bcas pa thim pa mngon ⑤du gyur pa las rang gi rig ma'i chos 'byung gi pad+ma'i ge sar du gyur pa'i ze'u 'bru'i sna rtser byang chub kyi sems las bskyed ⑥pa'i rdu las gyur pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa nas tsam pa'i lte ba la nyi ma'i gdan dang bcas pa la gnas pa'i rdu las 'phro ba'i rin po che shin tu phra bar gyur pa nyungs ⑦'bru'i tshad tsam du ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin kha dog lnga dang ldan pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa ste/ de lta bu'i yungs ⑧'bru rin po che de dag gi dbus na rten dang brten ⑨par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor lnga so sor bsam ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga so so'i dkyil 'khor bye brag tu gyur pa dgod par bya'o/ /de nas spro ba dang bsdu ⑩ba la dbang thob par bya ba ste cig car ram/ rim gyis ⑩yang dang yang du bsam gtan la rnal 'byor du bya'o/ /de dag kyang rnam pa gsal tson lha'i sku dang /sgra'i de kho na nyid yig 'bru la gnas pa dang / thig le'i ngo bo phyag mtshan du gsal ba 'od kyi gong bu dang bcas pa yin no/ /'di 7nyid so sor 8rang rig 82—770

pa'i rang bzhin bde ba chen po 'dus pa'i cha las yongs su sprul pa nyid la spro ba dang bsdu bas gnas par bya'o/ /de las brtan pa nyid du gyur pa na smig rgyu dang du ba lta bu la sogs pa'i rtags rnams nges pa nyid du 'byung bar byed do/ /de nyid la bying ba dang rgod pa la sogs pa'i skyon dang bral ba'i sgo nas bsam gtan bya'o / /so so rang gis rig gyur pa/ /ye shes lnga yi gzugs gyur pas/ /brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos kun gyi/ /ma lus khyab pa'i byin brlab cing / /yul dang dbang po rnam sbyangs pas/ /'jug dang 'byung dang gnas pa dang / /bde ba chen por gyur pa'o0)/ /gsang ba ye shes bsdus pa las yongs su gsal ba skyon med pa/ /myur zhing phan tshun ma 'dres pas/ /sgra bcas phreng sngags ②brjod par bya/ /'di ni gsang ba rgyal po yi/ /lha rnams mnyes byed dngos grub ster ba'o/ /gsang sngags snying po sku gsum gyi/ /snying po yi ge'i tshul gnas pa/ /ā li kā li phreng ba las/ /sngags rnams dbyangs dang gsal byed las/ /'byung zhing 'jug par byed pa yin/ /gnas pa ye shes lam gyur pa / /bde gshegs thugs las mnyam gnas pa/ /tshul gcig par ni lam gyur pa① / /'di ni gsang ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dus pa'i 'khor la bka' stsal pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'di lta ste/ gsang sngags las (4)byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi sku spro ba dang / sdud pa dang ske/ rab tu byung ba rdo rje'i gnas bying ba (geste/ byang chub kyi sems de yang lus la mi gnas/ ngag la mi gnas sems la mi gnas so/ /chos gang khams gsum na mi gnas pa de la skye ba med de 'di ni ye shes 'byung ba rdo rje'i gnas 82—771

yin no/ /chos kun sgyu ma rmi lam ltar/ /gsang ba'i ye shes kun 'byung ba/ /mi rtog 6)rnam par mi dmigs pas/ /zag pa med pa'i tshul 'byung 'gyur/ /de las kun tu dge ba yi/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i 'od gsal dbyings/ /spros med mkha' la ②kun khyab par/ /rang byung dri med tshul 'di bstan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor rab tu gsang ba bdud rtsi dag par ston pa rgyal po'i le'u ste bdun cu rtsa drug pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs 'dus pa chen po thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das gsang ba 'dzin pa'i rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i snying po bla na med pa'i dngos grub ji ltar yang dag par 'jug /gang na gnas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub thams cad (kyemakhyen pa dang / khams gsum ji snyed pa dag rang gi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rgyud rdo rje la gnas so zhes gsungs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis slar gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i dngos grub dang / khams gsum thams cad dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dang / rang gi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i snying po gang du 82—772

gnas / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po ye shes rdo rje'i snying pos bka' stsal pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi dngos grub thams cad dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dang /khams gsum pa thams cad rang gi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje ①gsang ba sems kyi rgyud snying po ye shes ni nam mkha' la gnas pa'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol pa/ nam mkha' gang na gnas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rjes gsungs pa/ gang na'ang gnas pa ma yin no/ /de nas gzhan yang dngos grub thob pa'i gnas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos bka' stsal pa/ de la gsang ba chen po'i dngos grub thams cad thob par bya ba'i phyir dngos grub tha mal pa gang ci yang rung ba la 'tshol zhing bsten par mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di lta ste/'jig rten pa la sogs pa dag gi dngos grub dang / mngag gzhug pa don du gnyer ba'i dngos grub dang / bum pa bzang po'i dngos grub dang / sa 'og gi dngos grub dang / rgyal srid kyi (midangos grub dang / rgyas pa'i dngos grub dang / dbang du bya ba'i dngos grub dang / mngon spyod kyi dngos grub la sogs pa rnam mang ①don du gnyer bar mi bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar gsang ba chen po (pebla na med pa'i don du 'jig rten pa'i las kyi dngos grub phra mo la 'dod pa bskyed (5)par mi bya'o/ /rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi dngos grub 'ba' zhig la sems rtse gcig tu gnas par 'gyur bar bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de bzhin gshegs pa (6)thams cad kyi bdag pos lus kyi dngos grub kyi dam tshig 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las 82—773

phyung ngo / /lus kyi spyod pa ma lus pa/ /de nyid thams cad yang ①dag par/ /sku yi rdo rje las dbyung bya/ /de nyid ma lus dkyil 'khor du/ /sems can khams rnams thams cad la/ /dri med phreng bas sbyar ba'i dngos/ /rtag par dus gsum kun tu yang / /sangs rgyas skur ni byed pa'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pas/ gang ②gi dngos grub kyi dam tshig 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs ①rdo rje las phyung ngo / /brjod pa tshig gi lam rnams la/ /grag pa sgra rnams ma lus par/ /khams gsum rdo rje'i gnas la ni/ /dri med ye shes dkyil 'khor du/ /so so ④yang dag rig pa yi/ /tshig gi dngos grub bla na med/ /yid kyi sngags ni sdom ⑤pa po/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pas sems rdo rje'i dam tshig 4)dngos grub 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi ⑦rdo rje las phyung ngo / /yid kyi rtog pa ma lus pa/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin thams cad kun/ /bstan pa'i snying po gsang ba che/ /rdo rje ye shes dag pa ni/ /mi phyed gsum ldan 'od gsal ba/ /rdo rje byang chub mngon byung ba/ /thams cad stong nyid ston pa las/ /dam tshig bshad pa 'di yin no/ /kun du rdo rje sems dpa' yin)/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /sngags slob pas ni bsam gtan bya/ /bsam 6)gtan rdo rje gsum sbyor ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kun du mdzes dga' kun du rdo rje sems dpas ⑩de skad ces bka' stsal to / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs 'dus pa de dag thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur rmad du gyur nas/ /e ma'o rdo rje e rdo rje/ /e mtho (nyagasang ba che bshad pa/ /82—774

gang du lus dang ngag sems med/ /de ru gzugs ni rnam par bsgom/ /rdo rje chen po'i dbyings 'byung ba/ /de nyid yang dag ston par mdzad/ /ces gsol to / /de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ①phyag byas nas/ /rdo rje gsum gyi mchog chen po/ /rdo rje gsum gyi mchog dbang bsgyur/ /rig ②pa'i skyes bu bsgom pa yi/ /dngos grub kun nas dubashad pa mdzad/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ /gsang ba zab dang rgya che'i dbyings/ /thabs dang shes rab 'khor lo'i gtso/ /dngos grub 'dis duni bsdus pa yin/ /zhes bka' stsal to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor dpag tu med pa rnams kyi 0ched du brjod pa yang dag par bstan pa/ gang du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba ma lus pa dusnying po gcig tu yang dag par gsungs pa dzoste/ 'di ni bsod nams thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/phun sum tshogs pa'i khyad par yid bzhin ⑤gyi 6)nor bu chos bla na med pa gsang chen rdo rje'i theg pa/ phyir rgol ba thams cad kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba mi 'phrog ⑩pa/sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa yang dag par rdzogs par byed pa/ lam thams cad kyi rgyal po lasayi/ bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyis 8thub pa med cing zil gyis mi non 0pa bdud kyi rigs ma lus pa'i gnas kyi dkyil 'khor rab tu 'joms par byed pa/ kun du rgyu ba'i log srid can rnams kyis glags rnyed par mi 'gyur ba'i yul tha snyad thams cad las rnam par 'das pa/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du 8med pa'i mtshungs snyipa med cing kun las gol yiba'i don te/ gsang ba chen po'i tshul 'di bstan pa'i tshe/ /spyod pa bla na med pa 'di thos pa'o(nye/ /lha dang mi dang lha 82—775

min dbang po dang / /tshangs brtsegs rnam grol 'bras bu rab tu thob/ /gtsang ma 0)lha rnams bya ba rab tu dga'/ /dbang po tshangs pa bar snang mkha' la gnas/ /bde bar gshegs la shin tu mchod par byas/ /byang chub sems dpa' bye ba mtha' yas pa/ /bar snang gnas te rab tu dga' gyur cing / /chu yi sprin med yid du 'ong ba dag② /'gro ba'i dug sel dri zhim bdug ③par byed / / lha yi sridabang po rab bsgyur rab dang zhi/ /mkha' las lha ⑤'khor khrag khrig dpag med dang / /rim gror bcas pas gos rnams 'thor bar byed/ /yid 'ong gos brgya 96)dag gis gtor bar gyur/ /'dod par spyod pa'i lha yi (7bu mo dag /ri rab sum cu rtsa drug rdul phran gyi/ /grangs mnyam dag gis dgyes pa'i rol mos mchod/ /gzugs la spyod pa'i lha yi bu mang po/ /ri rab sum cu rtsa drug rdul mnyam pas/ /kun nas de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod de/ /rol mo brdung ba bye ba khrag khrig dag /rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor lo dpag tu med / /de snyed gsang ba 'dzin pa'i rjes 'brang zhing / /byang chub sems dpa' rnam par 'phrul pa ston/ /e ma sgra dbyangs yan lag kun 'byung ba/ /kun du bzang po'i rnam 'phrul du mar shar/ /zhing mchog gcig na bde gshegs bzhugs mdzad pa/ /zhing rnams du mar sku gzugs rab tu bstan/ /de nyid sangs rgyas stong phrag gcig nyid las/ /sangs rgyas bye phrag (nyastong ni gong du bstan / /gsung gcig gis ni rab tu gang bstan pa/ /bsam yas gang gā'i klung gi bye snyed du/ /tshul rnams mi zad chos sgra sgrogs par mdzad/ /de snyed gsang ba mchog 'di rgyas par bkang / /gang du ye shes rdo rje mi 'byung ba'i/ /ting 'dzin gcig pa nges par bzhugs nas ni/ /chos kyi dbyings las 'byung ba 82—776

du ma yi/ /ting 'dzin sgo ni nam mkha' khyab par 'byung / /sangs rgyas skus ni zhing khams khrag khrig dag /yid 'ong sna tshogs khyab pa'i ①ye shes sku/ /chos dbyings rgya chen yongs su rgyas par bkang / /ba spu gcig las bde ldan 'od bkye ba/ /'gro ba'i nyon mongs yid 'ong zhi bar spro/ /zhing gi rdul phran zad par nus 'gyur gyi/ /'di dag bgrang 2bar shes par mi nus so/ /'khor los sgyur ②ba'i dam par la las mthong / /la las sangs rgyas mtshan rab mnga' bar mthong / /la las rigs ⑥drug thub pa sprul par mthong / /zhing rnams la lar spyod pa mchog mdzad cing / /dag cing rkang gnyis zhi ba ⑤dam pa mthong / /dga' ldan gnas na mgon po bzhugs pa dang / /rgyal tshab bsko mdzad nye bar 'pho ba bstan/ /gshegs dang gzigs pa de dag rab tu bstan/ /zhing rnams bye bar yum gyi lhums 'jug dang / /zhing rnams kun du skye ba ston pa nyid/ /gzhon nu rol cing sgyu 6)rtsal gnas pas mkhas/ /pho brang btsun (7mo'i nang na bzhugs par ston/ /'gro ba'i don du mgon po nges (nye'abyung zhing / /dka' yi)thub spyad cing 'ode las ldang bar ston/ /mi g.yo go 'phang du ni gnas byas shing / /bsam gtan bskul ba mdzad dang rgyal ba thob/ /rgyal ba'i dus las bslang ba 'di dag gis/ /gsang ba mngon par byang chub de nyid bstan/ /byang chub snying po rdo rje gdan du gshegs/ /de nyid bcom ldan mngon par sangs rgyas la(ste/ /sa yi lha mo dgyes pas khyab byas shing / /bdud sde bcom pas mi 'gyur mchog gi gnas/ /gsang ba 'og min 'di ni ye shes yul/ /gnyis med rdo rje'i gnas su rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo nges legs lam bstan pa/ /mtshan nyid med pa'i tshul du gsang ba bstan/ /rgyud sde yan 82—777

lag phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /rnam pa gsum du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pas tshul 'di gsungs/ /stong pa zhi ba bdag med mtshan nyid bral / /chos nyid rang byung mkha' dang mtshungs pa las/ /rgyal bas ①don dam rab tu mi gnas pa/ /chos nyid stong nyid de bzhin nyid du ni/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i chos rnams la/ /rgyu rkyen 'bras bus grub pa yang dag lam / /kun rdzob spyod yul yin par rab tu bstan/ /zhing mang phyimatha' yas kun du de nyid ston/ /sgyu ma'i mkhan po mkhas pas gang du ni/ /'gro ba'i gzugs brnyan du ma ston pa bzhin/ /de bzhin ston pa ye shes mchog mkhyen pa//kun du 'gro ba'i don du rab tu ston/ /thams cad ma lus chos nyid de 'dra ste/ /mtshan dang mtshan gzhi mnyam pa nyid kyis 'dra/ /mtshan nyid med pa chos rnams kun gyi mchog /bde bar gshegs pa'i lam 'di thob 'dod pas/ /rtog dang rnam ①rtog ma lus spang med pas/ /gsang chen tshul 'di gang gis spyod pa ni/ /dngos dang dngos med mnyam nyid shes par gyis/ /gang du rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug du ma'i spyod yul gsang ba chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs pa med par spyod pa 'di la 'di lta ste/ gsang ba chen po bla na med pa'i tshul 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis chos thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor tshad med pa rab tu spyod pa/ gsang ba chen po chos kyi tshul/ chos kyi dbyings lta ba po med pa / chos thams cad shes pa po med par yang dag par ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa nyid du yang dag par lta ste/ ye shes kyi snang ba rab tu thob pas chos thams cad la lus med par rab tu mthong ba/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid kyi rgya mtsho la mi 82—778

gnas pa'i tshul bstan pa nyid do/ /srid pa ①dang zhi ba'i chos thams cad rab tu zhi ba nyid nam mkha' lta bur gnas pa/ 'dus byas kyi khams 'dus ma byas su mngon par spags par mi byed la/ 'dus ma byas kyi khams 'dus byas su sgro ②btags pa thams cad kyis rnam par mi rtog par gnas pa ste/ 'di nyid sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin brlabs ①pa/ /bsod nams yongs su rgyas pa dag pa'i zhing ske/ /snang ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa'i 'od zer ni/ /skye dgu kun gyi blo yi ④'char byed pa/ /gang du sku gsung thugs kyi snang ba ni/ /rnam par gsal ba sgrib ⑤pa med pa nyid/ /chos rnams kun la yang dag rab 'jug cing / /chos kyi dbyings las ye shes 'bral med pa/ /lus ngag yid gnas kun gyi rjes 'gro ba'i / /skad cig nyid la bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /skad cig thog mtha' med par rab ston pa/ /'di ni ye shes mi zad 'byung gnas kyi/ /tshul la gnas pa gsang ba'i spyod tshul lo/ /brtan pas kun du rtog pa rab zhi ba/ /'di ni mi gnas gsang ba'i 6)spyod yul 'thob/ /sems can rgyud na'ang mi spyod ma yin te / /'di 'dra'i ye shes dam pa khong du chud(7)/ /de la kun du rtog dang mi rtog med / /blo mchog de dang 'gro kun kha lo sgyur(kyi/ /rnam par smin pas gos med nam mkha' bzhin/ /'jig rten thams cad rgyu dang bcas pas na/ /chos rnams kun du rgyu med bstan pa min/ /'di nyid rab dang 'bring dang tha ma yi /phyogs bcur ye shes bzhugs pa'i byang chub tshul/ /gsang ba po)dam pa'i spyod yul 'di bstan pa'o/ /chos thams cad kyi gnas ye shes kyi yul sangs rgyas thams cad 7kyi rab 'byam (1tshad med pa'i rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga las mngon par 'byung ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo 82—779

rje'i snying po'i dkyil 'khor las/ yang dag pa'i thugs rje chen po'i ngang las ye shes kyi sprin rdo rjes kun du khyab par spro ba dang sdud pa'i tshul gyis gang du mi gnas shing rang 'byung chen po'i byang chub kyi sems rdo rje/ chos kyi dbyings nam mkha' dang mnyam pa dbyings dang ye shes dbyer 0)med par ngo bo nyid dmigs su med pa nyid du ston to/ /de nas dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa sangs rgyas thams cad ②kyi 'gyur ba med pa'i ngo bo nyid rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs zhi)te/ byang chub kyi sems kyi gsang ba mi zad pa'i tshul 'di gsungs so/ /gsang ba spros med 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang / /kun du ma khyiskyes skye med dga' ba'i (57dbyings/ /bde chen ro mnyam rgyal ba kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun rang bzhin yongs su mnyam pa nyid/ /mngon par chags med mi gnas ye shes las/ /rlom sems med pa'i chos nyid skye ba med/ /ye shes chos kyi sgo yi ting nge 'dzin/ /nam mkha'i chos nyid 'byam klas thogs med pa/ /byang chub sems ldan bde gshegs spyod yul can/ /rdo rje lta bu'i gnas las bstan pa dang / /phyir mi ldog pa ye shes 'byung gnas nyid/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med 'bras bu'i yul / /grangs med gzhal du med pa'i don 'byung ba'o/ /'di dag kyang ji ltar rtogs /ne par bya ba yin zhe na/ rnam par 'phrul pa'i sa khong du chud pa/'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rjes su song zhing rjes su chags pa med par spyod pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa'i chos kyi tshul la (7)chos su rtogs pas gnas pa med pa sems bskyed pa shin tu yangs pas rnam par thar pa'i sgo du ma rab tu thob pa/ ye shes gcig nas gcig tu brgyud (8)pa'i rgyud la mkhas pa/ don gcig nas gcig tu bstan pa rab tu 'jug pa bla na med pa'i ye shes dam pa'i 82—780

spyod yul yin par rig par bya'o/ /de nas ①bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i bdag po la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gsang ba chen po'i rgyud 'dir gsang ba'i yi ge de ⑤dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dam tshig gi spyod pa'i rdo rje 'di la dad cing bsgom par 'gyur/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin pas de dag la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gsang ba'i yi ge gsum dang ldan na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi gsang chen gyi spyod pa rdo rje gang yin pa 'di la dad cing bsgom par 'gyur ro/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol pa / gsang ba'i yi ge gang zhig lags/ dpal rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i gsang ba chen po'i rdo rje dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung (kyegi gsang ba chen po'i rdo rje dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi (gegasang ba chen po'i rdo rje ste/ de dag nyid do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po la phyag 'tshal zhing 'dud (snyenas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin / /kun mchog ye shes ston mdzad pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas / /gsang ba dam pa bka' stsal to/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mi gsungs shing / /don chen 'bras bu lam gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gsang ba'i 82—781

rgyudam/ /rdo rje 'chang gis sbas pa nyid/ /u dum bā ①ra'i me tog bzhin/ /'jig rten du ni rnyed dka' phyib/ /kun gyi rtsa bar gyur pa'i mdo/ /gsang ba 'dus pa chen po yin/ /dbyings gyur khams gsum gsang ba che/ /de nyid bde bar 'gyur bsams pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyi gnas mtshan pas/ /ting 'dzin rdo rje khyu mchog dgyes/ /thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa/ /'di ni gang zhig gnas byed pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i grags chen rnams/ /zhag bdun gyis 57ni phun tshogs pa'i/ /sku gsum dngos grub 'dir thob 'gyur/ /bcom ldan sku gsung thugs gsang ba/ /rdo rje bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /dri med ye shes 'byung ba yi/ /khyad par mchog 'di phyung ba'o/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig ni/ /phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs pa/ /cho ga bzhin du kun bsgoms na / /skad cig gis ni sangs rgyas 'thob/ /gsang ba'i don 'di 'byung dka' ④ba'i / /bla med bde chen mi 'gyur ba/ /'di ni snying po bsdus pa ste/ /gzhan du 'byung bar 'gyur ba min/ /'on kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba 'dus pa chen po 'di la skad cig thang cig yud tsam gyis gnas na sangs rgyas kyi byang chub rdzogs par byed do/ / bskal pa ⑤gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed thams cad du byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 'bad cing rtsol kyang byang chub thob par mi 'gyur ba de dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la dga' ba'i byang chub sems dpas tshe 'di nyid la de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro'o/ /de dag shin tu dkon gyur pa/ /rnam grangs 'di na 97bstan pa'i tshe/ /de tshe byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /shin tu gdung bas cher non te/ /gsang chen bskal pa ngan gyur ces/ /dus gcig 82—782

bstan pa nyid gcig dang / /ston pa gcig las gzhan pa yi/ /spyod yul ma gyur de yi tshe/ /ji ltar thabs 'di ston byed 'gyur/ /ming tsam du yang mi thos na / /gzhan ci smos lta ga la dgos/ /de nyid kun du bsgrags gyur pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bka' stsal pa/ de skad ces ma zer cig /yi ge 'di kun dang thun mong ste/ rigs kyi bu khyed rnams kyis ji ltar mi shes pa dang glu/ ma thob pa de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa tshams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi gsang ba'i yi ge 'di dag ma thob cing mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/gsang ba'i yi ge ni rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad cang mi smra bar gnas par gyur to/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos gsang ba'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po mnyam pa nyid la rnam par dgongs nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas yang brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i byang chub ①sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos 'di ci'i slad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi nang na cang mi gsung bar bzhugs/de skad ces gsol pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ②byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bdag po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi bdag 82—783

po 'di ci'i slad du sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid las dmigs su med pa'i yi ge'i tshogs la ngo bo nyid med pa'i yi ge'i tshig brjod nas cang mi gsung bar bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad tu)kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas lha mo bzhi dag gis/ /tshad med ye shes dag pa'i sa/ /yang dag bskul ba mdzad pa las/ /de bzhin nyid las bzhengs par 'gyur/ /dpag med rdo rje'i tshul mchog las/ /'dod chags gnas la spyod pa yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs na/ /btsun mo'i tshogs dang lhan cig skyes/ /dam tshig 'khor lor gnas pa yis/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod nyer ldan pas/ /gnyis med byang chub sems gnas te/ /dgyes pa yongs su spyod pa mdzad/ /de nas rdo rje'i lus kyi ni/ /rtsa yi khong stong thams cad du/ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dang / /yon tan phrin las dam tshig gi/ /khu ba byang chub sems rgyun (gegyis/ /kun tu khyab par gyur pa ni/ /dper na bum pa chus gang ltar/ /shin tu bde bas rgyas ①par gnas/ /de nyid ye shes gyur pa'o/ /de nas chos kyi dbyings gnas pa'i/ /'gro ba'i phung po ji snyed 0)kun/ /sku gsum dam tshig las byung ba/ /de la bdud rtsi'i 'od zer gyis/ /glog 57gi zer ma ltar 'phro bas/ /shin tu bde bar rig nas ni/ /de nas brtsams te sems can khams/ /ma lus lus pa med pa la/ /rdo rje dpal gyi reg byung bas/ /yang dag mchog tu byin brlabs shing / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /ye shes dri med dbang bskur 767cing / /ma lus kun kyang kun tu bzang / /kun tu bzang po'i 82—784
