dpal zhes par/ /bla na med par dbang bskur to/ /de ltar dbang bskur 0)tsam gyis ni/ /thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku/ /dgra bcom yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes can/ /bde chen ngo bo nyid skur gyur / /rdo rje 'dzin gyis bka' stsal pa/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi / /ye shes spyod pa mthong gyur pas / /chos nyid mnyam pa nyid mthong ngam/ /slar gsol ba ni mthong lags so/ /ye shes spyod pa rdo rje che/ /bde bar gshegs pa mthong zhes gsol/ /de ltar yang dag gyur pa'o(5)/ /de ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kun/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga las/ /mngon par byung nas li 'di skad gsol/ /gang du 'dod chags chen po yi/ /yi ge'i tshogs kyis sangs rgyas kyi/ /byang chub rjes su rtogs gyur gang / /de nas bcom ldan ngo mtshar to/ /bde bar gshegs pa ngo mtshar to/ /de nas rigs kyi bdag po yis / /gsang ba mchog tu bka' stsal pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun / /de skad ces ni ma zer cig /de nyid ci yi (5)phyir zhe na/ /chos rnams (phyinanam mkha'i rdo rje'i gnas/ /de nyid mtshungs phyir stong pa nyid/ /rab tu mi gnas bdag nyid las/ /chos rnams 'od gsal dbyings gyur pa/ /de nyid ye shes 'byung gnas gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par dag pa'i mnyam pa nyid spyod pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /snyoms par zhugs nas kyang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / rig ma dang / lha mo 82—785

dang ske/ khro bo'i rgyal po du ma dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi ①'khor lo la bzhugs nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje 'dzin pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad la bka' stsal pa/ khyed rnams kyis phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i gsang ba 'di bgo bar gyis shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ phyogs bcu na gnas pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de rnams chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la skal ba yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dam tshig rdo rje 'di nyid zung cig② /khyod kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rdo rje snying po dbang phyug gsang ba'i rgyal po zhes bya bar dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying pos de bzhin du bgyi'o② / /zhes gsol nas/ cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /gsang ba'i rgyal po'i sku gcig las/ /zhing khams ma lus snang mdzad cing / /khams gsum spyod dang sangs rgyas kyi/ /rnam pa du ma'i skur bstan mdzad/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad khams gsum nyid kyi lus rdo rje la gnas shing /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ④sku'i ye shes mnyam pa nyid la dgongs nas/cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /gsang ba 'dzin pa'i gsung gcig gis/ /'jig rten khams kun khyab gyur cing / /chos kyi tshul ni mi zad las/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i 'khor lo bskor/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gsung rdo rje 'di ⑤82—786

dpag tu med pa khams gsum pa thams cad kyi ngag rdo rje la gnas shing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung mnyam pa nyid la gnas nas/ cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /rdo rje 'chang gi thugs kyi ni/ /ting 'dzin gcig tu ma bzhag ①nas/ /ting 'dzin du ma'i chos kyi sgo/ /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sems rdo rje la gnas shing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs mnyam pa nyid la dmigs nas/ cang mi gsung bar gyur to②/ /'dir snang ba ni gsum ste/ so so'i skye bo'i snang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i snang ba dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snang ba'o/ /gsang ba ni gsum ste(mi/ sku'i gsang ba bsam ④gyis mi khyab pa dang / /gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang /thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ni gsum stephyi / sku rdo rje thams cad mkhyen pa dang / gsung rdo rje thams cad mkhyen pa dang ske/ thugs rdo rje thams cad mkhyen pa'o/ /mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo ni gsum ste/ sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo dang / gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo dang / thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo nyid do/ /rgyud kun snying po bsdus pa yi/ /phyag rgya chen po'i ngang 'byung ba/ /grub pa rab tu mi gnas pas / /gsang ba'i rgyal po bstan pa yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa chen po bla na med pa mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i gnas rab tu rgyas pa chen po bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ gsang ba brjod du med pa'i gnas la dgongs nas/ cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas de 82—787

bzhin gshegs pa'i ①tshogs dpag tu med pa de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brjod du med pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dang ske/ lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs ②te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa dul mngon par bstod do// //dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs bcu'i gnas kyi zhing khams rdul phra rab snyed dubazhugs shing 'tsho duskyong ba thams cad kyi gsang chen⑥/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun du bzang po la sogs pa/ bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed brjod kyis ⑦mi lang ba'i yang brjod kyis mi lang ba rnams kyi (8)dgongs pa rab tu gsang ba/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa thams cad kyi/ shin tu gsang ba'i gnas kyi rgyal po/ rdo rje dpal mchog chen po nges par brjod pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba thun mong po)ma yin pa'i ye shes kyi 'byung gnas/ rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid/ rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba mchog tu dbang skur tibar byed pa / rgyud sde stong phrag sum cu rtsa bzhi'i snying po/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod rgya mtsho'i gnas las mngon par bsngags (nyupa/ rtog kyipa'i rgyal po bdun pa chos thams cad la bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don bstan pa'i le'u ste bdun cu rtsa bdun pa'o / / //du la k+ṣe tu tra'i grong khyer chen por rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal ye shes snying po dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba mar pa lho brag pa chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pali// //82—788

paṇ+ḍi ②ta mkhas pa chen po smṛ ti ②dz+nyā na bīrtis rang 'gyur byas pa cig kyang yod par gda'o// //e ma ho nyi zla ltar grags dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rgyud/ /gsang ba rnal 'byor dpal mchog chen po 'dis/ /shin tu gsal bar ston pa nges pa nyid/ /ma 'ongs dus su rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog /rnam bzhi'i 'khor ldan dbus su 'di gsal 'gyur/ /bstan pa'i sgron me nyid du 'byung ba'i phyir/ /skal ldan rnams dang rgyud 'di 'phrad ①par shog /rgyud 'di u rgyan nas slob dpon chen po khom bi he ru gas gdan drangs ④gsung ngo rdzogs sobya// //⑥bsdur mchan/266 6)mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉dza a/ ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉ba/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉kalpa ā/ 〈〈khu 〉〉kalnga/ ⑤〈〈li 〉〉 cad/⑥〈〈khu 〉〉yis/ ⑦〈〈li 〉〉gsungs/ (nye〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gsungs/267 7〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉lha/ ②〈〈khu 〉〉ci/268 6)〈〈khu 〉〉bo'i/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉byung / ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bsang /269 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉 ta tha da dha na/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉ri rī/ li lī/ a i au me aḥ/ 〈〈pe 〉〉2 rī/ bla lī/a i/ )sne /( a i/ 9)〈〈khu1 〉〉dbyings/ (ge〈〈khu1 〉〉theg27༷ 6)〈〈g.yung 〉〉po/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉kyi/ ③〈〈g.yung 〉〉 med/ ④〈〈co 〉〉khyad/ ⑤〈〈khu 〉〉bsdus/271 ①〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bsgrub/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉rigs/ ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉cha/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉rten/ ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉yid rang te/ 〈〈li 〉〉yi rang te/ 〈〈pe 〉〉yid rang ste/ 〈〈co 〉〉yi rang ste/6)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉brjod/272 0)〈〈co 〉〉po'i/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉cha'i/ ①〈〈khu 〉〉 'dzin la/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sgrin ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 / (6)( nye〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sgrika (kye6)〈〈sayung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉krita/ ⑩〈〈co 〉〉pad mār ta/ (nye〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉krita/ (nye〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉82wa 789
